question: How can I add store listing details for my branded app in the Google Play and Apple App Store?
answer:
To add your store listing details in the Google Play and Apple App Store, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Branded Mobile App tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Your%20Branded%20App%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/mobile-app?activeTab=branded) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down and click **Set up app store listings for your app.**
3. Click **Get Started** under the store listing you want to set up first: **Google Play** or **Apple App Store**.
4. Add a name and icon that members see in the app store. 
   
   **Note:** If you have already set up your name and icon, they will appear by default.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Describe your app with a promotional text and then add a description of your app's main features and functionality.
7. Complete the Discoverability details to help members find your app in the App Stores. Follow the steps below based on the store:

### Google Play Store
- Select a category that best fits your app and choose up to 5 tags to describe your app and the in-app experience. Then click **Save & Continue**.

### Apple App Store
- Add discoverability details about your app:
  * **Subtitle (Optional):** Summarize your app's value with a subtitle.
  * **Categories:** Assign one or two categories to help members find your app:
    + **Primary category:** Choose the main category for your app. Learn more about [choosing the right category for your app](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/categories/).
    + **Secondary category (Optional):** Choose a second category for your app in the App Store.
  * **Keywords:** Add words that enhance your app's visibility in search results.
  * **Support and info:** Add links and copyright details:
    + **Support URL:** Add a URL with support information for your app.
    + **Marketing URL (Optional):** Direct members to a page with additional marketing info about your app.
    + **Copyright:** Add the year the rights to this app were obtained, and the name of the person or entity that owns them.

   **Note:** If you don't see the optional details, you'll be able to access them when editing your discoverability later on.

question: How can I customize images carried over from the desktop version on my Wix mobile site?

question: How can I verify my site with Web of Trust to ensure it is marked as safe?
answer:
To verify your site with Web of Trust, follow these steps:

1. Go to [https://www.mywot.com/](https://www.mywot.com/) and sign up.
2. Enter the following into your address bar: `https://www.mywot.com/en/claim-site?target=**your-site-URL**`. 
   
   For example: `https://www.mywot.com/en/claim-site?target=https://mystunningwebsite.wixsite.com/mystunningwebsite`.
3. Enter your site URL and click **Claim and Verify**.
4. Copy the meta tag code from the text box under **Paste Meta Tag**.
5. Keep Web of Trust open in your browser and create a new tab.
6. In the new tab:
   
   1. Go to [Tracking & Analytics](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Tracking%20and%20Analytics&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website/embeds/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
   2. Click **+ New Tool** at the top right.
   3. Click **Verification Code** in the drop-down menu.
   4. Paste the meta tag code in the text box and click **Apply**.
7. Go back to Web of Trust and click **Verify** to complete the process.

**Note:** After verifying your site, other users of Web of Trust must rank your site and mark it as safe in order for your site to be marked as safe by Web of Trust.

question: What are some best practices for using Wix's generative AI tools responsibly?
answer:
To use Wix's generative AI tools responsibly, consider the following best practices:

* Always recheck generated AI outputs to confirm that they meet your expectations and that the information is accurate, and reflects your intention. It is recommended to approach each output with a critical eye and verify any factual information before publishing it on your website.
* Note that while the content was generated by AI, you are still responsible for the content, so make sure that the content complies with [Wix’s Content Guidelines](https://www.wix.com/about/content-guidelines).
* Be mindful of possible biases within AI-generated content and edit as necessary to align with your values and intended purposes.
* Avoid creating or promoting deepfake content or misinformation, as it can damage your credibility and be harmful to your site visitors or others.
* Do not copy or use others’ content as part of your input without permission, as this may cause the AI tools to generate copyrighted material.
* Avoid using AI outputs that appear too similar to existing works of art, paintings, or trademarks and logos of other companies.
* Consider editing the AI outputs to ensure that the final result is uniquely your own.
* Don’t use others’ personal information as part of your input without consent and permission.
* Check the output to see if it includes personal details or real individuals, and consider changing identifying details if they appear in the generated content.
* Consider informing your site’s visitors that some content was AI-generated, to provide transparency and maintain trust.
* As always when using Wix, ensure you comply with your local and applicable laws, regulations and policies.

question: How can I create an automated response for product purchases in Wix Stores?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to your Wix site's dashboard.

To create an automated response for product purchases in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Set up the trigger
The trigger is what sets the automation in motion. In this case, the trigger will be "order placed".

#### To set up the automation trigger:
1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **\+ New Automation.**
3. Click **\+ Start from Scratch** on the left.
4. Click the title at the top to give the automation a name.
5. Select **Wix Stores** from the available options.
6. Select **Order placed**.

### Step 2 | (Optional) Add a delay
Consider the best time to send the automated response. You may get better results by sending your message a week or two later.

#### To set when the automation is sent:
1. Click **Add Delay**.
2. Select Days, Hours, or Minutes.
3. Enter the number.

### Step 3 | Select products
Choose the products that trigger this automation by choosing a condition. You can select up to 50 products per automation.

#### To select which products trigger the response:
1. Click **\+Add Condition**.
2. Select **Line items** from the first drop-down.
3. Select **Includes any of** from the second drop-down.
4. Select the relevant products.

### Step 4 | Choose the automated response
Wix offers a variety of ways to respond to clients after a trigger is activated. Choose whether you want to send an email, a chat message, or maybe email your customer a coupon to encourage them to make another purchase.

**Important:** If you're sending an email, make sure to customize the message and design your email to suit your brand.

**Learn more about:**
* [Customizing automated emails](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-customizing-automated-emails#editing-your-email-template)
* [Creating new automations](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-3-choose-an-action)

To connect Grow by Meshulam as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Grow by Meshulam.
4. Depending on whether you have an account with Meshulam or need to create a new one, follow the steps:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your Licensed Business, Password and Installments.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s).

question: What are the limitations of the Wix Music Player and how can I set it up on my site?
answer:
The Wix Music Player can play one single, album, or playlist. The limitations are as follows:

- **Album:** Up to 30 tracks per album.
- **Single:** Up to 5 tracks per single.
- **Playlist:** Up to 500 tracks per playlist.

**Note:** Wix Music is not yet available in the Studio Editor. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, you can [vote for that feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-request-adding-wix-music).

To set up the Wix Music Player, you can follow the instructions in the article [Adding and Setting Up Wix Music](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-wix-music).

question: How can I send a 30-second music track preview to my fans using Wix Email Marketing?
answer:
To send a 30-second music track preview to your fans using Wix Email Marketing, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Music Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20My%20Music&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/music/).
2. Select the song you want to promote.
3. Click **Edit Track Info**.
4. Scroll down and select **Fans can listen to a 30 sec preview** from the **Track Streaming Options** drop-down menu.
5. Click **Save** on the top right.
6. Go to your [Email Marketing Dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Email%20Marketing&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fshoutout%2F).
7. Hover over the **Promote Your Music** template.
8. Click **Use Template**.
9. Click on the music player in your email.
10. Select the preview song from the **Set Player Music** drop-down menu.
11. Choose to display a light or dark theme music player.
12. Design the rest of your email. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-customizing-your-email-campaign)
13. Click **Next**.
14. Add your recipients.
15. Click **Publish.**

Fans will be redirected to your site from the email they receive to listen to the preview.

question: How can I connect a subdomain to an external resource using Wix?
answer:
To connect a subdomain to an external resource using Wix, follow these steps:

1. **Contact the host of the external resource/site** (e.g., WordPress) and ask for the DNS records required to point to the resource/site.
2. [Go to Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page in your Wix account. 

   **Note**: If you have multiple domains in your account, scroll to the main domain of the subdomain you're connecting (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com for connecting blog.mystunningwebsite.com).
3. Click the More Options icon on the right and select **Manage DNS Records**.
4. **Add the DNS records** (e.g., A or CNAME records) you received from your resource/site host:
   
   1. Click **\+ Add Record** under the relevant A (Host) or CNAME (Aliases) section.
   2. Click **Got it** in the pop-up message.
   3. Edit the **Host Name** field with the name of your subdomain (e.g. 'blog'). Edit the **Value** field for each record you need to add. 
      
      **Note:** Leave the **Host Name** field blank if instructed to add an **@** sign in it.
   4. Click **Save**, then click **Save Changes** in the pop-up message.
   5. Repeat step 4 for each DNS record you need to add.

**Note:** It may take up to **48 hours** for your subdomain to propagate. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation)

question: Why isn't my website appearing on the first page of Google even after completing the SEO Setup Checklist?
answer:
Completing the SEO Setup Checklist helps improve your site's SEO so it can be crawled and indexed by search engines, but it doesn’t automatically guarantee that your website will show up on the first page of Google for your keywords. Google uses many factors to determine which websites to display on results pages, such as the age of your site, the number of websites linking to you, and the location of the searcher.

Here are some things to consider:

### An indexed site is different from a high ranking
Just because Google has crawled and indexed your site, doesn’t mean you will show up high in search results. If your market is very competitive, your website may show up on Google somewhere in the long list of results for your keywords, but it may be on the 10th, 50th, or 100th page of results.

### Make sure you've chosen the right keywords
Quality content is essential to ranking higher in Google. If you are not ranking on Google for your keywords, reconsider your list of target keywords. Use your keywords in your domain, headlines, text on each page, and as alt text in images.

### Generate traffic to your site by creating fresh content and backlinks
Google favors sites with well-written and frequently updated content. Regularly publishing blog posts and getting backlinks from relevant or reputable sites can improve your online reputation and credibility.

### Be patient - Ranking high in Google takes time and effort
SEO is a long-term strategy, and changes rarely happen within days or even weeks. Once you’ve chosen great keywords to target, put fresh content on your website as often as possible.

For additional tips and ideas to optimize your site, [check our SEO Learning Hub](https://www.wix.com/seo/learn?utm_source=kb).

question: Can I have unique IDs for each widget instance when I add the same widget multiple times on a Wix site?
answer: Currently, when you install a blocks app on a site and add a widget to the canvas more than once, all instances of that widget will have the same **instanceId**. The **instanceId** is a property in the object returned by the [getDecodedAppInstance()](https://dev.wix.com/docs/velo/api-reference/wix-application/get-decoded-app-instance) in the [wix-application](https://dev.wix.com/docs/velo/api-reference/wix-application/introduction) module. This feature would allow you to distinguish between multiple widget instances on the same site.

question: What are the best practices for creating image ads on Facebook?
answer:
To create effective image ads on Facebook, follow these best practices:

1. **Showcase your product and/or service with your image:** Capture your brand essence with a clear picture that showcases your product or the benefits of your service. Someone viewing your ad should immediately understand what you're advertising without having to search for the point of the ad in the photo.

2. **Use high resolution images:** The better resolution your images are, the more professional your ad will look. Follow the [image formatting guidelines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-best-practices-for-creating-image-and-video-ads#formatting-guidelines-for-images-and-videos) to ensure your image doesn't turn out blurry or pixelated.

3. **Don't crowd the image with text:** Your ad's text should be kept to the headline, description, and call-to-action. Don't try to add text on top of the image. However, if you need to add text on top of your image, follow these guidelines:
   * Keep the text minimal and to a corner of the image rather than spread across it.
   * Stick to the 20% rule: Facebook research found that image ads with less than 20% text perform better.

4. **Use the correct URL formatting:** When linking your store or services to your ad, make sure you're using the right URL format so the link doesn't break.
   * If you're linking to a specific page of your site, make sure it's part of your main domain (www.mystore.com/page) and that it's an exact match of the page name.
   * The URL must begin with https://www or http://www.
   * Do not include spaces or special characters in the URL.

   **Tip:** When adding a URL to your ad (classic ads only), you can also click the **Set Destination URL** drop-down to choose from all the existing URLs on your site. You won't be able to select URLs from password-protected pages.

Learn more about Facebook's [recommendations for image ads](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/388369961318508?id=1240182842783684).

question: How can I track the performance of my paid ad campaigns in Wix Analytics if I'm running them outside of Wix?
answer:
To track the performance of your paid ad campaigns in Wix Analytics when running them outside of Wix, you need to complete two steps:

1. **Connect to Facebook/Google:**
   - Click **Connected platforms** under **Amount spent** and **CPC**.
   - Click **Connect** next to the relevant account.
   - Follow the prompts to connect your account.

2. **Create a UTM tracking link and add it as the destination URL of your external ad:**
   - Click **Create a UTM tracking link**.
   - Fill out the relevant information including:
     1. Adding your Wix site page URL (the page you want to open when the ad is clicked).
     2. Selecting a traffic source (e.g. Facebook, Google, other).
        - **Note**: If you select Facebook or Google, the remaining fields are automatically populated.
     3. (Optional) Adding your campaign ID and/or campaign name to get breakdowns by campaign.
        - **Note:** You will find this information inside the dashboard of the external platform you are running a campaign on (e.g. Google Ads).
   - Once the information is filled out, a unique tracking link appears at the bottom of the link builder. Click **Copy** to copy the link.
   - Open the external ad platform (e.g. Google Ads) and paste the new tracking link as the destination URL in your ad.

Once you have connected your Facebook and/or Google account(s) and added a UTM tracking link for external campaigns, you will be able to see all available data at the top of the paid ad campaign section. **Note:** The data begins from the moment you added the tracking link to the ad.

question: What are the key elements that should be included in a website's Terms and Conditions policy?
answer:
When creating a Terms and Conditions policy for a website, it is important to cover several key elements:

1. **Website Owner, Offering, and Binding of Terms:** Clearly state the owner of the website, what the website offers, and that the Terms are a binding agreement upon the users.
   
   **Sample:**
   *This website is owned and operated by \[name of your website operator]. These Terms set forth the terms and conditions under which you may use our website and services as offered by us. This website offers visitors \[description of what is offered on your website]. By accessing or using the website of our service, you approve that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms.*

2. **Who Can Use Your Website; Requirements to Create an Account:** Define who is entitled to use the website and the requirements for opening an account.
   
   **Sample:**
   *In order to use our website and/or receive our services, you must be at least \[add number] years of age, or of the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction, and possess the legal authority, right and freedom to enter into these Terms as a binding agreement. You are not allowed to use this website and/or receive services if doing so is prohibited in your country or under any law or regulation applicable to you.*

3. **Key Commercial Terms Offered to Customers:** Include the main commercial terms for purchasing or licensing services or products.
   
   **Sample:**
   *When buying an item, you agree that: (i) you are responsible for reading the full item listing before making a commitment to buy it: (ii) you enter into a legally binding contract to purchase an item when you commit to buy an item and you complete the check-out payment process.*

4. **Return and Refund Policy:** Present the product return policy and refund policy to comply with consumer protection regulations.
   
   **Sample:**
   *For any undamaged product, simply return it with its included accessories and packaging along with the original receipt (or gift receipt) within 14 days of the date you receive the product, and we will exchange it or offer a refund based upon the original payment method.*

5. **Retention of Right to Change Offering:** Include wording allowing the owner to change the services and products offered on the website.
   
   **Sample:**
   *We may, without prior notice, change the services; stop providing the services or any features of the services we offer; or create limits for the services.*

6. **Warranties & Responsibility for Services and Products:** Define the responsibility in relation to the services or products offered.
   
   **Sample:**
   *When we receive a valid warranty claim for a product purchased from us, we will either repair the relevant defect or replace the product.*

7. **Ownership of Intellectual Property, Copyrights, and Logos:** Retain all rights and emphasize that visitors and customers are not granted any such rights.
   
   **Sample:**
   *The Service and all materials therein or transferred thereby, including, without limitation, software, images, text, graphics, logos, patents, trademarks, service marks, copyrights, photographs, audio, videos, music and all Intellectual Property Rights related thereto, are the exclusive property of \[>>Name of website owner<<].*

8. **Right to Suspend or Cancel User Account:** Retain the ability to suspend or cancel a user's account to avoid misuse or illegal activity.
   
   **Sample:**
   *We may permanently or temporarily terminate or suspend your access to the service without notice and liability for any reason.*

9. **Indemnification:** Include indemnity obligations to protect the website from damages caused by users.
   
   **Sample:**
   *You agree to indemnify and hold \[website owner] harmless from any demands, loss, liability, claims or expenses (including attorneys’ fees), made against them by any third party due to, or arising out of, or in connection with your use of the website or any of the services offered on the website.*

10. **Limitation of Liability:** Limit the potential liability the website owner may face.
    
    **Sample:**
    *To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, in no event shall \[website owner], be liable for any indirect, punitive, incidental, special, consequential or exemplary damages.*

11. **Right to Change and Modify Terms:** Retain the ability to change or modify the Terms at the website owner’s discretion.
    
    **Sample:**
    *We reserve the right to modify these terms from time to time at our sole discretion.*

12. **Promotional Emails and Content:** Obtain user consent before sending promotional messages.
    
    **Sample:**
    *You agree to receive from time to time promotional messages and materials from us.*

13. **Preference of Law and Dispute Resolution:** Define the laws and regulations governing the website and the jurisdiction for disputes.
    
    **Sample:**
    *These Terms, the rights and remedies provided hereunder, and any and all claims and disputes related hereto and/or to the services, shall be governed by, construed under and enforced in all respects solely and exclusively in accordance with the internal substantive laws of \[Name of Country / State].*

question: How can I add a scroll animation to an element in the Wix Studio Editor?
answer:
To add a scroll animation in the Wix Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Select the relevant element or section.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
3. Click the **Animations and Effects** tab.
4. Click **\+ Add** under **Scroll**.
5. Set up the animation:
   
   1. Choose which element shows the animation under **Animated element**.
   2. Select an option under **Animation type** to decide if the element animates into or out of its original placement:
      
      * **In:** The animation's ending point is the current design on canvas (e.g. the element fades in as you scroll down).
      * **Out:** The animation's starting point is the current design on canvas (e.g. the element fades out as you scroll down).
   3. Select an animation from the list. 

   **Tip:** Hover over animations to see a preview of how they look.

**Notes:**
* It is not possible to set a [pinned](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-pinning-elements-and-sections) element as the trigger, as it always stays in the same position (relative to the visitor's viewport).
* Make sure there's enough room on the page for the scroll animation to appear properly. For example, if your element is located on the first or last fold of the page, you might not see the scroll animation.

question: How can I change the settings of a strip background in Wix Editor?
answer:
To change your strip settings in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the strip.
3. Click **Change Strip Background**.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Customize your strip type using the options available:

### Color settings
- Click the color box to select a new color for your strip background. Then drag the slider to adjust the strip's transparency to perfectly suit your site's design.

### Image settings
- **Image Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the image and expose some elements that the strip covers.
- **Color Behind Image:** Choose a color to appear behind your image when you lower the opacity of the image.
- **How's the image scaled?:** Enlarge or reduce the size of the strip's image.
  - **Original Size:** The original size image is displayed. Parts of it may be cut off.
  - **Scale to Fill:** The image is resized to fill the available space. You may want to reposition it.
  - **Tile:** The image is displayed in tile formation across the available space.
- **Where is it positioned?:** Select a section of the grid to choose which part of your image is in focus within the confines of your strip.
- **Image Text:** Add a description of your strip image to improve your site's SEO and accessibility.

### Video settings
- **Want to add an overlay pattern?:** Choose a cool overlay pattern that sits on top of your background video. Click **Darker** or **Lighter** to change the contrast of the overlay.
- **Video opacity:** Drag the slider to make the video more or less visible.
- **Color behind video:** Select the color that's behind the video background.
- **Where's the video positioned?:** Select a section of the grid to choose which part of your video is in focus within the confines of your strip.
- **How does the video play?:**
  - **Play Speed:** Choose to play your video at its original speed (normal) or at 0.5 / 0.25 times the original speed.
  - **Play in a loop:** Click the toggle to enable automatic looping of your background.

### Tip
We recommend that you play around with the settings and [preview your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-saving-previewing-and-publishing-your-site#previewing-your-site) to see what looks best.

question: What are the guidelines for creating a user name in Google Workspace?
answer:
To create a user name in Google Workspace, follow these guidelines:

- User names can be between 1 and 64 characters in length.
- User names may contain any of the following: letters (a - z), numbers (0 - 9), dashes (-), underscores (_), apostrophes ('), and periods (.).
- User names may **not** contain any of the following: ampersands (&), equal signs (=), brackets (< >), plus signs (+), commas (,), or more than one period (.) in a row.
- User names may **not** begin or end with a period (.), nor can a period (.) be the only character.

question: How can I recover my Wix account if I forgot the email address I used to sign up?
answer:
If you can't remember the email address you used to create your Wix account, you can recover your account in two ways:

### Recovering Your Login Email Using the Wix Email Locator

1. Go to the [email locator](https://users.wix.com/account-recovery/enter-website).
2. Enter the URL of your site and click **Next**.
3. There are two possible outcomes:
   - If there is a phone number associated with your Wix account, you are asked to confirm that number is yours:
     1. Enter your region and phone number.
     2. Click **Send** and you’ll receive your login email by text message.
   - If you have no phone number associated with your account, you are asked to submit possible login emails you think you may have used:
     1. Enter up to 3 email addresses you may have signed up with.
     2. Click **Next** and we'll confirm whether there's a match. If so, you are shown the correct login email.

### Recovering Your Account Using Your Recovery Phone Number

1. Click the **Forgot Password or Email?** link in the Wix Sign In window.
2. Click **Can't access my login email**.
3. Enter the email address associated with your Wix account and click **Next**.
4. Select **Send me a code to my phone number ending with XXXX** and click **Next**.
5. Enter the one-time verification code sent to your phone and click **Verify**.
6. (Optional) Reset your email and/or password in your [Account Settings](https://manage.wix.com/account/account-settings).

question: Is it possible to create a dropdown that filters its options based on another dropdown's selection?

question: What does it mean if my domain status is 'clientHold' or 'serverHold' on Whois, and how can I resolve it?
answer: If your domain status is 'clientHold' or 'serverHold' on Whois, your domain registrar has not yet activated your domain's DNS records. This can be due to several reasons, such as payment failure. To resolve this issue, you must contact your domain registrar. This domain status can be viewed when visiting [whois.com](https://www.whois.com/) or any other querying databases that store domain registration information.

question: What are the differences between selling images as 'Web Ready' and 'Original File' in the Wix Photo Albums Store?
answer:
In the Wix Photo Albums Store, you can sell your images either as **Web Ready** or **Original File**:

- **Web Ready**: If you upload an image over 1200 pixels, the Wix Photo Albums Store takes your image file and automatically creates a smaller version (the Web Ready file) which your customers can purchase. The Web Ready file has a slightly reduced quality and therefore can be sold at a lower price. These files are perfect for web use, and ideal if you are selling your images to be used online.

- **Original File**: When purchasing your image through the Wix Photo Albums Store, customers receive the original file that you upload. The Original File has no reduction in quality and can therefore be sold at a higher price. If you intend to sell images for print, it is recommended to upload images over 1200 pixels in order to retain the quality.

For more information on setting your pricing plan, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-photo-albums-setting-prices-in-the-wix-photo-albums-store).

question: What are the key benefits of using Wix Headless for business management?
answer:
Here are some of the key benefits of using Wix Headless:

* **One-stop shop**: All the services you need in one place.
* **Build your way**: Use your preferred tech stack to build your frontend and backend. Use Wix's business solutions to take care of the business logic. Wix's services are available as [REST APIs](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest) and using our [JavaScript SDK](https://dev.wix.com/docs/sdk).
* **Flexible**: Maximize the ways customers can interact with your business, by connecting multiple clients to a single Wix project. For example, multiple websites, a mobile app, and a smartwatch app can all share the same business data.
* **Secure**: Use industry-standard OAuth 2.0 for authorizing API calls. Enjoy Wix's enterprise-grade security for peace of mind.
* **Admin API**: Utilize account and site-level APIs to build dashboards and other admin features.

question: How can I customize shape dividers on my Wix mobile site?
answer:
To customize desktop dividers on your mobile site, follow these steps:

1. **Select your section or strip:**
   - For strips, click the strip in your mobile Editor.
   - For sections, double-click the section in your mobile Editor.

2. **Click the Shape Dividers icon.**

3. **Select either the Top or Bottom tab** (if you have two dividers on the section or strip).

4. **Choose what you want to do with the shape divider:**
   - **Choose a new shape divider:** Select a new divider shape.
   - **Adjust the divider:** Click **Customize Design** at the bottom of the panel to edit the divider with the options:
     - **Opacity & color:** Choose whatever color you want for your divider, and make it more or less visible on the strip/section.
     - **Height:** Set how high or low you want the divider to go on your section or strip.
     - **Horizontal offset:** Re-position your shape divider, moving it to the left or right.
     - **Layer effect:** Click the toggle to add a fade effect to the divider, then select a direction from the drop-down:
       - **Centered:** The effect is visible on the entire divider.
       - **Fade to top:** The effect lessens towards the top of the divider.
       - **Fade to bottom:** The effect lessens towards the bottom of the divider.
     - **Invert:** Invert the shape of the divider (vertically).
     - **Flip:** Set the divider to display the opposite way (horizontally) on your strip/section.
     - **Number of repeats:** Set how many times the pattern repeats across the divider.

**Note:** The available options depend on the shape you choose.

question: How can I add a business owner to my Wix Payments account during the setup process?

   - Country of citizenship
   - Personal address
   - ID number or Social Security Number (SSN)
6. Select the checkboxes:
   - **Does this person own 25% or more of the business:**
     - **Yes:** Select this option if this person is a shareholder owning 25% or more of the business.

7. Enter the person's **Role in the Business** using the text box.
8. Click **Save**.

question: Is it possible to move site members from one Wix site to another within my account?

question: What should I do if my payment for Wix services is not going through?
answer:
If your payment for Wix services is not going through, try the following steps:

1. **Contact your bank**: You may need to get in touch with your bank to find out why the payment has not gone through. For example, your bank can confirm if you are using the correct account details. Once the issue is resolved, you can try the upgrade again.

2. **Use a different card**: Try upgrading with a different credit/debit card.

3. **Change your browser or clear cache**: Try to make your payment on a different internet browser (e.g. Safari, Chrome, Firefox), or try clearing your browser's cache. Learn how to [clear your browser's cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-technical-assistant).

If you are still experiencing problems upgrading after contacting your bank, please [contact us](http://www.wix.com/contact) for help.

question: How can I resolve a false positive virus warning on my Wix website due to incorrect DNS records?
answer:
To resolve a false positive virus warning on your Wix website caused by misconfigured DNS records, follow these steps:

1. Visit the [Wix Domain Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-domain-assistant-3777632) to ensure that your DNS records are properly configured.
2. Once your DNS configurations are corrected, the false positive warnings should be resolved.

**Note**: Allow 48 hours for your updated DNS records to propagate.

question: Can customers pay for online programs in installments on Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to let customers pay for online programs in installments. When customers buy an online program, they can pay the full price upfront or sign up for a pricing plan.

question: Can I change the currency for each individual invoice in Wix Invoices?
answer: Currently in Wix Invoices it is not possible to change the currency for each invoice you create. You can change your invoice currency in the [Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/settings) tab of your dashboard, but this applies to all your invoices.

question: What steps should I ask my site visitors to follow if they are experiencing issues with Wix Video on my site?
answer:
If your site visitors are experiencing issues with Wix Video on your site, please provide them with the following steps to troubleshoot the issue:

1. **Clear your browser's cache and cookies.**
2. **Update your browser to the latest version.**
3. **Try to recreate the issue on different browsers and see if it still happens.**
4. **Disable all of your browser add-ons (extensions and plugins) for the duration of the troubleshoot.**
5. **Disable any anti-virus software for the duration of the troubleshoot.**
6. **Try a different computer.**
7. **Try a different internet connection.**

If the issue persists after following these steps, request the visitor to send a screenshot of the Developer Tools view of your site from Google Chrome. Here’s how they can do it:

1. **Open your site in a Google Chrome incognito window (Ctrl + Shift + N).**
2. **Use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + J (on PC) or Cmd + Option + J (on Mac).**
3. **Click the Console tab at the top of the panel and refresh the page (F5).**
4. **Navigate to the page on the site where the issue occurs and take any action necessary to recreate the issue.**
5. **Take a screenshot of what you see on the Console tab.**
6. **Click the Network tab at the top of the panel and take the action again (Tip: if the issue is on your live site you may need to refresh the page).**
7. **Take a screenshot of what you see on the Network tab.**

Ask them to send you this information so you can investigate the issue further.

question: How can I hide a specific site page from appearing as a URL below my Google ad text?
answer:
To hide a site page from search engines and prevent it from appearing as a URL below your Google ad text, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant site page.
3. Click **SEO Basics**.
4. Scroll down and disable the **Let search engines index this page** toggle to hide this page from Google Search.

This will ensure that the specific site page is not indexed by search engines and will not appear as an automatic site link in your ad.

question: How can I fix an unresponsive mobile menu on my Wix site if elements are overlapping the menu?
answer:
If elements are overlapping the menu, causing it to be unresponsive, you can arrange the menu to be in front. Follow these steps to bring the menu to the front:

1. Click **Layers** on the Editor Toolbar.
2. Click **Header**, **Page** or **Footer**.
3. Select the Menu icon from the list.
4. Right-click the icon.
5. Click **Arrange**.
6. Click **Bring to Front**.

This should resolve the issue of overlapping elements making the menu unresponsive. For more details, you can refer to the [Wix Editor: Viewing and Selecting Overlapping Elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-viewing-and-selecting-overlapping-elements) and [Wix Editor: Arranging Elements Using Right-Click](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-arranging-elements-using-right-click).

question: How do I add and set up a ratings display element in the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site or [enable coding](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/getting-started/getting-started-with-code) if you haven't already.
* Make sure you have a [CMS collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection) that stores your ratings.

### Step 1 | Add and set up the ratings display element: Wix Editor
Add the ratings display element to your page and customize its settings, layout, and design.
1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2021/08/23/fb2504cd-afa3-47dd-8e84-4cd32a0ea1ed/653ea261-d479-44ae-8509-7735843df25c.png) on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Input**.
3. Click **Ratings**.
4. Click and drag the **Ratings Input** element of your choice onto the page.

![Screenshot of adding the Ratings display element in the Wix Editor.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/07/30/1a575512-514d-4b64-b05d-5acb24ae1cab/05ab8141-441f-4ff1-bdcd-41db6f601be4.png)

5. Click **Settings** on the ratings display element and click the relevant tab to choose what is shown when there are ratings and when there are no ratings:
   * **Ratings:** Choose what you want to show when there are ratings:
     + **Show the rating value:** Enable the toggle to show the rating value as a number in addition to the rating icons.
     + **Show the number of ratings:** Enable the toggle to show the total number of rankings.
     + **Ratings text label:** Enter the text that appears next to the ratings (e.g. "Recommend it").
   * **No Ratings:** Click the **No Ratings** tab and choose what displays when the element loads and there are no ratings: **Nothing**, **Icons**, or **Placeholder text**

![Screenshot of the Ratings display element's settings.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/07/30/5937922d-509c-4559-90a6-24b741c48d95/5aac79b5-3d95-407d-9cec-10edbb35fe0c.png)

6. Click the **Layout** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/09/12/734557c6-c0b4-447f-b06b-913a6cdda087/7d44f8a6-1640-4519-95a4-01eafb2f0dcf.png) to adjust the size, spacing, value placement, alignment and text direction.
7. Click the **Design** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/09/12/33af6f0f-b6ab-4e51-b58b-44f286e77642/959a4c6f-2294-42c7-ac5f-576b1be782d3.png) to choose a preset design. Then click **Customize Design** to adjust the design further.

question: How can I start building a website with Wix without any coding knowledge?
answer: Creating your dream website has never been simpler thanks to the Wix editors. With an intuitive drag-and-drop interface, building and customizing your site is a breeze, and the best part is, you don't need to write a single line of code! We have 2 intuitive editors for you to choose from, so whether you're a beginner or an experienced user, we got you covered. The **Wix Editor** offers a user-friendly experience for those who prefer simplicity, while the **Wix Studio Editor** is better suited to website designers and other professionals who want to implement intricate design elements. Start creating with the [Wix Editor](http://www.wix.com) or the [Studio Editor.](https://www.wix.com/studio) You can also use [Wix's AI Website Builder](https://www.wix.com/ai-website-builder) to create a website from scratch in just a few minutes.

question: How can I create a members-only category in my Wix Forum to restrict access to registered members?
answer:
To create a members-only category in your Wix Forum, follow these steps:

### Using the Dashboard:
1. [Go to Forum](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Forum&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/forum/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Categories** on the left.
3. Click the relevant category.
4. Scroll down to **Who can access this category?** and select **Logged in members** or **Selected members.**

### Using the Wix App:
1. Go to your site in the Wix app on your mobile device.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Forum**.
4. Tap **Categories**.
5. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant category.
6. Tap **Settings**.
7. Tap **Edit** next to **Who has access?** and select **Members only** or **Selected members.**

### Tip
You can edit permissions for a category so only admins and moderators can write posts. To learn how to change who can post in a category, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forum-creating-a-category).

question: How can I set permissions for a Google Drive file to allow others to edit it?
answer:
To set permissions for a Google Drive file to allow others to edit it, follow these steps:

1. Select the file you want to share.
2. Click **Share** on the top right.
3. Click the drop-down arrow![Down](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/zfrH4n2Q715LRIoZGbdTJKOhMP8f364D4wGLrUzbf--Y0u7VVDEj0n2bD_PaHlxhBd4=w18-h18) under **Get Link**.
4. Choose to share the file with **Anyone with the link**.
5. To allow others to edit the file, select **Editor**.
6. Click **Copy link**.

question: How can I temporarily turn off private registration for my Wix domain?
answer:
To temporarily turn off private registration for your Wix domain, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page.
2. Click the **Show More** icon next to the relevant domain and select **Edit Contact Info**.
3. Scroll down and click **Show more** to the right of **Privacy Protection**.
4. Click **Turn off privacy protection**.
5. Click **Turn Off Privacy**.

### Important
If you are an EU citizen and you turn off privacy, then the following info will be public in whois: State/province, country, organization name.

question: How can I create multiple Facebook & Instagram Ads campaigns using Wix?
answer:
To create multiple Facebook & Instagram Ads campaigns using Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpaid-ads%3FreferralInfo%3Dkb-article) in your site's dashboard.
2. The campaigns page shows all your current campaign(s) in a list. Click **Create New Campaign** at the top right to make another campaign.
3. Customize the settings and ad content of your new ad campaign. [Learn more about creating campaign content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-instagram-ads-creating-a-campaign).
4. Set your new campaign's daily budget. The daily budget is taken from your total ad credits.
5. Click **Launch** to launch your new campaign.

Your new campaign appears in the campaigns page. The status label is **In Review** until the campaign content is approved by Meta.

question: Can I customize different tax variables for my pricing plans, such as tax per state or country?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to customize different tax variables (e.g. tax per state, country, or different tax groups) for your pricing plans. You can only [set one fixed tax rate](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-setting-up-tax-collection) for all of your plans.

question: How can I check the date and amount of my upcoming renewals for my Wix Premium or Studio plan?
answer:
To check your upcoming renewals for your Wix Premium or Studio plan, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. View renewal information in the **Next payment due** column.
3. Click **View payment details** to see the specifics of your next payment, including the amount due.

The **Next payment due** column shows the renewal date, which may differ slightly from the expiration date. Hover over the **Info** icon to learn more. If the auto renew has been turned off, the expiration date of your plan will display.

question: How can I change the header design on my website using ADI?
answer:
To change your header design in ADI, follow these steps:

1. Hover over the **Customize Section Design** button.
2. Select a **Header Type**:
   * **Regular**: The header remains at the top of the page and only appears when your visitor scrolls to that area.
   * **Transparent**: A transparent header is one without a background color. It is important to note that you can choose to have a transparent header, but it only appears transparent on the homepage. On the other site pages it appears with a background color.
   * **Fixed**: The header appears at the top of the page even when your visitor scrolls down.
3. Select the **background color**.

For a transparent header, ensure your [site colors](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-customizing-your-sites-colors) are set to **Dark Mode** and the first section immediately following the header includes a **full-width image**.

question: Is it possible to lock my mobile site so it isn't affected by changes made in the desktop Editor?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to lock your mobile site so it isn't affected by changes you make in the desktop Editor. 

### Workaround
As an alternative, you can [hide desktop elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-hidden-elements-in-your-mobile-editor#hiding-an-element) on your mobile site, and [add mobile-only elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-mobile-only-elements).

question: How can I add a video to my Wix site using the Single Video Player?
answer:
To add a video to your Wix site using the Single Video Player, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Single Video Player](https://support.wix.com/en/article/single-video-player-adding-and-setting-up-the-single-video-player) section in the Wix Editor.
2. Upload your own video (up to 1GB) or add a video from a social network by copying and pasting the link.
3. Resize the player as needed and customize the settings and frame to fit your site's design.

question: Can clients add tips to the sale of booking services at a mobile point of sale?
answer: Clients can now add tips to the sale of bookings services at a mobile point of sale. Learn how to [enable tipping at a mobile POS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-mobile-pos-collecting-tips).

question: Can I integrate Wix Video Library with Online Programs?
answer: You can now seamlessly [add videos](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-adding-a-video-step-to-a-program) from the library into your programs with a new advanced video step.

question: Can I create a floor plan for table reservations using Wix Restaurants?
answer: You can now [create and manage a floor plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-creating-a-restaurant-floor-plan) with the Wix Table Reservations app.

question: How do I choose a campaign goal for my Facebook Ads campaign using Wix?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure you've already done the following:
* Connected your Facebook Page
* Upgraded to a Premium Plan
* Published your site
* Connected a domain

### To choose a campaign goal:
1. Go to [Facebook Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpaid-ads%3FreferralInfo%3Dkb-article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Let's Start**.
3. Click the goal you want to use for this campaign. Learn more about the [different types of campaign goals](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-choosing-a-campaign-goal).
4. Click **Continue**.

**Note:** If this is your first time creating a campaign, you need to first complete the [campaign setup steps](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-setting-up-facebook-ads-with-wix). If you've already done this, click **Create Ad**.

question: How can I connect my Google Analytics property to my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
To use Google Analytics with your site, you must have a [Premium](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website) site and a [connected domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-you-own-to-your-wix-site).

### Step 1 | Get your Google Analytics 4 property ID
First, you need to create a Google Analytics 4 (GA4) property in your Google Analytics account and get its measurement ID.

#### To get your GA4 property ID:
1. Sign in to [your Google Analytics account](https://analytics.google.com/analytics/web/).
2. Click **Admin** at the bottom left.
3. Click **+ Create Property**.
4. Enter a property name.
5. Choose your reporting time zone and currency from the drop-down menus.
6. Click **Next**.
7. Select your type of business from the **Industry category** drop-down.
8. Select your business size.
9. Choose the information you want to track under **How do you intend to use Google Analytics with your business?**.
10. Click **Create**.
11. Choose **Web** under **Choose a platform**.
12. Add your website URL and a stream name under **Set up your web stream**.
13. Click the Settings icon.
14. Click **Show advanced settings** under **Page views**.
15. Deselect the **Page changes based on browser history events** checkbox.
16. Disable the **Site search** toggle.
17. Click **Save**.
18. Click **Create stream**.
19. Copy your **Measurement ID**.

### Step 2 | Add your Google Analytics property to your Wix site
Add your Google Analytics property to Marketing Integrations in your dashboard to connect Google Analytics to your site.

#### To add your property:
1. Go to [Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Marketing%20Integrations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/marketing-integration/) on your site’s dashboard.
2. Click **Connect** under **Google Analytics**.
3. Click **Add Google Analytics ID**.
4. Paste your GA4 Measurement ID in the pop-up.

   **Note:** Make sure that there are no extra spaces before the code.
5. (Optional) Select the IP Anonymization checkbox if you want to hide your site visitors’ IP addresses from Google.
6. Click **Save**.

### Tips
* If you have connected multiple domains to your site, make sure to add your Google Analytics code to your primary domain only, rather than your secondary domain(s).
* It may take some time before you see statistics in your Google Analytics account.

question: How can I add alt text to my images in a Wix portfolio?
answer:
To add alt text to your portfolio images:

1. [Go to Portfolio](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/portfolio?&title=Manage%20Portfolio&buttonText=Manage+your+portfolio) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant project and click **Edit**.
3. Click Add alt text to images under **SEO & Social**.
4. Choose what you want to do:
   
   * **Write your own alt text:**
     1. Enter your alt text for each image.
     2. Click **Apply Alt Text**.
   * **Generate alt text with AI:**
     1. Click **Generate missing alt text**
     2. Click **Apply Alt Text**.

question: Can site members edit their password and email within their profile?
answer: Yes, site members can now [edit their password and email from the member profile](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-changing-login-details-as-a-member). Site members have full control over their member login information and can quickly update their login details without the need to contact the site owner.

question: How can I access and customize my sales reports in Wix Analytics?
answer:
To access your sales reports in Wix Analytics, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Reports](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Analytics%20Reports&actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fanalytics/reports/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. View the reports in the **Sales** section.

To customize your sales reports, you can adjust the data you're viewing and the way it's displayed. You can also save the views you want to return to later. Learn more about [customizing your report](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-wix-analytics-reports).

question: Is Mercanet supported as a payment provider on Wix?
answer:
Currently, Wix does not offer Mercanet as a payment provider.

### Tip
You can accept payments to your BNP Paribas account by [connecting PayZen as a payment provider](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-payzen-by-lyra-as-a-payment-provider).

question: Can I add hyperlinks to text within a collapsible text box in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to hyperlink text in a collapsible text box. The only hyperlink that you can add is to [link button to the full text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-customizing-collapsible-text).

question: How can I add the Online Programs app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor and your site's dashboard.

### To add the Online Programs app using the Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Apps** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2021/11/24/fdfa6035-0515-49cd-bb10-d4944db1edb5/dadbb3a0-fafa-4627-ac02-0fcb2f693cb1.jpeg) on the left side of the editor.

question: Is it possible to make subpages in the Wix Editor open only when clicked, instead of on hover?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to change this behavior so that the subpages menu only opens when clicked. When you hover over a menu button, the [header menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-and-managing-a-dropdown-submenu) and any [subpages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-a-subpage-drop-down-menu) you have open automatically.

question: How do I set up manual (offline) payments on my Wix site?
answer:
To set up manual (offline) payments on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Connect** next to **Manual Payments**.
3. Click the drop-down menu and select a title for the payment instructions: **Cash payment**, **Offline payment**, or **Cash on delivery**.
4. Enter instructions to complete the payment in the text box.
5. Click **Connect**.

question: How can I create a new video channel on Wix?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your site's dashboard and the Video Library.

[Learn how to access the SEO Assistant with Wix Bookings services.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-your-pages-seo-with-the-wix-seo-assistant#using-the-wix-seo-assistant)

question: How do I add the Faire Integration app to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add the Faire Integration app to your Wix site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

question: How can I change the color of the header for my Wix blog feed and post page on mobile?
answer:
To change the background color of a header for your Wix blog feed and post page on mobile, follow these steps:

### Wix Editor
1. Go to the page that you want to edit in your Editor.
2. Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
3. Click **Blog Pages**.
4. Choose to customize your main blog feed or the post page:
   * Main Blog Feed: Click **Blog**.
   * Post Page: Click **Post**.
5. Click the Blog or the Post element on your page.
6. Click **Settings**.
7. Click the **Design** tab.
8. Click **Background & Buttons**.
9. Select a background color for your button under **Button Style**.
10. Publish your site.

### Editor X
1. Click **Pages** at the top of Editor X.
2. Scroll down to **Blog Pages**.
3. Choose to customize your main blog feed or the post page:
   * Main Blog Feed: Click **Blog**.
   * Post Page: Click **Post**.
4. Click the Blog or the Post element on your page.
5. Click **Settings**.
6. Click the **Design** tab.
7. Click **Background & Buttons**.

question: How can I add a custom element to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:

1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/13/ff6d0998-bff3-41b9-bc06-595fd926d806.png) on the left side of the Editor.

question: How can I adjust the strips on my Wix mobile site to improve their appearance?
answer:
To adjust strips for mobile on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Open your site in the mobile editor.
2. Click the relevant strip.
3. Choose how you want to adjust the strip:
   
   ### Resize your strip
   Drag the stretch handle up or down to make the strip larger or smaller.
   
   ### Reorder your strips
   Click the **Move Up** or **Move Down** arrow until the strip is in the desired position.
   
   ### Hide a strip
   Click the **Hide Element** icon.
   
   ### Add an effect to your strip

question: How can I optimize my mobile site content to improve loading time?
answer:
To optimize your mobile site content and improve loading time, follow these guidelines:

### Use the mobile Editor
- Open the Editor.
- Click the **Mobile Editor** icon from the top toolbar.

### Hide unnecessary elements
- Click the element you want to hide.
- Click the Hide Element icon.

**Tip:** Hidden elements can be viewed and re-added to your mobile site by clicking **Hidden on Mobile** on the left side of the mobile Editor.

### Crop or resize images
- Click the image in the Editor.
- Click the Crop icon.
- Drag the handles to crop the image.
- Click **Apply**.

**Tip:** Images can be resized by clicking the image, then dragging the handles to make it larger or smaller.

### Reduce items in galleries and repeaters
- Reduce the amount of items in a gallery or set of repeaters on mobile. Only display relevant and important items and media.

### Add a welcome screen
- Click **Mobile Tools** on the left side of the mobile Editor.
- Click **Welcome screen**.
- Customize your Welcome screen using the options available.
- Click **Done**.

### Use a supported system and browser
- Ensure visitors use supported operating systems and browsers:
  - iPhone: iOS 12 and above (iPhone 6 and above)
  - Android: 9.0 and above
  - Supported browsers: Google Chrome, Safari

### Keep in mind
- Tablet devices, such as iPads and Android tablets, display the desktop version of your site. [Learn more about Wix sites compatibility with tablets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/troubleshooting-ipad-and-tablet-live-site-issues)

question: How can I remove horizontal scroll bars from my Wix site when viewed on different devices?
answer:
To remove the horizontal scroll bars and spaces from your Wix site, follow these steps:

* Use the Layers panel to identify the elements on your page that have a horizontal scrollbar. Look for elements that:
  
  + Are not stretched to full-width. [Learn how to stretch an element to full width](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-stretching-an-element-to-full-width)
  + Have a width bigger than 980px
  + Are placed at the edge of your Editor screen (or going off the screen). [Learn more about the Layers panel](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-using-the-layers-panel)
* If the element does not have Stretch enabled, then enable it. If the element does not have the Stretch option available, then add a strip and place the element inside the strip. [Learn how to attach an element to a strip](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-attaching-elements-to-strips-and-columns)
* If you have images that are placed outside the gridlines, we recommend that you add them as a strip background instead. [Learn how to add an image to your strip background](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-your-strip-background#adding-an-image-to-your-strip-background)
* If you stretched a gallery to full-width manually, we recommend that you change it to a full-width gallery.

question: How can I create a loyalty program for my business using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To create a loyalty program using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. **Choose a Program Name**: Decide on a name for your loyalty program that reflects your brand.
2. **Name Your Points**: Select a name for the points that clients will earn.
3. **Select an Icon**: Choose an icon that represents your brand and will be associated with the loyalty program.
4. **Set Actions for Earning Points**: Determine the actions clients need to take to earn points, such as making a certain number of bookings.
5. **Decide on Points per Action**: Specify how many points clients will earn for each action.
6. **Define Rewards**: Decide what rewards clients can redeem with their points, such as coupons.

For detailed instructions, you can learn more about how to [create your own loyalty program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-and-setting-up-a-loyalty-program-for-your-business).

question: Why can't I submit website forms that have conditional signature fields?
answer:
We are aware of the issue where users are unable to submit website forms with conditional signature fields. As a workaround, you can follow these steps:

1. Open the form settings.
2. Click **Conditions**.
3. Edit the relevant conditions that involve the signature field and uncheck the signature field.
4. Publish your site to see changes live.

question: What should I do if Facebook is blocking me from sharing my Wix site?
answer:
If Facebook is blocking you from sharing your Wix site, it is because your site has been blocked by Facebook. Here are the steps you can take:

1. **Ensure Compliance**: Make sure that your site adheres to [Facebook's community standards](https://www.facebook.com/communitystandards).
2. **Contact Facebook**: Submit a request to Facebook to unblock your site. Keep in mind that it may take some time for them to process the request as they review each site individually.

Please note that the decision to block sites is made by Facebook, and Wix has no control over this process.

question: How can I edit my profile and 'About' page on my Wix site?
answer:

question: How can I adjust the image scaling and position on a strip in Wix Editor if my image doesn't fit properly?
answer:
To change the image scaling and position on a strip in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Select the image on the strip.
2. Depending on whether your image takes up the whole strip or just a column, do one of the following:
   * Whole strip: Click **Change Strip Background**.
   * Column only: Click **Change Column Background**.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Scroll down to **Scaling & Positioning**.
5. Click the **How's the image scaled?** drop-down and select an option:
   * **Original Size:** The original size image is displayed. Parts of it may be cut off.
   * **Scale to Fill:** The image is resized to fill the available space. You may want to reposition it.
   * **Tile:** The image is displayed in tile formation across the available space.
6. Select a position for your image under **Where is it positioned?**.

**Tip:** This is helpful if your image is not centered or is focused on the wrong area.

Alternatively, you can crop the image to better fit the available space.

question: How can I share my Wix group page or a specific post to social networks?
answer:

To share a group page or group post:

question: How can I create a new rate plan in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
answer:
To create a new rate plan in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Rate Plans](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1c5b7dec-159e-48cf-b618-6d77d7a17f8c%7C3%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Rate+Plans) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Rate Plan**.
3. Enter the rate plan **Name**. 

   **Tip:** We recommend you avoid mentioning the room type in the name of the rate plan.
4. Select the relevant **Meal plan** from the drop-down, for example, "Full board".
5. Enter the **Code** for the meal plan. This unique code is used to integrate your information with the property management system.
6. Choose your **Cancellation policy** from the drop-down.
7. Choose your **Sellable markets** from the drop-down. These are the countries where you offer the rate plan. For example, you could offer the rate plan only to guests booking from North America.
8. Choose when this rate plan is available under **Date Settings**:

   * **All year round:** Choose this option for rate plans that don't change from season to season.
   * **Select date range:** Choose this option for seasonal rate plans. This is a great way to encourage off-season bookings with cheaper or more flexible rate plans.

      + Enter the relevant Start and End dates for the rate plan.
9. (Optional) Enable the **Link to a rate plan** toggle to link this plan to another.
10. Click the **Show the rate plan on your site** toggle:

   * **Enabled:** Guests can see this rate plan on your site.
   * **Disabled:** The rate plan doesn't appear on your site, but it still appears for online travel agencies.
11. Click **Add**.

question: Can I connect my business phone number to a landline?

question: How does Wix use IndexNow to inform search engines about changes to my site?
answer: Wix uses IndexNow to instantly alert search engines, like Bing and Yandex, about any changes made on your website, making crawling more efficient. The IndexNow functionality is included with your Premium plan. Wix checks when there are changes to your site pages and submits the changes on your behalf to the IndexNow protocol. This allows search engines to quickly identify that a page was changed and reflect the change in search results. Normally, it can take time for search engines to crawl and index your site, but with a Premium site, Wix automatically makes IndexNow aware of any site changes without you having to keep on top of it. For example, if you add a new blog post to your site, Wix notifies IndexNow, and IndexNow then pings relevant search engines about the changes. This allows the search engines to crawl and index the page faster (depending on their indexing factors).

question: How do I add products from Modalyst to my Wix Store?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have connected your store to Modalyst.

To add products from Modalyst to your Wix Store, follow these steps:

1. **Add products to your Import List:**
   - Start looking for products you love. Click to add the ready-to-sell products to your Import List.
   - To search for products, click the **Ready to sell** tab and start shopping.
   - To narrow your search, select a category or click **Filter** to limit your search. When you find a product you like, click **More Details** to learn more about it or **Add to Import List** to customize it for your store.

2. **Customize products and product options:**
   - Go to the [Modalyst dashboard](https://modalyst.co/).
   - Click the **Import List** tab.
   - Update settings in the **General** tab: Edit the product name, select the category or categories, and edit the vendor name.
   - Update text in the **Description** tab: (Optional) Edit the product description.
   - Update settings in the **Variants** tab.
   - Update settings in the **Pricing** tab: You can override your general pricing settings.
   - Update settings in the **Media** tab: Deselect the checkmarks on images you don't want to display.

3. **Add products to your Wix Store:**
   - Once you finish customizing a product, you can add it by clicking **Add to Store**. When you do, the product is added to your **Products** tab in your Wix dashboard and appears on your live site.
   - If you prefer, rather than adding a product right after you customize it, you can later add multiple products at once.

   **To add multiple products to your stores:**
   - Depending on the products you want to add, follow the steps:
     - **All products:**
       1. Click the arrow next to the number of products you have.
       2. Select all products or all products on the current page.
     - **Individual products:** Select the checkboxes next to products you want to add.
   - Click **Add to store**.

   **Tip:** If this button isn't visible, click the **Actions** drop-down and select **Add to store**.

Products usually appear in your Wix Store as soon as you add them. Note that products with many images might take a few minutes before they are live.

question: How can I enable shipping to pickup points using Boxtal in my Wix store?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have added the Boxtal app and set up your Boxtal account as described in Steps 1 and 2.

### To enable shipping to pickup points via Boxtal:
1. [Go to Shipping & Fulfillment](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Shipping&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select a shipping region where Boxtal operates (e.g. France).
3. Scroll down past any shipping, delivery, or store pickup options you created.
4. Click the toggle next to the Boxtal app to enable it.
5. Enter a **Shipping option name** (e.g. Pickup Points). 

   **Tip:** Customers see this name during checkout.
6. Enter the **Rate at checkout**.
7. Click **Save**.
8. Repeat steps 2 - 6 for any additional shipping regions (e.g. Spain).

question: How can I create a new design library in Editor X?

question: Can I choose different fonts for different blog posts on Wix?
answer: Currently, when you select a font style (e.g. Times New Roman) for body text, the font you choose appears in the body text for all blog posts. It is not possible to choose different fonts for different posts. However, you can still do a lot with your fonts. [You can customize your fonts by size, color and font style](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-customizing-your-blog-post-page).

question: How can I allow customers to add a personalized message when purchasing a product on my Wix Store?
answer:
To allow customers to add a personalized message when purchasing a product on your Wix Store, you can add a custom text box to your Product Page. Follow these steps:

1. [Go to Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant product or click **New Product** to add a new one.
3. Scroll down and click **Add Custom Text Field**.
4. Enter the title of the text field (e.g. What name should we engrave?).
5. Enter the character limit for the text field.
6. Select or deselect the **Mandatory field** checkbox:
   
   * **Selected:** The customer must fill in the text field.
   * **Deselected:** The customer can leave it blank.
7. (Optional) Click **Add Another** to add a second custom text field. 

   **Tip:** You can add up to 2 fields.
8. Click **Save**.

After a customer makes an order, you can see the information they wrote in the **Orders** tab.

question: How can I add a slideshow to my Wix site using ADI?

question: How can I add a Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions to my Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To add policy documents such as a Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions to your Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website/overview) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select **Order settings**.
3. Click **Advanced**.
4. Click the **Policies** toggle to enable it.
5. Choose the policies you want to add:

### Add Terms & Conditions
1. Select the **Terms & Conditions** checkbox.
2. Choose an option:
   * **Link to URL:** Adds a page to your site with Terms and Conditions that the customer sees when they click the hyperlink.
   * **Paste as text:** The Terms and Conditions are displayed in a popup while the customer is ordering or making a reservation.

### Add a Privacy Policy
1. Select the **Privacy Policy** checkbox.
2. Choose an option:
   * **Link to URL:** Adds a page to your site with the Privacy Policy that the customer sees when they click the hyperlink.
   * **Paste as text:** The Privacy Policy is displayed in a popup while the customer is ordering or making a reservation.

### Add a Policy Agreement Checkbox
Once you've selected either Terms & Conditions or Privacy Policy, you have the option to add a Policy Agreement Checkbox that requires customers to agree with your restaurant's terms.

1. Select **Policy Agreement Checkbox.**
2. Choose an option:
   * **Checked by default:** the checkbox is automatically selected.
   * **Customers are required to check the box:** the customer must confirm they accept your policies before continuing. If they don't select the checkbox, they will see an error message.

question: How can I add a new call agent to my business phone number plan?

1. Go to [Business Phone Number](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fvirtual-numbers%3FreferralInfo%3DKB_Article&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Manage%20Business%20Phone%20Number) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Call Agents** tab.
3. Click **+ Add an Agent**.
4. Enter the **Name** of the new agent.
5. Enter the **Phone Number** of the new agent.
6. Set the **Agent's Call Hours**:
   * **Default Hours:** Your agent's call hours are defined in the **Call Hours** tab.
   * **Custom Hours:** Customize your agent's call hours.
     1. Click the **Receive Calls 24/7** toggle to set your custom hours.

     **Tip:** Click the **Add** icon to add multiple time slots to the same day.
7. Click **Next**.
8. Enter the **Email** of the new agent.
9. Click **Send Invite**.

question: What should Wix users consider regarding the content they upload to their websites?
