question: Can I create multiple schedules for a course in Wix Bookings and modify each set of sessions individually?
answer: Currently, when creating a course with sessions that run on more than one day of the week (or with different staff members, durations, etc.) you cannot modify each set of sessions individually. For instance, if a course is set up with sessions on Tuesdays and Thursdays, when you cancel the Tuesday sessions, the Thursday sessions will also be cancelled. The same applies to the details of any given session. If you update details for the Tuesday session (such as staff members, durations, etc.), those details will also be updated for the Thursday session (and all future sessions).

question: How can I create a custom form in Wix that allows visitors to submit their information directly to my CMS collection?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.

### Step 1 | Create a collection and set the permissions
1. [Go to CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20CMS&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Collection**.
3. Enter a name for your collection.
4. Leave **Multiple items (Default)** selected and click **Create**.
5. Click **More Actions** and select **Permissions & privacy**.
6. Choose which permissions to use for the collection:
   - **Collect content**: Allow visitors to add content to the collection with input elements or API.
   - **Custom**: Set custom permissions to control who can view, add, update, and delete content.
7. Click **Save**.

### Step 2 | Add input elements to your site: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page or section where you want to create a custom form.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
4. Click **Input**.
5. Click the type of input element you want to add.
6. Click and drag the relevant input element onto the page.
7. Repeat steps 3-6 to add as many input elements as your form needs.

### Step 3 | Connect the input elements to your collection: Wix Editor
1. In your editor, click any of the input elements you just added.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
3. Connect to a dataset that binds to the collection where you will store the submissions:
   - **If you do not have a dataset on the page**: Click **+ Add a Dataset**, choose the collection to connect, enter the dataset name, and click **Create**.
   - **If you already have a dataset on the page**: Click **Collect content**, then select the relevant dataset.
4. Connect the input element to a new collection field:
   - Click the **Value connects to** drop-down and select **Add new field**.
   - Enter a **Field Name** for the new collection field.
   - Select the **Field Type** from the drop-down.
   - Click **Add**.
5. (If necessary) Click the **Connect list items** toggle to choose where to manage the element's choices.
6. Repeat these steps for each of your custom form's input elements.

### Step 4 | Set the dataset modes: Wix Editor
1. In the panel on the right, click **Dataset Settings** under the first **Choose a dataset** drop-down.
2. Click the **Dataset mode** drop-down and select **Write**.
3. (If you connected list items to the CMS) Set the mode for the dataset connected to the list items:
   - Click **Back to dropdown element** at the top of the panel.
   - Click **Dataset Settings** under the dataset selected in the **List Connections** section.
   - Click the **Dataset mode** drop-down and select **Read** or **Read & Write**.

### Step 5 | Create a submit button: Wix Editor
1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Button**.
3. Click and drag the button you want to use as your submit button onto the page.
4. Click **Change Text & Icon** and enter the text you want to display on the button (e.g. "Submit").
5. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
6. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select the dataset connected to your submissions collection.
7. Click the **Click action connects to** drop-down and select **Submit**.
8. (Optional) Add success and failure messages that appear when submissions are submitted successfully or unsuccessfully.
9. Select the button and click the **Connect to CMS** icon. Then click the **When successful, navigate to** drop-down, and select an option:
   - **Stay on this page**
   - **A link**: The visitor is redirected to another page after submitting the form.
10. Click the button and select the **Design** icon to [customize the appearance of your submit button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-the-design-of-your-buttons).

### Step 6 | Customize the input elements: Wix Editor
1. In your editor, click any of the input elements that you want to customize.
2. Click **Settings** to enter the field title, set the field as required, or adjust various settings depending on the input type.
3. Click the **Layout** icon to adjust the text alignment and other layout options.
4. Click the **Design** icon to choose a preset design, then select **Customize Design** to further adjust the appearance of the element.
5. (Optional) Click the **Animation** icon to [add an animation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-an-animation) to the element.
6. Repeat these steps for each input element you want to customize.

### Ready to go live?
Click **Preview** at the top right of your editor to test out your new custom form. When everything looks great and works perfectly, click **Publish** to make the changes go live. If you've enabled Sandbox, [sync your Sandbox collection to the live collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-sandbox-and-live-collections-and-syncing) to make the database changes go live.

question: How can I customize the design of my Booking Page on Dayful by Wix?
answer:
To customize your Booking Page on Dayful by Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to the Channels tab in your Dayful dashboard.
2. Click **Booking Page**.
3. Click **Edit Design**.
4. Choose what version of your Booking Page to edit, using the arrows next to **Preview**:
   * **Service List:** What your clients see when you display your service page. This can include any of your services.
   * **Calendar:** Show clients the full weekly timetable for specific appointments or classes.
   * **Memberships and packages:** Show clients your [pricing plans or membership packages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-about-memberships-and-packages).
5. Set the colors of your Booking Page on the left:
   * **Background color:** Choose an appropriate background for your services.
   * **Accent color:** Choose the color for your Booking Page buttons.
   * **Text color:** Choose the color for your font, make sure it stands out from the background color and easy to read.
   * **Font:** Choose the font for the text on your Booking Page.
6. Click **Save & Publish**.

**Note:** The design settings you choose for the Booking Page apply to all links you share and all website widgets you embed.

**Tip:** Click the Mobile Preview button to make sure your Booking Page design is optimized for mobile as well.

question: Is it possible to change my site's main language in Wix Multilingual?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to change your site's main language to a different language. 

### Workarounds
* [Delete Wix Multilingual](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-deleting-wix-multilingual-from-your-site) and re-add it. This allows you to start from the beginning and choose a new main language. We recommend [duplicating your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/duplicating-your-site-1472847) before deleting Wix Multilingual. This will help you later on when you re-add Wix Multilingual. You can refer to the duplicate for your previous translations and site design/layout. 

**Note:** When you delete Wix Multilingual and re-add it, your purchased word credits will not be restored, and you may need to [purchase more word credits to automatically translate your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-auto-translating-your-site).
* You can [enable the Auto-switch language toggle](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-automatically-showing-your-site-to-visitors-in-the-language-of-their-browsers), and automatically redirect visitors to the language version of your site that matches their browser's language.

question: How can I make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Hover over the relevant page and click the **More Actions** icon.

   **Tip:** Make sure you don't restrict the main (original) Pricing Plans page. You can, however, restrict other pages where you display plans. You can also hide the main page.

4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click **Permissions**.
6. Click **Site members**.
7. Select **Specific members**.
8. Click the **Members with plan subscriptions** toggle to enable it.
9. Click **Manage Plans**.
10. Select the checkbox next to the relevant pricing plans.
11. Click **Apply**.

question: Can I import all the details from previous events in one action in Wix Events?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to import all the details from previous events in one action. However, you can [duplicate](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-your-events-in-wix-events#viewing-event-drafts) an entire event to copy its details to new events. You can also copy and paste specific details such as [policies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-adding-a-policy-checkbox) and [registration messages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-customizing-registration-settings-messages#editing-the-thank-you-registration-closed-messages).

question: How do I connect my Apple and Google Developer accounts for my branded app?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have completed the design and content customization of your app.

### To connect Apple and Google Developer accounts:
1. [Go to the Branded App](https://www.wix.com/branded-apps?path=welcome&referralInfo=HelpCenter) dashboard in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Apple Developer Account** tab and follow the instructions to start registering your account. When you've finished registering, do the same for the **Google Developer Account** tab.

**Important:** Your Branded App plan does not include the app registration fee from Apple and Google. 
* To create an [Apple Developer account](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-creating-and-connecting-an-apple-developer-account) you also have to enroll in Apple's Developer program. This is a separate cost through Apple starting at $99 USD a year.
* To create a [Google Developer account](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-creating-and-connecting-a-google-developer-account) you also have to join the Google Developer Program. This is a $25 USD one-time fee that you pay separately to Google.

question: What steps should I follow if Google Ads disapproves my campaign due to Googlebot not being able to crawl my site?
answer:
If you received an email from Google about not being able to crawl your site because of robots.txt, you can test the robots.txt file by navigating to your [Google Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console/about) and following the steps below:

1. Log in to the [Google Search Console](https://www.google.com/webmasters/tools/robots-testing-tool?utm_source=support.google.com/webmasters/&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=+6062598&pli=1).
2. Choose the correct property.
3. Type the URL that was detected and blocked by robots.txt.
4. Click **Test**.

If Google shows "Allowed" when you test the file, this means that the robots.txt file is not blocking the Google bot. In this case, resubmit your campaign to Google.

question: Can I increase the character count for blog post titles beyond 200 characters in Wix Blog?
answer: Currently, blog post titles are capped at 200 characters. It is not possible to go over this limit.

question: How can I add a 'Save to Pinterest' button to my Wix site?
answer:
To add the Save to Pinterest button to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Social**.
4. Scroll down to the Pinterest section.
5. Drag the **Pin to Pinterest** button ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/10/09/f3bcefb7-0c30-4dae-80b3-cea59ae1284e/efa2eee9-756a-409b-9f8d-644f7f7d1fcc.png) onto your site.

**Note:** Place the button near or on the image you want visitors to be able to save.
6. Click **Add Image**.
7. Select the relevant image from your Media Manager and click **Add to Page**.

**Note:** This should be the same image that you just placed your pin on.
8. Enter a description to appear next to the pin when it's saved or shared:
   
   1. Click the **Settings** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/10/09/88420251-1ff8-4ba1-8791-fdb4d666e257/a9f536bb-cc85-4582-9303-6ead2d721e39.png).
   2. Enter your description under **What's this pin? Tell Pinterest**.
9. (Optional) Click the **Layout** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/10/09/d94a04ff-d7b4-41ee-906c-e05553179237/73cb48aa-efb0-48e5-8a45-bf9a972b2fca.png) to change the look of the button:
   
   * **What size is the button?:** Select either the small or large button.
   * **How does it look?:** Show or hide the number of times the image has been saved.
10. (Optional) Click the **Animation** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/09/440e8afd-e063-4c4d-a21a-2014df55796f.png) select an animation from the available options.

### Important
You should place the Save to Pinterest button on or next to the image you want visitors to share, however this does not automatically link it to the button. You still need to click **Add Image** to link it to the image you want to share.

question: How can I connect a button to a dataset in the Wix Editor to perform a specific action when clicked?
answer:
To connect a button to a dataset in the Wix Editor and define a specific action when clicked, follow these steps:

1. In your Editor, click the button you want to connect to the CMS.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/06/16/2d484f5d-e1bf-4d48-9e42-82216e8b88de/08e74518-edad-42f8-b007-c974ba767eb6.png).
3. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click **Add a Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name and click **Create**.
4. Click the **Click action connects to** drop-down and select the relevant option:
   
   * **Dataset Actions:** Choose the [action you want the dataset to perform](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images) when the button is clicked.
   * **Dynamic Pages:** Choose the [dynamic page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages) you want to link to. Then choose how the link opens: **In the current window** or **As a new window**.
   * **Fields:** Choose the collection field you want to connect to. You can connect to the following field types: **Audio**, **Document**, **Image**, **URL**, or **Video**. Learn more [about the field types and their content limitations](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-supported-content-in-collection-field-types).
   
   **Tip:** Select **Add new field** to [add a new field in your collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-a-field-to-a-collection) and link to it.

5. (Optional) Display dynamic text in the button that changes based on the collection item it links to. Click the **Label connects to** drop-down and select the relevant collection field.

   **Tip:** Alternatively, you can use static text that doesn't change by going to the button settings.

6. Click **Preview** to test your connections.
7. Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: Is there a Velo API available for Wix Online Programs?
answer: Currently there is no Velo API available for Online Programs.

question: How can I change the pricing plan for selling digital files only in my Wix Art Store?
answer:
To change your pricing plan when selling digital files only in your Wix Art Store, follow these steps:

1. Click the Wix Art Store app in your Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Store** tab.
4. Click **Set Pricing**.
5. Set which licenses you want to use:
   
   * **License Templates:** Click the toggles under **My Licenses** to enable or disable each license option:
     
     + **Commercial Use:** Web and digital use only.
     + **Extended Use:** Web, digital and print use.
   * **Custom License:** Click **Create License** and fill in the information to create a custom license:
     
     1. Enter the name of the license in the **License Name** field.
     2. Enter a description of the license in the **Description** field.
     3. (Optional) Upload your license agreement:
        
        1. Click **Upload**.
        2. Select your license document or click **Upload Docs** to upload it from your computer.
        3. Click **Apply**.
     4. Click **Save**.
6. Select or deselect the image resolution checkboxes and enter the price for the selected options:
   
   * **Web Ready:** Image quality is slightly reduced to allow for quicker web loading.
   * **Original File:** The image is purchased in its original quality.
7. Click **Save**.

**Tip:** All images within a specific Wix Art Store gallery are sold with the same pricing plan. Within each gallery, you can offer different prices for different licenses and qualities. To offer different images with a different pricing plan, add the app again to a different page of your site.

question: Can I connect multiple addresses from one collection item to the Google Maps element?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to connect more than one address for the same collection item to the Google Maps element. You can connect only one address field to your map to display one location per collection item. You can display multiple addresses on your map, however, they need to each be for different collection items. Learn how to [connect an address field from your CMS collection to the Google Maps element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-addresses-from-your-collection-items-on-google-maps).

question: Is it possible to hide the title and description when hovering over gallery images in Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, there is no option to hide the image title and description when hovering over gallery images.

question: Is the fade out feature for text elements supported in Wix Editor?
answer:
Currently, Wix does not support the fade out feature on text elements. As an alternative, you can create a similar effect by splitting your text, and [applying animation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-an-animation) to each element at different time intervals.

## To add animation to your text:
1. Select a text element in your Editor.
2. Click the Animation icon.
3. Select an effect, and click **Customize** to adjust the time settings (e.g. duration and delay).
4. Repeat steps 1-3 for each text field you want to animate.

question: Can I add alt text to a file directly inside the Wix Media Manager?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add alt text to a file directly inside the Media Manager. You must [add alt text to each individual file in the Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-images-and-galleries-for-seo-alt-text#adding-alt-text-to-individual-images).

question: Can I add a participant to multiple recurring class sessions at the same time using the Booking Calendar?
answer: This feature is not yet implemented. The article mentions the ability to "add a participant to multiple recurring class sessions at the same time" using the Booking Calendar, but it does not provide further details or instructions on how to do so.

question: Can I automatically sync my CMS collection changes with Google Sheets?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to automatically sync CMS collection changes to Google Sheets. However, you can use the following workarounds:

* You can [export your CMS collection data as a CSV file](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-exporting-content-from-your-collection), then import the CSV file to Google Sheets. This allows you to work with your collection content in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
* You can export your Google Sheets spreadsheet as a CSV file, then [import the CSV file to your CMS collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-importing-content-into-a-collection). This allows you to replace your CMS collection content with data imported from Google Sheets.

question: Can I add a signature field to a Wix price quote?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add a signature field to a price quote.

question: Can I add animation to hamburger menu containers in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add or edit an animation on [hamburger menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-using-hamburger-menus) containers.

question: How can I unpublish my site using ADI, and is there a way to keep it accessible via a direct link but hidden from search engines?
answer:
To unpublish your site using ADI, follow these steps:

1. Access your [Site Manager](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website).
2. Click **Unpublish**.
3. Click **Unpublish** to confirm.

If you want your site to remain accessible to users with a direct link, but do not want it to appear in Google search results, you can hide your site from search engines. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/enabling-search-engines-like-google-to-index-your-site) to learn more.

question: How can I edit, duplicate, or rename an automation using the new automation builder?
answer:
To edit, duplicate, or rename an automation using the new automation builder, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to the **Your automations** section.
3. Hover over the relevant automation and click the **More Actions** icon.
4. Choose what you want to do:

### Edit an automation
1. Click **Edit**.
2. Edit the automation as necessary.
3. When you're finished editing, click **Save**.

### Duplicate an automation
1. Click **Duplicate**.
2. Edit the relevant details within your duplicated automation.
   
   **Note:** Don't forget to update your duplicated automation's name, or it will remain 'Copy of...'.
3. When ready, click **Activate**.

### Rename an automation
1. Click **Rename**.
2. Edit the automation's name.
3. Click **Save**.

question: How can I display a single video in my Wix Video player instead of a channel?
answer:
To display a single video in your Wix Video player, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the Wix Video player.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. On the **Videos** tab, select **Single video**.
5. Search for the video you want in the search bar or select a video from the list by clicking on it.

### Important information about playing one video
* The single video format is not yet available with [action cards](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-video-adding-and-editing-action-cards). Similarly, videos that are not in a channel cannot yet be displayed in an email campaign.
* If you're looking to display a single video without the features of Wix Video, try adding the [single video editor element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/single-video-player-adding-and-setting-up-the-single-video-player).

question: How can I create a new rule in Wix Forms to show or hide fields based on user input?
answer:
To create new rules for your form in Wix Forms, follow these steps:

1. Click the relevant form in the editor.
2. Click **Edit Form**.
3. Click the **Rules** icon on the right.
4. Click **+ Add Rule**.

   **Note:** To enable Rules, your form must have a minimum of 2 fields.

5. Fill out the sections:
   
   **Choose a condition (If)**
   
   1. Select the field you want to base the rule on from the drop-down under **This field**.
   2. Select the condition for the rule from the drop-down (e.g. is empty, is filled, is equal to, etc.).
   3. (Optional) Add another condition to this rule.
      
      1. Click **+ Add Condition** to add another condition.
      2. Choose if the conditions should be combined with **And** or **Or**.
         
         * **And:** Both conditions need to be met.
         * **Or:** Either condition needs to be met.

   **Decide on the result (Then)**
   
   1. Select the field you want to base the rule on from the drop-down under **This field**.
   2. Select the condition for the rule from the drop-down (e.g. is hidden, shown, optional, required).

      **Tip:** You can select more than one field to apply the same result.
   3. (Optional) Click **+ Add Rule** to add another rule.

6. Click **Save Rule**.
7. Click **Save** at the top right to save the form.

Your rule is now saved. Publish these changes to ensure that the next user completing your form will see the updated rule.

question: How do I add and set up a pagination bar in my CMS dynamic page?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have connected a [repeater](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-dynamic-content-in-a-repeater) or [gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-collection-content-in-a-pro-gallery) to the dynamic dataset in a [dynamic list page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-dynamic-list-page) or [dynamic item page displaying items in categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-dynamic-pages-that-list-items-by-category-2254237).

### Step 1 | Add and customize a pagination bar
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the relevant dynamic page that can list multiple items:
   - Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   - Click **Dynamic Pages**.
   - Click the relevant dynamic page that can display multiple items.

   **Note:** Pagination bars are not relevant for dynamic item pages that can only display 1 item at a time.
3. Add a pagination bar:
   - Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
   - Click **Interactive**.
   - Click **Pagination Bar**.
   - Click and drag the pagination bar you want to use onto the page.
4. Customize the layout and design of the pagination bar:
   - **Layout**: Click **Change Layout** to adjust the layout and choose from options like **Click**, **Input**, or **Arrows**.

question: Why am I not seeing my Google AdSense ads on my site?
answer:
If you are unable to view AdSense ads on your site, consider the following potential causes and solutions:

### Ad was activated less than 48 hours ago
After entering a new ad code or editing an existing ad, it can take up to 48 hours for the new ad to appear. 

**Solution:** Wait until at least 48 hours have passed to see if the problem resolves itself.

### Ad is blocked by security software or a browser extension
Google AdSense ads can be blocked by browser settings or by ad blocking browser extensions/add-ons such as AdBlock. 

**How to check:**
* Check whether popups are blocked by your browser: 
  * [Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95472?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en)
  * [Firefox](https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/article/pop-blocker-settings-exceptions-troubleshooting#w_pop-up-blocker-settings)
  * [Internet Explorer](https://support.microsoft.com/en-au/help/17479/windows-internet-explorer-11-change-security-privacy-settings)
  * [Microsoft Edge](https://support.microsoft.com/en-hk/help/4026392/microsoft-edge-block-pop-ups)
  * [Safari](https://support.apple.com/en-il/HT203987)
* In your browser settings, check to see if any browser extensions/add-ons that block popups are enabled.
* Another way to test if ads are blocked on your computer is to [open your browser window in incognito mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/opening-your-browser-in-incognitoprivate-browsing-mode). If you are able to see ads, disable your browser extensions and Internet monitoring software applications one at a time. This may help you determine which ones are blocking your ads.

**Solution:** Note that ads blocked on your computer can display on other computers. You do not need to take any further action.

### Site no longer has the same domain
If the domain listed in Google AdSense does not match your current site domain, ads no longer appear on your site. 

* Remove the incorrect domain and add your site's new domain name. [Learn More](https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/9130038)
* If you have failed to renew your domain, ads no longer appear on your site. Go to the [Domains tab](https://www.wix.com/dashboard/14b6506c-b158-4653-a0d1-3c4a6769bd33/manage-website/domains?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard and connect your domain.
* If you connected a new domain to your site, Google AdSense no longer recognizes your site. Add your site's new URL to the list in the **Sites** tab in the AdSense Dashboard. [Learn More](https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/9130038)

### Site verification status in Google AdSense is "unverified"
If changes were made to a verified site, ads may no longer display.

### Site has a policy violation
If your site does not comply with one of Google AdSense policies, ads won't display. 

**How to check:** In the AdSense dashboard, click the **Account** tab, select **Policy Center**, and check for policy violations. 

**Solution:** Take appropriate action to fix the specific problem.

### Important
The Google AdSense app works by displaying the information that it receives from Google. If you have followed all the steps above and still don't see ads on your site, we recommend contacting Google to find out the specific reason that ads are not displaying on your site. [Learn how](https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/9437976)

question: Why didn't I receive a free domain voucher after purchasing a Wix site plan?
answer:
If you didn't receive the voucher, or believe it wasn't credited to your domain purchase, you may not have been eligible for one of the following reasons:

* **You purchased a monthly plan:** The free domain voucher is offered as a gift with purchase of selected **yearly** site plans. If you purchased a monthly plan you are not eligible for the free domain voucher.
* **You purchased your domain name before you purchased a site plan:** If you purchased your domain name prior to purchasing your Wix site plan, it is not possible to apply the voucher retroactively or offer you a refund. If you received the voucher and already have a domain name, you are welcome to use it for the purchase of another domain name.
* **The voucher has already been applied**: If you have a collaborator with [Billing Manager permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-voucher-roles-permissions), they may already have applied the voucher for your site.
* **Additional Features:** You redeemed your voucher, but purchased additional features such as privacy, or additional years of service on top of this.

If none of the points above apply to you, please [contact us](https://www.wix.com/contact) and we'll be happy to check the status of your voucher.

question: How do I verify my Employer Identification Number (EIN) in Wix Payments?
answer:
To verify your Employer Identification Number (EIN) in Wix Payments, follow these steps:

1. **Complete your Wix Payments account setup** as a Partnership, LLC, Corporation, or NGO. During this process, you will be asked to provide your company's 9-digit EIN.

2. **Upload a copy of your EIN confirmation notice**. Ensure the following:
   - The company name should be visible and clear and should match the business details in your Wix Payments account.
   - The Employer Identification Number should be visible and clear.
   - Documents must be sent in one of the following formats: jpeg, jpg, pdf, png.
   - The maximum file size is 10 MB.
   - The minimum file size is 1 kB for PDF, 100 kB for other formats.

If all details have been entered correctly, the verification process usually takes 1 working day to complete. If your EIN has not been successfully verified after this timeframe, please [contact us](https://www.wix.com/contact) and we'll investigate the issue.

question: How can I create a membership plan for an event in Wix Events?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have created a ticketed event and at least one type of ticket for the event.

To create a membership plan for an event:

1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select a ticketed event.
3. Click the **Tickets** tab.
4. Click **Edit** next to **Memberships**.
5. Click **Create Membership**.
6. Click **Get Started**. 

   **Note:** The Pricing Plans app is added to your site.

7. Enter the plan name (e.g. VIP plan).
8. (Optional) Enter a short description of the plan.
9. Enter each plan benefit and press **Enter** on your keyboard (e.g. 20% discount on concerts, first drink 30% off).
10. (Optional) Connect this plan to other benefits:

    **Note:** You can connect this plan to other events, or other services your site offers (e.g. [groups](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-using-wix-groups-to-promote-your-events)). The event you are editing is automatically connected to this plan.

11. Enter the discount amount next to each event (e.g. 25%).
12. Enter the maximum number of tickets a guest can apply the discount to next to each event.
13. Select a pricing option:

    * **Free Plan:** Clients don't pay for this plan:
      
      + Select the duration of the plan from the **Length of Plan** drop-down.
    * **One-time Payment:** Clients pay a specific amount for the entire duration of the plan.
      
      1. Enter the plan price in the **Price** field.
      2. Select the duration of the plan from the **Length of Plan** drop-down.
    * **Recurring Payments:** Clients pay a specific amount each period, until the plan ends (e.g. a monthly membership that lasts 6 months).
      
      1. Enter the price for each recurring period.
      2. Select how often payments are made from the **Payment Frequency** drop-down.
      3. Select the duration from the **Length of Plan** drop-down (i.e. how long the entire plan is valid for).
      4. (Optional) Enable the **Enable Free Trial** toggle and set the trial length. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-offering-your-clients-a-free-trial-period)

14. (Optional) Make this a promotional plan that clients can book only once. Click the **People can only buy this plan once** toggle to create a promotional plan for free or for a reduced price.

    **Note:** Clients who try to purchase a second time see a notice that the plan can be purchased once.

15. (Optional) Click the **Allow plan cancellation** to let members cancel the membership by themselves.
16. (Optional) Click the **Let people set start date** to let members decide when the clock starts running on their membership.
17. (Optional) Click **Add** next to **Add a policy**. The policy appears on the checkout page.
18. (Optional) Click **Select** next to **Collect additional info at checkout**. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-collecting-additional-information-at-checkout)
19. Click **Edit** next to **Customize a Thank you page**. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-customizing-your-thank-you-page)
20. Click **Save**.

question: How can I provide a copy of my customer's data collected on my Wix site?
answer:
To get a copy of your customer's data collected on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Privacy & Cookies](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Privacy%20Center&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/cookie-consent-settings-app?referralInfo=article_about-your-customers-data) in your site's settings.
2. Click **Visitor Data**.
3. Click **Data Request**.
4. Click **+ New Request**.
5. Click the dropdown and select **Get a copy of their data**.
6. Click **Continue**.
7. Verify that the email **or** phone number belongs to the customer who made the request:
   * Enter their phone number.
   * Enter their email address. 
   **Important:** Make sure to enter the email address **exactly** as it is saved in your contact list.
8. Click **Submit Request**.

After submitting a request, you will receive a notification confirming the start of the process. You'll receive your customer's data file within 48 hours of submitting the request.

**After you've received your customer's data file, make sure to do the following:**
* Confirm the customer's identity and contact details.
* Download your customer's data file using the link in the email.
* Send the file to your customer via email.

**Notes:**
* For larger files, you may wish to use a file sharing service agreed with the customer.
* No email is sent to your customer. As a site owner, it is your responsibility to send the data file.

question: How can I resolve the 'There Are No Available Rooms' error in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
answer:
To resolve the 'There Are No Available Rooms' error in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Check that you are showing unavailable rooms in search results in Reservation settings
Make sure to enable the **Show unavailable rooms in search results** checkbox under **Search rules** in Reservation settings under [Property Settings](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1c5b7dec-159e-48cf-b618-6d77d7a17f8c%7C1%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Property+Settings). This gives your guests the chance to try searching for alternative dates or to contact you about making a reservation.

### Step 2 | Check that your opening dates are correct under General Settings
Make sure you select the correct opening dates for your property under **Season and time** in General Settings under [Property Settings](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1c5b7dec-159e-48cf-b618-6d77d7a17f8c%7C1%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Property+Settings).

### Step 3 | Check that the relevant countries appear in your Market list
Make sure you connect the relevant countries from which you accept reservations in the [Markets](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1c5b7dec-159e-48cf-b618-6d77d7a17f8c%7C6%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Markets) section of your site's dashboard.

### Step 4 | Check that your Inventory Calendar is configured correctly
To check that your [Inventory Calendar](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1a6e0874-2039-49cf-bef3-9138bb5c3b16%7C2%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Manage+Inventory) is set up correctly:
1. Check if you have **Stop Sell** active on the relevant dates (Stop Sell dates appear in red on the calendar).
2. Check if **Close to arrivals** or **close to departures** are active on the incorrect dates.
3. Check if you have the correct minimum stay set up for the relevant room that's not available to reserve on your site.

### Step 5 | Check that the relevant rate plan isn't hidden
Make sure the relevant [rate plan](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1c5b7dec-159e-48cf-b618-6d77d7a17f8c%7C3%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Rate+Plans) isn't hidden from your site.

If the problem persists, you may need to contact Wix support with specific details about your site and the issue.

question: How can I avoid my email marketing campaigns from being marked as spam?
answer:
To avoid your email marketing campaigns from being marked as spam, follow these best practices:

1. **Create engaging email content:** Your emails should make a strong first impression with high quality, value-driven content. From the subject line to the text and images, every part should offer value to your subscribers. Learn more about [creating engaging email content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-engaging-content).

2. **Only email your subscribers:** Only email people who have explicitly consented to receive your messages. Sending emails to people who don’t recognize you or why they’re receiving your emails is a fast way to get spam complaints. 
   **Tip:** [Add a subscribe form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-subscribe-form) to your site to make it easy for people to join your mailing list and build an engaging audience for your campaigns.

3. **Develop good frequency practices:** Establish a consistent email schedule. Once you find the right frequency for your subscribers, stick to it. Best practices recommend sending 1 to 5 campaigns per month.

4. **Avoid spam traps:** Do not purchase email lists. Make sure all your recipients have given explicit permission to send them emails. Send your email campaigns only to your [active contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-about-active-and-inactive-contacts). Clean your contact list at least twice a year and remove recipients with whom you have not been in touch for over 6 months.
   **Tip:** Use [campaign statistics](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-your-email-campaign-statistics) to locate and remove addresses that consistently bounce or remain unopened.

5. **Test your email campaigns:** Test your email campaigns by sending them to yourself or a small group first to catch any issues before sending to your entire list.

By adhering to these practices, you can reduce the likelihood of your emails being marked as spam and improve your email deliverability.

question: How can I create a pricing plan for a blog post on Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites: You need to have a payment method set up in order to set up a subscription.

To create a pricing plan for your blog post on Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog) tab in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Create New Post**.
3. Click **Monetize** in the toolbar on the left.
4. Click **Get Started**.
5. Click **Create Plan** in the popup.
6. Enter the plan details:
   * **Plan name**: Choose a descriptive name for your plan.
   * **Tagline**: Write a concise and appealing tagline that summarizes the plan's benefits.
   * **List of benefits**: Detail the benefits that subscribers receive as part of the plan.
7. Under **Other Benefits**, choose which posts you want to include:
   1. Click **Choose Posts** under **Posts included**.
   2. Select the posts you want to include.
   3. Click **Done**.
8. Under **Pricing Options**, set the pricing and duration of the subscription. You can choose from the following options:
   * **Free Plan:** Offer your blog readers access to your subscription content for free. Click the drop-down to select the duration.
   * **One Time Payment:** Offer your readers access to your subscription content for a one-time payment. Enter the price and select the length of the plan.
   * **Recurring Payments**: Offer your readers access to your subscription content when they set up a recurring payment plan. Enter the payment frequency and the price of each payment.
9. (Optional) Under **Settings**, provide details of the plan policy:
   1. Click the **One purchase per person toggle** to choose how you want to allow visitors to purchase this plan:
      * **Enabled**: Visitors can only purchase this plan once.
      * **Disabled**: Visitors can purchase this plan more than once.
   2. Provide any important information about the plan, e.g., renewals, cancellations, and refunds.
10. When you're ready to create your plan, click **Save**.

question: How can I display shared folders on multiple pages of my Wix site using the Wix File Share app?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure to add the [Wix File Share app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-apps-adding-and-setting-up-the-file-share-app#step-1-add-the-file-share-app-to-your-site) to your site.

### Step 1 | Add the Shared Folder Add-On
Once you've added the Wix File Share app to your site, you can then go and add the Shared Folder app as an "Add-On". Both apps work together to enable you to share your files/folders on multiple site pages.

#### To add the app:
1. Click the File Share app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Add-Ons**.
4. Click **Choose Add-On**.
5. Click the **Add to Page** drop-down and select the page you want to add the app to.

### Step 2 | Choose a folder to display
Choose the folder you want to display in the file. This folder appears on the page you selected as part of step 1. You can select an existing folder or make a new folder.

#### To add a folder:
1. Click the Shared Folder app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Select Folder**.
4. Select an existing folder or click **+ New Folder** to add a new folder.

### Step 3 | Customize what is displayed on the app
Choose the elements you want to display on your app and customize how the files are sorted in the folder.

#### To customize the display:
1. Click the Shared Folder app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Display** tab.
4. Select the checkboxes next to the elements you want to display.
5. Click the **Sort folder items by** drop-down and choose how you want to sort the items in your folder:
   * **Last updated:** Sort the items by when they were last updated.
   * **Item name A-Z:** Sort the items alphabetically from A-Z.
   * **Item name Z-A:** Sort the items alphabetically from Z-A.
   * **Most views:** Sort the items by most views.
   * **Most favorites:** Sort the items by the files that are the most popular.
   * **Item type:** Sort the items by type.
   * **Item size:** Sort the items by size.
6. Choose an alignment for the display: **Left** or **Right**.

### Step 4 | Customize the design of your folder
Change the design to match the look and feel of your site.

#### To customize the design:
1. Click the Shared Folder app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Design** tab.
4. Choose what you want to customize:
   * **Icons, Style & Color:** Choose a style for your icons and customize the color.
   * **Buttons & Actions:** Choose the button style and color.
   * **Table & Background:** Customize the table content and colors, adjust the divider line, and change the background color.

### Tip
Publish your site to view the changes.

question: Can I set different payment methods for pickup and delivery orders in Wix Restaurants?

question: How do I create a site using Wix Editor and what are the steps involved?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have set up your business dashboard as described in Step 4.

To create a site using Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. **Create your site**: Once your dashboard is set up, click **Design Site** to start creating your site. You can use the AI tool or customize a professionally designed template.
   - **Using AI**: Customize the prompt or regenerate the design until it matches your vision. You can further customize your site later in the Wix Editor.
   - **Using a site template**: Choose from over [800+ website templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates) that fit your style preferences. You can add apps to any template in seconds.

2. **Customize your site in the Wix Editor**: Change every part of your site, including text, media, and layout.
   - **Add and edit text**: Remove default text and [add your own](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-editing-text). Use the [AI text creator tool](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-the-ai-text-creator) if needed.
   - **Add media or upload your own**: Add [images](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-an-image-on-your-site) or upload your own. Use [image AI tools](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-creating-images-with-the-wix-ai-image-creator) for creative graphics.
   - **Add animations**: Use animations like "Float-in" and "Expand-in" to enhance your site. [Learn more about adding animations.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-an-animation)

3. **Publish your site**: Once satisfied, click the Publish button. [Learn more about publishing your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-publishing-your-site).
   - **Connecting a domain**: [Upgrade your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-your-site-to-premium-3066683) to connect your own domain for a professional touch. [Learn more about domains](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domains)

question: How can I make my website accessible for visitors with sight impairments?
answer:
To make your website accessible for visitors with sight impairments, you should prepare your media by:

* [Adding alt text to images and galleries on your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-images-and-galleries)
* [Adding text descriptions to GIFs and other media without sound](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-making-videos-and-audio-accessible#adding-text-descriptions-to-media-without-sound)
* [Adding audio descriptions to videos on your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-making-videos-and-audio-accessible#adding-audio-descriptions-to-videos)

**Tip:** Don't forget to check that all of the text on your site has the correct [HTML tag](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-site-structure), so the screen reader doesn't skip or jump around the pages.

question: How can I set up an automation to send a welcome email when a new site member is approved in Wix?
answer:
To set up an automation to send a welcome email when a new site member is approved in Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation.**
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Click **Site Members** in the **Trigger** section.
6. Select **Member approved** as your chosen trigger.
7. Select your chosen action in the **Action** section and set up the action using the available options. Learn more about [actions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-3-choose-an-action).
8. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
9. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when the action should be carried out. You can choose **Immediately** or **Set custom time**.
10. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency. You can choose **Don't limit (trigger every time)**, **Once per contact**, or **Once per contact every 24hrs**.
11. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
12. Click **Activate** to activate and save your new automation.

question: How can I cancel and refund an order paid via PayPal on my Wix site?
answer:
To cancel and refund an order paid via PayPal on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Orders tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant order. 

   **Tip:** Only paid orders can be canceled and refunded. For stores, only unfulfilled orders can be canceled and refunded.
3. Click **More Actions** at the top right.
4. Select **Cancel & Refund**.
5. (Optional) To provide a partial refund, enter the amount you want to refund.
6. (Optional) Select the **Update inventory** checkbox, to return all items to stock. 

   **Tip:** This option is relevant only if you use Wix Stores and track inventory amounts.
7. (Optional) Select the **Send a confirmation email to customer** checkbox to send a message. You can enter a personal note to your customer. 

   **Note:** Customers may also receive a notification from the payment provider.
8. Click **Continue**.
9. Click **Cancel This Order**. 

   **Note:** This cannot be undone.

question: Is there a built-in way to provide users with a free trial for my Wix Blocks app?

question: How can I enable or disable push notifications in the Wix app on my mobile device?
answer:
To enable or disable push notifications in the Wix app on your mobile device, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Inbox** at the bottom.
3. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right.
4. Tap **Settings**.
5. Tap **Notification settings** under **General Settings**.
6. Tap the **Allow Push Notifications** toggle to enable or disable the relevant notifications:
   
   * **Enabled:** You receive push notifications from the notification types of your choice. Tap the toggle next to the relevant notification type to enable or disable it. After disabling a notification, choose how long you want to mute notifications for.
   * **Disabled:** All notifications are disabled. Select the time frame you want to disable all notifications for.

question: How can I customize the text on my logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
answer:
To customize the text on your logo using the Wix Logo Maker, follow these steps:

**To add new text to your logo:**
1. Click **Text** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f1b5ecb4-ca89-48f1-8ab9-874357eb9d8b/2024/08/12/5c442f79-2b0c-484a-96ae-f9725561390c/bb7ef9ad-8d68-4ea7-adf2-f5c60d1ad180.png) on the left.
2. Click **\+ Add Text**.
3. Enter your text under **Edit text** and customize it as needed.

**To customize existing text:**
1. Click the existing text on your logo.
2. Customize the text using the following options:
   * **Edit text:** Click the text field to replace the text.
   * **Font:** Click **Change Font** to select a new font. Choose from the available fonts, or [upload your own](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-uploading-your-own-fonts-to-the-wix-logo-maker).
   * **Alignment:** Select your text's alignment (left, center, right).
   * **Text color:** Click the color box to change the text's color. Choose from the colors based on your color palette or add a new color.
   * **Text opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the text.
   * **Outline width:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the outline around your text.
   * **Outline color:** Click the color box to choose the color of your text's outline or enter a HEX code.
   * **Size:** Drag the slider to change the text's size (between 1 and 400 pixels).
   * **Letter spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the space between the letters.
   * **Flip:** Click the relevant icon to flip the text horizontally or vertically.
   * **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the text.
   * **Text Curve:** Drag the slider to bend the text into a curve.
   * **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move the text left or right.
   * **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move the text up or down.
   * **Shadow:** Enable the toggle to add a shadow behind the icon and customize it using the options.
   * **Blur:** Enable the toggle to blur the text. Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness.

**Note:** Under [Wix Logo Terms of Use](https://www.wix.com/about/logo-terms-of-use), every logo is required to have a business name. It is not possible to have a logo with an icon only.

question: How can I add Wix Hotels to my site and what features does it offer?
answer:
To add Wix Hotels to your site, you can follow the instructions provided in the [Add Wix Hotels to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-wix-hotels) guide. 

Wix Hotels offers the following features:

* **Take reservations 24/7:** Never miss a booking with around-the-clock reservation capabilities.
* **Accept online and offline payments:** Offer your guests flexible payment options, both online and in person.
* **Manage your room inventory:** Keep track of your room availability with ease.
* **Synchronize bookings with the Channel Manager:** Ensure your bookings are always up-to-date across multiple platforms.
* **Add up to 12 languages:** Cater to international guests by supporting multiple languages.
* **Set seasonal rates and extra charges:** Optimize your pricing strategy with customizable seasonal rates and fees.
* **Let guests book from anywhere - computer, tablet or smartphone:** Provide a seamless booking experience on any device.

Before adding Wix Hotels, make sure to read the [legal requirements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/legal-requirements-for-wix-features) for Wix features.

question: How can I auto-translate my entire Wix site using the Translation Manager?
answer:
To auto-translate your entire Wix site using the Translation Manager, follow these steps:

1. Click [Auto-translate Site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-auto-translating-your-site) at the bottom left.
2. Click **Auto-translate Site** in the pop-up to confirm.
3. If you don't have enough word credit, you can [purchase more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-auto-translating-your-site).

**Note:** Any text you already edited will not be changed.
4. Review the translations.
5. (Optional) Replace the text in the text box to match the correct translation and click **Done** to confirm the change.
6. Repeat these steps for each text you want to translate automatically.

Once you have finished translating all the fields, click **Save and Publish**. To show the translation on your live site, change the status of the relevant language from **Hidden** to **Visible**.

question: Can I use Instamojo as a payment provider on Wix?

question: Can readers like a forum post on Wix Forum without logging in?

question: How can I delete my Wix account using the Wix app?
answer:
To delete your account using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap your profile icon at the top.
3. Tap **Manage Account Settings**.
4. Tap **Delete Your Account**.
5. Tap **Continue** to follow the steps on how to delete your account.

Once you delete your account, you can no longer use any of your Wix services. Your account and all its data will be removed permanently. **Important:** Wix will not be able to restore your account or retrieve your data in the future.

question: Can I change the time intervals between reservation slots in the Wix Table Reservations app?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the time intervals between reservation slots using the Wix Table Reservations app. The available time slots are set in 15-minute intervals, such as 10:00, 10:15, and 10:30.

question: How can I customize the Wix AI Chat Assistant to reflect my brand's style and voice?
answer:
Designing and customizing the AI Chat Assistant in your editor allows you to reflect your brand's voice and style. Customize colors, fonts, layouts and more, making it easy to find and use. An inviting chat interface encourages customers to get in touch, providing them with better service and increasing your site's engagement.

Learn more about [designing and customizing the AI Chat Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/designing-and-customizing-the-wix-ai-chat-assistant).

question: Can I use the Selection Tags input element to display plain text without any functionality?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to use the [Selection Tags input element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-selection-tags) to display plain text without any functionality. However, you can use the Selection Tags element to let visitors click to filter content or click to submit selections to your collection.

### Workaround
You can [connect text elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-connecting-text-elements-to-collection-fields) to the Tags field type to show the tags as plain text without any clickable functionality.

question: Is it possible to move from section to section in the Studio Editor using a keyboard shortcut?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to move from section to section in the Studio Editor via a keyboard shortcut.

question: Is it possible to save or copy design settings to a new Pro Gallery?
answer:
Currently, any design or settings changes you make to an existing Pro Gallery must be recreated from scratch in any new galleries. It's not possible to save or copy your design settings to a new gallery, or save your own presets. 

As a workaround, you can [duplicate an existing gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-downloading-images-from-a-gallery#duplicating-a-gallery). However, this is generally not recommended for optimal performance.

question: How do I set up Apple's in-app purchase for my branded app?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your Apple Developer account and your Branded app dashboard in your Wix account.

### To set up Apple's in-app purchase:
1. Go to your [Branded app dashboard](https://www.wix.com/branded-apps?path=welcome&referralInfo=HelpCenter) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Apple-In-App Purchase** on the left.
3. Click **Get Started**.

question: Can I send abandoned cart notifications to my clients using Wix Bookings?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to send your clients notifications via email or SMS when they abandon their cart before completing checkout.

question: How can I send a link to a store product using Wix Chat?
answer:
To send a link to a store product using Wix Chat, follow these steps:

1. Choose the contact you'd like to chat with:
   * [Go to Inbox](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Inbox&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/inbox/) in your site's dashboard and click an existing conversation.

2. Click the text box at the bottom to start typing your message.
3. Click the **Message via** drop-down and select **Chat**.

question: Can I manually send review requests to customers using Wix Reviews?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to manually send requests. question: How can I assign my existing Wix Premium plan to an Editor X site?
answer:
To assign your existing Wix Premium plan to an Editor X site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the plan you want to reassign.
3. Select **Assign to a different site**.
4. Click the checkbox next to the relevant Editor X Site.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Click **Compare Plans**.

question: How can I connect Twint as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Twint as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Twint.
4. Depending on whether you need to create a new TFTW account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your TFTW Key and TFTW Secret.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account
   1. Click [**Create TFTW account**](https://www.pend.ch/en/payment-methods/twint).
   2. Register for a TFTW merchant account to receive your credentials.
   3. Once your merchant account is approved, return to this window (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your TFTW account to avoid transaction declines. [Learn how to change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: How can I mark items as 'Received' in a Wix Stores purchase order and update the inventory?
answer:
To mark items as 'Received' in a Wix Stores purchase order and update the inventory, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Purchase Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Purchase%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/purchase-order) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant order.

question: How can I add an action card to a video I uploaded on Wix?
answer:
To add an action card to a video you uploaded on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant video to which you want to add a card.
3. Click the **Action Cards** tab.

   - **Promote a Video**: Select whether to **Always promote your latest video** or **Choose a video to promote**, then select the relevant video and channel, and click **Save**.

question: How can I add and customize a hotel search bar on my Wix site using the original Wix Hotels app?
answer:
To add a search bar to your Wix site using the original Wix Hotels app, follow these steps:

1. Click the Wix Hotels app in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Add-Ons** tab.
4. Click the **Add to Site** drop-down next to **Search Bar**.
5. Select the page you want to place the search bar on.
6. (Optional) Drag the search bar to place it and use the stretch handles to resize it.

To customize the Search Bar:

1. Click **Settings**.
2. Click the following tabs to customize the Search Bar to suit your needs:
   
   **Settings**
   - **Layout**: Select a layout for your search bar.
   - **Fields**: Select or deselect the **Kids** checkbox to show or hide this field. 
     **Note:** This is useful if your hotel or rental property does not allow children.
   - **Date format:** Click the drop-down and select your preferred date format.

   **Design**
   - **Titles text:** Select the color and font of the title text.
   - **Body text:** Select the color and font of the body text.
   - **Background:** Select the background color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
   - **Buttons background:** Select the background color of the buttons and drag the slider to change the opacity.
   - **Buttons text color:** Select the button text color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
   - **Separators color:** Select the separator line color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
   - **Fields background:** Select the field background color.
   - **Fields text color:** Select the field text color.

   **Text**
   - **Title:** Edit the title text.
   - **Date Labels:** Edit the check in and check out text.
   - **Guest Labels:** Edit the Adult and Kids text.
   - **Button label:** Edit the search button text.

### Tip
You can place the Search Bar on multiple pages of your site, and design each one differently.

question: How can I delete a collection in the CMS, and what should I check before doing so?
answer:
To delete a collection in the CMS, follow these steps:

1. Go to [CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Content%20Manager&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon on the relevant collection.
3. Click **Delete Collection**.
4. Click **Yes, delete collection** to confirm you want to delete the collection.
5. Click **Delete**.

Before deleting a collection, we recommend checking the following:

- **Are there dynamic pages connected to the collection?** If so, convert them to regular pages or delete the pages unless you plan to connect a different collection. Visitors to your live site will encounter a 500 error when attempting to view dynamic pages associated with the deleted collection.
- **Are any datasets connected to this collection?** Make sure to remove any connected dataset filters that are in use. This includes datasets set to filter by reference field or by dataset. If your filter settings are unmatched, the dataset will be empty.
- **Is this collection referenced in another collection?** If the collection is referenced elsewhere, make sure to remove the reference by either updating it to a different collection, modifying the field type, or deleting the reference field. If you do not do this there will be broken references in the items.

By checking these factors, you can ensure a smooth deletion process and prevent any problems or disruptions on your site.

question: Does the Right Click Protect app support preventing Ctrl+C copying on my Wix site?

question: What are some tips for improving engagement rates in Wix Email Marketing?
answer:
To improve your engagement rates in Wix Email Marketing, consider the following tips:

- **Send your email campaigns only to your [active contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-about-active-and-inactive-contacts)** to increase your customers' engagement and avoid compliance restrictions.
- **Clean your contact list periodically.** Delete any subscribers who have not opened or clicked on an email from you in the last six months.
- **For best results, send your emails between 8am to 2pm on Mon, Tues, Wed or Thurs.**
- **When people sign up to your email list, let them know how often they can expect an email from you.**
- **Write interesting and inviting subject lines.** Avoid using phrases such as "100% guaranteed", adding symbols, or writing in capital letters.
- **Try to segment your contact list to different groups of interest, and tailor your content to each group.**

Additionally, you can check out the [Wix Email Marketing Best Practices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-email-marketing-best-practices) for more ways to improve your email delivery rates.

question: How can I add Google AdSense ads to my blog posts in Wix Blog?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have a Google AdSense account and your site is verified. You also need to have a connected domain.

To add Google AdSense ads to your blog posts in Wix Blog, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create a Google AdSense account
1. Go to [Google AdSense](https://www.google.com/adsense).
2. Sign up for a new account.
3. Click **Sites** in the left sidebar.
4. Click **Add site**.
5. Enter the URL of your site.
6. Click **Save and continue**.

### Step 2 | Create an ad unit and generate an AdSense code
1. In Google AdSense, go to the **Ads** tab.
2. Click the **Ad Units** tab.
3. Select **Display ads under Create new ad unit**.
4. Enter a name for your ad in the field provided.
5. Click the Ad size drop-down at the top right and select **Fixed**.
6. Click **Create**.
7. Click **Copy code snippet** to copy the code.
8. Save the code for future use.

### Step 3 | Add the AdSense code to a blog post
1. [Go to Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/blog) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the blog post you want to edit, or click **Create a Post** to start writing a new post.
3. Click **Add** on the left.
4. Click **AdSense** under **From the web**.
5. Paste the AdSense code from your document under **Insert an ad from AdSense**.
6. Click **Save**.

**Notes:**
- It may take a few moments for the ad to appear in the post.
- To view the ad, make sure to disable any ad blockers you've installed on your browser.

question: How can I create a custom login form for my member's area on my site?
answer:
To create a custom login form for your member's area, follow these steps:

1. Click the **Pages** icon on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Signup & Login**.
3. Click **Member Login Form**.
4. Click the drop-down menu and select **Custom Form**.
5. Select which option your members should see first in the login form:
   * **New member signup:** The signup window appears first. Existing members see a link to switch to the login window.
   * **Existing member login:** The login window appears first. New members see a link to switch to the signup window.
6. Click **Edit Custom Log In Form** to access the form.
7. Customize your form by doing the following:
   
   ### Design the form
   Click the **Design** icon to choose a new preset design for your form. To make further changes to the design, click **Customize Design**.
   
   ### Customize the form fields
   Customize the fields of your login form. Select a form field and edit it by doing the following:
   * Click **Settings** to adjust settings like the field's placeholder text.
   * Click the **Design** icon to choose a new preset design for the field.
   * Click the **Layouts** icon to adjust the alignment and padding.
   
   ### Remove login elements
   Remove login elements that you don't need, like the option to sign in through Google or Facebook. If needed, you can re-add them at any time.
   
   **To remove a login element:**
   1. Click the element to select it.
   2. Press the **DEL** key on your keyboard to remove it.
   
   ### Add login elements
   1. Click the **Add Login Elements** icon.
   2. Click the **Add** icon next to the element you want to add.
   
   **Tip:** Click **Add All Elements** at the bottom to add all missing login elements at once.

If your custom form only appears on your live site, you may be experiencing a known issue. We are aware of this issue and are working to resolve it as soon as possible. [Learn more about this issue and see potential workarounds](https://support.wix.com/en/article/custom-signup-lightbox-appears-on-live-site-only-includes-workaround).

question: How can I choose which readers receive email notifications when I publish a blog post on my Wix site?
answer:
To choose who notifications are sent to, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/blog) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** drop-down and select **Blog settings**.
3. Click **Manage** next to **Manage your notifications & emails**.
4. Click the **More Actions** icon next to **Notify when a blog post is published**.
5. Click **Edit**.
6. Choose the recipients for each action:
   
   **Send an email**
   1. Click **Broadcast Lists** under **Include additional recipients**. 
      
      **Note:** This recipient type is automatically included as part of the pre-installed automation.
   2. Choose who you want to send the notification to:
      
      * **Author Followers:** Send notifications to people following the author of the blog post.
      * **Site Members:** Send notifications to all of your site members.
   3. Click **Add**.

**Tip:** You can add additional recipients by clicking **+ Add Recipients** and selecting individual contacts, [labels](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-contact-labels), or [segments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-campaign-to-a-segment).

4. Click **Save** on the top right.

question: How can I upload my own fonts to Editor X and what formats are supported?
answer:

4. Click **Upload Fonts** at the bottom.
