question: How can I create an invoice for a custom order using Wix Retail POS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to a desktop computer as creating an invoice is not possible on the tablet.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Create a manual order on desktop
To start, go to the Orders tab on your desktop computer and create a manual order. You can select any store products or Wix Bookings services to add to the order. You can also add a custom item. You don't need to select a shipping option.

Learn how to [manually create an order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/manually-creating-an-order-8027377).

#### Step 2 | Create an Invoice for the order
Now that you have your order, select it from the list of orders in the dashboard and create an invoice. You can optionally send the invoice to your customer or print it out using the options at the top of the invoice.

Learn more about [creating invoices for unpaid orders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-invoices-for-store-orders#requesting-payment-via-invoice-for-an-unpaid-order).

#### Step 3 | (Optional) Collect a deposit
If you want to charge your customer some (or all) of the order price before they come to pick up the order, you can do so on the POS tablet.

**To collect a deposit:**
1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Sales History** from the bottom bar.
3. Tap the relevant sale.

   **Tip:** You can click to view the invoice number to view the invoice.
4. Tap **Collect** at the top right.
5. Tap **Split Total** at the top right.
6. Enter the deposit amount.
7. Tap **Continue**.
8. Select a payment method (e.g. cash) and complete the first part of the payment.
9. Tap **Continue**.
10. Tap **Mark as Partially Paid**.

#### Step 4 | Complete the sale
When you're ready to complete the sale, go into your Sales History in the POS tablet to complete the order. You can collect the entire amount of the sale or the balance if you collected a deposit.

**To accept payment and complete the sale:**
1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Sales History** from the bottom bar.
3. Tap the relevant sale.

   **Tip:** You can click to view the invoice number to view the invoice.
4. Tap **Collect** at the top right.
5. Accept payment as you would for any POS sale.

question: How do I create a new automation in Wix Automations?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to your site's dashboard and have completed any necessary setup for the apps you plan to use.

To create a new automation in Wix Automations, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** at the top right.
3. Choose how you want to start creating your automation:
   * **From Scratch:** Click **Start from Scratch** to begin from a blank automation template.
   * **Suggested automation:** Use the categories or search bar to find the suggested automation you want to edit. Then click **Set Up** next to the automation.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.

Next, choose a trigger for your automation:

1. Click the app you'd like to base your trigger on in the **Trigger** section.
2. Select your chosen trigger from the available options.
3. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
   * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
   * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.

(Optional) Add a delay to your automation:

1. Click **+ Add Delay**.
2. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours, and minutes.

(Optional) Add a condition to your automation:

1. Click **+ Add Condition**.
2. Click the **Select criteria** drop-down and choose the criteria you want to use to decide whether this automation continues each time it's triggered.
3. Click the drop-down that appears next to your criteria drop-down to select your operator (e.g. "is", "is not").
4. Click the drop-down or text box that appears next to your operator drop-down to complete your condition.
5. (Optional) Click **+ Add Criteria** to add any further criteria.

Choose an action for your automation:

1. Click your chosen action in the **Action** section.
2. Set up the action using the available options.

Finally, activate your automation:

1. Click **Activate** to save and activate the automation. It now appears on your [Automations page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-managing-your-automations#viewing-all-of-your-automations) where you can edit, deactivate or delete according to your needs.

question: How can I restrict access to dynamic content on my website to specific member roles?
answer:
To restrict access to dynamic content on your website to specific member roles, follow these steps:

1. **Create members-only pages**: Create or make an existing static or dynamic page a members-only page. This feature allows you to restrict access to pages, making them available exclusively to your logged-in members. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-members-only-pages)

2. **Create member roles**: Member roles help you manage which site members can access which pages. For example, you might want to create some pages that are accessible to any signed-up member (i.e., students and teachers) and some pages that are restricted to specific members only (i.e., teachers). [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-creating-member-roles)

3. **Limit pages to specific member roles**: Use member roles to limit specific restricted pages of your site to a group of members (a role). Limit your site pages to specific members based on member roles by following the steps detailed [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-limiting-pages-on-your-site-to-specific-member-roles).

   **Note**: Dynamic pages can only be restricted to member roles via your editor, not via the site's dashboard.

4. **Change your collection permissions**: It is recommended to review your collection permissions and modify them to member roles only. When you create a new collection, you define its permissions, which control who can view, create, update, and delete content in a collection. You can change these permissions from the CMS (Content Management System). [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-your-collection-permissions)

question: Why am I receiving an error message saying 'That URL's Unavailable' when trying to edit my page's URL on Wix?
answer:
When you receive the error message 'That URL's Unavailable' while trying to edit your page's URL on Wix, it is most likely because you're trying to change to a URL slug that is either used by Wix apps or reserved for SEO. Some examples of URL slugs you should avoid for your pages are:

- apps
- \_api
- robots.txt
- sitemap.xml
- feed.xml
- sites
- events (when using the Wix Events app)

If you try to use these URL slugs, you'll see an error that the URL's unavailable. Try adding a different URL slug, then publish your page.

question: How can I filter my Booking List to show only confirmed bookings for a specific staff member?
answer:

1. [Go to Booking List](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Bookings%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/bookings/bookings-list) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I manually enter credit card details to accept a complete payment for an order in Wix?

question: Can I set a bundle price for photos in my Wix Photo Albums store?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to set a different price (a bundle price) for just some of the images in a Photo Album - for example, a special price for photos purchased in a bundle/bulk. When you set the price of your photos in your Photo Album store, all your photos are set at that price. This means that each individual photo in your store costs the same price.

question: How can I enable the scroll bar to always be displayed in the Editor on my Mac?
answer:
If you're unable to see the scroll bar in the Editor on your Mac, you can enable it to always be displayed by adjusting your Mac's settings. Follow these steps:

1. Click the Apple menu at the top-left of the screen.
2. Select **System Preferences**.
3. Click **General**.
4. Click **Always** under **Show scroll bars**.

**Note:** The setting names may be different depending on your computer model and system version.

question: How can I customize the printed receipts in Wix Retail POS?
answer:
To customize your printed receipts in Wix Retail POS, follow these steps:

1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
3. Tap **Settings**.
4. Tap **Receipt** on the left menu.
5. Tap **Customize Your Receipt**.
6. Add any of the following to your receipt:
   - **Business name and website address**: Enter your business's name under **Business Name** and add your site's URL under **Website**.
   - **Logo**: Tap **Add Images**, select your logo from the Media Manager, and tap **Choose**. Note that your logo appears in grayscale on the receipt.
   - **Employee name**: Click the **Employee name** toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, the receipt displays the name of the team member logged into the POS (e.g., Sold by Julie Kennedy). You can edit the "Sold by" text.
   - **Address**: Click the **Address** toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, enter your business address.
   - **Return policy**: Click the **Return Policy** toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, enter the policy.
   - **Custom text**: Click the **Custom Text** toggle to enable or disable it. If enabled, enter a message (e.g., Thank you for your purchase).

When you're finished customizing your receipt, tap **Save** at the top right.

You can view a preview of a sample receipt on the right of the screen or tap **Print Test Receipt** to print a receipt using your receipt printer.

question: How do I set up Tap to Pay on my Android phone using Wix Mobile POS?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have downloaded the Wix app and created and verified a Wix Payments account.

To set up Tap to Pay on your Android phone:

1. Enable Tap to Pay in the dashboard:
   1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
   2. Click **Accept** or click the toggle next to **Tap to Pay** to enable it.
2. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
3. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
4. Tap **Point of Sale** under **Getting Paid**.
5. Tap the **Connect** icon at the top right.
6. Tap **Activate Tap to Pay.**
7. Tap **Activate**.
8. Make sure NFCs are enabled in your phone.

**Tip:** Search for NFC in your settings and enable them. NFC is a protocol found in Android phones which makes it possible to tap your phone to pay and receive payment. Without this setting enabled, tap to pay won't work.

question: How can I set up an automation to automatically move a workflow card in Wix?
answer:
To set up an automation with "Move a workflow card" as the action in Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** in the top right corner.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Click the app you'd like to base your trigger on in the **Trigger** section.
6. Select your chosen trigger from the available options.
7. Click **Move a workflow card** in the **Action** section.
8. Click the **In This Workflow** drop-down to choose the workflow you want to automatically update.
9. Click the **To This Step** drop-down to choose the step you'd like to automatically move a card to.
10. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
11. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
    * **Immediately:** The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
    * **Set custom time:** The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
12. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
    * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered.
    * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
    * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
13. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
14. Click **Activate** to save your new automation.

**Important:** Cards cannot be moved back to previous steps using automations. Automations can typically only move cards forward in a workflow. The exception to this is cards in a "Completed" or "Archive" column - in this case, a new card will be generated for a contact when the automation is triggered.

question: How can I view and update my Wix domain contact information?
answer:
To view and update your domain contact information:

1. [Go to Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
3. Click **Edit contact info**.

   **Note:** If this option is missing, your domain was purchased elsewhere and you must contact your domain host to update the contact information.

4. Edit your contact information.
5. (Optional) Use different contact information for your Technical or Administrative contacts:
   
   1. Deselect the **Use registrant contact info** checkbox below the relevant contact type.
   2. Enter the person's contact details.
6. Click **Save**.

### Note
As a domain registrant owner, you are required to [confirm your domain contact info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/icann-confirming-your-domain-contact-information) within two weeks after registering the domain. If not confirmed within two weeks, the domain and any business email attached to it may go offline. In case that happens, to ensure you can still receive a confirmation email, we recommend using an email address that is not associated with your domain as your registrant contact email (e.g. gmail.com).

question: How can I ensure the DOM order matches the visual order on my Wix Editor site, especially for right-to-left languages?
answer: On Wix Editor sites, the automatic DOM order is enabled by default for left-to-right scripts (e.g., English, Spanish). This means any changes you make to the visual order of elements are automatically applied to the DOM order. However, if your site uses a right-to-left script such as Arabic or Hebrew, you need to manually re-arrange the DOM order in the Layers panel. This ensures that the DOM order matches the visual order of your page, providing a smoother experience for visitors.

question: How can I view the most clicked elements on a specific page in Wix Analytics?
answer:
To view the most clicked elements on a specific page in Wix Analytics, follow these steps:

1. Navigate to the **Top pages** section in the Behavior Overview.
2. Use the search bar to find the specific page you are interested in.
3. Click on the page to view stats just for that page.
4. On the right, you will see all the available metrics, and on the left, you will see the most clicked elements on the page.

This allows you to understand which elements are engaging visitors the most on that particular page.

question: How can I set up a webhook in Wix Automations to send data to a specific URL?
answer:
To connect automations with a webhook in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** in the top right corner.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch** or choose a suggested automation.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Select a trigger for your automation.
6. Choose **Send via webhook** as your automation's action.
   1. Enter the URL the webhook should send a notification to under **Target URL**. Every time your automation is triggered (e.g., a customer fills out a form on your site), the webhook sends data to the URL you've specified.
   2. Choose whether the webhook should send all available data to the URL or only certain data:
      * **All keys and values:** All data from the trigger is sent to the target URL. For example, if the trigger is Wix Forms, the webhook sends data from every form field.
         
         **Tip:** Click **View Structure** to see all the data that the webhook will send. When you're done, click **Got It**.
      * **Customize structure:** Only specific data is sent to the target URL. For example, if your trigger is Wix Forms, you might only want to send the Name and Email fields.
         
         1. Click **Customize structure** next to **Add your own keys and values**.
         2. Enter a key name in the **Key** field. This helps you distinguish what data is sent.
         3. Click **Insert Variable** next to **Value** to choose the data that should match the key.
         4. (Optional) Click **+ Add Key-Value** to add another row and match key names to data.
         
         **Note:** If you choose not to map a specific key to a value, the webhook will notify the URL without any additional information from the trigger.
         5. When you're done, click **Save**.
7. Click the **Timing** drop-down to select a timing for your automation.
8. Click **Activate** or **Save**.

question: How can I translate my Wix Bookings site into multiple languages?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Start by [adding and setting up Wix Multilingual](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-adding-and-setting-up-wix-multilingual).

### Step 1 | Manage translations in your site's dashboard
1. [Go to Translation Manager](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/multilingual?&title=Translation%20Manager&buttonText=Go+To+Translation+Manager) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Bookings** on the left.
3. Choose the relevant option:
   * **If you auto-translated your site:** Review each of the automated translations and edit if necessary.
   * **If you didn't use auto-translation:** Translate each of the content types on the left and manually translate the content phrases one by one.

### Step 2 | Translate booking pages in your editor: Wix Editor
1. Go to the main language version in [your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26):
   1. Click the **Switch Language** drop-down menu at the top left of the editor.
   2. Select the language you want to manage.
2. Go to a bookings page (e.g. the Service Page) and click to select it.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click the **Text** tab.
5. Update the relevant text as needed.

### Step 3 | Translate booking elements in your editor: Wix Editor
1. Go to the main language version in [your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26):
   1. Click the **Switch Language** drop-down menu at the top left of the editor.
   2. Select the language you want to manage.
2. Select the element you want to translate:
   * Featured Service
   * Service List
   * Book Button
   * Calendar
   * Next Availability
   * Weekly Timetable
   * Daily Agenda
   * Cart Icon
3. Translate any text options that were not automatically translated.

### Step 4 | Publish and test your site
Once you've finished translating your site, make sure to [make the language visible to visitors](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translating-text-buttons-and-links#step-5-make-the-translation-visible). Then publish your site as usual. We recommend [previewing the checkout process in each language](https://support.wix.com/en/article/previewing-the-checkout-process-1420066), before you launch your multilingual Bookings site.

question: Can I download an SVG logo file with a background color from Wix?
answer: Currently, all [SVG logo files](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-about-svg-logo-files) come with a transparent background by default. If you want to use a logo file with your chosen background color, you can use one of the PNG files that come in your downloaded ZIP file. Keep in mind that PNG files may lose quality if you resize them.

question: How can I create a restaurant floor plan using Wix Restaurants?
answer:
To create your restaurant floor plan using Wix Restaurants, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Table Reservations (New)](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/restaurants/table-reservations?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Table+Reservations) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Floor Plan View**.
3. Click **Edit layout**.
4. Choose what you want to do next:
   
   **Add and customize tables**
   - Click a Round or Rectangular table on the left.
   - Click the map to add the table.
   - (Optional) Drag the resize handles to change the table size.
   - Edit the Table Properties on the right:
     * **Table Name:** Edit the default table label.
     * **Min & Max Seats**: Specify the minimum and maximum number of people who can book this table.
     * Enable or disable the **Let guests reserve this table online** toggle.
   - Edit the table layout on the right:
     * **Width:** Enter a value to resize the table width.
     * **Height:** Enter a value to resize the table height.
     * **Rotate:** Enter a value to rotate the table.

   **Add and customize text**
   - Click **Text** on the left.
   - Click the map to place the text.
   - Under **Layout** on the right, adjust the text settings:
     * **Text:** Edit the text.
     * **Text size:** Enter a value to customize the text size.
     * **Text color:** Select a text color.
     * **Rotate:** Enter a value to rotate the text.

   **Add and customize rectangles or circles**
   - Click **Rectangle** or **Circle** on the left.
   - Click the map to place the shape and drag to resize it.
   - Under **Layout** on the right, adjust the text settings:
     * **Width:** Enter a value to resize the shape width.
     * **Height:** Enter a value to resize the shape height.
     * **Border size:** Enter a value in pixels.
     * **Rotate:** Enter a value to rotate the shape.
     * **Shape color:** Select a color and click the Checkmark icon.
     * **Border color:** Select a color and click the Checkmark icon.

   **Add and customize lines**
   - Click **Line** on the left.
   - Click the map and drag it to change the length of the line.
   - Under **Layout** on the right, customize the line:
     * **Length:** Enter a value to resize the line length.
     * **Width:** Enter a value to resize the line width.
     * **Rotate:** Enter a value to rotate the line.
     * **Color:** Select a color and click the Checkmark icon.

   **Add icons**
   - Click **Icons** on the left.
   - Click the map to add an icon.
   - Under **Layout** on the right, customize the icon:
     * **Size:** Enter a value to resize the icon.
     * **Rotate:** Enter a value to rotate the icon.
     * **Select icon:** Select the icon you want to display.
     * **Color:** Select a color and click the Checkmark icon.

   **Add an image**
   - Click **Add Image** on the left.
   - Select an image and click **Apply**.
   - Drag the image to position it.
   - Under **Layout** on the right, adjust the settings:
     * **Width:** Enter a value to resize the image width.
     * **Height:** Enter a value to resize the image height.
     * **Rotate:** Enter a value to rotate the image.

### Tips
- To delete an element, click to select it and press **Delete** on your keyboard.
- To move the entire floor plan, click the Pan icon at the top, then click and drag the map.
- To move an element on the map, click to select it and then drag it. To move more than one element at a time, select and drag them.

question: Can I book and accept payment for new class sessions using the Wix App at a mobile POS?

question: How can I ensure that my customers receive confirmation emails for their orders placed through Wix Restaurants?
answer:
Wix Restaurants automatically sends a confirmation email to your customer after an order is placed through your online ordering system. The confirmation email includes:

* Order number
* Order summary
* Delivery address
* A link which customers can click to view their order status

Currently, you can't customize these confirmation emails. [Click here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-request-customizing-automated-emails) to vote for this feature. Additionally, you cannot create your own as Wix Automations doesn't integrate with Wix Restaurants. question: Is the vacation mode feature supported in Wix Stores?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to set your store on vacation mode. In the meantime, you can use one of the following workarounds:

### Create a landing page and hide your store pages
1. Create a landing page with a message about your store closure. [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-a-landing-page-eg-coming-soon-page)
2. Hide your store pages from your site menu. 
   * Wix Editor: [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-hiding-and-unhiding-a-page-from-your-site-menu)
   * Editor X: [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-and-managing-your-pages#hiding-a-page)

### Add a Vacation app
You can use third-party apps such as the **Vacation Mode app** and the **Vacation: Take a Rest** app to put your site into vacation mode while you're away. To get started, [go to the Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market).

Disable your store's payment methods. [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/disconnecting-a-payment-provider) 

Customers who try to complete a purchase see a popup with the following message.

question: How can I customize my logo using the Wix Logo Maker on a mobile device?
answer:
Prerequisites: Complete the steps in 'Getting Started with Wix Logo Maker on Mobile' and 'Selecting a Logo'.

After choosing a logo design that you like, you can customize your logo's finer details. Personalize the color palette, text design, and background of your logo, and even add additional icons.

### Color Palette
1. Tap the Palette icon to change the logo's color palette.
2. Scroll through the available color palettes and tap the one you like best.
3. Tap **Done**.

### Manage Text
1. Tap the Text icon below your logo.
2. Tap the **Add** icon to add new text, or tap existing text to change it.
3. Customize the text by using the options available:
   * **Font:** Scroll through the available fonts and choose the one you like best.
   * **Text Align:** Choose to align the text left, centered, or right.
   * **Color:** Select the text's color and its opacity. Choose from the colors based on your color palette or add a new color.
   * **Size:** Drag the slider to adjust the font size.
   * **Outline:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the outline around your text.
   * **Line Color:** Change the color of the outline around your text.
   * **Flip:** Tap the relevant toggle to flip the text horizontally or vertically.
   * **Curve:** Drag the slider to adjust the curve of the text.
   * **Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the text's transparency.
   * **Position:** Drag the relevant slider to adjust the text's horizontal or vertical position.
   * **Spacing:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the spacing between letters.
   * **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the text.
   * **Shadow:** Tap the toggle to enable a shadow behind the text.
   * **Blur:** Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the text.
4. Tap **Done**.

### Manage Symbols
1. Tap the Symbols icon below your logo.
2. Tap the symbol you want to customize.
   * **Change:** Replace your current icon with another.
   * **Color:** Tap a color to edit it. Choose from the colors based on your color palette or add a new color.
   * **Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the shape's transparency.
   * **Size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the icon's size.
   * **Position:** Drag the relevant slider to adjust the text's horizontal or vertical position.
   * **Flip:** Tap the relevant toggle to flip the icon horizontally or vertically.
   * **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the icon.
   * **Shadow:** Tap the toggle to enable a shadow behind the icon.
   * **Blur:** Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the icon.
   * **Delete:** Tap the Delete icon to delete the icon.
3. Tap **Done**.

### Manage Shape
1. Tap the Shape icon below your logo.
2. Tap the shape you want to customize.
   * **Change:** Swap your current shape with a new shape from the options available.
   * **Fill Color:** Select the shape's color and its opacity. Choose from the colors based on your color palette or add a new color.
   * **Line Width:** Drag the slider to adjust the width of your shape's border.
   * **Line Color:** Select the shape's border color and its opacity. Choose from the colors based on your color palette or add a new color.
   * **Position:** Drag the relevant slider to adjust the shape's horizontal or vertical position.
   * **Size:** Drag the sliders to adjust the width and height of the shape.
   * **Rotation:** Drag the slider to rotate the shape.
   * **Shadow:** Tap the toggle to enable a shadow behind the shape.
   * **Blur:** Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the shape.
   * **Delete:** Tap the **Delete** icon to delete the shape.
3. Tap **Done**.

### Upload Image
1. Tap the Image icon below your logo.
2. Tap **Upload Image.**
3. Choose the file you want to upload.
4. Tap **Done**.
5. Customize your uploaded image by using the options available:
   * **Size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the image size.
   * **Position:** Drag the relevant slider to adjust the image's horizontal or vertical position.
   * **Flip:** Tap the relevant toggle to flip the image horizontally or vertically.
   * **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the image.
   * **Opacity:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the image's transparency.
   * **Shadow:** Tap the toggle to enable a shadow behind the image. Customize the color, position, and blurriness of the shadow.
   * **Blur:** Tap the toggle to enable blurring. Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the image.
   * **Delete:** Tap the delete icon to delete your image.

### Background Color
1. Tap the Background icon below your logo.
2. Select a background color based on your color palette, or tap the plus icon to add a new color.
3. Tap **Done**.

question: How can I customize the overlay and icons for the Wix Pro Gallery on my mobile site?
answer:
To customize the overlay and icons for the Wix Pro Gallery on your mobile site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Switch to mobile** icon at the top of the editor.
3. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Design** tab.
6. Click **Overlay & Icons**.
7. Choose between a **Full** or **Partial** overlay and customize using the options available:
   
   * **Full Overlay:** The overlay covers the entire gallery item.
     
     + **Gradient:** Click the toggle to enable a gradient overlay. 
       
       - **Color & Opacity 1 and 2:** Click the relevant color box to customize the gradient's colors. Then drag the slider to adjust the colors' opacity.
       - **Gradient Direction:** Drag the slider to adjust the gradient's overlay direction.
       - **Icon Color:** Click the color box to change the color of gallery icons that appear on hover.
     + **Color overlay:** Click the color box to choose a color. Then drag the slider to change the transparency of the color overlay.
     + **Icon color:** Click the color box and select a new color for your gallery icons.
   
   * **Partial Overlay:** The overlay covers only a portion of the gallery item.
     
     + **Set size in:** Manage your overlay's size in percentages or pixels.
     + **Size:** Drag the slider or enter a value to choose an overlay size.
     + **Overlay starts from:** Choose where your overlay is positioned.
     + **Padding:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of space between the gallery border and your overlay.
     + **Gradient:** Click the toggle to enable a gradient overlay. 
       
       - **Color & Opacity 1 and 2:** Click the relevant color box to customize the gradient's colors. Then drag the slider to adjust the colors' opacity.
       - **Gradient Direction:** Drag the slider to adjust the gradient's overlay direction.
       - **Icon Color:** Click the color box to change the color of gallery icons that appear on hover.
     + **Color overlay:** Click the color box to choose a color. Then drag the slider to change the transparency of the color overlay.
     + **Icon color:** Click the color box and select a new color for your gallery icons.

8. Choose an overlay effect from the options available:
   
   * **No effect**: The overlay does not apply any effect.
   * **Fade in**: The overlay gradually appears on hover.
   * **Expand**: The overlay expands on hover.
   * **Slide up**: The overlay slides up on hover.
   * **Slide right**: The overlay slides right on hover.

question: How can I create a Back to Top button on my Wix site?

1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/06/7ed12e24-bf08-4ab0-ba6d-62ef39ef5674.png) on the left side of the editor.

*Want a different button?* You can also use other elements such as vector art or icon buttons for your Back to Top button.

### Step 2 | Link your button to the top of the page

2. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/cdff0ec4-6b02-4f12-8539-cf6a845d4dac.png).

question: How can I add Alt text to images and gallery images in ADI?
answer:
### To add Alt text to your images
1. Hover over the section inside ADI that includes the image you want to add Alt text to.
2. Click **Edit**.
3. Hover over the image thumbnail and click **Edit \&** **Replace**.
4. In the **Title (Alt Text)** field, enter the title of your image. It should be a short description (just a few words) of the image. This title is used as the image's Alt text.

### To add Alt text to your gallery images
1. Hover over the section that includes the gallery you want to add Alt text to.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Manage Media**.
4. Click the desired image.
5. In the **Title** field, enter the title of your image. It should be a short description of the image. This title is used as the image's Alt text.

### Tip
Alt text is also important for accessibility purposes. Some of your site visitors might be using screen readers, which read out the alt text to describe the media on your site. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-checklist-for-improving-your-sites-accessibility)

### Note
Adding Alt text is only available when your **Media Layout** is set to either **Crop** or **Full Image**.

question: How can I provide feedback on a Wix site using the Get Feedback feature?
answer:
To add your feedback on a Wix site using the Get Feedback feature, follow these steps:

1. **Access the Get Feedback app in a desktop browser (not from a mobile device):**
   
   * **From the email:** Click View Site from the invite email titled: "*You're invited to give feedback on the [site name] website*"
   * **From the shareable link URL:** In your browser, go to the Get Feedback URL you received from the site owner, collaborator, or teammate.

2. **Browse through the site to review it.**
   
   **Note:** Click **Mobile View** at the top to review the mobile version of the site.

3. **Click "+ Add Comments" at the top-right.**

4. **Click the Comment icon** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2020/03/20/a616b5f1-dda5-401d-a976-2f852d2b8d58/9164affe-8e9b-4ed9-89e2-61f17f1f6c5a.png) **and drag it to the area you're commenting about.**

5. **Enter your name in the "My Name" field.**

6. **(If the "My Email" field appears) Enter your email address so you can receive notifications when the site owner or collaborator replies.**

7. **Enter your comment in the "Add your comment..." field.**

8. **Click "Post".**

9. **(Optional) Repeat these steps to add more comments.**

### Note
* You do not need to log into a Wix account to add comments.
* The Get Feedback Shareable Link URL is valid for 2 weeks only.
* The last saved version of a site displays in Get Feedback so you can provide feedback before changes are published.
* Protected pages (with passwords or set to members-only) are viewable in Get Feedback.
* [Site collaborators](https://support.wix.com/en/article/inviting-people-to-contribute-to-your-site) can only view comments from Get Feedback links they share. They won't see comments posted from Get Feedback links shared by site owners or other collaborators.

question: Why do fonts appear differently on my Wix mobile site compared to desktop, and how can I fix this issue?
answer: Different browsers and devices use a variety of rendering engines which may result in minor differences in the way your font appears. Fonts also render differently between iOS and Android, and the significance of the difference can vary from font to font. If you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, we recommend choosing another similar looking font for your site. Additionally, you can learn how to [resolve text alignment issues on your live mobile site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-alignment-issues-on-your-live-mobile-site).

2. Click **Pages** at the top of the editor.
3. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant page.
4. Click **SEO Basics**.
5. Enable the **Let search engines index this page** toggle.
6. Publish your site.

question: How can I update my Facebook ad campaign's products if they aren't syncing with the live ad?
answer:
If your Facebook ad campaign's products aren't updating, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Edit your campaign and remove 1-2 products
1. Go to [Facebook Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/paid-ads/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit Campaign.**
3. Navigate to the products section and remove one or two of your store products (you will add them back in later).
4. Click **Save**.

### Step 2 | Check that your campaign is not in review
If your campaign is currently in review, the products and caption won't update until the campaign is approved. Learn more about [campaigns in review](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-about-the-campaign-review-process-with-facebook).

### Step 3 | Try Facebook's Debugger tool
1. Go to [Facebook's Debugger tool](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/) and log in using your Facebook credentials.
2. Paste your site URL and click **Debug**.
3. Click **Scrape Again**.
4. Check your Facebook Ads dashboard in 30 minutes to see if the campaign is now live with the updated products (missing the 1-2 you removed in Step 1).

### Step 4 | Add back the products you removed and try the Debugger tool again
1. Return to the [Facebook Ads dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/paid-ads/) and click **Edit Campaign**.
2. Add back in the products you previously removed for testing.
3. Go back to [Facebook's Debugger tool](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/) and scrape the site again.
4. In 30 minutes, check your Facebook Ads dashboard to see if your campaign is now updated with all the products.

question: How can I create a new membership plan using the Wix app?
answer:
To create a Pricing Plan in the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Pricing Plans** under **Catalog**.
4. Tap **Create New Plan**.
5. Enter the plan's name and tagline.
6. List the plan benefits:

   **Tip:** Here you can explain to clients what they get when they buy the plan.
7. Choose your pricing options:

   * **Recurring Payments:** Customers pay each week, month, or year until the plan ends.
     
     1. Select **Recurring Payments**.
     2. Tap the **Payment Frequency** drop-down and select an option.
     3. Enter the price per payment.
   * **One-Time Payment:** Customers pay one amount for the duration of the plan.
     
     1. Select **One-time Payment**.
     2. Enter the plan price.
   * **Free Plan:** Customers do not pay. Select **Free Plan**.
8. Set the plan duration by tapping the **Length of Plan** drop-down and selecting when the plan expires.
9. (Recurring and one-time payments only) Tap the **Setup Fee** toggle to apply a setup fee to the first payment of your plan. Then enter the **Amount** and the **Setup fee name**.
10. Tap the **Free Trial** toggle to [create a plan that starts with a free trial period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-offering-your-clients-a-free-trial-period).

    **Note:** This option is available for plans with recurring payments.
11. [Connect your plan to Wix content and services](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-connecting-a-plan-to-content-services-in-the-wix-app) you create.
12. Tap the options below to choose your **Advanced Settings** for the plan:

    * **Single Purchase Only:** Tap to enable the toggle to [create a trial plan that can only be booked once per client](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-free-plan).
    * **Allow Plan Cancellation:** Tap to enable the toggle to [allow clients to cancel plans themselves](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-allowing-clients-to-cancel-plans) in the My Subscriptions page.
    * **Custom Start Date:** Tap to enable the toggle to allow clients to choose when the plan starts.
    * **Plan Policies:** Tap to enter policy information and tap **Save**.

      **Note:** The policy appears on the checkout page.
    * **Collect additional info at checkout:** Tap the relevant form and tap **Save**. Learn more about [collecting additional info from customers at checkout](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-collecting-additional-information-at-checkout).

      **Note:** You can only create and manage custom forms on desktop.
    * **Customize a Thank You Page**:

      1. Tap to customize the message and button text on your Thank You Page and then tap **Save**.
      2. Tap the relevant option to choose where to redirect your customers after checkout:

         + **Home Page:** Customers go straight to your home page after completing their purchase.
         + **Other page:** Enter the URL of the page.
      3. Tap **Save**.
13. Tap **Save** at the top right.

answer:
To change the scroll effect of the header on your Wix mobile site:

1. Click the header in the [mobile editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-getting-started-with-the-mobile-editor).
2. Click **Change Header Scroll**.
3. Select an option:
   
   * **Scrolls with site:** The header is always at the top of the site and scrolls with it.
   * **Freezes:** The header is always at the top of the mobile screen.
   * **Disappears:** The header disappears when you scroll down the page, but is at the top of the screen when you scroll upward.
   * **Fades out:** The header slowly disappears as you scroll down the page. It reappears as you scroll upward.

### Important note about the freeze scroll effect
If your header has too much content and is too big on mobile, the freeze scroll effect is disabled on the live mobile site. This is because when set to frozen, the header would cover the entire viewport of the mobile device and hide the rest of the site content as a result.

question: How can I add an address to a room in Wix Hotels for my rental properties in different locations?
answer:
To add an address to a room in Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
2. Click the **Hotels** tab on the left.
3. Click the **Rooms** tab.
4. Click the **Edit** icon for an existing room type or click **Create New** to add a new one.
5. Scroll down to the **Address** section.
6. Click the **Show map location** toggle to enable the address option.
7. Enter the city, state, and country of the property.
8. Enter the street address of the property.
9. Enter the zip code of the property.
10. Click **Save** at the bottom of the page.

**Important:** You can only add an address to a room after you've set up your hotel. If you're trying to add an address to your first room and you're unable to find the address section, add the room without the address and come back to add the address after setting up your hotel.

question: How can I add a new item to my site menu in ADI?
answer:
To add a menu item in ADI, follow these steps:

1. Click the header section inside ADI (at the top of your site).
2. Click **Edit** next to Menu.
3. Click **Add Menu Item** on the bottom of the panel.
4. Select where you want the link to connect to:
   * **None:** Creates an unlinked item on your header.
   * **Page:** Select a page within the site and where on the page it links to. 
     
     **Note:** You will not see an option to select a page section if you have a one-page site.
   * **Web Address:** Creates a link to an external website.
   * **Document:** Lets you link to an external document (E.g. .docx, .xls, .ppt, .pdf, etc.)
   * **Email:** Create a link to an email of your choice
   * **Phone:** Creates a link to a phone number you can dial to via an external app. 
     
     **Note:** People that visit your site on mobile can call you.
   * **PayPal Donations:** Connect a PayPal email address with currency and amount.
5. Click **Done**.
6. Type the title for your item. This title is displayed on your menu.

question: How can I create a new design library in the Studio Editor?

question: How can I manually add a table reservation for a walk-in guest using the Wix dashboard?

2. Click the **Add New** drop-down at the top right.
3. Choose the type of reservation you'd like to add:
   
   **Walk-in**
   
   1. Select **Walk-in**.

      * **Duration**: How long the table will be reserved.

question: How can I display additional product details on my Wix Stores Product Page using a CMS collection?
answer:
Prerequisites:

* Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.
* [Enable Wix app collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections) so you can use Wix Stores with the CMS.

To display additional product details on your Wix Stores Product Page using a CMS collection, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Create a collection that references your Wix app collection

1. Create a [Multiple items (Default) collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection) where you will keep the additional info you want to integrate into your Product page.
2. Click **+ Add Item** to add items for each product you want to save additional details about.
3. Click **+ Add Field** to add fields for each type of content you want to save (e.g. [Rich Content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-rich-content-and-adding-it-to-a-dynamic-page)).
4. Click the relevant cells to add your content to each item.
5. Add a Reference field type and connect it to the Stores Wix app collection:
   
   1. Click **Manage Fields** then click **+ Add Field**.
   2. Select **Reference** and click **Choose Field Type**.
   3. Enter the **Field name**.
   4. (Velo only) If necessary, update the **Field ID**, which is used in the site's code. You cannot update this ID later.
   5. Click the **Referenced Collection** drop-down and select **Products** under **Stores**.
   6. (Optional) Enter help text to include a tooltip in your collection next to the field name.
   7. Click **Save**
6. For each item, click the reference field and select the relevant product. You can select multiple products if you added a multi-reference field in the previous step.

## Step 2 | Set up datasets and connect elements to them: Wix Editor

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to your Product page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Store Pages** and select the **Product Page**.
3. Add a dataset that connects to your 'Details' CMS collection and filters for your reference or multi-reference field:
   
   **Note:** Skip this step if you do not need to show additional details from a 'Details' CMS collection.
4. Add a dataset that connects to your Stores Wix app collection:
   
   1. Click **Add a Dataset** at the bottom of the panel on the right.
   2. Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select the **Products** collection under **Stores**.
   3. Edit the **Dataset name** if needed and click **Create**.
5. Add a URL slug filter to your Stores/Products dataset:
   
   1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to your Stores/Products dataset and select **Dataset settings**.
   2. Click **+ Add Filter** under **Filter**.
   3. Click the **Field** drop-down and select **Slug (Text)**.
   4. Leave **is** selected as the **Condition**.
   5. Under **Value source**, select **URL Slug**.
   6. Click **Add Filter**.
6. Add the [supported elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-elements-and-the-collection-fields-they-can-connect-to) that you want to connect.
7. [Connect the elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset) to the relevant fields in the relevant dataset:
   
   * **Details dataset:** Connect to the collection fields in this dataset to use content from your 'Details' CMS collection.
   * **Stores/Products dataset:** Connect to the collection fields in this dataset to use content from your Stores Wix app collection.
   
   **Tip:** You can add a button or image, then [connect its click action](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images#wix-stores-actions) to the **Add to cart** dataset action to create your own 'Add to Cart' button. Similarly, connect to the **Open quick view** action to create a button that opens the ['Quick View' window](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-customizing-the-quick-view-in-the-product-gallery).
8. (Optional) Hide default details from your Product Page widget:
   
   1. Click the **Product Page** element and select **Settings**.
   2. Click the **Settings** tab.
   3. Uncheck the checkboxes next to each detail you want to hide from the Product page widget.
   4. Disable the toggle next to the relevant buttons or icons to hide them from the widget.
   5. If necessary, [customize your Product page widget further](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-customizing-your-product-page).
9. Use the **Preview** toolbar to test the connections for the relevant products.
10. Publish your site when you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How can I delete a site using the Wix app?
answer:
To delete a site using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to the Wix app on your mobile device.
2. Tap the **Site List** drop-down at the top.
3. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant site.
4. Tap **Move to Trash**, then tap **Move to Trash** to confirm.
5. (Optional) Tap the **Trash** folder to permanently remove a site.
   
   1. Tap the site you want to delete.
   2. Tap **Remove Site**, then tap **Remove** to confirm.

**Notes:**
- Only site owners can delete a site.
- When you permanently delete a site, all site and member data will be erased and you cannot restore it.

question: How can I ensure that my Wix Store is compliant with local tax regulations using Avalara?
answer: Make sure your business is always compliant with local tax regulations by setting up automatic tax calculation. Wix provides the convenience of automatic tax through Avalara, a third-party app. Avalara simplifies the process by automatically collecting taxes correctly in each location you add, including situations where different tax rates apply within smaller subdivisions, such as counties or cities. Avalara makes sure your tax is calculated based on the latest tax rules, so you don’t have to update tax rates yourself. When a tax rate changes, your website automatically adjusts to reflect the updated rate. Each tax location (a country or state/province) has a default tax rate, and Avalara is ready to manage tax correctly for all these items in all your locations.

question: Can I create multiple seating maps for a single ticketed event in Wix Events?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to create multiple seating maps for a single ticketed event, such as when using different facilities. You can only [create one seating map](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-a-seating-map) for a ticketed event, that includes different ticket types with unique seating arrangements (e.g. general admission, assigned seating, VIP areas).

question: Can I use Moip as a payment provider on Wix?

question: Can I transfer business calls to an agent once a call has been answered?

Currently, it is not possible to transfer business calls to an agent once a call has been answered. 

### Note
While you can't transfer calls once they have been answered, incoming business calls can be routed to your forwarding numbers. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-assigning-incoming-calls-to-your-agents)

question: What will happen to my current sites built on Editor X when Wix Studio is introduced?
answer: You can keep building on Editor X for now. We’ll gradually open up the option to [update sites to Wix Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-faqs-transitioning-from-editor-x) in January over several weeks. Once the update is available to everyone, we’ll close the option to create new sites on Editor X — for this reason, we highly recommend using Wix Studio for any new projects you get. Having said that, know that you’ll get plenty of notice and all the info before this happens. **Note:** If you've never used Editor X before, the option to create new sites is now closed.

question: How can I update outdated page information and thumbnails for my Wix site when sharing on Facebook?
answer:
To update your page info on Wix for sharing on Facebook, follow these steps:

1. Click **Menus & Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click the **Show More** icon next to the relevant page and follow the steps according to what you want to update:
   
   * **Page Title and Description:**
     1. Click **SEO (Google)**.
     2. Edit the text under the following sections:
        
        + **What's the page's title on search results on browser tabs?** This is the page title. It appears in the browser tab, but also when sharing your site on social media.
        + **What's the page about? Add a description.** This is the page description. It appears below your page title in search results, but also when sharing your site on social media.

Once you have updated the above, publish your site from inside the [Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-publishing-your-site). Facebook may take some time to process the new information.

question: How can I set up my beauty business to accept online payments using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To set up your beauty business to accept online payments using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. **Online Payments**: Let your clients book and pay in advance on your website with [Wix Payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wix-payments). Wix also supports a [variety of payment providers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/available-payment-providers-in-your-country#all-countries), based on your preferences and location.

2. **Afterpay**: Allow customers to pay in installments with [Afterpay](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-afterpay-as-a-payment-provider-3515230).

3. **Retail POS**: Make your phone a point of sale, so clients can accept payment for services that have already been booked. Learn more about [Wix Retail POS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-retail-pos-about-wix-pos-for-brick-and-mortar-stores).

4. **Mobile POS**: Use your phone as a point-of-sale (POS) with the [Wix Owner App](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-pos-booking-services-and-accepting-payments-with-the-wix-owner-app).

5. **CC on File**: Save clients' credit card details and charge for future bookings in a more convenient way. More details can be found [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-saving-and-charging-clients-credit-cards).

6. **Charge Manually with CC Details**: Accept payments by typing in the customers' credit card details. This works great for accepting bookings over the phone. Learn more [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-by-manual-card-entry).

7. **Pay Links**: Instantly request payments from contacts by sharing unique pay link URLs that allow them to make secure online payments. Share pay links via email, social media, SMS, and other channels. You can also create and send QR codes as pay links. More information is available [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pay-links-creating-and-managing-pay-links).

8. **Invoices**: Create and send professional invoices in seconds. Simply email or text your invoice so your clients can make payment. Learn more about sending invoices [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-sending-an-invoice).

By following these steps, you can streamline your payment processes and offer flexible options to your clients.

question: How can I customize the design of my horizontal menu container in Wix Editor?

question: How do I set up a Point of Sale with SumUp using the Wix Mobile POS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed the following before proceeding:
- Download the Wix app from the Apple App Store or Google Play.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

**Step 1 | Download the Wix app**
1. Go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android).
2. Type 'Wix' in the **Search** field.
3. Click **Get** or **Install** to download the app.

**Tip:** If you are accessing this article on your phone, you can click to download: 
- [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wix-owner-websites-apps/id1545924344)
- [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wix.admin&hl=en&gl=US)

**Step 2 | Set up SumUp as your payment provider**
- Go to [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard and [connect SumUp as your payment provider](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-sumup-as-a-payment-provider).

**Note:** You can set up SumUp without an upgrade, but to start collecting payments, you'll need a [Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) or [Studio plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-upgrading-sites) that supports payments.

**Step 3 | Order a SumUp card reader**
- To accept credit card payments, you need one of SumUp's credit card readers. SumUp card readers connect to your smartphone or tablet via Bluetooth. They can be used to swipe, tap or insert debit/credit cards.
- Contact SumUp to order one of their card readers. [Learn How](https://sumup.com/)

question: Why are my email marketing campaigns sent from a Wix email address instead of my own?
answer: Email marketing campaigns sent from a public email address such as @gmail, @yahoo, or @outlook have a low delivery rate. To make sure more of your contacts receive your emails, they're sent from an authenticated address owned by Wix. You may also see your campaigns as sent from a Wix email address if your domain is [connected to Wix via pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pointing-vs-name-servers-domain-connection-methods#using-the-pointing-connection-method). To send emails and receive replies from your own professional email address, you need to have a personalized mailbox that’s connected to your [custom domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-a-custom-email-domain-for-wix-email-marketing). It is also recommended to [authenticate your custom domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-authenticating-your-custom-email-domain) to prevent emails from getting marked as spam.

question: How can I create a custom animation in Editor X that changes an element's appearance on click or hover?
answer:
To create a custom animation in Editor X that changes an element's appearance on click or hover, follow these steps:

2. **Design the Animation:** Use the [custom animation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-click-and-hover-interactions-beta) feature to design how the element should look and behave. You can change the element's fill color, opacity, angle, size, and more.

3. **Set the Initial State:** Design the element's initial state, which is how it looks when it loads before any interaction. Adjust the element's initial opacity, angle, size, and position.

4. **Preview the Result:** Once you've set up the trigger and animation, preview the final result directly from your Editor to ensure it meets your expectations.

question: How can I create and send a pay link using the Wix app?

2. Tap **Add** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/be0b50df-801c-4d6d-b81c-dc49333eccac/2023/03/22/05179d75-4797-4116-b5be-9c1a9fab1a93/6a94d708-3bfc-4f55-b9cf-40f15397e771.png) at the bottom.

question: Can I switch the Facebook account connected to an ad campaign in Facebook Ads?
answer:
Currently in Facebook Ads you cannot change the Facebook account you connected initially when first setting up a campaign. In order to change the account you need to [contact Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact). Our team will review the issue and provide you with available options. It is possible for us to remove your connected account altogether, but this is not recommended.

question: How can I customize the sender details for my automated emails in Wix?
answer:
To set your sender details for automated emails in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Choose what you want to do:
   * **Create a new automation:**
     1. Click **+ New Automation**.
     2. Click **+ Start from Scratch** or click **Set Up** next to a suggested automation.
   * **Edit an existing automation:**
     1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant automation.
     2. Click **Edit**.
3. Click the title to give your automation a name.
4. Select a trigger for your automation.
5. Make sure **Send an email** is selected in the **Action** section.
6. Scroll down to the **Manage details** section and click **Edit**.
7. (Optional) Edit your sender details:
   * **From name:** Edit the name that appears in the recipient's inbox and click **Save**.
   * **Reply-to email:** Edit the email address people reach when they hit reply and click **Save**.
8. (Optional) Click **Edit** or **Switch Template** to create and personalize your email message.
9. Under **Set email type**, select a type for your email to determine how or when your recipients can mute or unsubscribe from your emails:
   * **Promotional:** Non-essential business information or marketing content. Recipients who have unsubscribed or muted the selected notification topic will not receive this email.
   * **Business transactional:** Essential information to your customers, directly related to their activity on your site. Recipients who have muted the selected email notification topic will not receive this email.
   * **Business critical:** Only meant for critical cases. Recipients cannot mute these emails and they will be sent regardless of any unsubscribe preferences.
10. Under **Set recipients**, select all who will receive this automated email when it's triggered:
    * **Include trigger contact:** Recipient who triggered this automation.
    * **Include additional recipients:** Additional recipients who didn't trigger this automation.
11. Click **Activate**.

**Important information about the reply-to address:**
* Automated emails sent from a public email service like Gmail or Yahoo tend to land in the spam or promotions category. It's better to use an authenticated address (e.g. you@yourbusiness.com).
* If you use a public domain address, Wix redirects your email through our own authenticated address. Don't worry, only your name and subject line appear in the inbox and readers' replies will go straight to your inbox.
* You may be asked to confirm your reply-to address. If so, you'll receive an email in your inbox with instructions.

question: How can I enable the language auto-switch feature for my Wix site to automatically show visitors the language version of my site that matches their browser's language?
answer:
To enable the language auto-switch feature for your Wix site, follow these steps:

### From the Multilingual Dashboard:
1. [Go to Multilingual](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fwix-multilingual%2Fmanage-languages%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Go+to+Multilingual) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Language auto-switch** toggle to change how your site redirects:
   - **Enabled:** The site is automatically displayed in the visitor's browser language.
   - **Disabled:** The site is displayed in your site's main language, and visitors must switch to their preferred language using your [language menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-customizing-the-wix-multilingual-language-menu-on-your-site).

### From the Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Switch languages** drop-down menu at the top left.
3. Click **Manage Languages**.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Language auto-switch** toggle to change how your site redirects:
   - **Enabled:** The site is automatically displayed in the visitor's browser language.
   - **Disabled:** The site is displayed in your site's main language, and visitors must switch to their preferred language using your language menu.

### From the Studio Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Switch languages** drop-down menu at the top left.
3. Click **Manage Languages**.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Language auto-switch** toggle to change how your site redirects:
   - **Enabled:** The site is automatically displayed in the visitor's browser language and visitors can still switch to their preferred language using your language menu.
   - **Disabled:** The site is displayed in your site's main language, and visitors can switch to their preferred language using your language menu.

**Note:** This feature is only available if you have at least one active secondary language in Wix Multilingual. Make sure your [language is visible](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-managing-languages-in-a-multilingual-site#showing-or-hiding-a-language-on-your-site) in the Multilingual dashboard.

question: How can I edit a guest's information for my Wix event?

question: How can I add and set up a SoundCloud player on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your Wix editor and a SoundCloud account to retrieve the URL or embed code.

### Step 1: Add the SoundCloud Player
#### Using Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Video & Music**.
4. Click **SoundCloud Player**.
5. Drag the player onto your page.

#### Using Studio Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **App Market** on the left side of the editor.
3. Search for the SoundCloud app in the search bar.
4. Click **Add to Site**.

#### Using Dashboard:
1. [Go to the Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market) in your site's dashboard.
2. Search for the SoundCloud app in the search bar.
3. Click **Add to Site**.

### Step 2: Add the SoundCloud URL or Embed Code
1. In your SoundCloud account, search for the music you want to add.
2. Click **Share**.
3. Click **Share** or **Embed**.
4. Copy the URL or code.
5. In your editor, click the SoundCloud player.
6. Click **Settings**.
7. Paste the URL or code.
8. Click **Confirm**.

### Step 3: Set Up Your Player
1. Click the SoundCloud player in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the relevant toggle to show or hide the play count and comments.

### Step 4: Design Your Player
1. Click the SoundCloud player in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Design**.
4. Choose what you want to customize:
   * **Choose a layout:** Select a layout that works best for you.
   * **Color:** Choose a color for the play button of your SoundCloud player.

question: How can I enable shipping to pickup points in my Wix store using Sendcloud?
answer:

question: Can I display product prices without the decimal point in Wix Stores?

question: How do I connect Skrill as a payment provider for credit/debit card transactions on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Skrill as a payment provider for credit/debit card transactions on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard. 

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options.**
3. Click **Connect** next to Skrill Credit Card.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Skrill account, or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Merchant ID, E-Mail, Secret Word, and MQI/API Password. **Tip:** Sign in to your Skrill account and go to **Settings > Developer Settings** to create your Secret Word and API Password. Your Merchant ID can be seen at the top right of your Skrill account.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create Skrill account**](https://signup.skrill.com/onboarding/#/?rdu=onboarding&rid=92359478&lang=EN) and register with Skrill to create your account.
   2. Once your Skrill account has been verified, you can retrieve your Merchant ID from the top right of your Skrill account.
   3. Still in Skrill, go to **Settings > Developer Settings** to create your Secret Word and API Password.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Skrill account to avoid transaction declines. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: Can I require customers to order certain menu items in advance on Wix Restaurants?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to require advanced ordering for certain menu items. For example, if you need two days to create a fruit platter, customers must order the fruit platter at least two days in advance. It is possible for a customer to [place an order for a future date](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-faq-can-customers-place-orders-for-a-future-date), however it is not possible to make this mandatory.

### Tip
In the meantime, we recommend placing notice on your site stating that certain items must be ordered in advance.

question: How can I set up a payment method for pricing plans on my Wix site?
answer:
To set up a payment method for pricing plans on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Choose what type of payments you want to accept:
   - **Offer clients plans with one-time payments (no recurring payments):** In the **Accept Payments** tab, you can choose any online payment methods available in your region. Note that you cannot use the manual method to accept payment for pricing plans.
   - **Offer clients plans with recurring payments:** In order to accept recurring payments, you must [connect to one of these payment providers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-recurring-payments).

Remember, the manual (offline) payment method is not available with Pricing Plans, and if you choose to switch payment providers, you must first cancel all active recurring plans, switch providers, and then ask your clients to repurchase the same plan. Additionally, to accept online payments, you need to [upgrade your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-upgrading-your-site-to-sell-plans-online).

question: Can I embed TikTok videos in the Wix Single Video Player?

question: How can I claim my free apps after purchasing an eligible premium plan?

question: How can I assign a staff member to an appointment in Wix Bookings?

question: Is there an onboarding progress bar available in the Wix Monetize with AdSense app?

question: What features and apps can be translated using Wix Multilingual?

Wix Multilingual allows you to translate various features and apps on your site. Here are the translatable features and apps:

- [Wix FAQ app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translating-your-faq)
- [Online Programs](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-online-programs-translating-your-online-programs)
- [Cookie Banner](https://support.wix.com/en/article/translating-your-cookie-banner-using-wix-multilingual)

- **Accepting Payments:** Currently, you can only translate payment instructions for Manual Payments.
- [Wix CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translating-cms-collection-content)
- [Automatic Discounts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-translating-your-store#faqs)

question: What are the service fees for processing a transaction using American Express with Wix Payments in the United States?
answer: For transactions processed using an American Express Credit Card (including use with Apple Pay & Google Pay) in the United States, Wix Payments charges a fee of **3.7% of the transaction amount + 0.30 USD**.

question: Can I customize the automated emails sent to clients for services that require approval in Wix Bookings?
answer:
Currently, none of the automated emails sent to clients for services that [require your approval](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-requiring-approval-for-appointment-bookings) can be customized. These emails are sent to notify clients when:

* Their request was received
* Their request was approved
* Their request was denied
* The service is being rescheduled

### Tip
You can add a personal note to emails notifying that you declined the request or rescheduled the session.

question: Can I use different document files for each language on my Wix site using the CMS?
answer: Currently, with the CMS (Content Management System) and Wix Multilingual, it is not possible to use different document files for each of your site's languages. This refers to the Document and Multi-Document field types in CMS collections. Learn more about [translating CMS collection content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translating-cms-collection-content).
