question: Why is Avast flagging my free Wix site as a phishing site, and how can I resolve this issue?
answer:
Avast is known to flag free Wix sites for phishing. To resolve this issue, you can whitelist your website in Avast by following these steps:

1. Open Avast on your computer and go to the Avast dashboard.
2. Click **Menu**, and click the **Settings** tab. Click the **Exceptions** tab under the **General** tab.
3. Under this tab, click **ADD EXCEPTION** and a new window will appear. Type the URL that you want to add to your whitelist.
4. Click **ADD EXCEPTION** to save the URL.

The website and/or web form you want to access should now be available. Additionally, we recommend reporting the false positive to Avast at [https://www.avast.com/report-false-positive#pc](https://www.avast.com/report-false-positive#pc).

question: Why am I receiving a 'This site was deleted' message when trying to edit my site?
answer: If you are receiving a 'This site was deleted' message when attempting to edit your site, it indicates that the site you are trying to access has been deleted. This can happen if the site was removed intentionally or due to a policy violation. To resolve this issue, you will need to verify the status of the site and check if it can be restored or if a new site needs to be created.

question: Can I create a real estate listings site using the CMS?
answer: Yes, it is now possible to create a real estate listings site using the [CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-content-management-system-an-overview). If you are creating a new site, you can choose a real estate template from our [templates page](https://www.wix.com/website/templates). Alternatively, you can [add the Property Listings CMS preset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-collection-presets) to your existing site, then replace the demo properties with your own.

question: What happened to the Wix Music distribution service and what are the alternatives for music distribution?
answer:
Wix Music's distribution service ended on January 1st, 2019. To continue distributing your music, you can check out [Soundrop](https://soundrop.com/). Soundrop is free and has tons of cool distribution features across top platforms.

### Important
* You will still receive outstanding payments for any music you sold using Wix distribution. Most stores and services release revenues within 3-4 months of a sale.
* If you have any issues with your previously distributed music, [contact Wix Support.](https://www.wix.com/contact/en)

Some element tabs (such as text and buttons) have themed elements. These elements have been handpicked for you, as they match your site's color and text theme.

question: How can I display a one-time class session on my Wix site so that it appears on the Service Page?
answer:
To display a one-time class session on the Service Page, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Business%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I view and manage my outgoing notifications on Wix?
answer:
To view your outgoing notifications:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Outgoing notifications**.

To manage outgoing notifications:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Outgoing notifications**.
3. Hover over the relevant notification and click **View Summary**.
4. Choose what to do next:
   - **Edit a notification**: Click **More Actions**, then **Edit**. Make necessary changes and click **Save**.
   - **Duplicate a notification**: Click **More Actions**, then **Duplicate**. Edit details and click **Activate**.
   - **Rename a notification**: Click **More Actions**, then **Rename**. Edit the name and click **Save**.
   - **View email automation stats**: Click **More Actions**, then **View email stats**. Scroll down in the pop-up to see statistics.
   - **Deactivate a notification**: Disable the **Active** toggle. You can reactivate it by clicking the toggle again.
   - **Delete a notification**: Click **More Actions**, then **Delete**. Confirm by clicking **Delete** in the pop-up.

**Note:** Notifications marked as "Installed for you" can be deactivated but not deleted.

question: What are the steps to set up my Wix site to sell hemp and hemp-derived CBD products?

question: How can I fix a 404 error in Google Search Console for a URL that I have changed or deleted?

question: How can I ensure that each item in my CMS collection has a unique dynamic item page URL?
answer: To ensure that each item in your CMS collection has a unique dynamic item page URL, you need to add unique content to the Primary field for each item. The Primary field is used in the [dynamic item page URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-unique-dynamic-page-urls). Without content in the Primary field, a dynamic item page URL cannot be created for the item. By default, each collection includes a Primary field named "Title", but you can change the name of this field or choose another to be your Primary field. Make sure each item has a unique value in the primary field.

question: Can I add a condition to my automation that changes the email flow based on customer interactions, like opening an email or clicking a link?

For example, if you have an automation that sends a recurring email, you can't add a condition that stops sending this email or starts sending a different email if a customer interacts with the email (e.g. opens it, or clicks links within it to access your site or purchase a product).

question: How can I create a new service in Dayful by Wix?
answer:
To create your first service in Dayful by Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to the Services tab in your Dayful dashboard.
2. Select a template or click **\+ Start from Scratch** under the relevant service type:
   * **Appointment:** A 1-on-1 session that clients book depending on availability.
   * **Class:** A group session that clients book to join at any time.
   * **Course:** A multi-session service that starts and ends on specific dates.
3. Enter the **Service Name**.
4. (Optional) Add more information about the service:
   * Click **Add Image** to showcase the service.
   * Enter a **Tagline** to provide more information about the service.
   * Enter a **Description** to provide more details about the service so clients know what to expect.
5. Choose the relevant place for your service under **Location**:
   * **Business address:** Choose this option for services where clients come to you.
   * **Client's place:** Choose this option for services where you meet clients at their home.
   * **Custom location:** Choose this option for services with varying locations.
6. Click **Price type** the drop-down and choose from the following options:
   * **Fixed price:** Set a standard price for the service.
   * **Varied Prices:**
     1. Set a default amount.
     2. Click **Manage Price Options**.
     3. **Price options label:** Enter the pricing criteria, for example "Participant age" or "Service type"
     4. Enter the different pricing options in the fields provided.
     5. (Optional) Click **\+ Add New Price Option** to add more options.
     6. Click **Save**.
   * **No fee:** You don't display a price on your site. This is useful for services where you negotiate with the client based on their needs.
   * **Custom Price:** Enter a description of how you charge for services with varying prices, in the Price Description field. For example, "Starting from $50." Clients cannot pay online when they book custom price services.
7. Choose when clients pay for the service under **Payment Preferences** from the following options:
   * **Entire amount online:** Choose this option if you have a [Dayful premium plan](https://manage.wix.com/premium-purchase-plan/dynamo?siteGuid=bbf72f63-0d36-414f-af68-cf0dc62b11e2&referralAdditionalInfo=bizMgrHeader) and want clients to pay online.
   * **Entire amount in person:** Choose this option if you have a free Dayful plan.
   * **Entire amount either online or in person:** Choose this option if you have a Dayful premium plan and want to offer your clients flexible payment options.
   * **Online deposit and the rest in person:** Choose this option if you have a Dayful premium plan and want to reduce no-shows for your services.
8. Click **Save**.

question: How can I enable or disable visual indicators on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?

question: How can I set a submission limit for my Wix form to stop accepting entries after a certain number or date?
answer:
To limit your form submissions on Wix, follow these steps:

1. **Click the form** in your editor you want to limit form submissions for.
2. Click **Form Settings** on your form.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click **Form Submission Limit**.
5. Choose what you want to do:
   
   ### Limit number of submissions
   - Enter the number of total submissions you want to receive.
   - Review or edit the message that replaces the form once the limit has been reached.
   
   ### Limit form submissions by specific date & time
   - Click on the calendar icon to select a date.
   - Click the **Select a time format** drop-down to select a 24H or 12H time format.
   - Write the last hour your visitors can submit the form by. 
   - Review or edit the message that replaces the form once the limit has been reached.

**Note:** If your limit was 100, and you changed it to 150, you will now be able to receive an additional 150 form submissions from the moment you click **Publish**.

This feature is only available for [old Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-the-difference-between-the-new-and-old-wix-forms). Make sure your form is published on your site to access these options.

question: What should I do if I encounter an error message when trying to publish my site using the ADI Builder?
answer:
If you encounter an error message when trying to publish your site using the ADI Builder, follow these steps to resolve the issue:

1. **Try a different browser:** Open the ADI Builder using a different [supported browser](https://support.wix.com/en/article/supported-browsers) and try publishing your site. If this resolves the issue, consider reinstalling your problematic browser.

2. **Try incognito mode:** Open the ADI Builder in [incognito mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/opening-your-browser-in-incognitoprivate-browsing-mode) and try publishing your site. If this works, you may be experiencing a local issue.

3. **Disable antivirus software:** Temporarily disable your antivirus software, as it may interfere with loading certain websites. Reload the ADI Builder and try to publish your site.

4. **Try a different network connection:** Connect to another network and open the ADI Builder to publish your site. Note that some public institutions may restrict access to certain URLs, including Wix servers. If a different network resolves the issue, contact your IT department to whitelist Wix.

5. **Check your browser's zoom settings:** Ensure your browser is set to 100% zoom and try publishing your site. Adjust the zoom by:
   - On Windows, press and hold the "**Ctrl**" key, then press the "**-**" (zoom out) or "**+**" (zoom in) key.
   - On a Mac, press and hold the "**Command**" key, then press the "**-**" (zoom out) or "**+**" (zoom in) key.

If these steps do not resolve your publishing issue, follow the instructions in the [Wix Technical Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-technical-assistant), which includes clearing your cache and disabling add-ons/extensions. If the issue persists, [contact Wix Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact) and mention the specific error message and troubleshooting steps you've already followed.

question: Can I track who liked, shared, or downloaded items from my Wix Pro Gallery?

question: How can I customize the design of breadcrumbs on my Wix mobile site?
answer:
To customize your breadcrumb trail on your Wix mobile site, follow these steps:

1. Click the breadcrumbs element in the mobile Editor.
2. Click the Design icon ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/j-rXK3SQAEZoPrh7cdaR14ihsCQqEsLllKBidFTcrvvztKxDV-KXxP_BjTpNXNFmd-j-f7zbM_TsxRf3_6HB0Mfsxvow9tuHcYoCJbE5Bn5rvLLWaC4EFHvpkQw9kmMhLaUiL-V3).
3. Select what part of the trail you want to design from the dropdown menu:

### Background
- Click **Background** in the dropdown menu, and use the options to adjust the design:
  * **Background Fills:** Choose a color for your trail background, and set its opacity.
  * **Borders:** Add a border to your trail background, and change the color, width, and spacing.
  * **Corners:** Make the corners of the trail background square, or more circular.
  * **Shadow:** Add and adjust a shadow on your trail to give it a cool 3D effect.

### Separators
1. Click **Separators** from the dropdown menu.
2. Click the **Show text** toggle to enable separators between trail items.
3. Choose how you want to customize the separator:
   * **Themes:** Apply one of your saved text themes to the separator.
   * **Fonts:** Choose a font from the dropdown menu for the separator.
   * **Font size:** Set how big or small you want the item separator to be.
   * **Formatting:** Add different formatting options to your separator, such as bold, underline, and strikethrough.
   * **Color and Alignment:** Choose the colors for your separator, and set the text direction and alignment.
   * **Spacing:** Make the spacing between the characters and lines bigger or smaller.

### Items
- Click **Items** in the dropdown menu, and use the options to make them look the way you want:
  * **Items state:** Select which mode you would like to adjust the items for:
    + **Regular:** How the items look before a visitor interacts with them.
    + **Hover:** How the items look when a visitor hovers their cursor over them.
    + **Current page:** How the item is displayed when it is the page the visitor is currently on.
  * **Background Fills:** Choose a color for your items, and set their opacity.
  * **Text:** Adjust the text for your trail items. You can choose and edit options such as the font, color, and alignment to suit your site's look and theme.
  * **Borders:** Add and adjust a border on your items. You can change the color, width, and spacing to make them stand out on your page.
  * **Corners:** Make the corners of the trail items square, or more circular.
  * **Shadow:** Add and adjust a shadow on your items to give them a cool 3D effect.
  * **Layout:** Adjust the padding around your items to make the space around them smaller or bigger.

question: How can I track Quick Action Bar events on my mobile site using Google Analytics?
answer:
To track Quick Action Bar events on your mobile site using Google Analytics, follow these steps:

1. **Connect Google Analytics to your site**: Start by connecting Google Analytics to your site. You can find instructions on how to do this [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/tracking-events-on-your-wix-site-with-a-google-analytics-property).

2. **Sign in to your Google Analytics account**: Go to [Google Analytics](http://www.google.com/analytics/) and sign in.

3. **View the events**:
   - Click **Reports** in the menu on the left.
   - Select **Engagements**.
   - Select **Events**.

By default, Wix sends information to Google Analytics about the following Quick Action bar events:

- **Leads**: Whenever a visitor on your mobile site tries to contact you using the Quick Action bar, by clicking the phone, email, WhatsApp, or LINE buttons.
- **Engagement**: When a visitor clicks any other item on your mobile site's Quick Action bar.

### Important
It can take up to 24 hours for your events to appear in Google Analytics.

### Tip
Use the Google Analytics Real-Time report to test your events and make sure they're logged. [Learn More](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/1638635?hl=en)

question: How can I change the URL of a page in ADI, and what should I be aware of when doing so?
answer:
To change your page URL in ADI, follow these steps:

1. Click the **Page Menu**.
2. Click the **Settings** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/1ddd9bce-2a39-4184-904e-b1e37f4e875e/2017/11/27/c0c542f9-c526-4ab4-bb95-91cc51a2fbf6.jpg).
3. Click **Page SEO**.
4. Under **Page URL** delete the existing name and enter a new one.

**Important information about changing your page URL:**

If you change your page URL, the new URL is treated as a new page and your old page will no longer work. This means that any existing links to the old page URL that you have previously shared on social media will stop working and your existing page SEO rankings will be lost. This is because search engines will always treat a different URL as a new page.

To keep your links working and move the SEO to the new page, you should [set up a 301 redirect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site) from the old URL to the new URL.

**Important:** To set up 301 redirects you need to [upgrade](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-your-site-to-premium-3066683) your site to a Premium Plan and [connect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-elsewhere) a domain to your site.

question: How can I use PayPal to pay for Wix services?
answer: You can choose to pay for all your Wix services using [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/) (e.g. plans, domains, business emails, etc). Use PayPal by selecting the PayPal option at the checkout. You will then be redirected to the PayPal website to finish your purchase. When completed, you will be brought back to your Wix account. You need to have an account with PayPal in order to use their service. If you don't have an account yet, the option to create one appears right after selecting the PayPal option. For a detailed guide, see our step-by-step guide for [using PayPal to purchase an upgrade plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-paypal-to-purchase-a-premium-plan).

question: Can I block specific IP addresses from accessing my site?
answer:

question: Can I add a form directly to a Wix blog post?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to add a Form to a blog post, to help you generate new subscriber information without your site visitors having to leave your blog.

### Workaround

question: How can I remove a domain purchased from Wix in order to close my account?
answer:
You can remove a Wix domain from your account in two ways:

### Option 1. Transfer your domain to another domain host
1. Go to the [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page in your account.
2. Click the **Show More** icon next to the relevant domain.
3. Select **Transfer Away from Wix**.
4. Click **Transfer Domain**.
5. Click **I Still Want to Transfer**.

**Note:** As soon as you click **I Still Want to Transfer**, we’ll send a transfer authorization code (EPP code) to your domain's [registrant contact email address](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-and-updating-your-wix-domain-contact-information). Once you get the code, follow the instructions from your new domain provider to transfer your domain. Learn more about [about transferring your domain away from Wix.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/transferring-your-wix-domain-away-from-wix-2477749)

### Option 2. Turn off auto-renewal and wait for domain to expire
1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Show More** icon next to the relevant domain.
3. Click **Cancel Domain**.
4. Select **Cancel auto renew** and click **Submit**.

Learn more about [about what happens if you cancel a domain.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/canceling-a-wix-domain)

question: What should I do if my PayPal payment is still pending after 24 hours on my Wix site?
answer:
If your PayPal payment is still pending after 24 hours, you can follow these troubleshooting steps:

1. **Check the PayPal pending reason in your Payments page:**
   - [Go to Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Your%20Transactions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpayments-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
   - Click on the PayPal payment to view more details.

2. **Check that you have a PayPal Business account:**
   - [Log in to your PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/signin) dashboard to confirm if you have a Business account.
   - If you do not have a PayPal Business account, you can change your account type to accept payments through Wix.

3. **Make sure Advanced Features are enabled:**
   - [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
   - Click **Enable Advanced Options** under PayPal.
   - Click **Grant Permission.**
   - **Note:** If you don't see the option to enable Advanced Features, contact [Wix Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact).

4. **Confirm your email address / account with PayPal:**
   - Go to PayPal to [confirm your email address](https://www.paypal.com/us/cshelp/article/how-do-i-confirm-my-email-address-help138).
   - **Tip:** You can get a clue of which email address you've used in the [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) page.

5. **Make sure the purchase amount meets the minimum payment threshold:**
   - For PayPal in the US, the threshold is $1.
   - For PayPal in the UK, the threshold is £1.

If after trying these steps, your payments are still showing as Pending, [contact us](https://www.wix.com/contact) and we'll be happy to help.

question: How can I customize the design of my Event Details page using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the design of your Event Details page using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the Event Details & Registration page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Event Pages**.
   3. Click **Event Details & Registration**.
3. Click the Event Details element on your page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Design** tab.
6. Choose what you want to design:
   
   #### Text
   Click **Text** to customize the fonts and colors of any of these options:
   * **Header Date & Location:** Customize the date and location text that appears above the event name.
   * **Event Name:** Customize the event name.
   * **Description:** Customize the description text (short teaser).
   * **Title:** Customize the titles in the body of the page.
   * **Text:** Customize the general text in the body of the page.
   * **Ticket Name:** Customize the ticket text (if you're selling tickets).
   * **Additional Info:** Customize additional text, such as additional ticket info, fees, or ticket sales period dates.

   #### Schedule text
   If you added an [event schedule](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-an-event-schedule), click **Schedule text** to customize the fonts and colors of any of the options.

   #### Ticket picker
   Click **Ticket picker** to customize the place where guests view and select their desired tickets.
   * **Text:** Set the font and color of your ticket info (e.g. ticket name and price).
   * **Card:** Set the background, border and opacity that surrounds the ticket information (e.g name, price).
   * **Shadow:** Customize the shadow design settings for your ticket picker.
     
     + **Card shadow:** Enable the toggle to display a shadow behind the ticket picker.
     + **Angle:** Set the angle for the shadow to be displayed.
     + **Distance:** Set the distance for your shadow.
     + **Blur:** Set the blur of your shadow displayed behind the ticket picker.
     + **Opacity & Color:** Choose a color and set the opacity for the shadow of your ticket picker.

   #### Button & links
   Click **Button & links** to customize the fonts and colors of any of these options:
   * **Choose a Style:** Select a preset style for the button.
   * **Font Style:** Click the drop-down menu to select the font style.
   * **Corner Radius:** Choose a corner radius (the higher the radius, the rounder the corners).
   * **First Button:** Customize the RSVP button which appears in the header:
     
     + **Text Color:** Select the color of the button text.
     + **Background/Border Opacity & Color:** Choose a color and set the opacity for the button background.
   * **Second Button:** Customize the second RSVP button (if enabled on the Display tab) which appears under the About The Event section.
     
     + **Text Color:** Select the color of the button text.
     + **Background/Border Opacity & Color:** Choose a color and set the opacity for the button background.
   * **Links:** Select a color for the available links displayed on your event (e.g. "See all" under Guests).

   #### Background
   Click **Background** to customize the header and page background colors:
   * **Header Background:** Choose a color and set the opacity.
   * **Page Background:** Choose a color and set the opacity.
   * **Ticket Divider:** Drag the slider to change the divider line thickness.

question: How can I change the text size of my Wix blog posts specifically for mobile devices?

question: What steps should I follow to change my domain after purchasing a Premium or Studio site plan on Wix?
answer: Once you've upgraded to a [Premium](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) or [Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-upgrading-sites) site plan, you are **eligible** to connect your own domain and remove "Wix" from the URL. However, your domain is **not** automatically changed once you upgrade to a site plan. You must connect your own domain for the domain name to change. If you haven't yet purchased your own domain, you can [purchase one directly from Wix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/purchasing-a-domain-from-wix-3133977). Additionally, with selected yearly site plans, you receive a [voucher to get a free domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-your-free-domain-voucher) for a year.

question: How can I enable desktop notifications for Wix Inbox?

question: Can I switch between multiple accounts in my Instagram Feed app?

question: How can I send an invoice to a client for a service they booked using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To send your clients an invoice using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant session in your calendar.
3. Click **Manage**.
4. Click **Collect Payment** next to the relevant client.
5. Click **Charge with invoice**. 

   **Note:** If your client does not have an email on file, you need to add one to send an invoice.

6. Click **Create Invoice**.
7. Review the invoice details to make sure they're correct.
8. Choose what you want to do next:
   
   * **Print:** Print out the invoice if your client requires a physical copy.
   * **Share Link:** Create a shareable link that you can send via email, social media or messenger app. 
     
     1. Click to create a link to the invoice.
     2. Click **Copy Link**.
     3. Click **Done**. 
     
     **Note:** when you create the link to the invoice, it automatically marks the invoice as **Sent**.
   * **Send via Email:** Send the client their invoice via email. 
     
     1. Click to edit the **subject line**.
     2. Click to edit the **message** you send in the email.
     3. Click **Send**.

question: Can I set a general ticket limit for how many tickets can be sold per event in Wix Events?
answer: Currently, you cannot set a general ticket limit of how many tickets you can sell per event. However, you can limit the number of guests that can purchase a particular type of ticket (i.e. you can limit sales of VIP tickets to 20).

question: How can I refund an order in Wix that was paid and fulfilled?
answer:
To refund an order in Wix that was paid and fulfilled, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant order.
3. Click **More Actions** at the top right.
4. Select **Refund**.
5. Select the checkboxes next to items you want to refund. 

   **Tip:** If there are more than 1 of the same item, use the arrows to select how many to refund.

6. (Optional) To provide a partial refund, enter the total amount you want to refund for the order on the right.
7. (Optional) Deselect the **Update inventory** checkbox next to a store product if you don't plan to restock it. 

   **Tip:** This is relevant if you track inventory amounts.

8. (Optional) Select the **Send a confirmation email to customer** checkbox and enter a personal note to your customer. 

   **Note:** Customers may also receive a notification from the payment provider.

9. Click **Refund**.
10. Click **Issue Refund**. 

    **Note:** This cannot be undone.

question: Can I toggle on or off the date of the last update to a blog post on mobile in Wix Blog?

question: How can I add a cover image to a blog post using the Wix app?
answer:
To add a cover image to a blog post using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom right.
3. Tap **Blog**.
4. Tap **Posts**.
5. Tap the post you want to edit.
6. Tap **More actions** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2019/11/03/d37f8e4f-129d-4645-b7b9-ba14c1aef096/60c86196-af6f-4436-90b3-d053a39a14b3.png) next to the relevant post.
7. Tap **Post Settings**.
8. Tap the **Select cover image** toggle.
9. Select an option:
   
   * **Upload an image:**
     
     + Tap **Upload Cover Image**.
     + Select an image or take a picture.
     + Tap **Upload.**
     + Tap **Next**.
     + Choose an option:
       
       - **Publish Post**
       - **Save as Draft**
   * **Replace the existing image:**
     
     + Tap the image.
     + Tap **Replace Image**.
     + Select an image or take a picture.
     + Tap **Upload.**
     + Tap **Next**.
     + Tap **Save**.
     + Choose an option:
       
       - **Publish Post**
       - **Save as Draft**.

### Note
You can go back to the settings and tap the **Display Cover Image** toggle:
* **Enabled:** The image you added is displayed in the post feed, custom feed, recent posts feed, and when sharing the post on social media.
* **Disabled:** The image you added is displayed only when sharing the post on social media.

question: How can I resize and crop an image using the Wix Image Resizer?
answer:
To resize and crop an image using the Wix Image Resizer, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Wix Image Resizer](https://www.wix.com/tools/image-resizer).
2. Click **Select Images**.
3. Select the image you wish to upload from your computer.
4. Resize your image using the **Resizing Options**: 
   * **Pixels:** Enter the width and height you want your image to be.
   * **Percentage:** Use the slider to resize the image to a percent of its original size.
   * **Image Format:** Select a format from the drop-down to download your image in.
   * **Crop & Rotate:** Use the cropping tools to choose a ratio, rotate or flip your image. You can move the cropped area to select the area of your choice.
5. Click **Resize Image**.
6. Click **Download Image** to download your newly resized image.

question: How can I add a new language to my Wix Hotels app?
answer:
To add a language in Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
2. Click the **Hotels** tab on the left.
3. Click the **Languages** tab.
4. Click **Create New**.
5. Click the **Translate to** drop-down menu and select a language.
6. Do one of the following:
   
   * **Auto Translate:**
     
     1. Click **Auto Translate** to instantly translate your text with Google Translate.
     2. (Optional) Manually edit the text. Click **See Current Text** to view original text for each field.
   * **Translate the texts yourself:** Enter the translated text in the relevant fields. Click **See Current Text** to view original text for each field.
7. Click **Save**.

After you've added a language, you can enable or disable it at any time by clicking the toggle next to the relevant language on the **Languages** tab.

### Tips
* You can only use Auto Translate when adding a new language. To use auto translate for an existing language, first delete the language then add it again.
* You can also use Wix Multilingual to translate the rest of your site. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-an-overview)

question: How do I choose a business idea using the Wix Business Launcher?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed building your profile in Step 1.

To choose a business idea:
1. Click **Explore This Idea** to read the brief for a generated idea.
   
   **Tip:** Click **Start Over** at the top right to delete your profile and start the process again.
2. Review the brief:
   
   * **Overview:** Provides a summary of how this business idea suits your skills and experience.
   * **Skill match:** Identifies the relevant skills you have and need for this business.
   * **Market analysis:** Offers insights into market demand, potential growth, and potential customer base to help you understand the business environment.
   * **SEO metrics:** Suggests SEO keywords to improve online visibility, highlights traffic potential, and provides a general overview of the SEO competition and volume for this business.
   * **Earning strategies:** Suggests various ways to generate revenue from the business.
   * **Launch kit:** Presents the custom suite of tools and resources you receive to help kickstart your business, including a tailormade business name, personalized site, marketing tools, and more.
3. Click **Set up This Business** to continue with the idea or click the **Back** button to go back to the Ideas List page.

question: How can I create and manage tasks from a contact card in Wix?
answer:

question: How can I use keyboard shortcuts to manage my CMS collections more efficiently?
answer:
To streamline your workflow when managing your CMS collections, you can use the following keyboard shortcuts in your collection's **Table** layout:

- **Ctrl** \\+ **A** or **⌘** \\+ **A**: Select all cells
- **Ctrl** \\+ **C** or **⌘** \\+ **C**: Copy one or more cells
- **Ctrl** \\+ **X** or **⌘** \\+ **X**: Cut one or more cells
- **Ctrl** \\+ **V** or **⌘** \\+ **V**: Paste cut/copied content
- **Shift** \\+ **Enter**: Insert an empty row below
- **Tab**: Go to the next cell
- **Shift** \\+ **Tab**: Go to the previous cell
- **Shift** \\+ **Click**: Select a range of cells between two clicks
- **Right Click** or **Ctrl** \\+ **Click**: Open the context menu

### Tip
You can view this list of shortcuts from within your collection by clicking **More Actions** and selecting **Keyboard shortcuts**.

For more details, you can refer to the [managing your CMS collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-managing-your-collections) guide.

question: What happens to the media files in the Media Manager when I transfer a Wix site to another account?

question: How can I add and customize tabs in the Studio Editor?
answer:
To add tabs in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Layout Tools**.
3. Click **Tabs**.
4. Select a design and drag it onto the page.
5. Customize the content of the tabs:
   
   1. Click the Tabs element you just added.
   2. Click **Manage Tabs**.
   3. Select the tab you want to work on.
   4. Edit the tab's content:
      
      * Add more elements.
      * Edit existing elements.
      * Adjust the [grid](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-working-with-an-advanced-css-grid#applying-a-css-grid-on-other-elements) to the desired layout.

To manage tabs:

1. Click the tabs element.
2. Click **Manage Tabs**.
3. Hover over the relevant tab and click the **More Actions** icon.
4. Choose what you want to do with the tab: **Rename**, **Delete** or **Duplicate**.

To design the tabs:

1. Click the tabs element.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
3. Click the **Design** tab.
4. Choose the part you want to design from the drop-down:
   
   * **Tab container:** This container shows the tab menu.
   * **Tabs:** These are the tabs appearing on the menu. Select the state you want to customize (**Regular**, **Hover**, or **Selected**).
   * **Container:** This is the container that shows the content of each tab.
5. Use the available design options:
   
   * **Background fills:** Apply a color, gradient or image background. You can add multiple background layers and adjust their opacity.
   * **Borders:** Add borders to create a contrast against the site page. Choose a design and color, and set the width.
   * **Corners:** Choose how you want the corners to look. You can adjust each corner differently, and make them rounder or more square.
   * **Shadows:** Add shadows for a cool 3D effect. You can set the size, visibility, angle, and more to give it more impact.
   * **Layout:** Adjust the padding to make it larger or smaller. You can enable or disable the **Lock** icon to adjust each side separately, or make them match.
   * **Text:** Style and format the tab names appearing on the menu. You can change the font, size, color and more.

To set the default tab:

1. Click the tabs element.
2. Click **Manage Tabs**.
3. Hover over the relevant tab and click the **More Actions** icon.
4. Click **Set as default**.

To adjust the tab layout:

1. Click the tabs element.
2. Click the **Layout** icon.
3. Adjust the layout using the available options:
   
   * **Tab distribution:** Decide how much the tab menu should stretch:
     
     + **Default:** The menu does not stretch to fit the width of the element. You can then align the tabs to the left, center, or right.
     + **Stretch:** The menu stretches to fit the width of the element. You can align the text on the menu to the left, center, or right.
   * **Space between tabs:** Drag the slider to change the spacing between the tabs on the menu.
   * **Space between tabs & container:** Change the space between the menu and the container that shows the content of each tab.
   * **Horizontal padding:** Adjust the padding on the left and right of the menu tabs.
   * **Vertical padding:** Adjust the padding on the top and bottom of the menu tabs.
   * **Overflow tabs:** Select how to display tabs that don't fit in the menu:
     
     + **Scroll:** Site visitors can scroll through the menu to see more tabs.
     + **Wrap:** Another row is added to fit the other tabs. You can then use the slider to adjust the space between the rows.
   * **Tab direction:** Display tabs on the menu from left to right, or vice versa.

question: Why are videos and animations not playing on my live site, and how can I fix it?
answer:
Videos and animations may not play on your live site due to settings in the operating system that you or your visitor are using. There are two settings that prevent animation and videos from playing: Reduced Motion and Best Performance.

### Reduced Motion
The Reduced Motion feature stops animations and videos from playing in the browser. It is an accessibility feature designed for visitors with disabilities and certain conditions, such as motion sickness. Reduced Motion is available on most operating systems and can be deactivated to see the full range of effects, motion, and animation on your site. You can learn how to turn off Reduced Motion for different devices using the following links:

- [iPhone and iPad](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202655)
- [Mac OS](https://support.apple.com/en-il/guide/mac-help/mchlc03f57a1/mac)
- [Windows OS](https://support.office.com/en-us/article/Turn-off-Office-animations-9EE5C4D2-D144-4FD2-B670-22CEF9FA025A)
- [Android](https://www.howtogeek.com/415161/does-looking-at-your-phone-make-you-dizzy-disable-animations/)

**Note:** Reduced Motion is also automatically enabled for some mobile devices in low battery / power saving mode.

### Performance Options
On Windows devices, the **Adjust for best performance** setting can affect visual effects like animated elements and videos. To change performance settings:

1. Enter "Performance" into the Windows search box.
2. Select **Adjust the appearance and performance of Windows**.
3. Select the **Visual Effects** tab.
4. Choose an option from the list below:
   - **Let Windows choose what's best for my computer:** Windows changes your device's performance settings based on your device's capabilities.
   - **Adjust for best appearance:** All advanced visual effects and settings are enabled and play on your device (including animation and videos).
   - **Adjust for best performance:** All advanced visual effects and settings are disabled and do not play on your device.
   - **Custom:** Manually adjust the settings to enable and disable the features you want.

**Note:** In order for visitors to see animations and videos play on your live site, they should select the **Adjust for best appearance** option.

question: How can I pause my Facebook ad campaign until a specific date and what happens if my subscription expires before that date?
answer:
To pause your Facebook ad campaign until a specific date, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Facebook Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/paid-ads/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the Campaign Actions drop-down at the top right.
3. Click **Pause Temporarily**.
4. Click **Select a date** next to **Resume on**.
5. Select a day from the date picker that you want your campaign to resume on.

Once you pick a resume date, your campaign will either resume automatically or need to be resumed manually from the dashboard depending on if the date is before or after your subscription expires:

- **Before your subscription expires:** Wix automatically resumes your campaign on the selected date. Whatever current ad spend you have remaining will be saved until then. Click **Pause Campaign** to confirm.
- **After your subscription expires:** You must go to the dashboard and restart your campaign with a new subscription. Any remaining ad spend will be added to the new subscription once your campaign is active. Click **Pause Campaign** to confirm.

**Note:** If the new date you set is after your subscription expires, you have to purchase a new subscription before you can resume your campaign and use leftover ad spend.

question: How can I create a package for my Wix Bookings service?
answer:
To create a package for your Wix Bookings service, follow these steps:

2. Create a new appointment or class, or edit an existing one.
3. Scroll down to the **Price and Payment** section.
4. Choose the relevant price option in the **Price type** drop-down:
   * **Fixed Price:** Set a standard price for the service.
   * **No Fee:** Choose this option for free service.
   * **Varied prices:** Create different price options depending on either the client type or the staff member.

   * **Custom Price:** Describe how you charge for the service, for example, "Price negotiable".
5. Click **Create New Plan** next to **Pricing Plans (Memberships & Packages)**.

9. Choose the services included in the package:
   1. Click the **What services are included?** drop-down.
   2. Select the checkbox next to the relevant services. 
      **Tip:** Click **Select All Services** to create an all-inclusive package.
10. Choose how clients pay under **Price and Duration**:
    * **One-time payment:** Your clients pay for the package as they check out:
      1. Enter the package's price.
      2. Decide how long this package is valid for.
    * **Free:** Offer this package for free. This is a great way to gain new clients.
11. Click the **Package is valid for** drop-down and choose the relevant length of time.

12. (Optional) Add more benefits to your package (e.g. Blog or File Share Subscriptions) under **Extra benefits**.
13. (Optional) Further customize your package using the options under **Settings**:
    * **Limit to 1 per person:** Enable the toggle to make the package a one-time offer for each client.
    * **Let clients cancel:** Enable the toggle to allow clients to cancel their package themselves at any time.
    * **Clients set start date:** Allow clients to set when their package starts at checkout.
    * **Add a policy:** Create your own terms & conditions for the package:
      1. Click **Add**.
      2. Enter your terms and conditions in the field provided.
      3. Click **Save**.
14. Click **Save**.

question: How can I transfer my domain purchased elsewhere to Wix?
answer:
To transfer your domain to Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Add an Existing Domain** and select **Transfer your domain to Wix**.
3. Read the information on your screen and click **Start Transfer**.
4. Enter the domain you want to transfer (e.g. mystunningwebsite.com).
5. Click the drop-down and select the domain host you purchased your domain from.
6. Click **Continue**.
7. Log in to your account with the current domain host:
   
   1. (In a different browser tab) Log in to the account where your domain was purchased.
   2. (In your Wix account) Select the **I logged in** checkbox.
8. Make sure your domain is ready to transfer:
   
   1. (In a different browser tab) Unlock your domain from your current domain host.
   2. (In your Wix account) Select the **I unlocked it** checkbox.
9. Get an authorization code from your account with your current domain host.
10. Paste the code under **Enter authorization code**.
11. Click **Continue**.
12. Select an extension period of at least one year. 

    **Tip:** If you have a free domain voucher, it's automatically applied.
13. Click **Continue**.
14. Check and/or edit your contact information. Then, click **Continue**.
15. Select a [privacy option](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-privacy):
    
    * **Private Registration:** Your contact details won't appear in the WHOIS domain information records. You can turn the privacy protection option on and off whenever you want.
    * **Public Registration:** Your name and address always remain public in the WHOIS domain information records. You can only change it to private when [manually extending](https://support.wix.com/en/article/activating-private-registration-for-a-wix-domain) the domain subscription.
16. Click **Continue**.
17. Select your payment method and click **Submit Purchase**.

Once you've submitted the purchase, an email is sent from **wix-team@registrar.wix.com** to your domain's registrant email, confirming the transfer has been initiated. It may take up to 7 days for your domain transfer to complete.

question: How can I set up an automation in Wix to send an email after a form is submitted?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Make sure your form includes an email field.

### Step 1 | Choose a form to trigger the automation
1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation**.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. In the **Trigger** section, click **Wix Forms**.
6. Select an option under **Select a trigger**:
   - **Option chosen on a form**: The automation is triggered when a specific option within a form is chosen before being submitted.
     1. Click **+ Select** under **Select a form**. Only forms with choice fields will appear.
     2. Click **+ Select** under **Select a field**.
   - **Form submitted:** The automation is triggered after a form on your site is submitted. Choose the relevant option under **Select which forms trigger this automation**:
     - **Any:** All forms trigger this automation.
     - **Specific:** Select which form(s) will trigger this automation.
7. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   - **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered.
   - **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
   - **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
8. (Optional) [Add a delay](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-3-optional-add-a-delay) between a trigger and its action.
9. (Optional) [Add a condition](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-4-optional-add-a-condition) to make the automation occur when certain conditions are met.

### Step 2 | Set "Send an email" as your action
1. In the **Action** section, select **Send an email**.

question: What are the limitations for Wix users from OFAC restricted countries?
answer:
Wix users from OFAC restricted and sanctioned countries face the following limitations:

- They cannot register or use any of Wix's services, including Wix sites.
- They cannot connect to Wix (via pointing or name servers) domains with the following extensions:
  - Cuba (.cu)
  - Iran (.ir)
  - Iran .xn--mgba3a4f16a (.ایران)
  - North Korea (.kp)
  - Syria (.sy)
  - Syria .xn--ogbpf8fl (.سورية)

Attempting to utilize Wix sites from any of the restricted countries, regions, or domains is a violation of Wix's [Terms of Use](https://www.wix.com/about/terms-of-use) and can result in a revocation of access to Wix’s services. Additionally, if Wix contacts you via email requesting additional information as part of their monitoring process, you are required to cooperate within the specified timeframe. Failure to do so may result in your account and/or site being deactivated.

question: What changes were made to the page structure of Wix websites for accessibility, and how can I resolve any design issues caused by these changes?
answer:
The update has corrected the page structure of your site for accessibility purposes. As a result of this update, we no longer support elements that overflow the footer, into the container above it. This means that if your website had an overflowing element like this, the design might have been affected once your site was updated.

**Before the update:**
Elements could overflow from the footer into the main container above it.

**After the update:**
Elements cannot overflow from the footer into the main container above it. The update has also removed the "arrange" option from the footer's right-click menu, so you can no longer move the footer forward and backward.

**Resolving Issues:**
If something has changed in the design of the footer on your site, please make sure that all the elements in the footer are properly attached to it, and that they are fully contained inside the footer, without overflowing into the container above it. By placing them correctly, they will become visible.

For more information, you can visit the following links:
- [About the update](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-page-structure-update#about-the-update)
- [Resolving issues related to the update](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-page-structure-update#resolving-issues)

question: How can I transfer a free Wix site to another account, and what should I be aware of before doing so?
answer:
To transfer a free Wix site to another account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/home/).
2. Click the **Site Actions** icon at the top of the page.
3. Select **Transfer site**.
4. Enter the recipient's email address. If necessary, choose whether the recipient is a client, agency or freelancer, or someone else.

   **Tip:** If the person you're transferring to does not yet have an account, they'll be prompted to create one when accepting the transfer.
5. Click **Continue**.
6. (Optional) Select the checkbox next to the relevant options:
   * **Keep my role as Co-Owner of this site after the transfer:** Become a collaborator on the site after the transfer. You will have the [Admin (Co-Owner)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-overview#general-roles-for-site-management) role, which the new site owner can remove at any time.
   * **Create a copy of this site and keep it in my account:** Create a copy of the site in your account after the transfer.
7. Click **Continue**.
8. Confirm that the site transfer details are correct and click **Transfer Ownership**.
9. Click **Got it**.

**Note:** The recipient has 3 days to accept the invite. If they accept, you will receive an email once the transfer is complete.

### Before you begin
- Once you transfer the site, the **site ownership** is transferred and all future subscription payments are managed by the new owner.
- You can choose to simply add someone as a collaborator instead of transferring ownership. Learn more about [Roles and Permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-overview).

### Tip
Go to [Roles and Permissions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20this%20Site&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmanage-website%2Fauthorization) to track and [manage your transfers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/managing-your-site-transfers).

question: Can I connect a repeater item's background directly to the CMS in the Studio Editor?
answer:
Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to click a repeater item and then connect the background to the CMS (Content Management System). However, you can add a background image to a repeater item first, then connect this image to the CMS to display images from your collection. This allows you to manage the backgrounds of your repeater items in CMS collections.

### To connect a repeater item's background to the CMS:
1. [Go to the Studio Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Select a repeater item in the relevant repeater.
3. Click **Add Media**.
4. Select an image or click **\+ Upload Media** to upload a new image to your media manager. Then click **Add to Page**.
5. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
6. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select a dataset that connects to the collection with the images you want to use as backgrounds.
7. Click the **Image source connects to** drop-down and select the image field you want to connect.
8. (Optional) Click the remaining drop-down menus under **Connections** to connect the image's alt text, tooltip, and link.

Learn more about [connecting repeater items to your CMS collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-dynamic-content-in-a-repeater).

### Notes
