* Adding apps to your site will trigger an automatic autosave, regardless of whether autosave has been disabled.
* Viewing your site Preview will trigger an automatic autosave, regardless of whether autosave has been disabled.

question: How can I display FAQs in my Wix member app using the Wix FAQ app?
answer:
Prerequisites: You must [add the Wix FAQ app to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-and-setting-up-the-wix-faq-app) from a desktop computer before you can display FAQs in your member apps.

### Step 1 | Add a new screen for your FAQs
To get started, set up a new screen to show your FAQs.

#### To add a new screen:
1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage**![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Mobile App**.
4. Tap **Edit** under the name of your app.
5. Tap **Screens**.
6. Tap **Add New Screen**.
7. Type the screen name.
8. Tap **Save**.

### Step 2 | Customize your FAQ display
Next, choose what you want to display in your FAQs.

#### To customize the display:
1. Tap the FAQ screen.
2. Tap **\+ Add Element**.
3. Scroll through the top menu and tap **FAQs**.
4. Tap the FAQs element.
5. Tap the toggles to enable or disable the following options:
   * **Show search bar:** Add a search bar to your FAQ's to let your site visitors search for a specific FAQ.
   * **Show first question and answer:** If you have more than one FAQ, the first question and answer is shown. To view the additional FAQs tap the "View All" button.
   * **Open one answer at a time:** Shows only one answer at a time and collapses the other answers.
   * **FAQs displayed per category:** Choose how many FAQs you want to display.
6. Decide whether or not to show categories for your FAQs:
   
   **Note:** To [edit your FAQ categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/working-with-categories-in-the-wix-faq-app), log in to your Wix account from a desktop computer.
7. (Optional) Enable the **Show element title** toggle to display a title above your FAQs.
8. (Optional) Click the drop-down under **Visibility** to select the devices you want to show this element on: Android, iOS or All.
9. Tap **Add** at the top right.

question: How can I change the size of a slideshow on my Wix mobile site?
answer:
To change the size of your slideshow on a Wix mobile site:

1. Click the slideshow in the mobile Editor.
2. Click and drag the sides of the slideshow to adjust the height and width.

**Note:** This option is only available for **Box slideshows**. However, you can adjust the height of a **Full Width slideshow** by clicking and dragging the Stretch Handle icon.

question: Is it possible to add a shopping cart to Wix Events so that clients can purchase tickets for multiple events at once?
answer: Currently, Wix Events does not have a shopping cart. Clients who want to buy tickets for multiple events need to purchase tickets separately for each event.

question: Can I schedule appointments in Wix Bookings without assigning a specific staff member?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to schedule appointments without assigning a specific staff member in charge of the session. However, you can [create a generic staff profile](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-staff-members) to represent unstaffed sessions. This allows you to offer appointment services without needing to assign them to individual staff members at the time of booking.

question: How can I enable or disable the gridlines in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To enable or disable the editor gridlines:

1. Click **Tools** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/10/19/f2ec3586-a47e-4e3b-821a-334dc6be7fe7/71c2ecf0-b689-4394-9613-81ec23012fa7.png) at the top of the editor.
2. Select or deselect the **Gridlines** checkbox.

question: Can I reorder my Wix photo albums to display in alphabetical order?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to reorder albums to display in alphabetical order (automatically or manually), so that your albums display from A-Z according to their titles.

question: How can I tell if a Printful order has been fulfilled in my Wix dashboard?
answer: Once an order is fulfilled, you receive an email from Printful. In addition, a tracking number appears beside the item in the Wix dashboard.

question: Can I add my own CSS code to style elements in Wix Blocks using Velo code?
answer: Currently in Wix Blocks, it’s not possible to edit CSS through Velo code. This feature would allow you to add your own CSS code to style elements and their individual parts.

question: Can I import a CSV file with non-Latin characters into a collection in the CMS?
answer: Currently, non-Latin languages are not supported when importing a CSV file into a collection in the CMS (Content Management System). Any non-Latin characters are imported as 'unknown' type.

question: How can I create an image with a transparent background using Wix Media Manager?
answer:
To make an image or logo background transparent using Wix Media Manager, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your Media Manager](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Media%20Manager&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/media-manager/).
2. Click the image you want to edit.
3. Click **Crop & Edit**.
4. Click **Cut Out** on the left.
5. Click **Auto Cut Out**.
6. Click **Refine Cut Out** to edit the image cut out with a brush. Use the editing options:
   
   * **Restore:** Restore parts of the cut out that you removed.
   * **Erase:** Edit the image to remove parts of the cut out.
   * **Fix Edges:** Fix soft edges (for example, around hair).
   * **Size:** Select the brush size to make more accurate edits.
   * **Hardness:** Select the brush hardness to make more accurate edits.
   * **Opacity:** Select the brush opacity to make more accurate edits.
7. (Optional) Click and hold the **Preview Changes** icon to preview the changes you've made.
8. Click **Apply** once you're happy with your changes.
9. Click **Save** to save the new image in your Media Manager.

question: How do I add and set up an address input element in the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.
* Make sure you have [a collection with suitable permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-a-custom-form-with-input-elements-that-submit-to-your-collection#step-1-create-a-collection-and-set-the-permissions) for storing submissions from the address input element.

### Step-by-Step Instructions
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2021/08/23/fb2504cd-afa3-47dd-8e84-4cd32a0ea1ed/653ea261-d479-44ae-8509-7735843df25c.png) on the left.
3. Click **Input**.
4. Click **Address Input**.
5. Click and drag the address input element of your choice onto the page.
6. Click **Settings** on the address input element.
7. Enter the **Field title** that will display at the top of the element.
8. Enter the **Placeholder text** that appears in the field before visitors type in it.

   **Tip:** If you do not want placeholder text, click **None** under **Initial text**.
9. (Optional) Click the **Read only** checkbox to restrict the address input from writing content to the collection. This is helpful if you're using the element to display content rather than submit it.
10. Choose an option under **Address autocomplete:**

    * **All countries:** When visitors type, autocomplete uses addresses from every country to help finish the address input.
    * **One country:** When visitors type, autocomplete only uses addresses from one country to help finish the address input. Click the **Choose a country** drop-down and select the country to use.
11. Click the **Layout** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/09/12/734557c6-c0b4-447f-b06b-913a6cdda087/7d44f8a6-1640-4519-95a4-01eafb2f0dcf.png) to set text alignment, placeholder padding, and the dropdown list display.
12. Click the **Design** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/09/12/33af6f0f-b6ab-4e51-b58b-44f286e77642/959a4c6f-2294-42c7-ac5b-576b1be782d3.png) to choose a preset design. Then click **Customize Design** to adjust the design further.

question: Can I create different pickup and delivery rules for my lunch and dinner menus in Wix Restaurants?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to create different pickup and delivery rules for different menus at your restaurant (i.e. Lunch vs. Dinner menu). When you set your pickup and delivery options, those settings apply to all menus. However, you can set different delivery charges and minimum order amounts for different [delivery areas](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-setting-up-delivery-areas-for-orders). You can also set a minimum order amount for [pickup orders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-offering-pickup-for-orders).

question: How can I embed Google customer reviews on my website using the Google Reviews app by Elfsight?
answer:
To embed Google customer reviews on your website using the Google Reviews app by Elfsight, follow these steps:

1. Visit the [Google Reviews](https://www.wix.com/app-market/google-reviews-by-elfsight) app page by Elfsight.
2. Use the app to embed customer reviews from a Google business or location on your website without the need for any coding.
3. Take advantage of features such as full control over the displayed reviews with advanced sorting, filtering, and moderation.
4. Boost your conversions with CTA buttons, star rating snippet, and AI-generated summary.
5. Choose from ready-to-use templates, layout designs, and review card styles to find the look you want.

For any questions or comments, you can contact Elfsight directly via their [website](https://elfsight.com/) or email them at [support@elfsight.com](mailto:support@elfsight.com).

question: How can I create color-swatch options for my products in Wix Stores?
answer:
To create color-swatch options for your product in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Store Products tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Do one of the following:
   * Click to select an existing physical product.
   * Click **New Product** and select **Physical**.
3. Scroll down to the **Product Options** section.
4. Click **+ Add Options**.
5. Enter **Color** under **Type in an option name**.
6. Select **Color** under **Show in product page as**.
7. Enter your first color choice (e.g. Purple) and press **Enter** on your keyboard.
8. (Optional) Select a shade:
   1. Click the color you just added.
   2. Select a shade or enter a hexadecimal color value.
   3. Click the Checkmark icon.
9. Repeat steps 7 and 8 to add additional colors.
10. (Optional) Drag the option choices to rearrange their order.
11. Click **Add**.

question: How can I change the spacing between items in my Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the spacing between gallery items in your Wix Pro Gallery using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click the **Layout** tab.
5. Choose a layout.
6. Click **Customize Layout**.
7. Scroll down to the **Design Settings**.
8. Drag the **Spacing** slider to increase or decrease the amount of spacing between images.

**Note:** You cannot change the spacing for Slideshow galleries.

question: Can I use Global Payments as a payment provider on Wix?
answer: Currently, Wix does not offer Global Payments as a payment provider. If you use the [Manual payment method](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-manual-offline-payments), you can mention that you accept payments through Global Payments and arrange the payment offline.

question: How can I connect page elements to my CMS collections in Wix?
answer:
In the CMS, [datasets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-datasets) are your tool for linking elements within your editor to the content stored in your collections. Select any supported element in your editor and click the **Connect to CMS** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/06/16/2d484f5d-e1bf-4d48-9e42-82216e8b88de/08e74518-edad-42f8-b007-c974ba767eb6.png) to map out which collection fields correspond to each part of your elements. 

Within your dataset settings, you have full control. Customize the [dataset mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-working-with-the-dataset-mode-and-collection-permissions#dataset-modes) to suit your needs, set the [maximum number of items to load](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-the-maximum-items-displayed-in-your-dataset-settings) at once, and fine-tune [filters and sorting conditions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-filters-and-sorts-to-datasets-to-control-live-site-content) to exclude specific items and determine their display order on your site. With these settings, you can ensure your content is presented exactly how you envision it.

Learn more about [connecting page elements to datasets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset).

question: Can I upload my own custom icons for my Branded App?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to upload your own custom icons when designing your Branded App. You can choose to display specific predefined icons based on which business apps you're currently using.

question: Can I add a custom logo (watermark) to the videos I upload to Wix Video?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add a custom logo (watermark) to the videos you upload to Wix Video. You can, however, add a custom logo to [embedded videos](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-custom-logo-to-videos-when-embedded-in-other-sites).

question: How can I connect Atome as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Atome as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options.**
3. Click **Connect** next to Atome.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Atome account, or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your API Key and Password.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account
   1. Sign up for an Atome account, using the link that matches your location:
      
      * [Atome for Indonesia](https://portal.atome.id/form-submit?accessToken=f3d1034261a643b59fc347f89d3b4ebb)
      * [Atome for Malaysia](https://portal.atome.my/form-submit?accessToken=462e2e87bd6043b080cf550e9e0eb961)
      * [Atome for Singapore](https://portal.atome.sg/form-submit?accessToken=6057b2224b204738b9e4ac55084f3794)
      * [Atome for Thailand](https://portal.atometh.com/form-submit?accessToken=71a36a18431a4e888f04e0e7736f4b3b)
   2. Fill in the registration form and click **Agree and Submit**.
   3. Wait for an email from Atome to get your API Key and Password.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

question: Can I create a holiday menu in Wix Restaurants?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to create a holiday menu for your restaurant in Wix Restaurants. However, you have the flexibility to create a new menu, save it as a draft, and publish it when the holiday season arrives. You can also manually unpublish it and save it as a draft until the next holiday.

question: How can I customize visitor interactions and notifications for my Wix Photo Albums Favorites list?
answer:
To customize visitor interactions and your notifications for a Wix Photo Albums Favorites list, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fphotography-albums/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Album** next to the relevant album.
3. Click the drop-down in the **Favorites Lists** section to expand it.
4. Set your album's heart icon settings:
   
   1. Enable the **Let visitors select photos by clicking on a heart icon** toggle to allow visitors to mark their favorite photos with heart icons.
   2. Choose whether clicking the heart icon adds the photo to a Favorites list or marks the photo as liked.
5. Enable the **Notifications for Favorites lists** toggle to receive notifications when certain Favorites lists actions are taken. Select the checkboxes next to the actions you'd like to receive notifications for.
6. Click **Save**.

question: Can I set repeater items as sticky in the Studio Editor?
answer: You can now [set repeater items as sticky](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-creating-sticky-elements-and-sections), so they stick to the page as visitors scroll up and down.

question: How can I upgrade my video storage on Wix if I'm reaching my storage limit?
answer:
To upgrade your storage on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.
2. If you're approaching or have reached your storage limit, you'll see a warning bar at the top of your screen. Click **Upgrade** to view upgrade options.

**Note**: You'll only see this message if you're approaching or have reached your storage limit, but you can [upgrade](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) at any time.
3. Select the Premium plan you wish to add to your site and complete the purchase process.

Once you've purchased a new Premium plan, your new storage limit is automatically applied to your site.

question: How can I add a Related Products gallery to my Wix Store using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add a Related Products gallery to your Wix Store using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page to which you want to add the gallery. 

   **Tip:** The Related Products gallery works best when added to the Product Page.
3. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
4. Select **Store**.
5. Click **Related Products**.
6. Drag the gallery to the page.
7. Select the gallery in your editor.
8. Click **Settings**.
9. Select the type of related products to display:
   
   * **From the same categories:** Works best when added to the product page, cart or thank you page.
   * **Frequently bought together:** Works best when added to the product page.
   * **Frequently viewed together:** Works best when added to the product page.
10. (Optional) Edit the default gallery name ("Related products"):
    
    1. Click the **Text** tab.
    2. Enter a new name under **Gallery title text.**

### Tips
* Learn how to customize your [Related Products gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-setting-up-product-galleries#adding-a-slider-gallery-selecting-a-category-to-display).
* In [preview mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-saving-previewing-and-publishing-your-site#previewing-your-site), the images do not move from product to product. You can see them on your live site.

question: How can I generate and send a paystub using the Wix Paystub Generator?
answer:
To generate and send a paystub using the Wix Paystub Generator, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Wix Paystub Generator](https://www.wix.com/tools/pay-stub-generator).
2. Click **Create a Pay Stub**.
3. Fill in the fields under the **Your Business Info** section.
4. Fill in the fields under the **Employee Info** section.
5. Fill in the fields under the **Salary Details** section.
6. (Optional) Preview the paystub under the **Pay Stub Preview** section.
7. Choose how you wish to receive your paystub: 
   
   * **Email Pay Stub:** Send the paystub directly to your employee.
   * **Download Pay Stub:** Download a copy of the paystub to your device.

question: How can I create subcategories in my Wix site menu using the regular site menu?
answer:
To create a site menu with submenu items using the regular site menu, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages and Menu** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Site Menu**.
3. Click the Link icon at the bottom.
4. Select **Category Page** from the **Which Page?** drop-down.
5. Select the category you want to display from the **Which item?** drop-down.
6. Click **Done**.
7. Repeat to add all the categories you need to build your menu.
8. Drag a category under and to the right of the categories you want to place it under.

question: How does Wix ensure the protection of users' personal information according to their privacy policy?
answer: Wix is fully committed to protecting users' personal information and using it properly. The privacy of users is of extreme importance to Wix.

question: How can I save a proposal as a template in Wix Proposals by Prospero?
answer:
To save a proposal as a template in Wix Proposals by Prospero, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Proposals](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Proposals&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/proposals) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant existing proposal.
3. Click **Save as template**.

question: Can I filter images by tags in the Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to search and filter images by tags in the Wix Pro Gallery.

### Tip
If you connected your gallery to the CMS (Content Management System), you can [allow visitors to use input elements to filter content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-setting-up-filters-for-site-visitors-using-input-elements).

question: What is the main establishment for Wix under the EU NIS2 directive and how can inquiries be submitted?
answer: Pursuant to article 2, Wix appoints Wix Online Platforms Limited as the main establishment for the purposes of the NIS2 directive based on the highest number of employees in the Union. Wix's point of contact for inquiries from member state authorities, the EU Commission, ENISA, and recipients of the service is [legal@wix.com](mailto:legal@wix.com). Please submit inquiries in English.

question: How can I add a button to my ADI site and customize its text and link?
answer:
To add a button to your ADI site and customize its text and link, follow these steps:

1. Click the relevant page section.
2. Click **Edit**.
3. Select or deselect the **Show/Hide** icon next to the **Buttons** field: 
   * **Selected**: The button is shown.
   * **Unselected:** The button is hidden.
4. (Optional) Click **\+ Add Button** to add another button.
5. Enter the text for your button.
6. Click **Link** and select the link for your button.
7. Click **Done**.

**Notes:**
* The style of your secondary button is based on the settings of your first button.
* The option of adding a second button may not be supported in some sections of your ADI site.

question: Does Wix support proxied DNS records for domain connections with Cloudflare?
answer: Currently, Wix does not support proxied DNS records for domain connections. With Cloudflare, DNS records are proxied by default. As a workaround, you can ask Cloudflare to disable any active proxies or record masking for your domain. Learn more about [verifying your Cloudflare settings when connecting your domain to Wix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/verifying-your-cloudflare-settings-for-connecting-a-domain-to-wix).

question: Can I duplicate cells in a section grid using the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to duplicate cells in a [section grid](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-customizing-a-section-grid).

question: Can clients purchase a pricing plan with a service and a product together?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible for clients to purchase a pricing plan with a service and a product, such as booking a yoga class and buying a yoga mat. They have to go through separate checkouts for each one.

### Tip
You can also vote for clients to [purchase multiple pricing plans together](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-request-purchasing-multiple-pricing-plans-together) in a single checkout.

question: How can I deactivate a shipping rule in Wix Stores?
answer:
To deactivate a shipping rule in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Shipping & fulfillment](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Shipping&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/store/shipping-and-tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the toggle next to the relevant country to deactivate the shipping rule.

question: How can I change the password for a password protected page in Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the password of a password protected page in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

question: How can I add a new writer to my Wix blog using the Writers list?
answer:
To add a blog writer or blog editor from the Writers list:

1. Go to your [blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog) in your dashboard.
2. Click the **Writers** tab in the panel on the left.
3. Click **Add Writer** at the top right.
4. Select the type of writer that you want to add and click **Continue**.
5. Choose what you want to do:

### Invite a new writer
When you choose to add a new writer, you're giving that person additional permissions and responsibilities on your blog. You can choose to make them a Blog Editor or a Blog Writer.

1. Enter the person's email address.
2. Select what type of role you want to give:
   * **Blog Editor:** They can write posts and manage your blog. They cannot manage other areas of your site.
   * **Blog Writer:** They can write and publish posts, but cannot manage your blog.
   * **Guest Writer:** They can write posts, but cannot publish them.
3. Click **Send Invite**.

### Create a managed writer
You can manually add managed writers to your blog without giving them any permissions to your site. Managed writers have no permissions on your site and cannot post themselves or customize their profile. Adding a writer this way means that you can attribute them to a specific post on a one-time basis.

1. Enter a name for the managed writer under **Name**.
2. (Optional) Add a profile picture and any other additional information for the writer.
3. Click **Save**.

question: How can I enable autoplay for my gallery in Wix Editor?
answer:
To enable autoplay for your gallery in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Open the **Settings panel** for your gallery.
2. Look for the **Autoplays on loading** setting.
3. Enable this toggle so your gallery starts playing automatically, as soon as the page loads.
4. Control the time (in seconds) given to each image under **How long between images?**

This setting is available for the following galleries:
- Grid (Portrait)
- Slider (Arrows)
- Slider (Postcard)
- 3D Slideshow
- 3D Carousel
- Animated Slide

question: What apps are recommended for musicians to use on their Wix site to share and sell music?
answer:

question: How do I set up Wix SMS for my site?
answer:
To set up Wix SMS, follow these steps:

1. [Go to SMS Settings](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/wix-sms?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+SMS+Settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. (If your site is not upgraded) Click **Get Started** and click **Upgrade**. 
   
   1. Click **Select** under the plan you wish to purchase.
   2. Select a billing cycle and click **Continue to Checkout**.
   3. Enter your payment details and click **Submit Purchase**. 
   
   **Note:** After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to [verify your identity.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/paying-for-wix-services-strong-customer-authentication-sca-and-3d-secure-3ds) If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.
   4. Go back to the **SMS Settings** page and click **Refresh Page**.
3. Scroll down to **Your automated texts** section to manage the texts getting sent:

### Enable or disable a notification
All [automations that include sending SMS messages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-sending-an-sms-to-customers-using-pre-installed-automations) are activated by default. Click the **Active/Inactive** toggle next to a notification to start or stop it from running. 

### Edit a notification
Although the action of sending an SMS cannot be edited in a notification, you can click **Edit Automation** next to a notification to do any of the following: 
* **Edit the** [**'Send an email' action**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-customizing-automated-emails)**:** Customize the sender details, change or edit the email template, change the email type, and set the email's recipients.
* **Customize the automation:** Add a [delay](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-3-optional-add-a-delay) and [condition](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-4-optional-add-a-condition) to specify when you want the automation to happen.
* **Delete an action:** Remove an action from the automation by clicking **Delete Action** below the action. 

**Note:** Even if you remove the **Send an SMS** action from an automation, it still appears in the notifications list on the SMS Settings page.

### Reset a notification to its default setting
You can always reset an automation if you have changed its settings, for example if you have modified or deleted one of the actions. 
Click the **More Actions** icon and click **Reset to default**.

### Note
Your upgraded site plan comes with a certain number of automated texts each month. To increase your quota, [upgrade your SMS plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-sms-upgrading-wix-sms).

question: How can I manually give loyalty points to a customer in the Wix Loyalty Program?

question: Can I make a specific element on my site visible only to members?
answer: While you can [restrict entire pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-applying-page-permissions) so only members are allowed to access them, it's not possible to do the same with individual elements. For example, you cannot change the viewing permissions of an element so it doesn't appear for visitors who aren't members.

question: How can I use the Accessibility Monitor to check my site's accessibility on Wix?
answer:
To use the Accessibility Monitor to check your site's accessibility on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/home/).

question: How can I add a gradient background to a section in the Studio Editor?
answer:
To add a gradient background to a section:

1. Select the relevant section.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
3. Click the color box under **Design**.
4. Depending on your preference, click below to learn how to create each gradient type:

### Add a Linear, Radial or Conic gradient
1. (In the Color Picker) Click the Gradient icon.
2. Choose the gradient type from the drop-down: **Linear**, **Radial** or **Conic**.
3. Adjust the gradient and its colors by doing the following:
   * **(Linear and Conic) Change the angle:**
     1. Click the current angle that appears on the gradient preview.
     2. Enter the desired angle.
   * **(Radial and Conic) Change the focal point:**
     1. Click the current focal point appearing on the gradient preview.
     2. Hold and drag it to the desired location.
   * **Change an existing color:**
     1. (On the colors bar under the preview) Click the color dot that you want to change.
     2. Click the color box.
     3. Select a color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish.
   * **Add more colors:**
     1. (On the colors bar under the preview) Click on the desired location for your new color.
        **Tip:** As you hover over the colors bar, you'll notice your cursor changing to this icon.
     2. Select a color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish.
     3. (Optional) Drag the slider to change the color's opacity.
   * **Delete a color:**
     1. (On the colors bar under the preview) Click the color dot that you want to remove.
     2. Click the Delete Color icon.

**Tip:** Save the gradients you design so they're always available for future use. After designing your gradient, click **+ Add** next to **My color gradients**.

### Add a Fluid gradient
1. (In the Color Picker) Click the Fluid Gradient icon.
2. Adjust the gradient and its colors by doing the following:
   * **Change an existing color:**
     1. (On the gradient preview) Click the color dot that you want to change.
     2. Click the color box below the preview.
     3. Select a different color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish.
   * **Add more colors:**
     1. (On the gradient preview) Click on the desired location for your new color.
        **Tip:** As you hover over the preview, you'll notice your cursor changing to this icon.
     2. Select a color. You can choose one of your theme colors or any custom color you wish.
     3. Adjust your new color:
        + Drag the slider to change the color's opacity.
        + Drag the slider under **Size** to change the amount of space this color takes up in the gradient.
        + Drag the slider under **Spread** to set how much each color spreads across the gradient.
   * **Delete a color:**
     1. (On the gradient preview) Click the color dot you want to remove.
     2. Click the Delete Color icon.

**Tip:** Save the gradients you design so they're always available for future use. After designing your gradient, click **+ Add** next to **My fluid gradients**.

question: How do I create a draft for a single event in Wix Events?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to your site's dashboard on Wix.

To create an event draft:

1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Add Event**.
3. Select a type of event (this can't be changed after you click **Create Draft**):
   * **Ticketed Event:** Sell event tickets (can include free tickets).
   * **RSVP Event:** Guests register for the event.
4. Add your event details:
   
   **General info**
   * Enter the event name.
   * Enter a brief description of the event under **Short Teaser**.
   * Connect this event to one or more event categories.
   * Add an **Event image**:
     1. Click the Add **+** icon.
     2. (In the Media Manager) Select or upload an image and click **Add to Page**.
   
   **Date and time**
   * If the date and time are still unknown:
     1. Enable the **Time is TBD** (to be determined) toggle.
     2. (Optional) Edit the TBD message.
   * If the event has a time and date:
     1. Select a start date and time.
     2. Enter an end date and time or click the "X" icon to remove it.
     3. Click the **Timezone** drop-down and select a time zone.
     4. (Optional) Click the **Display timezone** checkbox.
   
   **Location**
   * If the location hasn't been set:
     1. Click the **Location is TBD** (to be determined) toggle to enable it.
     2. (Optional) Edit the location message.
   * If the event has a physical location:
     1. Click **Physical Location**.
     2. Start typing the address of the location and select it from the list.
     3. (Optional) Enter a **Venue Name** (e.g. Freemont Hotel).
   * If the event takes place online:
     1. Click **Online**.
     2. Enter an **Online Location Title** (e.g. Webinar).
   
   **"About the event" description**
   * Add detailed event information about your event.
5. When ready, click **Create Draft** at the top right.

question: How can I set up a new route to redirect visitors to a different site using Wix Studio for enterprise?
answer:
To set up a new route to redirect visitors to a different site using Wix Studio for enterprise, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Routing](https://manage.wix.com/enterprise-dashboard/routes) in your Enterprise dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Route** at the top right.
3. Create your custom URL subdirectory:
   * **URL Base:** In the URL base field, select the base URL you want to use. The base URL means the main part of the URL with which your customers are familiar - e.g. https://yourcompanyname.com.
   * **URL Path:** Choose a path word(s) that best suits the destination of the URL or leave it blank. For example, yourcompany.com/summersale.
4. Under **Destination**, choose whether to direct traffic to a Wix site or an external link. Then select the site or enter the URL next to your selection.
5. Click **Create Route**.
6. (Optional) Hover over the relevant route and click **Manage Sites** to add alternative sites to the route and set their language and location targeting.

You can set up as many routes as you need. There is no limit.

answer: Currently, it is not possible to add extra charges to a renewal payment for an ongoing subscription. This might include additional services or products.

question: How can I create a detailed report of my site's index status using Wix Site Inspection?
answer: You can [create Site Inspection reports for your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-site-inspection-creating-a-report) in your site's SEO Dashboard. In your report, you can see a Highlights summary of the status of your entire site and a Full Report listing all the pages of your site and their individual statuses. You can also select a specific page to open a more detailed report for that page including its status results and rich results status. question: Can I hide folders from members without access permissions in the Wix File Share App?

question: How can I improve my Wix editor's performance by using dynamic pages?
answer:
Instead of duplicating many pages and changing their content manually, you can use dynamic pages. With dynamic pages, you can reduce the number of static pages on your site and help your editor perform better. Dynamic pages allow you to reuse the same page layout across multiple pages while showing different content in each. Every dynamic page connects to a collection in your [CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-content-management-system-an-overview) where you add the info you want to display in the page.

Learn more about [using dynamic pages in your Wix site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages).

question: How can I display product categories on the Category Page using the Wix Editor?

7. Select **List**.

   * **Hide individual categories:**
     1. Select **Customize & reorder the list manually**.
     2. Deselect the checkbox next to the category you want to hide.
9. (Optional) Reorder categories by dragging the categories to the preferred order.

**Important:** The category list is not displayed on mobile devices. We recommend adding categories to the site menu so customers viewing your site on mobile can access your categories.

question: How can I edit my purchased logo if it says I need to upgrade my plan?
answer: If you purchased a Logo-Only Plan ([Basic, Advanced, and Value](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-about-the-wix-logo-maker-plans)) your design is locked once you choose to download it. question: How do I customize the Pricing Plans app on my site using the ADI Builder?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added the Pricing Plans app to your site from the ADI Builder.

To customize your Pricing Plans page:

1. Go to the Plans & Pricing page in the ADI Builder.
2. Click the Pricing Plans app.
3. Click **Design** to select a new layout for the app.
4. Click the **Show More** icon and select Settings to edit the app settings:
   
   * **Full Width:** Enable this toggle to display your pricing plans over the full width of your page.
   * **Page Header:** Click the checkmark to show or hide a title above the plan list. If shown, edit the text.
   * **Button Text:** Edit the text for the "Select" button that appears on each plan.
   * **Plan Info:** Click the checkmarks next to each info section you want to include:
     
     + **Plan title:** This is the name of the plan.
     + **Tagline:** This is a brief description of your plan.
     + **Benefits:** This is a list of benefits or features that the plan includes.
     
     **Tip:** Click **Manage Pricing Plans** at the bottom, to edit the plan info text.
   * **Highlighted Plan:** Select a plan you want to highlight or promote (e.g. "Best Value").
   * **Ribbon Text:** Edit the text that appears on the highlighted plan.
   * **Auto Renewal Disclaimer:** Click the checkmark to add an autorenewal disclaimer and tell your customers about your renewal policy.

question: How can I add and customize sections in the Wix Editor for my website?

question: Can I upload my own screenshots to Store Listings in the Branded app?
answer:
Currently, in the Branded app, it is not possible to upload your own screenshots to Store Listings when preparing to submit your app to the App Store and Google Play. As a workaround, you can [upload your own screenshots to the Wix Chatbot](https://www.wix.com/contact?nodeId=101c61ab-8645-4ef5-81df-a9f337378bb2&referral=brandedAppByWixKb). Once you submit them, the Branded App by Wix submissions team will get notified and upload the screenshots to Store Listings on your behalf.

### Make sure your screenshots meet the Apple and Google requirements
* **Apple:** Requires 3 images for the 3 different device types (sizes 6.5, 5.5, and 12.9).
* **Google:** Requires specifications for an app icon, feature graphic, and phone screenshots.

[Learn more about Apple and Google requirements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/requirements-for-uploading-your-own-screenshots-to-store-listings-via-the-wix-chatbot).

question: How can I access a site in a workspace using the Wix Studio app?

question: Can I view files uploaded through Wix Forms in my Contact List?
answer: Currently, files that visitors upload using Wix Forms are sent directly to your email address, but are not saved inside the contact card within your Contact List.

question: How can I track events in Wix Bookings using Meta Pixel and view the event data in Facebook?
answer:
Wix automatically sends events to Facebook about your [Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-about-wix-bookings) services on your site. Using the Meta pixel, you can track events on your site such as views and purchases for each service you offer. [Connect your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-facebook-pixel-and-the-conversions-api-to-your-wix-site-7351813) to get started.

The events you see in your Facebook account are:

* **View Content:** When a visitor views a service page.
* **Initiate Checkout**: When a visitor clicks on the "Book Now" button.
* **Select Date:** After the user selects a date for his service.
* **Add Payment Info**: After the visitor added his payment information.
* **Purchase:** When a visitor books a service and is taken to the "Thank-you" page.

To see the event data in Facebook:

1. Sign into your Facebook account.
2. Click **Ads Manager**, located in the top left corner.
3. Click **Events Manager**.

question: Why does Wix change the sender email address to a wixshoutout.com domain when using free public domains for email campaigns?
answer:
Mail services might not accept email marketing campaigns sent from free public domains, such as Gmail, Yahoo, and AOL. If you choose to use a public domain as your sender email address, Wix automatically changes the sender address to an authenticated wixshoutout.com email address. This is in order to ensure that your email will arrive to the inbox of your recipients, rather than their junk folder, or to be rejected entirely. Replies to your email campaigns are still sent to the Reply-to email address that you use. 

If you do not want your email campaigns to be sent from wixshoutout.com authenticated domain, it is best to use an email address on a domain that you own or any other private domain (eg. @your-business.com). You can purchase [business email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-purchasing-a-personalized-business-email) for your own domain directly from Wix.

### Tip
Learn how to [change your Reply-to email address](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-changing-the-sender-details-of-your-campaigns).

question: Why don't my music and videos autoplay on mobile and tablet devices using Wix Editor?
answer: You may find that your music and videos do not play automatically on iPhones, Androids and tablets. This is because Apple and Chrome block the autoplay function to prevent additional data charges from the visitor's cellphone network. No data is loaded until the user taps the play button on the audio or video player. Autoplay functions are also disabled if the visitor has enabled low-power mode on their iOS device. For more information, please see [Apple's Safari Developer Library](https://developer.apple.com/library/safari/#documentation/AudioVideo/Conceptual/Using_HTML5_Audio_Video/Device-SpecificConsiderations/Device-SpecificConsiderations.html%23//apple_ref/doc/uid/TP40009523-CH5-SW1) and [Google's Developers guidelines](https://developers.google.com/web/updates/2017/09/autoplay-policy-changes).

   **Note:** Guests can click the link to read your policy.

question: Why does my Wix mobile site show an error for viewport configuration in Google's mobile friendliness tool?
answer: When running a test at [https://testmysite.thinkwithgoogle.com/](https://testmysite.thinkwithgoogle.com/), you may see an error regarding the use of viewport configuration. This is because Wix uses the meta tag: `<meta id="wixMobileViewport" name="viewport" content="width=320, user-scalable=yes">`, while Google considers `<meta name=viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` to be a better option. However, this can't be implemented in Wix for technical reasons. Despite this, your Wix mobile site still gets a very good score, and the error can be ignored.

question: How can I set up shipping options for my online store in the Fit by Wix app?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added Wix Stores to your site and added products to your store.

To set up shipping options for your online store in the Fit by Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/11/10/bdebceaa-3cca-42c8-b60d-6c55923bf8fa/bb911823-182e-4453-b87e-0dbbe1ab5d50.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Sales**.
4. Tap **Orders**.
5. Tap the **Settings**![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/11/10/939d55c2-5bd7-4105-a0b9-495538fd58f6/a8207526-56c8-4a84-b13e-e8a552432fb8.png)icon.
6. Select **Set shipping**.
7. Tap **\+ New Region**.
   1. Enter a region name.
   2. Tap **\+ Add Destination**.
   3. Tap the destination(s) you want to add to this shipping rule.
   4. Tap **Save**.
8. Choose what you want to do:
   
   **Set up free shipping**
   - Free shipping is the default shipping rule. Just tap **Save** to save this rule.
   
   **Set up flat rate shipping**
   - Tap **Edit** next to **Free Shipping**.
   - Tap **Change** next to **Free Shipping**.
   - Select **Flat Rate**.
   - Tap **Next**.
   - Create a delivery option (e.g. Standard Shipping, Express Shipping):
     1. Enter a title in the **Delivery Option Name** field.
     2. (Optional) Enter the estimated delivery time for this option in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
     3. Enter the shipping fee in the **Rate** field.
     4. (Optional) To offer free shipping on orders above a specific price:
        1. Tap to enable the **Offer free Shipping** toggle.
        2. Enter the price above which shipping is free and tap **Done**.
     5. Tap **Save**.
   - (Optional) Create an additional delivery option (e.g. Express Shipping) by tapping **\+Add Delivery Option** and following the instructions above.
   - (Optional) Add a handling fee:
     1. Tap **Add** next to **Handling Fee**.
     2. Enter the fee amount.
     3. Tap **Save**.
   - Tap **Save**.
   - Tap **Save** again.

   **Set up shipping rates by weight**
   - Tap **Edit** next to **Free Shipping**.
   - Tap **Change** next to **Free Shipping**.
   - Select **Rate by Weight**.
   - Tap **Next**.
   - Create a delivery option (e.g. Standard Shipping, Express Shipping):
     1. Enter a title in the **Delivery Option Name** field.
     2. (Optional) Enter the estimated delivery time for this option in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
     3. Enter the top limit of the first weight range (e.g. enter 2 lb. to create a rule for purchases from 0 - 2 lb).
     4. Enter the rate (shipping price) for the first weight range (e.g.$4).
     5. Create the second weight range: (e.g. 2 lb- 4 lb) and add the shipping rate (e.g.$8):
        - If this is your last weight range (e.g. 2 lb and up), just enter the shipping rate.
        - If you plan to add more weight ranges, tap **\+ Add Range** to enter the new range and shipping rate.
     6. (Optional) Tap **Add Range** to add another weight range and rate.
     7. (Optional) To offer free shipping on orders above a specific price:
        1. Tap to enable the **Offer free Shipping** toggle.
        2. Enter the price above which shipping is free and tap **Done**.
     8. (Optional) Repeat step 5 to create additional shipping rule(s).
     9. Tap **Save**.
   - (Optional) Create an additional delivery option (e.g. Express Shipping) by tapping **\+ Add Delivery Option** and following the instructions in step 5 above.
   - (Optional) Add a handling fee:
     1. Tap **Add** next to **Handling Fee**.
     2. Enter the fee amount.
     3. Tap **Save**.
   - Tap **Save**.
   - Tap **Save** again.

   **Set up shipping rates by price**
   - Tap **Edit** next to **Free Shipping**.
   - Tap **Change** next to **Free Shipping**.
   - Select **Rate by Order Price**.
   - Tap **Next**.
   - Create a delivery option (e.g. Standard Shipping, Express Shipping):
     1. Enter a title in the **Delivery Option Name** field.
     2. (Optional) Enter the estimated delivery time for this option in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
     3. Create the first price range: (e.g. $0 - $15) and add the shipping rate (e.g.$4).
     4. Create the second price range: (e.g. $15 - $30) and add the shipping rate (e.g.$8):
        - If this is your last price range (e.g. $15 and up), just enter the shipping rate.
        - If you plan to add more price ranges, tap **\+ Add Range** to enter the new range and shipping rate.
     5. (Optional) To offer free shipping on orders above a specific price:
        1. Tap to enable the **Offer free Shipping** toggle.
        2. Enter the price above which shipping is free and tap **Done**.
     6. (Optional) Create an additional delivery option (e.g. Express Shipping) by tapping **\+ Add Delivery Option** and following the instructions in step 5 above.
     7. (Optional) Add a handling fee:
        1. Tap **Add** next to **Handling Fee**.
        2. Enter the fee amount.
        3. Tap **Save**.
     8. Tap **Save**.
     9. Tap **Save** again.

   **Set up store pickup**
   - Scroll down and tap the **Store Pickup** toggle to enable it.
   - Enter a Pickup title.
   - Do one of the following:
     * Select the **Use my business address** toggle.
     * Enter the address where customers can pick up products.
   - (Optional) Enter when the product will be ready for pickup.
   - Enter pickup instructions for your customer.
   - Tap **Save**.
   - Tap **Save** again.

question: What is the refund policy for Ascend by Wix if I want to cancel my plan?
answer: You can cancel your Ascend plan at any time within the first 14 days to receive a full refund. No questions asked! The 14 day trial period includes the first 14 days after purchasing an Ascend plan. The 14 day trial period does not apply to renewal payments. If you decide to cancel your Ascend plan within the 14 day trial period, your plan will be canceled immediately and you will no longer be able to make use of its features. Wix is not responsible for any bank charges, commissions or overdrafts. The only way to remove these charges is through direct negotiation with your bank.

question: Why does my text shift and get cropped when I try to edit a textbox with a bulleted or numbered list?
answer:
If you try to edit a textbox that has bulleted or numbered list formatting, it causes the text to shift down and go outside the bounding box. This makes part of the text cropped and not visible while editing. 

### Workaround
1. Click **Edit Text** on the specific textbox you need to edit.
2. Remove the bullet or numbered formatting.
3. Make the necessary changes to your textbox.
4. Enable bullets or numbered formatting again.

question: How can I add and customize a table in a Wix blog post?

3. Click **Add** on the left side.
4. Click **Table**.
5. Type the number of columns and rows you want in your table.
6. Click **Create table**.
7. Add the relevant content to each section of the table.
8. Customize the look of the table and the text:

question: How can I connect a pricing plan to a Wix Group?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure you have added Wix Groups and created at least one group.

### To connect a plan to a group:
1. [Go to Groups](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Groups&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsocial-groups-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant group.
3. Scroll down to **Privacy**.
4. Select **Monetization**.
5. Click **Connect a Pricing Plan**.
6. Choose what you want to do:
   * **Connect an existing plan:** Click **Connect** next to the relevant plan.
   * **Create a new plan:** Click **Create New Plan** and set up your new plan.

### Tell me how to create a new plan
1. Enter your plan details:
   * **Plan Name:** Enter name of your plan. e.g., VIP, Gold, Silver etc.
   * **Tagline:** Add some info to encourage visitors to purchase the plan.
   * **List what is included in the plan:** Add the main features of the plan.
2. (Optional) Click **Add more** to add more fields.
3. Scroll down to **Pricing and Duration** and choose how you want to price the plan:
   * **Free Plan:** The plan is free of charge for a specific duration.
   * **One-time payment:** Visitors provide a once-off payment for a specific duration.
   * **Reoccurring payments:** Visitors pay a reoccurring fee either weekly, monthly or yearly.
4. Customize the **Advanced Settings**:
   * Click the **Single Purchase Only** toggle to allow your visitors to purchase the plan once or multiple times.
   * Click the **Allow Plan Cancellation** toggle to enable your visitors to cancel the plan at any time or not.
   * Click the **Custom Start Date** toggle:
     * **Enabled:** Visitors can choose when they want the plan to start at the checkout.
     * **Disabled:** The plan starts from the time the visitor completes the purchase.
   * (Optional) Click **Add** next to **Plan Policies** to add any specific policy requirements to the plan and add your requirements in the text box and click **Save**.
5. Click **Create**.
6. Click **Done**.
7. Click **Save**.

### Note
If you connect an existing plan that already has subscribers, those subscribers will automatically be added to the group.

question: Does Wix support an automatic privacy policy generator?
answer: Currently, Wix does not have an automatic privacy policy generator. However, users in Germany can enable a 3rd party app, [Legal Texts by Trusted Shops](https://www.wix.com/app-market/legal-texts-by-trusted-shops), to help them generate a privacy policy. This app is available from the [Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market/?referral=menu_navigation). For more information on creating a privacy policy, you can check out Wix's recommendations [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-privacy-policy).

question: Can I design individual items in a slideshow repeater in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to adjust the design and layout of individual items in a slideshow repeater. Any changes you make are automatically applied to all items. As an alternative, you can [add a flexbox to the page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-setting-up-flexboxes) and [select the slides layout](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-managing-and-customizing-flexboxes) to customize each item. Note that transition effects or auto scroll are not available on slide flexboxes.

question: Can I add modifiers to my menu using the Wix Restaurant Menu (New) app?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add modifiers to your menu when only using the Wix Restaurants Menus (New) app. You can add modifiers to your menu using the [Wix Restaurants Orders (New) app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-adding-and-setting-up-wix-restaurants-orders-new).

question: How can I preview the checkout process for my Wix Store without making it available to customers?
answer:
To preview the checkout process for your Wix Store without making it available to customers, follow these steps:

1. **Prepare your site to preview the checkout process:**
   
   1. Enable the [manual payment method](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-manual-offline-payments) so you won't be charged.
   2. If your site has a Premium plan or Studio plan, do one of the following:
      
      * Temporarily [unassign the plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/unassigning-a-premium-plan-from-a-site) from your site.
      * [Duplicate your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/duplicating-your-site-1472847) and test the checkout on the duplicated version.
   3. If your site doesn't have a Members Area, [add it now](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-add-and-set-up-a-members-area).

2. (If not already logged in) Log in to your Wix account.
3. Open your live site.
4. Log in to your site using the [Members Area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-about-the-members-area).
5. Navigate to a Shop page.
6. Add a product to your cart and click **Checkout**.
7. Click **I just want to place a test order**.
8. Complete the store checkout process.

**Note:** Only the site owner can preview the checkout process, not site Admins or people with other [roles & permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-overview). It's not currently possible to preview the checkout process for Wix Bookings services.

question: How can I design and print a menu using the original Wix Restaurants Menus App?

question: How can I migrate my Shopify store to Wix Stores using the Cart2Cart app?
answer:
Prerequisites:

- Make sure to add Wix Stores to your site.
- Upgrade to a Premium or Studio plan to migrate store orders.

To migrate your Shopify store to Wix Stores using the Cart2Cart app, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add the Cart2Cart App and Select a Wix Account
1. Go to the Wix App Market and add the Cart2Cart app.
2. Select an option:
   - **Wix Editor:** Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the Editor.
   - **Editor X:** Click the **Apps** icon on the top of the Editor.
3. Start typing Cart2Cart and select the app.
4. Click **+Add**.
5. Click **Allow and Install**.
6. Select an option:
   - Sign in to your existing Cart2Cart account.
   - Create a new Cart2Cart account:
     1. Click **Sign Up**.
     2. Fill in the required fields.
     3. Click **Sign Up**.
7. In the Cart2Cart dashboard, make sure the email associated with the relevant Wix account is selected.
8. Click **Source and Target Cart Setup**.

### Step 2 | Source and Target Cart Setup
1. Select **Shopify** from the **Source Cart** drop-down.
2. Enter your store's URL (e.g. http://your-store-name.com).
3. Get your Shopify API password:
   1. Log in to Shopify.
   2. Click the **Apps** tab on the left.
   3. Click **Manage private apps**.
   4. Click **Create a New Private App**.
   5. Enter **Cart2Cart** in the **Private app name** field.
   6. Enter the email of a developer or the person most suited to deal with technical issues in the **Emergency developer email** field.
   7. Set your permissions to **Read Access**.
   8. Scroll down and click **Save**.
   9. Copy your API password and return to Cart2Cart.
4. Paste the API credentials in the **API Password** field.
5. Select Wix from the **Target Cart** drop-down.
6. Click **Choose Entities**.

### Step 3 | Select What to Migrate and Perform a Demo Migration
1. Select which types of data (e.g. products, orders, and coupons) you want to migrate to Wix.
   - **Note:** Imports are limited to 1,000 products and 1,000 orders.
2. (Optional) Select any of the additional options you see displayed:
   - Select the **Clear current data on Target Store before Migration** to delete data in your Wix store for the entities you are migrating.
   - Select the **Skip product thumbnail images migration** checkbox.
   - Select the **Change products quantity to 100 on Target Store ($29)**.
   - Perform data mapping for orders.
3. Click **Start Free Demo**.

### Step 4 | Check Demo Migration Results and Complete the Migration
1. Click **Check the Results** to view your data in your Wix dashboard.
2. When satisfied, select an insurance plan or click the Skip Migration Insurance option.
3. Review the migration price.
4. Pay and complete the migration:
   1. Click **Add Funds for Full Migration**.
   2. Enter the required details.
   3. Click **Buy now**.

When the migration is complete, you'll receive an email notification.

question: Does Wix Video support 4K video uploads?

question: What happens to recipients in Wix Email Marketing if their emails are likely to be marked as spam or bounce?
answer:
After you click to [send your email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-email-campaign), Wix Email Marketing reviews your list of recipients. Your recipients are automatically removed if emails to them are likely to get marked as spam or bounce. Once these contacts are removed from your recipients list, your email campaign is sent to the remaining recipients. This automatic removal of recipients is to protect your [sender reputation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-your-email-sender-reputation) and prevent campaigns from getting marked as spam. The following recipients are removed from sending:

* Contacts who have unsubscribed
* Contacts without email addresses
* Contacts with duplicate email addresses
* Contacts you've sent emails to that have bounced (undeliverable email addresses)
* Contacts with typos in their email addresses (including extra spaces)

question: What should I do if I receive an email from Apple saying 'Your Certificate Has Been Revoked'?
answer: You can disregard the email titled 'Your Certificate Has Been Revoked'. As part of the app submission process, Wix generates 'certificates' necessary to upload your app to the App Store. When new certificates are generated, older ones are deleted, which may trigger this email. Wix takes care of the necessary actions, so no action is required from you.

question: How can I make an element or section sticky in the Wix Studio Editor?

question: How can I check if a domain name is available using Wix?
answer:
To check if the domain you want is available:

question: How can I edit my site's robots.txt file using Wix?
answer:
To edit your site's robots.txt file using Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your SEO Dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO).
2. Select **Go to Robots.txt Editor** under **Tools and settings**.
3. Click **View File**.
4. Add your robots.txt file info by writing the directives under **This is your current file**.
5. Click **Save Changes**.
6. Click **Save**.

**Tip:** Search engines will update their cached version of your robots.txt file the next time that they crawl your site. If you need to update it faster, you can try [submitting your homepage's URL to search engines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines#submitting-individual-urls-to-search-engines).

question: How can I set up a 301 redirect from one domain to another using Wix?
answer:
To set up a 301 redirect from one domain to another using Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Set up 301 redirects for the relevant pages on your new site.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site) 
   **Note:** If you have already set up redirects for your site's pages, skip this step.
2. [Connect your secondary external domain to Wix.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-elsewhere)
3. [Connect the secondary domain to the primary domain connected to your Wix site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-multiple-domains-to-one-wix-site).

**Important:** To use this feature, you need to [upgrade](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-your-site-to-premium-3066683) your site and [connect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-elsewhere) a domain. It is not possible to set up a 301 redirect from a free Wix URL to a premium site.

question: How can I add a video from YouTube to my Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:

question: What should I do if I encounter printing and shipping issues with my Wix Photo Albums Store?

question: Can I upload an existing logo to Wix to get branded assets and a branded site?

question: How can I add animation to an element in the Wix Editor?

question: How can I sell physical gift cards using Wix Retail POS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have ordered and received physical gift cards.
- Enable gift cards in your Wix dashboard.

### To sell gift cards:
1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Checkout** from the menu bar at the bottom.
3. Tap **Gift Cards**.
4. Tap **Issue gift card**.
5. Select the actual gift card (i.e. the plastic card) that you want to sell to your customer.
6. Select an option:
   * Scan the card's code.
   * Manually enter the card's code. 
   **Tip:** Gift card codes are not case sensitive.
7. Enter the value of the gift card (up to $1000).
8. Tap **Add to Cart**.
9. Complete checkout as you would for any product.

question: How can I schedule a recurring class session in Wix Bookings?
answer:
To schedule a recurring class session in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Business%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the time slot in which the class meets for the first time.
3. Select **Class Session**.
4. Add the class session details:
   
   * **Class:** Select the service you want to schedule.
   * **Location:** (If you have more than 1) Select the location of the class.
   * **Staff:** Select the staff member giving the class.
   * **Start Time:** Edit the date and start time of the class.
   * **Duration:** Select the duration of the class.
   * **Repeat:** Click to select the relevant option from the **Repeat** drop-down:
     
     + **Repeats:** Choose this option to offer this class session multiple times:
       
       1. Select the relevant option from the drop-down: **Weekly**, **Every 2**, **3** or **4 weeks**.
       2. Select the day(s) of the week the class takes place.
       3. (Optional) Click **Set an end date** and choose the date of the last class.
5. Choose a saving option:
   
   * **Save & Add New:** Save the session and start scheduling another one.
   * **Save:** Save the session and return to your calendar.

question: How can I customize the registration form for a ticketed event in Wix Events?
answer:
To customize the registration form for a ticketed event in Wix Events, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant event.
3. Click the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Edit** next to **Registration Form**.
5. Choose whether to collect info per order or per ticket:
   - **Fill out 1 registration form per order:** Guest fills out the registration form once, even if buying multiple tickets.
   - **Fill out a registration form for each ticket in an order:** Guest fills out a separate registration form for each ticket.
6. Edit the form text:
   1. Hover over any text fields and click the **Edit** icon.
   2. Edit the text and click the checkmark to save.
7. Add additional preset fields to the form:
   1. Click **Add More Options**.
   2. Select the field you want to add.
   3. Edit the option using the available customizations.
   4. (Optional) Select the **Make this info required** checkbox.
8. Add a custom question to the form:
   1. Click **Custom Question**.
   2. Enter a title under **Custom Question Text** (e.g. Joining the jam?).
   3. Select the type of response (e.g. multiple choice).
   4. If you selected **Dropdown Menu**, **Multiple Choice**, or **Checkboxes**, enter all the options your guests can choose from. Press **Enter** on your keyboard after every choice.
   5. Click the checkmark to save.
9. (Optional) Edit the "Continue" button text:
   1. Hover over **Continue** and click the **Edit** icon.
   2. Edit the button text and click the **checkmark** to save.
10. Click **Save** at the top right.

question: Can I change the title of a blog post on my mobile site to be different from the desktop site?
answer:
Currently, you cannot change the title of a blog post on your mobile site to say something different to the title on your desktop site. Blog post titles are the same for your desktop and mobile sites.

### Tip
You can [write new posts and make changes to existing posts from your mobile](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-managing-your-blog-on-a-mobile-device).

question: How can I use the POS Checkout solution to accept payments for custom charges?
answer:
To use the POS Checkout solution to accept payments for custom charges, follow these steps:

1. Add the custom charge to the cart. This could be for consultations, therapy sessions, lessons, or any other service you provide.
2. Accept payment for the custom charge. You can accept cash payments, which are available for all merchants in any location.
3. If you want to accept credit/debit card payments using a card reader, note that this option is available only through [Wix Payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-an-overview) and is available for merchants in the US & Canada.
4. Alternatively, you can accept payment by manually entering credit card details if you are using a [payment provider that supports this option](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-by-manual-card-entry#payment-providers-that-support-manual-card-entry).

This makes it easy to accept payment for custom charges using the POS Checkout solution.

question: How can I update my payment method in Wix if my renewal payment was declined?
answer:
If your renewal payment was declined, you can update your payment method to a credit or debit card. Follow these steps to update your payment method:

1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Update Payment Method** under the relevant subscription.
3. Update your payment card details.
4. Click **Submit**.

**Note**: Once you have updated your payment details, our system attempts to process the payment again.

**Tips**:
* You can also update your payment method in the [Payment Methods](https://www.wix.com/account/payment-methods) page in your Wix account.
* If you are updating your Wix account payment method, you can update it to a debit / credit card, or PayPal if that option is available in your region.

question: How can I offer real-time shipping rates on my Wix site using third-party apps?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed the initial setup of your Wix site.

To offer real-time shipping rates on your Wix site using third-party apps, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add an app that offers real-time rates

#### Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
3. Search for the shipping app you want to integrate.
4. Click **Add to Site**.

#### Studio Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **App Market** on the left side of the editor.
3. Search for the shipping app you want to integrate.
4. Click **Add to Site**.

#### Dashboard:
1. [Go to the Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market) in your site's dashboard.
2. Search for the shipping app you want to integrate.
3. Click **Add to Site**.

### Step 2 | Set up shipping rules in the shipping app
1. [Go to Manage Apps](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Apps&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/manage-installed-apps/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Open** next to the relevant app.

Refer to the help information from the app you're using to learn how to set up shipping rules:
- [Shippo help center](https://support.goshippo.com/hc/en-us)
- [ShipStation help center](https://help.shipstation.com/hc/en-us)
- [Envia help center](https://help.envia.com/)

### Step 3 | Enable the rule in relevant shipping regions
1. [Go to Shipping & fulfillment settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Shipping&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select a shipping region.
3. Scroll down past any shipping, delivery, or pickup options you created.
4. Enable the toggle next to the shipping app.
5. If your app has a **Rate at checkout** field, enter a rate.
6. Repeat steps 2-5 for any additional regions.

### Step 4 | Fulfill orders
When you receive a [new order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-fulfilling-store-orders), you see which shipping option your customer chose. You can use this method to fulfill your order, but you don't have to. You're free to fulfill the order using any shipping method you choose.

question: Can I add the same contact to multiple steps in a workflow?
answer:
Currently, you can only add a contact to a single step in a workflow. Since each contact is linked to a card, you can move them to another step by moving the card. However, you cannot create a new card under a different step for the same contact.

### Exception
It is possible to have the same contact in two workflow columns if one of these columns is the "final step" (e.g. "Paid & Completed") or archive column (these columns indicate that the contact has moved through the workflow and appear to the right of a dividing line).

question: Does Wix support setting a page to refresh automatically?
answer:
Currently, Wix does not have an automatic refresh page feature.

## In the meantime, you can use the following workaround to refresh your page:
1. [Add the HTML code element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-embedding-a-site-or-a-widget) in your Editor.
2. Enter the code: 
   ```html
   <script> var timer = null;
   ```
3. Save and publish your site. 
   **Note:** Be aware that the script also asks if you want to refresh your Editor. Make sure you save before you refresh the Editor.

### Important
This workaround only works if you have upgraded your site with a Premium Plan.

You can also set certain elements, such as [videos](https://support.wix.com/en/article/single-video-player-adding-and-setting-up-the-single-video-player) and [audio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-audio-to-your-site) to loop without your site being refreshed.
