question: How can I create a recurring event in Wix Events using the dashboard?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your Wix site's dashboard and have the necessary permissions to manage events.

### To create an event draft:
1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Add Event**.
3. Select the **Event type**:
   * **Ticketed event:** Sell event tickets or offer free tickets.
   * **RSVP event:** Collect RSVPs or set a guest waitlist.
4. Fill out the **General info** section:
   1. Enter the event name, a short teaser, and up to 10 event categories.
   2. Click the **Event image** and choose an image from your media manager.
5. Select **Recurring event** in the **Date and time** section, then set up the following:
   1. (Optional) Edit the default date and time:
      1. Click the **Edit** icon next to the first date.
      2. Edit the start date, end date, and time.
      3. Click the **Timezone** drop-down and select a time zone.
      4. (Optional) Click the **Display timezone** checkbox.
      5. Click **Done**.
6. Add repeating dates in bulk:
   1. Click the **Add Dates** drop-down and select **Repeating dates**.
   2. Choose the relevant date sequence:
      1. Set the **Event duration** by entering the start date, end date, and time.
      2. Set the **Event recurrence** by selecting the frequency and timeframe.
      3. Set the **Event ending** by selecting the last date/day of the event recurrence.
      4. Click **Add**.
7. Add a specific date if needed:
   1. Click the **Add Dates** drop-down and select **Specific dates**.
   2. Enter the start date, end date, and time.
   3. (Optional) Click **+Add more dates** to add more.
   4. Click **Done**.
8. Select the location of your event in the **Location** section:
   * If the location hasn't been set, click **Location is TBD**.
   * If the event has a physical location, click **Physical Location** and enter the address.
   * If the event takes place online, click **Online** and enter an **Online Location Title**.
9. (Optional) Add detailed event information about your event.
10. When ready, click **Create Draft** at the top right.

question: How does Wix's Smart Algorithm optimize Facebook ad campaigns?
answer:
Wix's Smart Algorithm optimizes Facebook ad campaigns by using advanced data science algorithms and a lot of data. Here's how it works:

- **Audiences**: The decision-making engine creates more variations of Lookalikes, engagement, and remarketing audiences. It measures their potential reach and performance using data from the business’ Facebook Page, pixel, and campaign stats.

- **Targeting**: It takes users’ predefined targeting and breaks it down into age, gender, locations, interests, and placements in Facebook and Instagram. It measures the effectiveness of each and decides when to broaden the audience, break it down, or take no action. The best audiences with the highest potential for conversion are chosen, while low-quality audiences are paused.

- **Ad Sets**: The algorithm pauses ad sets with negative trends, low quality, low conversion rate, or low engagement rank. It resumes ad sets with new potential signals based on new engaging insights from the campaign or pixel.

The algorithm runs daily analyses of every change in campaign performance from Facebook and Instagram, combined with data from your website. It uses this data to run unique decision-making models and trend analyses, simulating and estimating the effectiveness of each action to fine-tune the campaign.

question: How can I create a class using the Wix app?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed any necessary setup on your Wix site before proceeding.

### To create a class in the Wix app:
1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.

   **Tip:** Alternatively, you can tap **Add** at the bottom, then select **Service** and tap **Class**. Then skip ahead to the Step 2 section steps below.
3. Tap **Booking Services**, or tap **Catalog** and select **Booking Services**.
4. Tap **\+ Create New Service** at the bottom.
5. Tap **Class**.

### To fill out your service details:
1. Add your service details:
   * **Name:** Enter a name for the class.
   * **Category:** Select a category from the drop-down menu (if you created categories).
   * **Tagline (optional):** Enter a tagline that will appear below the service name on your app.
   * **Description (optional):** Enter a description that will appear on the service page of your app.
   * **Max participants:** Set the maximum number of participants that can book your service.
2. Tap **Continue**.

### To set your price and payment details per session:
1. Tap the **Price type** drop-down and select how you want to charge your client per session:
   * **Fixed price:** You charge a set price for the class.
     1. Tap **Amount** and enter the price.
     2. Choose how clients pay from the **Payment preferences** drop-down:
        + **Entire amount online:** Only accept online payments for the class.
        + **Entire amount in person:** Only accept in-person payments (before or after the class).
        + **Entire amount either online or in person:** Allow clients to choose whether they pay online or in person.
        + **Online deposit and the rest in person:** Accept an online deposit for the class and have clients pay the rest in person. Add the deposit amount that clients need to pay online.
   * **Free:** Offer the service free of charge. No price will be displayed for this service.
   * **Varied Prices:** Go to your Wix account on desktop to [add varied prices to your class](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-an-appointment#step-3-set-your-pricing-payment-details). You can charge different rates for classes depending on the staff member, client type, service type, and more.
   * **Custom price:** Enter a short description of your pricing (up to 20 characters). The description appears on your site.

   **Note:** This means clients can't pay you online.
2. Tap **Create Service**.

question: How do I connect Razorpay as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Razorpay as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Accept Payments tab](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-the-accept-payments-tab) on your dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to **Razorpay**.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Razorpay account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Key Id, Key Secret, and Site URL.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create Razorpay account**](https://dashboard.razorpay.com/#/access/signup/?utm_source=wix-dashboard&utm_campaign=connect-account).
   2. Fill in the Razorpay's registration form.
   3. Once your Razorpay account is approved, sign in to your account and retrieve your account credentials (Key Id and Key Secret).
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-the-accept-payments-tab) (repeat steps 1-3) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

question: Is there a 'Back' button feature available on the Wix Stores Product Page?
answer: Currently, the Wix Stores Product Page does not have a Back button, which would lead your customers back to your main store page or the previous page they were on. However, you can add a back button using the [Back Button: Go Previous Page app](https://www.wix.com/app-market/back-button-go-previous-page?referral=search-result&appIndex=0&referralTag=Back%20Button:%20Go%20Previous%20Page&referralSectionName=search-result).

question: What features are available for free when using Wix Video, and how can I manage my video storage limits?
answer:
### Free Wix Video Features
- **Customize the layout and design of your video player.**
- **Organize your videos into channels.**
- **Upload videos to and from social platforms like YouTube, Facebook, and Vimeo.**
- **Stream up to 10-minute long live stream videos.**

### Managing Video Storage Limits
- **Uploads:** You cannot upload a video that exceeds your video limit.
- **Live Stream:** If your live stream exceeds your storage limit, it is saved in your Video Library.

To increase your video limit, you can [upgrade your site](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website?referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter). Learn more about [managing your site's storage](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-managing-your-storage).

**Note:** Your video storage limit is per site. To increase the limit on more than one site, you'll need to upgrade each site individually.

question: How can I save form fields to my contact list using old Wix Forms?
answer:
To save form fields to your contact list using old Wix Forms, you can either match all form fields at once or save individual form fields. Here are the steps for both methods:

### Match all form fields
1. Click the form in your editor.
2. Click **Form Settings**.
3. Click the **Contacts** tab.
4. Click **Choose Fields.**
5. Click the drop-down next to each form field and select the relevant contact field. 

   **Note:** For form fields you don't need to save, select **Don't Save**. For form fields that don't have an existing match, select **Create field** and type in a name for a new custom field.
6. Click **Save**.

### Match individual form fields
1. Click the field in your form you want to save to your contacts.
2. Click the **Settings** icon.
3. Click the drop-down under **Save Field Data to Contacts.**
4. Select a field to connect this form field to. 

   **Note:** For form fields you don't need to save, select **Don't Save**. For form fields that don't have an existing match, select **Create field** and type in a name for a new custom field.

question: Can I make the Previous/Next navigation buttons loop on dynamic item pages without using Velo code?
answer:
Currently, Previous/Next navigational buttons on dynamic item pages do not loop. When a visitor gets to the last item page returned by the dataset, the Next button is inactive. Similarly, when a visitor is on the first item page, the Previous button is inactive. It is not possible, without using Velo code, to have these buttons continue to navigate visitors through all the items.

**Workaround:**

Using Velo, you can create Previous/Next buttons that loop to continuously navigate through your dynamic pages. Here are the steps to implement this:

1. [Go to your Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the dynamic item page that has Previous/Next buttons.
3. Make sure your Previous/Next buttons' click actions are not connected to the dataset:
   
   1. Click your Previous button and click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
   2. Click the **Click action connects to** drop-down and select **Not connected**.
   3. Repeat steps 3a-3b with your Next button.
4. Enable Velo Dev Mode:
   
   1. Click **Dev Mode** at the top of the Editor.
   2. Click **Turn on Dev Mode**.
5. Copy the code snippet below and paste it at the top of your page code:

```javascript
import wixLocationFrontend from 'wix-location-frontend';
```

6. Copy the code snippet below and paste it after: **$w.onReady(function () {**

```javascript
$w('#prevBtn').onClick(async () => {
 const previousPage = await $w('#dynamicDataset').getPreviousDynamicPage();
 if (previousPage) { wixLocationFrontend.to(previousPage) }
 else { wixLocationFrontend.to('/last-page-url') }
 })
 $w('#nextBtn').onClick(async () => {
 const nextPage = await $w('#dynamicDataset').getNextDynamicPage();
 if (nextPage) { wixLocationFrontend.to(nextPage) }
 else { wixLocationFrontend.to('/first-page-url') }
 })
```

7. In the sample code you pasted, replace the IDs and URLs listed below with those used by your site:
   
   * **prevBtn** Replace with the ID of your Previous button.
   * **nextBtn** Replace with the ID of your Next button.
   * **dynamic Dataset** Replace with the ID of your dynamic page dataset.
   * **/last-page-url** Replace with the URL slug of the last dynamic item page read by the dataset.
   * **/first-page-url** Replace with the URL slug of the first dynamic item page read by the dataset.

**Tips:**

* Click the relevant button or dataset to find its ID in the [Properties and Events panel](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/workspace-tools/velo-workspace/properties-events-panel/working-with-the-properties-events-panel). Do not remove the hashtags (**#**) or apostrophes (**'**) in the code.
* To get the correct first and last dynamic item page URLs, create a [custom collection view](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-custom-collection-views) with the same sorting and filtering as in the dataset settings. You can copy the URL slug from the **[Collection] (Item)** page link field in your collection.

question: How can I connect my Gmail account to Wix Inbox using the Wix app?
answer:
To connect your Gmail account to Wix Inbox using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Inbox** at the bottom.
3. Tap the **More Actions** icon.
4. Tap **Settings**.
5. Tap **Sender email address**.
6. Tap **Use Gmail Address**.
7. Select the Gmail account you want to connect.
8. Tap **Connect Gmail**.
9. Tap **Allow** to grant Wix access to your Gmail account.
10. Tap **Back to Wix App**.

question: How can I choose a text theme for my Wix site?
answer:
To choose a text theme for your site:

2. Click **Text theme**.
3. Select the **Heading Font** you want to apply to all your headings.

question: How can I use Wix Shipping to print shipping labels for my store orders?
answer:
To use Wix Shipping to print shipping labels for your store orders, follow these steps:

1. **Ensure your business address is entered:** Before you begin, make sure you [enter your business's address in the Business Info page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information).

2. **Use Wix Shipping:** Wix Shipping is an integrated shipping label solution that allows you to purchase and print labels directly from your Wix dashboard. It is available for merchants in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the UK, and the US.

3. **Learn more about Wix Shipping:** For detailed instructions on using Wix Shipping, you can visit the [Wix Shipping support page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-printing-shipping-labels-with-wix-shipping).

By following these steps, you can efficiently manage your shipping labels using Wix Shipping.

question: Can I add music to my Wix blog posts using Wix Music?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add music to blog posts using Wix Music. However, it is possible to add music by [embedding a music track](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-html-code-to-a-blog-post) (such as a SoundCloud track) using HTML code.

question: Can I manage my Wix Payments account from the Wix app on my mobile device?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to manage your Wix Payments account from the Wix app on your mobile device. Head over to the [Wix Payments dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-wix-payments-dashboard) on desktop for any action or info you need.

question: Is the table layout supported for viewing or editing the Portfolio Wix app collection in the CMS?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to view or edit the Portfolio Wix app collection in your CMS using the table layout. However, you can use the list or gallery layout in your CMS to edit the Portfolio Wix app collections.

### To view or edit the Portfolio Wix app collection:
1. Enable the **Wix App Collections** toggle in your [CMS Advanced Settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections).
2. Go to **CMS** in your Editor.
3. Click **Wix App Collections**.
4. Scroll down and click the relevant portfolio collection.
5. View or edit the collection using the list or gallery layout in the CMS.

question: How can I add product options to my products using the Wix app?
answer:
To add product options using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Store Products**, or tap **Catalog** and select **Store Products**.
4. Tap to select the relevant product.
5. Scroll down and tap **\+ Add Options**.

### Create a new product option
1. Tap **\+ Add Option** at the top.
2. Enter an **Option name** (e.g. size).
3. Tap **Next**.
4. Select a product option display type:
   * Tap **Colors** for color options.
   * Tap **List** for all other options.
5. Enter the first **Choice name** (e.g. Small) and tap the **Plus** icon.
6. Enter additional option choices (e.g. Large) and tap the **Plus** icon after each entry.
7. Tap **Save**.

### Select a product option you created for another product
1. Tap **Select** next to the product option you want to apply.
2. Do any of the following to add product option choices:
   * Tap **Add All** at the bottom left to add all the existing product option choices.
   * Tap a product option choice to add it.
   * Create a new product option choice:
     1. Enter the option choice name (e.g. X-Large) in the **Choice Name** field.
     2. Tap **Save**.

question: How can I access priority support as a Wix Partner?
answer:

question: How can I request a new feature in Wix Studio?
answer:
To request a feature in Wix Studio, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Discover](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/discover) in your Wix Studio workspace.
2. Click the **News Center** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/02/14/eb1d37bd-73ed-4dad-bab6-7973169453e3/94aeb2c3-5013-4e5e-abaf-96c98dd7b9f0.png) at the top right and select **Wix Product Roadmap**.

You can also head over to our [Wix Studio Community Discord](https://discord.com/invite/wixstudio) to share your vision for the future of Wix Studio and engage with others.

question: Can I integrate Velo's Secrets Manager in my Wix Blocks applications?
answer: Currently in Blocks, you cannot integrate Velo's Secrets Manager in your applications. This serverless Secrets Manager feature would allow you to create, store, and manage secrets such as API keys. The value of each secret would be safely stored and encrypted in the Secrets Manager. Only app collaborators would be able to access it, and the name for each secret can be used in the app's code.

answer: Currently, it is not possible in [business phone number](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-getting-started-9797633) to block incoming calls. However, you can choose to block phone numbers and unwanted messages from your conversation list in your Inbox. question: How can I turn off email and SMS notifications for table reservations in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
To turn notifications on or off in the Wix Table Reservations app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Outgoing notifications**.
3. Hover over a **Wix Table Reservations** notification and click **View Summary**.
4. Choose what you want to do:
   
   * **Turn both Email and SMS notifications on/off:** Click the toggle at the top to turn both email and SMS notifications on or off for this notification.
   * **Choose the channel for notification:** Hover over the channel you want to disable and click **Edit Action**. Click **Delete Action** to remove it, then click **Delete** again to confirm. Click **Save** to apply your changes.

**Note:** Your monthly SMS message limit is determined by your SMS quota, which varies based on your site's plan. To view your quota, go to [SMS Settings](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/wix-sms?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+SMS+Settings) in your site's dashboard.

question: What should I do if I encounter an error message saying 'Audio File could not be uploaded due to unsupported sample rate' when uploading an audio file to Wix?
answer: If you encounter the error message 'Audio File could not be uploaded due to unsupported sample rate,' you should check that your sample rate is 44,100, 48,000, 96,000, 88,200 or 192,000 hz. Re-encode or convert the file with [supported sample rate](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-supported-media-file-types-and-file-sizes).

question: How can I add an autocomplete address field to my Wix form?
answer:
To add an autocomplete address field to your Wix form, follow these steps:

1. Click your form in the editor.
2. Click **Add New Field**.
3. Click **Autocomplete Address** in **Contact Fields**.
4. Click the autocomplete address field in the form and click **Edit Field**.
5. Customize the autocomplete address field by updating the settings:
   
   * Click the **Field Title** textbox and enter the field name. 
   
   **Tip:** Learn more about [adding field titles to your form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-field-titles-to-your-form).
   * Under **Show initial text** choose to add a 'hint' or placeholder text inside the field to help visitors know what to write:
     
     + **None:** No text appears inside the field.
     + **Placeholder text:** Text appears inside the field before visitors enter their info.
   * Click the **Required** **field** checkbox to make the autocomplete address field mandatory.
   * Choose to limit the autocomplete address search results to a specific country under Search Preferences.
     
     + **None:** The autocomplete address field does not limit its search to a specific country.
     + **Filter by country:** The autocomplete address field only searches addresses in a country that you choose. Click the **Choose a country** drop-down to select a country for the autocomplete address to use in its search.

**Note:** This feature is only available in [old Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-the-difference-between-the-new-and-old-wix-forms).

question: Is there a feature in the Studio Editor that analyzes a site and highlights areas that require adjustment for accessibility?
answer: Currently, we do not offer a feature that analyzes a site and highlights areas that require adjustment in order to make it accessible. However, you can apply certain settings that may help make your client's site more accessible, like adding alt text and [arranging your elements in the layers panel](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-working-with-layers#reordering-layers).

question: Is it possible to export and save email campaigns to a PDF file format directly from the site's dashboard?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to export and save email campaigns to a PDF file format directly from your site's dashboard. As a workaround, you can view your campaign and print to PDF.

## To manually save an email campaign as a PDF:
1. Go to [Email Marketing Campaigns](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Email%20Campaigns&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/shoutout/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the campaign you want to save as a PDF, and click the More Actions icon.
3. Click **View**.
4. Right click on the email campaign, and select **Print**.
5. In Destination drop-down, click **Save as PDF**.
6. Click **Save**.

### Note
The printing options available depend on the device you use to view your email campaign.

question: What should I do if I receive the error message 'You already have a Google Workspace business email account. You can manage it from the Google Admin Console' when trying to purchase a business email?
answer:
If you receive the error message "You already have a Google Workspace business email account. You can manage it from the Google Admin Console," it means the business email you are trying to purchase already exists. You can manage your Google Workspace account through your [Google Admin console](https://admin.google.com/).

If you did not purchase this business email, or can’t recover access to it, you need to contact [Google Workspace](https://support.google.com/a#topic=4388346) directly to be able to use the email account.

If your domain is already registered on Google's end, you should see a message that the domain is already taken. Workspace provides a form in order to verify that you are the current owner of this domain. Once verified, and if you have successfully purchased a business email, you can connect it to your domain by following the steps in [Adding Google Workspace MX Records in Your Wix Account](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-adding-google-workspace-mx-records-in-your-wix-account).

question: Can I add additional payment options for Wix Music?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add additional payment options for Wix Music. To learn more about how to set up payments from the options available, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-music-setting-up-your-payment-methods).

question: How can I connect my existing .il domain to my Wix site?
answer:
To connect your existing .il domain to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. **Upgrade your site with a plan**: Ensure that your Wix site is upgraded with a plan. You can do this by visiting [Wix Upgrade](http://www.wix.com/upgrade/website).

2. **Access your current domain registrar**: You will need access to your current domain registrar to make changes to your DNS settings.

3. **Connect via Nameservers**: We recommend connecting your domain to Wix via Nameservers. This method allows Wix to host your DNS records, enabling you to manage them directly in your Wix account. This is beneficial as Wix Customer Care can assist you with DNS management if needed.

4. **Propagation time**: Be aware that new DNS records may take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

For detailed instructions, you can learn more about [connecting a domain to the Wix nameservers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

Please note that it is currently not possible to purchase or transfer a .il domain to Wix. If you would like this feature in the future, you can [vote for this feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-purchasing-or-transferring-an-israeli-il-domain-with-wix).

question: Can I freeze the footer on my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, you cannot freeze your footer on your mobile site.

question: How do I connect Pagsmile as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Pagsmile as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Pagsmile.
4. Depending on whether you have an account with Pagsmile or need to create a new one, follow the steps:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your app id and security key.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create Pagsmile account**](http://www.pagsmile.com/).
   2. Register for a Pagsmile merchant account.
   3. Once your merchant account is approved, you will be provided with your unique app id and security key credentials.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under Have an account to connect your account.

Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Pagsmile account to avoid transaction declines. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: How can I view and manage my site's media storage usage on Wix?
answer:
To view and manage your site's media storage usage on Wix, follow these steps:

### Viewing Your Site's Media Storage: Dashboard
1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Storage**.

### Viewing Your Site's Media Storage: Media Manager
1. [Go to your Media Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-accessing-the-media-manager).
2. View the total storage your site has used at the bottom left.
3. Hover over the **Info** icon to view how much storage space your site has left.

### Managing Your Site's Media Storage
1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Storage**.
3. Click the **More Actions** icon on the relevant file(s).
4. Choose how you want to manage your files:
   * **Preview:** View a larger version of the file.
   * **Download:** Save the file to your device.
   * **Move to Trash:** Move the selected file(s) to the Trash tab, where they can be recovered later if needed.
   * **Permanently Delete:** Delete the selected file(s) completely.

### Tips
* Select multiple media files to perform these actions in bulk.
* You can also access the storage manager from the media manager by clicking **Manage Storage**.

question: How can I create a custom image for social media using the Wix app?

2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.

question: How can I invite new members to my site using the Fit by Wix app?
answer:
To invite new members to your site on the Fit by Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Mobile App**.
4. Tap the **Share** icon.
5. Choose one of the following methods to send your invite:

### Email Wix Contacts
- Email the contacts saved in your Wix account. **Note:** To use this feature, you need to [upgrade your site with a plan](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website?referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter).

### Send an SMS
- Send the link and invitation code to people by SMS (text message).
  1. Tap **Send an SMS**.
  2. Choose if you want to allow the Wix app to access your contacts.
  3. Select the contacts you want to invite.
  4. Tap **Next**.
  5. Tap **Send** in the message field on your phone.

### Share via Social & More
- Share the link and invitation code to any social network connected to your phone.
  1. Tap **More**.
  2. Choose how you want to send your invite to. For example, Facebook, WhatsApp, Gmail, and more.
  3. Tap **Send**.

### Copy Link
- Copy the link and paste it into a new message in any application.
  1. Tap **Copy link**.
  2. Paste the link into a new message using the application of your choice.

question: How can I add and customize a search box for events on my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor or Editor X.

To add and customize a search box for events on your Wix site, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add a search box to your site
1. Go to the Wix App Market:
   * **Editor:** Click the Add Apps icon on the left side of the Editor.
   * **Editor X**: Click the App Market icon on the top bar of Editor X.
2. Enter **Wix Site Search** in the search bar.
3. Select the **Wix Site Search** app.
4. Click **Add to Site**.

### Step 2 | Customize the search box field
1. Click the search box in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Enter placeholder text suitable for event searches (e.g., Search for an event).
4. Click the Layout icon and Design icon to customize the look of the search box.

### Step 3 | Customize the search results page
1. Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Select **Site Menu**.
3. Click the page named **Search Results**.
4. Click the Search Results page in the Editor.
5. Customize search results so it displays only events:
   1. Click **Settings**.
   2. Click the **Settings** tab.
   3. Click the toggle next to other types of search results to disable them.
6. (Optional) Edit the Events label that appears in the results menu:
   1. In the **Settings** tab, click the Edit icon next to **Events**.
   2. Edit the Events tab label.
7. Increase the number of results per page (Recommended for sites with many events):
   1. Click the **Layout** tab.
   2. Drag the **Number of results per page** slider to increase the number of events displayed on the first page of search results.
8. Use the rest of the customization options to further customize the behavior and look of the search results page.

### Tips
* To see how your event search works, publish your changes and test it on your live site.
* After your search runs for a while, you can [use Wix Analytics to see what customers are looking for](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-analytics-about-your-behavior-reports#top-searches).

question: How can I add a watermark to my art in the Wix Art Store?
answer:
A watermark is a semi-transparent design, added to images to protect against copyright. Adding a watermark is the best way to protect your images from theft.

1. Click the Wix Art Store gallery in your Editor.
2. Click **Settings** and then the **Settings** tab.
3. Enable the **Watermark** toggle.
4. Click **Customize Watermark**.
5. Click **Change Watermark:** Select the watermark image from your media manager, or click **Upload Images** to upload a new image.
6. Click **Apply**.
7. Customize the following:
   * **Watermark Opacity:** Drag the slider to change the opacity of the watermark (the lower the opacity, the less visible the watermark).
   * **Watermark Size:** Drag the slider to change the size of the watermark image.
   * **Watermark Position:** Select the position of the watermark on the original image.

**Note:** Once a customer purchases your image, the watermark will automatically disappear.

question: How can I connect a new pricing plan to my online program on Wix?

To connect a new pricing plan to your online program on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Pricing Plans](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Pricing%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/membership/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Plan**.
3. [Add your plan's details](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-one-time-payment-plan#step-1-create-the-pricing-plan) in the **Plan info** section including the name of your plan, a brief description of the plan, and the details of what is included.
4. Connect your program to this plan under **Other benefits**:
   
   1. Select the checkbox next to **Online Programs**.
   2. Click **+ Add Program** under **Programs Included** and select the checkbox next to the program(s) you want to include in the pricing plan.
   3. (Optional) Select the **Automatically add subscribers to these programs when they purchase this plan** checkbox. 
   
   **Note:** This means people who purchase this pricing plan are automatically added to the program(s) you select in step 4b.
5. Select the relevant pricing option and the duration of the offer under the **Pricing options** section:
   
   * [**Free plans**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-free-plan)**:** Offer your clients a free membership plan.
   * [**One-time payment**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-one-time-payment-plan#step-3-set-the-price-and-duration-of-your-plan)**:** Create a one-time plan that lasts for the time period you choose.
   * [**Recurring payment**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-recurring-payment-plan#step-3-set-the-price-and-duration-of-your-plan)**:** Create a subscription plan with recurring payments and select how often the plan and payment reoccurs: weekly, monthly, or yearly.
6. [Adjust a variety of settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-one-time-payment-plan#step-4-adjust-your-plans-advanced-settings) in your pricing plan to offer a more personalized and flexible experience for participants.
7. Click **Save**.

### Tip
Before saving your plan, check the **Plan preview** to see how it will appear on your program page.

question: How can I handle unused JavaScript files on my Wix site as suggested by Google PageSpeed Insights?
answer:
When Google PageSpeed Insights suggests removing unused JavaScript files, it's important to understand that some of these files are essential to the structure of your Wix site. Any code delivered through [static.parastorage.com](http://static.parastorage.com/) is packaged by Wix and is crucial to the site's structure. These files cannot be modified, manipulated, or deleted as they are vital for the site.

For JavaScript files from third-party code, Google may flag them as unused if they are not optimized. You should identify these files and review whether they are necessary for your site. If they are not needed, you can remove them or replace them with an optimized alternative. 

Additionally, when you add apps and components to a page, JavaScript files are automatically added for them, which can affect loading speed. It is recommended to space apps and components between different site pages where possible. 

For more information, you can refer to the following resources:
- [JavaScript files on Wix sites](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-performance-removing-unused-javascript#javascript-files-on-wix-sites)
- [JavaScript files from third-parties](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-performance-removing-unused-javascript#javascript-files-from-third-parties)
- [Learn more about unused JavaScript and PageSpeed Insights](https://web.dev/unused-javascript/)

question: Can I completely remove my free Wix URL after connecting my domain?
answer: Currently, after connecting your domain (e.g., **www.mystunningwebsite.com**) to your site, your free Wix URL (e.g., **siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress**) still exists. Your free Wix URL redirects to your domain name so that anyone who tries to access your free Wix URL can still view your site. Please allow 24 hours for the redirection to propagate. Your free Wix URL can no longer be found by search engines or site visitors. They can only find your site publicly by using your domain name, unless they have saved your free Wix URL.

question: How can I edit the General Info screen in the Wix Member App?
answer:
To customize your General Info screen in the Wix Member App, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Site & App**.
4. Tap **Customize** under the relevant member app (Spaces or Branded).
5. Tap the **Screen** drop-down at the top, then tap **General Info**.

### Contact Information
1. Tap the **Edit** icon next to **Contact Us**.
2. Tap **Customize element** and choose from the following options:
   - **Element Title:** Edit the text under **Element Title** if you wish to change this from the preset 'Contact Us' title.
   - **Display Settings:** Tap the relevant checkboxes next to the elements you want to display.
   - **Edit Business Info:** Tap **Edit Business Info** to customize the business information. Choose from the following options:
     - **Business Name:** Edit the business name used for emailing, invoicing and more.
     - **Email:** Update the email used to notify you about activities in your site.
     - **Currency:** Choose the currency you would like to accept.
     - **Time Zone:** Select the time zone used for your business calendar, invoicing and more.
     - **Description:** Enter a description about your business.
     - **Phone Number:** Add a phone number so members can contact you.
     - **Location:** Tap the checkbox next to **My business has a physical address** to enter a business location.
3. Tap **Save** at the top right.

### Member
1. Tap **Edit** icon next to **Members**.
   - **Tip:** As some mobile operating systems may have different requirements of what should be displayed on the General Info screen, you have the option to hide the Members section on this screen. Tap **Hide element** if you do not want to display this on your site. Learn more about [hiding elements on different operating systems](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-showing-or-hiding-elements-on-different-mobile-operating-systems).
2. Tap **Customize element**.
3. Edit the text under **Element Title** to change this from the preset 'Members' title.
4. Tap **Save** at the top right.

### Social Links
1. Tap **Edit** icon next to **Social Links**.
2. Tap **Customize element** and choose what you want to edit:
   - **Element Title:** Edit the text under **Element Title** if you wish to change this from the default 'Social Links' title.
   - **Add Social Link:** Tap **+ Add Social Link** and enter the URL you want to link. **Note:** Repeat this step to add up to 6 social links.
   - **Note:** Tap **Remove Link** under a specific URL and tap **Remove** to confirm.
3. Tap **Save**, then tap **Done.**

question: How can I manually verify my domain with Google Workspace using a TXT record?
answer:
To verify your domain using a TXT record:

1. Sign into your [Google Admin Console](http://admin.google.com/).
2. Click **Domains**. 
   
   **Note**: (If hidden) Click **More Controls** at the bottom of your Admin console and select **Domains**.
3. Click **Manage Domains**.
4. Click **Set up Admin Console** next to the domain you would like to verify. 
   
   **Note:** If your domain isn't listed, click **Add a Domain** to add a new domain.
5. Click **Next** and then **Continue** to choose TXT verification.
6. Copy the TXT record.
7. Add the TXT record to your domain's [DNS records](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-or-updating-txt-records-in-your-wix-account) in the **TXT Value** field.
8. Click **Verify**. 
   
   **Note**: If you receive a message that your domain couldn't be verified, please wait at least 10 minutes and try again. It may take a few tries for your domain to be verified.

If you have verified your domain with a TXT record and you still cannot set up your Google Workspace business email, we recommend changing your email username. For example, if you originally set your email user name to **username**@mystunningwebsite.com, try setting it to **username1**@mystunningwebsite.com. You can re-edit your username at any time by accessing the [Google Admin Console](http://admin.google.com/).

### Important
If your domain is connected to Wix [via pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pointing-vs-name-servers-domain-connection-methods), your domain host is in control of your domain records. Contact your domain host and ask them to add the TXT record on their end.

question: What are the rules for interacting with Wix Customer Care, and what actions can Wix take if these rules are violated?

6. Avoid using sexually explicit remarks or excessive obscene or vulgar language.

Wix reserves the right to remove any support requests that violate these terms without warning or explanation. Additionally, Wix can ban anyone who willfully violates these terms. question: How do I set up a referral program on my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites:

- You must have one of the following plans: Wix Editor (Business or higher plan) or Wix Studio (Plus or higher plan).
- You need at least one of these apps: Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Pricing Plans, or the new Wix Restaurants ordering app.

To set up a referral program on your Wix site, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create your referral program: Dashboard
1. [Go to Referral Program](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Referral%20Program&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/referrals/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Set Up Program**.
3. Provide basic info about your program in the **Program details** section:
   - **Program name:** Enter your referral program name. (Note: This is for internal use only and does not appear on your site.)
   - **Reward trigger:** Click the drop-down and choose the action that will trigger a reward for the referring customer:
     - **Store order placed**
     - **Ticket ordered**
     - **Session booked**
     - **Plan ordered**

### Step 2 | Set your program rewards: Dashboard
1. Scroll down to the **Referring customer reward** section and select an option from the drop-down:
   - **Coupon:** Customize your coupon by selecting the type, reward name, what it can be used for, and the discount.
   - **Loyalty points:** Enter the number of loyalty points in the **Points given** field.
   - **No reward:** Choose not to reward the referring customer.
2. Scroll down to the **Referred friend reward** section and choose how to reward a referred friend:
   - **Coupon:** Customize your coupon similarly to the referring customer reward.
   - **Loyalty points:** Enter the number of loyalty points in the **Points given** field.
   - **No reward:** Choose not to reward the referred friend.

### Step 3 | Decide whether to activate automated emails: Dashboard
1. Scroll down to the **Emails** section. If you chose to offer rewards, you'll see automated emails for each reward type.
2. Click the toggle next to the email notifications you want to enable or disable:
   - **Enabled:** Customers will automatically receive an email.
   - **Disabled:** Customers will not automatically receive an email.

### Step 4 | Review your referral program: Dashboard
Use the **Program preview** on the right to get an idea of how the program will look on your site. When you're happy with your program setup, click **Save**.

### Step 5 | View your new site pages
When you add a referral program to your site, 2 new site pages are automatically generated. Go to [your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26) to see and [customize the Referral Program pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-referral-program-customizing-your-referral-program-pages).

question: How can I display my Wix Stores product categories on any page using the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Create multiple [product categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-product-categories) in Wix Stores.
* Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.
* [Enable Wix app collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections) so you can use Wix Stores with the CMS.

### Step 1 | Add a Pro Gallery, repeater, or table to a page: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page or section where you want to display your Wix Stores categories.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
4. Add a Pro Gallery, repeater, or table:
   * **Pro Gallery:**
     1. Click **Gallery**.
     2. Click and drag the Pro Gallery of your choice onto the page.
     3. Remove the default images from the gallery:
        1. Click the gallery and select **Manage Media**.
        2. Click **Select All** then click **Delete**.
        3. Click **Done**.
   * **Repeater:**
     1. Click **List**.
     2. Click and drag the repeater of your choice onto the page.
     3. Make sure your repeater has an image or button so you can link it to your Category Page later.
   * **Table:**
     1. Click **List**.
     2. Click **Tables** and drag the table of your choice onto the page.

### Step 2 | Connect your gallery, repeater or table to the CMS: Wix Editor
1. In your Editor, click the repeater, Pro Gallery, or table.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
3. Click **Create Dataset**. If you already have a dataset on your page, click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select **Create a New Dataset**.
4. Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select **Collections** under the **Stores** Wix app collection.
5. (Optional) Click the **Dataset name** field and enter a name for the dataset.
6. Click **Create**.
7. (Repeaters only) Under **Connections**, click the repeater element you want to connect (e.g. Text, Button, Image).
8. Under **Connection options**, click the relevant drop-downs and select the dynamic collection fields you want to connect:
   * **Name (Text):** The category name set in Wix Stores.
   * **Main Media (Image):** The category image set in Wix Stores.
   * **Slug (Text):** The unique part of the URL at the end of your Category Page web address.
   * **ID (Text):** The unique identifier code in the backend of each category.
   * **Navigate Page URL:** The web address of the relevant Category Page.
9. (Repeaters only) Click **Repeater connections** and repeat steps 7-8 above to connect additional elements in the repeater.
10. Click to adjust your repeater elements, Pro Gallery or table as needed.
11. Click **Preview** to test the functionality.
12. Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How can I create an automatic discount for specific menu items in Wix Restaurants?

4. Select what the discount applies to:

5. (Optional) Create minimum requirements for the discount to apply:
   
   * **Minimum quantity (e.g. order 3 dishes get $10 off):**
     
     1. Select the **Minimum quantity of items** checkbox.
     2. Enter the number of items.
   * **Minimum amount (e.g. spend $50 on salads and get $10 off):**
     
     1. Select the **Minimum order subtotal** checkbox.
     2. Enter the minimum amount.
6. Select the type of discount from the **What is the discount?** drop-down and enter the required percentage, amount, or price. 

   **Note:** If you offer an **Amount off discount** (e.g. $10 off), it's applied to every relevant item in an order.
7. Select the date and time when the discount starts.
8. (Optional) Select the dates when the discount ends: 

   **Note:** By default, the discount starts immediately and doesn't have an end.
9. Click **Save**.

question: How can I create a monetary discount coupon in Wix Bookings?

1. [Go to Coupons](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.

4. Set the monetary discount offered by the coupon.
5. Choose which services or products the coupon applies to from the **Apply to** drop-down menu.
6. Select one of the following (doesn't apply if you selected Minimum order subtotal):
   * **Apply once per order (to the lowest priced item):** Customer who buys 2 or more relevant items gets a discount only on the lowest priced item.
   * **Apply to each eligible item in an order:** Customer who buys 2 or more items gets a discount on each item.
7. (Optional) Set an end date using the **Valid between** field for limited-time offers.
8. (Optional) Select the **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon** checkbox and enter the number of times the coupon can be used.
9. (Optional) Select the **Limit to one use per customer** checkbox.
10. Click **Create Coupon**.

question: How can I set up a payment form on my Wix ADI site to accept payments?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have a Business or eCommerce Premium plan.
- Connect your site to a payment method.

### Step 1 | Add a form to your site
1. Go to the page in ADI where you want to add the form.
2. Hover over **Add** at the top.
3. Click **Section to Page**.
4. Scroll down to **Forms** and choose a type of form.
5. Pick a section design for your form and click and drag it onto your site.

### Step 2 | Choose a type of payment form
1. Click the section with the form in ADI.
2. Click **Edit** next to **Form** at the bottom of the section panel.
3. Click **Form Settings**.
4. Click **Get Started** under **Get paid with this form**.
5. Choose a type of payment form:
   - **Single item**: Offer one item at a fixed price.
     1. Select **Single Item**.
     2. Click **Next**.
     3. Enter a name for the item under **Item Name**.
     4. Enter the price under **Item Price**.
   - **List of items**: Visitors select one item from a list.
     1. Select **List of Items**.
     2. Click **Next**.
     3. Click **\+ Add Item**.
     4. Enter a name for the first item under **Item Name**.
     5. Enter the price for the first item under **Item Price**.
     6. Click **Back** at the top.
     7. Click **\+ Add Item** again to add more items.
   - **Visitors enter price**: Let visitors enter the amount they wish to pay.
     1. Select **Visitors Enter Price**.
     2. Click **Next**.
     3. Enter a name for the item under **Item Name**.
     4. Enter the **Default Amount**.
     5. Enter a **Minimum Amount**.
     6. Enter a **Maximum Amount**.

### Step 3 | Connect a payment method
1. Click **Connect Payment Method**.
2. Connect a payment method from [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpayments%2F) in your site's dashboard.
3. Once a payment method is connected, click **Next** on the form.
4. Click **Done** to finish setup.

**Tips:**
- You can change the payment method and remove it at any time. Click the Settings icon next to **Payment Settings** status and choose an option.
- You can also click **View Payments** to see how many people have paid with this form.

question: How can I edit a campaign image in the Wix app for my email marketing campaign?
answer:
To edit a campaign image in the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [email marketing dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-accessing-the-email-marketing-dashboard-in-the-wix-owner-app) in the Wix app.
2. Tap the **Drafts** tab.
3. Tap the campaign you want to customize.
4. Tap **Edit**. 

   **Note:** If you don't see the option to edit it means your campaign was created on a desktop and you must customize it from there.
5. Tap the image you want to customize.
6. Edit your image using the following options:
   
   * **Change Photo:** Replace the photo with another photo.
   * **Edit Photo:** Tap to open the photo editor where you can adjust advanced image settings (e.g. Saturation, Brightness) and add elements like text and stickers to the image.
   * **Link:** Follow the instructions to add a link to your image:
     
     1. Tap the **Include Link** toggle to enable the option.
     2. Select one of the options: 
        
        + **My Wix Site** to add a link to your site. 
          
          **Note:** This option will not appear if your site is not published.
        + **My Wix App** to add a link to your place in the app.
        + **Custom Link** to add a different link. Use the **Add a URL** field to add your link.
     3. Tap **Done**.

question: How can I set up an automated push notification for my branded app users when they perform a specific action?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have a Branded App Premium plan and your app is live in the App Store and Google Play Store.

To set up an automated push notification for your branded app users, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create an automation with 'send a push notification' as the action
1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** at the top right.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Name your automation and [choose a trigger](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-2-choose-a-trigger) (e.g. when someone books an online session).
5. Under the **Actions** drop-down, click **Send a push notification (new)**.
6. Click the **Recipient** drop-down and add the specific individuals.

### Step 2 | Customize your push notification message
1. Enter the notification title that appears above the main message.
2. Enter the push notification message. 
   
   **Tip:** You can add up to 200 characters. Keep your message clear and concise since it appears on smaller device lock screens.
3. Click **+ Add Dynamic Value** under **Message** / **Title**. 
   
   **Tip:** Dynamic values appear in bold at the top of your notification.
4. (In the pop-up) Select the relevant dynamic value and click **Save**.

### Step 3 | Set the notification details
1. Select the relevant option from the **Notification topic** drop-down.
2. Add a link under **Notification behavior** to determine where the notification leads:
   
   * **Mobile link:** Specify a URL or action that will direct the user to a specific page or feature within the app:
     
     + **Open a specific page in the app:** Choose the relevant page.
     + **Open a specific product or service:** Select a specific product or service:
       
       1. Click the **Category** drop-down to select the app (e.g. Wix Stores, Wix Bookings).
       2. Click the **Item** drop-down to select the product or service page. The list populates based on the products or services you've created.

### Step 4 | Choose the timing and activate the automation
1. (Optional) Add delay to the automation:
   
   1. Click **+ Add Delay**.
   2. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
2. Click **Activate** at the top right to publish your automation.

The new automation appears on your [Automations dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) under the **Created by you** tab. If the automation status is set to **Active** it means it's live. From here you can also edit, deactivate or delete it.

question: How can I check if I was charged tax on my Wix premium subscription invoice?

question: Can I change the language of the Wix Groups app using Wix Multilingual?

question: How can I create a complex automation flow using the new automation builder?
answer:
To create a complex automation flow using the new automation builder, follow these steps:

1. **Access the Automation Builder**: The automation builder is available from your site's dashboard, with no pre-requirements.

2. **Use the Canvas View**: The builder features a canvas view designed for a clearer, more user-friendly experience. You can easily add actions, delays, and conditions at any point in the flow. As you select each step, a visual representation is seamlessly created.

3. **Discover Triggers and Actions**: As you start to build your automation, a panel appears to guide you. This panel helps you understand what is possible when setting up your automation. It includes a search function to find the trigger or action you need, and a filter drop-down menu to discover more triggers or apps.

4. **Create Larger and More Complex Flows**: The builder supports larger and more complex flows with IF/ELSE conditions that align with your business logic. You can see exactly how each step impacts the others and define what happens when a condition isn't met.

For example, you can set up an automation where a 'thank you' email is sent to customers after an order is placed. Add a condition step to send a coupon to high-spending customers and a follow-up email to others.

For more detailed guidance, you can learn more [about automations here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-getting-started).

question: Can I integrate CMS collections with Zapier to sync changes with Google Sheets?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to integrate CMS (Content Management System) collections with Zapier. For example, with a Zapier integration, you would be able to sync CMS collection changes with Google Sheets and other apps available in Zapier.

You can [create an automation that connects with Zapier](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-automations-for-cms-form-submissions) each time you receive a form submission from input elements.

question: How can I switch my payment provider to Wix Payments on my Wix site?

question: Can I use Payoneer as a payment provider on Wix?

question: Can I create fixed appointment hours in Wix Bookings?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to create fixed time slots each day exclusively for appointment bookings. Appointment availability is determined by staff members' schedules, and may vary each day depending on existing bookings, synced events on staff members' personal calendars, and [other factors](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-troubleshooting-availability-for-appointments).

### Workaround
You can [create a class service](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-availability-for-classes-in-wix-bookings) with a single participant and set fixed times. For example, a psychologist with patients scheduled at regular intervals could create a recurring class schedule with set hours such as 09:00, 10:15, 11:30, etc.

question: How can I add or remove participants from a class session in Wix Bookings?
answer:
To add or remove class participants in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

### To add new participants:
1. [Go to Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant class in your calendar.
3. Click **Manage**.
4. Click **+ Add Participant** at the top right.
5. Enter the participant details:
   - **Name:** Enter the participant's name. You can also click **+ Add Contact** to add a new client.
   - **Group of:** Enter the total group members associated with the participant who are attending.
   - **How do you want to charge your client:** Choose from options like charging with an invoice, collecting payment later, using the client's plan, or marking as paid.
6. (Optional) Enable the toggle to add the client to future sessions of the class and choose the frequency and number of times.
7. Click **Save** or **Save & Add Another** to add more participants.

### To remove participants (without cancellation and no-show fees):
1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the participant you want to remove, then click **Remove**.
2. (Optional) Select the **Notify participants with an email** checkbox and add a message.
3. Click **Remove**.

### To remove participants (with cancellation and no-show fees):
1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the participant you want to remove, then click **Remove**.
2. (Optional) Select the **Apply cancellation fee** checkbox to charge a cancellation fee.
3. (Optional) Select the **Notify participants with an email** checkbox and add a message.
4. Click **Remove**.
5. (Optional) Edit the cancellation fee.
6. Click **Confirm Fee & Continue**.
7. Click **Collect Payment** and choose how you want to charge the participant.

**Note:** You can issue a refund through the [Orders page](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I customize my VideoBox for mobile viewing in Wix Editor?
answer:

2. Select the relevant VideoBox.
3. Click the Settings icon and customize the video's settings for mobile.
   
   * **Reset video:** Reset your video to its original proportions.
   * **Play Video on mobile:** Click the toggle to enable or disable automatic play of your video on mobile.

question: Is it possible to cut out or erase a part of a shape, icon, or text in the Wix Logo Maker?

question: How can I retrieve a list of all Third Party Apps ever installed on my Wix sites?
answer:
To view a list of all Third Party Apps ever installed on any of your sites, you must submit a request to retrieve an archive of your data. In the archive, you'll receive a file with a list of all your Apps, along with the contact information for each one. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/privacy-retrieving-your-wix-account-data) to retrieve your data.

The columns in the file contain the following information:

- **By:** The name of the company that created the App.
- **Name:** The name of the App.
- **InstanceID and appDefinition:** Technical identification that you might need to provide to the App owner.
- **SupportMail:** The email address where you can contact the App.
- **SupportURL:** The website where you can contact the App.
- **SupportPhone:** The phone number of the App developer.
- **Site Name:** The site on which the app is installed.

question: Can I reposition individual elements on a Wix project page?

If you want to change the position of the elements in your project page, you can choose a different preset design. Learn how to [edit the project page design](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-portfolio-customizing-your-wix-portfolio#customizing-the-project-pages).

question: Can customers pay the entire cost upfront when purchasing a subscription in Wix Stores?

question: How can I create exclusive store pages for site members in Wix Stores?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added a Members Area to your site.

To create exclusive store pages for site members in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. **Add a Members Area to your site**: The [Wix Members Area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-about-your-customers-member-pages) allows customers to sign up and log in to your site. If you deleted it, you can [re-add the Members Area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-adding-and-setting-up-the-members-area).

2. **Add a private page to your site**: When site visitors click to access a private page that's restricted to site members, they are prompted to sign up and log in. If you restricted the page to password holders, they are prompted to enter the password. Learn how to [add a private page to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-adding-and-managing-private-member-pages).

3. **Add products to the new page**: Now [add a store element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-store-elements), such as a Product Gallery or Slider Gallery to the new page and create a special category with the products you want to display there.
   - **Tip**: If you want to sell the same products you sell on public pages - but at different prices - you can duplicate your existing products and save them with a different name and price. When the products are ready, add them to a category and display that category on your exclusive page.

4. **(Optional) Hide the page from your site menu**: If you don't want site visitors to see that there is a page they can't access, you can hide it from your site menu. Learn how to hide pages from your site menu in the [Wix Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-hiding-and-unhiding-a-page-from-your-site-menu) and in the [Studio Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-managing-pages#hiding-a-page).

After creating restricted pages, you can:
- [Create an email marketing campaign and send it to selected customers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-and-sending-an-email-marketing-campaign).
- [Create coupons and discounts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-offering-discounts-and-coupons) and send them to customers who have access to exclusive store pages.
- Create a link on another site page that leads to the restricted page.

question: How can I connect PayU Czech Republic as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect PayU Czech Republic as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **See Options** next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
4. Click **Connect** next to PayU.

Depending on whether you have an account with PayU or need to create a new one, follow the steps:

### Have an account
1. Enter the credentials you received from PayU Poland when your account was approved:
   * **Pos id**
   * **Second key**
   * **Client secret**
2. Click **Connect**.
3. Log in to your [PayU account](https://secure.payu.com).
4. Click **Online Payments**.
5. Click **My Shops**.
6. Click **POS**.
7. Click the link with your store's name.
8. Click **Disable** next to each payment method under **Automatic Collection**. Make sure the value is set to "No".

   **Important:** Registered to PayU before February 3, 2020? Contact [PayU CZ](https://czech.payu.com/podpora/) and request to configure your account as a Wix merchant.

### Don't have an account
First, create your PayU account following the instructions below. Once your account is approved, follow the steps to retrieve your Pos id, second key, and client secret.

**To create the PayU account:**
1. Click [**Create PayU account**](https://registration.payu.com/boarding/#/form?lang=cs&nsf=false&onlyCard=true&origin=cz&partnerId=r764hk53) to be redirected to PayU.

   **Tip:** Switch between English and Czech by clicking the language icon at the top right.

2. Create your new account:
   1. Fill in your personal information and select the checkbox under **Consent to contact**.
   2. Click **Provide company data**.
   3. Fill in your company's information under **Company data**.
   4. Enter the details of your Wix site under **Your website**.
   5. Enter the details of the person representing your company in front of PayU under **Person(s) authorized to represent the organization**
   6. Click **Go to summary**.
   7. Select the checkbox to accept the agreement with PayU and click **I accept**.
   8. Upload the relevant company documents and click **Send documents**.
3. Follow the instructions to send 3 CZK to PayU's bank account for verification.
4. Set up your PayU Merchant Panel:
   1. Log in to your [PayU account](https://secure.payu.com).
   2. Click **Online Payments**.
   3. Click **My Shops**.
   4. Click **Add Shop**.
   5. Follow the instructions to add the details of your site and store.
5. Wait for a confirmation email from PayU.

**To connect your PayU account to Wix (after approval):**
1. Go to your [PayU account](https://secure.payu.com).
2. Click **Online Payments**.
3. Click **My Shops**.
4. Click **POS**.
5. Copy the following account credentials:
   * **Pos id**
   * **Second key**
   * **Client secret**
6. Go back to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to complete your account setup.

question: How can I set up channel subscriptions in Wix Video?
answer:
To set up channel subscriptions in Wix Video, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fvideo-library%2Fvideos).

5. Scroll down to **Channel Subscriptions**.

question: How can I prevent bots and spammers from attacking my site's Members Area?
answer:
To prevent attacks by bots and spammers, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Signup & Login Security](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmember-permissions/signup-login-settings%3F&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Member+Settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to **Ask new members to confirm their email**.
3. Enable the toggle next to **Everyone who signs up**. 

   **Note**: You can disable this toggle at any time. If you do so, only new site members who are already in your contacts will need to confirm their email.

4. Customize the reCAPTCHA settings under **Use reCAPTCHA for signup and login**.
   
   * **Add reCAPTCHA to signup:** Enable the toggle to add a reCAPTCHA field to your signup form. You can choose to always display the field, or only display it to suspected bots.
   * **Add reCAPTCHA to login:** Enable the toggle to add a reCAPTCHA field to your login form. You can choose to always display the field, or only display it to suspected bots.
5. Click **Save**.

question: How can I customize the Side Cart in Wix to reflect my brand's look and feel?
answer:
To customize the Side Cart in Wix:

1. Click the **Side Cart** in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Customize the Side Cart using the available options:
   * **Settings:** Show or hide any of the Side Cart elements.
   * **Design:** Customize the colors, fonts, opacity levels, and more.
   * **Text:** Edit the default text.
4. Customize the overlay over the rest of the page:
   1. Click anywhere on the page outside of the Side Cart.
   2. Click **Change Background**.
   3. Click **Settings** and customize the overlay.
5. Set what happens when customers click outside of the Side Cart:
   1. Click anywhere on the page outside of the Side Cart.
   2. Click **Set Up Overlay**.
   3. Click the **Clicking closes lightbox** toggle to enable or disable it:
      * **Enabled:** When customers click outside of the Side Cart, the Side Cart closes. Customers can also close the Side Cart by clicking the "X" in the top corner.
      * **Disabled:** When customers click outside of the Side Cart, nothing happens. Customers can close the Side Cart by clicking the "X" in the top corner.
6. When you're done, click **Exit Mode**.
7. (Optional) You can [switch to the mobile editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-getting-started-with-the-mobile-editor#accessing-the-mobile-editor) and customize the Side Cart on mobile.

**Tip:** Customization you make to the mobile editor don't affect the Side Cart on desktop.

question: Is it possible to validate a customer's VAT ID during checkout for tax exemptions?

question: How can I change the availability of a dish in the Wix app for my restaurant menu?

4. Select the relevant menu.

question: How can I set up DoorDash Drive for my restaurant using Wix Restaurants?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure your business info is up to date.

To set up DoorDash Drive for your restaurant using Wix Restaurants, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Register with DoorDash Drive
1. [Go to Pickup and Delivery](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/wix-restaurants-orders-new/settings/pickup-delivery?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Pickup+and+Delivery) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Edit** icon next to **DoorDash Drive** under **Delivery Partners**.
3. Click **Register** to begin the registration with DoorDash Drive:
   - Click **Agree & Continue** to allow DoorDash Drive to manage restaurant orders and read basic site and business info.
   - Enter your credentials and click **Sign in**.

[Go to Pickup and Delivery](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/wix-restaurants-orders-new/settings/pickup-delivery?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Pickup+and+Delivery) in your site's dashboard.

[Go to Pickup and Delivery](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/wix-restaurants-orders-new/settings/pickup-delivery?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Pickup+and+Delivery) in your site's dashboard.

[Go to Pickup and Delivery](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/wix-restaurants-orders-new/settings/pickup-delivery?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Pickup+and+Delivery) in your site's dashboard.

[Go to Pickup and Delivery](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/wix-restaurants-orders-new/settings/pickup-delivery?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Pickup+and+Delivery) in your site's dashboard.
