question: How can I display different pricing plans using tabs on my website?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the Editor and have your pricing plans ready to be added.

To display different pricing plans using tabs on your website, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add tabs to your site
1. Click **Add Elements** on the left of the Editor.
2. Click **Interactive**.
3. Click **Tabs** under **Boxes**.
4. Click and drag your chosen tab design to add it to your page.

### Step 2 | Name your tabs
1. Click the tabs element in your Editor.
2. Click **Manage Tabs**.
3. Hover over the relevant item in the panel.
4. Click the More Actions icon.
5. Click **Rename**.
6. Enter the new name into the field.
7. Click **Done**.
8. Repeat steps 3-7 for each tab you display.

### Step 3 | Add the pricing plans elements to your tab items
1. Click the tabs element in your Editor.
2. Open the relevant tab item from the drop-down.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
4. Click **Payments**.
5. Click either Plan List or Single Plan under Pricing Plans.
6. Drag the relevant element onto the tab.
7. Drop the element when you see the **Attach to Tab** message.
8. Repeat steps 2-7 for each tab.

### Step 4 | Choose what plans to display in each tab
1. Click the tabs element in your Editor.
2. Select the first tab from the drop-down.
3. Click to select the pricing plans element you added.
4. Choose which plans to display, depending on which pricing plans widget you chose for each tab.

#### Plan List
1. Click the Plan List widget in the tab.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Plans**.
4. Select the checkbox next to each plan you want to display in the selected tab.

#### Single Plan
1. Click the Single Plan widget in the tab.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the drop-down and select the plan you want to display.

question: How can I set up tax collection for my business using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To set up tax collection for your business using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. **Understand the Tax Rules**: Before you begin, it's important to understand the tax rules that apply to your business to avoid charging customers extra taxes or not collecting them when necessary. You can learn more about [setting up tax for your business](https://support.wix.com/en/article/tax-collection-an-overview).

2. **Access Tax Settings**: Go to your site's dashboard and access your Tax settings by clicking [Go to Tax](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Tax&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/store/tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar).

3. **Set Up Tax for Your Location(s)**: Ensure that you set up tax for your specific location(s) so that clients see the correct tax details during checkout.

4. **Select the Correct Business Address**: From the Business Info drop-down, select the correct business address. If you type the address but don't click to select it, it may not save, and the correct tax rates may not appear. You can find more details on [adding your business and regional details](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-your-business-and-regional-details#step-2-add-your-business-info).

5. **Choose a Tax Calculation Method**: You can either use the manual method or automatic tax calculation:
   - **Manual Method**: Select the location(s) where you want to collect tax and manually enter the tax rate. If the rate changes, you need to update it. Learn more about [setting up manual tax calculation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-tax-calculation-using-the-manual-method).
   - **Automatic Method**: Use Avalara for automatic tax calculation. Select the location(s) where you want to collect tax, and Avalara will add the right rate. When rates change, your tax updates automatically. Learn more about [automatic tax collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-automatic-tax-collection).

By following these steps, you can ensure that your business is compliant with local tax regulations and that your clients see the correct tax details at checkout.

question: How can I cancel my Editor X plan and what should I be aware of before doing so?
answer:
To cancel your Editor X plan, follow these step-by-step instructions:

1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings).
2. Click the Show More icon next to the relevant plan.
3. Click **Cancel plan**.
4. Click **Cancel Now** in the pop-up to confirm.

**Important Information Before Canceling:**
- **Site status:** If you cancel your plan, it remains active until the end of the subscription period. After that, your site address reverts back to the free Editor X URL (username.editorx.io/siteaddress) and Editor X ads appear on your site.
- **Renewal date:** Your Premium plan renews up to 14 days before the original purchase date to ensure no downtime.
- **Trial period:** Plans come with a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you cancel within the first 14 days, your subscription ends immediately and you are fully refunded within the next 20 business days.
- **Other subscriptions:** Canceling your site plan does not cancel any domain, business email, or app subscriptions. These must be canceled separately.
- **Deleting a site:** Canceling a site plan does not delete the site. To delete your site, first cancel your plan (or transfer it to another site) and then follow the steps [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/moving-a-site-to-trash) to delete your site.

**Note:** Canceling your plan does not immediately end it; it simply does not renew at the end of the subscription period.

question: How can I customize the settings of my gallery in ADI?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added a gallery to your site and added media to it.

To customize your gallery settings:

1. Click your gallery in the ADI builder.
2. Customize your gallery settings on the panel on the left using the available options:
   
   * **Full Width:** Switch on the toggle to expand your gallery across the width of your site.
   * **Load More Button:** Switch on the toggle to show a 'Load More' button for galleries with more items than fit in the section layout.
   * **Image Ratio:** Select a ratio of the gallery items. The images automatically update on the page so you can see how it looks.
   * **When Clicking On an Item:** Click the drop-down to select what happens when visitors click a gallery item:
     
     + **A Link Opens:** Visitors are directed to a link (a web address, page, lightbox, etc.)
     
     **Note:** To set up a link click **Manage Media** beneath the drop-down.
     + **Nothing Happens:** Nothing happens when someone clicks an item.
     + **Open in Full Screen:** The gallery item expands in fullscreen mode so visitors can get a closer look.
   * **Display Elements:** Select the elements to include in the gallery alongside the gallery items.
     
     + **Image Title:** Display the title of the gallery item. **Note**: Click **Manage Media** at the bottom to update your titles.
     + **Image Description:** Include the description of the item. **Note**: Click **Manage Media** at the bottom to update the item description.
     + **Social Sharing:** Add social media icons to your gallery items so visitors can share the media.
     + **Download:** Add a download icon beside each gallery item so visitors can download your media.
     + **Heart Icon:** Add a heart icon so visitors can react to their favorite gallery items.
   * **Image Quality:** Drag the slider to change the image quality.
   * **Image Sharpening:** Select the checkmark to sharpen your image using the amount, radius and threshold controls.

**Note:** Some settings may be different or unavailable based on the gallery layout you choose.

question: How can I view the tracking codes on my website using Google Chrome?
answer:

2. Open the developer tools:
   * **Windows:** Press the F12 key on your keyboard.
   * **Mac:** Press CMD + Option + I on your keyboard.
3. Click the More Actions icon at the top right.
4. Select **More tools**.
5. Select **Network conditions**.
6. Deselect **Use browser default** under **User Agent**.
7. Select **Googlebot** from the drop-down menu.
8. Close the **Network conditions** tab.
9. In the top tab, select **Network**.
10. Enter "/tags" in the filter field.
11. Refresh the page to see the active tracking codes.

question: Can I add or customize security response headers on my Wix website?
answer: Currently, it's not possible to add or customize security response headers, via code or otherwise, unless you have the [Wix Studio enterprise solution](https://www.wix.com/enterprise).

question: How can I add and set up gift cards using the Gifted app on my Wix website?
answer:
To add and set up gift cards using the Gifted app on your Wix website, follow these steps:

1. Ensure that you have added Wix Stores to your site, as the Gifted app requires it. You can learn how to add Wix Stores [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores).
2. Visit the [Gifted app page](https://www.wix.com/app-market/gifted) on the Wix App Market.
3. Install the Gifted app on your website.
4. Once installed, you can start selling branded gift cards on your website.
5. Your customers will be able to purchase and send personalized digital gift cards directly to their recipients.
6. Benefit from integrated gift card order tracking from your Wix Store.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the [Gifted app setup guide](https://support.wix.com/en/article/offering-gift-cards-with-the-gifted-app).

question: Can I display more than 20 blog posts in an RSS feed on Wix?
answer: Currently, you cannot display more than 20 blog posts in an [RSS feed](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-an-rss-button-to-your-site).

question: How can I add a cancellation and no-show fee to my Wix booking policy?
answer:
To add a cancellation and no-show fee to a policy, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Booking Policies](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Booking%20Policies&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/settings/policies) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant policy or click **+ Add a New policy** and [add all relevant details](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-up-your-booking-policies).
3. Select the **Charge cancellation and no-show fees checkbox**.
4. Click the **Edit** icon next to **Paid window**.
5. Select the relevant timeframe from the **Cancellations or no-shows** drop-down.
6. Under **Fee**, enter the fee amount and select the relevant icon to choose whether it is a **Fixed amount** or a **Percentage of the session's price**. Then click the **Checkmark** icon.
7. (Optional) Click **Add a later window** to create an additional paid window and follow steps 4-6 above.

Make sure to repeat the steps above for each of your [booking policies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-up-your-booking-policies) to reduce your cancellations and no-shows.

question: How can I add my Wix site to the home screen of my iPhone?
answer:
To add your Wix site to the home screen of your iPhone, follow these steps:

1. Open the site in Safari on your device.
2. Tap the Share icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2017/03/28/cbe3872c-145b-4316-925c-0c73ae1aed36.png).

question: Can I remove or hide Wix Chat from the Quick Action Bar on my mobile site while keeping it on my desktop site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to remove or hide it from the Quick Action Bar while keeping it on your desktop site. For more details, you can refer to the [Quick Action Bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-the-quick-action-bar-on-your-mobile-site).

question: Can I remove the shopping cart icon from the header of my site using ADI?
answer: Currently, you cannot remove the shopping cart icon from the header of your site, as it is an essential part of your online store. If you want to remove the icon from your site, you need to [head to the Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-moving-from-adi-to-the-editor). Then select the icon in the Editor and press delete on your keyboard.

question: Can I hide image titles and descriptions in expand mode in Wix galleries?
answer: Currently, hiding gallery image titles and descriptions in expand mode is not supported. You can learn more about expand mode in galleries [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-customizing-the-expand-mode-for-your-gallery).

question: How can I connect Stripe as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Stripe as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard. 

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **See Options** beside Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
4. Click **Connect** next to Stripe.
5. Select an option:
   
   * **Already have a Stripe account**:
     
     + Enter your email and password.
   * **Claim your Wix Stripe account**:
     
     1. Enter an email and password.
     2. Fill in the form (for detailed instructions, learn about [claiming your Stripe account](https://support.wix.com/en/article/claiming-your-stripe-account)).
     3. Click **Authorize access to this account**.

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

question: How can I fix the issue of text and other elements overlapping on my Wix mobile site?
answer:
If you've added a large amount of text to your site in a single text box, and added an element on top of it, the text may overlap with other elements on your live site. This is usually seen in text that has been added to your site in the desktop Editor.

To resolve the issue:

1. Open the desktop Editor.
2. Break up the text into multiple text boxes - one per paragraph.
3. Add the elements between the text boxes with some space between them.
4. Group the elements together to ensure they're aligned. [Click here to learn how to group elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-grouping-and-ungrouping-elements)

question: Can I change the playback quality of my videos in Wix Video?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to change the playback quality of your videos in Wix Video.

question: How can I add a title and description to my photos in Wix Photo Albums?
answer:
To add a title and description to your photos in Wix Photo Albums, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fphotography-albums/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Album** next to the relevant album.
3. Click **Edit** on the top right.
4. Click the **Text** tab in the panel on the left.
5. Click the **Galleries** tab at the top.
6. Click the checkbox to enable or disable the title and description that appears on your gallery.
7. Customize how the text appears on your gallery:
   * **Alignment:** Choose how you want to align your text (to the left, in the center, or to the right).
   * **Vertical alignment:** Choose how you want the button to align on hover (above, in the center, or below the photo).
   
   **Note**: The above options depend on what gallery layout you choose. Different options are available if you choose Grid, Slider, Strip or Column layouts.
8. Click the toggle to add a **Buy Now** button.
9. Customize the text in the text box that will appear on the button.
10. Click the **Media** tab.
11. Hover over the relevant gallery and click **Manage Media**.
12. Select the relevant image.
13. Edit the title and description on the right.
14. Click **Done** on the bottom left.
15. (Optional) Publish your changes by clicking **Publish Now** at the top right.

If some of your photo's titles and descriptions are being cut off, set the text box height of the title and description to **Set Manually** and increase the size until it's big enough to fit in all the text.

question: How can I report a copyright infringement on Wix.com?
answer: To report a copyright infringement by a Wix user, please fill out our [automated DMCA Copyright Complaint Form](https://www.wix.com/support-chatbot?nodeId=om98g6kPvnc8SE5FUBqC&referral=termsOfUse). This form is the fastest way to report a case of copyright infringement.

question: How can I upgrade my Google Workspace plan through Wix?

question: What is the purpose of Wix's Data Processing Agreement for its users?
answer: The DPA (Data Processing Agreement) is a public and binding document between Wix and its users, where each party agrees to process personal data only within the purposes and instructions set forth therein.

question: How can I delete my blog from my Wix site if it is set as the homepage?
answer:
To delete your blog when it is set as your homepage, follow these steps:

1. [Add a new page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-adding-and-managing-your-sites-pages).
2. Click the **Pages** menu on the top bar.
3. Click the **Settings** icon next to the new page you have created.
4. Click **Set as Homepage**.
5. Click the **Settings** icon next to **Blog**.
6. Click **Delete**.

question: Can I customize the email address notifications are sent from in Wix Bookings?
answer: We are excited to announce that you can now [customize the email address you send email notifications from](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-managing-your-outbound-client-emails).

question: How can I enable and customize back-in-stock notifications for my Wix store customers?
answer:
To enable and customize back-in-stock notifications for your Wix store customers, follow these steps:

### To start collecting customer requests:
1. [Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Back-in-Stock&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/back-in-stock) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Start Collecting Requests**.

### To activate automated notifications:
1. [Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Back-in-Stock&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/back-in-stock) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Activate Automation**.

### To customize the design of the notification:
1. [Go to the Back in Stock Requests tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Back-in-Stock&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/back-in-stock) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Automations** tab.
3. Click **Preview & Edit**.
4. Edit the Sender Details:
   - Click **Edit**.
   - Edit the "from" name. 
     **Note:** Enter a name customers recognize like your business name.
   - (Optional) Edit the reply-to email. 
     **Tip:** This is where emails are directed if customers reply.
   - Click **Save**.
5. Customize the notification:
   - Click **Edit Template** to [customize the text and design of the notification](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-customizing-your-email-campaign). 
     **Tip:** Click **Add** and then **Logo** to display your logo at the top of the notification.
   - Click **Save & Publish**.

### Tip
To see what the email looks like when sent to customers, go back to the Automations tab, click **Preview & Edit** again and select **Preview & Test**. From there you can click **Send Test Email** and enter your details to get the notification sent to your inbox.

question: Can clients access the cart through the member apps in Wix Bookings?
answer: Currently, it is not possible for clients to access the cart through the relevant member apps. Clients can access the cart directly from your site on desktop or the mobile web version of your site, enabling them to add multiple services before checking out. [Learn more about adding a cart to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-a-cart-to-your-site).

question: Can I permanently delete a pricing plan that I have archived?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to delete a plan that you have archived.

question: Can I automatically add custom fields like VAT or guest billing address to an invoice for an event in Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to automatically add custom fields (e.g. VAT or guest billing address) when creating an invoice for an event.

question: Does Wix support CAA records for domain connections?
answer: Currently, CAA records are not supported by Wix. If you have connected via pointing method, please make sure to remove the existing CAA record at your domain host's side.

question: Can I put a business call on hold using the Business Phone Number feature?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to place business calls on hold.

question: Can I expose a test site to only desktop or only mobile devices?
answer: Currently, you cannot expose the test site to just desktop, or just mobile devices. The percentage exposure refers to the percentage of your site visitors that see the test site when they access your live site on desktop and mobile devices.

question: How can I find and export my invoice history for services paid to Wix?
answer:
To find and export your invoice history for services paid to Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Billing History](https://www.wix.com/account/billing-history?referralAdditionalInfo=account-manager) page.
2. Use the filters and search fields to find a specific invoice:
   - **Date and site**: Use the **All Dates** and **All Sites** drop-downs to find a charge by date or by site name.
   - **Status and payment method**: Click **More Filters** to filter by payment status and payment method.
   - **Keyword**: Click **Search** to look for invoices by keywords.
3. To export your billing history, click the **Export** button ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/e960df7a-7f65-4692-b4a0-a80de5db52fa/2024/05/13/683b3e9c-e7e0-4a2c-821c-9c4dd3df5752/8977b8e7-392c-45e6-8a47-ba25a60d22c4.png).
4. Choose to export all invoices, or export a filtered CSV based on the **More Filters** or **Search** options.

**Note:** You can download a maximum of 3,000 invoices per export. If your export exceeds this limit, try filtering your invoices by year.

question: Can I display sale prices directly in the ticket list for Wix Events?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to show these discounted prices directly in the ticket list. You can reduce ticket prices by [creating coupons or automatic discounts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-event-coupons).

question: How can I add a new location or edit the details of an existing location in Wix Retail POS?
answer: To add a new location or edit the details of an existing location in Wix Retail POS, you need to go to your desktop. Learn more about [adding and managing multiple locations](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-offering-services-at-multiple-locations).

question: How can I invite someone to collaborate on my Editor X site?
answer:
To invite someone to collaborate on your Editor X site, follow these steps:

1. Click **Invite** at the top right of Editor X.
2. Click **Site Team** at the top.
3. Enter the email address of the person you want to invite. 
   
   **Tip:** If you're inviting multiple people, make sure to separate their email addresses with a comma.
4. Click the **Choose role** drop-down and select the role you want to assign.
5. Click **Send Invite**.

After sending an invite, you can see the person's name on the list with a **Pending** label. They can accept and join the team directly from the email they received from Editor X.

**Note:** When inviting someone to your site team, certain back office roles might not be available in the drop-down menu. To invite people to those roles, click **Manage Roles & Permissions** at the bottom.

question: How can I mark attendance for my classes using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To mark attendance for your classes using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=kb) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant class in your calendar.
3. Click **Manage** next to participants.
4. Click the **Attendance** drop-down next to the relevant client and choose an option:
   * **Booked:** Your client booked the class and hasn't yet arrived.
   * **Checked-In:** Your client arrived to the class.
   * **No-Show:** Your client booked the class but never arrived.

### Tip
You can mark the attendance of multiple clients by selecting the checkbox next to each one.

### What's next?
* You can [install the Client Check-In app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-installing-and-setting-up-the-client-check-in-app) to allow your members to check themselves in at your services.
* You can also [mark attendance on the go using the Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-marking-attendance-for-classes-using-the-wix-owner-app).

question: How can I check if my site is indexed by search engines?
answer: To check if your site was indexed by search engines, search "site:" followed by your site's domain with no spaces. For example: **site:wix.com**. If any of your domain's pages are listed in the search results, those pages have been indexed. If there are no results for your domain, your website has not been indexed yet. Check that you have [allowed search engines to crawl your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/enabling-search-engines-like-google-to-index-your-site).

question: How can I delete Wix Bookings from my site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To delete Wix Bookings from your site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

question: Can I grant permission to someone to manage specific online programs?
answer: You can now grant people permission to edit and [manage specific online programs](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-adding-program-contributors).

question: How should I structure a prompt for the Wix AI Image Creator to ensure the generated images match my expectations?
answer:
When writing your prompt for the Wix AI Image Creator, it’s important to structure it correctly by including the following 3 characteristics: a prefix, the scene, and a suffix. 

- **Prefix:** Defines the medium.
- **Scene:** Defines the content.
- **Suffix:** Defines the atmosphere and elaborates on the scene.

An example of an AI prompt following this structure is: "A studio professional photo of cosmetics products on a podium, pastel colors, shot on a Nikon D850".

question: How can I manage pending booking requests in Wix Bookings?
answer:
To manage your pending booking requests in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the Booking Activity icon at the top right.
3. Hover over the relevant booking request under **Pending Booking Requests**.
4. Choose what you want to do next:
   * Click **Approve**.
   * Click **More Actions** to either decline the booking request or propose a new time.

**Note:** This widget only appears for services where you [activate manual approval for bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-requiring-approval-for-appointment-bookings).

question: How can I set library permissions for users in the Wix File Share app?
answer:
To set library permissions for your users in the Wix File Share app, follow these steps:

1. Select the File Share app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Library Permissions**.
5. Click the **Who can view and download items?** drop-down to set view and download permissions for your library:
   * **All members:** Members with a Public profile who are logged in to your site can view and download files.
   * **Site visitors:** Anyone who visits your site can view and download files.
6. Click the Edit icon under **Who can upload files?** to select who has upload permissions.
7. Select the checkbox next to all roles you want to allow to upload files.
   
   Tip: To create a custom role, click **+Create New**. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-creating-member-roles)
8. Click **Apply**.
9. Click the Edit icon under **Who can manage the library?** to choose who has manage permissions.
10. Select the checkbox next to all roles you want to allow to manage files.
11. Click **Apply**.
12. Click **Save Changes**.

question: What should I do if I encounter the error message 'Must be either "Product" or "Variant"' when importing products to my Wix store?
answer: If you encounter the error message 'Must be either "Product" or "Variant"', you need to ensure that for each product, you enter "Product" and for each variant, you enter "Variant". If you do not use SKUs, you can leave this field blank.

question: How can I add a tracking number to an order using the Wix app?
answer:
To add a tracking number using the Wix app:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/11/10/bdebceaa-3cca-42c8-b60d-6c55923bf8fa/bb911823-182e-4453-b87e-0dbbe1ab5d50.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Sales**.
4. Tap **Orders**.
5. Tap the relevant order.
6. Scroll down and tap **Add Tracking Number**.
7. To add the barcode, select an option:
   * **Scan barcode:** Tap the barcode symbol and scan the barcode.
   * **Manually enter barcode:** Tap **Tracking Number**, enter the barcode, and tap save.
8. To add the shipping carrier, select an option:

question: How can I create and set up a standalone form using Wix Forms?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* You must have [Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-form-on-your-site) on your site.
* Make sure your form has a [submissions table](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-viewing-and-managing-a-submissions-table).

### To create a standalone form:
1. Go to [Forms & Submissions](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fwix-forms&title=Select+a+Site&primaryButtonText=Go+to+Forms+and+Submissions) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Old Forms** tab.
3. Click **+ Create Standalone Form**.
4. Pick a template for your standalone form or click **Start from scratch**.
   
   **Tip:** Templates have pre-existing fields that you can customize. We offer form templates for collecting contact details, client info, feedback, and applications.
5. Click **Get Started** to start customizing your standalone form.

### To add a form title and description:
1. Add the title of your form under **Form title**. 
   
   **Note:** This is mandatory and appears at the top of the form for visitors to see.
2. Add a description under **Form description** that tells visitors what the form is about. You can also include any tips for filling out the form (e.g. average time to complete).
   
   **Tip:** If you don't want to add a form description, click **Remove**.

### To add form fields and manage your form:
1. Hover over a field under **Add form fields** and click **Add**.
   
   **Note:** If the **Add form fields** window doesn't appear at first, click **+ Add Field** at the bottom of the form to open it.
2. Fill in the question and placeholder text for your new field:
   
   * **Question:** Add the exact question that should appear on the form (e.g. "What is your phone number?").
   * **Placeholder:** This is the placeholder text inside the answer field in the form. Once a visitor adds an answer the placeholder text disappears.
3. Click **+ Add Field** at the bottom and repeat steps 1-2 to add more fields.
   
   **Tip:** Different fields have different information. For example, a paragraph field allows you to set a character limit for responses.
4. (Optional) Add a section of explainer text above or below a field by clicking **Header** / **Paragraph** under **Other elements**.
   
   **Tip:** With the Paragraph element you can also stylize the text.
5. Once you're done adding form fields, manage your form fields with the following options:
   
   * **Make a question required:** Click the **Required** checkbox at the right of a field to make that question mandatory for visitors to answer.
   * **Duplicate a field:** Click the **Copy** icon to create a copy of that field and its content directly below the first.
     
     **Note:** Some contact fields, such as First Name and Last Name, can only be added once to a form.
   * **Delete a field:** Click the **Trash** icon to delete a field from your form.
   * **Rearrange a field:** Click and drag the top left of a field to move it up and down the question order.
     
     **Note:** You cannot move the submission button and thank you message at the bottom of the form.

### To add submission text and save:
1. Edit the text that appears inside the form's submit button under **Submit Button Text**.
   
   **Note:** There is a 22 character limit since the buttons are small.
2. Edit the thank you text that appears after visitors submit the form (e.g. 'Thanks for submitting!').
   
   **Tip:** The message is shown on a new page.
3. Click **Save** at the top right to save your new form.

### To view and share your form:
1. Click the **Open live form** icon at the top right of the form builder.
   
   **Tip:** You can also view the live form at any time from the Forms dashboard.
2. Share your form's direct link or post it on social media:
   
   1. Click **Share** at the top right of the form builder.
   2. Choose what to do next:
      
      * Click **Copy Link** to copy the link to your clipboard. You cannot edit this unique URL.
      * Click a social media icon to share the form directly to Facebook, LinkedIn, or X (Formerly Twitter).
      * Click **Open Live Form** to view the live form in a separate tab. You can also copy the share URL from here.
   3. Click **Done**.

question: What are the differences between selling images as 'Web Ready' and 'Original File' in Wix Art Store, and how does it affect pricing?
answer:
In Wix Art Store, you can sell your images either as **Web Ready**, **Original File** or both. You can set different prices for each option.

### Web Ready
If you upload an image over 1200 pixels, Wix Art Store takes your image file and automatically creates a smaller version (the Web Ready file) which your customers can purchase. The Web Ready file has a slightly reduced quality and therefore can be sold at a lower price. These files are perfect for web use, and ideal if you are selling your images to be used online.

### Original File
When purchasing your image through Wix Art Store, customers receive the original file that you upload. The Original File has no reduction in quality and can therefore be sold at a higher price. If you intend to sell images for print, it is recommended to upload images over 1200 pixels in order to retain the quality.

### Tip
Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-art-store-setting-prices-in-your-wix-art-store) to learn more about setting your pricing plan.

question: How do I connect my Wix store to Wish and set up my Wish shop?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you are a merchant based in the US with an English language site.

To connect your Wix store to Wish and set up your Wish shop, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create a Wish account
1. [Go to the Wish tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Your%20Wish%20Shop%20&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/channel/wish) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Get Started**.
3. Select what you want to do:
   - Create a new account: Click **Sign up** and complete the form to create a new account.
   - Log in to an existing account: Click **Log in** and enter your Wish username and password.
4. Click **Allow access**.
5. Click **Continue**.

### Step 2 | Select your default Wish shipping settings
1. If not already there, go to the Wish tab in your site's dashboard.
2. Enter a shipping price for the first shipping area.
3. Enter the maximum number of delivery days.
4. (Optional) Set up default shipping rules for additional destinations:
   1. Click **\+ Add Destination**.
   2. Select the checkboxes next to one or more countries.
   3. Click **Add**.
   4. Enter a price and maximum delivery days.
5. Click **Continue to Tags**.

### Step 3 | Select your default Wish tags
1. Enter your first tag (e.g. Clothes) and press **Enter** on your keyboard.
2. Repeat to add up to 5 tags in total.
3. Click **Continue to Wish Shop**.

### Step 4 | Edit general info for products without product options
1. Click to select a product without product options.
2. Enable the **Edit for Wish** toggle next to any of the fields to make changes to it in Wish.
3. Edit any of the product details:
   - **Name:** Enter a product name.
   - **Price:** Enter a product price.
   - **Inventory:** Enter an inventory amount.
   - **SKU:** Enter an SKU.
   - **Description:** Enter a product description
   - **Wish images:** Add up to 21 images.
4. Enter the Wish product specifics:
   - **MSRP** (Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price)
   - **Product condition**
   - **GTIN** (Global Trade Item Number)
5. Click **Save** and select **Save as draft**.

### Step 8 | List your first product
1. After editing your product details, you can list your product by selecting the **Save & update** option.
2. After you click **List**, the product is sent to Wish for approval, which can take up to 48 hours.
3. Once approved, the product appears in your product list with a **Listed** label.

question: How can I add a file upload field to a site form using the new Wix Forms?

Choose from the following customization options:

- **Field title:** Give a short title that tells people what you are asking for in the field.
- **Button text:** Edit the text that appears on the upload button in the form, e.g., 'Upload file'.
- **Text below button:**
  - **File info:** Only the name of the file appears beneath the button after a visitor uploads a file.
  - **Custom text:** Custom text appears beneath the button after a visitor uploads a file, e.g., 'Add up to 5 files.'

- **Required field:** Enable the toggle to make the upload file field mandatory (visitors cannot submit the form without uploading a file).
- **Field description:** Enter text if your form needs additional explanation (e.g., terms and conditions or additional legal information).

Note: Accepting archive files is a feature available only in [new Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-the-difference-between-the-new-and-old-wix-forms).

question: How can I create another online ordering page for my Wix restaurant site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed any necessary setup in your Wix Restaurants dashboard.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Access the online ordering settings
1. [Go to Restaurant Orders Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/olo-settings/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More actions** drop-down and select **Add another ordering page**.
3. Click **Continue**.

#### Step 2 | Create a new ordering page
1. Enter a name for your new page.
2. (Optional) Choose which menus should appear on the new page. 
   
   **Note:** Menus assigned to this page will no longer appear on your existing ordering page.
3. Click **Save**.

#### Step 3 | Customize page settings
1. [Go to Restaurant Orders Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/olo-settings/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant ordering page tab under **Restaurant Orders Settings**.
3. Edit the relevant settings:
   - **Order scheduling**: Click the **Edit** icon under **Order scheduling** or **Prep time** and select the relevant scheduling options. Click **Save**.
   - **Fulfillment settings**: Click the **Hours** drop-down and select **Edit in Pick-up and Delivery**. Manage settings for fulfilling orders and click **Save**.
   - **Change the page name**: Click the **More actions** drop-down, select **Manage ordering pages**, enter the name, and click **Save**.

#### Step 4 | Assign menus to ordering pages
1. [Go to Restaurant Orders Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/olo-settings/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Menus** drop-down and select **Assign Menus**.
3. Click the **Menus** field under the relevant order page and select the menu(s) you want to add.
4. Click **Save**.

#### Step 5 | Add the page to your editor
1. [Go to Restaurant Orders Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/olo-settings/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the new ordering page tab under **Restaurant Orders Settings**.
3. Click the **More actions** drop-down and select **Design in editor**.
4. (Optional) Customize the new page in your editor to fit your preferred layout and design.
5. When ready, click **Publish** at the top right.

### Tip
You can also click **Go to Editor** if you just want to add the page without designing it for now.

question: How can I create a multi-action automation in Wix Automations?
answer:
To create a multi-action automation in Wix Automations, follow these steps:

1. [Create a new automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation) or [edit an existing automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-managing-your-automations#editing-duplicating-or-renaming-an-automation).
2. Scroll down to the bottom of the automation editing screen and click **+ Add an Action**.
3. Click your chosen action in the **Action 2** section.
4. Set up the action using the available options.
5. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
6. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when this follow-up action should be carried out:
   * **Wait between actions:** The action is performed after the previous action, after a period of time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours, and minutes.
   * **Respond Immediately:** The action is performed immediately after the previous action.
7. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** and follow steps 3 - 6 to add any additional follow-up actions.
8. Click **Activate**.

Note: If you add new actions to existing automations, these actions will only apply to instances triggered after you save your changes. For every instance already triggered (e.g., form submitted), these new actions will not be performed.

question: How can I add and set up collapsible text on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor and are familiar with basic navigation within the editor.

### Step 1 | Add collapsible text
To add collapsible text to your site:
1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/2_Q3UWFeRrr5eTMMy5BcmnSAohKtI_dMraA_5NEO86PZzJ1C6RLZFszKuF-1mKgkvV4ee4eSdDzyvTbeogg8P5XGH8QMTpNCPtZMEWh1kJV1_Jk7RjMl4g4JvgeWtKfTBU5Wfg_V) on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Text**.
3. Click **Paragraphs**.
4. Scroll down to **Collapsible Text**.
5. Click and drag your chosen text box to add it to your site.

### Step 2 | Adjust the layout of the collapsible text
To adjust the text's layout:
1. Click the Layout icon ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/_o63TCTCRJLLQGXjE3A037_Ewcw6NyoTwOCmtaYSCkiQ-u2XW00xPpyw3PUuq7gyYimF_Uw3SHZ5zdeCUAThh_PyIweKwILGTFEOkwv8aK-0mOQJNLRHa9B_LZJdEADO0BQvJb8y) on the text box.
2. Customize the layout using the options:
   * **Choose how the text appears:**
     + **Collapsed:** A text preview is displayed, and visitors need to click an expand button or a link to read the full body of text.
     + **Show all:** The entire text piece is displayed on your site, and is not collapsed.
   * **Number of lines displayed:** Choose how many lines of text are displayed in the preview.
   * **Align button:** Set the alignment of the expand or link button.
   * **Spacing between text and button:** Increase or decrease the spacing.

### Step 3 | Type and set up your text
To edit and set up your text:
1. Click the collapsible text box.
2. Click **Change Text**.
3. Type or paste your chosen text into the box under **Change Text**.
4. **What does the button do?:** Set up how visitors view the full text, and customize it with the options:
   * **Expand:** Visitors can view the full piece of text by clicking an expand button:
     + **Expand button text:** Enter the text shown on the expand button, e.g. "Read More".
     + **Collapse button text:** Enter the text shown on the collapse button, e.g. "Read Less".
   * **Link:** Visitors can view the full piece of text by clicking a link:
     + **Link button text:** Enter the text for the link, e.g. "Click to read more".
     + **Where does this button link?:** Enter the details for the link to the full piece of text.
5. (Optional) Add a description, and select your text's HTML tag from the dropdown menu under **SEO & accessibility** to define its text type (a heading, paragraph, etc). [Learn more about defining your text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-site-structure)

question: How can I manually create an order in Wix for a custom product?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you are using Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, or Wix Restaurants Orders (New).

To manually create an order for a custom product, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Add items to the order
1. [Go to Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+Add New Order**.
3. Click **Add Custom Item**.
4. Enter an item title.
5. Enter the price.
6. (Optional) Enter a description of the item under **Item info**. 
   
   **Note:** This description is visible to customers.
7. Select the **Is shippable item** checkbox if you plan to ship this item to your customer.
8. Click **Add**.
9. (Optional) Repeat to add additional custom items.

## Step 2 | Add a customer to the order
1. Click the **Add a customer to the order** drop-down.
2. Select an option:
   * **Existing customer:**
     1. Select a customer.
     2. (Optional) Click the Edit icon to view or edit the customer's details.
   * **New customer:**
     1. Click **+ Add new customer**.
     2. Enter the customer's details.
     3. If the customer asks to subscribe to your site, click the **Never subscribed** drop-down next to **Primary email** and select **Subscribed**.
     4. (Optional) Add an address.
     5. (Optional) [Add a label](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-labels-to-contacts-in-your-contact-list).
     6. (Optional) [Assign the customer to someone on your team](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-assigning-contacts-to-your-site-collaborators).
     7. (Optional) Click **Add New Field** to add more client info and fill out the new field.
     8. Click **Save**.

## Step 3 | (Optional) Add a discount
1. Click **Add Discount**.
2. Enter the discount amount.
3. (Optional) Enter a note about the discount (not visible to customers).
4. Click **Apply**.

## Step 4 | Add a delivery method
1. Click **Add Delivery Method**.
2. Select an option:
   * **Select an existing shipping option:**
     1. Click **Select from your shipping, delivery or pickup options.**
     2. Select an option from the dropdown and click **Add**.
   * **Create a custom shipping rate:**
     1. Click **Create a custom shipping rate**.
     2. Enter the shipping name (e.g. Express shipping).
     3. Enter the rate.
     4. (Optional) Add scheduling:
        1. Click the **Add scheduling** toggle to enable it.
        2. Enter the date and time.
     5. (Optional) Select the **Is this a pickup order?** checkbox.
     6. Click **Add**.

## Step 5 | Create the order
After checking that all the details are correct, you can go ahead and click **Create Order**.

### What's next?
The new order appears in the Orders tab of your site's dashboard. Make sure to contact your customer to arrange payment.

question: How can I improve my email bounce rate using Wix's email marketing tools?
answer:
Improving your email bounce rate is crucial for maintaining a good sender reputation. Here are some steps you can take using Wix's email marketing tools:

### Create a Good Quality Mailing List
- Only send email campaigns to people who have actively signed up or subscribed to be on your mailing list.
- [Enable Double Opt-In](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-a-subscriber-opt-in-checkbox-to-a-site-form) in your form settings, asking users to verify their email address.
- Only import contacts from the mailing lists that you have built up and have permission from people to use. Do not use purchased mailing lists or contacts you found online (e.g., Facebook).

**Tip:** You can [add a subscribe form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-subscribe-form) to your site to help grow your mailing list.

### Check Bounced Emails Regularly
- After sending an email campaign, check for typos in email addresses that have bounced.
- If you have alternate email addresses for subscribers whose email campaigns bounced, contact them directly and invite them to re-subscribe to your mailing list or reach out through another channel.
- If you are unable to correct a contact's email address, [delete it from your mailing list](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-contacts-managing-your-contact-list#deleting-a-contact) and don't send to it again.
- Never add a bounced contact back to your mailing list without verifying the email address and getting permission from the person.

### Review Your Mailing List Regularly
- Maintain your mailing lists by reviewing them every 6 months. It’s recommended to remove anyone you haven’t been in touch with during the past 12 months.
- Use an email validation tool to keep your mailing lists clean.

By following these steps, you can improve your bounce rate and enhance your sender reputation over time.

question: How can I add and manage multiple languages on my Wix site using Wix Multilingual?
answer:
To add and manage multiple languages on your Wix site using Wix Multilingual, follow these steps:

1. **Choose Translation Method**: Decide whether to translate your content manually or automatically. This allows your entire site to be translated instantly into a language of your choice.

2. **Manage Language Visibility**: You can choose to make the new language available to visitors or keep it hidden while you're working on it.

3. **Navigate Languages in Studio Editor**: Click the drop-down menu showing the current language in the top bar of the Studio editor to select a language to work on, or click **Manage Languages** to access the Multilingual dashboard.

4. **Use the Translation Panel**: Access the translation panel using the newly added languages dropdown at the top of your editor. You can translate your site's content automatically or manually for a tailored multilingual experience.

5. **Translate Site and App Content**: Translate both your site and apps content in one place on your site's dashboard - The [Translation Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-using-the-translation-manager). Add and translate as many languages as you want as your customer base and business grow.

6. **Manage Language Display**: Choose what languages to show or hide, and delete any languages that you no longer wish to display.

### Important
- Once you've selected your site's main language, you cannot change it to a different language. If this is something you'd like to see in the future, you can [vote for this feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-request-changing-your-sites-main-language).
- We recommend reviewing our list of translatable content before translating your site. [Learn more about what apps can and can't be translated with Wix Multilingual](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translatable-content#apps-you-can-and-cant-translate).

### Tip
Wix Multilingual affects your site's [regional settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-sites-regional-settings), automatically adjusting the date format, numbers, and other metrics to that specific locale.

question: How can I manually change the registration status for my Wix event to 'Open' or 'Closed'?
answer:
To manually change the registration status for your Wix event to 'Open' or 'Closed', follow these steps:

1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click to select the relevant event.
3. Click the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Edit** next to **Registration settings**.
5. Click **Open** or **Closed** to change the current status.
6. Click **Save**.

Note: You can change the registration status to 'Open' to allow guests to register after an event has started.

question: Can I delete multiple messages at once in Wix Inbox?

question: How can I enable pre-orders for a product in my Wix store?
answer:
To enable pre-orders for a product in your Wix store, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Store Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. [Create a new physical product](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-a-physical-product) or edit an existing one.
3. Scroll down to the **Pre-order** section.
4. Click the **Pre-order** toggle to enable it.
5. Enter a short pre-order message. 

   **Tip:** It's recommended to add a message about when the product should be available (e.g. Ready to ship by mid-May). The note appears above the pre-order button.
6. (Optional) Limit the number of possible pre-orders:
   
   1. Click **Limit to**.
   2. Enter the maximum number of pre-orders you can accept.

**Notes:**
- Pre-order is not currently available through the [standalone Add to Cart button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-setting-up-an-add-to-cart-button).
- When customers pre-order a product, they pay the full amount in advance. It's not possible to collect partial payment at checkout.

question: How can I add custom code to my Wix site and ensure it loads correctly?
answer:
To add custom code to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Custom Code** in the **Advanced** section.
3. Click **+ Add Custom Code** at the top right.
4. Paste the code snippet in the text box.
5. Enter a name for your code. 

   **Tip:** Give it a name that is easy to recognize so you can quickly identify it later.
6. Select an option under **Add Code to Pages**:

   * **All pages:** This adds the code to all of your site's pages, including any new pages that you create in the future.
     
     + Choose whether to load the code only once per visit, or on each page your visitor opens.
   * **Choose specific pages:** Use the drop-down menu to select the relevant pages.
7. Choose where to place your code under **Place Code in:**.

   * Head
   * Body - start
   * Body - end
8. Click **Apply**.

Make sure that your site is [published](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-publishing-your-site) and has a [connected domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-your-site-195136). The placement of your custom code depends on the instructions provided by the third party from which you received the code. Generally, place tracking and verification codes in the head section, and other functional scripts in the body section. Always follow the third-party provider's instructions for optimal performance.

question: What tools does Ascend by Wix offer to help manage and grow my business?
answer:
Ascend by Wix provides you with a package of tools to manage and grow your business, all within your Wix account. Ascend by Wix includes:

* **Contacts:** Keep track of everyone interacting with your site and business, all in one place. Learn more about [Contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-your-contact-list)
* **Wix Inbox and Chat:** Manage all of the interactions you have with your site visitors, across various channels. Add a fully customizable chatbox to your site and chat with your site visitors live. Learn more about [Wix Inbox](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-inbox-an-overview) and [Chat](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-chat-an-overview)
* **Wix Forms:** Create custom forms to collect information from your site visitors. Learn more about [Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-an-overview)
* **Wix Automations:** Create automated processes to save time on manual tasks. Learn more about [Automations](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-getting-started)
* **Wix Price Quotes and Invoices:** Send official price quotes to prospective customers and convert these to invoices once products or services have been ordered. Learn more about [Price Quotes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-price-quotes-creating-and-sending-price-quotes-to-clients) and [Invoices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-invoices-about-wix-invoices)
* **Tasks:** Organize and prioritize your work by creating tasks with reminders that keep you on track. Learn more about [Tasks & Reminders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-tasks-reminders)
* **Email Marketing:** Get the word out about your business with professional email marketing campaigns. Learn more about [Email Marketing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-getting-started)
* **Social Posts:** Reach out to your social media followers and drive traffic to your site with eye-catching posts. Learn more about [Social Posts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/social-posts-creating-and-customizing-a-social-post)

question: How can I add alt text to images in my Wix site using the Accessibility Wizard?
answer:
To add alt text to site images using the Accessibility Wizard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Settings** at the top of the editor.
3. Click **Accessibility Wizard**.
4. Click **Scan My Site**.
5. Select cards titled **Alt text**.
6. Enter the image description into the **What's in the image?** field.
7. Click **Set Alt Text**.

Make sure to publish the site so the alt text is live. Note that it is not currently possible to add alt text to images/galleries in bulk. If you would like to see this feature, you can [vote for it here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-adding-and-editing-alt-text-in-bulk).

question: How can I customize the SEO basics for my Online Program on Wix?
answer:
To customize the SEO Basics for your Online Program:

1. Click the **SEO basics** tab.
2. Customize the following SEO Basics settings under each field:
   
   * **URL slug (ending of the Online Program page URL):** This text is the last part of your page's URL. You should only change this if it's necessary to reflect the content of your page. We recommend keeping it short and easy to read. 
   
   **Note:** Click **Go to URL** to view the full URL that potential site visitors see.
   * **Automatically redirect visits from the old URL to the new one:** When you change an Online Program's URL slug, you can choose to let Wix automatically redirect visitors who try to use the old URL to the new URL. Alternatively, you can disable this toggle and [manually create your own redirect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site).
   * **Title tag:** Add a title tag that summarizes the content of the page. Enter your title tag as it is meant to appear on search engines results.
   * **Meta description:** Add a short meta description of the content on the page. This description helps users decide if the Online Program is relevant to them.
3. Click the **Let search engines index this page** toggle:
   
   * **Enabled:** Search engines will index your page. People can find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
   * **Disabled:** Search engines will not index your page. People cannot find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
4. Click **Save**.

question: How do I set up a Google Tag in Google Tag Manager for my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have connected Google Tag Manager to your Wix site as described in Step 1.

To set up a Google Tag in Google Tag Manager, follow these steps:

### a | Add a configuration tag
1. From the [Google Tag Manager account page](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/14842164?sjid=15113026945209550936-EU), click **Tags** from the left-hand side menu.
2. Click **New.**
3. Enter a name for the tag (e.g. GA4 Config).
4. Click **Choose a tag type to begin setup** under **Tag Configuration**.
5. Select **Google Tag**.
6. Add your Tag ID. We recommend creating a constant variable that contains the tag ID.
7. Click **Configuration Settings**.
8. Under **Configuration Parameters** click **Add Parameter**.
9. Enter “send\_page\_view” into the **Configuration Parameter** field and false into the **Value** field.

### b | Add a trigger to the configuration tag
1. In the **Triggering** section click **Choose a trigger to make this tag fire**.
2. Select "Consent Initialization - All Pages." [Learn more about consent](https://support.wix.com/en/article/enabling-consent-mode-in-google-tag-manager).
3. Click **Save**.

question: What are the pre-defined Google Analytics events available for tracking in Wix apps?
answer:
The pre-defined Google Analytics (GA4) events available for tracking in Wix apps include:

- **page_view**: When any page is loaded. (General)
- **view_item_list**: When the user has been presented with a list of items of a certain category. (Wix Stores, Pricing Plans, Wix Restaurants)
- **select_item**: An item was selected from a list. (Wix Stores, Pricing Plans, Wix Restaurants)
- **view_item**: Some content was shown to the user. Use this event to discover the most popular items viewed. (Wix Stores, Pricing Plans, Wix Restaurants)
- **add_to_cart**: An item was added to a cart for purchase. (Wix Stores, Wix Events)
- **remove_from_cart**: An item was removed from a cart. (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Restaurants)
- **begin_checkout**: A user has begun a checkout. (Wix Stores, Wix Events)
- **add_payment_info**: A user has submitted their payment information in an ecommerce checkout process. (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Restaurants)
- **purchase**: One or more items is purchased by a user. (Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, Wix Restaurants, Pricing Plans)
- **sign_up**: A user has signed up for an account. (General)
- **generate_lead**: Lead has been generated, through a form submission or initiating a chat conversation. (General)
- **Widget View**: When a site visitor has been presented with a list of upcoming events. (Events)
- **Select Date**: When a site visitor selects a date of appointment. (Bookings)

For more details, you can refer to the [Google Analytics documentation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/event-tracking-by-service#google-analytics).

question: How can I manually schedule an appointment for a client using the Wix app?
answer:
To manually book an appointment for a client using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Booking Calendar**.
4. Tap the **Add** icon.
5. Tap **Appointment**.
6. Tap to select an existing client or tap **\+ Add New Contact** to add a new one.
7. Select the relevant appointment.
8. Tap to choose the **Date** for the appointment.
9. (Optional) Create a recurring appointment:
   - Tap the **Repeats** drop-down and choose how often the appointment repeats.
   - Tap the **For** drop-down and select the total times the appointment repeats.
   - Tap **Select**.
10. Tap the **Location** drop-down to choose where the appointment takes place.
11. Tap the **Session starts** drop-down to choose the start time.
12. Tap the **Duration** drop-down to select how long the session lasts.
13. Tap the **Staff member** drop-down to assign a staff member.

   **Note:** A notification will appear if there are scheduling conflicts. You can continue scheduling or tap **Show free time slots** to choose a different time.
14. Tap the **Payment options** drop-down to select how your client will pay for the session:
   - **Use client's plan now:** Redeem the session from the client's [membership plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-membership-plan-in-wix-bookings) or [package](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-offering-packages) as soon as you schedule it.
   - **Use client's plan later:** Redeem this session from the client's [membership plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-membership-plan-in-wix-bookings) or [package](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-offering-packages) at a later date.
   - **Collect payment:** Charge the client for this session or mark as paid at a later date.

   **Note:** If your client doesn't have a pricing plan yet, you can tap **Sell Plan** to choose a plan for them, before continuing to create the appointment. Make sure you get the client's consent before signing them up for one of your pricing plans.
15. (Optional) Select the **Notify client with an email** checkbox to send your client an email with the details.
16. Tap **Book**.

question: How do I connect Opn Payments as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Opn Payments as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options.**
3. Click **Connect** next to **Opn Payments**.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Opn account, or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your Public key and Secret key
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account
   1. Click [**Create Opn Payments account**](https://dashboard.omise.co/signup?locale=en&origin=direct).
   2. Fill in the registration form.
   3. Wait for an email from Opn Payments to get your credentials.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Make sure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Opn account to avoid transaction issues. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: How can I set up a Multi-Checkbox input element to filter content on my live site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To set up a Multi-Checkbox input element to filter content on your live site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. **Go to your editor**: [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

2. **Add the Multi-Checkbox input element**:
   - Go to the page where you want visitors to use checkboxes to filter live site content.
   - Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
   - Click **Input**.
   - Click **Checkboxes**.
   - Click and drag the relevant Multi-Checkbox input element onto the page.

3. **Connect the Multi-Checkbox element to the CMS**:
   - Click the **Connect to CMS** icon on the Multi-Checkbox element.
   - Select **Filter content** in the panel on the right.
   - Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select the same dataset that connects to the elements (e.g., repeater, gallery, table) that you want visitors to filter.
   - Click the **Filter content by** drop-down and choose the collection field that visitors will use to filter the content. You can connect the following field types: **Text**, **Number**, **Tags**, **Reference**.
   - Click the **Condition** drop-down and choose an operator that controls how the filter is applied (e.g., **Is any of**, **Equals any of**, **Includes any**).

4. **Customize the Multi-Checkbox input element**:
   - Click the **Settings** icon to edit the field title that lets visitors know what the checkboxes do.
   - Click the **Layout** icon to choose a horizontal orientation or adjust the sizing, spacing, formatting, alignment, or text direction.
   - Click the **Design** icon to choose a preset design and customize it further.
   - Click the **Animation** icon to choose and customize an animation effect.

5. **Click Preview** to test your Multi-Checkbox element.

6. **Click Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How can I update the prices and availability for my rooms using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
answer:
To update the prices and availability for your rooms using Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, you can use the **Inventory Calendar** tab. Here, you can make changes to the availability and price rates for each of your rooms as required. You can filter the calendar view by Room type, Rate plan, or Channels.

For price or availability updates to multiple rooms at once, use the **Bulk Updates** tab. Here you can update your rooms, rate plans, and prices in bulk. Filter the view by Rate plan, by channel, or both.

Choose what you want to update from the following options:

* **Base Price:** Update base price rates for a given period of time. Choose between a fixed monetary adjustment or a percentage adjustment.
* **Availability:** Update how many rooms of a certain type you have available. Make sure this new number is accurate to avoid over-bookings.
* **Minimum stay:** Encourage longer stays by setting a minimum stay restriction. This is useful during high season.
* **Stop Sell:** Block the sale of certain rates for a period of time. This is useful during low seasons.
* **Closed to arrival:** Restrict guests from arriving on specific dates. This is useful during holidays to better manage your staff’s workload.
* **Closed to departure:** Restrict guests from departing on specific dates. This is useful to better manage your staff’s workload.

Then select the relevant start and end dates, and specific days of the week you want to update.

question: How can I add and set up online programs on my Wix site to generate extra income?

For detailed instructions on adding and setting up online programs, visit [this link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-adding-and-setting-up-online-programs).

4. **Use Wix Bookings for a full learning experience**: If you are a personal coach, you can create a 30-day challenge for your clients. Each day, post a new video, article, or resource. Guide and encourage them daily. Use the coaching sessions option in [Wix Bookings](https://www.wix.com/scheduling-software) to create a full learning experience.

By following these steps, you can display your expertise and earn passive income through Wix Online Programs.

question: How can I align multiple elements in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To align multiple elements in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Multi-select the relevant elements.
3. Click the **Layout** icon, or the **Align** icon on the Editor Toolbar.
4. Select an option:
   * **Left**: The elements are aligned to the left of the selected elements box.
   * **Center**: The elements are aligned to the center of the selected elements box on a vertical axis.
   * **Right**: The elements are aligned to the right of the selected elements box.
   * **Top**: The elements are aligned to the top of the selected elements box.
   * **Middle**: The elements are aligned to the middle of the selected elements box on a horizontal axis.
   * **Bottom**: The elements are aligned to the bottom of the selected elements box.

### Tip
You can also [position elements using the Editor Toolbar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-using-the-editor-toolbar-to-adjust-elements#positioning-elements-using-the-editor-toolbar) or drag an element until the Wix Smart Guide indicates that the elements are aligned evenly (vertically or horizontally).

question: How can I add and set up the Google Event Calendar on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites

question: How can I send a pay link to a customer for an unpaid order in Wix?

question: Is it possible to duplicate a collection in the CMS?

question: How can I flush the DNS cache on a Windows 10 computer to resolve domain connection issues with Wix?
answer:
To flush the DNS cache on a Windows 10 computer, follow these steps:

1. Click **Start**.
2. Type **cmd** in the search field.
3. Right-click **Command Prompt** and select **Run as Administrator**.
4. Type the following command: **ipconfig /flushdns**
5. Press **Enter**.

If the command succeeds, the system returns the following message: 'Windows IP configuration successfully flushed the DNS Resolver Cache.'

If you're still unable to view your site on your domain, review the [Wix Domain Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-domain-assistant-3777632) to make sure your domain is properly connected.

question: Can I customize the error messages for field validation in Wix Forms?

question: Is it possible to add a pagination bar to the Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to add a pagination bar to the Wix Pro Gallery to help visitors navigate your gallery.

### Workarounds
* You can [add a Load More button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-enabling-and-customizing-a-load-more-button) to your gallery to minimize the amount of content facing your site visitors when they access the page. This allows your visitors to load all the gallery images in one click, or section by section.
* If you are using the [CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started), it is possible to [connect a pagination bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar) to the Pro Gallery. With the CMS, you connect the gallery to a dataset that connects to a collection field where the media is stored. Then connect the pagination bar element to the same dataset and decide in the dataset settings how many items appear per page.
