question: Why was my email marketing campaign declined when using a certain sender address?
answer:
Wix does not allow sending email marketing campaigns from certain email domains. We automatically decline any campaign sent from these addresses. If your email address is associated with one of the following domains, you need to [update your sender email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-changing-the-sender-details-of-your-campaigns) in order to send future campaigns:

- @mail.com (including all domains used by mail.com services)
- @email.com
- @store.com
- @contact.com
- @shop.com

**Note:** The above addresses are only the most common examples of declined email addresses. To avoid these errors in the future, do not apply a mailbox you don't own in the sender address.

question: How can I add funds to my Wix Payments account to cover a refund if my current balance is insufficient?
answer:
To issue a refund and add funds to your Wix Payments account on desktop, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Your%20Transactions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpayments-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the payment to refund.
3. Click **Refund**.
4. Enter the amount you wish to refund.
5. (Optional) Add a note.
6. Click **Refund** and confirm by clicking **Yes, Refund**.
7. If you need to add funds to refund your customer:
   
   1. Click **Add Funds & Complete Refund** to add funds to your account.
   2. Enter your credit / debit card details and click **Add Funds & Complete Refund.**

To issue a refund and add funds using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to Payments in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap on the payment to refund.
3. Tap **Refund**.
4. (Optional) Tap the Note icon to add a note of the details of this refund and tap **Save**.
5. Enter the amount to refund, and tap **Issue Refund**.
6. Tap **Issue Refund** to confirm.
7. If you need to add funds to refund your customer:
   
   1. Click **Add Funds & Complete Refund** to add funds to your account.
   2. Enter the amount of funds to be added and tap **Continue**.
   3. Enter your payment details and tap **Add Funds.**

Once the funds are processed, we'll automatically refund the relevant customer. It may take up to 3-5 business days for the refund to appear in your customer's statement.

question: How can I use grids in Editor X to create complex layouts?
answer: In Editor X, a Grid is a two-dimensional CSS model that allows you to create complex layouts by defining their responsive behavior. You can choose the number or size of columns and rows for each breakpoint to ensure the composition is always pixel-perfect. When setting the size of your columns, rows, and gaps (gutters), there are many fixed and fluid measurements you can use, such as px, percentage, fr, and more. However, it is important to note that it is not possible to connect CSS grid elements to content collections. For more details, you can refer to the [Grid element in Editor X](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-grids).

question: Can I display more than 5 images per row in a Grid Gallery using Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to display more than 5 images per row in a Pro Gallery with a Grid layout. However, you can use the following workaround to display more than 5 items per row:

1. Click the Pro Gallery in your Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Layout** tab.
4. Select **Fit to screen** under Design Settings.
5. Drag the **Thumbnail size** slider to add more images to a row.

**Note:** It's possible more or less than 5 images will be displayed depending on your site visitor's screen size.

question: How can I upload files to the Media Manager using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To upload files to the Media Manager using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Media** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2019/06/12/b2ece2c3-ee2b-4da5-8a7d-c1ab0cb581db/d2911584-eca0-4bfd-9e7e-5e98de009b0b.png) on the left side of the editor.
3. Click the **Upload Media** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/01/23/bf60774f-c9c5-4b02-b9fb-7a1689d5b25c/de959ea7-a583-4de1-aae1-0ed6087f3cb9.png).

  2. Paste the URL link and click **Import**.

question: Can I duplicate my site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to perform additional site actions such as duplicating and transferring your site from the Wix app. You can perform all [site actions from your dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/managing-your-site/site-management).

question: How can I customize the signup form for my client's site using the Studio Editor?
answer:
To customize the signup form for your client's site using the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Hover over **Signup (Default)** and click the More Actions icon.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Select **Custom Form** under **Which member signup form do your visitors see?**.
5. Click **Add to Site** to start customizing.
6. Select the form on the canvas.
7. Choose how you want to customize the form:
   
   * **Manage the form:** Add more fields and remove those you don't need. You can also click individual fields to adjust the title, placeholder text, and other settings.
   * **Design the form:** Customize the form's design from the Inspector panel. Change the background, the input fields, and the button members click to submit the form.
   * **Adjust the form settings:** Click **Form Settings** to add conditional rules, change the email notification settings, and adjust the way new members are saved to the contact list.

### Tip
You can add any element you need (e.g., image, text, etc.) around the custom signup form.

### Note
Currently, it is not possible to add social login buttons (e.g., Facebook, Google) to the custom signup form. They are only available on the default signup form. [Vote for this feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-social-login-buttons-on-the-custom-signup-form)

question: Is it possible to set a default role for new team members who join my account by themselves?
answer:
Currently, it's not possible to set a default role that's assigned to all team members that [join your account by themselves](https://support.wix.com/en/article/sso-adding-team-members-to-your-account-and-assigning-a-role#adding-team-members-by-allowing-them-to-join-by-themselves).

### Tip
You can assign roles to team members in the Team Management section of your Partner Dashboard. [Learn more about assigning roles](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-partners-managing-the-roles-of-your-teammates)

question: How can I add a YouTube feed to my Wix Video widget?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed Step 1 by finding and copying your channel or playlist URL on YouTube.

To add a YouTube feed:
1. [Go to Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Channels** tab in the side panel on the left.
3. Hover over the **New Channel** drop-down at the top right and select **YouTube Feed**.
4. Paste your YouTube channel or playlist URL in the field.
5. Click **Connect**.

Note: It may take several hours for your embedded YouTube channel or playlist on Wix to sync with the latest uploads from the YouTube channel.

question: Can I create shareable links from the Wix app?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to create shareable links from the Wix app. You can create shareable links from the Sharable Links tab in your site's dashboard. For more information, visit [Wix Bookings: Creating and Managing Shareable Links](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-and-managing-shareable-links).

question: How can I connect my existing .ca domain to my Wix site using nameservers?
answer:
To connect your existing .ca domain to your Wix site using nameservers, follow these steps:

1. Ensure you have access to your current domain registrar.
2. Update your domain's nameservers to point to Wix. This will allow Wix to host your DNS records, enabling you to manage them in your Wix account.
3. Be aware that new DNS records may take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

For detailed instructions, you can learn more about [connecting a domain to the Wix nameservers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

question: How can I import media files from one Wix site to another using the Media Manager?
answer:
To import media from your Wix sites:

1. [Go to your Media Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-accessing-the-media-manager).
2. Click **+ Upload Media**.
3. Click **My Wix Account** on the left menu.
4. Select the file you want to import.
5. Click **Select Files to Upload.**

### Import files in bulk
Use the keyboard shortcut **Ctrl** + **A** (for PC) or **⌘** + **A** (for Mac) to select multiple files at once and import them in bulk from other sites to your current site.

question: How can I fix my menu to the top of my Wix site so it remains visible when visitors scroll down?
answer:
To create a fixed menu on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Place your menu in your header.
2. Click the header.
3. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/07/30/56387f0e-f08b-4c41-9bcb-ce15dba48541/0af2bd38-6dbf-45ae-b21f-ae14cb372f6e.png).
4. Click **Header Scroll Settings**.
5. Select **Freezes**.

### Tips
* We recommend keeping the height of your header small so it doesn't cover any element or content when visitors scroll through your site.
* You can also pin your menu to the top of your site by right clicking on your menu and selecting **Pin to Screen**. Freezing keeps the header always visible at the top, while pinning fixes it at a specific point as you scroll.

question: How can I add and customize business elements for my booking-based business in the Wix Member App?
answer:
To add and customize business elements for your booking-based business in the Wix Member App, follow these steps:

1. **Go to Mobile App** in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant tab (e.g. **Spaces by Wix app**, **Branded Mobile App**).
3. Click **Edit Mobile App**.
4. Click the **Screen** drop-down at the top and choose the screen you want to edit.
5. Click **Elements** on the left.
6. Select the relevant business category under **Add Elements** (e.g. Store, Bookings, Events or Table reservations).
7. Click the element you want to add to your screen.
8. Edit the element on the right panel of your screen. 

   **Note:** The details you can edit depend on the element you add.
9. Repeat steps 4-8 to add and customize additional business elements.
10. Click **Save & Publish**.

For booking-based businesses, you can add elements such as:
- **Upcoming bookings:** Remind clients of their upcoming bookings, allow them to easily book a new appointment and see their booking history.
- **Agenda:** Add a weekly timetable and make it easier for your clients to find and book the right service.
- **Services:** A list of all your services where your clients can book services straight from the app. Clients can also filter services by location.
- **Upcoming sessions:** A preview of your [upcoming sessions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-viewing-your-upcoming-sessions-in-the-wix-owner-app).

question: Can I add links to lightboxes in the Rich Content Editor?
answer: Currently, in the [Rich Content Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-rich-content-and-adding-it-to-a-dynamic-page), it is not possible to add links to your site's [lightboxes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-lightbox). This would allow you to create links in Rich Content fields used in blog posts and the CMS (Content Management System) that, when clicked, open lightboxes on your site.

question: How can I disable the pop-up blocker in Google Chrome to allow pop-ups from Wix.com?
answer:
To disable the Google Chrome pop-up blocker and allow pop-ups from Wix.com, follow these steps:

1. Click the **More** icon at the top right of your browser.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Privacy and security** on the left.
4. Click **Site settings** in the **Privacy and security** section.
5. Scroll down and select **Pop-ups and redirects**.
6. To allow pop-ups only from specific sites:
   1. Click **Add** next to **Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects**.
   2. Type **https://[\*.]wix.com** and click **Add**.

question: Can I add tags to gallery images in the Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, you cannot add tags to gallery images.

question: How can I translate CMS collection content on my Wix site using Wix Multilingual?
answer:
To translate CMS content that appears on your live site using Wix Multilingual, follow these steps:

1. Go to [CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20CMS&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, you can click **CMS** in your Editor.
2. Click the relevant collection.
3. Click **More Actions** at the top and select **Manage translations**. This opens the Translation Manager in Wix Multilingual.
4. Click **Add/remove collections** under **CMS** on the left.
5. Select the collection(s) you want to translate and click **Save**.
6. Click the collection that you want to translate under **CMS** on the left.
7. Auto-translate your entire site or each field individually:
   - **Auto-translate site**: Click **Auto-translate Site** at the bottom left.
   - **Translate each field separately**:
     1. Click the relevant field under **{Language} translation**.
     2. Manually enter your translation for the text or click **Auto-translate** to have the text translated automatically.
     3. Click **Done**.
8. Repeat these steps to translate each field.
9. Click **Save and Publish** at the top right to make the changes go live.

**Tip:** Click the **Restore Last Saved Translation** icon to revert the translation to its last saved version.

question: Can staff members sell event tickets using Check-in by Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible for staff members to sell tickets, which would also allow you to track the number of tickets each staff member sells. However, you can [add staff members](https://support.wix.com/en/article/check-in-by-wix-adding-and-managing-staff-members) to an event so they can check in guests, scan tickets and manage the guest list.

question: How can I customize the header of my branded app using the Wix app?
answer:
To customize the header of your branded app using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Mobile App**.
4. (If needed) Switch to editing your branded app:
   - Tap the member app name at the top (e.g. Spaces by Wix App).
   - Select your branded mobile app.
5. Tap **Edit**.
6. Tap **Change Header Design**.
7. Choose a header design for your home screen:
   - **Detailed**: Create your header with features like your logo, a cover photo, and more. You can choose how much content you want to include.
     - Tap **Customize** to edit your header.
       - **App info**: Add details about your app like a name and tagline. You can also enable the **Show logo** toggle to add a logo to your header. To add a header link with more about your business, including social links, contact info, and site URL, enable the **Show general info** toggle.
       - **Cover photo**: Tap **Add Image** to upload a cover photo. You can add multiple photos to create a slideshow. For slideshows, select a transition delay (in seconds) between photos.
       - **Members info**: Choose what member information you want to show in the header by enabling the available toggles.
       - **Action buttons**: Add an invite button to allow members to invite others to your branded app. You can also add a custom button, for example, a button to navigate users to another screen within the app.
       - **Note**: The available actions vary depending on the type of apps on your site.
     - Tap **Save** on the top right.
   - **Minimal**: For a more classic, clean look you can choose a minimal header to show a small bar at the top of your app.
     - Tap **Customize** to edit your header.
       - **Style**: Customize your header color to match your primary color or your background color. You can also choose which icons you want to display on the header.
       - **Icons**: Enable the toggles to add additional icons to your header.
       - **Note**: Depending on the Wix apps you've installed (e.g. Wix Stores, Wix Chat) you may see different customization options.
     - Tap **Save** on the top right.

question: How can I set up Wix Bookings to accept payments in person?
answer:
To set up payment in person with Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Booking Services](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Booking%20Services&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/offerings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select an option:
   * Click to edit an existing service.
   * Click **+ Add a New Service** to add a new one.
3. Scroll down to the **Price & Payment** section.
4. Click the Payment Preferences drop-down and select the option that meets your needs:
   * **Entire amount in person**
   * **Entire amount either online or in person**
   * **Online deposit and the rest in person**
     * Enter the amount in the **Deposit** field.

In-person payments aren't tracked automatically in your Wix dashboard, but you can manually [mark sessions as paid](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-manually-marking-a-service-as-paid).

question: How can I unhide an element in the Layers panel in Editor X?
answer:
To unhide an element in the Layers panel:

1. Click **Layers** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2021/11/24/b266b525-ae5d-4677-af91-23f8a8fa5d54/1a133fef-26dc-4c05-a7bf-9a82ad05bacb.jpeg) at the top of Editor X.
2. Locate the hidden element in the list.
3. Hover over the element and click the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2023/02/20/fb2eda34-eddc-4fac-9cc2-af32dd6a66a1/5232ffbd-3b70-45ee-9793-5d227cf0a1af.png).
4. Click **Display**.

### Tip
When adding an element to a smaller [breakpoint](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-managing-breakpoints) (e.g., mobile), it's always hidden on larger breakpoints (e.g., tablet). Following the steps above, you can make the element appear on other breakpoints as well.

question: How can I add staff to my Wix Retail POS and assign them roles?
answer:
To add staff to your store and assign them a role:

1. Go to [Roles & Permissions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20this%20Site&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website/authorization) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+Invite Collaborators**.
3. Enter your employee's email address. 

   **Note:** To invite more than one person, enter each email separated by a comma.
4. Select a role:
   
   * **Cashier:** Cashiers can checkout customers, open the cash drawer, and manage contacts.
   * **Store Manager:** Store managers have complete access to the POS tablet (including Wix Bookings services) and limited access to your site's dashboard.
   * **Custom Role:** You can define exactly which parts of your business the staff member has access to. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-creating-and-managing-custom-roles-for-collaborators)

   **Tip:** Click **View Role Permissions** for detailed information on permissions.

5. Click **Send Invite**.
6. Your new employee receives an email with the subject line **You're Invited to Collaborate on a Website**. Make sure they accept the invite by clicking **Accept Now**. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-accepting-an-invitation)

**Tip:** After adding staff members to your business, you can [use the POS tablet to track staff hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-retail-pos-managing-shift-management-for-team-members).

question: Can I customize the layout and design settings of the Related Posts element on my Wix Blog Post Page?
answer: Currently, the [Related Posts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-related-posts-to-your-blog) element does not have its own dedicated layout and design settings. The current settings are pulled from your Post Page settings.

question: How can I manage the privacy settings for my site members using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To manage the privacy settings for your site members using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Members Area**, then select the **Member Page**.
4. Select the Member Page element.
5. Click **Manage Member Privacy**.
6. Select an option under **Who can set their profile to public**:
   - **All site members**: This option lets every member choose whether or not to make their profile public. If a member makes their profile public, their name and profile image are displayed next to their activities (e.g. any comments, likes or [files](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-the-file-share-app) they post). The name and profile image are clickable, leading to the member's profile.
   - **No one**: This option means all of your members will have private profiles, with no option to make them public.
7. Select an option under **Who can see public member profiles**:
   - **Anyone**: All site visitors can see your members' profiles.
   - **Only site members**: Your members' profiles are only visible to logged-in site members.
8. Click **Save** to apply your changes.

question: How can I access the Microsoft Office 365 Admin Center through my Wix account?
answer:
To access the Microsoft Office 365 admin center through your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Business Email](https://manage.wix.com/account/mailboxes) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Manage at Microsoft** next to the relevant mailbox.
3. Login using your Admin credentials.

question: Is it possible to remove the black overlay from gallery images viewed in expand mode on mobile devices in Wix Editor?
answer:
Currently, when clicking a gallery image in expand mode while using a mobile device, a black overlay is added to the image. At the moment, you can remove the black overlay by removing the title and description of the image.

### Tip
Alternatively, you can switch to the [Wix Pro Gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-an-overview) which allows you to [customize the expand mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-customizing-the-expand-mode-for-your-gallery) window according to your preferences.

question: How can I change a member's login email on my site?
answer:
To change your member's login email, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Site Members](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Members%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/member-permissions/members) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant member and click the **More Actions** icon.
3. Select **Change login email**.
4. Enter the **New login email** for your member.
5. Click **Change** to confirm.

### Tip
You can also change a member's login email from [Contacts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Contacts&title=Select%20a%20site%20to%20update&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fcontacts) in your site's dashboard. Click the relevant member to open up their contact card on the right. The option to change their email is located in the **Member info** section.

### Note
The new login email must be unique and not associated with any other site member.

question: Can I hide the price of a service in Wix Bookings?
answer: Currently, you cannot hide the price of a service in Wix Bookings. However, for Appointments, you can now select a "No fee" pricing option. No price will be displayed on your site.

question: How can I resolve the issue of text being unreadable on top of an image in ADI?
answer: If you cannot see the text on top of an image it is because the text is a similar color to the image. To resolve this, you should [change the design of your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-customizing-your-sites-colors).

question: How can I add a note to a sale using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
answer:
To add notes to a sale using the Wix Retail POS tablet, follow these steps:

1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Sales History** from the bottom bar.
3. Tap the relevant sale.
4. Tap **Actions**.
5. Select **Add a note**.
6. Enter the note and tap **Save**.

**Tip:** You can also add a note when making a sale, after you collect payment.

question: How can I access my site settings in ADI to update my business information and manage my apps?
answer:
To access your site settings in ADI:

1. Click **Site** on the top bar inside ADI.
2. Click **Settings**.

From your site settings, you can update your business and social network information, optimize your site for search engines, get site analytics, manage your apps, handle your billing history and subscriptions, and access your domain and mailbox settings.

question: How can I enable sales notifications for my music on Wix?
answer:
To enable sales notifications for your music on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Music Settings**.
3. Click the **Sales notifications** toggle to enable it.

When enabled, you will receive an email notification whenever you make a sale. Notifications are sent to the email address registered to your Wix account.

question: How can I add a 'Book' button for a single service calendar to my Instagram business page using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To add a single service calendar 'Book' button to your Instagram business page, follow these steps:

question: How can I create a discount coupon for Pricing Plans using the Wix app?
answer:
To create a Pricing Plans coupon using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Coupons** under **Marketing**.
4. Tap **Add a Coupon**.
5. Select an option:
   * **Create a $ Discount coupon**:
     1. Tap **$ Discount**.
     2. Enter the amount that will be taken off the price.
     3. Tap **Next**.
   * **Create a % Discount coupon:**
     1. Tap **% Discount**.
     2. Enter the percentage of the discount you want to offer.
     3. Tap **Next**.
6. Enter the **Coupon Code** your clients enter to get the discount.
7. Enter the coupon name for your own records. 
   
   **Note:** This name appears in your coupons list.
8. Tap **Next**.
9. Choose which plans the coupon applies to:
   * **All plans:** The coupon can apply to any available plans you offer.
   * **Specific plan:** The coupon can apply to one specific plan you offer.
     + Click the **Service** drop-down menu and select a service. 
     
     **Tip:** If your site has Wix Stores or Bookings, you see additional options.
10. Choose the billing cycle that the discount applies to:
    * **First billing cycle:** Choose this option to only apply a discount to the first billing cycle of a plan.
    * **All billing cycles:** Choose this option to apply a discount to all future billing cycles of a plan until the coupon expires.
    * **Custom:** Choose how many billing cycle you want the coupon to last for.
      + Enter the number of first billing cycles the coupon applies to.
11. Set the coupon's start and end date:
    1. Tap the date under **Dates Valid**.
    2. Select the start date from the calendar.
    3. (Optional) Tap to select an end date.
    4. Tap **Save**.
12. (Optional) Enable the toggle under **Usage Limits** and enter the total number of times the coupon can be used.
13. Tap **Done**.
14. (Optional) Tap **Share** to share your new coupon.

question: How can I connect my WhatsApp Business account to Wix Inbox?
answer:

To connect your WhatsApp Business account:

1. [Go to Inbox](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Inbox&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/inbox/) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I connect my hotel to booking channels like Booking.com using the Wix Channel Manager?
answer:
To connect your hotel to booking channels such as Booking.com using the Wix Channel Manager, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your dashboard.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-sites-dashboard)
2. Click the **Hotels** tab.
3. Click the **Reservations** tab on the left side of the Wix Hotels dashboard to expand the options.
4. Click **Channel Manager**.
5. Click **Start Now**.
6. Select the first channel you want to connect.
   
   - **If you have an account with the selected channel:** Enter the required information (e.g. ID, username, and password). Information on how to access the information is provided.
   - **If you do not yet have an account with the selected channel:** Click the link provided to create an account, then enter the required information.

7. Click **Next**. 
   
   **Note:** If you selected Channels and **Room Types and Rate Types** do not appear on the **Room Type Mapping** page, [contact HotelRunner](http://support.hotelrunner.com/en/contact-us/).

8. Match the first room type (e.g. single room) to make sure the information entered in Wix Hotels matches the channel information.
   
   1. Map Availability (when the room is booked) for each room type, including room and price options.
   2. Map room rates. 
      
      **Note:** The mapping process is different for each channel.

9. Click **Next Room Type** and repeat the mapping process for each room type.
10. After all room types are correctly mapped, click **Complete & Send Room Mapping**.
11. Complete any additional steps required by the selected channel.
12. Click **Activate**.

After completing this process, reservations made in other channels appear in your Wix Hotels Reservation Calendar.

question: Is min-max sizing supported for typography styles in the Studio Editor?

answer: Currently, it's not possible to charge for multiple booking services from different orders at the same time. On both desktop and on the Wix app, you need to charge each order separately.

question: How can I set up the login bar in the Wix Editor to display a greeting before the member's name?
answer:
To set up the login bar in the Wix Editor to display a greeting before the member's name, follow these steps:

1. Click the Login Bar element in the Editor.
2. Click **Set Up Login Bar**.
3. Choose what people see on the Login Bar under **Select layout**:
   
   * **Avatar:** Only the member's profile picture is displayed.
   * **Name:** Only the member's name is displayed.
   * **Initials:** The member's initials are displayed, based on their first and last name.
   * **Full:** The member's profile picture and name are displayed.
4. (Optional) Enable the **Show greeting before name** toggle to add a greeting before your member's name. Then, enter your greeting text. 

**Note:** This option is only available for the **Name** and **Full** layouts.
5. Edit the text on the Login Bar:
   
   * **What does the bar say before login?:** Edit the text that appears before members log in. This helps your site visitors know what to do (e.g., Sign Up, Log In).
   * **What's the logout message?:** Edit the text that members click to sign out of their account.

question: How can I search for a file across all the sites in my Wix account?
answer:
To search for a file across all of the sites in your Wix account:

1. [Go to your Media Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-accessing-the-media-manager).
2. Click **Upload Media** at the top left.
3. Click the **Wix** icon.
4. Choose a folder to view the media.
5. Click on the relevant media to highlight it.
6. Click **Select files to upload**.

### Notes
* The titles of the folders you see in the **My Wix Account** tab of the Media Manager come from the name of your site itself. To change the title of a folder, you must [change the name of your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/renaming-your-site).

### Tip
Add tags to your media to help you locate it faster. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-adding-tags-to-your-media-files).

question: How can I create a QR code using the Wix QR Code Generator?
answer:
To create a QR code using the Wix QR Code Generator, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the QR Code Generator](https://www.wix.com/tools/qr-code-generator).
2. Click **Create QR Code**.
3. Select the content type you want your QR code to direct your users to: **Text**, **URL**, **Image**, **Email**, **PDF**, and more.
4. Enter / upload the relevant details / content.
5. Customize your QR code using the following options:
   * **Select Size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the final size of your QR Code. You can create a code of maximum size 1000 x 1000 px, and minimum size 100 x 100 px.
   * **Colors:** Choose the background and dots colors of your QR code.
6. Click **Download.**
7. Select the file type you want to download your QR code as: **PNG**, **SVG**, or **JPEG**.

question: How can I promote my event using a Link in Bio page with Hopp by Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed setting up a Hopp by Wix account.

To promote your event using a Link in Bio page with Hopp by Wix, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create a Hopp account
1. Go to [hopp.co](https://www.hopp.co/?utm_source=wix_support&utm_campaign=addingsettinguplinkinbiopage).
2. Click **Log In** on the top right to sign in, or **Get Started for Free** to create a new Wix account.
3. Select the relevant Wix site and click **Connect Site**. 
   
   **Tip:** You can click **Not Now** and [connect your Wix site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/hopp-by-wix-connecting-to-your-wix-account) later.
4. Choose a name to showcase on your page and customize the URL for your Link in Bio page.
5. Click **Create Account**.

### Step 2 | Customize your Link in Bio page
1. Choose the actions you want to show on this page (e.g. Event, List of Events), then click **Next**.
2. Select a template with a layout you like, then click **Use This Template**.
3. Add social icons to your page, then click **Next**.
4. Add an advanced [search box](https://support.wix.com/en/article/hopp-by-wix-adding-setting-up-your-link-in-bio-search-bar-and-search-links) to your page, then click **Add Search**. 
   
   **Tip:** We recommend adding this if you plan to include a lot of content Link in Bio page. This will help your visitors to find the event or info they need.
5. Click **Edit Page** to view and customize the page further.
6. Customize the [**Actions**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/hopp-by-wix-adding-and-managing-actions-for-link-in-bio) tab on the left to promote your event:
   
   **Get visitors to RSVP or buy event tickets**
   1. Click the **Actions** tab.
   2. Click **\+ Add Action**.
   3. Click **Events**.
   4. Click **Event**.
   5. Choose how you want visitors to join your event:
      * Enter the **Event page URL**.
      * Choose an event from your Wix site.
   6. Click **Next**.
   7. Customize the **Action Appearance**:
      1. Choose how you want to display the event.
      2. Enter a title to showcase the event.
      3. Click the **Button click behavior** drop-down and select how you want your event to appear.
   8. Click **Next**.
   9. (Optional) Edit the event **Display settings** and **Search settings** as needed.

### Step 3 | Publish your Link in Bio page
1. Click **Publish** at the top right of the Link in Bio editor.
2. Choose how to share your Link in Bio page:
   * Share a direct link.
   * Share on social media such as YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.

question: How can I manage sections in my self-paced online program using the Wix dashboard?
answer:
To manage sections in your self-paced online program using the Wix dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Online Programs](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Online%20Programs&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/challenges/list) in your site's dashboard.

question: What happens after a visitor purchases a gift card using the Gift Card app on my Wix site?
answer:
After visitors purchase gift cards using the Gift Card app, they see a confirmation message with the option to print the gift card. In addition, three emails are sent out:

* **Email to customer:** An email is sent to the buyer with the details of the purchase and an image of the card, which the buyer can print or forward by email. Tell your customers to check the spam folder if the email does not arrive. This email is sent from \[your email] via app-notifications.wix.com and has the subject line: Congratulations! You just purchased a gift card

* **Emails to you:**
  1. An email is sent to you (the site owner) containing information about the purchase, including the coupon code and "valid until" date. We advise you to keep this email so that when someone uses the gift card, you can verify the details. The email is sent from wix-team@app-notifications.wix.com and has the subject line: Someone just purchased a gift card from your website!
  2. A second email is sent which also included information about the purchase and contains a copy of the gift card. The email is sent from wix-team@app-notifications.wix.com and has the subject line: Copy of Gift Card ##\#\#-\#\#\#\#

Both you and the buyer can view details of the transaction in your PayPal accounts.

question: How can I change the DOM order of my site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the DOM order of your site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Select **Settings** on the top bar of your Editor.
2. Select **Accessibility Wizard**.
3. Select the More Actions icon at the top right of the Wizard.
4. Select **Advanced accessibility settings**.
5. Select **Automatic DOM Order**.
6. Disable the toggle in the panel.
7. Select **Turn It Off** in the pop-up window.

Next, adjust the DOM order manually:

1. Select the Layers icon at the bottom left of the Editor.
2. Check over the list and delete any redundant elements. This includes duplicate elements that do not have a use on your site and can confuse screen reader users.
3. Drag and drop the remaining elements into the desired order.

**Notes:**
- Navigating a site using the Tab key only navigates through the interactive elements and not static elements such as text. If you want to test out a screen reader on static elements such as text, follow the instructions in your screenreader's help center on how to properly navigate a website with a keyboard.
- Pinned elements are automatically placed at the end of the tabbing sequence. If you want it to be tabbed earlier in the sequence, we recommend that you unpin the element and place it in the header.

question: How can I send a payment request to a customer using Wix Inbox?

4. Click the **Message via** drop-down to select the channel to send your message through. 

   **Note:** The channels available to you depend on the contact information you hold for that person.
5. Click the Request Payment icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/be0b50df-801c-4d6d-b81c-dc49333eccac/2022/05/12/5736a995-1178-411c-a882-2cd2014f30e7/d669923f-743f-4e1a-b19e-d0c8c3572b9b.png).

question: Can I reorder widgets, design presets, and panels in Wix Blocks?

question: How can I edit my property rates using Quick Rates in the original Wix Hotels?
answer:
To edit your property rates using Quick Rates in the original Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your dashboard.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-sites-dashboard)
2. Click the **Hotels** tab.
3. Click the **Reservations** tab.
4. Select the checkbox next to **Show Rates**.
5. Click the new rate's starting date on the calendar, for the relevant room.
6. Move your mouse left or right until you reach your rate's end date.
7. Click your end date. 
   **Note:** You can click the date arrows and calendar to access dates that are not visible on your screen.
8. Select **Add Quick Rate**, from the pop-up menu.
9. From the pop-up: 
   * (Optional) Edit your start and end dates.

**Note:** When **Show Rates** is checked, the new rates appear bolded on your reservation calendar.

To delete a quick rate, repeat steps 1-5, and select **Reset Quick Rates** from the pop-up menu.

question: How can I ensure that each page of my Wix site appears individually in search results?
answer:
To ensure that each page of your Wix site appears individually in search results, you should add unique title tags and meta descriptions to each page. This will help search engines display them in search results. Your title tags and meta descriptions should be relevant to the content of the page, which will help your potential site visitors understand what the page is about based on the information displayed in search results. You can find more information on how to do this by visiting [this link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-seo-title-tags-and-meta-descriptions-to-your-pages). 

### Tip
If you want to prevent search engines from indexing an individual page, you can learn more about how to do this by visiting [this link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-preventing-search-engines-from-indexing-your-page).

question: How can I manage the preset markups for my site's pages in Wix?
answer:
To manage your preset markups in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your SEO Dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO).
2. Select **Go to SEO Settings** under **Tools and settings**.
3. Select the page type that you want to edit. **Note:** It's not possible to customize the default markup for your Main Pages. You can customize markup for individual pages in [the Edit by Page section](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-seo-settings-1420929#editing-the-seo-settings-of-individual-pages) or [in your editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/add-structured-data-markup-to-your-sites-pages).
4. Click **Edit** beside **Structured data markup**.
5. Choose what you want to do:
   - **Preview or switch a preset markup**: Click **Preview Preset** beside the markup you want to preview, or **Switch Preset** for pages that have multiple [preset markup options](https://support.wix.com/en/article/understanding-preset-markups-for-your-sites-pages).
   - **Include or exclude a preset markup**: Click the Show/Hide icon beside the markup you want to include or exclude.
   - **Create a custom markup**: Click **Preview Preset** beside the markup you want to create a custom markup from, then click **Convert to custom markup**. Enter a name for the markup, edit your markup under **Write your markup in JSON-LD format**, and click **Apply**.
   - **Create a new custom markup**: Click **+ Add New Markup**, enter a name for the markup, add your new markup under **Write your markup in JSON-LD format**, and click **Apply**.
   - **Edit or remove a custom markup**: Click **Edit** beside any custom markup you want to edit, or click the Remove icon beside any custom markup you want to remove.

### Tip
You can have up to 5 markups per SEO Setting (including the preset markup).

question: How can I use the Wix Analytics Insights page to improve my business decisions?
answer:
To use the Wix Analytics Insights page to improve your business decisions, follow these steps:

1. **Access the Insights Page:** You can find the **Insights** page under **Analytics** in your site's dashboard.

2. **Ensure Sufficient Visitor Data:** The insights on this page are based on visitor activity over the last 30 days. To see data on this page, your site must receive at least 50 visitors in the last 30 days.

3. **Explore Different Categories:** The Insights page is divided into distinct categories:
   - **Attention required:** Identify areas that need immediate attention, such as a decrease in traffic from specific sources.
   - **Growth opportunities:** Discover new opportunities, like popular product pages that could benefit from promotions.
   - **Trends:** Observe changes in stats and compare your site with others in the same category.

4. **Get Personalized Suggestions:** Alongside the insights, you receive tailored suggestions based on successful strategies used by similar sites. These suggestions can help increase traffic, sales, and more.

5. **Visit the Insights Page:** [Visit the Insights page in your dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Analytics%20Insights&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/analytics/performance/insights?referralInfo=sidebar) to start exploring and implementing these insights.

question: Can I customize the design of my portfolio gallery's expand mode in Wix?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to customize the design of your portfolio gallery's expand mode. However, you can set the expand mode's background color and fonts from your site's color and text theme. Keep in mind that customizing your site's color and text theme changes the color and fonts throughout your entire site.

### Workarounds
* To adjust the background color of expand mode: Edit **Color 1** of [your site theme's colors](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-your-color-theme).
* To adjust your media's title and description fonts in expand mode: In [your theme's text styles](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-working-with-text-themes), edit **Heading 4** and **Paragraph 2**.
* To edit the actual text that displays for your media files in expand mode: Go to [your project](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-portfolio-adding-and-setting-up-wix-portfolio#step-2-create-projects) and click **Manage Media**. Then enter the relevant text in the **Title** and **Description** fields.
* Alternatively, if you do not want to use expand mode, go to [the portfolio gallery settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-portfolio-customizing-your-wix-portfolio#customizing-the-project-pages) and select another option from the **When clicking on an item** drop-down.

question: How can I set up my videos for rental on Wix Video?
answer:
To set up your videos for rental on Wix Video, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.

4. Select **Paid**.

question: How can I connect a domain with special or foreign characters to my Wix site?
answer:
To connect a domain with special or foreign characters to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. **Purchase the domain** from another domain host (for example www.ex¥mple.com).
2. Use [this Internationalized Domain Names encoder](http://idn-encoding.online-domain-tools.com/) to translate your domain and change it to an **xn--** variant.
3. Connect the **xn--** variant of your domain to Wix's name servers. 

Learn how to [connect your domain to Wix's name servers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

### Important
Some browsers don't support the correct translation for the special character "ß" to "xn--". In this case, please use [the DENIC encoder to translate the .de domain correctly](https://www.denic.de/en/service/tools/idn-web-converter/#idnace-form) while using the special character "ß".

### Note
New DNS records may take up to 48hrs to fully propagate. Learn more about [domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: Can Wix automatically update invoices for unpaid orders after product changes?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to update an invoice when you add a new product to an unpaid order. Additionally, if you delete the invoice, it won't automatically regenerate with the new details added to the existing order.

question: Is it possible to disable fuzzy search in Wix Site Search?
answer: Currently, when you perform a search using Wix Site Search, you get some results that are not really relevant to your search. For example, if you searched for the word "Cat", you are matched with words that contain the letters "Cat". Disabling fuzzy search is not implemented yet.

question: Can I use a Wix promo code to renew my existing Premium plan at a discounted rate?
answer: No, promotions offered by Wix are valid for the **first** month/year of service (depending on the plan purchased) and cannot be used to renew an existing Premium plan. The discounted price is valid for the first year/month **ONLY**. All subsequent renewals are charged at the original price of the plan (without the discount). However, it is possible to [upgrade an existing Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-an-existing-premium-plan) using a promotional coupon.

question: How can I set my default business hours using the Wix app?

2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down and tap **Settings**.
4. Tap **Booking Settings**.
5. Tap **Default Hours**.

7. Enter a default start and end time for each day (e.g. 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM).
8. (Optional) Add another time period if your business closes at any point during the day:
   
   1. Tap **\+** **Add Hours**.
   2. Enter a start and end time. (e.g. 9:00 AM \- 12:00 PM and 1:00 PM \- 6:00 PM).

**Tip:** You can also [create custom working hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-editing-your-staff-members-working-hours) for your staff members outside your regular hours of business.

question: How can I set up a backup shipping rate for USPS Real Time Shipping in Wix Stores?
answer:
To enter a backup shipping rate for USPS Real Time Shipping in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

question: How can I create a form with input elements to manage collection content directly from my live site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Add the [CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site.
- [Create a collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection) that you want people to manage from the live site.

### Step-by-Step Instructions
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page or section where you want to create a custom form.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
4. Click **Input**.
5. Click the type of input element you want to add.
6. Click and drag the relevant input element onto the page.
7. Click the input element you added and select **Settings**.
8. Fill out the settings. The options vary depending on which input element you selected.
9. (Optional) Click the **Layout** and **Design** icons to change the layout or design.
10. Repeat steps 3-9 above to add as many input elements as your form needs.

By following these steps, you can build custom forms for your site's specific needs by adding input elements to your site. The elements used to make up your form accept content such as text and file uploads from visitors. Your collection saves the content submitted through the form. Learn more about [creating a form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-a-custom-form-with-input-elements-that-submit-to-your-collection) with user input elements.

question: How can I protect my Wix site from spambots and ensure that new members are genuine?
answer:
To protect your Wix site from spambots and ensure that new members are genuine, you can customize your site member settings and Wix Forms settings. Here are some steps you can take:

1. **Ask new members to confirm their email:**
   - You can choose to send a confirmation email to your new site members when they join. This ensures that they signed up with an active email address that they own.
   - You have the option to request confirmation from:
     - **Only new members who are already in your contacts:** This is the default email confirmation status and cannot be disabled.
     - **Everyone who signs up:** All new site members will be asked to confirm their email address. It is recommended to enable this for added security.
   - Enable this setting in the [Signup & Login Security](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmember-permissions/signup-login-settings%3F&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Member+Settings) section of your dashboard.

2. **Add a reCAPTCHA field to signup and login forms:**
   - You can add reCAPTCHA fields to your signup and login forms that site visitors need to check. If they don't check the field, they won't be able to continue to the member's area of your site.
   - Enable the reCAPTCHA field for your site members in the [Signup, Login, and Security](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmember-permissions/signup-login-settings%3F&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Member+Settings) section of Site Member Settings in your dashboard.
   - You can choose to show the reCAPTCHA boxes only to suspected bots or to everyone.
   - [Learn how to add a reCAPTCHA field to signup and login forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/managing-signup-login-and-security-settings-for-your-site-members)

3. **Add a reCAPTCHA field to your Wix Forms:**
   - You can also add reCAPTCHA fields to [your Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-an-overview) to protect your site from spam. This creates a checkbox on your form that your site visitors will need to check before they can submit it.
   - [Learn more about reCAPTCHA for Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-protecting-your-site-forms-from-spam-with-a-captcha-field)

question: How can I customize the privacy settings of the member signup form in Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the privacy settings of the member signup form in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Signup & Login**.
3. Select **Member Signup Form**.
4. Click the **Social & Community** tab.
5. Select the relevant option under **Signup privacy footnote customization**:
   
   * **Footnote only:** Members sign up with a public profile.
   * **Checkbox for members to choose profile privacy on signup.** You can enable the **Sign up to this site with a public profile** toggle for people to sign up with a public profile.

   * **Enabled:** The checkbox is automatically selected for a public profile.
   * **Disabled:** The checkbox for a public profile is not selected.

Additionally, you can set up an automation that [adds new members to your group automatically](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-creating-automations-for-your-group).

question: How can I set a lightbox to automatically display when a page loads in Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have added a lightbox to your page.

To set the lightbox trigger:

1. Open the relevant lightbox from the **Menus & Pages** panel.
2. Click the lightbox.
3. Click **Set Triggers**.
4. Click an option under **Automatically display lightbox on pages**:
   * **Yes:** Your lightbox is displayed when a page loads.
     + Click the **Which pages is it on?** field and select the pages you want the lightbox to appear on, or select the **First page visitor sees** checkbox.
     + Drag the **Delay** slider to increase or decrease the time between the page loading and the lightbox appearing.

   **Note:** This slider does not appear on all lightboxes.
   * **No:** The lightbox does not appear when a site visitor enters a page. Instead, you can link to it from elements on your site.
5. (Optional) Set a schedule for your lightbox. This is helpful for displaying offers or services that are available for a limited time:
   * **Dates:** Use the options to select the start date and end date for your lightbox.
   * **Times:** Select the start and end time for the lightbox schedule.
   * **Time zone:** Choose your time zone from the options in the drop-down.
   * **Clear scheduling:** Remove scheduling you previously added to the lightbox.

question: How can I manage my online store using the Online Store app by Ecwid Inc. from my mobile phone?
answer: With the Online Store app by Ecwid Inc., you can manage everything from your mobile phone. This includes controlling your inventory, order management, and pricing from a single dashboard. To get started, check out the [Online Store](https://www.wix.com/app-market/online-store) app by Ecwid Inc.

question: How can I edit the social media image, title, and description for a product in my Wix Store?
answer:
To edit images, titles, and descriptions for a product in your Wix Store, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Store%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the product you want to customize.
3. Click **Edit SEO Settings** on the right.
4. Click the **Social Share** tab.
5. Edit the product image: 
   
   * Hover over the image and select an option:
     
     * **Edit the existing image:**
       1. Click the **Adjust** icon to open the Photo Studio.
       2. Edit the image and click **Save**.
     * **Replace the image:**
       1. Click the **Change** icon.
       2. Select an image and click **Add to Page**.
6. Edit the title: Enter your title in the **og:title** field. 
   
   **Note:** By default, Wix uses your page's title tag.
7. Edit the description: Enter your description in the **og:description** field. 
   
   **Note:** By default, Wix uses your product's meta description.
8. Click **Twitter Settings** to set a different image and text for Twitter shares:
   
   1. Click the **Change** icon to select a different image.
   2. Choose a card size under **Select card size**.
   3. Add a title under **twitter:title**.
   4. Add a description under **twitter:description**.
9. Click **Save**.

### Tip
In some cases, Facebook might show outdated information about your product. Learn how to [troubleshoot outdated info and images on Facebook](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-troubleshooting-outdated-info-and-thumbnail-on-facebook).

question: Is it possible to automate the suspension or reactivation dates for pricing plans?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to automate what date an existing plan suspends or reactivates after a suspension. 

### Workaround
You can [set a reminder](https://support.wix.com/en/article/managing-your-tasks-reminders) in your dashboard to manually suspend or reactivate a plan on the required date.

question: How can I update the payment method for my active recurring subscription on a Wix site?
answer:
To update your payment method for an active recurring subscription on a Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Log in to the relevant Wix site.
2. Go to the **My Subscriptions** section of the Members Area.
3. Click the relevant plan.
4. Click **Update Payment Method**.
5. Click **Credit/Debit Cards** to add a new credit/debit card or select a previously saved credit card from the drop-down.
6. Enter the relevant details for the new credit/debit card.

   **Note:** The current credit/debit card details appear at the top to avoid confusion.
7. Click **Submit**.

### Notes
- This option is only available for active, online recurring subscriptions.
- Clients cannot update their payment method using the Wix Member apps, including the Spaces by Wix app or Wix Branded app.
- Clients can only update their payment method to a credit card, not PayPal.
- Clients need to update the payment method on each subscription separately (changes to one subscription do not affect all subscriptions).
- Adding a new payment method through “My wallet” does not update the payment method on the customers’ active subscription.

question: How can I create a custom role with Facebook Ads permissions in Wix?
answer:
To create a custom role with Facebook Ads permissions in Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Roles & Permissions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20this%20Site&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website/authorization) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Roles** at the top right.
3. Click **+ Create New Role**.
4. Fill in the details of the new role:
   - Enter a title under **Role Title** such as "Facebook Ads Manager."
   - (Optional) Add a description that outlines the new role.
5. Add Billing permissions to the new role so the site team member can manage the campaign's budget and pause or end a campaign.
   - Under **Permissions** click **Billing & Domains**.
   - Click **Manage Billing**.
6. Add Facebook & Instagram Ads permissions so the site team member can update the campaign as necessary.
   - Under **Permissions** click **Marketing Tools**.
   - Click **Manage Facebook & Instagram Ads**.
7. (Optional) Add additional marketing or business permissions to the new role.
8. Click **Save**.
9. After creating the role, assign it to the person you want to give manage campaign permissions to.
   - Click the Show more icon next to the role you just created.
   - Click **Invite People.**
   - Enter the email address of the person you want to give manage campaign permission to.
   - Click **Send Invite**. Once the collaborator accepts the invite, they are assigned to the new role.

question: How can I add a new field to my Wix site form?

question: How can I check if there are any Facebook comments on a specific page of my Wix site?

question: How can I avoid sending my email campaigns to Spam Traps?
answer:
To avoid sending your email campaigns to Spam Traps, follow these guidelines:

* Do not purchase email lists.
* Make sure all your recipients have given explicit permission to send them emails.
* Send your email campaigns only to your [active contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-about-active-and-inactive-contacts).
* Clean your contact list at least twice a year.
* Make sure to remove recipients with whom you have not been in touch for over 6 months. You can also use [campaign statistics](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-your-email-campaign-statistics) to locate and remove addresses that consistently bounce or remain unopened.

**Important:** Wix does not tolerate the use of illegitimate mailing lists and if a spam trap identifies that you are using such a list, your Wix Email Marketing account will be restricted. Purchased mailing lists are against the Wix Email Marketing [Terms of Use](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-terms-of-use) and [Best Practices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-email-marketing-best-practices).

question: How can I add a new booking policy using the Wix app?
answer:
To add a new booking policy using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Booking Services**, or tap **Catalog** and select **Booking Services**.
4. Tap **Settings** at the top.
5. Tap **Booking Policies**.
6. Tap **\+ Add a New policy**.
7. Tap to enter the **Policy name**.
8. Select the checkboxes and choose the timeframe next to the relevant **Client Booking Rules** below:
   
   * **Allow cancelation:** Select the checkbox to allow clients to cancel their booked sessions. Define how much time before a session clients can cancel their booking by choosing one of the existing options from the drop-down or create your own custom timeframe.
   
   **Note:** Only site members can cancel their upcoming bookings on your site.
   * **Allow rescheduling:** Select the checkbox to allow clients to reschedule their booked sessions. Define how much time before a session clients can reschedule their booking by choosing one of the existing options from the drop-down or create your own custom rescheduling timeframe.
   * **Limit early bookings:** Select how long before a session a client can book from the **Limit early bookings** drop-down. You can also select **Custom** to choose a specific timeframe (e.g., 1 week) before which clients can't make a booking.
   * **Limit late bookings:** Set how close to a session clients can book, for example, "24 hours before start time". Choose an existing option from the **Limit late bookings** drop-down. You can also tap **Custom** to choose a specific timeframe after which clients can no longer book a session.
9. (Optional) Enter your **Policy description**. Let clients know your policy terms and conditions by adding a note to your service pages. Clients see the policy on the checkout page when they book.
10. (For classes only) Allow clients to join a waitlist:
    
    1. Tap to select the checkbox next to **Allow clients to join a waitlist for fully booked classes**.
    2. Tap to enter the **Max. waitlist capacity**.
    3. Tap to choose how long **An open spot will be held for**.
11. (For classes and courses only) Tap to choose the **Maximum number of participants allowed per booking** for group bookings.
12. (For courses only) Tap to select the checkbox to **Allow clients book a course after it's already started**.
13. Tap **Save Policy**.

question: How can I add and set up a dynamic page for managing content in my CMS collection on Wix?
answer:
To add and set up a dynamic page for managing content in your CMS collection on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **CMS** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Your Collections**.
4. Hover over the relevant collection and click the **More Actions** icon.
5. Select **Add dynamic page**.
6. Select **Manage item page** and click **Add to Site**.
7. Click **Create Page**.
8. Modify the [collection permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-collection-permissions-overview):
   - Click **Go to permissions** in the banner at the bottom of the editor to edit the collection permissions.
   - If the banner disappears before you click it, follow the steps below to go to your collection permissions:
     1. Click the **What type of content will you store in this collection** drop-down and choose a preset setting (e.g. **Collect content** or **Custom**).
     2. Click the relevant drop-downs to choose who can view, add, delete, and update content.
     3. Click **Save**.
9. Edit the page permissions to determine who has access to the page:
   - Click **Pages** on the left side of the editor.
   - Hover over your dynamic Manage Item page and click the **More Actions** icon.
   - Select **Settings**.
   - Click the **Permissions** tab at the top.
   - Select an option under **Which members can access this page?**:
     - **All members:** Any signed-in member or site collaborator can access this page.
     - **Only selected members or paying customers:** Limit access to collaborators and [members with specific roles](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-creating-member-roles) or customers who purchased specific [pricing plans](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-an-overview). Choose from the following:
       - **Select from your Member Roles:** Allow collaborators or members with specific roles to access the page.
       - **Select from your Pricing Plans:** Allow customers who purchased specific pricing plans to access the page.
10. (Optional) Modify any of the input elements or buttons that connect to your dataset and CMS collection:
    - Click the relevant input element or button and select the **Connected to CMS** icon.
    - Edit the connections in the Inspector panel on the right.
11. Customize any other elements on the page you'd like to adjust. For example, you could edit the text near the top that explains to site members how to use the components to edit collection content.
12. Click the **Preview** icon at the top right to test your dynamic list page.
13. Click **Publish** when you are ready to make the changes go live.

**Tip:** [Add a link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-linking-to-dynamic-pages) to your new dynamic Manage Item page so visitors with relevant permissions can access it on your live site.

question: How can I process an exchange for a customer using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
answer:
To let customers exchange purchased items using the Wix Retail POS tablet, follow these steps:

1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Sales History** from the bottom bar.
3. Select the relevant sale. 
   
   **Tip:** You can search for a sale by order number, customer name, or customer email.
4. Tap **Actions** at the top right.
5. Tap **Exchange**.
6. Use the Plus icons to select how many of each product the customer wants to exchange.
7. Tap **Next**.
8. Select the new product the customer wants. 
   
   **Tip:** You can scan the new item with your barcode scanner or select it from the product list.
9. Select the type of sale:
   
   - **The order total is the same as the original order:**
     - Tap **Exchange**.
     - Select a receipt option:
       - Email Receipt: If prompted, enter the customer's email address.
       - Print Receipt: Receipt prints on your POS printer.
       - No Receipt: No receipt is printed or emailed.
   
   - **The order total is less - I need to refund my customer:**
     - Tap **Exchange**.
     - Refund the customer using the payment method they used to pay for the order.
     - Select a receipt option:
       - Email Receipt: If prompted, enter the customer's email address.
       - Print Receipt: Receipt prints on your POS printer.
       - No Receipt: No receipt is printed or emailed.
   
   - **The order total is more - I need to charge my customer:**
     - Tap **Charge** in the top right corner. The amount you need to charge your customer appears on the button.
     - Accept payment as you would for a regular sale.
     - Select a receipt option:
       - Email Receipt: If prompted, enter the customer's email address.
       - Print Receipt: Receipt prints on your POS printer.
       - No Receipt: No receipt is printed or emailed.

**Notes:**
- You can only accept exchanges for store products purchased at a POS, not online.
- You cannot accept exchanges when the order was paid for with a split payment.
- You can exchange orders paid for with a gift card only when the price of the exchanged products is the same (i.e., the customer isn't refunded or charged).

question: How can I verify my domain on Facebook to track events using Meta pixel?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your site's dashboard and the ability to add custom code.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Confirm you own your site domain on Facebook
1. Verify your domain on Facebook using the [meta tag method](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/domain-verification/verifying-your-domain#meta-tags). **Note:** It is not possible to upload an HTML file to confirm domain ownership.
2. Copy your meta tag.

#### Step 2 | Add your Facebook Meta Tag to your site
1. Go to [Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Custom Code** under **Advanced Settings**.
3. Click **Add Custom Code** at the top right.
4. Paste your Facebook meta tag in the text box.
5. Enter a meaningful name for your code so you can quickly identify it later if needed.
6. In **Add code to pages**, select **All pages**.
7. In **Place your code in**, choose **Head**.
8. Click **Apply**.

#### Step 3 | Return to Facebook to complete verification
Follow the Meta instructions to [associate Facebook pages with your verified domain](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/domain-verification/verifying-your-domain#associate-pages).

question: How does Wix ensure compliance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) for its users?
answer:
Wix has worked with a team of experts and has implemented the required adjustments to our products, services, and documentation, to ensure compliance with the LGPD. This empowers Wix customers to get more control over their personal data and gain the tools necessary to protect the information of visitors to Wix sites. In accordance with the LGPD, site visitors have the right to access their data or to be permanently deleted from your databases. Wix has developed tools to assist you in becoming LGPD compliant:

- [**The right to access**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/gdpr-about-your-customers-data#getting-a-copy-of-your-customers-data).
- [**The right to be deleted**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/gdpr-about-your-customers-data#permanently-deleting-your-customers-data).

question: How can I set up an eCommerce conversion based on purchase using Google Tag Manager?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- You need to [connect Google Tag Manager to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-your-google-tag-manager-account-to-your-wix-site) before you can set up conversion tracking.
- First, [create a conversion action](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/12216424?sjid=6783535481547499834-EU) in your Google Ads account to get the Conversion ID and Conversion label.

### Create an eCommerce conversion based on purchase
After you've created your conversion action, set up 2 variables in your Google Tag Manager account. Then, create 2 triggers that use these variables so that you can track your conversion action. Finally, you can start tracking the conversion action by creating 2 tags.

#### a | Create 2 variables
1. Go to [Google Tag Manager](https://tagmanager.google.com/).
2. (If required) Select the container that you want to create variables in.
3. Click **Variables**.
4. Click **New** under **User-Defined Variables**.
5. Enter "dl_transaction_id" as the name for the variable.
6. Click **Choose a variable type to begin setup**.
7. Select **Data Layer Variable** under **Page Variables**.
8. Enter "ecommerce.purchase.actionField.id" under **Data Layer Variable Name**.
9. Click **Save**.
10. Click **New** under **User-Defined Variables**.
11. Enter "dl_conversion_value" as the name for the variable.
12. Click **Choose a variable type to begin setup**.
13. Select **Data Layer Variable** under **Page Variables**.
14. Enter "ecommerce.purchase.actionField.revenue" under **Data Layer Variable Name**.
15. Click **Save**.

#### b | Create 2 triggers
1. Click **Triggers**.
2. Click **New**.
3. Enter a name for the trigger. 

   **Tip:** We recommend "tr_pageview" or similar.
4. Click **Choose a trigger type to begin setup**.
5. Select **Custom Event** under **Other**.
6. Enter "Pageview" under **Event name**.
7. Click **Save**.
8. Click **New**.
9. Enter a name for the trigger. 

   **Tip:** We recommend "tr_purchase" or similar.
10. Click **Choose a trigger type to begin setup**.
11. Select **Custom Event** under **Other**.
12. Enter "Purchase" under **Event name**.
13. Click **Save**.

#### c | Create 2 tags
1. Click **Tags**.
2. Click **New**.
3. Enter a name for the tag. 

   **Tip:** We recommend "conversion_linker" or similar.
4. Click **Choose a tag type to begin setup**.
5. Select **Conversion Linker**.
6. Click **Choose a trigger to make this tag fire**.
7. Select **tr_pageview**.
8. Click **Save**.
9. Click **New**.
10. Enter a name for the tag. 

    **Tip:** We recommend "conversion_tracking" or similar.
11. Click **Choose a tag type to begin setup**.
12. Select **Google Ads Conversion Tracking**.
13. Enter the following information:

    * **Conversion ID:** Enter your Conversion ID from your Google Ads conversion action.
    * **Conversion Label:** Enter your Conversion Label ID from your Google Ads conversion action.
    * **Conversion Value:** Enter "dl_conversion_value".
    * **Transaction ID:** Enter "dl_transaction_id".
    * **Currency Code:** Enter your 3-character currency code.
14. Click **Choose a trigger to make this tag fire**.
15. Select **tr_purchase**.
16. Click **Save**.
