question: How can I duplicate and edit a Wix Analytics report to create a customized report for my business?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that your Wix site is upgraded to the [Business Elite plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) (for Wix Editor users) or an [Elite plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-upgrading-sites) (for Studio users).

### To duplicate a report:
1. [Go to All Reports](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=All%20Reports&actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fanalytics/reports/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the report you want to duplicate.
3. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/3eadcc04-813b-4e69-acf6-5bb047eced92/2024/10/10/1ef37cf7-6df5-46b2-8b8b-7e76a050d567/c2254483-9602-45b9-a645-9309d26e5984.png) at the top right and select **Duplicate and edit report**.
4. Click **Start Now** on the pop up window.
5. Add your report title, select the display type (e.g. line chart, table), and a description which any collaborator you’re working with may find useful.
6. Click **Duplicate**.

### Tip
After duplicating and saving a report, you'll be able to access it in your **Custom Reports** list on the **All Reports** page.

### To edit the dashboard:
1. Click the **More Actions** icon ![more](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/1de041c3-9554-4d04-9ed8-d7e127f698b3/2020/06/05/7f6896b5-469f-436b-8f6f-f87a9f3d2e84/35084d4a-056c-4fb9-a0d4-b7cf1e2f9e6b.jpg).
2. Select **Edit dashboard** from the drop-down menu.

### To edit an existing tile:
1. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/1de041c3-9554-4d04-9ed8-d7e127f698b3/2020/06/05/fd540f3e-5060-41f9-ad43-418479b6cc22/83ced5ec-5e9d-41a0-a8ce-4f47855e4a7f.jpg).
2. Click **Edit**.
3. Change the Tile data by selecting and deselecting Dimensions and Measures.

### How to choose Dimensions and Measures
- **Dimensions** are qualitative and cannot have math functions applied.
- **Measures** are quantitative and can have math functions applied.

### To run your report:
Click **Run** at the top right. Your results will load in the data pane.

### To choose how to view your report:
You can choose to see your data in a table, bar chart, columns, scatterplot, line, area, pie chart, map, or single value. Click your preferred visualization icon, and your data will be displayed accordingly.

### To save your updated tile:
Click **Save**, and the tile will be updated.

### (Optional) Add additional tiles:
You can [add additional tiles](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-new-wix-analytics-report#step-2-add-a-tile-to-your-report) to enrich your reports.

### To save your updated report:
Once you're done editing your report, click **Save** at the top right.

question: How do I add my store products to a Facebook Catalog using Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites: You must have [your Wix online store set up](https://support.wix.com/en/wix-stores/setting-up-your-store) in order to create a Facebook Catalog.

To add your store products to a Facebook Catalog using Wix, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Create a Facebook Catalog
To get started you need to create a Facebook Catalog for your products in Meta Commerce Manager.

### To create a catalog:
1. Go to [Meta Commerce Manager](https://www.facebook.com/products/?business_id=10152719914880429).
2. Click **Get Started**.
3. Select **Create a Catalog**.
4. Select **Ecommerce**.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Select **Upload Product Info**.
7. Select an owner for the catalog from the **Catalog Owner** drop-down.
8. Enter a name for your catalog in the **Catalog Name** field.
9. Click **Create**.
10. Click **View catalog**.

## Step 2 | Upload your products to your Facebook Catalog
The next step is to upload the physical products you want to add to your Facebook Catalog.

### To upload your products:
1. Click **Data Sources** under **Catalog**.
2. Select **Data Feed**.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Select **Yes** under **Are you ready to upload your spreadsheet?**.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Select **Use a URL** under **Choose how to upload your file**.

### Note
Keep this tab open as you continue into the next step. You'll need 2 tabs open to complete the set up process.

## Step 3 | Connect your Facebook Catalog to your Wix site
The last step is to connect your Facebook Catalog into the marketing integrations on your Wix site.

### To connect your Catalog:
1. In a new tab, go to [Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmarketing-integration%3FreferralInfo%3Dmarketing_integrations_article_link&title=Marketing%20Integrations&buttonText=Add%20Integrations).
2. Click **Connect** under **Facebook Catalog**.
3. Click **Get your Data Feed**.
4. Click **Copy** to copy the URL on the **Here's Your Facebook Catalog Feed** pop-up.
5. Click **Close**.
6. Go back to Meta Commerce Manager and paste the URL under **Enter URL**.
7. Click **Next**.
8. Set the schedule for how often you want the data feed to be updated.
9. Click **Next**.
10. Add a name for your data source and choose a default currency.
11. Click **Upload**.

question: Can I use a debit or pre-paid card to pay for Wix services, and what should I do if the payment is rejected?
answer: Wix accepts debit and pre-paid cards for payment, however the cards must be authorized for both recurring payments and online purchases. If you attempt to pay with a debit or prepaid card and receive a rejection of payment with no clear reason, please contact the issuer of the card and explain you wish to buy an online plan or service from Wix.

question: How can I add a WhatsApp link to a button on my Wix site?
answer:
To link a button to your WhatsApp on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Add a button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-text-icon-button) to your page.
2. [Change the button text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-text-icon-buttons#step-2-change-the-button-text), for example, "Contact on WhatsApp".
3. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/e81e2c4c-a111-4aea-ab65-0c5e2db6619e.png).
4. Click **Web Address**.
5. Choose an option:
   
   * **Create a link without a message:** Create a link that opens a WhatsApp conversation, with no automated message the visitor can send. Enter the following address under **What's the web address (URL)?**: https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=**<number>**
     
     + **Note:** The <number> should be your full phone number in international format. Omit any zeros, brackets, or dashes when adding the phone number.
   * **Create link with custom message:** Create an automated message that visitors can send as WhatsApp opens. Enter the following address under **What's the web address (URL)?**: https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=**12125558471**&text=**Hi%20requesting%20a%20callback.%20Thanks**.
     
     + **Notes:**
       
       - The <number> should be your full phone number in international format. Omit any zeros, brackets, or dashes when adding the phone number.
       - To add a space in your custom message use '%20'.
6. Click **Done**.

### Tip
Click **Change Text & Icon** and upload the WhatsApp icon if you want it to appear on your button.

question: How can I add an additional meta tag to my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add an additional meta tag to your Wix site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

question: Can I limit my collaborator's access to member pages on my site according to their role?

question: How do I set up rooms in Wix Hotels after adding the app to my site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added Wix Hotels to your site.

To set up your rooms:

1. Click the Wix Hotels app in the Editor and click **Manage**.
2. Choose your property type and click **Next**.
3. Click **Add Rooms**.
4. Add your first room type (e.g., Standard, Deluxe, Superior):
   
   1. Enter the room details:
      * **Name this room:** Enter a name for the room. Many hotels use descriptive names such as Standard, Deluxe, Suite to help guests decide which one to pick.
      * **Units:** Enter the number of rooms of this type.
      * **Max Guests:** Enter the maximum number of guests this room can hold.
      * **Max Kids:** Enter the maximum number of kids this room can hold.
      * **Room Size:** Enter the room size. Click the drop-down to switch the units.
   2. Add the bed details:
      1. Click the **Bed type** drop-down and select an option.
      2. Enter the number of beds of this type.
      3. (Optional) Repeat for each bed in the room.
   3. Select the room amenities.
      * Click **+More Amenities** for additional options or to add your own.
   4. Add up to 10 photos of the room:
      1. Click **Add Photos**.
      2. Select the photos from your media manager or click Upload Media to upload them from your computer. **Tip:** Hold down the **Ctrl** / **Cmd** key to select multiple images at once.
      3. Click **Add to Page**.
   5. Enter a description of the room.
   6. Set the room price:
      1. Click the **Rate type** drop-down and select an option:
         * **Charge per room:** Charge one price for the room, regardless of the number of guests (you can still add an extra charge for guests over a certain number)
         * **Charge per person:** Charge for each guest individually.
      2. Enter the regular room price in the **Weekday price** field.
      3. (Optional) Enter a special price for weekends in the **Weekend price** field.
      4. Click **+ More pricing options** for additional options such as setting a weekly or monthly price, and charges for additional guests.
   7. Click **Save**.
5. (Optional) Click **Create New** and repeat step 4 for each room type you want to add.

question: How can I automatically assign badges to site members using Wix Automations?
answer:
To automatically assign badges to site members using Wix Automations, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation.**
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Click the app you'd like to base your trigger on in the **Trigger** section.
6. Select your chosen trigger from the available options.
7. Click **Assign a badge** in the **Action** section.
8. Click **+ Add Badge** and choose what you want to do:
   
   * **Select existing badge(s):** Select the checkbox next to the badge(s) you want to automatically assign.
   * **Create new badge(s):** Click **+ New Badge** and provide some information to create a new badge:
     
     + **Badge name:** Enter a name for your badge.
     + **Description:** Enter some text to explain to members why/when this badge is awarded.
     + **Background color:** Use the drop-down to select your preferred background color.
     + **Text color:** Use the drop-down to select your preferred text color.
     + **Icon:** Click **+** to choose an icon to appear on your badge.
9. Click **Save**.
10. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
11. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
    
    * **Immediately:** The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
    * **Set custom time:** The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
12. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
    
    * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
    * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
    * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
13. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
14. Click **Activate** to save and activate your new automation.

question: Why can't my customers apply a coupon code during the Wix Events checkout process?
answer:
If your customers are unable to apply a coupon code during the Wix Events checkout process, please ensure the following:

1. **The coupon was created for the Wix Events app**: Make sure the coupon is set to apply to either a specific ticket, a specific event, or all tickets. To verify this:
   - Go to the [Coupons tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
   - Select the coupon you want to check.
   - Check what is selected from the **Apply** to drop-down.
   - (If necessary) Select a different option and click **Save**.

2. **The coupon was entered correctly (case sensitive)**: Ensure that the coupon code is entered with the correct use of upper and lowercase letters.

3. **The coupon has not been restricted to a specific event or ticket type**: If the coupon is restricted to a specific ticket or event, it cannot be used for a different ticket or event. To verify this:
   - Go to the [Coupons tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
   - Select the coupon you want to check.
   - Check what is selected from the **Apply** to drop-down.
   - (If necessary) Select a different option and click **Save**.

4. **The coupon has not expired**: Check that the coupon is still valid. To verify this:
   - Go to the [Coupons tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
   - Select the coupon you want to check.
   - Check the dates in the Valid between section.
   - (If necessary) Change the end date or select **Don't set an end date** and save.

5. **The coupon does not have a limited number of uses**: Ensure the coupon has not reached its usage limit. To verify this:
   - Go to the [Coupons tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
   - Select the coupon you want to check.
   - Check the info in the **Limit uses** section.
   - (If necessary) Increase the limit or select **Unlimited** and save.

question: How do I set up a Point of Sale with Square using the Wix Mobile POS?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed the download of the Wix app as described in Step 1.

### Step 2 | Download the Square app
To use Square for POS sales, you need to download the Square app to your mobile device.

#### To download to an iOS device:
1. Open the App Store on your iOS device.
2. Search for Square Point of Sale (POS).
3. Tap **Get** next to Square Point of Sale (POS).
4. Tap **Install**.

#### To download to an Android device:
1. Open the Play Store on your Android device.
2. Search for Square Point of Sale (POS).
3. Tap Square Point of Sale (POS).
4. Tap **Install**.

### Step 3 | Set up Square as your payment provider
Go to **Accept Payments** in your site's dashboard and [set up Square as your payment provider](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-square-as-a-payment-provider#connecting-square-for-online-transactions).

### Note
You can set up Square without an upgrade, but to start collecting payments, you'll need a [Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) or [Studio plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-upgrading-sites) that supports payments.

### Step 4 | Order a magstripe card reader
To swipe credit cards, you need a magstripe card reader which plugs into your smartphone or tablet's headphone jack.
Contact Square to order your free magstripe reader. [Learn how](https://squareup.com/us/en/hardware/reader)

### Notes
* You can also manually enter your customer's credit card number. When you do so, Square charges a higher processing fee.
* Inventory is not automatically updated in the Square app. You can, however, set up real-time inventory updates in Square using [the skuIQ inventory app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/third-party-app-skuiq-real-time-inventory-sync-by-skuiq).

question: How do I set up System Cross Identity Management (SCIM) for my Wix account using Azure?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have a role with the Manage SSO and SCIM permission to customize the settings of your dashboard.

### Step 1: Create an app in your IdP
1. Sign in to your [Azure account](https://portal.azure.com/).
2. Select **Azure Active Directory**.
3. Select **Enterprise applications**.
4. Select **New application**.
5. Click **Create your own application**.
6. Enter a name for your application.
7. Select **Integrate any other application you don't find in the gallery**.
8. Click **Add**.
9. Select **Provisioning** in the left panel.
10. Select **Automatic** from the **Provisioning Mode** drop-down menu.
11. Leave the tab open.

### Step 2: Create your SCIM URL and add it to Azure
1. In a new tab, [go to your enterprise dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/enterprise-dashboard/home).
2. Click **Settings** on the left.
3. Select **SSO and SCIM Settings**.
4. Click **Set Up** next to **SCIM**.
5. Click **Get Started**.
6. Select a default role using the drop-down menu.
7. Click **Set Role & Continue**.
8. Click **App Created, Next Step**.
9. Copy the URL.
10. Go back to the tab with your Azure dashboard.
11. Paste the URL in the field under **Tenant URL**.

### Step 3: Get your provisioning key and add it to Azure
1. Go back to the tab with your dashboard.
2. Click **Next**.
3. Click **Send Code**.
4. In a new tab, go to your email account and login.
5. Copy the 6-digit code in your verification email.
6. Go back to the tab with your dashboard.
7. Paste the code under **Enter your 6-digit code**.
8. Click **Verify & Generate Token**.
9. Copy your provisioning token.
10. Go back to the tab with your Azure dashboard.
11. Paste the provisioning token in the field under **Secret Token**.
12. Click **Test Connection** to make sure that it's working correctly.
13. Click **Provision Azure Active Directory Users** under **Mappings**.
14. Select **mailNickname** under **Attribute Mapping**.
15. Select **ObjectId** from the drop-down menu under **Source attribute**.
16. Click **Ok**.
17. Click **Save**.
18. Click **Yes** on the pop-up.

### Step 4: Select the groups to sync and start provisioning
1. Go back to the overview page of your Azure app.
2. Select **Users and groups** in the left sidebar.
3. Click **Add user/group**.
4. Select the groups or users that you want to sync.
5. Click **Select**.
6. Click **Provisioning** in the left sidebar.
7. Click **Start provisioning**.

### Step 5: Map your organization's groups to Wix roles
1. Go back to the tab with your dashboard.
2. Click **Next**.
3. Click **Finish**.
4. Click **Refresh** under **Map your organization's groups to Wix roles** to see your groups.
5. Hover over the group that you want to map under **Map your organization's groups to Wix roles**.
6. Click **Change Role**.
7. Select the role that you want to use under **Role & Site Access**.
8. Click **Save**.

question: How can I resolve a 401 Unauthorized error when trying to access a webpage?
answer:
If you receive an Error 401 (Unauthorized) message, it means you're trying to access a page that you must first log in with a valid user ID and password to view.

## To resolve a 401 error message:
1. Check that the URL (web address) you are trying to access is correct, then re-enter it in your address bar and press **Enter**.
2. If you're trying to access a page other than the homepage, go to the homepage URL (e.g., www.mystunningwebsite.com), then look for a login link, click it, and enter your credentials.
3. If you're using incorrect credentials, follow the steps on the site to reset your password or contact the site owner to request access.
4. Use another [supported browser](https://support.wix.com/en/article/supported-browsers). If the error only occurs in one browser, [clear your browser's cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache).

question: How do I download and set up an encoder for live streaming using OBS Studio?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that your computer meets the system requirements for OBS Studio.

### Step 1 | Download the Installer from OBS Studio
1. Go to the OBS Studio [downloading page](https://obsproject.com/download).
2. On the download page, select your computer's operating system.
3. Scroll down and click **Download Installer**.

### Step 2 | Install the Encoder on Your Computer
1. On your computer, open the OBS Installer. 
   **Note**: If you see a verification window, click **Install anyway**.
2. Click **Next**.
3. Click **I Agree**.
4. Choose where the file should go and click **Next**.
5. Review the components and click **Install**.
6. Click **Finish**.

### Step 3 | Connect Your Camera to the Encoder
1. On your computer, open the OBS Studio Encoder.
2. On the bottom left, under **Sources**, click **Add**.
3. From the list, select **Video Capture Device**.
4. Select **Create New** and name your camera and click **OK**.
5. From the **Device** drop-down list, select your computer's integrated camera and click **OK**.

### Step 4 | Change Your Streaming Settings
1. Open the OBS Studio Encoder on your computer.
2. Click **Settings** on the bottom right.
3. Select the **Output** tab to change the codec, audio and video bitrates.
4. Select the **Video** tab to change the video resolution.

**Note**: To get the best results, make sure you don't exceed the following settings: 
* Video Resolution: 720p (1280x720)
* Codec: x264
* Video bitrate: ~2500 kbps
* Audio bitrate: AAC 44.1kHz ~128kbps

Currently, Wix Video only offers support and troubleshooting for the OBS Studio encoder - other encoders may not connect with Wix Video. If you want to use a different encoder, make sure you know where to enter the Server URL and the stream key.

question: Can I create a multipath automation to send different emails based on the amount spent in a store order?

You can't set different paths (with different actions) depending on the amount spent - path A sending an email to customers spending up to $50, path B sending a coupon to customers spending $50 - $100, path C adding a VIP label to customers spending over $100, etc.

question: Can I disable the maximum delivery or pickup time for orders in Wix Restaurants?

question: How can I choose a format for displaying date and time fields in my CMS collection on a live site?
answer:
To choose a format for displaying date and time fields in your CMS collection on a live site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Connect an element, such as text, to a [dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset) that connects to your collection.
3. Click the relevant field (e.g. **Text connects to**) in the dataset connections and select the date, or time field you want to display. If needed, you can select **Add new field** to create and connect a [new collection field](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-a-field-to-a-collection).
4. Click the **Choose a format** drop-down and select the format you want to display your dates or times in. View the format options in the table below:

   | Format | Displayed as |
   | --- | --- |
   | Short date | 2/25/19 |
   | Medium date | Feb 25, 2019 |
   | Long date | February 25, 2019 |
   | Full Date | Monday, February 25, 2019 |
   | Short date time | 2/25/19, 8:45 PM |
   | Long date time | February 25, 2019 at 8:45:00 PM |
   | Full date time | Sunday, February 24, 2019 at 10:50:00 PM PST |
   | Medium time (12h) | 8:45 PM |
   | Medium time (24h) | 20:45 |
   | Long time (12h) | 8:45:00 PM |
   | Long time (24h) | 20:45:00 |
   | Hour only | 8 PM |
   | Minute only | 45 |
   | Year only | 2019 |
   | Month only | February |
   | Short month only | Feb |
   | Day only | Monday |

5. Click **Publish** when you are ready to make the changes go live.

**Notes:**
- The date and times displayed on your live site adjust according to the visitor's local time zone.
- Your site's [regional settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-sites-regional-settings) determine date and time language, time zones and other regional formatting options.
- When you [export a collection to a CSV file](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-exporting-content-from-your-collection), the time fields in the file are formatted as UTC+0. They are not formatted to local time.

question: Is it possible to randomize gallery images in Wix Editor each time the page is refreshed?

question: How do I create and connect a Google Developer account for my Branded App?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed the design of your app in the Branded App dashboard.

To create and connect a Google Developer account for your Branded App, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create or sign in to your Google account
1. Go to your [Branded App](https://www.wix.com/branded-apps?path=welcome&referralInfo=HelpCenter) dashboard in your Wix account.
   
   **Note:** If this is your first time in the Branded App dashboard, click **Get Started** and [design your app first](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-designing-your-app).
2. Click the **Developer Accounts** tab.
3. Click **Connect** under **Google Developer Account**.
4. Click **Create a Google Account** and follow the instructions provided.
5. Once you've created a Google account, click **I've created a new Google Account** under **Required Info** at the right. If you already have an existing Google account, click **I already have a Google Account**.
6. Click **Continue** to move on to step 2.

### Step 2 | Register for a Google Developer account
1. Follow the steps provided under **Register for a Google Play Developer account**. Once you've enrolled, Google reviews your account and sends you an activation email when it's approved.
2. Once you've received an activation email, go back to the Google Developer account setup in the [Developer Accounts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Branded%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/branded-apps/publish/google-account) tab and click **Register for a developer account**.
3. Enter your Google developer account email under **Required info** at the right.
4. Click **Continue** to move on to step 3.

### Step 3 | Invite Wix to access your Google Developer account
1. Follow the instructions provided under **Invite Wix to access your Google Developer account**.
2. Once you've completed all the instructions in this section, including giving Wix permissions and access, select the checkbox under **Required Info**.
3. Click **Continue** to move on to the second permission Wix needs.

### Step 4 | Link your project to Google Play Console and invite Wix as a project owner
1. Follow the instructions provided under **Link your project to your Google Play Console Developer**.
2. Once you've completed all the instructions in this section, select the checkbox under **Required Info**.
3. Click **Save**.

### Step 5 | Wait for approval
Once you've given us all the required info, Wix submits your app on your behalf. You can disregard any emails you receive from Google at this time, as Wix files the necessary information and responds to Google as part of your Branded App package.

You can see the approval progress in the **Developer Accounts** tab of your [Branded App](https://www.wix.com/branded-apps?path=welcome&referralInfo=HelpCenter) dashboard. It may take up to one business week for the account to be approved.

question: How can I create custom private pages for my site members in the new Members Area app?
answer:
To create your own private pages with exclusive content for members, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Create your own private pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-adding-and-managing-private-member-pages) link.

3. These pages are automatically added to the [Login Bar Menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-customizing-the-login-bar-and-menu) for easy access.

Custom private pages allow you to provide exclusive content to your members, enhancing their experience on your site.

question: Is it possible to transfer a guest's ticket from one event to another in Wix Events?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to automatically transfer a guest's ticket from one event to another. 

### Workaround
You can cancel the order and then [add guests manually](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-manually-adding-guests-to-an-event) to a different event.

question: Can I screencast videos from my Wix site directly to a TV?
answer:
Currently, Wix Video does not have an option that would allow site visitors to screencast your videos to a TV.

### Workaround
You can use various third-party apps and devices to screencast your computer to a TV. For example, you can [use Google Chrome's built-in "Cast" feature](https://support.google.com/chromecast/answer/3228332?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop) to screencast your website from a tab to your TV.

question: Can I add collapsible text to my Wix Pro Gallery?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add [collapsible text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-and-setting-up-collapsible-text) to your Wix Pro Gallery.

question: Can I send SMS notifications to customers about their order status and updates in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
Currently, it isn't possible to send SMS notifications to customers about their order status and updates.

### Tip
Wix Restaurants Orders (New) includes pre-installed outgoing email notifications to update customers about their orders and keep site collaborators (e.g., kitchen staff) in the loop. You can manage, edit, and duplicate these notifications, including any custom ones you create. Learn more about [managing notifications for online orders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-managing-notifications-for-online-orders).

question: How can I resolve a 502 (Bad Gateway) error on my website?

question: How can I archive a menu, section, or dish in the Wix Restaurants Menus App?
answer:
To archive a menu, section, or dish in the Wix Restaurants Menus App, follow these steps:

question: How can I customize the tabs on my Wix Group Page using the Wix app?
answer:
To customize the tabs on your Wix Group Page using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Groups**.
4. Tap on the group you want to customize.
5. Tap **Edit** next to your group name.
6. Tap **Group Tabs** under **Content**.

For each tab (Discussion, Media, About, Events, or a Custom Tab), you can:

- Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the tab you want to customize.
- To change the name of the tab:
  1. Tap **Rename**.
  2. Enter a new name in the **Tab Name** field.
  3. Tap **Done**.
- (Optional) Tap **Hide Tab** to no longer display this tab to your group members.
- (Optional) Tap **Show Tab** to display this tab to your group members.

For the **About** tab, you can also edit the group description by tapping **Settings** and entering a new description. You can add images, videos, and GIFs to the description using the respective icons.

For the **Events** tab, you can select which events to display by tapping **Settings** and selecting the checkboxes next to each event you want to display.

To create a **Custom Tab**:

1. Tap **Group Tabs** under **Content**.
2. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to **New Tab**.
3. Tap **Manage** to customize your new tab:
   - Enter a name and description for your custom tab.
   - Add images, videos, and GIFs using the respective icons.
4. Tap **Save**.
5. Tap **Delete Tab** to remove the tab completely.

**Tip:** You can also [customize your Group Page from your desktop](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-customizing-your-group-page).

question: How can I create a task using Wix Automations when a form is submitted on my site?
answer:
To create a task with Wix Automations when a form is submitted on your site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **\+ New Automation** in the top right corner.
3. Click **\+ Start from Scratch** or choose a suggested automation.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Select a trigger for your automation.
6. Select **Create a task** as your automation's action.
   1. Enter your task in the **Add a task for you or your team** field.
   2. (Optional) Assign the task to you or someone on your team using the drop-down menu.
   3. Click the **Set a due date** toggle to choose whether to set a due date:
      * **Enabled:** Select a value in the **Number of days to complete task** field.
      * **Disabled:** Your task will not have a due date.
7. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
8. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
   * **Immediately:** The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
   * **Set custom time:** The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
9. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
   * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
   * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
10. Click **Activate**.

question: Can I sync multiple external calendars with Wix Bookings for a single staff member?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to sync with more than one external calendar per staff member in Wix Bookings. Each staff member can sync to one external calendar (Google, iCalendar, Outlook) at a time.

question: How can I manually mark an order as 'Paid' in Wix Stores?
answer:
To manually mark an order as 'Paid' in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant unpaid order.
3. Click the **Collect Payment** drop-down and select **Mark as Paid**.
4. (Optional) Select a custom amount (i.e. accept partial payment):
   
   1. Select the **Mark a custom amount as paid** checkbox.
   2. Enter the amount. 
   
   **Note:** Must be less than the order total.
5. Click **Mark as Paid** to confirm.

**Note:** This cannot be undone.

question: What should I do if my customers are experiencing issues with the Strong Customer Authentication process under PSD2?
answer: If your customers are experiencing issues with the Strong Customer Authentication process, advise them to contact their bank directly. The Strong Customer Authentication process is solely managed by the banks processing the transactions, which means they should be able to resolve any issue your customers might have. If you need more information on how SCA is implemented in your country, we recommend checking with your local regulator.

question: Can I search for products by SKU codes in the Wix store search box?
answer: Currently, you cannot search for products by SKU codes in a [store search box](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-optimizing-a-search-box-for-stores).

question: Can I offer advanced customization options for products in Wix Stores?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to offer customers advanced customization options for Wix Stores products. You can, however, use [product options](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-customizing-product-options) to create multiple variations of your product. For example, if you make different sized picture frames, you can create two product options: 

- **Size product option:** Small, medium, and large
- **Wood product option:** Oak, pine, and walnut

On checkout, customers can choose the size and type of wood to get the option they want. Note that you can add up to 6 types of product options to a product (e.g. size, material, style, etc.) and up to 30 option choices (e.g. small, large; oak, pine) to allow for many customizations.

### Tip
You can also [add a message box](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-allowing-customers-to-add-a-message-when-purchasing-a-product) so customers can add custom text.

question: Can I add a Range Slider in the Studio Editor to filter items based on a Number field value?
answer: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to add a Range Slider input element. This feature would allow you to create a slider that visitors drag to filter items that have a Number field value within a specified range. As a result, only items with a Number field value within the selected range would appear in the connected repeater, gallery, or table. You can, however, [add a Range Slider in the Wix Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-range-slider).

question: What are the supported file types and size limits for images in the Wix File Share app?
answer:
### Supported Image File Types and Size Limits in Wix File Share App

#### Site Images

**Supported files:**
- JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, WEBP, JPEG 2000, and RAW.
- The following **JPEG 2000** file formats are supported: .jp2, .jpg2, .j2k, .jpf, .jpm, .j2c, .jpc, .jpx
- The following **RAW** file formats are supported: .arw, .srw, .nef, .cr2, .cr3, .crw, .rwl, .rw2, .raw, .raf, .pef, .orf, .mrw, .dng, .sr2, .srf, .kdc, .k25, .dcr, .x3f, .erf, .3fr
- Animated **WEBP** images are currently not supported and convert to static image

**File size limits:**
- Images: 25MB
- GIFs: 15MB

#### Background Images

**Supported files:** JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, and WEBP

**File size:** At least 3000 x 3000px

question: Can I display available class times in a monthly calendar view on Wix Bookings?

question: How can I offer different prices for services based on the staff member's expertise in Wix Bookings?
answer: You can create pricing options for appointments based on the staff member in charge of the service. This is a great way to offer clients more flexible pricing options to suit their needs. It also allows your more experienced staff to focus on high value clients.

question: How can I add a site menu to my Wix website using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add a site menu to your Wix website using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Menu & Anchor**.
4. Click a menu type:
   * **My Menus:** If you've already added menus to your site, the styles you've chosen appear in this section so you can use them again.
   * **Themed Menus:** These menus have been handpicked to match your site.
   * **Horizontal Menus:** A horizontal menu is usually placed in the header or footer of a site.
   * **Vertical Menus:** A vertical menu can be placed anywhere you want on your site. Be sure to set it to [show on all pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-showing-an-element-on-all-pages).
   * **In-page Menus:** Display [your anchors](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-about-anchors-9563) and [sections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-about-sections) in a cool, floating menu. As the in-page menu is pinned to the screen, it is always visible wherever your site visitors are on your page.
   * **Hamburger Menus:** [Hamburger menus](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-hamburger-menu) are menus that display a button on your live site. When visitors click the button, the menu opens in a container.
5. Drag your chosen menu element onto your page.

### Tips
* To create a floating menu, [pin the menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-pinning-elements-to-the-screen) to the desired location on the screen.
* You can also add Site Search from the Menu & Anchor tab. Site Search lets your visitors search for anything on your site using a search bar, and the results of the search are displayed clearly in a list. [Learn more about Site Search](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wix-site-search)

### Important
A menu should be displayed on every page of your site. If your menu is placed in the header or footer, it automatically shows on every page. If you are using a vertical menu, or a horizontal menu (not in your header or footer) make sure you set it to [show on all pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-showing-an-element-on-all-pages).

question: How can I sync my Google Calendar with Wix Bookings to manage my appointments?
answer:
To sync your Google Calendar with Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Ensure your site is upgraded to a Business Premium Plan. You can do this by visiting [upgrade your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-upgrading-wix-bookings-to-a-business-premium-plan).
2. Go to your Wix Bookings settings and select the option to sync with Google Calendar.
3. Once synced, your clients' sessions with you will appear on your Google calendar, and your personal appointments will block off time in your booking calendar. This is a two-way sync.

The information you see in your personal calendar depends on the type of service that a client books:

- **Appointments:** You can access all the information you need about your upcoming service: The service name, address, customer name and contact details, and which staff member is providing the service.
- **Classes and Courses:** The name of the class or course appears in your personal calendar (except for Apple calendar). Note that even if no one booked a session, classes and courses still appear in your personal calendar.

For more detailed instructions, visit [sync your Google calendar with Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-syncing-bookings-and-google-calendars).

question: How can I apply SEO settings to all languages on my Wix multilingual site?
answer:
Wix Multilingual allows you to maintain a site in multiple languages and apply SEO Settings to all languages automatically. Instead of editing each page's individual settings, you can customize the settings that apply to entire sections of your site. This way, you can create a systematic SEO strategy much more quickly. Any changes you make to your SEO Settings affect the related pages regardless of their language (e.g. Product pages, Site pages, etc). Once you save your edits, no action is required to ensure the pattern supports other languages. 

*Tip:* You can also [customize the SEO Basics settings of individual pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-optimizing-seo-settings-for-multilingual-sites) for every version of your site. By default, Wix adds hreflang tags to your pages so search engines can identify their language and show the correct version to your visitors.

question: How can I turn off auto renewal for my Facebook Ads subscription on Wix?
answer:
To turn off auto renewal for your Facebook Ads subscription, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Find the relevant site and click the Show More icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/71d20af0-560e-44a5-bb38-bf3f513b58fa/2021/05/20/8b3a198f-e3ca-4dc9-aa10-fff01f865dc5/e7d5610a-7f31-459f-a13d-a55a354f266b.png) to the right of the subscription that says **Facebook Ads**.
3. Click **Cancel Facebook Ads**.
4. Select **Cancel Subscription** and provide a reason for cancellation.
5. Click **Cancel Subscription** to confirm.

Your Facebook Ads campaign will continue to run until the end of your current subscription. After the subscription expires, your campaign ends. You can choose to turn auto renew back on from the Premium Subscriptions dashboard by clicking **Turn Auto Renew On**.

question: How can I integrate my Wix site with the Melhor Envio app for shipping management?
answer: To integrate your Wix site with the Melhor Envio app, you need to first ensure that you have added Wix Stores to your site. You can do this by following the instructions provided in the [Wix Stores: Adding Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores) guide. Once Wix Stores is added, you can proceed to integrate your site with Melhor Envio by following the detailed steps in the [Integrate your site with Melhor Envio](https://ajuda.melhorenvio.com.br/pt-BR/articles/4390142-integre-sua-loja-wix-com-o-melhor-envio) article (in Portuguese). This integration will allow you to access multiple shipping options, real-time shipping rates, and manage shipments more efficiently.

question: How can I upload my own image to the Wix Logo Maker and customize it?
answer:
To upload an image to your logo in the Wix Logo Maker, follow these steps:

1. Click the Upload icon on the left of the logo editor.
2. Click **Upload Image**.
3. Upload an image or select an image from your Site Files.
   
   1. **Upload an image:**
      1. Click **\+ Upload Media.**
      2. Select the location you want to upload your image from (from your computer or a social network).
      3. Click the image(s) you want to upload.
      4. Click **Upload Selection**.
      5. Click **Add to Logo**.
   2. **Use a site file:**
      1. Select the image you want to add to your logo.
      2. Click **Add to Logo**.

After uploading, you can customize your image using the Customize Image panel:

1. Click the Upload icon on the left of the logo editor.
2. Hover over the image you want to edit in Customize Image panel and click **Customize**.
3. Customize the following aspects of your image:
   * **Size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of your image.
   * **Image opacity:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the transparency of your image.
   * **Flip:** Flip your image horizontally or vertically.
   * **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate your image.
   * **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move your image left or right.
   * **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move your image up or down.
   * **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable a shadow around your image and customize the following:
     + **Shadow color:** Click the color box to select the shadow's color or enter a hex code.
     + **Shadow opacity:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the transparency of your shadow.
     + **Shadow horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move your shadow left or right.
     + **Shadow vertical position:** Drag the slider to move your shadow up or down.
     + **Shadow blur:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the blurriness of your shadow.
   * **Blur:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the blurriness of your image.

question: How can I update my existing upload button to accept multiple documents in my CMS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have added a multi document field type to your collection as described in Step 1.

### To update your existing upload button:
1. Select the upload button.
2. Click the Connect to Data icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/59ef43fb-880d-46b2-bdce-82e4aaffaaec/2020/07/04/49602af9-3e86-4883-9ae4-a88f13ea85c9/d7fb62f6-ed05-401e-ac3f-6a0f5ce4b20f.png) (or![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2021/08/23/5ac63abf-0dd3-4527-aed6-8a53a1cc05ea/4c6442e4-199f-4e5d-913d-e565a144c22e.png)in Editor X).

question: How can I enable double opt-in for my Wix site forms?
answer:
To enable double opt-in on your Wix site forms, follow these steps:

### For New Forms:
1. Select your form in the editor.
2. Click **Edit Form**.
3. Select the **Subscribe** field.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Enable double opt-in** toggle:
   * **Enabled:** Anyone who submits the form or selects the subscriber checkbox receives an email to verify their subscription status. Once they have verified, they become subscribers in your contact list.
   * **Disabled:** Anyone who submits the form or selects the subscriber checkbox is automatically a subscriber in your contact list. They do not have to confirm their status.

### For Old Forms:
1. Select your form in the editor.
2. Click **Form Settings**.
3. Click the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Subscriber Double Opt-In**.
5. Click the **Enable double opt-in** toggle:
   * **Enabled:** Anyone who submits the form or selects the subscriber checkbox receives an email to verify their subscription status. Once they have verified, they become subscribers in your contact list.
   * **Disabled:** Anyone who submits the form or selects the subscriber checkbox is automatically a subscriber in your contact list. They do not have to confirm their status.

**Notes:**
- If the toggle is grayed out, it means you haven't yet added a [subscriber opt-in checkbox](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-a-subscriber-opt-in-checkbox-to-a-site-form).
- [This article](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-the-difference-between-the-new-and-old-wix-forms) will help you understand the differences between old and new Wix Forms.

question: Why are my Wix Stores notification emails being sent to my old business email address, and how can I fix this?

question: How can I speed up the process of getting my Wix site to appear in search engine results?
answer:
To speed up the time it takes for your Wix site to appear in search engine results, you can verify your site ownership with search engines and submit your sitemap. Here are the steps you can follow:

1. **Verify your site ownership with Google Search Console**: You can find the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-your-site-to-google-in-the-wix-seo-setup-checklist).

2. **Verify your site ownership with Bing Webmaster Tools**: Follow the guide [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/verifying-your-site-with-bing-webmaster-tools).

3. **Submit your sitemap directly to Google**: Once your site is verified, you can submit your sitemap via Google Search Console to make it easier for Google to crawl and categorize your site. Learn more about this process [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines).

Remember, the waiting period for your site to be indexed is determined by the search engines themselves and is the same for all websites, not just Wix sites.

question: How can I create a Back to Top button on my Wix site now that the Back to Top App is no longer available?

question: Why is my Vimeo video not working on my Wix site after switching to Vimeo Plus?
answer: If your Vimeo video is no longer working after switching to Vimeo Plus, Wix has changed the static domain from **static.wix.com** to **static.parastorage.com**. To resolve this issue, go to your Vimeo Plus settings and make sure that **static.parastorage.com** is defined as the allowed domain.

question: How can I set a text field in my CMS collection to accept only specific values?

question: How can I add and set up a Wix Blog on my site?
answer:
To add and set up a Wix Blog on your site, follow these steps:

question: How can I import loyalty points for my existing customers using the Wix Loyalty Program?
answer:
To import loyalty points for your existing customers using the Wix Loyalty Program, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Loyalty Program](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Loyalty%20Program&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/loyalty-accounts/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon at the top.
3. Click **Import**.
4. Prepare your CSV file for import:
   * Include a header row in your file.
   * Make sure each row in your file contains an email address and customer points balance.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Click **Upload file**.
7. Select the file containing the loyalty points you're importing and click **Open**.
8. Click **Next**.
9. Check that the data is matched correctly:
   1. Ensure the **Email** and **Points balance** columns are correct.
   2. (If needed) Click **Match Data** and use the drop-down menus to correct the column headers.
10. Click **Save and Import**.
11. Click **View Customers**.

Note: If you import points from a CSV file for a customer who already has points in your Wix Loyalty Program, their existing points balance is overridden.

question: How do I customize my ad settings and keywords for a Google Ads campaign with Wix?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Before customizing your ad settings and keywords, ensure you have completed the following prerequisites:
- Publish your site
- Purchase a Premium plan
- Connect a custom domain

### To customize your ad settings and keywords:
1. [Go to Google Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Google%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/google-ads/eligibility) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Create Ad Campaign** once your business is ready to advertise. 

   **Note:** If you do not see this option, make sure you've completed the checklist in Step 1.
3. Click the **Site page your ad lead to** drop-down and choose the page you want visitors to navigate to after clicking your ad (e.g. your Wix Stores product page).
4. Click the **Language** drop-down to choose the main language for the site page that appears in your ad. You can only pick one language.
5. Under **Targeted locations** choose where you want to advertise:
   
   * **Specific cities, zip codes or regions:** Enter a location in the text field and choose an option from the drop-down. You can add up to ten areas.
   * **Near a street address:** Enter a street address in the text field and select a radius from the drop-down.
6. Under **When your ad will appear** choose if your ad should be shown all the time or at specific times.
   
   * **Anytime (recommended):** Your ad appears at all times on Google search results. This is recommended as the more your ad is shown, the more views it will get.
   * **At specific times:** Only show your ad during certain hours. This is recommended if you are expecting calls and want to be available during business hours.
     
     1. Click **Edit ad schedule**.
     2. Select the checkboxes next to the days you want to show your ad and pick specific hours for each day.
7. Under **Keyword themes** enter up to 10 keyword themes to help people find your ad in searches. Pick keywords that match your service, product or offering. You can also use Google Ads suggested keywords. Learn more about [choosing keyword themes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-keyword-themes).
8. Click **Next** to create your ad content.

question: Why are my completed orders not appearing in the Orders tab on Wix?
answer:
When a customer places an online order, the payment needs to be approved by the relevant payment gateway (e.g. PayPal) before the order appears in the Orders tab. This usually happens almost immediately, however, in some cases it may take up to 24 hours.

A few payment methods, such as Boleto, and Degica (Komoju), require customers to make payments in person at a physical location after they complete their online orders. In these cases, the orders appear in the Orders tab only after your customer has paid for it. This may take a few days.

If the problem persists, [contact us](https://www.wix.com/support/conversations/category/contact) with the information below:

* A [screenshot](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-screenshot-to-a-ticket) of the payment confirmation from the relevant payment provider
* The payment amount
* The transaction date

question: Can customers pay in installments using the Branded App?
answer: Currently in [Branded App](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-an-overview), when your app users purchase a product or service, they need to pay the entire amount upfront. It is not possible to allow customers to pay in installments.

question: How can I customize the room list layout in Wix Hotels?

     + **Single**: Show off single properties, such as apartments or villas, featuring large stunning photos and a side search box.

question: How can I connect my own custom domain to my Wix site?

question: How can I display events on my Wix Group page?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have completed the necessary steps to set up your Wix Group and have access to the site's dashboard.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Enable the Events Tab on Your Group Page
1. Go to [Groups](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Groups&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsocial-groups-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant group.
3. Click the **Content** tab.
4. Click the **Events** toggle to set it to **Visible**.

#### Step 2 | Create Your Event
1. After enabling the Events tab, click **Edit** next to the toggle to choose which event/s you want to show.
2. If you're creating an event for the first time, click **Create an Event** to get started.
3. Click **Create an Event** at the bottom left of the popup.
4. Choose the type of event you want to create:
   * **Ticketed Event:** Provide guests with free tickets, or let them purchase tickets to your event.
   * **RSVP Event:** Allow guests to RSVP or join a waitlist for the event.
5. Enter the event details.
6. Click **Create Event**.
7. Add additional information about your event and click **Save**.

#### Step 3 | Connect Your Event to Your Group
1. Click **Connect Event**.
2. Select the checkbox next to the relevant event.
3. Click **Connect**.

### Tip
You can also choose which events to display on your Groups Page right from your mobile device. [Learn How](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-managing-groups-in-the-wix-owner-app)

question: How can I connect a text element to a CMS expression in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To connect a text element to a CMS expression in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. In your Editor, click the element you want to connect to the CMS (e.g. text, button, gallery).
2. Click the Connect to CMS icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/06/16/2d484f5d-e1bf-4d48-9e42-82216e8b88de/08e74518-edad-42f8-b007-c974ba767eb6.png).
3. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click **Create a New Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to connect.
4. Click the relevant drop-down under **Connection options** and select **Expression**.
5. Click the **Expression** field.
6. Enter the name of the function you want to use (e.g. **CONCAT**, **DATE**, **TEXT**).

**Tip:** Once you start typing, you can select from a list of possible functions to use.
7. Type an opening parenthesis: **(**
8. Enter the field IDs or values you want to use in the expression. As you type, a list of matching field IDs that you can select from appears.
9. Type a closing parenthesis: **)**

question: How can I upgrade my Wix site to start using Wix Bookings and accept payments?
answer:
To upgrade your Wix site and start using Wix Bookings to accept payments, follow these steps:

1. If you have not already done so, [add Wix Bookings to your site](https://www.wix.com/app-market/wix-bookings).
2. [Go to your site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
3. Click [**Upgrade**](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fstore%2Fplans%3FsiteGuid%3D%7BmetaSiteId%7D%26referralAdditionalInfo%3DHelpCenter&title=Select+a+Site+to+Upgrade&primaryButtonText=Upgrade+Site&referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter).
4. Click **Select** under the plan that suits your needs.
5. Click to select the relevant subscription period and click **Continue to Checkout**.
6. Enter your payment details.
7. Click **Submit Purchase**.

### Important
* After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to [verify your identity](https://support.wix.com/en/article/paying-for-wix-services-strong-customer-authentication-sca-and-3d-secure-3ds). If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.
* If you've previously purchased a site plan that doesn't support Wix Bookings, you can [upgrade to a plan that does](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fstore%2Fplans%3FsiteGuid%3D%7BmetaSiteId%7D%26referralAdditionalInfo%3DHelpCenter&title=Select+a+Site+to+Upgrade&primaryButtonText=Upgrade+Site&referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter). When switching plans, if the new plan costs more than the original plan you purchased, you pay only the difference in price.

question: Is it possible to list dorm rooms or shared accommodation in Wix Hotels?

question: How can I enable participant notifications for my online program?

question: What does the 'Page Resources Couldn't Be Loaded' error mean in Google Search Console for URLs starting with 'frog.wix.com'?

question: How can I turn off auto renewal for my Wix site plan?
answer:
To turn off auto renewal for your Wix site plan, follow these steps:

question: How can I add and arrange anchors on my Wix one-page site?
answer:
To add anchors to your page's strips and sections, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/AZpJ_GKartAMzPmGB-43LFoqyM6m-vlNuV5r3fiM5PyeOiiy4TrQJp0L7c_emNGNvbHKz1b3Ail0wYrq5kvPg4BEvXXHuNyxgaW5Lmz5mgBEWsNxiR-aeAtIcjO5fuywc8OASLuk) on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Menu & Anchor**.
3. Click the anchor under **In-Page Navigation**, or drag it to the relevant location on your page.
4. Click the anchor and click **Rename**.
5. Repeat steps 1-4 for each section you wish to mark on your site.

**Note:** We recommend attaching no more than one anchor to a strip or page segment. Attaching more than one may cause issues for visitors that rely on keyboards to navigate.

To arrange anchors in the layers panel:

question: How do I map my Wix SKUs to Amazon SKUs for Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added the Amazon MCF app to your site, connected an Amazon account, and sent your inventory to Amazon fulfillment centers.

To map your Wix SKUs to Amazon SKUs, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Manage Apps](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Apps&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-installed-apps/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Open** next to **Multi-Channel Fulfillment**.
3. Select the **SKU Mapping** tab.
4. (Optional) Click **Sync Wix SKUs** and **Continue** to make sure any products you added after you connected to Amazon appear in the list.

   **Tip:** The sync can take up to 10 minutes. Refresh the page to see the new items.

5. Select an option:
   * **Your store's SKUs match SKUs in Seller Central:**
     1. Click Automap.
     2. (Optional) To view matches, click the Filter icon and select SKUs Mapped.
   * **Your store's SKUs aren't the same as Amazon SKUs:**
     1. Click the Edit icon next to the first product you want to map.
     2. Enter the Amazon SKU for the exact same product and variant.
     3. Click the checkmark.

question: How can I use social networks to improve my site's SEO according to the article?
answer:
Social networks are a powerful tool to boost your site's visibility and page ranking. By linking back to your site from social networks, you can enhance your SEO. However, it's important to ensure that your posts are relevant and valuable, as irrelevant content can negatively impact your SEO. 

Wix provides several quick and easy ways to help boost your site on social networks. You can add various [social tools](https://support.wix.com/en/the-wix-editor/social) to your site, allowing visitors to interact with their respective social networks. For example, you can enable a visitor to 'like' your site, which will post your site on their Facebook page. 

Additionally, if you need help getting your site found in search results, you can check out the Wix [SEO Setup Checklist](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home/seo-setup?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=SEO+Setup+Checklist) for a step-by-step plan designed to help improve your site's SEO.

question: How can I create a segment in Wix Contacts to target specific groups for email campaigns?
answer:
To create a segment in Wix Contacts, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Contacts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Contacts&title=Select%20a%20site%20to%20update&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fcontacts) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Segments** tab.
3. Click the **\+ Create New** drop-down and select **Segment.**
4. Add a name for your segment to help you identify it later (e.g. 'Returning customers').
5. Select all the relevant filters that apply to this segment, or click **\+ Add a Filter** to create your first filter. 

   **Note:** Add the filters one at a time. The more filters you add, the more specific the segment becomes.
6. Create your filter by choosing an attribute, condition, and value:

   1. Choose an option from the **Contact attribute** or **Contact activity** list. For example, to find all contacts who have previously spent money on the site, select 'total amount spent.'
   2. Click the **Choose a condition** drop-down to choose logic for your filter. For example, select 'is more or equal to'.
   3. (Optional) Depending on the attribute, input a value for this filter. For 'total amount spent,' you might choose '100' as your value.
7. (Optional) Click **\+Add a Filter** below the first filter to create another filter for your segment. Both filters work together to find matching contacts.
8. Click **Create Segment**. The new segment appears under **Your segments**.

question: How can I resolve the issue of my Channel calendar being blocked or showing 0.00 for prices even though the Wix Calendar is normal?
answer:
This issue is most likely because some weekend prices were missing when connecting the Channel Manager. To resolve it, follow these steps:

1. Check you've [added weekend prices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-weekend-rates-for-your-rooms-in-wix-hotels) for your rooms as well as seasonal room rules. 
   
   **Note:** If you want to keep the same prices for weekends and weekdays, input the same value in both fields.

2. Reload your rates by doing the following:
   
   1. Go to the **Rooms** tab in your hotel dashboard.
   2. Select each room type.
   3. Increase both the weekend and the weekday price by 1.
   4. Click **Save.**
   5. Wait five minutes and then reset the rates for each of your rooms to their original prices.

question: How can I troubleshoot my SSL certificate if my domain is connected via name servers?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure your domain is connected to your site.

To troubleshoot your SSL certificate if your domain is connected via name servers, follow these steps:

1. Make sure your domain host has the following name servers set for your domain. You can use the following tool to check: [https://domain-troubleshooter.wix.com/ns-widget?type=ns](https://domain-troubleshooter.wix.com/ns-widget?type=ns).

2. Make sure you have the default A and CNAME records in your Wix account:
   
   1. [Go to Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
   2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
   3. Select **Manage DNS Records**.
   4. Check the records under the A (Host) and CNAME (Aliases) sections.
   5. (Optional) Reset the records to the [default settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/resetting-your-default-a-and-cname-records).

If you recently updated your DNS records, wait up to 48 hours to allow your domain to complete propagation. Learn more [about domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: How can I integrate Envia with my Wix Store to manage shipping labels?
answer:
To integrate Envia with your Wix Store, follow these steps:

question: How can I create custom merchandise using Wix's Business Card Maker?
answer:
To create custom merchandise using Wix's Business Card Maker, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Business Card Maker](https://www.wix.com/business-card/maker).

   **Note:** If you have a Wix website, you can also access the Business Cards Manager from the [Dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/) under the **Business Cards & More** tab.

3. Choose your shipping country by clicking the flag on the top right. Then select your shipping destination.
4. Hover over the template you want and click **Customize**.
5. Depending on the item you chose, follow the specific steps for each product:

   ### Business Cards
   1. (Optional) Fill in your business details and click **Save & Continue**.
   2. (Optional) Design your business card:
      - Click **Customize** at the bottom left.
      - Design your business card using the available options.
      - **Tip:** Click **Switch to Back** or **Switch to Front** to design the other side of the card.
      - When ready, click **Done** at the top right.
   3. Select the relevant paper type.
   4. Choose a quantity.
   5. Click **Add to Cart**.
   6. Click the Cart icon at the top right and do one of the following:
      - **Continue to Checkout:**
        1. Click **Continue to Checkout**.
        2. Enter your shipping details.
        3. Click **Save & Continue**.
      - **Add More Items:**
        1. Click **Add More Items**.
        2. Design more products following the relevant instructions.
        3. When ready to pay, click the Cart icon at the top right and **Continue to Checkout**.

   ### T-Shirts
   1. (Optional) Customize your T-shirt template:
      - Click **Customize** at the bottom left.
      - Design your T-shirt using the available options.
      - When ready, click **Done** at the top right.
   2. Select a color for your T-shirt: Black or white.
   3. Choose a size from the drop-down menu.
      - **Tip:** Click **Size Chart** to get the exact measurements of each size.
   4. Select the quantity.
   5. Click **Add to Cart**.
   6. Click the Cart icon at the top right and do one of the following:
      - **Continue to Checkout:**
        1. Click **Continue to Checkout**.
        2. Enter your shipping details.
        3. Click **Save & Continue**.
      - **Add More Items:**
        1. Click **Add More Items**.
        2. Design more products following the relevant instructions.
        3. When ready to pay, click the Cart icon at the top right and **Continue to Checkout**.

   ### Mugs
   1. (Optional) Customize your mug template:
      - Click **Customize** at the bottom left.
      - Design your mug using the available options.
      - When ready, click **Done** at the top right.
   2. Choose the number of mugs you want per pack.
   3. Click **Add to Cart**.
   4. Click the Cart icon at the top right and do one of the following:
      - **Continue to Checkout:**
        1. Click **Continue to Checkout**.
        2. Enter your shipping details.
        3. Click **Save & Continue**.
      - **Add More Items:**
        1. Click **Add More Items**.
        2. Design more products following the relevant instructions.
        3. When ready to pay, click the Cart icon at the top right and **Continue to Checkout**.

   ### Tote Bags
   1. (Optional) Customize your tote bag template:
      - Click **Customize** at the bottom left.
      - Design your tote bag using the available options.
      - When ready, click **Done** at the top right.
   2. Choose the number of bags you want per pack.
   3. Click **Add to Cart**.
   4. Click the Cart icon at the top right and do one of the following:
      - **Continue to Checkout:**
        1. Click **Continue to Checkout**.
        2. Enter your shipping details.
        3. Click **Save & Continue**.
      - **Add More Items:**
        1. Click **Add More Items**.
        2. Design more products following the relevant instructions.
        3. When ready to pay, click the Cart icon at the top right and **Continue to Checkout**.

   ### Stickers
   1. (Optional) Customize your sticker template:
      - Click **Customize** at the bottom left.
      - Design your sticker using the available options.
      - When ready, click **Done** at the top right.
   2. Select the dimensions of your sticker.
   3. Choose the number of stickers you want per pack.
   4. Click **Add to Cart**.
   5. Click the Cart icon at the top right and do one of the following:
      - **Continue to Checkout:**
        1. Click **Continue to Checkout**.
        2. Enter your shipping details.
        3. Click **Save & Continue**.
      - **Add More Items:**
        1. Click **Add More Items**.
        2. Design more products following the relevant instructions.
        3. When ready to pay, click the Cart icon at the top right and **Continue to Checkout**.

### Tip
[Design a QR code with Wix](https://www.wix.com/tools/qr-code-generator) and add it to your business card. A QR code can be used to send customers to a particular product page, to your social media account, or even to connect to WiFi.

question: How can I hide a private folder in the Wix File Share app?
answer:
To hide a private folder in the Wix File Share app, follow these steps:

1. Go to [File Share](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F1537b24e-29d1-6d8f-b8e1-d6860f2f70b9%3F&primaryButtonText=Manage+Files) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant folder.
3. Click **Permissions**.
4. Click the drop-down next to **All members** and select **Remove**.
5. Select the checkbox at the bottom of the pop-up to hide the folder.
6. Set up the new permissions for this folder:
   
   1. Use the search bar to find a specific member, role or pricing plan.
   2. Choose their permission level from the drop-down: **Can view**, **Can upload** or **Can manage**.
   3. Select or deselect the checkbox next to **Notify members**.
   4. Click **Add** / **Add & Notify**.
7. Click **Save**.

question: How can I create a dedicated page for legal notices on my Wix site?
answer:
To create a dedicated page for your legal notices on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** in your Editor.
2. Click **+ Add Page**.
3. Enter the new name for your page.
4. Click **Done**.

Once your page is created, you will need to make sure that your visitors will be able to easily locate and access this page. question: Can I change my profile name in the Wix Customer Care?
answer: Your profile name in Wix Customer Care is the Wix account name you used when you submitted your first support request. You can easily [change your account name](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-your-site-url-prefix), however this does not change your support profile name.

question: Can I apply a discount to only one product or service on a Wix invoice?
answer:

You can manually change the cost of a product or service when adding it to the invoice.

question: How can I track my payouts in Wix Studio and what options do I have for managing my payout invoices?

question: How can I remove 'lightbox' from the URLs of images in my Wix gallery?
answer:
To stop 'lightbox' appearing in image URLs, follow these steps:

1. Click the gallery in your editor.
2. Click the **Settings** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2016/03/13/da6b0534-0ba6-4456-8afb-70d7f3f12e4b.png).
3. Click the **When images are clicked** drop-down menu and select either **Nothing happens** or **A link opens.**
4. Publish your site.

The next time that search engines [crawl and index](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/how-search-works#introducing-the-three-stages-of-google-search) your page, they update the URLs that they use for the images on the page. If you want to try to speed up this process, you can [submit the page's URL to search engines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines#submitting-individual-urls-to-search-engines).
