question: Can I add external links to the navigation menu in the branded app?
answer: Currently, you can only link to screens inside the app from the navigation menu. It is not possible to add external links to this menu.

question: How can I add my Wix store products to my TikTok for Business catalog?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed the following steps beforehand:
- Connect to TikTok for Business by creating or switching to a TikTok for Business account.
- Create a catalog in TikTok for Business.
- Get the link to your Wix product catalog.

### To add products to the catalog:
1. Go to your dashboard on TikTok.
2. Select the catalog you want to add products to.
3. Select **Products** from the menu on the left.
4. Click **Add Products**.
5. Select **Data Feed Schedule**.
6. Follow [these instructions](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=10001005&redirected=1) to add products using a data feed schedule.

**Tip:** When asked to input the URL where your product file is hosted, paste the catalog link you copied in step 3.

question: How can I add and set up a table in the Studio Editor to display a dataset?
answer:
To add and set up a table in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Layout Tools**.
3. Click **Tables**.
4. Drag the design you like onto your page.
5. Connect the table to a content collection:
   
   1. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
   2. (In the Inspector) [Choose the dataset you want to display](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-displaying-collection-content-in-a-table#step-3-connect-the-table-to-your-cms-collection) in the table.
6. Click **Manage Table** and set up the table columns:
   
   * **Reorder:** Click the **Reorder** icon next to the relevant column and drag it up or down into place.
   * **Change column name:** Hover over the relevant column, click the **More Actions** icon, and select **Edit label**. Enter the new name and click **Done**.
   * **Delete column:** Hover over the relevant column, click the **More Actions** icon, and select **Delete**.
   * **Manage Connections:** Click **Manage Connections** to change any of the CMS connections. Then click the relevant drop-downs under **Connections** in the Inspector panel to edit the connections and links.

question: Can I set specific availability for each location in Wix Bookings?
answer:
Currently, the availability settings in Wix Bookings apply to all business locations. It is not possible to set specific availability for each location, allowing businesses with multiple locations to manage bookings independently based on each location's business hours.

### Workaround
You can [set staff hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-editing-your-staff-members-working-hours) separately for each location where you offer the service, which influences the availability accordingly. For example, if a staff member works at location A from Monday to Thursday and at location B on weekends, the service availability reflects these specific hours per location.

question: How can I start my first email marketing campaign using Wix Email Marketing?
answer:
To start your first email marketing campaign using Wix Email Marketing, follow these steps:

1. **Pick a Template**: Choose a stunning template that suits your campaign needs.
2. **Add Your Content**: Customize the template by adding your content, such as text, images, and links.
3. **Add Your Contacts**: Import or add the contacts you want to send the email to.
4. **Send Your Campaign**: Once everything is set, send your email campaign to your selected contacts.

All of your emails are fully customizable and exist as standalone landing pages. You can also view a [step-by-step tutorial for creating and sending campaigns](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-and-sending-a-campaign-from-start-to-finish) to guide you through the process. To start your first email campaign, visit the [Email Marketing Dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Email%20Marketing%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/shoutout/).

question: How can I manage individual invoices using the Wix app?
answer:
To manage your invoices using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Manage Invoices** under **Getting Paid**.
4. Tap the invoice you want to manage.

**Note:** If an invoice is in Draft status, tapping it will give you the chance to edit it before following step 6 below.
5. Tap the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/29/f94a01eb-8038-4c1a-9930-2b449a0e4e28/1f05f949-d789-465f-a6fc-203e5a325901.png) at the top of your screen.
6. Choose what you want to do:
   - **Send via email:** Tap **Send via email**, review or edit the content of the email, and tap **Send**.
   - **Share link:** Tap **Share link** and share your link via one of your device's native apps.
   - **Enter card details manually:** Tap **Enter credit card manually**, enter your customer's credit card details, and tap **Next**.
   - **Charge with card reader:** Tap **Charge with card reader** and select a payment option.
   - **Record payment:** Tap **Record payment**, enter the amount received, payment date, and payment method, and tap **Save**.
   - **Edit:** Tap **Edit**, make the necessary changes, and tap **Update**.
   - **Duplicate as draft:** Tap **Duplicate as draft**, make any changes, and tap **Next**.
   - **Void:** Tap **Void** and then tap **Void** to confirm.

**Notes:**
- Some invoice management actions, such as printing or deleting an invoice, can only be done [from your dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-invoices-managing-your-invoices).
- When you update your customer's email address for sent invoices, the status will change back to Draft, and a new invoice link is created. For paid invoices, the updated email will only be reflected in your [Contact List](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-your-contact-list).

question: How can I dispute a chargeback if I am using Wix Payments?
answer: If you use Wix Payments to process your payments, you can [dispute the chargeback](https://support.wix.com/en/article/chargebacks-in-wix-payments#filing-a-dispute-against-a-chargeback) directly from your Wix Payments dashboard. If you win the dispute, the funds for the payment are returned to your account. If your customer wins, they simply keep the funds that were already transferred to them. If Wix Payments is your payment provider, your chargeback fee is also returned to your account following a dispute win.

question: Why can't I see the premium services I purchased using SEPA in my Wix account?
answer: If you can't see the premium services you purchased using SEPA in your Wix account, it may be because Wix needs to receive confirmation of the payment before the service becomes active. **This may take up to 7 business days.** You will receive an email notification at the time of purchase, followed by a second email notification when the payment is confirmed. Additionally, any applicable vouchers are only available following the activation of your Premium or Studio plan.

question: Can I customize the endpoint URL for HTTP functions in Wix?
answer: Currently, when exposing API endpoints using [HTTP functions](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/integrations/exposing-services/expose-a-site-api-with-http-functions), you cannot customize the endpoint URL. All endpoints must start with the **\_functions** prefix.

question: Can I offer both appointments and classes in the same time slot using Wix Bookings?
answer:
Currently, clients cannot book an Appointment with you if you have a Class offered in the same time slot.

### Tip
As a workaround, it is possible to offer two Class services at the same time. While creating one of them, limit the number of participants to one.

question: How can I use the Layers panel in Wix Editor to manage elements on my site?
answer:
To use the Layers panel in Wix Editor to manage elements on your site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Layers** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/651c25b0-2d60-43c8-addf-1df2fd575568/2021/12/23/fd0b1fed-ce7c-46cd-8cbb-a18dfbd23b74/5b30cd66-be53-4e8d-ba28-91c2fec39ff5.png) on the bottom left of the editor.
3. Click either **Header**, **Page**, or **Footer** to view the elements in that area.
4. Locate the relevant element from the list and click it.
5. Choose what you want to do with the element:
   
   * **Move the element forward / backward:**
     
     + **Forward:** Select Ctrl + ↑ on your keyboard to move the element forward. (Ctrl + Shift + ↑ if you want to bring it to the front)
     + **Backward:** Select Ctrl + ↓ on your keyboard to move the element backward, (Ctrl + Shift + ↓ if you want to send it to the back)
   * **Recenter an element:** If you've moved an element outside of the editor viewport, it is not visible on your live site and may cause scrolling issues. Bring the element to the center of your screen to move and manage it as needed.
     
     1. Select the relevant element in the panel.
     2. Hover over the Information icon.
     3. Click **Recenter element**.
   * **Customize / adjust the element:** Click the element in your editor, and use the available options to adjust the content, layout, and design.
   * **Change the order of elements:** Click and drag elements in the panel to change their order. This is a helpful way to ensure that the order in the panel matches the visual order on your site.

question: How can I restrict access to certain pages on my Wix site to only specific members or paying customers?
answer:
To restrict access to certain pages on your Wix site to only specific members or paying customers, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** in your Editor.
2. Click the relevant page.
3. Click the More Actions icon.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Permissions** tab.
6. Select **Members Only** under **Who can view this page?**
   
   - Choose **Only selected members or paying customers**.
   - Select members with specific roles and/or [pricing plans](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-an-overview).

### Important
If you select Members Only, be sure to [add a Member's area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-add-and-set-up-a-members-area) to your site.

question: Can I log in to the Branded App using my Facebook or Google account?
answer:
Currently, in the Branded App you cannot login in using third party accounts such as Facebook or Google. You can only log in with an email address.

**Note:** If your members have previously used a third party log in for another Wix member app (e.g. Spaces by Wix) they need to create a new account via email for your branded app.

question: How can I sync my Microsoft calendar with Wix Bookings?
answer:
To sync your Microsoft calendar with Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Manage Calendar** drop-down in the top right.
3. Click **Sync Personal Calendar.**
4. Select the relevant account you want to sync.
5. Click **Sync** next to Outlook or Office365.
6. Login with your Microsoft account details.
7. Click **Yes** to grant Wix access to your personal calendar.
8. Enable the **Import Microsoft Calendar events** toggle.
9. Select the checkboxes next to each Microsoft calendar you want to import to your Booking Calendar.
10. (Optional) Enable the **Export Booking Calendar events** toggle to display your bookings sessions on your Microsoft Calendar.
11. Click **Sync**.

Events from your Microsoft calendar are now visible on your Wix Bookings calendar. Your Wix Bookings sessions also appear in your Microsoft calendar if you enable Booking calendar events exports.

question: How can I change the display settings of the old Instagram Feed app on my Wix site?
answer:
To change the display settings of the old Instagram Feed app, follow these steps:

1. Select the Instagram Feed app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Display** tab.
4. Enable the **Your Profile** toggle to select the account information you want to display on your Instagram Feed.
5. Enable the **Your Posts** toggle to display your posts on your Instagram Feed.
6. Enable the **Hashtag Feed** toggle to display hashtags on your Instagram Feed.

   **Note:** Hashtags that were not used in the last 30 days will not display in your Hashtag Feed. This is a limitation from Facebook.

7. Search for hashtags to display on your Hashtag Feed under **Choose hashtags to display**.

   **Note:** You can search for 30 hashtags in 7 days. This is a limitation from Facebook.

question: How can I add a favicon to my Wix site?
answer:
To add a favicon to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Settings in your site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/settings).
2. Click **Website Settings**.
3. Click **Update Image** under **Favicon**.
4. Select an image, or click **Upload Images** to upload one from your computer.
5. Click **Choose File**.
6. Click **Save**.

### Tips for a good quality favicon
* Make sure your favicon looks good at a resolution of 16x16px as Google rescales favicons to that size. The [Wix Photo Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-accessing-wix-photo-studio) can help you edit image.
* Use a .jpg or .png image file.
* Your favicon should be a 1:1 image ratio (a square shape). Google recommends a multiple of 48px square, e.g. 48x48px, 96x96px, 144x144px etc.

question: How can I switch to a new template for my Wix site and apply my existing Premium plan?
answer:
To switch to a new template for your Wix site and apply your existing Premium plan, follow these steps:

### To choose a new template:
1. Sign in to your Wix account.
2. [Go to the Templates Page](https://www.wix.com/website/templates).
3. Select the category you want to open the drop-down menu.
4. Select the relevant sub-category.
5. Hover over your chosen template.
6. Click **Edit** to open the template in the Editor.

### To reassign an existing plan:
1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan.
3. Click **Assign to a Different Site**.
4. Select the checkbox next to the new site.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Click **Assign** to confirm.

**You should know:**
- Creating a new site and applying your Premium plan does not carry over the previous site's content or [certain features](https://support.wix.com/en/article/switching-your-site-template). However, you can copy and paste several elements between your sites.
- Changing to a new site template can affect your site's SEO. You can learn more about site redesign and SEO with our [dedicated blog post](https://www.wix.com/blog/website-redesign).

question: Is it possible to make custom private fields added to the Members Area visible in the app collection?
answer: Currently, when you add a custom private field to the Members Area, it is not possible to see it in your regular collections. The custom field gets stored in a Wix App collection under **Members** called **PrivateMembersData**. Learn how to [show or hide Wix App Collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections#how-to-show-or-hide-wix-app-collections).

question: How can I add a text marquee to my site using the Studio Editor?

question: How can I transfer a duplicate copy of my Wix site to another account?
answer:
To transfer a duplicate copy of your Wix site to another account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your duplicate site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/home/).
2. Click **Site Actions**.
3. Click **Transfer Site**.
4. Enter the new site owner's email address.
5. Choose if you want to keep your role after the site transfer.
6. Choose to create a copy of the site and keep it in your Wix account.
   
   * **Note**: You are transferring a duplicate copy of the original site. The original site will still be in your Wix account after the transfer.

question: How can I add Session Recordings to my Wix site?
answer:
To add Session Recordings to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Analytics](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Analytics%20Highlights&actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fanalytics/highlights) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Session Recordings** on the left.
3. Click **Get Session Recordings**. **Note:** If you already have the Twipla app installed from the Wix App Market, click **Enable Session Recordings**.
4. Click **Agree & Add** in the window.
5. Choose a data privacy mode:
   * [**Light Privacy**](https://www.twipla.com/en/support/all-about-features/privacy-center#c98820): Offers minimal visitor anonymity, displaying all visitor information and site data insights.
   * [**Medium Privacy**](https://www.twipla.com/en/support/all-about-features/privacy-center#c98822): Offers medium visitor anonymity, displaying all site data insights except for visitors' IP addresses.
   * [**GDPR Privacy**](https://www.twipla.com/en/support/all-about-features/privacy-center#c98823): Offers high visitor anonymity and reduced site data insights.
   * [**Maximum Privacy**](https://www.twipla.com/en/support/all-about-features/privacy-center#c98824): Offers the highest visitor anonymity and disables most site data insights.
6. Click **Choose and Continue**.
7. Click **Select** under the plan you would like to purchase:
   * **Pro Plus:** 10,000 new monthly session recordings.
   * **Pro:** 2,000 new monthly session recordings.
   * **Basic:** 500 new monthly session recordings.
   * **Free:** 10 new monthly session recordings. 
   
   **Tip:** Choosing this plan does not require payment, which means you can skip steps 8-10.
8. Select a billing cycle (yearly or monthly) and click **Continue to Checkout**.
9. Enter your payment details and click **Submit Purchase**.
10. Click **Let's Go**.

question: Can I receive live site visitor notifications on the Wix app without having Wix Chat installed on my site?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to receive live site visitors notifications to the Wix app without having Wix Chat installed on your site.

**To add Wix Chat to your site:**

   * **Wix Editor:** Click the **Add Apps** icon on the left side of the Editor.
   * **Editor X:** Click the **App Panel** icon on the top bar.

3. Click **Add to Site**.

question: How can I send a test email for my email marketing campaign on Wix?
answer:
To send a test email for your email marketing campaign on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Create an email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-and-sending-a-campaign-from-start-to-finish) or edit an existing one. Then click **Next**.
2. [Customize the elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-elements-to-your-email-campaign) in your campaign to your liking, then click **Preview & Test**.
3. Click **Send Test Email**.
4. Enter details in the following fields:
   * **Send to:** Enter the email address you want to send the test email to. You can only send test emails to one recipient at a time.
   * **Subject:** Enter the subject line of the test email.
   * **Sender's name:** Enter the name the test email will show as sent from. This may be your business or personal name.
   * **Reply-to email:** Enter the email address that will appear when you reply to the test email.
5. Click **Send**.

### Notes
* Dynamic values do not show in test emails, but will appear in the final campaigns you send.
* The [Unsubscribe link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-the-unsubscribe-link-in-your-email-campaign-2071623) does not appear in test emails.
* Test emails are sent from no-reply@usrmailtest.com.

question: How can I set my Wix Store to update inventory when an order is placed?
answer:
To set your Wix Store to update inventory when an order is placed, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Store products & inventory settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Products%20and%20Inventory&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/store/settings?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.

question: Can guests see how many tickets are still available for an event on my Wix site?
answer:
Currently, guests visiting your site cannot see how many tickets are still available for an event. 

### Tip
If you [create a seating map](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-a-seating-map) for your event, guests buying tickets can see exactly which seats are available while completing the purchase.

question: How can I connect my Wix site to Google using the SEO Setup Checklist?
answer:
To connect your site to Google using the Wix SEO Setup Checklist, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the SEO Setup Checklist](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fapp%2F1480c568-5cbd-9392-5604-1148f5faffa0%3FreferralInfo%3Dseo_wiz_launch_lp&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=SEO%20Setup%20Checklist) in your site's SEO dashboard.
2. Complete the checklist in Step 1 of your SEO Checklist.
3. Click **Connect to Google**.

### Important
- To connect to Google Search Console, you must have a [Premium plan](http://www.wix.com/upgrade/website) and a domain connected to your site. This can be either a domain [purchased from Wix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-from-wix) or a domain purchased [from another domain host](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-elsewhere).
- Only site owners and admin collaborators can access the SEO Setup Checklist. It is not available to back-office managers. [Learn more about site collaborator roles and permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/roles-permissions-overview).
- If your site is missing any information necessary to submit your site to Google, it will be listed in the pop-up. Follow the instructions in the popup to learn how to add your missing information.
- It's possible to skip a step and complete the steps after it. However, any step you skip will show as incomplete until you finish it. You also won't be able to complete your SEO Checklist until you finish all of the steps.
- It is not possible to verify your site using the SEO Setup Checklist more than once. If you need to verify your site again, you must do it manually. [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/verifying-your-site-with-google-search-console-5033765).

If you encounter any errors, you can try the steps in the [Troubleshooting article](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-seo-setup-checklist-troubleshooting-errors-when-connecting-your-site-to-google).

question: What should I do if my .co.uk domain is in a suspended status?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the email account used to register your domain.

If your .co.uk domain has entered a **Suspended** status, follow these steps to troubleshoot the issue:

### Step 1 | Check for a verification email from Wix
Your domain might be suspended if you haven't verified it with Wix. Check if you have received an email about the verification process from [wix-team@domain.wix.com](mailto:wix-team@domain.wix.com). If you find such an email, follow the process to get your domain unsuspended. The subject line of the Wix email is: 'VERIFICATION REQUIRED - Please verify your domain name(s) as soon as possible'. Make sure that you are checking the email account address that you used to register your domain (or the one that is set as the current point-of-contact for your domain).

**Tip:** If you can't see a verification email from Wix, check in your spam folder.

### Step 2 | Contact the UK domain registry (Nominet)
Another reason that your domain might be suspended is if the address and contact information stored in the [WHOIS records](https://www.whois.com/whois/) don't match the information in the official UK records. Nominet (the official registry for all .UK domain names) is paying great attention to this matter and could suspend a domain if its information does not completely match. Contact Nominet directly to find out if they suspended your domain and how you can resolve this matter. You can reach Nominet support in one of the following ways:

* Phone: 01865 332244
* Email: [support@nominet.org.uk](mailto:support@nominet.org.il)

question: How can I sell a service as a product using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To sell a service as a product using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.

5. Click **Upload Media** to add images, GIFs, or videos and select the relevant media.
6. Click **Add to Page**.
7. Enter the service name in the **Name** field under Product info (max. 80 characters).
8. (Optional) Add a ribbon by typing the ribbon name (e.g. New).
9. Enter a description of the product in the **Description** field. (maximum 8000 characters, including HTML tags)
10. Click **+Add an Info Section**.

13. Click **OK**.
14. Enter the **Price** for the service product.

question: How does Wix ensure compliance with data protection laws when transferring personal data to its sub-processors?
answer: Wix ensures compliance with data protection laws when transferring personal data to its sub-processors by using a Wix intra-company Data Processing Agreement. This agreement puts in place appropriate safeguards as required to ensure that cross-border transfers are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection laws such as the EU’s GDPR. Additionally, each third-party sub-processor enters into a written contract with Wix that enforces compliance with applicable data protection laws. Cross-border transfers are conducted under applicable approved mechanisms, together with additional measures where required, to ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws, as detailed in the [Data Processing Addendum for Users](https://www.wix.com/about/privacy-dpa-users).

question: How can I create a function in Wix to charge an additional fee for fragile items in a customer's cart?
answer:
To add a fragile packing fee in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Functions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Functions%20&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/functions/manage) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down **Additional Fees** and click **Create Function**.
3. Select **Fragile packing fee** and click **Use Template**.
4. Click the **Condition** step to update the logic for your business. Click the default **Item name** property to change it to another identifier, like Item price or Item ID. You can also update the specific values the function checks (e.g., wine glasses).
5. (Optional) Click **\+ Add Criterion** to add another condition.
6. Click **Apply** to save the condition.
7. Click **Output** to choose the fragile packing fee that should be applied.
   
   1. Edit the amount and name of the fee.
   2. (Optional) Enable the **Collect tax** toggle to make the additional fee taxable (calculated based on your tax settings).
   3. (Optional) Click **\+ Add Fee** to add additional fragile packaging fees.
   4. Select your site's main currency from the drop-down.
   
   5. Click **Apply** to save the output.
8. Edit the function name at the top left. This is only visible to you in the dashboard.
9. Click **Activate** at the top right.

Customers now receive an additional fee at checkout if they meet the function requirements.

Additionally, you can [enable a grace period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-grace-period-for-subscriptions-eg-stores-pricing-plans-recurring-invoices) for your recurring subscriptions, which gives customers more time to resubmit payment before their subscription cancels.

question: How do I connect my GoDaddy domain to Wix by updating the name servers?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- You must [upgrade your Wix site](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website?referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter) to connect your own domain.

### Step-by-step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Add the domain to your Wix account
1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Add an Existing Domain**.
3. Click **Connect a domain you already own**.
4. Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click **Next**.
5. Enter your domain name and click **Let's Go**.
6. Click **Yes, I own this domain** under the search field.
7. Review the info about updating your name servers and click **Start**.

#### Step 2 | Update the name servers in your domain host account (GoDaddy)
1. Log into your GoDaddy account.
   - Open a new tab in your browser.
   - Go to your GoDaddy account site and log in.
   - Return to the Wix domains page.
   - Click **I logged in**.
2. Find your domain settings page.
   - Click your profile at the top right and select **My Products**.
   - Find your domain and go to the settings panel.
   - Click **DNS** to the right of your domain.
   - Return to the Wix domains page.
   - Click **I found my domain settings**.
3. Find your name servers.
   - In your GoDaddy DNS settings, click **Change** in the name servers section.
   - Select **Enter my own name servers (advanced)**
   - Return to the Wix domains page.
   - Click **I found the name servers**.
4. Replace your name servers.
   - In the **Enter My Own Name servers** section, replace your name servers with the Wix name servers provided on the Wix domains page.
   - Click **I've replaced my name servers**.

### Additional Information
- It may take up to 48 hours for the name servers changes to [propagate worldwide](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).
- If you're having trouble updating your name servers, you can contact your domain host (GoDaddy) for assistance.

question: How can I edit the elements of my email campaign using the Wix app?

5. Tap the **More Actions** icon next to the campaign you want to edit.
6. Tap **Edit**. 

   **Note:** If you don't see this option, it means your campaign was created from desktop.
7. Tap the element in the campaign that you want to edit.
8. The relevant menu opens at the bottom. Choose what you want to edit:
   - **Change the design of an element:** Customize the element using [the available design options](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-customizing-your-campaign-in-the-wix-owner-app-2833777).
   - **Add a link to an element:**
     1. Tap the **Link** icon at the top of the customization menu.
     2. Tap the **Include Link** toggle to enable it.
     3. Choose where to link the element:
        - **My Wix Site:** The element links to your Wix site.

        - **Custom Link:** Enter a custom URL where the element should link to.
     4. Tap the place you want to link to.

     **Note:** You cannot add a link to a divider.
   - **Duplicate an element:** Tap the **Copy** icon to duplicate the element. The new element will appear directly beneath the one you copied.

   - **Delete an element:**
     1. Tap the **Delete** icon.
     2. Tap **Delete** to confirm.
9. Click **Next** to save your draft.

When you're done editing the campaign, [send it to your subscribers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-campaign-in-the-wix-owner-app).

question: How can I add my EU VAT ID when making a purchase on Wix to avoid being charged VAT?
answer:
If you are a business in the EU and you have a registered, valid EU VAT ID, you can enter it on the purchase page and you will **not** be charged VAT. Here are the steps to add your EU VAT ID:

1. Select your purchase from Wix and proceed to the checkout.
2. Enter your other payment and billing details.
3. Enter your VAT ID in the **VAT ID** field. 

**Tip**: You can verify your VAT ID using the [European Commission's VIES VAT validation tool.](https://europa.eu/youreurope/business/taxation/vat/check-vat-number-vies/index_en.htm)
4. Click **Submit Purchase**.

**Note**: The VAT information you enter applies to future invoices only (including your current purchase). While you can [update your current invoices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/updating-your-invoices-for-wix-services), some fields cannot be changed. For example, VAT ID and Country cannot be changed for current invoices which relate to previous purchases.

question: Can I use Wix services to handle electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) in compliance with HIPAA?
answer: Wix services are not specifically designed to comply with HIPAA. As such, we are unable to operate as a Business Associate, subcontractor, or agent of a Covered Entity, as these terms are defined in HIPAA. If your business requires you to be compliant with HIPAA, you are responsible for compliance with all applicable laws governing the privacy and security of ePHI. Likewise, if you are subject to HIPAA as a Covered Entity or Business Associate, you should not use Wix services in a manner that causes Wix to create, receive, maintain, or transmit ePHI on your behalf. If Wix services being HIPAA compliant is something you'd like to see in the future, you can [vote for that feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-making-wix-services-hipaa-compliant).

question: How can I connect my thermal printer to the Wix app to print online orders automatically?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have a [compatible printer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-compatible-thermal-printers-for-online-orders-new).
- Pair your printer with your device using Bluetooth, WiFi, or Ethernet.

### To connect the printer to the Wix app:
1. Access your online ordering settings in the Wix app:
   
   1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
   2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
   3. Tap **Restaurants**.
   4. Tap **Online Orders (New)**.
   5. Tap the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2023/06/29/9677c2c5-557c-44a3-a725-039090fdd815/3e8bfca9-e210-41ce-b349-fe173b0e9378.png) at the top right.
   6. Select **Manage settings**.
2. Connect your printer to the app:
   
   1. Tap **Thermal printing** under **Printing**.
   2. Tap **Get Started**.
   3. Tap **Next**, then tap **Next** again.
   4. Verify your printer is the one selected from the list and tap **Next**.
      
      **Tip:** You can tap another printer on the list to select it instead.
   5. Tap **Done**.
      
      **Tip:** Verify the printer is connected by tapping **Print a test order**.

Now that the printer is connected, it will automatically print incoming orders. Auto-printing requires the app to be constantly open – for your convenience, your Online Orders page always stays on (even if you're inactive for a while).

question: How can I notify customers when their order is shipped using ShipStation with my Wix store?
answer:
To notify customers when their order is shipped, you can send email notifications with tracking numbers to let them know that their packages are on the way. You have two options for sending notifications:

### Send shipping notifications through ShipStation
By default, sending notifications to customers is disabled. You can learn how to [enable and set up customer notifications in ShipStation](https://help.shipstation.com/hc/en-us/articles/360026157911-Customer-Notifications-Settings).

### Send shipping notifications through Wix
To send a Wix Store notification when fulfilling an order, select the **Send Shipping Confirmation Email** checkbox. 

**Tip:** You can also send an email by clicking **More Actions** in an order and then selecting the relevant option.

question: Can I transfer my Wix Bookings App from one site to another?

question: How can I connect a subdomain to my Wix site?
answer:
To connect a subdomain to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Add an Existing Domain**.
3. Select **Connect a domain you already own**.
4. Select the site you want to repackage as a subdomain.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Enter the new subdomain URL for the site you chose (e.g. "blog.mysite6.com").

   **Tip:** The URL should be a combination of your main domain (e.g. "mysite6.com") and a subdomain of your choice (e.g. "blog.")

7. Click **Let's Go**.
8. Follow the steps, according to your main domain connection type:
   
   * **If the main domain is a Wix domain / connected by name servers:** No action is needed. The subdomain will be in the same Wix account and any DNS records are automatically added.
   * **If the domain is connected by pointing / not connected to Wix:** Follow the on-screen instructions to add CNAME details at the domain host. 

   **Note:** Be sure to [add both sets of CNAME records](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-or-updating-cname-records-in-your-wix-account) to your DNS records.

It may take up to 48 hours for your subdomain to be visible worldwide. We’ll send you an email when your subdomain connection is live. Learn more [about domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: How can I use AI to create and edit product images for my online store on Wix?
answer:
To create and edit product images for your online store using Wix's AI tools, follow these steps:

1. Click **Crop & edit image** on your product image to access the Wix Photo Studio.
2. Once there, you will find several AI tools to enhance your image:
   - **Auto enhance**: Automatically enhance your images to give your product photos a professional look.
   - **Remove and change backgrounds**: Use AI to remove the background and place your product against a different backdrop.
   - **Improve image quality**: Use the Upscale Image tool to increase the resolution of your photos, making them look sharp and clear even on larger screens.
   - **Change parts of your image**: Use the AI Image Editor to select parts of your image and use AI to change it to whatever you want.
   - **Remove parts of the image**: Use the Object Eraser tool to remove any unwanted objects from your photos.

If you want to create a new image for your store, you can use the [AI Image Creator](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-creating-images-with-the-wix-ai-image-creator) to generate images based on a description of your product.

question: How can I ensure that my OBS settings are correct for live streaming on Wix Video?
answer:
To ensure that your OBS settings are correct for live streaming on Wix Video, follow these steps:

1. **Open the OBS Studio Encoder** on your computer.
2. Click **Settings** on the bottom right.
3. Select the **Output** tab to change the codec, audio, and video bitrates.
4. Select the **Video** tab to change the video resolution.
5. Click **OK**.

**Note**: To get the best results, make sure you don't exceed the following settings:
- Video Resolution: 720p (1280x720)
- Codec: x264
- Video bitrate: ~2500 kbps
- Audio bitrate: AAC 44.1kHz ~128kbps

Additionally, ensure that your encoder is set to software:

1. Open the OBS Studio Encoder on your computer.
2. Click **Settings** on the bottom right.
3. Click **Output** on the left.
4. Check that the **Encoder** setting is set to **Software**.
5. Click **OK**.

Make sure the output is set to 'Simple' as well, as setting it to 'Advanced' can cause issues with the live stream.

question: How can I change the currency and payment terms for my Wix invoices and price quotes?
answer:
To change the currency and payment terms for your Wix invoices and price quotes, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/settings) in your site's dashboard.

question: Why doesn't my button do anything when I click it on my Wix site?
answer:
If your button doesn't do anything or direct you to the right destination, follow these steps:

1. **Check that the button link has been set up correctly:**
   - Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-text-icon-buttons) to learn how to set up the button link for a **text button.**
   - Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-an-icon-button) to learn how to set up the button link for an **icon button.**

2. **Check for overlapping elements:**
   - See if another element, such as a text box, has been placed slightly over the button. This prevents your button from working properly. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-viewing-and-selecting-overlapping-elements) to learn how to view overlapping elements. You can either move or resize the element which is covering your button, or bring your [button to the front.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-arranging-elements-using-right-click)

3. **Disable the freeze setting on your header and footer:**
   - Sometimes these can overlap with the content of your site. [Disable the freeze setting](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-your-site-header) to see if it helps.

question: How can I submit a project request to get matched with a Wix Professional?
answer:
To submit a project request to get matched with a Wix Professional, follow these steps:

1. [Sign in to your Wix account](https://www.wix.com/).
2. Go to [your projects page in the Wix Marketplace](https://www.wix.com/marketplace/my-projects).
3. Click **New Project** at the top right and select **Find me a professional**.
4. Choose what you need help with and click **Next**.
5. Continue filling out the details of your request.
6. Enter your contact details and click **Submit**.

You'll hear back from a Professional within 1 business day. Together, you can discuss the project details and price to decide if you'd like to hire them. Before you hire a Wix Professional, make sure to discuss and agree on the price and payment method that works for both of you. It’s important to set the costs and terms of your agreement together with your professional. Please note that Wix doesn’t get involved in disputes. For more details, check out the [Wix Marketplace Terms of Service](https://www.wix.com/marketplace/terms-of-use).

question: How can I add a new product to my catalog using the Wix Retail POS tablet?
answer:
To add a product to the catalog using the Wix Retail POS tablet, follow these steps:

1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
3. Tap **Catalog**.
4. Tap **\+ New Product** at the top right.
5. Enter your product info:
   
   1. Enter the product's name.
   2. Enter the product price including cents.
   3. (Optional) **Add a sale price:**
      
      1. Tap the **On Sale** toggle to enable it.
      2. Select a discount type, percentage or amount.
      3. Enter the discount value (e.g. 20% or $10)
   4. Upload product images:
      
      1. Tap the Add Images icon.
      2. Upload one or more images of your product.
6. Set the product's visibility:
   
   1. Click the Point of Sale toggle to make the product available for checkout in the POS tablet.
   2. Click the Online Store toggle to display the product in your online store.
7. (Optional) Enter your product's inventory details:
   
   1. Enter your product's SKU / UPC code in one of the following ways:
      
      * Tap the Barcode icon and scan the product. [Learn How](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-retail-pos-about-your-hp-barcode-scanner#scanning-products-with-the-barcode-scanner-1)
      * Enter the SKU / UPC manually.
   2. Select an inventory option:
      
      * **Track inventory**
         
         1. Click the **Track Inventory** toggle to enable it.
         2. Enter the amount of the product in the **Inventory** field.
      * **Do not track inventory:**
         
         1. Click the **Track Inventory** toggle to disable it.
         2. From the drop-down, select **In stock** or **Out of stock**.
8. Assign a tax group.
9. **Categories:** Add your product to one or more categories.

   **Tip:** To create a new category, go to the **Categories** tab.
10. Tap **Save** at the top right.

question: How can I set up tax calculation manually for my Wix Store?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you are using Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, or Wix Restaurants Orders (New) & Wix Table Reservations.

To set up tax calculation manually for your Wix Store, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Add tax locations
1. [Go to Tax](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Tax&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+Add Location**.
3. Select a country from the **Country** drop-down.
4. (Optional) Click the **Set up tax for every region individually** toggle.
5. If you enabled the toggle, select one or more states/provinces etc. from the **Districts** drop-down.
6. Click **Add**.
7. (Optional) Repeat steps 2-6 to add additional tax locations.

## Step 2 | Enter your tax rates
1. [Go to Tax](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Tax&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select a tax location.
3. Enter the rates.
4. If you have multiple locations, repeat steps 2 and 3 for each one.
5. Click **Save**.

## Step 3 | (Optional) Customize advanced mode settings
1. [Go to Tax](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Tax&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant location.
3. Click the **Advanced mode** toggle to enable it.
4. (Optional) Add an additional tax rate:
   1. Click **Add rate**.
   2. Enter a rate name (e.g. GST).
   3. Enter the tax rate percentages.
   4. (Optional) Select the **Add to all tax groups in this location** checkbox.
   5. Click **Add**.
5. Enter the second name and rate (e.g. HST).
6. (Optional) Repeat step 4 to add additional rates.

## Step 4 | Set how tax is displayed in your shop
1. [Go to Tax](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Tax&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select an option:
   * **Tax should be added at checkout:** For example, if the tax rate is 10% and a customer buys a $100 product, they are charged $110 at checkout.
   * **Tax is already included in my prices:** For example, if the tax rate is 10% and a customer buys a $100 product, they are charged $100 at checkout.

## Step 5 | (Optional) Create tax groups
If some of your items are taxed at a different rate, you can create a custom tax group for them. For example, if children's car seats are tax-exempt in one of your tax locations, you can create a car seat tax group, add all the relevant products to the group, and assign the group a tax rate of 0%.

Learn how to [create tax groups](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-tax-groups-using-manual-tax-calculation).

question: How can I add and configure security headers for my organization's site using Wix Studio for enterprise?
answer:
To add and configure security headers for your organization's site using Wix Studio for enterprise, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Security Headers](https://manage.wix.com/enterprise-dashboard/security-headers) in your enterprise dashboard.
2. Click **+ Add Headers** at the top right.
3. Click the relevant site.
4. Click **Select**.
5. Select the checkbox next to the security headers you want to add and configure.
6. Configure the relevant security headers according to your needs, following the instructions below:

### Permissions-Policy
- Assemble the relevant [directives](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Permissions-Policy#directives) and their corresponding [allowlists](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Permissions_Policy#allowlists), separating each with a comma.
- Copy and paste your directives into the **Directives** field under **Permissions-Policy**.

### X-Frame-Options
- Click to expand the **Directive** drop-down under **X-Frame-Options**.
- Choose the relevant option: **Deny** or **Same-origin**.

### Referrer-Policy
- Click to expand the **Directive** drop-down.
- Choose the relevant option from the drop-down.

### Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
- Enter the **max-age**, specifying the duration in seconds. For example: max-age=63072000
- (Optional) Select the **includeSubDomains** checkbox.
- (Optional) Select the **preload** checkbox.

**Note:** When using preload, the **max-age** directive must be at least 31536000 (1 year), and the **includeSubDomains** directive checkbox must be enabled.

### Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
- Enter all relevant directives and their corresponding values in the **Directives** field.

**Important:** Only click **Save** at the top when you are finished configuring all the relevant headers, or you will have to start again from scratch.

question: What should I do if I encounter a 404 error on my live site?
answer:
If you encounter a 404 error on your live site, try the following steps to resolve it:

1. Reload the page by pressing **Ctrl** \+ **F5** (or **Cmd** \+ **R** on a Mac).
2. Check that the URL you are trying to access is correct, then re-enter it in your address bar and press **Enter**.
3. If you're trying to access a page other than your homepage, go to the homepage URL (e.g., www.mystunningwebsite.com), then access the page via a different link.
4. If you received a 404 error on a dynamic page, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-troubleshooting-dynamic-pages-issues#404-or-500-error-page) to learn how to resolve the issue.
5. Use another [supported browser](https://support.wix.com/en/article/supported-browsers). If the error only occurs in one browser, [clear your browser's cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache).

question: How can I resolve the issue of incorrect color contrast calculation when text is placed on a container box in the Accessibility Wizard?
answer:
If you place text on top of a container box without attaching it to the container, the color contrast calculation is not correct. As a result, you may see a card flagging an issue with the contrast. This is because the Wizard does not recognize the container as the background, and instead calculates the contrast based on the background that the container is on (e.g. a strip or section). In order to resolve this issue, you need to attach the text to the container box.

### Show me how to attach text to a container
1. Select the relevant text box in your editor.
2. Drag it outside of the box and drop it on the section / strip.
3. Click the text box again and drag it to your desired position into the container box.
4. Drop the text when you see the **Attach to Box** message.

![A screenshot of a box in the Editor. The cursor has dragged text over it. It says 'Attach to Box'.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/651c25b0-2d60-43c8-addf-1df2fd575568/2024/08/29/1a63f890-0d32-4904-9f8f-9c06c1b93f80/426cf749-0e3c-4260-87bf-bd0423df6677.png)

question: How can I adjust an existing grid in Editor X?
answer:
To adjust an existing grid in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. **Click the relevant container or page section.**
2. **Change the grid in one of the following ways:**
   
   **Choose a layout:**
   - Need a quick and easy grid? Choose one of the available layouts (e.g. 2x1, 2x2), or click **Other** to set the number of rows and columns yourself. 
   - **Note:** This may change the positioning of your elements.
   
   **Customize grid on canvas:**

question: Can I email chat transcripts from Wix Inbox and Chat?

question: How can I set up my Wix Art Store to sell digital images?
answer:
To set up your Wix Art Store to sell digital images, follow these steps:

### Step 1: Choose the type of images you want to sell (digital or print).
1. Click the Wix Art Store app in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Set Up Store**.
4. Click **Start Now**.
5. Click **Sell Digital**.
6. Click **OK**.

If your store already sells prints, and you would like to switch to digital image sales:
1. Click the Wix Art Store app in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Set Up Store**.
4. Click **Change** on the bottom of the window.
5. Select **Sell Digital** Under **Choose What You Want to Sell.**

### Step 2: Add the images you want to sell to your gallery.
1. Click the Wix Art Store app in the Editor.
2. Click **Manage Media**.
3. Click **\+ Add Media** on the top right.
4. Click **Image.**
5. Select images from your Media Manager or click **\+Add Images** to upload new files from your computer, social platform or file hosting service. 
   **Note:** This only uploads your images to your Art Store Files. To display your images in the gallery on your site, complete the rest of the steps.
6. Click the **Back** tab.
7. Select the images you want to display. 
   **Note:** You can add a title, description and link for each image, reorder the images or edit the image quality.
8. Click **Done**.

### Step 3: Set the pricing for the images.
1. Click **Set Pricing**.
2. Set which licenses you want to use: 
   * **License Templates:** Click the toggles under **My Licenses** to enable or disable each license option: 
     + **Commercial Use:** Web and digital use only.
     + **Extended Use:** Web, digital and print use.
   * **Custom License:** Click **Create License** and fill in the information to create a custom license: 
     1. Enter the name of the license in the **License Name** field.
     2. Enter a description of the license in the **Description** field.
     3. (Optional) Upload your license agreement: 
        1. Click **Upload**.
        2. Select your license document or click **Upload Docs** to upload it from your computer.
        3. Click **Apply**.
     4. Click **Save**.
3. Select or deselect the image resolution checkboxes and enter the price for the selected options: 
   * **Web Ready:** Image quality is slightly reduced to allow for quicker web loading.
   * **Original File:** The image is purchased in its original quality.
4. Click **Save**.

### Step 4: Set your payment and general store settings.
1. Click **Manage Store**.
2. Click the **Payment** tab.
3. Click **Connect** next to the payment method you want to use and follow the instructions provided.
4. Click the **Business Info** tab.
5. Enter your business's basic info:
   * **Business Name:** Enter the name of your business.
   * **Your Logo:** Click the **Add** icon **\+** and select your logo from the media manager, or click **Upload Images** to upload a new one, then click **Apply**. (**Optional:** Don't have a logo yet? Design your own stunning logo with Wix Logo, [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-about-the-wix-logo-maker-2200409).)
   * **Email:** Enter the email address you'd like to use for order confirmations.
6. Set your business's local settings:
   * **Language:** Select your language.
   * **Currency:** Select your store's currency.
   * **Price** **Format:** Select a currency format.
   * **Symbol Alignment:** Select where the currency symbol appears.
7. Click the **Email me when I make a sale** toggle to enable or disable email notifications:
   * **Enabled:** You receive an email notification when you make a sale.
   * **Disabled:** You do not receive an email notification when you make a sale. You can view your transactions on the **Orders** tab.
8. Click **Save**.

**Notes:**
* Your customers receive their digital files via email. To troubleshoot email delivery issues, advise your customers to check their spam / junk folders in their inbox, and contact their email provider to ensure they can receive emails from Wix. If this doesn't resolve the issue, [contact Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact).
* If you want to sell digital images and prints (e.g. canvases, mugs, phones cases), click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-art-store-setting-up-wix-art-store-to-sell-digital-images-and-prints).

question: Can I direct a domain or subdomain to a specific page on my Wix site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to direct a domain or subdomain to a page on your Wix site. It is only possible to connect a domain or subdomain to your site's home page.

question: How can I add a dynamic list page for my events using the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* [Add Wix Events to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-wix-events-to-your-site) and publish your events.
* [Add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.

### Steps to Add a Dynamic List Page for Your Events Using the Wix Editor

question: How can I customize the design of a single event in Wix Events using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize a design for a single event in Wix Events using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the Events page:
   - Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   - Click **Event Pages**.
   - Click your Events page.
3. Click the Event List element on your page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Choose what you want to customize:

### Ribbons
Ribbons help event organizers and attendees quickly understand the status and availability of an event.
1. Click the **Display** tab.
2. Click **Ribbons**.
3. Click the relevant ribbon name and enable the **Ribbon** toggle:
   - **Sold Out Ribbon:** All tickets for the event are sold out.
   - **RSVP Closed Ribbon:** Registration is closed.
   - **Join Waitlist Ribbon:** When an RSVP event has a waitlist.
   - **Membership Ribbon:** The event is exclusive to members only.
   - **Multiple Dates Ribbon:** The event occurs on multiple dates.

**Tip**: Click the **Text** tab to edit the text on the available ribbons.

### General Info / Time and Location
1. Click the **Display** tab.
2. Click the relevant toggle(s) to select which event details you want to show or hide:
   - **Countdown**: The remaining time until the event starts.
   - **Event Name**: The title of the event.
   - **Description**: A brief teaser text that appears under the event title.
   - **Event Image**: A visual representation or photo associated with the event.
   - **Guests**: The avatars of people attending the event.
   - **Social Sharing**: Allow attendees to share your event on social media platforms.
   - **Event Time**: The specific date and time when the event will occur.
   - **Event Location**: The venue or place where the event will be held, displayed above the event title.

### Design
When designing details for a single event, you can choose colors, font styles, and more to create a cohesive and visually appealing event page.
1. Click the **Design** tab.
2. Click the relevant design elements to customize the following:
   - **Text Design:** Personalize the font style, size, color, and other text properties.
   - **Ribbon Design:** Draw attention to important aspects of the event such as:
     - **Membership Ribbon**: Displayed when a ticketed event has memberships connected.
     - **Multiple Dates Ribbon**: Displayed when an event has multiple dates.
   - **Button design:** Customize the appearance of buttons, including their shape, color, and text.
   - **Background:** Customize the background color or image of the event page.
   - **Spacing:** Adjust the spacing between different elements on the event page to ensure a clean and organized layout.

question: Can I restrict specific customers from creating a referral link in the Wix Referral Program?

question: What should I do if my Google Workspace account is suspended due to not accepting the new Terms of Service?
answer:
If your Google Workspace account is suspended because you have not accepted the new Terms of Service, you need to reinstate your account by following these steps:

1. [Sign in to your admin account](https://admin.google.com).
2. Accept the new Terms of Service that will be displayed, which state: "Your reseller has placed an order for you. In order to start using newly provisioned services, you must accept the following terms of service. After accepting the terms of service, your services will be activated."

### Note
If you have not yet set up your Admin business email, you need to do so in order to accept Google's new Terms of Service. See instructions on [how to set up your Google Workspace business email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-purchasing-a-personalized-business-email).

question: Can I create unique shipping rules for different cities and counties in Wix Stores?

question: How can I earn points in the Wix Partner Program and what are the different ways to accumulate them?
answer:
In the Wix Partner Program, you can earn points by building Premium sites and completing certifications. Here are the ways to earn points:

- **Upgrade a Wix Studio or Editor X site to Premium:** Earn 300 points. [Upgrade a Wix Studio or Editor X site to Premium](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Upgrade%20Site&title=Select%20a%20Site%20to%20Upgrade&overrideLocale=en&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fstore%2Fplans%3FsiteGuid%3D%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%26referralAdditionalInfo%3DSITE_LIST)
- **Upgrade a Wix site to Premium:** Earn 100 points. [Upgrade a Wix site to Premium](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Upgrade%20Site&title=Select%20a%20Site%20to%20Upgrade&overrideLocale=en&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fstore%2Fplans%3FsiteGuid%3D%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%26referralAdditionalInfo%3DSITE_LIST)
- **Wix Learn certifications:**
  - Get an Accessibility certification: Earn 100 points. [Get an Accessibility certification](https://www.wix.com/learn/certification/accessibility)
- **Wix Studio Academy certifications:**
  - Get a Web Designer certification: Earn 100 points. [Get a Web Designer certification](https://www.wix.com/studio/academy/wixstudiocertifications/web-designer)
  - Get a Developer certification: Earn 100 points. [Get a Developer certification](https://www.wix.com/studio/academy/wixstudiocertifications/developer)

Additionally, you'll earn 100 points for working as a collaborator on Premium Wix Studio and Editor X sites. Points are awarded immediately after a site is upgraded to a Premium plan, but points for certifications may take a few business days to be applied to your account. Note that you can lose points if the Premium plan is canceled within the first 14 days.

question: Can I change the date and time format on my live Wix Bookings site?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to change the date and time format on a live site in Wix Bookings.

### Tip
The day which is used as the first calendar day is determined by the business location you entered in your regional settings. To learn how to change your regional settings, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information).

question: Does Wix Video automatically add the ContentURL and EmbedURL fields to the structured data markup of videos?
answer: Yes, when you add Wix Video to your site pages, either the contentURL or embedURL fields are now added automatically to the [structured data markup](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-structured-data-markup-to-your-sites-pages-2546962) of the videos, depending on the method you used to upload the file.

question: Can I integrate Wix Invoices with a bookkeeping system?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Wix Invoices with a bookkeeping system.

question: Can I connect an Accordion in the Studio Editor to the CMS?
answer: Currently, in the Studio Editor, it is not possible to connect the [Accordion element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-and-customizing-an-accordion-5177642) to the CMS (Content Management System).

question: Can I send an invoice to multiple recipients using Wix Invoices?
answer: Currently in [Wix Invoices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-invoices-about-wix-invoices) it is not possible to send an invoice to multiple recipients.

question: How can I upload media files to my Wix Studio for enterprise account and notify my clients about the new uploads?
answer:
To upload your media files to your Wix Studio for enterprise account and notify your clients, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Media](https://manage.wix.com/enterprise-dashboard/media) in your enterprise dashboard.
2. Click **+ Upload Files** at the top right.
3. Click **Upload Files** to select the files you want to upload.
4. (Optional) Choose a category for your files, or click **+ Add New Category** to add a new one.
5. Click **Upload**.

Once you've uploaded a batch and want to share the news, click **Notify Clients** to notify your clients of the new media available for them to use in their sites. Your clients can also filter their media by the categories you've created.

question: Can I store a backup of my Wix site outside of Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to back up your site externally. Wix is committed to ensuring the safety of your site, and we have created the [Site History](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-and-managing-your-site-history) feature, which automatically creates site revisions every time you save or publish. This means that you can go back to a previous version of your site any time you want. You can also [duplicate your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/duplicating-your-site-1472847) at any time to create a manual backup in your Wix account. Be aware that the duplicated site is not automatically updated when your update your original site.

question: Can I add a welcome screen to greet visitors on mobile as my client's site loads in the background?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add a welcome screen to greets visitors on mobile as your client's site loads in the background.

question: Can I set the offset in px* for sticky elements and sections in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to set the offset in px\* for sticky elements and sections. You can enter the offset value in px, percentage (%), vh or vw. For more information, you can refer to the [sticky elements or sections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-creating-sticky-elements-and-sections) article.

question: How can I update the inventory of multiple products at once in Wix Stores?
answer:
To update the inventory of multiple products at once in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Inventory](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Inventory&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/inventory/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the checkboxes next to the products whose inventory you want to update.
3. Click **Update Inventory** at the top right.
4. Select an option:
   
   * **Add the same number of items to multiple products:** Select **Add** and click the arrows to select the inventory amount to add to the selected product (e.g. add 30 items of inventory to each selected product).
   * **Set the inventory of multiple items to the same level:** Select **Set** and then use the arrows to set the inventory to a particular level (e.g. set the inventory of all the selected products to 100).
   * **Choose an option from the drop-down:** If you are not tracking inventory, select an inventory status (**In stock** or **Out of stock**).

question: Can I design widgets in Wix Blocks that adjust according to specific custom breakpoints?
answer: Currently, in [Wix Blocks](https://support.wix.com/en/article/blocks-unboxed-a-quick-tour), it is not possible to design widgets that adjust according to specific custom breakpoints. You can build responsive layouts and define which layout is shown on mobile or desktop, but custom breakpoints are not supported.

question: How can I add a new page to my site using Editor X?
answer:
To add a page to your site in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2021/08/23/fdcd0c14-9ff7-4e99-99ab-3790d0960552/2c438246-bf80-4813-863f-4dc81c955926.jpg) at the top of Editor X.

   * **Member's Page:** A standard blank page that's only visible to your [site members](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-and-managing-a-members-area).
   * [**Dynamic Page**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages): A page that can change its content while keeping the same design and layout. Any element that's connected to your [Content Collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-content-management-system-an-overview) changes according to what item is being viewed.
4. Enter the page name and press **Enter** on your keyboard.

**Notes:**
* New pages are automatically displayed on your site's main menu.
* Some apps (e.g. Wix Stores, Wix Bookings etc.) add pages to your site automatically. Your pages are divided into categories in the Pages panel so you can easily find them.

**Tip:** Editor X sites have [a limit of 100 static pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-your-sites-page-limit). Dynamic pages are a handy solution to this limitation, as they allow you to have an unlimited amount of pages on your site.

question: How can I display my blog posts in a custom feed using a repeater or table on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure that the Wix Blog is added to your site.
- Enable Wix App Collections.
- Have a few posts and categories created.
- Add a dataset to your site.
- Be able to connect content to a repeater or table.
- Have a page ready to display your blog posts feed.

### Step 1 | Add a repeater or table to the relevant page on your site
1. In the Editor, open the page where you want to display your blog feed.
2. Click **Add** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2022/01/21/388a0337-7b76-459f-afa9-68d3698f81f3/4b6fbe51-a810-43ff-8b7d-8c9f999288a5.png) on the left side of the Editor.
3. Click **List**.
4. Drag and drop your selected repeater or table onto the page.

### Step 2 | Add a dataset to the page (and connect it to the blog post collection)
1. Click **CMS** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2022/01/21/20a13e41-bd48-4e39-9879-92f2bae40260/06c6b87f-9fc3-4c53-8f02-5a068764b185.png) on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Add Content Elements** then click the Add icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2021/02/05/d8cc34d4-f273-47f6-8794-bd2f2ec86601/49c26ce5-53e3-4168-a96a-6b9f63e2e62f.png) next to **Dataset**.
3. Click the newly added dataset.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Select **Posts** from the **Connect a collection** drop-down.

### Step 3 | Connect the table or repeater to the dataset
1. Click your repeater or table in your Editor.
2. Click the **Connect to Data** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2021/02/05/a79c5a31-5400-4f3a-a563-55baee76f19d/af2149e3-4ba4-4455-a399-8b4bd3c57499.png).
3. From the **Connect a dataset** drop-down, select the **Posts dataset**.
4. Link each of the components of your repeater or table to the appropriate fields in the collection. Click the arrow next to each of the components in the repeater or table (text, image etc.) and connect each one to the desired fields in the collection. **Note:** You can also link an image or button to **Post Page URL (URL)**. This brings the visitor to that blog post when clicked.
5. Click **Preview**.

### Additional Tips
- You can control the number of posts being shown using the repeater’s Dataset Settings or the Table Layout.
- Add a [pagination](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar) or a [load more button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-about-displaying-collection-content-in-a-repeater#navigating-through-a-repeater) to display more blog posts.
- Adjust the [order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-about-filtering-and-sorting-live-site-content-with-datasets#sorting-your-dataset-connector) of your post to show a specific sequence.
- Create a custom feed displaying blog posts from specific categories. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-your-blog-categories-using-datasets)

question: How can I ensure my Wix site is PCI compliant?
answer: Every site built on Wix is automatically PCI compliant by default with the highest Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards, regardless of the [payment provider](https://support.wix.com/en/article/available-payment-providers-in-your-country) used. This means that our certifications extend to your site and its checkout process. Wix holds PCI DSS Level 1: Merchant & Service Provider, a standard which provides protection of the privacy and confidentiality of card data used to complete online transactions.

question: How can I add a link to an image in my Wix Blog post?
answer:
To add a link to an image in your Wix Blog post, follow these steps:

1. **Add a new image or edit an existing one:**
   - **Add new image:**
     1. Click the **Add** icon.
     2. Click the **Image** icon.
     3. Choose to upload media or select one from stock images.
   - **Edit existing image:**
     1. Click the relevant image in your post.
     2. Click the **Link** icon.
2. Copy the URL of the link you want to add and paste it into the link box.
3. Select the relevant checkboxes to choose how the link behaves:
   - **Link opens in a new tab:** The link, when clicked, opens in a new tab on the screen.
   - **Noreferrer:** A noreferrer link does not provide information on the referring website.

   - **Sponsored:** A sponsored link indicates that the link contains a product advertisement or affiliate marketing.

question: How can I copy and paste a page from one Wix site to another, and what should I be aware of during the process?
answer:
To copy and paste a page from one Wix site to another, follow these steps:

1. Click **Menus & Pages** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2022/04/17/2d32eef4-cb8c-4ea8-bad8-69c19116b6ce/0f873f21-0353-4c6b-b81d-6749cc6c2aec.png) on the left side of the Editor.
2. Right-click the relevant page and click **Copy**.
3. Open the Editor of the site you want to paste to.
4. Paste the page by doing one of the following:
   * Right-click anywhere on the screen and select **Paste**.
   * Right-click anywhere on the screen and select **Paste & Apply Site Theme** to apply the color and text themes on the target site.
5. (In the Pages panel) Rename the new page:
   1. Enter the new page name.
   2. Click **Done**

### Important Considerations:
- You can only copy regular pages. You cannot copy anchors, links, folders, lightboxes, router pages, or pages from third-party and Wix business solution apps.
- If any elements on the page have a link to a page, anchor, or lightbox, it is replaced with a link to the home page of the target site.
- If any elements on the page are animated, the animation is applied to the target site.
- When copying and pasting **password protected pages**, the password protection is removed.
- When copying and pasting **members-only pages**, all members will have access to the pasted page.
- The pasted page is always added as a main page to the Site Menu page list, even if the original was a subpage.
- If you are unable to copy and paste pages, it's likely that the browser local storage is full. To resolve this, [clear your local storage](https://www.leadshook.com/help/how-to-clear-local-storage-in-google-chrome-browser/).

question: How can I automate my shipping and delivery process using third-party apps on Wix?
answer: To automate your shipping and delivery process on Wix, you can add third-party apps that provide an all-in-one solution for shipping and delivery. These apps can assist you with everything from shipping rates and labels to parcel tracking and returns.
