question: How can I export my restaurant orders from the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To export your restaurant orders from the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/restaurants/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More** at the top right and select **Export.**
3. Select a time option from the **Received** drop-down list.
4. (Optional) Click **Show export options** and select the checkboxes next to the details you want to include in the export:
   
   * **Customer details:** Name, phone, email, and delivery address.
   * **Financial information:** Subtotal, discounts, tax, tip, payment details.
   * **Ordered dishes:** Dish titles and counts.
5. Click **Export**.
6. Click **Download CSV**.
7. Save the file to your computer:
   
   * **Chrome:** The .csv file downloads and appears on the bottom of your screen.
   * **Firefox:** Select **Open with** to open or **Save File** to save.
   * **Internet Explorer:** Click **Save** at the bottom of your screen.
   * **Safari:** Click **cmd + s** on your keyboard to save the file (with a .csv extension, and Page Source format).

The exported file includes the dish name, quantity, and dish options (e.g. pizza toppings).

question: How can I manage the working hours of my staff members in Wix Bookings?
answer:
To manage your staff members' working hours in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. **Set your default work hours**: This applies to all staff members. You can do this by visiting the [set your default work hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-default-work-hours) page.

2. **Set individual staff members' hours**: For more flexibility, you can customize the working hours for each staff member. Visit the [set individual staff members' hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-editing-your-staff-members-working-hours) page to make these adjustments.

This two-level system allows you to offer a more flexible service to clients by setting both default and individual working hours.

question: How can I send email invitations for my event using Wix Email Marketing?
answer:
To send email marketing about an event using Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant event.
3. Click the **Guests** tab (RSVP events) or **Orders** tab (ticketed events) at the top.
4. Do one of the following:
   * If your event already has registered guests:
     1. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2019/02/13/63019e14-c2df-4e58-bac5-c5e4cf1b13b6.png).
     2. Click **Send Email Marketing**.
   * If your event still has no registered guests:
     1. Click **Create Invitation**.
5. Browse through the templates and select the one you want to use.
6. [Customize your email template](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-customizing-your-email-campaign).
7. Once you are finished, click **Next**.
8. Add recipients:
   * **If you have contacts in your account:** Select the contacts that you want to send the campaign to.
   * **If you do not have contacts in your account:** Enter the email addresses manually or click **Import Contacts** to import your contact list.
9. Click **Next**.
10. Enter the newsletter details:
    * **Subject Line:** The subject line of the email.
    * **From Name:** The name that the email campaign is sent from. This may be your business name or your personal name.
    * **Reply-to Email:** The email address that the email campaign is sent from. Replies are sent to this email address.
    
    **Note:** If you have not yet [confirmed your email address](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-confirming-your-email-address), click **Confirm Now**.
11. (Optional) Click **Send Test Email** to see what your event invitation will look like to recipients.
12. Click **Send**.

### Important
* Make sure you read the [Wix Email Marketing Terms of Use](http://www.wix.com/shoutouttos/terms) before sending an email campaign.
* To access more features and send more campaigns, you can [upgrade your email marketing plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-upgrading-your-email-marketing-plan).

question: How can I start selling products using the Wix member apps?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have downloaded the Wix app and the relevant member app.

To start selling products using the Wix member apps, follow these steps:

1. **Download the Wix app**:
   - Go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android).
   - Type 'Wix app' in the **Search** field.
   - Click **Get** or **Install** to download the app.
   - Alternatively, download directly using these links:
     - [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wix-owner-websites-apps/id1545924344)
     - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wix.admin&hl=en&gl=US)

2. **Download the relevant member app**:
   - Go to the Apple App Store (on iPhone) or Google Play (on Android).
   - Enter the name of the member app you want to download in the **Search** field (e.g. Spaces by Wix, Fit by Wix, Dine by Wix, Branded App by Wix).
   - Click **Get** or **Install** to download the app.
   - Alternatively, download directly using these links:
     - **Spaces by Wix**
       - [iPhone](https://itunes.apple.com/app/wix/id1099748482)
       - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wix.android)
     - **Fit by Wix**
       - [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fit-by-wix/id1552621043)
       - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wix.fitness&hl=en&gl=US)
     - **Dine by Wix**
       - [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/ai/app/dine-by-wix/id1561524113)
       - [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wix.restaurants&hl=en_IE&gl=US)

3. **Build your store**:
   - Go to your site in the Wix app.
   - Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
   - Tap **Manage Apps**.
   - Tap **Add** next to **Store**.
   - Build your store by adding products, organizing them into categories, and setting up payment, shipping, and tax preferences.
   - Learn more about adding products and organizing categories using these links:
     - [Add products](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-a-product-in-the-wix-owner-app)
     - [Organize products into categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-and-managing-categories-using-the-wix-owner-app)
     - [Set how you want to accept payment](https://support.wix.com/en/article/spaces-by-wix-connecting-a-payment-method)
     - [Set shipping, delivery, and pickup options](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-setting-up-shipping-using-the-wix-owner-app)

4. **Customize your member app**:
   - Customize your site on the member apps to put the most important information and actions front and center.
   - Learn how to [customize your site on the member apps](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-mobile-apps-customizing-your-site-on-the-member-apps).

5. **Invite visitors to connect to your member app**:
   - Invite your customers, clients, and contacts to download your member app and connect to your site.
   - Learn how to [invite people to join your site on the Wix member apps](https://support.wix.com/en/article/inviting-people-to-join-your-site-on-the-wix-member-apps).

question: How can I enable push notifications for the Wix app on my mobile device?
answer:
If you can't see push notifications on your device's notification screen, try the following steps:

1. Make sure you have enabled push notifications for the Wix app in the general notification settings of your phone. This differs from one device to another.

2. Check your site notification settings in the Wix app:
   1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
   2. Tap your profile icon at the top.
   3. Tap **Notification Settings** under **App Settings**.
   4. Select your site from the list (if you have more than one).
   5. Enable the **Allow Push Notifications** toggle to allow site notifications to your mobile device.
   6. (Optional): Manage the notification settings for the apps on your site by enabling or disabling the toggle next to the app's name.

**Note:** If you had both Spaces by Wix and the Wix app downloaded and stopped receiving push notifications after uninstalling the Wix app, re-download the Wix app and try again.

question: Can I set the exposure of a test site to change automatically?

question: How can I add an accessibility toolbar to my Wix site using third-party code?
answer:
To add an accessibility toolbar using third-party code on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the **Custom Code** tab under **Advanced Settings**.
3. Select **\+ Add Custom Code** at the top right.
4. Paste the code snippet in the text box.
5. Enter a name for your code. 

   **Tip:** Give it a name that is easy to recognize so you can quickly identify it later.
6. Select an option under **Add Code to Pages**:
   
   * **All pages:** This adds the code to all of your site's pages, including any new pages that you'll create in the future. Choose whether to load the code only once per visit or on each page your visitor opens.
   * **Choose specific pages:** Use the drop-down menu to select the relevant pages.
7. Choose where to place your code:
   
   * Head
   * Body - start
   * Body - end
8. Select **Apply**.

**Important:** Embedding custom code is only available for sites with a [connected domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domains).

question: How can I add Wix Site Search to my site using the Wix Editor?

question: How can I create and customize a promotional video for a product in my Wix Store?
answer:
To create and customize a promotional video for a product in your Wix Store, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Store Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant product.
3. Click **Promote this product** on the right.
4. Click the right arrow and select **Promotional Video**.
5. Do one of the following:
   
   * **Save a video as is:**
     1. Preview the video or videos created for you and click to select the video you want to save.
     2. Click **Save & Share**.
   * **Customize the video:**
     1. Preview the video or videos created for you.
     2. Click **Customize Video**.
     3. Customize the video content:
        1. Click the Plus icon to add additional media.
        2. **Product Name**: Edit the name of the product.
        3. **Business Name**: Add the name of your business.
        4. **Price**: Edit the price that you want to display.
        5. **Call to Action**: Add a text to drive potential customers back to your store.
        6. Click **Next**.
     4. Customize the video design:
        1. **Video Style:** Select the look and feel of your video.
        2. **Layout:** Select horizontal, vertical, or square.
        3. **Main Color**: Pick the primary color for the text and graphic elements in your video.
        4. **Secondary Color**: Pick a secondary color for the text and graphic elements in your video.
        5. **Font Style**: Pick a font that reflects your product and brand.

        3. Click the track that you want to use to select it.

6. (Optional) Display business info at the end of the video:
   1. Click the **Include info at the end of this video** toggle to enable it.
   2. Upload your business logo.
   3. Enter the business info you want to display.
7. Click **Apply & Preview** to view your video.
8. Click **Back to Editing** to make more changes or **Save & Share** to save a high definition version of your video.
9. (Optional) To share your video on social media or download your video, click **Upload / Download** under the relevant option.

question: How can I upload a Google Sheets spreadsheet to the Table Master app?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that your Google Sheets spreadsheet is published and you have the public URL for it.

To upload a Google Sheets spreadsheet to the Table Master app, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Publish Your Google Sheets Spreadsheet
1. Open your Google Sheets spreadsheet.
2. Click **File** at the top left.
3. Click **Share**.
4. Select **Publish to the web** from the drop-down menu.
5. Click **Publish**.
6. Click **OK** in the pop-up window.

question: How can I apply a page layout without a header and footer in Wix Editor?

- If you choose the **No Header & Footer** layout, the page does not display the menu in the header. Therefore, if you want your visitors to be able to navigate to the rest of your site, make sure to link a button to your site's main page. [Learn more about linking buttons to site pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-a-link-to-a-button)

question: How can I add and customize the Featured Members list on my Wix site?
answer:
To add the Featured Members element to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Community**.
3. Click **Featured Members**.
4. Drag the Featured Members element onto your page.

Once added, you can manage the list of members by:

1. Clicking the Featured Members element in your Editor.
2. Clicking **Members**.
3. Searching for the member you need by typing their name in the search bar or scrolling through the list.
4. Hovering on the relevant member and clicking the More Actions icon.
5. Clicking **Show** to add them to the list.

To customize which details to show about Featured Members:

1. Click the Featured Members element in your Editor.
2. Click the Elements icon.
3. Select the checkbox next to the elements that should appear about each member, such as **Image**, **Role description**, **Company name**, **About**, and **Link**.

To design the Featured Members list:

1. Click the Featured Members element in your Editor.
2. Click the element again to select a container box.
3. Click the Design icon.
4. Adjust the design options like **Fill Color & Opacity**, **Border**, **Corners**, and **Shadow**.

To change the layout of the Featured Members list:

1. Click the Featured Members element in your Editor.
2. Click **Preset**.
3. Choose the layout that suits your look, such as **Cards** or **Side by side**.

Please note that as of January 2024, the Featured Members element is no longer actively maintained. Consider using alternatives like a [repeater](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-managing-repeaters-lists-grids), [Pro Gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-adding-and-setting-up-your-gallery), or [Staff Member widget](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-and-customizing-a-staff-widget-on-your-site).

question: Can I refund ticket purchases directly through Wix Events?

question: What steps can I take if I am unable to view images on my site?
answer:
If you are unable to view images on your site, follow these steps to resolve the issue:

1. Clear your [browser's cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache).
2. View your site using [incognito or private browsing mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/opening-your-browser-in-incognitoprivate-browsing-mode).
3. View your site in the latest version of another [supported browser](https://support.wix.com/en/article/supported-browsers).
4. Temporarily disable any internet security programs installed (e.g. antivirus, firewall) and try to access your site again. It is preferable to try this while connected to the modem directly.
5. Try viewing your Wix site from a different computer that uses a different network to connect to the internet.

question: Can I schedule recurring class sessions months apart using Wix Bookings?

question: What are some examples of prohibited products and services for Wix Payments in the United States?
answer:
Wix Payments may not be used in relation to any of the following:

### Adult
- Adult goods (excluding fetish products)
- Fetish products
- Pornographic content: books, magazines, audio, videos, websites, streaming services and other content formats deemed offensive or of a sexual nature
- Entertainment: Gentleman's clubs, topless bars, strip clubs, sexually oriented massage parlors, saunas, escort agencies, or any sexually-related services
- Sexually oriented dating services

### Financial businesses
- Binary options
- Buy now pay later / Installment payment methods
- Credit card and identity theft protection
- Credit repair and credit protection business
- Debt repayment and collection agency
- E-wallet or e-money that can be monetized, re-sold or converted to physical and digital goods and services or otherwise exit the virtual world
- Extended warranties
- Financial service or money service business, including but not limited to:
  - Traveler checks
  - Money orders
  - Foreign Exchange
  - Check cashing
  - Virtual currencies
  - Cash advances by non-financial institutes
- Fines or penalty collections of any kind
- Forwarding brokers
- Independent or unlicensed financial advisors

**Note**: You may be allowed to provide educational financial services as long as such services do not include financial advice. You'll need to add a disclaimer to your site that clarifies that you do not provide financial advice.

### Healthcare
- Prescription-only and regulated medical devices (including contact lenses)
- Dental supplies
- Health practitioners, private medical practices, e-doctors, dental/medical services and facilities
- Intravenous therapy (e.g. IV drip bar, vitamin infusions, hangover cures)
- Medical benefit packages
- Pharmaceuticals, prescription medicine
- Supplements which include prescription ingredients and/or containing CBD/THC
- Nutraceuticals that are harmful or make unsupportable claims
- Nutraceuticals solely focused on weight loss or increasing sexual performance

### Intellectual Property (IP)
- Counterfeit products, replicas or designed infringements of them including products designed to circumvent IP
- Essay mills, paper mills where the intent is to falsely submit documents as their own work
- Products designed to circumvent copyright protection techniques or to otherwise facilitate the unlicensed use of copyrighted material

### Marketing practices
- Business investment opportunities operating as ‘get rich quick schemes’
- Business models that use ransom- or extortion-like practices
- Business practices that are designed to evade excessive chargeback monitoring programs
- Data pass
- Deceptive marketing tactics related to disclosure, false or inaccurate claims, before/after claims, endorsements, cancellation or refunds avoidance, pre-checked opt-ins, poorly disclosed negative options, misappropriation of incentives, disproportionate rebates, sweepstakes
- Fake references and other services or products that foster deception
- Inbound telemarketing for postcard or mailings
- Products or services that promote hate, violence, discrimination, terrorism, harassment or abuse in any shape or form
- Pyramid selling, chain letters or other financial scams

### Not for profit
- Unregistered charities

**Important**: By using your Wix Payments account for your registered charity, you declare that you manage the entire flow of the donation and that no funds will be sent to third parties

### Other products and services
- Airlines
- Ancestry research
- Animals and wildlife products classified as endangered or protected
- Bail bonds and bankruptcy lawyers
- Bidding fee and penny auctions
- Certain social media business (e.g. click farms, sale of Twitter followers, Facebook likes, YouTube views, and other forms of social media activity and online traffic)
- Cloud storage, VPN, file sharing, (high-risk) cyber lockers
- Cruise Lines
- Direct Marketing – Inbound teleservices, outbound telemarketing and travel-related arrangement services, Insurance services, catalog merchants, door-to-door sales
- Governmental services, such as embassies or consulates
- Hazardous materials (B2B), including but not limited to:
  - Hydrofluoric acid
  - Products containing cyanide
  - Prohibited ozone-depleting substances (ODS)
  - Nitric acid
  - Peptides, research chemicals
  - Bacteria cultures or other products containing E-coli or Escherichia coli
  - Toxic, flammable and/or radioactive materials
- Hazardous materials (B2C), as described above
- Human body parts or bodily fluids (excluding hair and teeth)
- Internet product and service providers
- Key-entry telecom merchant
- Live-streaming Services with in-app currency
- Live-streaming Services with in-app donations functionality
- Multi-level marketing
- Pawn shops
- Telemarketing companies selling products or services as an agent for a third party
- Timeshare and timeshare maintenance
- Veterinary practices

### Regulated (non-financial) products and services
- Alcohol sales as main product (e.g. alcohol shops, bars, breweries, wineries)
- Cannabis dispensaries and related businesses
- Drugs, and tools specifically intended for the production of drugs, drug paraphernalia, illegal drugs, substances designed to mimic illegal drugs and/or other psychoactive products

**Important**: Wix Payments does not support the sale of products that contain CBD and/or THC. However, for users in the USA selling CBD products, Wix offers other payment solutions. Learn more about [selling CBD with Wix](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/sell/cbd).

### Securities and trading
- Cryptocurrency exchange
- Cryptocurrency mining equipment
- High-risk securities such as:
  - Contract for difference (CFD)
  - Financial spread betting
  - Initial coin offering (ICO)
  - Forex currency options
  - Cryptocurrency options
  - Trading and purchases
- Security brokers/investments of any kind including the purchase of:
  - Securities
  - Currencies
  - Derivatives
  - Commodities
  - Shares
  - Options
  - Precious metal
  - Other financial instruments

### Third party payment processing
- Aggregators, including but not limited to:
  - Marketplaces
  - Platforms
- Staged Digital Wallet Operators
- Payment Facilitators or other internet payment or member service providers (IPSP or MPS)
- Payment service companies, including but not limited to:
  - Peer-to-peer
  - Bill payments
  - Commissary accounts

### Technology
- Decryption and descrambler products and services, devices designed to block, jam or interfere with cellular and personal communications

question: How can I connect an email purchased outside of Wix to my Wix domain?
answer:
To connect an email purchased outside of Wix to your Wix domain, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the relevant domain.
3. Select **Connect an email purchased outside of Wix** or **Edit MX records**.
4. Select your provider from the drop-down and click **Save**.

**Note:** If your provider isn't listed, select **Other** and follow the instructions to manually add the MX and other DNS records.

### To add your provider's MX and other DNS records:
1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the relevant domain.
3. Select **Connect an email purchased outside of Wix** or **Edit MX records**.
4. Select **Other** from the list.
5. Click the **Points to** field and enter the mail server address of your MX record.

**Note:** The **Host name** field cannot be edited. It is not currently possible to [connect a business email to a subdomain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-connecting-a-mailbox-to-a-subdomain) in Wix.

6. (If you have multiple MX records) Add the additional MX records:

**Note:** Enter the record with the lowest Priority value first. The [Priority values](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-the-priority-of-your-mx-records) do not need to match your provider's directions, but they do need to be in the same order.

### To add other DNS records (if required):
1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the relevant domain and select **Manage DNS Records**.
3. Scroll to the record type you'd like to add (e.g. CNAME, TXT) and click **+ Add Record**.
4. Enter the DNS record in the relevant fields.

**Note:** If instructed to add an **@** sign in the **Host name** field, leave the field blank instead.

5. Click **Save**.
6. Repeat steps 3-5 above to add additional DNS records.

### Important
* It can take up to 48 hours for this process to complete while the new records propagate.

question: How can I customize the SEO Basics settings for my Wix site pages?
answer:
To edit your SEO basics settings:

1. [Go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-3c4f785a-4597-467a-8279-ceddc7b499e2&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to **Tools and settings**.
3. Click **Go to SEO Settings** under **SEO Settings**.
4. Select the page type that you want to edit. 

   **Note:** You will only see options for the pages that are part of your site. For example, if you [added Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores) to your site, you'll see an option to customize settings for **Products**.
5. Click **Edit** next to **Basics & social share**.
6. Customize the SEO Basics settings:

   ### Title tag
   This is the title of your page(s) in search results. By default, Wix adds variables to this field to automatically create a title tag for each page. For example, with your Main Pages, Wix adds the variables "Page Name" and "Site Name" for the title tags. 
   Click the **Title tag** field to edit existing variables, add new ones, or enter static text.

   ### Meta description
   This is the description of the page(s) that appears in search results below the URL and title. By default, Wix does not add any variables to the meta description field. This is because search engines like Google often use a page's content to create a meta description that relates to a user's specific search query. 
   You can [add variables to this field](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-variables-in-seo-settings) to create a rule that applies to all of your pages. For example, for Wix Stores product pages, you could add the "Product Description" variable. 
   Click the **Meta description** field to enter static text. You can also click **+ Add Variable** to use dynamic values in your meta description. 

   **Note:** Some SEO audit tools may detect an empty field for the meta description. This is not an issue. Search engines like Google will create a meta description for your page.

   ### Let search engines index your page(s)
   Enable the toggle to allow search engines to [crawl and index](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/beginner/how-search-works#crawling) the page(s) so they can appear in search results. This applies to all pages within the same page type (e.g. all Products pages or all Booking Services pages). 
   If you disable the toggle, search engines will not be able to crawl and index the pages. This means people will not be able to find the pages in search engines like Google.

7. Click **Save**.

### Note
Many page types show a **Page URL** field to show the URL slug structure of the pages. Hover over the **Info** icon to learn more about the specific page type's URL.

question: How can I create a price discount coupon in Wix Stores?
answer:
To create a price discount coupon in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Coupons](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Coupon**.
3. Select **$ Discount**.
4. Enter the **Coupon code** customers need to enter.
5. Enter the **Coupon name**. 
   
   **Note:** This name appears in the cart page and your site's dashboard.
6. Enter the discount amount.
7. Select an option from the **Apply to** drop-down:
   
   * **All products:** Applies to all products (customers can apply it to multiple products).
   * **Specific product:** Applies to one product. Click the **Product** drop-down and select the product.
   * **Specific category:** Applies to all the products in a category. Click the **Category** drop-down and select the category.
   * **Minimum order subtotal:** Customers can use the coupon when their order subtotal is over a specific amount. Enter the amount under **Minimum subtotal**.
8. Select which items get the discount (doesn't appear if you chose "minimum subtotal"):
   
   * **Apply only to the lowest priced item:** If a customer buys multiple items that the coupon applies to, only the lowest price item is discounted.
   * **Apply to every relevant item in an order:** If a customer buys multiple items that the coupon applies to, all are discounted.
9. (Optional) Select the **Include subscriptions** checkbox to apply this coupon to [product subscriptions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-selling-product-subscriptions). 
   
   **Note:** Applies to every cycle (e.g. every month of a monthly subscription). Make sure the coupon value isn't greater than the subscription price.
10. Set when the coupon is valid:
    
    1. Enter the start date.
    2. Enter the end date, or select the **Don't set an end date** checkbox.
11. (Optional) Select the checkboxes next to the limits you want to apply:
    
    * **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon:** Enter the total number of times the coupon can be used. 
      
      **Tip:** Multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually.
    * **Limit to one use per customer:** Each customer can use the coupon only once.
12. Click **Create Coupon**.

question: How can I set up Single Sign-On (SSO) login for my organization using Wix?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Ensure you have access to the [Wix Studio enterprise solution](https://www.wix.com/enterprise) or [Wix Channels](https://www.wix.com/channels).
* Confirm that your Identity Provider (IdP) supports the [Open ID Connect protocol](https://openid.net/developers/how-connect-works/).

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Find your Identity Provider (IdP) settings
1. Locate the **Client ID**, **Client Secret**, and **Config URL** in your IdP settings.
2. For Azure, find these on the App Registration page in your Azure Portal. You need a specific role such as Global Administrator to view this information.
3. For Okta, find these in the OIDC app page in your Okta account.

#### Step 2 | Go to your account's SSO Settings
1. [Sign in to your Wix account](https://users.wix.com/signin).
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **SSO & SCIM Settings**.

#### Step 3 | Select the type of SSO login you want to allow
1. Choose between **SSO for employees** or **SSO for clients** in the SSO Settings.
2. Click **Add** next to the type of SSO login you want to allow.

#### Step 4 | Add your IdP information in SSO Settings
1. Enter the Client ID and Client Secret from your IdP.
2. Select the Config URL option and enter the Config URL from your IdP.
3. Optionally, override the well-known config by entering your own authorization values.
4. Click **Save Changes**.

#### Step 5 | Enable SSO login and set as required if needed
1. Click the **Enable SSO** toggle to enable or disable SSO login.
2. Click the **Set SSO as required** toggle to require SSO login.
3. Click **Save Changes**.

#### Step 6 | Copy your SSO login page info
1. Copy the login page URL generated by Wix to share with your users.

#### Step 7 | Copy the SSO ID (SSO for clients only)
1. If you set up SSO for clients, copy the SSO ID generated by Wix.

#### (Optional) Step 8 | Customize the Advanced settings
1. Enter the user ID, email, first name, last name, and profile image URL in the respective fields.
2. Enable the **JIT-Provisioning** toggle if needed.
3. Click **Save Changes**.

question: How can I display product categories as menu items on my Wix site using ADI?

Make sure to [create a product category](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-and-displaying-product-categories) in Wix Stores.

### Step 1 | Create a new page
First, add a blank page and rename it to match your product category's name.

#### To add a new blank page:
1. Click **Add** on the top bar inside ADI.
2. Click **Page**.
3. Click **Blank** from the list on the left-hand side.
4. [Rename](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-renaming-a-page) the new page.

### Step 2 | Add a product gallery or slider to the page

   * **Full Width:** Click the toggle to enable or disable this option:

### Step 3 | Display your category
Lastly, choose the category you want to display on each page.

#### To display a category:
1. Go to your sub-page in ADI.
2. Click the product gallery / slider section.
3. In the Settings panel, select the category you want to display.

question: What are some best practices to improve my email sender reputation?
answer:
To improve your email sender reputation, follow these best practices:

1. **Send high quality content:** Ensure that you are sending the most informative and relevant content to people who want to see it. Tailor your campaigns to the interests of your subscribers, including images and links that speak to what they want to know more about.

2. **Keep a consistent email schedule:** Decide on an email frequency as part of your email marketing strategy and stick to it. Start with a 'less is more' approach and figure out an optimum email cadence that gets you consistent results. Experiment with different types and timing, but once you've found what works, maintain a consistent schedule to avoid frustrating subscribers.

3. **Clean and maintain your subscriber list:** Regularly maintain your list and check for any unknown or outdated email addresses to remove. This helps avoid hard or soft bounces and falling into spam traps, which can lower your email sender reputation.

4. **Make sure your campaign looks legitimate:** Follow best practices for email structure. Your subject line should be straightforward and not spammy, your company name and address should be clearly visible, and all your content and images should be relevant.

question: How can I troubleshoot issues with adding items to a collection in my CMS?
answer:
To troubleshoot issues with adding items to a collection, follow these steps:

### Not enough permissions to add an item
- If you receive an error message stating "You don't have permission to add items to a collection. Contact the owner for access," it means you have limited access. You can read or update existing content but not add new items.
- **To resolve:** Contact the owner of the site and ask them to [assign you a role with more permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-custom-roles-and-permissions).

### Wix App Collections and external collections
- For Wix App Collections (e.g., Blog, Stores, Events), which are read-only by default, and external collections that may have mixed permissions, you might see an error message: "You can't add items to this type of collection."
- **To resolve:** Open the relevant section from within the dashboard (e.g., Blog, Stores) and add the item. For external collections, ask the site owner to adjust the settings.

### The server returns a collection item ID error
- This error can occur for various reasons, displaying an error message over the collection content area. The collection header and options, including the **+ Add Item** button, are still visible.
- **To resolve:** Refresh the collection and try to add an item again. If the issue persists, [contact Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/support/conversations/category/contact).

### A collection is not available (deleted, doesn't exist or the server can't find it)
- If a collection is deleted or unavailable, an error message will display to let you know.
- **To resolve:** If a collection was deleted accidentally, [use backups to restore it](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-backing-up-your-collections).

question: What are the different statuses a transaction can have in the Wix Payments table, and what do they mean?
answer:
In the Wix Payments table, a transaction can have the following statuses:

- **Pending:** The transaction was approved, but the funds are not yet available for payout.
- **Successful:** The transaction was approved and the funds are available for payout.
- **Pending Refund:** The debit transaction (e.g. refund / chargeback) was approved, but the funds have not been debited from your account.
- **Refunded:** The debit transaction (e.g. refund / chargeback) was approved and funds were debited from your account.
- **Paid Out:** The transaction was included in a previous payout to your bank account.
- **Payout Reversed:** The transaction is part of a payout that was returned by your bank. The funds are available in your Wix Payments account.
- **Failed:** The transaction has failed.
- **Authorized:** The payment is approved by the customer’s payment method and the payment sum is held in their account, in readiness to be captured (paid) later.
- **Void:** The authorized payment is cancelled and the hold on the payment is released from your customer's account.
- **Suspicious:** There is a high probability that the order has been made without the cardholder’s knowledge or permission. Consider refunding the payment and holding off on fulfilling the order.
- **Action needed:** You received a chargeback and can choose whether to accept it or dispute it. You're still within the timeframe to submit the dispute.
- **Expires in "X" days:** You received a chargeback and can choose whether to accept it or dispute it. You have the indicated number of days to submit the dispute.
- **Expired:** The time frame for filing a dispute has passed. The chargeback's status is now final and cannot be changed.
- **Final:** You received a chargeback but cannot dispute it. This status cannot be changed.
- **Accepted:** You received a chargeback and accepted the claim. The funds remain with your customer.
- **Disputed:** You received a chargeback and filed a dispute against it. It is now in review by the relevant credit card issuer.
- **Lost:** The bank and the credit card issuer have reviewed your dispute and found your evidence insufficient to prove the charge is legitimate. The funds will remain with the customer, and you will not be able to dispute the decision through Wix Payments.
- **Won:** The bank and the credit card issuer have reviewed your dispute and decided to recognize the payment as a legitimate charge. The funds will return to your Wix Payments account along with the chargeback fee.

question: How can I ensure my website design is responsive across different devices using the Wix Studio Editor?
answer:
To ensure your website design is responsive across different devices using the Wix Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. **Design on Desktop**: Start by designing an element the way you want it to look on a desktop.
2. **Choose Responsive Behavior**: Select a responsive behavior that meets your needs. This ensures the element automatically adjusts to different breakpoints.
3. **Use Advanced Measurements**: For more precise control, use advanced, responsive measurements to [resize](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-setting-the-size-of-your-elements#using-advanced-size-measurements) and [position](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-positioning-elements) elements on every breakpoint.
4. **Responsive Layout Tool**: Use a responsive layout tool to group related elements, based on either CSS grid or flexbox. For example, [grids](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-about-cells-and-grids) keep elements in their respective cells, while [stacking elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-about-stack) maintains their vertical or horizontal order.
5. **AI-Powered Layout**: Utilize the AI tool to generate a responsive layout with the click of a button. The AI analyzes the current layout and places a responsive structure that looks ideal, saving you time on checking every breakpoint and resolving design issues.

question: How can I track Google Ads conversions on my Wix site using custom code?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* You need to [connect Google Tag Manager to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-your-google-tag-manager-account-to-your-wix-site) before you can set up conversion tracking.

### Step 1 | Create a conversion action
First, you need to create a conversion action in your Google Ads account. This gives you the Conversion ID and Label ID that you need to use in your custom code snippet to track the action.

#### To create a conversion action:
1. Sign in to [your Google Ads account](https://ads.google.com/).
2. (If you're using [Smart Mode](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/9520605?hl=en)) Click the **Tools & Settings** icon and select **Switch to Expert Mode**.
3. Click **Tools & Settings** at the top.
4. Select **Conversions** under **Measurement** in the drop-down menu.
5. Click **New conversion action**.
6. Select **Website**.
7. Enter your website domain.
8. Click **Scan**.
9. Scroll down to **Create conversion actions manually using code**.
10. Click **Add a conversion manually**.
11. Select the type of conversion action to track from the **Goal and action optimization** drop-down menu.
12. Enter a name for the conversion action in the **Conversion name** field.
13. Select **Use different values for each conversion** in the **Value** section.
14. Click **Done**.
15. Click **Save and continue**.
16. Select the **Use Google Tag Manager** tab.
17. Make a note of the Conversion ID and Conversion Label ID.

### Step 2 | Set up tracking using custom code
After you've created your conversion action, you can start tracking it by embedding a snippet of custom code on your site.

#### To set up custom code:
1. Copy the following code snippet into a text editor.
   ```html
   <script>
   function registerListener() {
    window.wixDevelopersAnalytics.register('conversionListener', (e, p) => {
    if (e === 'Purchase') {
    gtag('event', 'conversion', {
    'send_to': 'AW-CONVERSION_ID/LABEL_ID',
    'value': p.revenue,
    'currency': p.currency,
    'transaction_id': p.orderId
    });
    }
    });
   }
   window.wixDevelopersAnalytics ? registerListener() : window.addEventListener('wixDevelopersAnalyticsReady', registerListener);
   </script>
   ```
2. Find the **send_to** line in the code.
3. Replace the placeholder values with your values:
   * **AW-CONVERSION_ID:** Your Conversion ID from Google Ads
   * **LABEL_ID:** Your Label ID from Google Ads
4. Copy the entire code snippet.
5. [Go to Custom Code](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website/embeds/?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Custom+Code) in your site's dashboard.
6. Click **+ Add Custom Code** at the top right.
7. Paste the code snippet in the text box.
8. Enter a name for your code.
9. Select an option under **Add Code to Pages**:
   * **All pages:** This adds the code to all of your site's pages, including any new pages that you create in the future. Choose whether to load the code only once per visit, or on each page your visitor opens.
   * **Choose specific pages:** Use the drop-down menu to select the relevant pages.
10. Choose where to place your code under **Place Code in:**.
    * Head
    * Body - start
    * Body - end
11. Click **Apply**.
12. [Go to Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Integrations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/marketing-integration) in your site's dashboard.
13. Click **Connect** under **Google Ads**.
14. Click **Add Google Ads Tag**.
15. Add your conversion ID.
16. Click **Save**.

question: How can I customize the Expand Mode in my Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
To customize the Expand Mode in your Wix Pro Gallery, follow these steps:

1. Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Settings** tab on the left.
4. Select **Open in Expand Mode** from the **When clicking on an item** drop-down.
5. Click the **Design** tab.
6. Click **Expand Mode**.
7. Click **Customize Expand Mode**.
8. Customize the following settings on the right side of the pop-up:
   
   ### Info Settings
   - **What info is shown?**: Select the checkboxes next to the info you want to display: **Title**, **Description** and/or **Link**. 
     
     **Note:** Currently, it's not possible to customize the style of the link in Expand Mode. If this is a feature you'd like to see in the future, you can [vote for it here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-request-changing-the-style-of-the-link-in-expand-mode).
   - **Where does it appear?:** Choose where the info should appear: **Side** or **Bottom**. 
     
     **Note:** Displaying info to the side of a horizontal image, may cause the image to be displayed smaller.
   - **When does it show?:** Choose when the info displays: **Always** or **When clicking info icon**.
   
   ### Viewing Settings
   - **Allow Full Screen**: Enable the toggle to allow visitors to view full screen images from Expand Mode.
   - **Magnifying Glass:** Enable the toggle to allow your visitors to zoom in on your image. Then drag the **Magnifying Size** slider to adjust the strength of the magnification.
   
   ### Background Design
   - **Gradient:** Enable the toggle to give your Expand Mode a blended color background and adjust the following: 
     
     + **Color & Opacity 1 and 2:** Click the relevant color box to customize the gradient's colors. Then drag the slider to adjust the opacity of the colors.
     + **Gradient direction:** Drag the slider to adjust the angle of the gradient.
   - **Background color & opacity:** Click the color box to select a color for your background. Then drag the slider to adjust the colors' opacity.
   
   ### Background Filters
   - **Blur:** Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of the background. This filter is applied to the elements visible behind your expand mode, and is seen when your background is less than 100% in opacity.
   - **Grayscale:** Enable the toggle to apply a grayscale filter. This filter is applied to the elements visible behind your expand mode, and is seen when your background is less than 100% in opacity.
   
   ### Text & Icon Design
   - **Icon color**: Click the color box to select the icon color.
   - **Title style**: Click the drop-down to select a font style and click the color box to select a color for the title.
   - **Description style**: Click the drop-down to select a font style and click the color box to select a color for the description.
   - **Text alignment**: Choose how you want to align the text: **Left**, **Center**, or **Right**.
9. Click **Done**.

**Tip**: To close the Expand Mode, click the Exit icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/5c3e602a-8647-41f7-bb22-686374bf97ce/2022/06/29/7750c3c0-6b17-4b34-b64f-76af15ed51a3/8b0d6319-00d5-4aab-b6a1-7d9f178d0120.png) on the top right of the gallery.

answer: When signing up for services such as Skype, Facebook, and Google, the company might send a verification SMS to the phone number you've provided in order to confirm your registration. Instead of using a regular 10 digit phone number, they send the SMS via a 'short code' or 5-6 digit number able to send and receive texts. Unfortunately, Business Phone Number cannot receive messages from these numbers. When signing up for a service like the examples above, we recommend using a phone number other than your business phone number as we cannot guarantee the verification message will go through.

question: Why are my payouts on hold in Wix Payments and how can I resolve the issue?
answer:
Payouts are placed on hold if there is an issue blocking your payout. The held amount includes the payout on hold, plus any other available funds that cannot be sent to your bank because of the issue. Payouts are placed on hold if:

* You have a [failed payout](https://support.wix.com/en/article/failed-payout-in-wix-payments).
* You have an unresolved [verification](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-verification-process) issue.

To resolve the issue, click on the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard to see the reason for the payout failure and for instructions on how to resolve it. Once the issue has been identified and resolved, the payout will be added to your next [scheduled payout](https://support.wix.com/en/article/scheduled-payouts-in-wix-payments).

### Note
If you have [grouped payment methods](https://support.wix.com/en/article/working-with-grouped-payment-methods-in-wix-payments) active in your Wix Payments account, your payouts on hold status applies to whichever group is experiencing an issue.

question: What should I do if I'm unable to sign in to my Wix account after resetting my password?
answer:
If you're unable to sign in to your Wix account after resetting your password, follow these troubleshooting steps:

### Clear your browser’s cache and try again
1. [Clear your browser’s cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache).
2. Close the browser and reopen it.
3. Go back to the password reset email and click the link.

**Note**: If you see a security warning pop-up, click **Load Anyway**.

### Check that cookies aren’t blocked in your browser
A cookie is a small file stored in your browser which helps a website recognize you. If you have chosen to block cookies in your browser, you will not be able to sign in to Wix. Go to your browser settings and make sure that you have [not chosen to block cookies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/enabling-cookies-in-your-browser).

If you still need help, fill out our [ownership verification form](https://users.wix.com/account-recovery?sessionId=ea3edf30-cd86-64b6-ab9c-a71d5480c904) and add a detailed explanation of your case, so we can properly verify the site or domain. Make sure to fill out the entire form, even if you're not completely sure of the answers. Don't forget to provide us with a valid contact email so we can respond to you.

question: How can I assign a domain to a site in my Wix account?

3. Assign your domain to your site:

   ### I want to assign a domain that is not currently assigned to a site
   1. Click **Assign** next to **Not Assigned to a Site** in the Unassigned Domains section.
   2. Select a site and click **Next**.

      **Note**: If the site is currently connected to a different domain, choose an option:
   3. Click **Assign**.

question: How can I reject a restaurant order using the Wix app?
answer:
To reject a restaurant order in the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Orders** under **Business**.
4. Tap on the order you want to reject in the **New** tab. You can also do this for an order you've already accepted.
5. Tap the Show More ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/71d20af0-560e-44a5-bb38-bf3f513b58fa/2021/04/09/cbffd9a8-4028-4a35-89df-c889ab8db89b/a8999a38-2634-402e-9af0-67bd086151b5.png) icon at the top right.
6. Tap **Reject Order**.
7. Enter a reason for why you are rejecting the order. 

   **Note:** The reason for the rejection is shown on the customer's order page.
8. Tap **Reject** at the top right.
9. [Contact](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-contacting-restaurant-customers-from-the-wix-owner-app) the customer to let them know that their order has been rejected.

**Important:**
- After you reject an order, you must contact the customer to let them know that their order has been unsuccessful. To learn how to contact a customer from the Wix app, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-contacting-restaurant-customers-from-the-wix-owner-app).
- Rejecting an order does not automatically void or refund the transaction. You must void the transaction in the dashboard of your chosen payment gateway. To locate the transaction ID, tap the order in the **Orders** tab. The ID is under the payment information.

To add a 'buy now, pay later' (BNPL) option to your Wix site using third-party payment providers, follow these steps:

1. **Choose a Third-Party BNPL Provider**: Wix offers a range of third-party BNPL payment options. You can select from providers such as Affirm, Afterpay, Atome, Cal, Cashfree Payments, Clearpay, Klarna, Laybuy, Max, Meshulam, MONEI, PayPal, Paidy (through Komoju), Payflex, PayItMonthly, PayU India, Sezzle, Sipay, and Splitit.

2. **Connect the Provider**: Click on the provider's name to see instructions on how to connect them to your Wix site. For example, you can connect Affirm by following the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-affirm-as-a-payment-provider).

3. **Upgrade Your Plan**: Ensure you have upgraded to a [Premium plan that allows you to accept payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) on your Wix site.

4. **Add PayPal 'Pay Later' Button**: As a tip, you can also [add a PayPal 'Pay Later'](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-understanding-customer-checkout-with-paypal) button to your Wix Store checkout.

Once connected, shoppers will automatically see the BNPL payment option available on your product pages and checkout, allowing them to purchase today and make affordable payments over time.

question: How can I assign a badge to a site member from the dashboard on my Wix site?
answer:
To assign a badge to a member from the dashboard, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Site Members](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Members%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/member-permissions/members).
2. Click **More Actions** at the top right and click **Manage Badges**.

4. Click **Edit**.

7. Select the members you want to assign the badge to, then click **Add**.

question: How can I restrict access to my Wix store pages using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To restrict access to your store pages using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Choose the page you want to restrict:

     1. Click **Store Pages**.
     2. Click **Category Page** or **Shop**.
   - **A site page with a Product Gallery:**
     1. Click **Site Menu**.

5. (For Gallery Pages only) Click **Settings**.
6. Click the **Permissions** tab.

question: How can I manually mark an order as 'Paid' in the Wix Restaurants Orders tab?
answer:
To manually mark an order as 'Paid' in the Wix Restaurants Orders tab, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant order.
3. Click **Collect Payment** at the top right.
4. Click **Mark as Paid**.
5. Select an option:
   
   * **Mark the entire amount as paid:** Click **Mark [$10.00] as Paid**.

question: How can I generate a new API key in the Wix enterprise dashboard?
answer:
To generate an API key in the Wix enterprise dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to API Keys](https://manage.wix.com/enterprise-dashboard/api-keys) in your Enterprise dashboard.
2. Click **+ Generate API Key** at the top right.
3. Enter a name for your new API key under **Key details**.
4. Select the permissions that you want to assign to the API key. 
   * The basic permission to return the IDs of all the sites on your account is selected by default. It cannot be deselected.
   * For security, only add the permissions that you need. [Learn more about API security](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-enterprise-using-wix-api-keys#choosing-wix-api-key-permissions)
5. Click **Generate Key**.
6. Click **Send Code** to send a 6-digit verification code to the email address linked to your account.
7. Get your verification code from the email.
8. Enter the code in the **Verify your account** pop-up.
9. Click **Verify & Generate Key**.
10. Click **Copy Token & Close**.
11. Store the token in a safe location.

### Tip
If you need another API key with the same permissions, you can [rotate the API key](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-enterprise-using-wix-api-keys#rotating-a-wix-api-key) or [duplicate the API key](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-enterprise-using-wix-api-keys#duplicating-a-wix-api-key).

question: How can I set up an Upload Button to allow visitors to upload multiple documents on my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed adding an Upload Button and a collection as described in Step 1.

To set up the Upload Button:

1. Click the Upload Button in your Editor, then click **Settings**.
2. Click the **Supported file type** drop-down and select **Document**.
3. Drag the **Max number of files** slider to set the maximum number of files.
4. Select the **Required** checkbox to make this a required field when a visitor is uploading files.
5. (Recommended) Enter the title that appears at the top of the Upload Button under **Field title**.
6. Enter the text that appears on your Upload Button in the **Button text** field.
7. Select an option under **Text below button**:
   * **Show file info only:** Display the visitor's selected file name after the file is selected.
   * **Show custom text:** Enter text in the **Custom text** field that you want to show below the button. Once the visitor uploads their file, the file name displays below the button instead. **Tip:** Add helpful info such as the correct file size (e.g. "Max file size is 25MB").

**Tip:** Click **View Uploaded Files** to go to your media manager where you can view the files visitors upload to your site.

question: How do I connect my Expedia account to Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
answer:

- Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability for the channel manager to fully register your rooms.
- Ensure your account on Expedia is active, and the room types are created and updated for at least three months.

### To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Expedia:
1. Log in to the Expedia extranet with your username and password.
2. Click **Room and Rates** in the menu on the left.
3. Click **Expedia Connectivity Settings**.

5. Copy and paste your **Hotel ID** at the top.
6. Click **Save and continue**.
7. [Go to the Channel Manager](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1a6e0874-2039-49cf-bef3-9138bb5c3b16%7C4%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Channel+Manager) in your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.

10. Click **Save and Continue**.

question: How can I disable the pop-up blocker for Wix.com in Safari?
answer:
To allow pop-up windows on Wix.com in Safari, follow these steps:

1. In your Safari browser, go to **www.wix.com**.
2. Click **Safari** from the top menu and select **Settings**.
3. Click the **Websites** tab.
4. Select **Pop-up Windows** under **General** on the left.
5. Click the **When visiting other websites** drop-down at the bottom right.

Make sure you are using a [supported Safari version](https://support.wix.com/en/article/supported-browsers#supported-browsers-for-desktop-devices). question: Is it possible to impersonate a member to preview what my site looks like to them?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to impersonate a member to preview what your site looks like to them. It is only possible to view your site according to your own role. However, you can create new members and add them to the role you want to test so that you can see your site as they see it.

### To create a member role for testing:
1. Go to your live site.
2. Sign up as a new member.
3. [Add the new member to the role](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-managing-your-member-roles) that you want to test.
4. Visit your live site as that member to see what the site looks like for them.

question: How can I set up catering services using Wix Restaurants?
answer:
To offer catering services using Wix Restaurants, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Order Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/restaurants/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Pickup** tab.
   - Set the pickup time for 0 minutes.
   - Click **Save** at the top right.
3. Click the **Delivery tab**.
   - Click into each delivery area to edit them.
   - Set the **Maximum Delivery Time** to 0 minutes.
   - Click **Save** at the top right.
4. Click the **Order scheduling** tab.
   - Click the **Scheduled orders** toggle to enable it and set how far in advance customers can place orders:
     - **Minimum time:** Enter a number and select **Minutes, Hours or Days** from the drop-down list. 
       
       **Note:** This is the minimum time customers can place a future order in advance.
     - **Maximum time:** Enter a maximum number and select **Minutes, Hours or Days** from the drop-down list. 
       
       **Note:** This is the maximum time customers can place a future order in advance.
   - Disable the **ASAP** toggle.
   - Click **Save** at the top right.

question: How can I set up payment methods for selling my music on Wix Music?
answer:
To set up your payments for selling music on Wix Music, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Set up the payment methods you want to use.

question: Is it possible to display a weekly layout in the Google Event Calendar app?

question: Can I create a draft automation in Wix Automations to activate later?

question: Can I upload XML files in the Wix Editor?

question: Can I add a watermark to my images in the Wix Portfolio?
answer: Currently, you cannot add a watermark to your uploaded images in the Wix Portfolio in order to protect the copyright. As a workaround, you can create and add a watermark [using text in the Wix Photo Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-using-the-wix-photo-studio-tools#text). Be aware that when doing this, it is not possible to add text to multiple images at once. The text needs to be added to each image separately.

question: What should I do if I'm experiencing issues with my Wix Forum on my live site?
answer:
If you're experiencing issues with the Wix Forum, follow this troubleshooting checklist:

1. **Check for Cookies or Cache Issues**: Some issues may be caused by cookies or cache. You can check if the issue is related to cookies or cache by opening your browser in [incognito / private mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/opening-your-browser-in-incognitoprivate-browsing-mode) and see if the problem persists.

2. **Disconnect and Reconnect to the Internet**: Try disconnecting and reconnecting to your internet.

3. **Use a Different Browser**: Open your site in a different browser to see if the issue continues.

If you're still having trouble, go through the [Technical Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-technical-assistant), which includes steps for clearing your browser's [cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache) and [cookies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-wix-cookies-from-your-browser). This will help determine if the issue is local to your computer or related to your internet connection.

If the problem persists after completing these steps, contact Wix support for further assistance. Be sure to include a [screenshot](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-screenshot-to-a-ticket) or [video](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-video-to-a-ticket) showing the issue, along with the troubleshooting steps you've already taken.

question: Why are my customers unable to checkout from my Wix store?
answer:
If customers are unable to checkout from your store, follow these steps:

1. **Make sure you've set up a payment method:**
   - Go to [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
   - Connect to a suitable payment provider such as Wix Payments, Credit Card, PayPal, or Manual payments. 
   - [Learn more about Wix Payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wix-payments), [accepting card payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-by-credit-card), [connecting PayPal](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-paypal-as-a-payment-provider), and [manual payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-manual-offline-payments).

2. **Check if you've upgraded your site to a suitable plan:**
   - Upgrade to a plan that allows you to accept payments. 
   - [Learn more about upgrading an existing premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-an-existing-premium-plan).

3. **Create shipping rules:**
   - Ensure you have a [shipping/delivery/pickup rule](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-a-guide-to-setting-up-shipping-delivery-and-pickup) for the countries you sell to.
   - You can create shipping rules for individual countries plus an international rule to cover the rest of the world.

4. **Make sure that coupons or discounts don't reduce a product's price below zero:**
   - Review which products each coupon or discount applies to.
   - Consider creating [percent discount coupons](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-a-percentage-discount-coupon) instead of [price discount coupons](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-a-price-discount-coupon) to avoid negative pricing issues.

question: Is it possible to connect breadcrumbs to dynamic pages in the CMS?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to connect breadcrumbs to [dynamic pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages). This would allow you to add navigational links in the breadcrumbs element that visitors click to go to dynamic pages created with the CMS (Content Management System).

### Workarounds
* You can [create links to dynamic pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-linking-to-dynamic-pages) from various other site elements such as the menu, text, or buttons.
* In the Wix Editor, you can [connect pagination bars](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar) on dynamic list pages that allow visitors to navigate through 'pages' of items.

question: How can I customize the layout of my All Posts feed in Wix Blog?
answer:
To customize the layout of your All Posts feed in Wix Blog, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to your Blog page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2021/11/02/0b84b086-cf99-4826-93e0-9ffff492898a/c4974969-a151-4474-b053-c2dcfe3e00e6.png) on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Blog Pages**.
   3. Click your Blog page.

5. Click the **All Posts Feed** tab.

question: Is it possible to add a single item collection to my app in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently in Blocks, it is not possible to add a [single item collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-differences-between-single-item-and-multiple-item-collections) to your app. Single Item collections are used when there is information that you want to pass together with your app, but it does not have a repeatable nature.

question: How can I improve the chances of Google using the thumbnail image I want for my site in search results?
answer:
To improve the chances of Google using the thumbnail image you want for your site in search results, follow these steps:

* Use high-quality images on your site. Small or low-resolution images may not be used in search results.
* Add alt text to your images. Search engine bots can't read images and use alt text to get a description of the image. [Learn more about adding alt text.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-images-and-galleries-for-seo-alt-text)

It's important to note that it's not possible to manually change the thumbnail image that Google uses, and it's not guaranteed that Google will add a thumbnail image to your site's search result.

question: How can I find header codes that I added previously in my Wix account?
answer:

2. Select **Go to Site Verification** under **Tools and settings**.
3. Scroll down and click **Your Existing Header Codes**.

question: Can I add, reposition, or resize elements only in a specific language on my Wix multilingual site?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to add, reposition or resize elements only in a specific language. When you customize or add an element, it appears the same across all languages of your multilingual site. For example, if you add an image to the English version of your site, it appears in the Spanish version as well. You can display a different image in the Spanish version, but you cannot display an image in English and not display an image at all in Spanish.

In the meantime, you can use Velo by Wix to [change the direction of your menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-tutorial-changing-the-direction-of-menu-tabs-based-on-the-current-language), or [add a multi-state box](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-using-multi-state-boxes-to-switch-from-ltr-to-rtl) that displays different content based on the selected language.

question: How can I approve a new site member from the member list in my site's dashboard?
answer:

question: How can I create main forum guidelines in Wix Forum?

question: How can I manage the properties of elements on my site using Editor X?
answer:
To manage the properties of elements on your site using Editor X, you can use the Inspector panel. Click the Inspector icon at the top right. Depending on the chosen element, you can click through the tabs to customize it further: Layout, Design, Interactions, and Content Suggestions. The Inspector panel lets you see, design, and edit the properties of each element on your site. You can choose how elements are aligned and resized on different breakpoints, change their docking position, add scroll effects, and more.

**Tip:** Some tabs, like Design and Content Suggestions, are not available for all elements in Editor X.

question: How can I add a new category in the Wix FAQ app using my site's Editor?

question: How can I enable tipping on Wix Mobile POS for my business?
answer:

2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/11/10/bdebceaa-3cca-42c8-b60d-6c55923bf8fa/bb911823-182e-4453-b87e-0dbbe1ab5d50.png) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down to the **Get Paid** section and tap **Point of Sale**.
4. Tap the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2023/05/07/59cbf674-b2ff-4d06-a8a5-81609a1f1090/14b48db3-1ad7-4317-b878-e06b01647b0b.jpg) at the top right.

question: How can I set up how clients earn points in my loyalty program?

answer:

question: How can I show overflow content on my site page using Editor X?
answer:
To show overflow content on your site page using Editor X, follow these steps:

1. **Select your page:**
   - Go to the relevant page.
   - Click **Layers** at the top of Editor X.
   - Click **Page**.

2. Click the **Inspector** icon at the top of Editor X.

question: How can I add a cart to my Wix site for booking multiple services?

question: How can I view and filter my photo album statistics on Wix?
answer:
To view your photo album statistics on Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fphotography-albums/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Album Stats** tab.
3. Choose what you want to do:
   
   ### View your stats
   View the following photo album stats in the relevant section: 
   * **Overview:** View your overall site and album traffic.
     
     + **Site visits:** The number of visits to your site.
     + **Album Views:** The total number of album views.
   * **Album stats:** View the breakdown of your site traffic by album:
     
     + **Photos:** The number of photos in each album.
     + **Views:** The number of times each album has been viewed.
     + **Leads:** The number of leads this album generated for your site. A lead is when a visitor views your album and then clicks on your business name to get to your site.

### Filter your stats
Click the **Filter by** drop-down to filter the albums on display by: 
* **All albums**
* **Drafts**
* **Published**

### Sort your stats
Click the Sort icon to view your albums by: 
* **Newest**
* **Oldest**
* **Album name: A - Z**
* **Album name: Z - A**

### Search for albums
Click the Search icon to search for a specific album by any word in the title of the album.

question: How can I create a Members Only page in Wix Editor and restrict access to specific members?
answer:
To create a Members Only page in Wix Editor and restrict access to specific members, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Hover over the relevant page and click the **More Actions** icon.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Permissions** tab.
6. Select **Site Members**.
7. Select which members can access this page:
   
   * **All members:** Any signed in member can access this page.
   * **Specific members:** Limit this page to specific members only. You can choose one or both of the following options:
     
     + **Members with roles:** Members with a specific [role](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-creating-member-roles).
       1. Click **Manage Roles**. 
          
          **Note:** If you have not created member roles, click **Create Role**.
       2. Select the checkbox next to the relevant role(s) and click **Apply**.
     + **Members with plan subscriptions:** Members who've purchased a specific [pricing plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-an-overview).
       1. Click **Manage Plans**. 
          
          **Note:** If you have not created a pricing plan, click **Create Plan**.
       2. Select the checkbox next to the relevant plan(s) and click **Apply**.

By default, the **Site collaborators** toggle is always enabled. This ensures you and your collaborators are able to access all parts of your site.

question: How can I connect my existing .it domain to my Wix site?
answer:
To connect your existing .it domain to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. **Upgrade Your Site**: First, ensure that you have [upgraded your site with a plan](http://www.wix.com/upgrade/website).

2. **Access Your Domain Registrar**: You will need access to your current domain registrar to proceed with the connection.

3. **Connect via Name Servers**: We recommend [connecting your domain to Wix via name servers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers). With this method, Wix hosts your DNS records, allowing you to manage them in your Wix account. This is beneficial as Wix Customer Care can assist you with managing your DNS records if needed.

4. **Wait for Propagation**: Be aware that new DNS records can take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

Note: There is another method called [pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-wix-using-the-pointing-method), but it is not recommended as Wix may not be able to assist with some issues that could arise. Learn more about the differences between [connecting your domain via name servers vs. pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pointing-vs-name-servers-domain-connection-methods).

question: How can I connect Paystack as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Paystack as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.
