2. Add the email addresses to the field with **mailto:** at the beginning of each address (e.g. **mailto:support@email.com**). 
3. [Link a button or image to a dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-a-button-to-a-dataset) that connects to this URL field. When visitors click the link, their email client opens with the relevant address in the 'To:' field.

question: How do I add and set up a dataset in the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure to [add the CMS to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) if you haven't already.

### Step 1 | Add a dataset: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26) and navigate to the relevant page.
2. Click **CMS** on the left.
3. Click **Add Content Elements**.
4. Click the dataset type you want to add:
   * **Dataset:** Add a blank dataset to connect page elements so they can display content from your collection.
   * **Form dataset:** Add a dataset configured to accept form submissions from site visitors.

### Step 2 | Connect the dataset to a collection: Wix Editor
1. Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select the collection you want to connect.
   
   **Tip:** Select **Create Collection** to [create a new collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection).
2. (Optional) Click the **Dataset name** field to edit the name of the dataset.
3. Click **Create**.

### Step 3 | Edit the dataset settings: Wix Editor
1. (Velo only) In the dataset settings, edit the **Dataset ID** used to identify the dataset in your page's code, if necessary.
2. Click the **Dataset mode** drop-down and select an option:
   * **Read:** Connected elements can read and display content from your collection. The elements cannot modify the collection content.
   * **Write:** Connected elements cannot display content from the collection. [Input elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-user-input-elements) can add content to the collection but cannot modify the collection's existing content.
   * **Read & Write:** Connected elements can display content from your collection. Input elements can add or edit content in your collection.
3. (Optional) Click the permission type next to **Permissions** to edit your collection's [permissions & privacy settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-your-collection-permissions).
4. Edit the **Maximum items displayed** field to determine how many items can initially load in connected [repeaters](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-dynamic-content-in-a-repeater#step-5-optional-create-a-load-more-button) and [galleries](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-collection-content-in-a-pro-gallery#step-4-optional-create-a-load-more-button).
5. (Velo only) Select the relevant checkboxes under **Performance**:
   * **Fetch after the page loads:** The dataset's data is fetched only after the rest of the page has finished loading.
   * **Fetch pages using cursors:** The dataset will load initial and subsequent data using sequential cursors.
6. (Optional) Add a filter to include or exclude items from the dataset:
   1. Click **+ Add Filter**.
   2. Click the **Field** drop-down and select the field you want to filter.
   3. Click the **Condition** drop-down and choose the condition to use in the filter.
   4. (If necessary) Select the **Value source:**
      * **Manual entry:** Enter the value you want to filter in the **Value** field.
      * **Another dataset:** Select another dataset and the field you want to filter from the relevant drop-downs.
   5. Click **Add Filter**.
7. (Optional) Add a sort that controls the order in which connected items display.
8. (Optional) Enable the **Show on all pages** toggle under **Advanced Settings** to use the dataset globally across all site pages.

### Step 4 | Connect page elements to the dataset: Wix Editor
1. In your editor, select the element you want to connect to the dataset.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
3. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select the dataset you want to connect.
4. Click the relevant drop-down menus under **Connections** and choose the collection fields or dataset actions you want to connect to each part of the element.
5. Click **Preview** to test your CMS connections.
6. Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How can I switch to a new template for my Wix site and transfer my existing content?
answer:
While it's not possible to switch to a different template for a site you already created, you can create as many sites as you want in your account. This means you can start over with a new template at any point. Once you have chosen your new template, you can import elements, pages, and media from your old site, and transfer your plan and domain to it.

### Step-by-Step Instructions:

**Step 1: Choose your new template**

- Get started by selecting a new template from our huge range of professionally designed templates. There are a variety of options and categories available including portfolio sites, business services, eCommerce templates, and more, so you can choose the best style for your brand needs.
  - [View our Editor templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates)
  - [View our Studio Editor templates](https://www.wix.com/studio/templates)

**Step 2: Copy elements and pages from your old site**

- In the Editor, you can copy specific elements from your old site, and paste them onto your new site. You can also copy and paste entire pages. Learn how to [copy and paste elements and pages to a new site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-getting-a-new-template-for-your-site).
- In Editor X and Studio Editor, you can save and [re-use design assets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-saving-and-reusing-design-assets) in a library that you can use on any of your sites.

**Step 3: Import media from your old site**

- All the media from your existing site is saved under Site Files in your Media Manager. If you want to add any file from your existing site to your new site, just [import it from the Site Files folder.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-importing-media-from-one-wix-site-to-another)

**Step 4: Transfer additional features**

- You can transfer features like Business email, Ascend Plan and features, and Wix Blog. However, some features like Site Theme, Design and Layout, and Premium Apps cannot be transferred.

**Step 5: Transfer your plan and domain**

- Once your new site is ready, you can transfer your plan and the domain from your old site to your new one. Learn how to transfer your [plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/assigning-a-premium-plan-to-a-different-site-in-your-wix-account) and [domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/assigning-a-domain-to-a-site-in-your-wix-account) to your new site.

question: Why might there be discrepancies between Wix Analytics and Google Analytics data?
answer:
Discrepancies between Wix Analytics and Google Analytics data can occur due to several reasons:

1. **Differences in Traffic Data**: Both Wix Analytics and Google Analytics filter out traffic from bots, but they use different algorithms, which can lead to different results.

2. **Differences in Sales and People Reports**: Wix Analytics has access to production data on your Wix site, such as your contact list and transaction database, and will not show cancelled orders but will show zero sum (free) orders. Google Analytics, on the other hand, relies on client events, which might be lost due to network issues or not collected if cookies are not enabled, and it will show cancelled orders but not zero sum (free) orders.

3. **Differences in Metric Names**: The metric names between the two platforms aren't always an exact match. For example, 'Users' in Google Analytics is equivalent to 'Visitors' in Wix Analytics.

4. **Differences in Time Frames**: When Google shows stats for the last 7 days, the end date is yesterday, whereas in Wix Analytics, the last 7 days time period includes today.

For more detailed information, you can refer to the [Google Analytics data discrepancies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/discrepancies-between-wix-analytics-data-in-other-tracking-tools#google-analytics-data-discrepancies) section.

question: How do I set up dropshipping with Printful in my Wix store?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed the initial setup of your Wix store.

### Step 1 | Add the Printful app: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

6. Select an option:
   * Create a new account
   * Connect an existing account
7. Click to connect your Wix Store to the email address associated with your Printful account.
8. (For new accounts) Follow the instructions in the email you received to confirm your email address.

### Step 2 | Connect your store and start creating products
Log in to [Printful](https://www.printful.com) and select the **Stores** tab in the Printful dashboard. If not already connected, click **Add** next to your Wix store. You're now ready to create your first product and set pricing. [Watch Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q8bgFKa29Y4&feature=youtu.be&t=117)

### Step 3 | Set up shipping
Printful ships [worldwide](https://www.printful.com/faq/shipping-packaging-fulfillment/163-is-printful-available-in-all-countries-). Make sure you set up shipping in your Wix dashboard, and take into consideration Printful shipping costs. You can charge for shipping separately or you might want to increase the product price so that it covers the shipping cost and then offer free shipping - the choice is yours. If you prefer to charge different shipping rates for your Printful products than for other products, set that up using the [Shipping Rate by Product](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-setting-up-shipping-rate-by-product) method.

### Step 4 | Add a billing method in Printful
After a customer pays for a purchase of a Printful product, (or when you mark an order as "Paid"), the next step is to pay Printful so they can fulfill the order. You can handle payments to Printful in a number of ways:

- **Automatically charging your billing method for each order**: Save one or more credit cards and/or PayPal as billing methods. Each order that comes in is automatically billed.
- **Manually depositing to your Printful wallet**: Deposit funds into the wallet, and Printful withdraws funds from the wallet for each order.
- **Automatic deposits to your Printful wallet**: Set up auto recharge to ensure your wallet doesn't run out of funds.

Learn more about the [Printful Wallet](https://help.printful.com/hc/en-us/articles/360014009500-What-does-the-Printful-Wallet-do).

question: Can I make some fields on the checkout page optional in Wix Stores?

question: How can I update my payment details in my Wix account to include my ABN for a tax exemption in Australia?

question: How can I revoke an Admin status for another user in Google Workspace to delete their account?
answer:
To revoke an Admin status for another user in Google Workspace, follow these steps:

1. Log into the Google Admin console using your Admin account.
2. Click **Users** on the Admin console home page.
3. Click the name of the Admin whose privileges you wish to revoke.
4. Click **Admin roles and privileges**.
5. Click **Roles**.
6. Disable the **Super Admin** toggle.
7. Click **Save**.

Once you have revoked the required Admin status, you can delete unwanted Workspace accounts for [monthly](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-reducing-your-monthly-business-email-users) or [yearly](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-reducing-your-yearly-business-email-users) subscriptions, as needed.

question: How do I document my Velo Package using the README.md file provided by Wix Blocks?
answer:
To document your Velo Package using the README.md file provided by Wix Blocks, follow these steps:

1. Click **README.md** in the code files panel README section.
2. Write your text in the markdown file provided.
3. Click **Preview** to see how the file is rendered.

Your readme should include the following sections:

- An introduction that explains what the package does and why it's useful.
- How to use the package.
- Package contents and functions provided.
- Packages, such as npm packages, included in your package, along with licensing information for those packages. For example, your users should be aware that when they install a package that uses an npm package, they agree to that npm package's license agreement.
- Instructions for using the package's functions.
- Usage examples.

question: How can I set up the Yelp app on my Wix site after adding it?
answer:
### To set up the Yelp app:

#### Step 1 | Open the Settings panel of the app
1. Select the app in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.

#### Step 2 | Connect your Yelp account
Click **Connect Account** and log in to your Yelp account or click **Create Account** to set up a new account.

#### Step 3 | Edit the app settings
1. Click the **Settings** tab.
2. Click the **Title Text** toggle: 
   * **Enabled**: A title appears in the Yelp app. Enter the title text.
   * **Disabled**: A title does not appear in the Yelp app.
3. Click the **Star Ratings** toggle: 
   * **Enabled**: Your review score appears in the Yelp app.
   * **Disabled**: Your review score does not appear in the Yelp app.
4. Click the **Reviews** toggle: 
   * **Enabled**: Your Yelp reviews appear in the app.
   * **Disabled**: Your Yelp reviews do not appear in the app.

#### Step 4 | Change the app layout
1. Click the **Layout** tab.
2. Choose the header layout.
3. Choose the layout of your star ratings.
4. Choose an option for reviewer profile images.

#### Step 5 | Customize the app design
1. Click the **Design** tab.
2. Click the color box to change the background color, and drag the slider to change the opacity.
3. Click the color box to change the border color and drag the slider to change the border width.
4. Click the color box to change the divider color and drag the slider to change the divider width.
5. Select a font style and color for each piece of text.

question: How can I add and customize a Google Map on my Editor X site?
answer:
To add a Google Map on your Editor X site, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add** on the top of Editor X.
2. Click **Contact & Forms**.
3. Click **Maps**.
4. Choose a map you like and drag it onto your page.

To customize the Map settings:

1. Click the Google Map in Editor X.
2. Click the Settings icon.
3. Customize your Map's settings:
   - **Zoom:** Choose the zoom of your map by dragging the slider.
   - **Show map and satellite views:** Enable or disable visitors' ability to switch between views.
   - **Show zoom control:** Enable or disable visitors' ability to change the zoom.
   - **Show Street View control:** Enable or disable Google Street View.
   - **Show Directions link:** Enable or disable the link to Google's directions service.
   - **Allow dragging:** Enable or disable visitors' ability to move around the map by clicking and dragging.

To choose a different Map and Pin design:

1. Click your Google Map.
2. Click the Inspector icon at the top right of Editor X.
3. Click the Design tab.
4. Choose an option for Map or Pin design.

To manage your locations (Pins):

1. Click your Google Map.
2. Click **Manage Locations**.
3. Choose the relevant option under **How many locations do you have?**:
   - **One:** Enter the location details (Address, Title, Description, Link, Link Text).
   - **Multiple:** Enter the first location's details, click **Add Location** to add more, and repeat for each location.

**Tip:** Hover over a location and click the More Actions icon to edit, duplicate, or delete it.

question: Can I upload my own fonts in Wix Photo Albums?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to upload your own fonts in Wix Photo Albums.

question: Can I view detailed analytics reports for my Branded App, such as the number of downloads from the App Store and Google Play Store?

question: How can I download an invoice for my Wix subscription?

question: How can I customize the Google Maps settings for my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the Google Maps settings for your mobile site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click the Google Map in the [mobile editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-getting-started-with-the-mobile-editor).
2. Click the **Settings** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/09/9d53d4d1-6fc7-4c52-b91f-e3e2b0f6c0ad.png).
3. Drag the slider under **Zoom** to adjust the zoom of the map.
4. Click the toggles to enable or disable the options:
   * **Show map and satellite views:** Your visitors can switch between map and satellite views of the map.
   * **Show zoom control:** Your visitors can zoom in and out on the map.
   * **Show Street View control:** Your visitors can use Google Street View.
   * **Show Directions link:** Your visitors can be directed to the location from where they currently are.
   * **Allow dragging:** Your visitors can move around the map by clicking and dragging.

question: How can I resolve the 'Submitted URL Marked 'noindex'' error in Google Search Console?
answer:
If you received the **Submitted URL Marked 'noindex'** error message in Google Search Console, follow these steps to resolve the issue:

### Step 1 | Check the URL
Make sure that you entered the URL of the page correctly when you submitted it for indexing. You should also ensure that it corresponds with an existing page on your site that doesn't return a [404](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-search-console-404-error) error message or [5xx](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-search-console-5xx-error) error message.

### Step 2 | Make sure search engines can index your page and site
Check your site's pages to ensure that search engines are not prevented from indexing them. In this case, the page would have a "noindex" tag in the code and Google will not include it in search results. Learn how to check if search engines can index your pages in:
* [Wix Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-preventing-search-engines-from-indexing-your-page)
* [Studio Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-managing-pages#hiding-a-page)

You should also check [your site's settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/preventing-search-engines-from-indexing-your-site) to make sure that search engines can index it.

### Step 3 | Check if the page is password protected
Make sure that your page is not password protected. In this case, the page would have a "noindex" tag in the code and Google will not include it in search results. Learn more about password protected pages in:
* [Wix Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-password-protecting-a-specific-page-of-your-site)
* [Studio Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-managing-pages#changing-the-page-settings)

### Step 4 | Check if the page is a members only page
Ensure that the page is not set to members only. Members only pages are excluded from search results by default. Learn more about members only pages in:
* [Wix Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-members-only-pages)
* [Studio Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-managing-pages#changing-the-page-settings)

### Step 5 | Use the URL Inspection Tool
If the page is indexed, not a members only page, or not password protected, you should inspect the URL using Google's URL Inspection Tool. The URL Inspection Tool allows you to submit individual pages to Google and simulate how Google crawls or renders a URL on your site. You can use it to diagnose errors that are preventing the page from being indexed. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-search-console-using-the-url-inspection-tool)

### Step 6 | Check the Last Crawled date
Check the date below **Last read** in the [Sitemaps report](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7451001) in Google Search Console. If the date is over a month ago, the error message is most likely not relevant anymore.

### Step 7 | Request Google to index the page
If you've checked all the above and the page is still not indexed, request Google to index by clicking **Request Indexing** in the URL inspection tool.

question: Is it possible to download invoices for Wix services in bulk?

question: How can I sign in to the Wix member apps using my Apple account?
answer:
To sign in to the Wix member apps using your Apple account, follow these steps:

1. Open the Wix member app you want to sign in to.
2. Tap **Log in**.
3. Tap **Continue** **with Apple**.
4. Tap **Continue** under **Sign in with Apple**.

question: How can I set up local delivery for my Wix store, and what are the steps involved?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Before setting up local delivery, ensure you have created the relevant shipping region. For example, to set up local delivery in New York City, first create a shipping region for the US. Learn how to [create a shipping region](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-a-guide-to-setting-up-shipping-delivery-and-pickup#step-1-set-up-your-regions).

### Step 1 | Name the delivery area & set a rate
1. [Go to Shipping & fulfillment](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Shipping&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant region (e.g. United States).
3. Click **+Add Local Delivery**.
4. Enter an area name (e.g. Delivery to Lower East Side).
5. Enter your delivery rate (e.g. $5).
6. (Optional) Offer free delivery to customers who make purchases over a set amount:
   - Select the **Offer free delivery when a customer buys over a certain amount** checkbox.
   - Enter the amount.

### Step 2 | Define your delivery area
You can define your delivery area using one of the following methods:

#### Define an area by radius
1. Select **Radius** under **Set area by**.
2. Enter an address.
3. Use the up/down arrows to increase or decrease the radius size.

#### Define an area by postal code
1. Select **Zip / postal codes** under **Set area by**.
2. Enter one or more complete postal codes and press **Enter** on your keyboard after each entry.
3. Enter a partial postal code with an asterisk to encompass a larger area and press **Enter** on your keyboard after each entry (e.g. Enter **100*** for all 43 Manhattan zip codes which all start with 100).

#### Draw a map to define an area
1. Select **Draw on a map** under **Set area by**.
2. (Optional) Enter a different address.
3. Click and drag the corners of the shape to customize the delivery area.

### Step 3 | Define delivery days & time frames
You can set up delivery days and time frames in two ways:

#### Set up a single delivery option
1. Select the **Estimated delivery time** option.
2. Enter an estimated delivery time (e.g. 2 - 3 Business Days).
3. Click **Add Area**.
4. (Optional) Add another delivery area (e.g. Brooklyn):
   - Click **+ Add another delivery area**.
   - Repeat the steps to set up the delivery area.
5. Click **Save**.

#### Set up scheduled delivery (Customer chooses the delivery date)
1. Select the **Delivery time slots** option.
2. Select checkboxes next to the days you deliver.
3. Select when your delivery hours start and end from the **From** and **Until** drop-downs.
4. (Optional) Click the Plus icon next to any time slot to add an additional slot to the same day (up to 8 time slots per day).
5. Choose the [delivery type and conditions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-when-customers-can-request-delivery):
   - **Same day delivery:** Enable the toggle to set a cut-off time and enter the latest time a customer can place an order for same day delivery.
   - **Next day delivery:** Enable the toggle to set a cut-off time and enter the latest time a customer can place an order for next day delivery.
   - **Minimum 2 days delivery:** Enter the minimum number of days it will take to deliver the order after your customer places it.
6. Click **Add Area**.
7. (Optional) Add another delivery area (e.g. Brooklyn):
   - Click **+ Add another delivery area**.
   - Repeat the steps to set up the delivery area.
8. Click **Save**.

### Step 4 | Setting up your Order tab
To get a clear picture of which orders you need to fulfill on specific days and at specific times, add the "Delivery Method" and "Delivery Time" columns to the Orders tab.

question: How does Wix handle pre-date charging for different services to ensure uninterrupted service?
answer:
Wix attempts to process your renewal payment before your plan's expiry date to ensure there is no interruption to your service. Depending on your service or subscription, you may be charged on a monthly, annual, or 2-3 year basis. Here's how Wix's pre-date charging works:

* **Premium or Studio plans:**
  
  + **Monthly plans:** Same date as the expiry date
  + **Yearly plans:** 14 days prior to your plan's expiry date (anniversary of your purchase)
* **Third-party apps:** Same date as the expiry date
* **Domains:** 30 days prior to the expiry date
* **Business Emails:** 30 days prior to the expiry date

If the charge is unsuccessful, Wix attempts the transaction again to ensure continuity of service.

question: How can I create an online event using Wix Events?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Before creating an online event, ensure you have planned your online event and decided where you'd like to host it.

### To create an online event:
1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Add Event**.
3. Select a type of event (this selection can't be changed after you click **Create Draft**):
   * **Ticketed Event:** Sell event tickets or offer them for free.
   * **RSVP Event:** Guests register for the event.
4. Enter the **General Info**.
5. Enter the **Date and time**. 
   **Tip:** For online events, we recommend displaying your time zone.
6. Select a location:
   * **Online only events:**
     1. Click **Online**.
     2. Enter an **Online Location Title** (e.g. Webinar).
   * [**Hybrid events**](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-a-hybrid-event) **(physical location and online):**
     1. Click **Physical Location**.
     2. Start typing the address of the location and select it from the list.
     3. (Optional) Enter a Venue Name (e.g. Freemont Hotel).
7. Click **Create Draft**.
8. When you've finished adding other customizations (e.g. creating tickets, customizing the registration form), publish your event.

question: How can I create and add tags to my Wix blog posts?
answer:
To create and add tags to your Wix blog posts, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Tags](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog/tags?&title=Go%20to%20Tags%20&buttonText=Manage+Tags) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Tag**.
3. Enter your **Tag Name** and **Slug** in the fields provided. 

   **Note:** The slug field automatically populates based on what you add in the tag name field.
4. (Optional) Click **Edit SEO Settings** and customize the tag's SEO information.
5. Click **Save**.
6. [Go to Posts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Posts&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/blog/posts) in your site's dashboard.
7. Hover over a post and click **Edit**.
8. Click **Settings** in the sidebar on the left.
9. Click **Tags**.
10. Add the tag you created.
11. When you're ready, click **Publish**.

question: Is it possible to integrate Airtable with the Wix CMS?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to integrate [Airtable](https://www.airtable.com/) with the Wix CMS (Content Management System). However, there are workarounds available:

- With Wix Automations, you can [use Zapier to automate connections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-connecting-your-automations-with-a-third-party-app-using-zapier) with Airtable and other third-party apps. You can also [view Airtable workflow templates in Zapier](https://zapier.com/apps/wix/integrations/airtable).
- You can use the [Sync: Connect to data sources app](https://www.wix.com/app-market/sync-connect-to-data-sources) to connect site elements with data from Airtable.

question: How can I import a Lottie animation into the Studio Editor and ensure it plays in a continuous loop?
answer:
To import a Lottie animation into the Studio Editor and set it to play in a continuous loop, follow these steps:

1. **Importing the Animation:**
   - Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
   - Click **Embed & Social**.
   - Click **Lottie Animations**.
   - Click the Add to Site icon next to **Lottie Animation**.
   - In a separate browser tab, copy the saved animation's URL from [your LottieFiles account](https://lottiefiles.com/getting-started).
   - Paste the animation's URL in the Editor:
     1. Click the Lottie Animation element in the Editor.
     2. Click the Settings icon.
     3. Paste the URL under **What's the animation's URL?**.
     4. Press **Enter** on your keyboard.

2. **Setting the Animation to Play in a Loop:**
   - Select the Lottie Animation element.
   - Click the Settings icon.
   - Click the toggle next to **Plays in a loop** to turn it on.

By following these steps, you can successfully import a Lottie animation and set it to play continuously on your client's site.

question: Can I transfer sites between different workspaces in Wix Studio?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to transfer sites between different workspaces in Wix Studio.

### Workaround
You can transfer the site to another account and then back to your original account, choosing the desired workspace in the process.

question: Is it possible to automatically restrict file names to one file only in the Wix Media Manager?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to automatically restrict file names to one file only. This means you can have multiple files in the Media Manager with the same title.

question: Is it possible to use the form submission time in Wix Forms automations?
answer: Yes, it is now possible to use the form submission time in Wix Forms automations. When setting a Wix Forms trigger, you can select "Form submission time" from the "Data from trigger" drop-down and match it to a field in a Google sheet. Learn more about [creating an automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation).

question: Can I integrate Wix Restaurants with the Toast POS system?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to integrate Wix Restaurants with the Toast POS (Point of Sale) system. In the meantime, you can integrate Wix Restaurants with a POS [using a webhook](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-using-a-webhook-to-integrate-wix-restaurants-with-third-party-services).

question: How can I add multiple locations to my Wix SEO Setup Checklist after I've already created it?
answer:
To add multiple locations after creating your SEO Checklist, follow these steps:

1. Go to [SEO Setup Checklist](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home/seo-setup?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=SEO+Setup+Checklist) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I require visitors to sign up before watching a free video on my Wix site?
answer:
To require viewers to sign up before watching a video on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Edit** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2017/01/01/271a5128-6b27-4bf4-bb9a-7d66252b23fd.png) next to the video you want to change.

question: How can I resolve general text issues in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To resolve general text issues in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. If you are copying and pasting the text from an external source, try [pasting without formatting](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-copying-text-from-an-external-source-eg-word-document).
2. Reset to the text theme by following the below steps:
   
   1. Click the text.
   2. Click **Edit Text**.
   3. Click **Reset to Theme** at the bottom of the panel.
3. Try [making the text box a bit larger](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-fixing-spacing-and-alignment-issues-on-your-site#elements-and-text-misaligned-on-the-live-site) to allow for space for the text to enlarge on different screen sizes and browsers.
4. Follow our [general interactive troubleshooter](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-technical-assistant).

question: How can I connect KG Inicis as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect KG Inicis as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to KG Inicis.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new KG Inicis account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Merchant ID, Type, and API Key.

      **Tip**: [Contact KG Inicis](https://www.inicis.com/blog/archives/category/cs/cs_best) to get your Type information.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create KG Inicis account**](https://www.inicis.com/service-application).
   2. Fill in the registration form.
   3. Wait for a message from KG Inicis to get your credentials.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Make sure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your KG Inicis account to avoid transaction declines. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: Can I hide the duration of an appointment on the Calendar page in Wix Bookings?

question: Can I connect a business email to a subdomain in Wix?

question: Can I reset the invoice numbering in Wix Invoices?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to reset the invoice numbering in Wix Invoices. For example, if your initial invoice number is 0001, and you send 2 test invoices, the first invoice that a real customer receives is invoice number 0003.

### Tip

question: What happens if I issue a chargeback for a Wix Premium plan payment, and how can I restore the features?
answer:
If you perform a chargeback for a payment made for your Premium plan, your plan is canceled. When a Premium plan is canceled:

* Your domain is disconnected from your site
* Your site displays Wix ads
* Your site's storage and bandwidth is limited
* Any other Premium features that come with your plan (e.g. Wix Stores) are removed

### Want to restore these features?
You must [purchase a new Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) with a **different** payment card.

question: How can I connect my GoDaddy domain to Wix via pointing?
answer:
To connect your GoDaddy domain to Wix via pointing, follow these steps:

1. **Sign in to your GoDaddy account.**
2. Click the user profile icon at the top right and select **My Products**.
3. Click **DNS** to the right of your domain.
4. Update the **A** record that has **@** in the Name column.
   - Click the **Edit** icon to the right of the **A** record that has **@** in the Name column.
   - Enter **185.230.63.107** in the **Points to** field.
   - Click **Save**.

   **Note:** If you don't have an **A** record with **@** in the Name column, add one:
   - Click **ADD** at the bottom right.
   - Click the **Type** drop-down and select **A**.
   - Enter **@** in the **Host** field.
   - Enter **185.230.63.107** in the **Points to** field.
   - Click **Save**.

5. Update the **CNAME** record that has **www** in the Name column.
   - Click the **Edit** icon to the right of the **CNAME** record that has **WWW** in the Name column.
   - In the **Points to** field, type: pointing.wixdns.net
   - Click **Save**.

   **Note:** If you don't have a **CNAME** record with **WWW** under Name, create one:
   - Click **ADD** at the bottom right.
   - Click the **Type** drop-down and select **CNAME**.
   - Enter **www** in the **Host** field.
   - In the **Points to** field, type: pointing.wixdns.net
   - Click **Save**.

### Note
It may take up to 48 hours for the DNS changes to propagate (become live) worldwide. Learn more about [domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: Why are my widgets not attaching to sections in Editor X, and how can I fix this issue?
answer:
Currently, there is an issue that causes widgets for some applications to not be attached inside of a section. We're aware of the issue and are currently gathering more information regarding this matter.

### Meanwhile, you can use the following workaround:
1. Add a new blank section to the top of the page.
2. Arrange the affected widget to be on top of the page for every breakpoint (even above the header).
3. Set the Position type to "pinned" for the affected widget.
4. Set the Position type back to "default".
5. Adjust the Size, Docking, Margins for the widget on all breakpoints after it is attached to a section.

![Screencast](https://www.screencast.com/users/stoppino/folders/Snagit/media/037b547f-b6c0-45f6-8458-56f4f81bed57/embed)

* The Widget must be at the top of the page for every breakpoint or it will not be able to be pinned.
* In the cases you have another component already pinned to the top of the page, it must be temporarily set back to default first.
* When adding a new blank section, make sure it is placed at the top of the page (below the affected widget).

question: How can I create a free plan for my customers using the Wix dashboard?
answer:
To create a free plan using the Wix dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Pricing Plans](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Pricing%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/membership/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Plan** at the top right.
3. Enter your plan's details in the **Plan Info** section:
   
   1. Enter the plan name.
   2. Add a cover image to showcase on your plan.
   3. (Optional) Enter a tagline with a brief description of the plan.
   4. Add perks under **Tell customers what the main features are** (e.g. First month free):

      **Note:** What you enter here is what your clients see. It does not connect services or content to the plan (see the next step).
4. Scroll down to **Benefits** and select the checkbox next to the services or content types you want to include.
5. Add the relevant details (e.g. the specific services that are included).
6. Select **Free** under **Pricing options**.
7. Choose the duration from the **Length of Plan** drop-down:
   
   * **Monthly:** Select each one individually.
   * **Until canceled:** Clients choose when they want to cancel.
   * **Custom:** Choose the duration of the plan from the **Choose period** drop-down (weeks, months, years) and enter the relevant number.
8. Scroll down to **Settings** and choose how you want to adjust your free plan's settings:
   
   * **Limit to 1 subscription per customer:** Enable the **Limit 1 purchase per person** toggle so customers can only purchase this plan once using the same email. If they try to purchase it again, they [receive a notification that they can only purchase the plan once](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-managing-notifications-you-send-and-receive).
   
   **Note:** Enabling this toggle only applies to future purchases. Clients who purchased the plan previously can still purchase the same plan again before the restriction takes effect.
   
   * **Allow plan cancellation:** Enable this toggle to allow clients to cancel their plan subscriptions by themselves in their personal My Subscriptions page.
   
   **Note:** For this to work, your site must have [the Wix Members Area and the My Subscriptions pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-about-the-my-subscriptions-page#adding-the-my-subscriptions-page-to-the-members-area).
   
   * **Add a policy:** Create a policy for your pricing plan that appears on the checkout page. This could include any legal requirements, details about your renewal policy, and so on.
   
   **Note:** There is a 3,000-character limit for plan policies. Shorter plan policies appear at checkout. Clients can access longer plan policies using the link under the checkout.
   
   **To add a plan policy:**
   1. Click **Add** next to **Add a policy**.
   2. Write your terms and conditions in the field provided.
   3. (Optional) Enable the **Policy checkbox** toggle so clients have to agree to your terms and conditions before completing checkout.
   4. (Optional) Enable the **Checked by default** toggle to automatically tick your policy checkbox for clients.
   
   **Note:** Make sure to check any legal requirements regarding policies, terms, and conditions in the country where you sell your plans.
   5. Click **Save**.

9. **Add custom form fields for clients to fill:** Add a custom form field to your checkout form to gather more information from your customers. It can include specific contact details you need, a checkbox, drop-down or multi-choice field.
   
   **To add a custom form:**
   1. Click **Select** next to **Collect additional info at checkout**.
   2. Click **+ Create Form**.
   3. Drag and drop the form field onto the page.

10. **Customize a Thank You page:** Add a message you display to customers after they purchase one of your plans. The message also includes a button, which can lead to your site's home page or any other page.
    
    **To add a custom form:**
    1. Click **Edit** next to **Customize a Thank You page**.
    2. Enter a title for your **Thank You** page.
    3. Add the message you want this page to display.
    
    **Tip:** You can add links to direct customers to additional products, services or plans that may interest them.
    4. Enter your **Button text**.
    5. Choose where the button directs customers to:
       
       * **Home Page:** When they click the button on the Thank You page, your customers return to your home page.
       * **Other page:** Direct customers to a specific URL, such as your services or products page or a landing page.
       
       1. Enter the **Page URL**.

11. Click **Save** at the top to finish creating your plan.

### Notes
* When clients subscribe to the free plan, they have instant access to its perks and benefits.
* During setup, the **Let people choose their start date** toggle is disabled since the plan is active immediately and does not require a payment.

question: How can I add or update a TXT record in my Wix account?
answer:
To add or update a TXT record in your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page.
2. Click the **Show More** icon next to the relevant domain and select **Manage DNS Records**.

### To add a TXT record:
1. Click **\+ Add Record** in the **TXT (Text)** section.
2. Click the **Host Name** field and enter the host name. 
   **Note:** Leave this field blank if instructed to add an **@** sign.
3. Click the **Value** field and enter the TXT value.
4. Click **Save**.

### To update a TXT record:
1. Hover over the TXT record and click **Edit**.
2. Click the **Host Name** field and enter the host name. 
   **Note:** Leave this field blank if instructed to add an **@** sign.
3. Click the **Value** field and enter the TXT value.
4. Click **Save**.

**Important:** If your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, you must add or update TXT records with your domain host (not Wix).

question: How can I add gift registry links to my wedding website using Wix Editor?
answer:
To add links to your wedding registries on your Wix website, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Button**.
4. Click **Text & Icon Buttons.**
5. Drag a button onto your page.
6. Click **Settings**.
7. Select an option under **Choose what displays**:
   * **Text and icon:** Both text and an icon are shown on the button.
   * **Icon only:** The button only displays an icon.
   * **Text only:** The button only displays text.
   * **Nothing:** The button is blank.
8. Click **Choose a Link** under **Links To**.
9. Click **Web Address**.
10. Enter your registry URL.
11. Choose if you want the registry link to open in a new browser window, or the current one.
12. Click **Done**.
13. Repeat steps 2-12 for each wedding registry.

### Tip
Another option is to [add the store logo](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-a-link-to-an-image) (e.g. Amazon, Target) to your site and link the image to your registry.

question: How can I track sales using the Thank You Page URL in Wix Stores?
answer:
To track sales using your Thank You Page URL in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. **Access Your Thank You Page URL**: The URL for your site's Thank You page is made of your domain name followed by: **/thank-you-page**. For example, if your site URL is **www.mystunningwebsite.com**, your Thank You page URL is **www.mystunningwebsite.com/thank-you-page**.

2. **Create a Rule in an External Tool**: Start by creating a rule to track Thank You Page visits using an external tool such as Google Analytics.

3. **Enter the URL Part**: Enter this part of the Thank You Page URL: **/thank-you-page** in the relevant tool to track visits.

### Note
If you have a conversion pixel, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-your-facebook-pixel-to-your-wix-site) to learn how to add it to your site.

question: Can I change the browser theme color for mobile using the Studio Editor?
answer:
Currently, the Studio Editor does not offer a feature that lets you choose the color of the browser when visitors view your client's site on mobile. 

As a workaround, you can add custom code to change the browser color, specifically for Safari:

- **Single page:** [Add it as a meta tag](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-additional-meta-tags-to-your-sites-pages#adding-an-additional-meta-tag) in the page's Advanced SEO settings panel.
- **Multiple or all pages:** [Add it to the Custom Code tab](https://support.wix.com/en/article/embedding-custom-code-on-your-site#adding-custom-code-to-your-site) in the dashboard.

This code, for example, changes the browser color to white:

```
<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
```

question: How can I send an email campaign to a specific segment of contacts using Wix?
answer:
To send an email campaign to a segment using Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Email Marketing](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Email%20Marketing%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/shoutout/) in your site's dashboard.
2. [Create an email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-and-sending-a-campaign-from-start-to-finish) or [edit an existing one](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-managing-your-campaign).
3. [Customize the elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-elements-to-your-email-campaign) in your campaign to your liking. 

   **Tip:** [Preview and test your email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-email-campaign#sending-a-test-email-before-sending-your-campaign) to make sure it is perfect before you add recipients and send.
4. Click **Next** at the top right.
5. Select **Target group** under **Who are you sending this email to**.
6. Click **\+ Add Segment** under **Segments**.
7. Select the checkbox next to the relevant segments to receive your campaign.
8. Click **Choose Segments**. 

   **Tip:** If you want to create a new segment with filters for this email campaign, go to the Segments tab in [Contacts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Contacts&title=Select%20a%20site%20to%20update&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fcontacts).
9. (Optional) Add individual contacts to your recipient list who aren't in the segment.
10. Click **Next** at the top right to publish your email campaign.
11. Edit the sender details of your campaign including the subject line, 'From name' and reply-to email.
12. Click **Send now** to send your campaign to the segment. 

   **Tip:** You can also send a test email to see how the campaign appears, or click **Schedule** to schedule your campaign.

**Note:** Sending an email campaign to a segment counts towards your monthly email marketing balance (both campaign and email limits). You can view all stats in [My Email Campaigns](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20My%20Campaigns&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/shoutout/contacts?referralInfo=sidebar#/my-shoutouts).

question: How can I set up spam protection on my new Wix Forms?
answer:
To set up spam protection on your new Wix Forms, follow these steps:

1. Click **Edit Form** to open the form builder.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Select **Spam filter settings**.
4. Choose from the following options:
   
   * **Only reCAPTCHA:** Uses invisible reCAPTCHA to analyze site visitor behavior and determine if they are human or a bot. If suspected to be a bot, a challenge is shown. This is the lowest level of spam protection.
   * **Basic and reCAPTCHA:** After passing invisible reCAPTCHA, submissions go through a basic spam filter that labels spam based on criteria like network identifiers and contact information. This is the mid-level spam protection.
   * **Advanced and reCAPTCHA:** Includes reCAPTCHA and the basic filter, plus an advanced filter using additional technologies to mark spam. This highest level of spam protection is only applied if the other two filters do not mark the submission as spam.

For more details, you can visit the [Setting up spam protection on your site form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-protecting-your-site-forms-from-spam-with-a-captcha-field#setting-up-spam-protection-on-your-site-form) page.

question: How do I set up a flat rate shipping rule in Wix Stores?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have created or selected a shipping region as described in Step 1.

To set up a flat rate shipping rule in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. Select **Flat Rate** from the **Select how shipping is calculated** drop-down.
2. Enter a name in the **Shipping Option Name** field (e.g. Standard Shipping).
3. (Optional) Enter a time in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
4. Enter the shipping rate.
5. (Optional) Offer free shipping on orders above a specific price:
   
   1. Click the **Offer Free Shipping when customer buys over a certain amount** checkbox and enter the amount.
   
   **Note:** If you create additional shipping services (e.g. priority shipping), this checkbox must be selected and the amount specified to apply to each rule.
6. Click **Add another Delivery Option** to add additional options (e.g. Express Shipping).
7. (Optional) Check the **Add a handling fee to every order** checkbox and enter the handling fee.
8. Click **Save**.

question: How can I add a WhatsApp button to my website using Editor X?
answer:
To add a WhatsApp button to your website using Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/09/22/c5b3c4c7-39a4-456b-8fa1-95ca24679369/9c664d7c-243b-44b1-bb86-77355a6cd1e0.jpg) at the top left of your Editor.
2. Drag a button to the desired location on your page.
3. (Optional) Change the button text (e.g., Contact on WhatsApp).
4. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/09/22/c3c2dde3-9fa5-4f05-ba83-195740671475/2083d667-c273-4c2c-b4f4-13aa1fbaefb7.png).
5. Click **Web Address**.
6. Choose an option:
   
   **Create a link with an automated first message**
   - Enter the following address under **What's the web address (URL)?**: `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=**<number>**`
   - To include a message, add `&text=your message` to the URL, like so: `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=**12125558471**&text=**Hi%20requesting%20a%20callback.%20Thanks**`.

**Tip:** You can link from any element on your site, such as from a menu tab or image.

question: How can I set up delivery to pickup points for my Wix store?
answer:
To set up delivery to pickup points for your Wix store, you need to use third-party apps such as [Boxtal](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-offering-delivery-to-pickup-points-with-boxtal) or [Sendcloud](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-offering-delivery-to-pickup-points-with-sendcloud). Here are the steps to follow:

1. **Add a Third-Party App**: Choose either Boxtal or Sendcloud and add it to your Wix store.
2. **Integrate the App**: Follow the instructions to integrate the app with your store.
3. **Configure and Enable**: Once integrated, configure the app settings and enable it for the relevant locations.
4. **Order Processing**: When you receive an order, send it to one of the relevant carriers' pickup points. They will ensure it gets to the location your customer selected.

By following these steps, you can offer your customers the convenience of collecting their orders from nearby pickup points.

question: How can I restore my site to search engine results after it was removed?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that any issues with your site have been resolved as per the search engine's guidelines.

To restore your site to search engine results after it was removed, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Resolve any issues with your site

Usually, search engines will let you know what issues exist on your site. For example, Google gives you a [Manual Actions report](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9044175?hl=en) in Google Search Console that details the issues with your site. Make sure to follow any advice from search engines to make sure your site is compliant with [their quality guidelines](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/guidelines/webmaster-guidelines) before you request a review.

### Step 2 | Request a review of your site

After you've removed any black hat SEO optimization and resolved any other issues, you can [request a reconsideration review](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9044175). These reviews can take several days or weeks to complete, and the search engine will notify you when it's done.

### Step 3 | Add original content to help improve your site's ranking

One of the best ways to [rank higher in search engine results](https://support.wix.com/en/article/getting-your-site-found-on-google-seo-best-practices) is to regularly add original content to your site. The rank of your page depends on the quality of your content and [how relevant it is to certain keywords](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-keywords-on-your-sites-pages). You should also try to use your keywords and search phrases organically throughout your content.

Here are some ways that you can create high-quality content that organically uses your keywords:

- Describe the main purpose of your site in different ways with a variety of keywords
- Go into as much detail as you can about what you do, what services or products you offer, and what your users can get from your site
- Write content that answers popular questions related to your keywords
- [Create a blog](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-about-the-wix-blog) for news updates and new trends
- [Make an FAQs page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-and-setting-up-the-wix-faq-app) to help customers with common questions
- [Add a testimonials page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-customer-testimonials-to-your-site) for customer reviews

### Tip

[Learn more about optimizing your site's content for SEO.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-sites-content-for-seo)

question: How can I add a dataset filter to display content from multiple collections in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add a dataset filter to display content from multiple collections in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page where you want to show content from both collections. Your primary collection should already be connected to a dataset that connects to the page elements.
3. Add a dataset and connect it to your secondary collection:
   
   1. Click **CMS** on the left.
   2. Click **Manage Page Connections**.
   3. Click **Add a Dataset** in the panel on the right.
   4. Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select your secondary collection.
   5. (Optional) Edit the name of the dataset.
   6. Click **Create**.

4. Add a filter to your secondary collection's dataset:
   
   1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to your secondary collection's dataset in the panel on the right.
   2. Select **Dataset Settings**.
   3. Click **+ Add Filter**.
   4. Click the **Field** drop-down and select the field that has the same values as a field in your primary collection.
   5. (Optional) Click the **Condition** field to change the operator that determines how the filter is applied.
   6. Select **Another dataset** under **Value source**.
   7. Click the **Dataset** drop-down and select the dataset that connects to your primary collection.
   8. Click the next **Field** drop-down and select the field from your primary collection that matches the secondary collection field.
   9. Click **Add Filter**.

5. Connect elements to the secondary collection's dataset to show content from the collection:
   
   1. Click the relevant element (e.g. text, image) and select the **Connect to CMS** icon.
   2. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select your secondary collection's dataset.
   3. Click the relevant drop-down(s) under **Connections** and select the secondary collection's field(s) that you want to connect.

   **Note:** Don't worry if any of the CMS connections in your editor appear to disconnect at this point. Once you're done with the connections, you can click **Preview** to test the new connections.

6. Click **Preview** to test your connections.
7. Publish your site when you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: Can I use a third-party app subscription to upgrade an app on my Wix site?
answer:
Unfortunately, it is not possible to use a subscription created outside of Wix with a third-party to upgrade an app from the Wix App Market. For example, if you have an account with 123 Contact Forms that you created outside of Wix, you cannot use that account to upgrade the 123 Contact Forms app on your Wix site.

* [Learn how to upgrade an app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-an-app-from-the-wix-app-market)
* [Go to your billing and payment information](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings)

### Tip
We suggest you contact the third-party app provider directly to see if they can provide assistance.

question: How can I set up my Wix Art Store to sell both digital images and prints?
answer:
To set up your Wix Art Store to sell digital images and prints, follow these steps:

### Step 1: Choose the type of images you want to sell (digital or digital and print).
1. Click the Wix Art Store app in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Set Up Store**.
4. Click **Start Now**.
5. Click **Sell Digital & Print**.
6. Click **OK**.

### Step 2: Add the images you want to sell to your gallery.
**Note:** You do not need to add all the images you want to sell at once. You can always come back to add more images. 
1. Click **Upload Images**.
2. Click **Add Media**.
3. Click **Image**.
4. Select the images from your media manager or click **Upload Images** to upload new images.
5. Click **Apply**. 

**Note:** You can add a title, description and link for each image, reorder the images or edit the image quality.
6. Click **Done**. 

**Tip:** The size offered for the printed items depend on the size of the file you use in your Art Store. The larger the file is, the larger the print sizes that will be offered. To get the best results for large prints (e.g. art posters, canvas) it is recommended to upload images of 4000px or more, in RGB format.

### Step 3: Set the pricing for the images.
1. Click **Settings** on the Art Store in the Editor.
2. Click **Store**.
3. Click **Set Pricing**.
4. Follow the steps [here](https://www.orderaprint.com/art-store/pricing) to set the pricing.

### Step 4: Add your business information and set up your Art Store
1. Go to the **Store Info** tab in the Art Store in your dashboard
2. Add your business name, email for order confirmation, and your country.
3. Choose your email settings.
4. Add location settings: e.g. currency, language, price format, and currency symbol alignment.

question: How can I import products to my Wix Store using a CSV file?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Export your product data from your current eCommerce platform or another Wix store.

### Step 1 | Download the Wix CSV Template File
1. [Go to the Store Products tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More Actions**.
3. Click **Import**.
4. Click **Download CSV File.**
5. Choose an option:
   - **Blank Wix CSV template:** Import products from another store.
   - **Wix CSV with your products:** Update existing products.
6. Open the CSV file. 
   - **Note:** Mac users should open the file with Numbers or Excel version 15 or higher.
7. Save the downloaded file in CSV (Comma delimited) format.

### Step 2 | Add Your Products & Upload the File
1. Enter the product data into the template, following these guidelines:
   - Do not add or delete columns.
   - Do not edit column names.
   - Each product must have a **handleId**, **name**, **fieldType**, **price**.
   - Each variant must have a **handleId**, **fieldType**, **optionChoices**.
   - If unsure about non-mandatory fields, leave them blank.
   - Do not add fields not found in the Wix CSV Template file.
2. Delete the rows of sample data or leave them and delete the sample products after the import.
3. Save the file in a CSV format.

### Uploading the CSV file
1. Go to the [Store Products tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More Actions**.
3. Click **Import**.
4. Click **Upload CSV File**.
5. Upload the updated file you saved and click **Continue**.
6. Read the import review and check for error messages.
7. Do one of the following:
   - **No products with errors:** Click **Import Products** to complete the process.
   - **Products with errors:** Correct the errors and import again or import your products as is. Only products without errors are imported if you proceed without corrections.

**Note:** Product images may take up to one hour to upload if you have many products. You can continue to make changes in your store while the images upload in the background.

question: How can I connect Klarna as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Klarna as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** beside Klarna.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Klarna account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:
   
   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Klarna API keys (username and Password). 
      
      **Note**: Playground credentials aren't accepted.
   2. Click **Connect**.
   
   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click **Create Klarna Account** and fill in the information to create your account.
   2. Return to this window (repeat steps 1-4), and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

**Note**: The currency used in your Wix account must match the currency in your Klarna account. If the currencies do not match, the transactions may be declined. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: How can I manually mark a reservation as 'Paid' in the original Wix Hotels?
answer:
To manually mark a reservation as 'Paid' in the original Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your dashboard.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-sites-dashboard)

question: How can I view and chat with live site visitors using the Wix app?
answer:
To view and chat with live site visitors using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. A notification appears at the top of the dashboard if you have live site visitors. Tap the notification to see the full list.
3. Site visitors appear as a number (Visitor #9504) if they are not registered to your site, or as their name if they are site members. To view more information about a visitor:
   - Tap the visitor you want to view.
   - Tap the drop-down next to **On Page** to view all the available details including the page of your site the visitor is currently on, the browser they're using, their location, and how many times they've previously visited.

   - Make sure the **Chat status** toggle is enabled at the top of the site visitor list so you are online and available to chat.

The message pops up in the chatbox on your site for the visitor to see and respond to. A green dot also appears at the top of the chatbox to let visitors know you are active and ready to chat.

question: Can I automatically move contacts from one Wix site to another within my account?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to automatically move contacts from one Wix site to another within your account. However, you can use the following workaround:

### Step 1: Export your contacts from the first site.

   * **By group:** Click the drop-down menu to select a contact group, or select **All Contacts**.
5. Select a file format: 

   * Google CSV file
   * Outlook CSV file
6. Click **Export**
7. Save the file to your computer.

### Step 2: Import your contacts to the second site.

question: How does Wix determine the ownership of a site in the event of a dispute?
answer: In the event of a dispute between several parties, Wix will determine site ownership by using established guidelines. For free sites, the owner of any sites or content is the owner of the Wix account under which the content was created. In most cases, the owner of the account is considered to be the person or entity who has access to the email address listed in Wix's records. For premium sites connected to a domain, if a site is/was connected to a domain whose registration information is publicly available via the [WHOIS](https://www.whois.com/whois/) database, the owner of the site is considered to be the person or entity registered as the owner of this domain. If a domain is not connected or we are unable to verify the registration information in the WHOIS database, we may use any relevant billing information to determine the account or site owner. If any paid services were purchased via the account, the owner of this account or any site or content created there, is considered to be the person or entity whose billing details were used to purchase these paid services.

question: How can I add a Google Map to my Wix site and manage multiple locations on it?

2. Click **Contact & Forms**.
3. Click **Maps** or **Full Width Maps**.
4. Click a map or drag it to the relevant location on your page.
5. Click **Manage Locations**.
6. Choose how many locations you want to add to the map:

### Multiple locations
1. Click **Multiple**.
2. Edit the template location to make it your first location:
   1. Hover over the default (Wix Office) location and click the **More Actions** icon.
   2. Click **Edit**.
3. Enter your first location's details:
   * **Address:** Type the address.
   * **Title:** Add a title to the location on the map to let users know what it's called.
   * **Description:** Add a short description to describe the location.

4. Click the **Back** icon at the top left.
5. Add another location:
   1. Click **Add Location**.
   2. Enter the location details.
   3. Click the **Back** icon at the top left.
   4. Repeat steps a-b for each location you want to add to your map.

**Tip:** Click the More Actions icon next to a location to edit, duplicate, or delete it.

question: How can I submit a notice about illegal content under the Digital Services Act on Wix?
answer:
Under the DSA, platforms like Wix are required to have a process in place to aid the notification of illegal content by individuals or entities. Notices may be submitted by:

* Users residing in the EU
* Users residing outside of the EU about content accessible within the EU
* [Trusted Flaggers](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=celex%3A32022R2065#d1e2973-1-1) appointed by the European Commission

According to Article 16 of the DSA, government authorities, trusted flaggers, and users online can submit complaints about illegal content. Click to [submit a notice](https://www.wix.com/abuse).

question: How can I set up a grace period for my customers' subscriptions on Wix?
answer:
To set grace periods and recurring retries for your subscriptions:

1. [Go to Subscription settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Subscription%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/subscriptions/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Enable the toggle next to **Grace Period**.
3. Enter the grace period you want to offer clients who miss their recurring payments.
4. Click the toggle next to **Retry a customer's payment method automatically during grace period** to choose how you want to retry payments during the grace period:
   
   * **Enabled:** The system automatically makes multiple attempts to collect payment from the customer's existing payment method.
   * **Disabled:** The system does not make any additional attempt to collect payment from the customer's existing payment method.
5. Click the toggle next to **Send customers an automated email when a payment needs to be resubmitted** to choose whether to email customers who need to resubmit payments:
   
   * **Enabled:** Customers get an automated email about the grace period when their payment fails.
   * **Disabled:** Customers don't get an email when their subscription enters the grace period.
   
   **Note:** Automated emails for failed payments are active by default.
6. Click the toggle next to **Email customer when failed payment is successfully collected**:
   
   * **Enabled:** Customers receive an automated email that their payment was successful, and their grace period is over.
   * **Disabled:** Customers don't receive an email about their successful payment and the end of their grace period.
   
   **Note:** Automated emails for successful payments after entering a grace period are active by default.

### Tip
A notification showing whether a subscription is in grace period and if the system is attempting recurring retries appears in the [Subscriptions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Subscriptions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/subscriptions) tab.

question: How can I resolve the 'Default mail client is not properly installed' error message when clicking an email link on my website?
answer:
If you receive the error message: **"Default mail client is not properly installed,"** you need to set a default mail client in your browser's settings. This issue occurs when you click an email link from your live site if you do not have a defined default mail client for your device. 

To avoid this issue, it is recommended to display your email address on your site and [use a contact form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-form-on-your-site). This issue is localized to your computer and should not affect your visitors unless they have also not set up a default mail client.
