question: How can I connect a Pro Gallery to my CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have created a CMS collection with the necessary fields and set the appropriate permissions.

To connect a Pro Gallery to your CMS collection in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page where you want a gallery to display images representing different collection items.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
4. Click **Gallery**.
5. Click and drag the Pro Gallery you want to use onto the page.
6. Remove the default images from the gallery:
   1. Click **Manage Media** on the gallery.
   2. Click **Select All**, then click **Delete**.
   3. Click **Done**.
7. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
8. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click **Create a New Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to connect.
9. Click the relevant drop-downs to connect your collection fields to the gallery:
   * **Image sources connect to:** Select the image field you want to display.
   * **Titles connect to:** Select the field you want to use for the image titles.
   * **Descriptions connect to:** Select the field you want to use for the image descriptions.
   * **Alt texts connect to:** Select the field you want to use for the image alt texts.
   * **Links connect to:** Select the dynamic page, URL field, or image field you want to link the images to.
10. Click the gallery and select **Settings** to customize your gallery's layout, design, and more. Learn more about [customizing your Pro Gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-customizing-the-gallery-settings).

question: How can I move my site from ADI to the Wix Editor and what should I expect after the switch?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed any necessary preparations in ADI before switching to the Wix Editor.

### Step 1 | Access ADI and Move to the Editor
To get started, access your site in ADI. You can switch to the Editor using the top bar (under **Site**), or click **Go to Editor** on the right.

1. Click **Site** on the top bar inside ADI.
2. Select **Go To Editor** at the bottom.
3. (In the pop-up) Click **Switch to Editor**.

### Step 2 | Explore the Wix Editor
After clicking **Switch to Editor**, your site automatically moves to the Editor. Once the process is done, it's time to discover all the advanced tools and features it has to offer. Using drag and drop, you can start adding elements and apps to your site.

On the left side of the Editor, you can see the different menus that let you add new elements and apps to your site. You can also manage your pages, themes, media and much more. 

The options are displayed in the below order: 

* **Add panel:** Add new elements and apps to your page using drag and drop.
* **Pages:** Add new pages to your site and manage existing pages from here.
* **Theme Manager:** View your site's [color](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-your-color-theme) and [text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-working-with-text-themes) themes and adjust them as necessary.
* **Background:** Change the current page's background. You can choose a [color](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-your-page-background-color), an [image](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-an-image-to-your-page-background) or a [video](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-a-video-to-your-page-background).
* **Add Apps:** Add new apps to your site from the [App Market](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-an-app-to-your-site).
* **Media:** Upload media, edit images and videos and access your site's [Media Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-about-the-media-manager).

### Tip
When switching to the Editor, the layout and design of your ADI site stay exactly the same – this allows you to continue building from where you left off.

### Warning
If you move to the Wix Editor, you will not be able to return to ADI.

### Note
Currently, if you move to the Wix Editor, you will no longer be able to edit your site on a mobile or tablet device.

question: Can customers save their payment details when making purchases through Spaces by Wix?
answer: Currently, customers who make purchases through Spaces by Wix cannot save their credit card details. Their contact details, however, are saved.

question: How can clients cancel or reschedule their sessions on a Wix site?
answer:
When you [add a Wix Members Area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-allowing-clients-to-become-site-members#add-a-members-area-to-your-desktop-site) to your site, clients can log in and make changes to their bookings. On their personal **My Bookings** page, they can view upcoming and past bookings. Each of the upcoming bookings has a **Reschedule** and **Cancel** option, so clients can make changes without taking up any of your time.

### Important
Clients cannot reschedule sessions paid for with different [price options](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-understanding-price-options).

### Notes
* To avoid last-minute cancellations, [set a cancellation policy](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-up-your-booking-policies) that includes cancellation and no-show fees.
* Clients can also book, reschedule, or cancel attendance at their upcoming sessions using the Wix mobile member apps (Spaces, Fit, Branded, Dine).
* When clients cancel sessions booked using pricing plans, the session is added back into their pricing plan allowance.

question: How can I create a combo meal in the original Wix Restaurants Menus App?
answer:
To create a combo meal in the original Wix Restaurants Menus App, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Menus](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Restaurant&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/restaurants/menus) in your site's dashboard.
2. Navigate to the relevant menu section.
3. Click **Add Dish**.
4. Enter the combo meal details:
   - **Name:** Enter a name for the combo meal.
   - **Price:** Enter a price for the combo meal.
   - **Tax:** Enter taxes for the combo meal, if applicable.
   - **Description:** Enter a description for the combo meal.
   - **Dish Labels:** Add relevant labels to your combo meal (Special, Vegan, Vegetarian, Gluten Free, Organic and Spicy levels).
   - **Visibility:** Select to show this combo meal to customers in the menu.
   - **Image:** Click to add an image to the combo meal.
5. Click **Save**.
6. Click "+ New Option" and then **New Option**.
7. Click **New Choice** at the top right and then **Select Existing**.
8. Hover over and select the existing dishes you'd like to add to the combo meal.
9. Click **Add**.

**Note:** The dishes are added with their dish options. To remove the dish options, click **Use without**.
10. Click **Add**.

question: How can I enable and configure pickup options for my restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To offer pickup for restaurant orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Order Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/restaurants/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Pickup** tab.
3. Click the **Pickup** toggle to enable it.
4. Set the pickup details:
   
   1. **Time until orders are ready:** Enter the time it takes for orders to be ready for pickup after customers have placed their orders. This is shown to customers at checkout.
   2. **Minimum Order Price:** Enter a minimum amount for pickup orders. Your customers are alerted if they don't reach the minimum amount. 
      
      **Note**: If you don't want to set a minimum amount, just set it to $0.
   3. (Optional) Click **Edit** to change your opening hours.
      
      * **Opening Hours**: Pickup is available during your restaurant's opening hours.
      * **Custom Hours**: Set specific days and hours where pickup is available. 
        
        **Note**: Click the box with the \+ icon to set multiple custom hour settings (i.e. you could set one for Mon \- Thurs from 9AM\-5PM and another for Fri \- Sat from 9AM\-11PM).
   4. Select the checkbox under **Curbside Pickup** to give customers the option of having their food brought to them outside your restaurant (e.g. your restaurant's parking lot).
      
      * **Curbside pickup instructions**: Enter the curbside pickup instructions that are displayed for your customers when placing their order.
      * **Additional customer information**: Choose if you want to require additional information from the customer.
         
         + Enter the field label for the additional information.
5. Click **Save**.

question: What are the CMS limits for free sites on the Wix Studio platform, and how do they change if I upgrade or leave the platform?
answer:
If your account is in the Wix Studio platform, your free sites have a CMS quota of **10,000 collection items**. This increased quota is an exclusive benefit for all Wix Studio sites and applies only to sites you're the owner of.

If you upgrade to a Premium or Studio plan that includes higher CMS limits than the new quota for free sites, you automatically move to the quota offered by your new plan. For example, if you have 1,000 collection items on your free site and you upgrade to a plan that includes 10,000 items, you have 9,000 items left to use.

If you upgrade to a plan that includes lower CMS limits than the new free plan quota, you move to the quota offered by your new plan. None of the existing collection items are deleted, but you are unable to add more if they exceed the new quota. For example, if you have a free site with 5,000 collection items and you upgrade to a plan that includes 4,000 items, you need to delete existing items until your item count is under 4,000, or upgrade to a plan with more items.

If you choose to leave Wix Studio, your free site CMS quota reverts to **1,000 items**. This is also the free site CMS quota if you never joined Wix Studio. Keep in mind that if you are a Wix Partner and choose to leave Wix Studio, you also opt-out of the Partner Program entirely, losing access to exclusive benefits and features. Learn more about [choosing to leave Wix Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-reverting-after-switching).

question: How can I connect KOMOJU as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect KOMOJU as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to any payment option provided by KOMOJU.
4. Select an option:
   
   ### I have a KOMOJU account
   1. Enter the Secret Key you received from KOMOJU.
   2. Click **Connect**.
   
   ### I don't have a KOMOJU account
   1. Click [**Create KOMOJU account**](https://komoju.com/en/sign_up). This will redirect you to KOMOJU where you can create your new account.
   2. Follow the instructions to sign up.
   3. (When your account is approved) Repeat steps 1-4 and follow the steps under **I have a KOMOJU account**.

   ### I have already connected KOMOJU and I want to add another payment method
   1. Sign in to your [KOMOJU](https://komoju.com/sign_in/) account.
   2. Add the payment method you wish to connect and confirm that the payment method is active.
   3. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
   4. Click **Manage** next to KOMOJU.
   5. Enable the toggle next to your desired payment method.

   **Tip**: Make sure your payment method is [active in KOMOJU](https://help-ja.komoju.com/article/321-article).

* For Convenience Store payments (Konbini), you must confirm the payment in your KOMOJU account before the transaction can be completed in Wix.
* Longer processing times are expected with Bank Transfer payments.

question: What should I do if my video fails to upload on Wix Video due to incompatible file type or encoding issues?
answer:
If your video fails to upload on Wix Video due to incompatible file type or encoding issues, follow these steps:

1. **Export video in the right format**: Use video editing software with YouTube export settings to ensure a successful upload.
2. **Use recommended formats**: Upload mp4 or .mov files, encoded with the h264 codec. Wix Video [supports many video formats](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-video-supported-files), but these formats work best.
3. **Check internet connection for slow upload**: Restart your modem and router, and ensure your computer doesn't go into "sleep mode" during the upload.
4. **Check browser settings**: Ensure your browser is updated to the latest version, try a different browser, and check for any add-ons that may slow down the upload.
5. **Remove any privacy settings**: Turn off all privacy settings on platforms like YouTube to ensure the video can be added to Wix. Videos with privacy settings may not display or play properly. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/troubleshooting-issues-with-external-videos-in-wix-video).

If the issue persists after these steps, provide the affected video file by uploading it to Google Drive or Dropbox and add a public download link to your next reply.

question: Can collaborators purchase Shutterstock images?
answer: Currently, only site owners can purchase Shutterstock images. It is not possible for collaborators to purchase these images.

question: Can I transfer my existing email account to Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to transfer an existing email account to Wix, even if you've transferred the domain to Wix. Instead, you can connect your business email to Wix by adding DNS records (MX, A, CNAME and TXT records) provided by your email host in [the Domains page of your Wix account](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains).

question: Can I set up back-in-stock notifications using the Wix app?
answer: Currently, you must go to desktop to set up [back-in-stock notifications](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-notifying-customers-when-products-are-back-in-stock). It's not possible to set up the notifications using the Wix app.

question: Can I resize a specific text box inside a section?
answer: Currently, you cannot resize a specific text box inside a section but you can resize the text in a section.

question: How can I upgrade my Wix site to allow customers to place orders?
answer:
To upgrade your Wix site so that customers can place orders, follow these steps:

1. If you have not already done so, [add Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores) to your site.
2. Go to your [site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
3. Click the **Upgrade** icon.
4. Click **Select** under the plan you want to purchase.
5. Select a subscription period and click **Continue to Checkout**.
6. Enter your payment details.
7. Click **Submit Purchase**.
8. Refresh your editor to see the upgrade applied to your site.

After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to [verify your identity](https://support.wix.com/en/article/paying-for-wix-services-strong-customer-authentication-sca-and-3d-secure-3ds). If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

question: What can I do with the Wix app as a site owner?
answer:
As a site owner, the Wix app allows you to:

* Set up and customize your site on the member apps
* Manage all aspects of your business
* Communicate with your members and live site visitors

You can control and customize how your business looks on the member apps and communicate with your members directly. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview)

question: Can I connect the page background of dynamic pages to the CMS?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to connect the page background of [dynamic pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages) to the CMS (Content Management System). However, you can connect regular static page backgrounds to the CMS by following these steps:

1. Go to the relevant page in the Wix Editor.
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of your editor.
3. Click the More Actions icon next to the page you are on.
4. Click **Connect to CMS**.
5. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click **Add a Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name and click **Create**.
6. Click the **Page background connects to** drop-down and choose the Image or Video file type you want to connect.

question: Can I import SEO tags to my pages from a CSV file?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add SEO tags to your pages by importing them from a CSV file.

question: How can I add and set up a site search feature on my Editor X website?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure your site is set to [appear in search engines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/enabling-search-engines-like-google-to-index-your-site).

### Step 1 | Add the Site Search App
1. Click **Add** on the top of Editor X.
2. Click **Menu & Search** on the left.
3. Select **Site Search**.
4. Click the Add to Site icon next to **Site Search** to add it to your site.

### Step 2 | Customize the Search Bar
- Choose a search bar from the Add panel and drag it to a section on your page, preferably in the default master header.
- Customize the search bar's placeholder text, layout, and design.

#### Manage the search bar settings
1. Select the Search Bar element on your page.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Enter your own placeholder text and enable quick search if desired.

#### Design the search bar
1. Select the Search Bar element on your page.
2. Click the **Design** icon.
3. Customize the design using options like Fill Color & Opacity, Border, Corners, Shadow, and Text.

#### Adjust the layout of the search bar
1. Select the Search Bar element on your page.
2. Click the **Layouts** icon.
3. Customize the layout using options like Icon alignment, Text alignment, Text padding, and Icon spacing.

### Step 3 | Customize the Search Results Page
- Change the page's title by clicking the text element and selecting **Edit Text**.
- Manage the page's settings, layout, and design by selecting the **Search Results** app and clicking **Settings**.

#### Manage the page's settings, layout, and design
1. Select the **Search Results** app on the page.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Customize the page using the Settings, Display, Layout, and Design tabs.

### Tip
Tailor the search bar to your site's [breakpoints](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-managing-breakpoints) so visitors can use it from any device.

question: How can I optimize the SEO settings for my Wix Events Details Page?
answer:
To optimize the SEO settings for your Wix Events Details Page, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Published Events tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant event.
3. Select **Edit SEO Settings**.
4. Customize any of the following SEO settings:
   * **URL slug**: This text is the last part of your page's URL. You should only change this if it's necessary to reflect the content of your page. We recommend keeping it short and easy to read.
   * **Automatically redirect visits from the old URL to the new one**: When you change an event's URL slug, you can choose to let Wix automatically redirect visitors who try to use the old URL to the new URL. Alternatively, you can disable this toggle and [manually create your own redirect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site).
   * **Title tag**: Add a title tag that summarizes the content of the page. Enter your title tag as it is meant to appear on search engines results.
   * **Meta description**: Add a short meta description of the content on the page. This description helps users decide if the Event is relevant to them.
5. Click the **Let search engines index this page** toggle to set whether search engines can [crawl and index](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/beginner/how-search-works#crawling) your page or not:
   * **Enabled:** Search engines will index your page. People can find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
   * **Disabled:** Search engines will not index your page. People cannot find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
6. Click **Save**.

### Tip
You can use [your site's SEO Settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-seo-settings-1420929) to apply the same SEO logic to many Event Details pages at the same time. You can also view and edit all of the URL slugs and meta tags for your pages on [the Edit by Page tab](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-seo-settings-1420929#editing-the-seo-settings-of-individual-pages).

question: How can I customize my statement descriptor in Wix Payments?
answer:
To customize your statement descriptor in Wix Payments, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Manage Wix Payments](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/provider-manage/com.wix.wixpay.us?&title=Manage%20Wix%20Payments&buttonText=Manage+Wix+Payments).
2. Scroll down to **Customer Statement Descriptor.**
3. Enter the name you do business as under **Statement Descriptor**. 
   
   * Your statement descriptor must be between 5-19 characters.
   * Your statement descriptor must be similar to your business name / legal entity name /, or URL.
   * Your statement descriptor should not be too generic (e.g. "Store"), or already in use (e.g. "Wix.com").
4. Click **Save**.

**Note:** Most banks display financial information consistently and in-line with the statement descriptor you have provided to Wix Payments. Some may display it incorrectly or not at all. Unfortunately, Wix Payments has no control of how banks choose to display financial information.

question: How can I troubleshoot issues with publishing my social media posts to Facebook using Wix?
answer:
To troubleshoot issues with publishing your social media posts to Facebook using Wix, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Make sure you have a Facebook Business page
The option to share to Facebook is only available for Facebook business pages and not personal profile pages. If you don't have a Facebook Business page yet, learn how to create one [here](https://www.facebook.com/pages/creation/).

### Step 2 | Check you have given Wix the right Facebook sharing permissions
1. Click **Sharing Options** in the error message.
2. Make sure you've selected all the checkboxes including **All Pages** at the top.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Click **Confirm**.

If you continue to experience issues, ensure that your Facebook account settings are correct and that you have the necessary permissions set up for Wix to access your Facebook Business page.

question: How can I add an 'About' profile description in Wix Forum?
answer:
To edit your profile and "About" page in Wix Forum, follow these steps:

1. On your live site, click the Login Bar.
2. Click **Profile**.
3. Click **Edit** to update your profile name and image.
4. Do any of the following:
   
   * **Name:** Enter a profile name.
   * **Image:** Click the avatar or image, browse to select a profile image, and click **Open**.
5. Click **Save**.
6. Do any of the following to edit the "About" section:
   
   * Enter text introducing yourself.
   * Click either of the media icons to add images, GIFs, or Videos.
7. Click **Publish**.

### Tip
You can share an "About" page on social media by clicking the **Show More** icon.

question: How can I access my people reports in Wix Analytics?

question: How can I ensure that each dynamic page in my CMS collection has a unique URL?
answer: To ensure that each dynamic page in your CMS collection has a unique URL, make sure you have at least one field whose values uniquely identify each item. This is important because it allows each page to have a [unique URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-unique-dynamic-page-urls). For example, if you have several different recipes for chocolate cake in your recipe collection and you call them all "chocolate cake," their dynamic pages will all have the exact same URL (e.g., mysite/recipes/chocolate-cake). This means you will not be able to control which chocolate cake recipe is displayed on your dynamic page. Therefore, ensure that the [Primary field](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-about-your-collection-fields#primary-fields) in your collection has unique values so that you can select the correct item in your reference fields.

question: How do I connect my Google Workspace business email for a domain that is pointing to Wix?
answer:
To connect your Google Workspace business email for a domain that is pointing to Wix, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your domain host account where your DNS records are managed.
2. Add the following MX records to your DNS settings:

   | Name/Host/Alias | Time to Live (TTL*) | Record Type | Priority | Value/Answer/Destination |
   | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
   | Blank or @ | 3600 | MX | 1 | ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM. |
   | Blank or @ | 3600 | MX | 5 | ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM. |
   | Blank or @ | 3600 | MX | 5 | ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM. |
   | Blank or @ | 3600 | MX | 10 | ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM. |
   | Blank or @ | 3600 | MX | 10 | ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM. |

### Tip
View Google's list of [host-specific directions for adding Google Workspace MX records](https://support.google.com/a/topic/1611273).

### Note about TTL
Once the MX records are set up correctly, Google recommends changing the TTL value to 86400.

question: How does the iOS 15 update affect the opened email statistics in email marketing campaigns?
answer:
With iOS 15, Apple device owners who have set up the Apple Mail app receive a prompt to choose "Protect Mail activity" or "Don't protect Mail activity". When Apple device owners choose “Protect Mail activity”, the Apple Mail app downloads emails received when the app is opened. For a marketing email, this automatic download is counted in campaign statistics as an email being opened. These false positive results increase the following statistics: 
* Opened email
* Open rate
* Recipients who opened your campaign
* Recipients that did not open your email statistics.

question: How can I set up a group redirect for my Wix site to change the URL path for multiple pages at once?
answer:
To set up a group redirect on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your SEO Dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO).
2. Select **Go to URL Redirect Manager** under **Tools and settings**.
3. Click "+ Create New Redirect".
4. Select **Group redirect**.
5. Enter the original path for the group of pages under **Old URL Path**. For example, enter "products" if your old site used the path "mystunningwebsite.com/**products**/product-name".
6. Enter the new path for the group of pages under **New URL Path**. For example, enter "product-page" if the new path is "mystunningwebsite.com/**product-page**/product-name".
7. Click **Save & Close**.

### Limitations of the Group Redirect Tool
- It is not possible to add spaces in either the old or new path.
- You cannot use a path which has already been used in another redirect (single or group).
- Redirecting from your site's home page is not possible.
- You cannot add group redirects for external domains.
- Redirecting a group of pages to a single page (e.g., from "mystunningwebsite.com/**products/product-name**" to "mystunningwebsite.com/**product-gallery**") is not allowed.

question: How can I ensure that my email marketing campaign has a clear and effective Call-To-Action (CTA)?
answer:
To ensure that your email marketing campaign has a clear and effective Call-To-Action (CTA), follow these guidelines:

* Avoid having too many CTAs as it can be distracting and prevent readers from focusing on your primary goal.
* If you do have multiple CTAs, limit them to three levels at most. Have a primary CTA that stands out, so it is obvious to your readers that it is the most important action. Then, include secondary CTAs, followed by the least important ones.
* Use buttons for the more important CTAs as they are more noticeable and attention-grabbing. Use links for the less important CTAs.
* If you have a lot of information to convey, it is better to link to a page on your site rather than including all of it in the email. Your email should act as a teaser or introduction.

By following these guidelines, you can make sure that your CTA is clear, focused, and effective.

question: What are some best practices for writing engaging email content in a marketing campaign?
answer:
Here are some best practices to follow when creating your email content:

1. **Clearly identify yourself in the 'from' name**: Make sure recipients immediately understand who is sending them an email. Use your business name, and if you want a personal touch, include your name followed by the business name (e.g., Sarah from Wix.com).

2. **Write a value-driven and concise subject line**: Your subject line should inform the recipient about what to expect in the email. Keep it informative and aligned with the action you want subscribers to take.

3. **Keep your brand consistent to build trust**: Use consistent brand colors, fonts, and tone of voice in every email to build trust with your contacts.

4. **Speak directly to your audience**: Use data from past campaigns to address your subscribers' pain points and solve their issues.

5. **Keep the email short and focused on one topic**: Each email should have a clear point and topic. Stick to the most important points and link to your call-to-action button for more information.

6. **Stick to one call-to-action**: Choose one main goal for your email and make it obvious what action you want subscribers to take.

7. **Text and images best practices**:
   - Maintain an 80% text to 20% image ratio.
   - Keep text under 200 words and break up paragraphs with sub-headings.
   - Avoid spammy keywords and ensure credible links.
   - Do not send image-only emails; include at least 1-2 sentences of text.
   - Use .jpg, .gif, or .png formats for images and ensure they are at least 750 px wide.
   - Use descriptive file names for images as they become the alt text.

question: How can I update my Velo package and install the updated version on a Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have completed the initial setup of your Velo package and have Dev Mode enabled on your Wix or Editor X site.

### Step 1 | Update the Package
1. Open a Wix or Editor X site.
2. Use one of these approaches to open your package for editing:
   - Make sure that **Dev Mode** is enabled. Click the **More Actions** menu for the package you want to update, and click **Edit Package**.
   - Click the **More Actions** menu next to the Packages section and then click **Manage Installed** to open the Package Manager. Then, in the Package Manager, click the **More Actions** menu of the package you want to update and click **Edit Package**.
3. Make your changes. We recommend you complete the **Release notes** section to explain to package users what changes were made in the release. The release notes appear in the Package Manager under each version you build.
4. Save and [Build](https://support.wix.com/en/article/building-your-velo-package) your package. When you build your package, choose the appropriate type of version - minor or major.

### Step 2 | Install the Updated Package on a Site
1. Open the Wix or Editor X site on which you installed the package (if the site is open, refresh the editor).
2. Make sure that Dev Mode is enabled.
3. Note the update notification.
4. Click **See Update** from the more menu. This opens the **Package Manager**.
5. Click the **Update to <version>** button.

### Additional Note
If you add or update an events.js file in the [backend files](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-velo-package-3964385#add-backend-files) of your package, republish the site after you install the updated version of the package.

By following these steps, you can create a custom collection view and manage its fields effectively.

question: How can I change the payment date for a monthly recurring subscription on Wix?

6. Click **Next**.
7. Choose whether you want to apply a credit for the changes to the billing cycle:
   * **No, don't apply credit to the next payment:** Select this option if you do not wish to credit your customer for days when services weren't provided as a result of the change.
   * **Yes, apply credit to the next payment:** Select this option to apply credit for days when services weren't provided as a result of the change in payment day. **Note:** You cannot select a date within 5 days of the date you are changing from. This is to prevent unwanted surprises for your customers.

question: Why are my email campaigns marked as 'delivered' but not reaching my subscribers' inboxes?
answer:
The most likely reason subscribers aren't seeing your campaign is that it's caught in a spam folder. This will still show as 'delivered' in your email marketing dashboard as the campaign reached the intended recipient, but the subscriber can't see it in their inbox. Other possible scenarios include:

- The email provider is purposefully slowing delivery time or performing it in batches to prevent potential spam.
- There is an issue with the domain associated with the campaign. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-blacklisted-url-links-in-campaigns)
- The campaign doesn't follow email marketing best practices.
- Internet Service Providers (ISP) rules have been violated. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-your-email-sender-reputation)

To ensure your campaign is delivered, follow these steps:

1. **Ask subscribers to check their spam filters:** If your campaign is in a spam filter, make sure subscribers move it back to their inboxes. This will tell the email provider to trust similar emails to these. To learn more about preventing your campaigns from getting marked as spam, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-campaigns-marked-as-spam).
2. **Ask subscribers to add the 'From' email address to their contact lists:** If the email address used to send your campaign is in your subscribers' address books, email providers are more likely to trust the address and allow the content through.
3. **Ask subscribers to check their webmail provider rules:** Some providers such as AOL, Yahoo and Hotmail deliver campaigns to recipients in batches, which means the campaign could take up to 24 hours to get to their inboxes.
4. **Make sure your campaign content follows best practices:** Make sure your email content (including subject line) doesn't include anything that could flag your campaign as suspicious. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-engaging-content)
5. **Make sure your contact list is up to date:** You should regularly be checking and maintaining your recipient list so your campaign doesn't go to bad or old email addresses. If too many of your emails bounce, your campaign could be flagged as spam. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-the-deliverability-of-your-campaign#tips-to-improve-your-email-deliverability)

question: How can I manage my notification settings for online programs in the Wix app?
answer:
To manage your program's notification settings in the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap your Profile icon at the top left.
3. Tap **Notification Settings**.
4. Select the site you want to update notification settings for.
5. Scroll down and tap **Online Programs**.
6. Enable or disable the toggles for the following notifications:
   
   * **New Participants:** Receive notifications for new participants joining or requesting to join your program (if it's private).

question: Can I add titles to every screen's top bar in my branded app?

question: How can I manage restaurant notifications in the Wix app for different restaurant locations?
answer:
To manage your restaurant notification settings for different locations in the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap your profile image at the top left.
3. Tap **Notification Settings**.
4. Select the site you want to update notification settings for.
5. Tap the **Allow Notifications** toggle to enable or disable notifications:
   
   * **Enabled:** Receive push notifications from your restaurant site and any other Wix apps you have installed (e.g. Wix Invoices). You can further customize the notifications you receive by tapping the toggles below:
     
     + **Restaurant Orders**: Get notified every time you receive an order. If disabled, you will not receive a notification in the app, but you can still view the order in the Orders tab. 
       
       **Note:** If you have multiple restaurant locations, enable the toggles for the locations you want to receive notifications for.
     + **Restaurant Reservations**: Get notified every time you receive a reservation. If disabled, you won't get reservation notifications in the app, but can still view them in the Reservations tab. 
       
       **Note:** If you have multiple restaurant locations, enable the toggles for the locations you want to receive notifications for.
   * **Disabled:** You won't receive any push notifications for the Wix apps you have installed.
6. (Optional) Tap the toggles for other apps on your site to manage their notification settings.

**Note:** If you have more than one site, you receive notifications only from the site that is currently open in the Wix app. To switch between sites, tap the drop-down at the top.

question: How can I add a translation disclaimer to my Wix site using the Auto-translate feature?
answer:
To add a translation disclaimer to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Add a new page to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-a-page-to-your-site).
2. [Hide the page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-hiding-and-unhiding-a-page-from-your-site-menu).
3. Add your disclaimer (example below) to the new page.
4. Add text to your footer (e.g. "Translation Disclaimer").
5. [Link the text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-a-link-to-text) to your new page.

You can use one of the following disclaimer text examples:

**Example 1:**

*THIS SERVICE MAY CONTAIN TRANSLATIONS POWERED BY OTHER THIRD PARTY SERVICES, SUCH AS GOOGLE TRANSLATE. \[SITE OWNER] DISCLAIMS ALL WARRANTIES RELATED TO THE TRANSLATIONS, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY WARRANTIES OF ACCURACY, RELIABILITY, AND ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NON INFRINGEMENT.*

**Example 2:**

*The \<company name\> website has been translated for your convenience using translation software powered by third party services, such as Google Translate. Reasonable efforts have been made to provide an accurate translation, however, no automated translation is perfect nor is it intended to replace human translators. Translations are provided as a service to users of the \<company name\> website, and are provided "as is." No warranty of any kind, either expressed or implied, is made as to the accuracy, reliability, or correctness of any translations made from \<source language\> into any other language. Some content (such as images, videos, Flash, etc.) may not be accurately translated due to the limitations of the translation software.*

**Example 3:**

The official text is the \<primary language\> version of the website. Any discrepancies or differences created in the translation are not binding and have no legal effect for compliance or enforcement purposes. If any questions arise related to the accuracy of the information contained in the translated website, refer to the \<primary language\> version of the website which is the official version.

Make sure to add your company details to the \<\> sections in the disclaimer.

question: How can I import contacts into Wix by uploading a CSV file?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that your CSV file is ready and in the right format. This includes having a header row, ensuring each row contains an email address or phone number, and that the file is in CSV format with UTF-8 encoding.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1: Initiate the import process
1. Go to [Contacts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Contact%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/contacts/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select **Import contacts** from the **Import/Export** drop-down at the top.
3. Click **Get Started** under **CSV file**.
4. Click **Next**.

#### Step 2: Upload your CSV file
1. Click the **Add** **+** icon to browse for your file on your computer, or drag your file into the box.
2. (Optional) Select the **Mark as email subscribers** checkbox if every contact you're importing has agreed to be added to your mailing list.
3. Click **Next**.

#### Step 3: Match your fields to Wix contact fields
1. Review the drop-downs under **Wix Contact Fields**. For each drop-down, choose what you want to do:
   * **Leave the field as it is:** Wix automatically maps the fields in your file to the Wix contact fields. You only need to make changes if the field displayed is incorrect.
   * **Select a new field:** Choose an existing field or click **Create Custom Field** to create a new field.
   * **Do not import the field:** Select **- Don't Import -** to leave this field out.
2. Click **Next**.

#### Step 4: (If necessary) Review and fix file errors
1. Click the **view errors** link under **Want to fix your file?**.
2. Open the file and review the **Import Status** and **Error Description** columns.
3. Make the recommended changes that appear in the **Solution** column.
4. Click **Back to Upload** and upload your file again.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Follow [step 4](https://support.wix.com/en/article/importing-contacts-by-uploading-a-csv-file-1066522#step-4-match-your-fields-to-wix-contact-fields) above to match your file fields to Wix Contacts fields.
7. Click **Next**.

#### Step 5: (Optional) Label and import your contacts
1. Click **+ Add Label** and select an existing label, or start typing and press **Enter** to create a new label.
2. Click **Import**.
3. Click **Done**.

question: How can I set up my Wix restaurant to offer both ASAP and scheduled orders?
answer:
To offer both ASAP orders and scheduled orders in your Wix restaurant, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Restaurant Orders Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/olo-settings/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Order Scheduling**.
3. Select **As soon as possible (ASAP) or scheduled for later**.
4. Set up **Scheduling Rules**: 
   
   1. Select an option under **How quickly orders can be prepared?:** 
      
      * Up to a certain number of minutes
      * A range (e.g. between 30 to 40 minutes)
   2. Click **How far in advance orders can be scheduled?** and select the relevant option (e.g. Until the end of the business day). 
   
   **Note:** Days are calculated as business days, not 24-hour periods.
5. Click **Save**.

This setup allows customers to receive their orders immediately or schedule them for later, with preparation times providing expected pickup times. For deliveries, this time includes the relevant delivery duration. Additionally, you can limit how far in advance orders can be placed, with any dates beyond the set limit disabled on your site.

question: Does Wix Email Marketing provide analytics for the best email send times?

question: How can I send a broadcast SMS message using my Business Phone Number on Wix?
answer:
To send a broadcast SMS message using your Business Phone Number on Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap the **Inbox** icon.
3. Tap the **Compose** icon.
4. Tap **Broadcast Message**.
5. Select the contacts you want to send a broadcast message to. 
   
   **Tip:** The contacts receive the messages separately (not as a group message).
6. Tap the drop-down at the bottom left and select **SMS** for your broadcast. 
   
   **Tip:** You can also send a broadcast message via chat or email.
7. Compose the message that will be sent to your selected contacts via SMS. 
   
   **Tip:** Tap the **Add** icon to add photos, saved replies, and more to the broadcast.
8. Tap **Send**.
9. (For contacts with no associated phone number) Choose if and how to inform contacts with no phone number:
   
   * **Send email to contacts without numbers:** The broadcast message is sent as an email to any contacts without saved phone numbers.
   * **Send SMS only to contacts with phone numbers:** The broadcast SMS is only sent to contacts with saved phone numbers. Those without saved numbers do not receive the broadcast.
10. Tap **Send Broadcast** to send the broadcast SMS.

**Tip:** You can also send a broadcast message specifically to those who [booked a service](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-sending-a-broadcast-message-using-the-wix-owner-app) or [signed up for an event](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-broadcasting-a-message-to-guests-using-the-wix-owner-app).

question: How can I create a custom app using Wix Blocks for my organization?

question: How can I create a purchase order in Wix Stores and what are the steps involved?
answer:
To create a purchase order in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Purchase Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Purchase%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/purchase-order) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+Create Purchase Order**.
3. (Optional) Edit the **Ship to** address, to ship the products to a different location.
4. Add a new supplier:
   
   **Tip:** Next time you can simply select this supplier from the list.
5. (Optional) Enter the payment terms.
6. Add products that are in your store's catalog:
   
   1. Click **Select from Catalog**.
   2. Select a product.
   3. If the product has product options, click **Continue** and select a variant.
   4. Click **Add to Order**.
   5. (Optional) Add a description.
   6. If needed, change the SKU to the supplier's SKU.
   7. Select the quantity.
   8. Enter your cost.
   9. (Optional) Click tax and create a tax rate.
   
   **Tip:** Next time you can select the tax rate.
   10. Repeat to add more of your store products.
7. Add products not yet in your store's catalog:
   
   1. Click **+Add Custom Product**.
   2. Add the product name.
   3. (Optional) Add a description.
   4. Enter the supplier's SKU.
   5. Select the quantity.
   6. Enter your cost.
   7. (Optional) Click tax and create a tax rate.
   
   **Tip:** Next time you can select the tax rate.
   8. Repeat to add more custom products.
8. (Optional) Add a note to the order.
9. (Optional) Click **+Add Discount** to enter a percentage discount.
10. Click **Save as Draft**.
11. (Optional) Download the purchase order as a PDF file or email it to yourself.

   **Important:** We suggest not entering your supplier's email address since they will not be able to reply to the email.
12. (Optional) Select **Mark as ordered**.
13. Click **Done**.

question: How can I activate and customize abandoned cart emails in Wix Stores?
answer:
To activate and customize abandoned cart emails in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Set Up Automation** under **Increase sales by reminding customers of abandoned carts**.
3. Choose what you want to edit in this automation:
   
   ### Edit the sender name and email
   1. Click **Edit** next to **Action**.
   2. Click **Edit** under **Sender details**.
   3. Enter a **From name** (select a name customers will recognize, such as your business name).
   4. Enter a **Reply-to email** (the email address that gets the customer's reply).
   5. Click **Save**.
   
   ### Edit the text and design of the email
   1. Click **Edit** next to **Action**.
   2. Click **Edit Template** under **Create an email**.
   3. [Edit the text and design the look of the email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-customizing-automated-emails#editing-your-email-template).
   4. When ready, click **Save & Publish**.
   
   **Important:** The email is set up to automatically show each customer a product they abandoned, the product name and price, and a link to the cart. We suggest **not editing** the parts of the template outlined in red. The design of the button (outlined in green) can be edited, but **do not** change the button link.
   
   ### Schedule how soon you send the email
   1. Click **Edit** next to **Timing**.
   2. Select an option from the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down.
      * **Immediately:** Email is sent one hour after the customer adds an item to the cart.
      * **Set custom time:** You select when to send the email (if you select 4 hours, the email is sent 5 hours after the customer adds an item to the cart):
         1. Click the arrows to set the number of hours / days.
         2. Select **Hours** or **Days**.
   3. Select how many times the same customer can receive an abandoned cart email:
      * **Don't limit**: Customer receives an email for each abandoned cart.
      * **Once per contact:** An email is sent the first time a particular customer abandons an item.
      * **Once per contact every 24 hours (Recommended):** Every time a customer abandons a new cart within 24 hours, they receive an email.
4. When ready, click **Activate** at the top right.

question: How can I customize the hover view of my gallery items in Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
To customize the hover view of your gallery items in Wix Pro Gallery, follow these steps:

1. Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Design** tab.
4. Choose which hover elements you want to customize:

### Overlay & Icons
- Click **Overlay & Icons**.
- Choose an overlay and customize it using the options available:
  
  * **Full Overlay:**
    - **Gradient:** Click the toggle to enable a gradient overlay and edit its options:
      - **Color & Opacity 1 and 2:** Click the relevant color box to customize the gradient's colors. Then drag the slider to adjust the opacity of the colors.
      - **Gradient direction:** Drag the slider to adjust the gradient's overlay direction.
    - **Overlay color:** Click the color box to choose a color. Then drag the slider to change the transparency of the color overlay.
    - **Icon color:** Click the color box and select a new color for your gallery icons.
  
  * **Partial Overlay:**
    - **Set size in:** Manage your overlay's size in percentages or pixels.
    - **Size:** Drag the slider or enter a value to choose an overlay size.
    - **Overlay starts from:** Choose where your overlay is positioned.
    - **Padding:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of space between the gallery border and your overlay.
    - **Gradient:** Click the toggle to enable a gradient overlay and edit the options:
      - **Color & Opacity 1 and 2:** Click the relevant color box to customize the gradient's colors. Then drag the slider to adjust the opacity of the colors.
      - **Gradient Direction:** Drag the slider to adjust the gradient's overlay direction.
    - **Overlay color:** Click the color box to choose a color. Then drag the slider to change the transparency of the color overlay.
    - **Icon color:** Click the color box and select a new color for your gallery icons.

5. Choose an overlay effect from the options available:
  
  * **No effect**: The overlay does not apply any effect.
  * **Fade in**: The overlay gradually appears on hover.
  * **Expand**: The overlay expands on hover.
  * **Slide up**: The overlay slides up on hover.
  * **Slide right**: The overlay slides right on hover.

### Texts
- Customize the text using the options below:
  * **Info to display:** Select the checkbox next to the text you want to display on your gallery.
  * **Info position:** Choose where to position your text: **Underneath**, **Above** or **On Image**.
  * **What happens to the info on hover?:** Choose how your text behaves on hover: **Appears**, **Disappears** or **No Change**.
  * **Title style and color:** Select the font and color of the title text.
  * **Description font style and color:** Select the font and color of the description text.
  * **Horizontal alignment:** Choose how to align horizontal text: Left, Centered, or Right.
  * **Vertical alignment:** Choose how to align vertical text: Left, Centered, or Right.
  * **Text vertical padding:** Drag the slider to change the amount of space between the vertical text and the border.
  * **Text horizontal padding:** Drag the slider to change the amount of space between the horizontal text and the border.

### Item Style
- Customize the following settings:
  * **Border width and color:** Drag the slider to change the border width and click the color box to select a color.
  * **Corner radius:** Drag the slider to make the corners more round or square.
  * **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable or disable the shadow:
    - **Enabled:** The gallery item has a shadow around it. Customize the opacity, color, blur, shadow direction and shadow size.
    - **Disabled:** The gallery item does not have a shadow around it.
  * Choose what happens when someone hovers over the gallery item with their mouse:
    - **No effect**: No effect is applied to the hover.
    - **Zoom in**: Zooms in on the image on hover.
    - **Blur**: The image is blurred on hover.
    - **Grayscale**: The image becomes black and white on hover.
    - **Shrink**: The image gets smaller on hover.
    - **Invert**: The image color is inverted on hover.
    - **Color in**: The image turns from black and white to colorful on hover.
    - **Darken**: The image becomes slightly darker on hover.
  * Choose what happens while the image is loading:
    - **Blurred image**: A blurred version of the image appears while loading.
    - **Color placeholder**: A colored placeholder appears while the image is loading.

### Scroll Animations
**Note**: You can apply these effects to galleries that load as visitors scroll downwards (e.g. Collage, Masonry, Grid). **You cannot apply these effects to Slider galleries**.
- Choose what happens when visitors scroll through your gallery:
  * **No effect**: No effect is applied to the scroll.
  * **Fade in**: Images gradually appear during the scroll.
  * **Grayscale**: The image becomes black and white when scrolling.
  * **Slide up**: The image slides up when scrolling.
  * **Expand**: The image gets larger when scrolling.
  * **Shrink**: The image gets smaller when scrolling.
  * **Zoom out**: The image zooms out when scrolling.
  * **One color**: A single color is applied to the images when scrolling.

### Tip
While you are customizing the hover view, you can see it on the Pro Gallery in your editor. Click **Exit Hover Preview** to go back to the regular Pro Gallery view.

question: How can I manually create a 301 redirect for a page on my Wix site?
answer:
To manually create a 301 redirect for a page on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your SEO Dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO).
2. Select **Go to URL Redirect Manager** under **Tools and settings**.
3. Click **+ New Redirect**.
4. Select **Single redirect**.
5. Enter the old URL path you want to redirect from (e.g., /about-us) under **Old URL**.
6. Enter the new URL that you want to redirect to:
   * **For pages on your site:** Start typing the URL slug of your new page and select it from the drop-down.
   * **For external pages:** Enter the entire URL that you want to redirect to.
7. Click **Save**, or click **Save & Add Another** to add more.

### Tip
Once you've added the redirect, hover over it in the list to see options to [edit it](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site#editing-a-301-redirect), [view it live](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site#viewing-a-301-redirect) to check it's set up correctly, or [delete it](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site#deleting-a-301-redirect) if needed.

question: Is there an automatic tool to import products from other eCommerce platforms into Wix Stores?
answer: Currently, there is no way to automatically import products from other eCommerce platforms (e.g. Shopify) into Wix Stores. You can, however, export your products from another platform to a CSV file. You can then [import the products into Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-importing-products-to-wix-stores) after making the necessary adjustments. Additionally, you can [use the Cart2Cart third-party-app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-migrating-from-other-ecommerce-platforms-to-wix-stores) to migrate from another platform to Wix Stores.

question: How can I claim and apply a voucher after upgrading to a yearly or multi-year site plan?
answer:
To claim a voucher, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Premium Vouchers](http://www.wix.com/wix/api/voucherConsole?referralAdditionalInfo=%7Btheir) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Claim Voucher** or **Get Your Domain** next to the voucher you want to claim.

Once you've claimed your voucher, you can apply it by following these steps:

1. [Go to Premium Vouchers](http://www.wix.com/wix/api/voucherConsole?referralAdditionalInfo=%7Btheir) in your Wix account.

question: Can I exclude specific products from shipping to a certain region in Wix Stores?
answer: Currently, when you set up shipping to a certain region in Wix Stores, all products can be shipped to that region. It is not possible to exclude a specific product.

question: How can I cancel a client's plan myself using the Wix dashboard?
answer:
To cancel a client's plan yourself, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Subscriptions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Subscriptions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/subscriptions) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant plan.
3. Click **Manage Subscription.**
4. Select **Cancel Subscription**.
5. Select when the cancellation takes effect:
   * **Cancel at end of this billing period:** Plan continues until end of current payment cycle (for example, until the end of the month for a monthly plan). The plan does not renew.
   * **Cancel immediately:** Client's access to services stops immediately.
6. Click **Yes, Cancel**.

**Important:** Canceling a plan does not refund it. You must contact your payment provider to issue a refund.

**Tip:** You can undo cancelations for plans with the "Pending cancelation" status. If you undo the cancelation, the status of the plan returns to "Active".

question: How do I set up an HP terminal receipt printer for my Wix Retail POS system?
answer:
To set up an HP receipt printer for your Wix Retail POS system, follow these steps:

1. **Insert the paper roll:**
   - Make sure to unplug the printer to turn it off.
   - Turn the top of the printer counterclockwise.
   - Open the compartment cover.
   - Place the paper roll in the compartment. **Important:** Make sure the thermal side is exposed.
   - Pull the paper enough so that a bit of paper sticks out when you close the compartment. **Important:** Make sure the paper is tightly rolled.
   - Press the compartment cover to close it until it clicks into place.
   - Turn the top of the printer clockwise.

2. **Connect the printer:**
   - Using the cables supplied with the printer, connect the printer to the tablet and the cash drawer.

3. **Verify that the printer is connected:**
   - Open the POS tablet.
   - Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
   - Tap **Settings**.
   - Scroll down and tap **Manage Hardware**.
   - Check the status next to **Receipt Printer**. If the printer is connected properly, the status should read **Connected**. **Tip:** The light on the printer should be green.
   - Press the paper feed button to prepare for printing.

4. **Connect the printer to the tablet and cash drawer (if you have one) and check in the hardware settings to see that it's connected properly.**

question: Can I limit the number of dishes a customer can order from a specific menu section in Wix Restaurants?
answer: Currently, you can't limit the number of dishes a customer can order from a specific menu section (e.g. only 2 appetizers per order).

question: How can I customize the main portfolio page in Wix Portfolio?
answer:
To customize the main portfolio page in Wix Portfolio, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Portfolio Pages** and select the **Portfolio** page.
3. Click the Portfolio Page element in your editor.
4. Choose what you want to do:

### Edit Portfolio page background
1. Click the **Design** icon on the Portfolio Page element.
2. Select **Background**.
3. Customize the portfolio page's background color and opacity, border, corners, and shadow.

### Set the stretch settings
You can keep the portfolio page element stretched to the width of your site or set it to appear only within the Editor's [gridlines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-working-with-the-editor-gridlines).

1. Click the **Stretch** icon on the Portfolio Page element.
2. Click the toggle to choose the width of the element:
   * **Enabled:** The Portfolio Page element stretches to fill the width of your site. Use the **Margins** slider to set the distance between the edges of your site and the element.
   * **Disabled:** The Portfolio Page element appears within the Editor's gridlines and doesn't fill the width of your site.

### Edit the portfolio gallery
1. Click the Portfolio Gallery element in your Editor.
2. Choose what you want to edit:
   * **Layout:** Click **Layout**, choose a layout type and click **Customize Layout** to make further changes including gallery direction and scroll direction.
   * **Behaviors:** Click the **Behaviors** icon and set the video play options.
   * **Design:** Click the **Design** icon. Then click the **What do you want to design?** drop-down to choose which part of the gallery you want to design. Choose from the following settings to customize the design: **Regular** or **Hover** state, **Background fills**, **Borders**, **Shadows**, and **Corners**.
   * **Animation:** Click the **Animation** icon and customize the effect visitors see when they hover over a gallery item or scroll down the page.

### Change the order your collections display on the portfolio page
1. Click **Manage Collections**.
2. Drag and drop your collections to change the order they appear in your portfolio.

question: How can I customize the member login form on my Wix site?
answer:
To customize the member login form on your Wix site, you can follow these steps:

1. **Customize the Background and Design**: You can change the background and overall design of the login form to match your site's aesthetic.
2. **Add Elements**: Tailor the form by adding elements that suit your needs.
3. **Tailor the Fields**: Customize the fields to collect the information you require from your members.
4. **Social Login Options**: Choose whether or not to display the option to log in with Facebook or Google.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the [Customize the member login form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-creating-a-custom-login-form-for-your-members-area) guide.

question: How can I connect my Wix site to the Meta Pixel & CAPI integration?
answer:
To connect your Wix site to the Meta Pixel & CAPI integration, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Marketing Integrations](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmarketing-integration%3FreferralInfo%3Dmarketing_integrations_article_link&title=Marketing%20Integrations&buttonText=Add%20Integrations) in your site's dashboard.

question: Does Wix Bookings support setting appointments with true 24/7 availability?
answer: Wix Bookings currently does not support setting appointments with true 24/7 availability. However, as a workaround, you can set each day from 00:00 to 00:00 (+1 day) both as [default hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-default-work-hours) and for [staff hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-editing-your-staff-members-working-hours). **Note:** Setting hours from 00:00 to 23:59 leaves one minute unaccounted for and can cause issues with availability.

question: Can customers book a table at my restaurant using the Wix member apps?
answer: Yes, your customers can now [book a table at your restaurant on the Wix member apps (Spaces or your own branded app)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-member-apps-adding-business-elements-to-your-app#faqs).

question: Is it possible to change a gallery image on hover in the Wix Pro Gallery?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to have a different image appear when hovering over a gallery item in the Wix Pro Gallery.

question: Can I manage and allocate rooms and other resources for my services in Wix Bookings?
answer: We are excited to announce that you can now [manage and allocate rooms and other resources for your services](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-managing-your-resources).

question: Is it possible to automatically create a gallery page that shows a clickable image for each store category in Wix Stores?
answer:
Currently, it's not possible to automatically create a gallery page that shows a clickable image for each store category – unless you do it using the [Wix CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-content-management-system-an-overview).

### Workarounds
* You can display store categories using the [Category page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-about-the-category-page).
* You can [manually create an index of product categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-an-index-of-product-categories).
* You can use the CMS (Content Management System) to display all your categories on one page. Learn how to:

  + [Display your Wix Stores categories in a repeater, gallery, or table on any page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-your-wix-stores-categories-on-any-page) such as your Home or Cart page.
  + [Display your Wix Stores categories on a dynamic list page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-your-wix-stores-product-categories-on-a-dynamic-list-page).

question: How can I create an automation for a new Wix Form to send a thank you email after a form submission?
answer:
To create an automation for a new Wix Form to send a thank you email after a form submission, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation**.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. In the **Trigger** section, click **Wix Forms** (blue icon).
6. Select **Form submitted** under **Select a trigger**.
   - Choose **Any** or **Specific** forms to trigger this automation.
7. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   - **Don't limit (trigger every time)**
   - **Once per contact**
   - **Once per contact every 24hrs**
8. (Optional) [Add a delay](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-3-optional-add-a-delay) between a trigger and its action.
9. (Optional) [Add a condition](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-4-optional-add-a-condition).
10. [Choose an action](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-5-choose-an-action) and select **Send an email**.
11. Customize the sender details, email template, and email type.
12. (Optional) Add a chain of [follow-up actions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-multi-action-automation).
13. Click **Activate** to save and activate the automation.

Tip: You can send an automated email when a site visitor submits a form, and customize the sender details, email template, and email type. Learn more about [sending automated emails](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-sending-automated-emails-to-contacts-after-form-submissions).

question: Can I translate Google Maps using Wix Multilingual?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to translate [Google Maps](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-google-maps) with Wix Multilingual.

question: Can I customize the style, fonts, and colors of my Wix Blog in ADI?
answer: Currently, the Wix Blog has been designed to match your site perfectly in ADI and for that reason there are not many customization options available inside ADI. question: How do I create my first online program using ADI?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added Online Programs to your site as described in Step 1.

To create your first online program, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Online Programs](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Online%20Programs&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/challenges/list) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create New** at the top right.
3. Pick a program template with pre-filled content or click **Start Fresh** to create a program from scratch.
4. Fill in your online program's basic information as well as its pacing, timing, and duration. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-creating-a-new-program) about how to create a program.
5. Click **Continue.**
6. Add content to your program such as sections and steps. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-adding-sections-and-steps-to-your-program)
7. When you're finished adding content, click **Publish** to publish your program and make it possible for participants to join.

**Tip:** You can also get to Online Programs in your dashboard by selecting the Online Programs element in the ADI Builder and clicking **Manage**.

question: Can I customize the timing, design, and content of the Wix Reviews request email sent to customers?
answer: Yes, it's now possible to make changes to the timing, design, and content of the Wix Reviews request email sent to customers. Learn how to [customize the review request email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-setting-up-wix-reviews#step-3-optional-customize-review-requests).

question: What are the steps to set up Facebook Ads with Wix for a campaign aimed at getting more store orders?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have admin permissions for the Facebook page and Business Manager, have published your Wix site, upgraded to a Premium plan, and connected a domain.

### Steps to Set Up Facebook Ads with Wix for 'Get More Store Orders' Campaign

1. **Connect an Online Payment Method**
   - Make sure your site is eligible to accept online payments by connecting a payment method. This is essential for campaigns with the goal of 'getting more store orders'.
   - [Learn more about accepting payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-an-overview).

2. **Have Products in Stock**
   - Ensure you have added products to your online store. To do this, go to the Products page in your site's dashboard and click **+New Product**.
   - [Learn how to create a physical product](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-a-physical-product).

### What's Next?
Once your site meets all the requirements, go to the Facebook Ads dashboard and [create your first campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-creating-a-new-campaign).

question: What should I do if my Wix Video is pausing or skipping during playback for both me and my site visitors?
answer: If your Wix Video is pausing or skipping during playback for both you and your site visitors, follow the troubleshooting steps in the [Wix Technical Assistant guide](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-technical-assistant). If issues still persist after following all the troubleshooting steps, delete and re-upload the video to your video library. Learn more about [deleting](https://support.wix.com/en/article/deleting-a-video-from-your-wix-video-library) and [uploading](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-video-adding-videos-to-your-video-library) videos to your video library. If the video is from an external platform (e.g. YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook), disable all privacy settings before trying to embed. Learn more about [troubleshooting issues with external videos](https://support.wix.com/en/article/troubleshooting-issues-with-external-videos-in-wix-video).

question: How can I add an info section to a single product in Wix Stores?
answer:
To add an info section to a single product in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.

3. Click **+ Add an Info Section**.
4. Enter the info section title.
5. Enter the relevant information and use the text editing toolbar to format the text.
6. Click **Save**.

question: Can I add an app-ads.txt file to my site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add an app-ads.txt file to your site. The app-ads.txt file works like an ads.txt file for mobile apps. Adding this file would let you identify the digital sellers that you've authorized to sell your products. [Learn more about app-ads.txt](https://www.app-ads-txt.com/)

question: How can I add and set up a social bar on my mobile site using Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the Wix mobile Editor.

To add and set up a social bar on your mobile site using Wix Editor, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add a social bar to your mobile site
1. Click **Add** on the left side of the [mobile Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-accessing-the-mobile-editor).
2. Click **Social**.
3. Select the social bar you want to use or click and drag it onto your page.

### Step 2 | Customize the design of your social bar
1. Click your social bar in the mobile Editor.
2. Click **Set Social Links**.
3. Click the icon you would like to change.
4. Click **Replace Icon** on the right side of the panel and do one of the following:
   * Click an option under **Explore** to select an icon available from Wix, Shutterstock, or Unsplash.
   * Click **Site Files** to use an image you have previously uploaded to your site.
   * Click **Upload Media** to upload a file from your device, and use it as your icon.

**Tips:**
* Click **+ Add Icons** to add more social icons to the bar.
* Hover over an icon and click the Remove Image icon to delete it.

### Step 3 | Connect your social media accounts
1. Click your social bar in the mobile Editor.
2. Click **Set Social Links**.
3. Click the icon you want to connect.
4. Click the field under **What social page does this icon link to?** on the right.
5. Select **Web Address**.
6. Enter the URL of your social media account in the **What's the web address (URL)** field.
7. Choose how you want the link to open: **New window** or **Current window**.
8. Click **Done**.
9. Repeat steps **3-8** for all of your icons.

### Step 4 | Adjust the layout of your social bar
1. Click your social bar in the mobile Editor.
2. Click the Layout icon.
3. Adjust the layout using the following options:
   * **Icon size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of the icons.
   * **Spacing:** Use the slider to make the spacing between icons smaller or bigger.
   * **How does the bar look?:** Select whether the bar is displayed horizontally or vertically.

question: How can I add the Program List Add-On to my site using the Wix Editor?
answer:

question: How can I add a cover image to my Wix blog post?
answer:
To add a cover image to a post in Wix Blog, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog) in your dashboard.
