question: Can I connect my site's navigation menu to the CMS to automatically display content and links from my collection items?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to connect your site's navigation menu to the CMS (Content Management System) to automatically display content and links from your collection items. This would allow you to replace your site menu's titles and links with text and links from your collection fields.

You can, however, add links to your site's menu that navigate to any of your dynamic pages. Learn how to [link your menu to dynamic pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-linking-to-dynamic-pages#linking-your-site-menu-to-dynamic-pages).

question: Can I choose a custom favicon for the Wix Editor that I see on my browser while working on my site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to choose a custom favicon for the Wix Editor that you would see on your browser while working on your site. However, you can [upload and use a custom favicon on your live site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-your-favicon).

question: How can I add an anchor to my site menu in Wix Editor for a one-page site?
answer:
To add an anchor to your site menu in Wix Editor for a one-page site, follow these steps:

1. [Add an anchor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-renaming-and-deleting-an-anchor) to your site.
2. Drag the anchor to the top of a page section.
3. [Change the name of the anchor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-renaming-and-deleting-an-anchor#renaming-an-anchor) to something that describes the content (e.g. "About" or "Services").

question: How can I customize the default member signup form in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the default member signup form in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Signup & Login**.
3. Click **Member Signup Form (Default)**.
4. Go through the tabs one by one to set up the signup form:
   
   #### General tab
   
   1. Choose which option appears first in the signup window:
      
      * **New member signup:** The signup option is displayed first.
      * **Existing member login:** The login option is displayed first.
   2. Click **Additional Signup & Login Settings** to [manage who can become a member](https://support.wix.com/en/article/managing-signup-login-and-security-settings-for-your-site-members#controlling-who-can-be-a-site-member).
   
   #### Social & Community tab
   
   Choose whether or not to allow new members to sign up using their Google or Facebook credentials. If you have a social app (e.g., Wix Blog, Wix Forum) installed on your site, there are additional settings to decide on:
   
   * **Signup privacy footnote customization**:
     
     + **Footnote only:** Members are informed that they are signing up with a public profile; They can't choose to make it private.
     + **Checkbox:** Members can choose the privacy level of their profile.
   * **Sign up to this site with a public profile:** Choose whether or not a member's profile is public by default.
   
   #### Policies tab
   
   Decide if you want to include links to your site's terms of use and privacy policy. After enabling either one of the toggles, click the Link icon to set it up.

question: How can I export my Figma designs to Wix Studio using the Wix Studio plugin?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that custom fonts are uploaded to Wix Studio and the Figma frame width matches the editing size in Wix Studio.

To export your Figma designs to Wix Studio using the Wix Studio plugin, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Prepare for the export
- Upload custom fonts to Wix Studio to avoid system fonts replacing your intended fonts.
- Compare the frame width in Figma to the editing size in Wix Studio to ensure the design appears in the right proportions.

### Step 2 | Install the plugin and connect the Figma file
#### a | Install the plugin on Figma
1. Go to the [Figma to Wix studio](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/987294632651817123/figma-to-wix-studio) plugin page.
2. Add the plugin to your Figma account.
3. Open the Figma file that contains the frame you want to export.
4. Copy the URL of your Figma file.

#### b | Connect the Figma file to your client's site
1. Go to your client's site in the editor.
2. Click the **Wix Studio** icon at the top left.
3. Hover over **Tools**.
4. Click **Import from Figma**.
5. Paste the URL of your **Figma file** and click **Connect**.
6. (First time only) Click **Allow access** to finish connecting the file.

### Step 3 | Choose what to export from Figma
1. Open the relevant Figma file.
2. Access the Studio plugin:
   - Click the **Figma** icon to open the main menu.
   - Hover over **Plugins** and click **Figma to Wix Studio**.
3. Click **Set up Export**.
4. Select the **I'm done connecting my file** checkbox and click **Next**.
5. Verify that the editing size in Wix Studio matches the Figma frame width. When ready, click **Start Export**.
6. Choose what to export and follow the steps:
   - **Styles**: Select frames that include all the colors and fonts that should be exported. Review the styles before exporting and click **Export Styles**.
   - **Frame**: Click the frame you want to export. Double-check it matches the editing size in the editor and click **Export Frame**.

### Step 4 | Complete the import in the editor
1. Go to your client's site in the editor.
2. (If not already open) Click the **Import from Figma** icon on the left.
3. Depending on what you're importing, follow the steps below:
   - **Styles**: Review the colors and fonts, upload missing fonts, and click **Apply Styles to Site**.
   - **Frame**: Review the frame, upload missing fonts, match editing size if needed, select the relevant option next to **Add frame as**, and click **Add**.

Enhance your Figma design by adjusting responsiveness, adding animations, connecting business solutions, and linking elements with the CMS.

question: How can I add and set up the Wix Tips app on my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have updated to the latest version of the Wix Tips app and uninstall the old version if necessary.

### Step 1 | Add Wix Tips to your site
You can add Wix Tips to your site directly from the Wix App Market. This app only works with e-commerce apps such as Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, and Wix Restaurant Orders.

#### To add Wix Tips to your site:
1. [Go to the Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market).
2. Type "Wix Tips" in the search bar and select **Wix Tips** from the drop-down menu.
3. Click **Add to Site**.
4. Click **OK**.

### Step 2 | Activate the app and customize the settings
In order to start accepting tips, you need to activate the app in your dashboard and customize the settings. You can customize the tip options according to your needs by charging tips based on percentages or amounts.

#### To activate the app and customize the settings:
1. Click **Get Started**.
2. Click the **Enable tips at checkout** toggle.
3. Choose how you want to accept tips:
   * **Percentage:** Set your tips to be a percentage of the total order amount.
   * **Fixed amount:** Offer fixed amount tips, e.g. $2.00 or $5.00.
4. Click the **Let customers leave custom tip amounts** toggle:
   * **Enabled:** Customers can enter their own tip amount.
   * **Disabled:** Customers do not have the option to enter their own tip amount.
5. Click **Save**.
6. Click **Add** to activate Wix Tips on your site.

### Step 3 | Track your tip analytics
Once you have the app installed on your site, it automatically syncs with the "Sales over Time" report so that you can track and monitor the tips given by your customers.

#### To track analytics for your tips:
1. [Go to Analytics and Reports](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Analytics%20Reports&actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fanalytics/reports/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Reports**.
3. Click **Sales over Time**.

question: How can I resolve the Google Workspace error message 'You do not have access to Email' when accessing my business email purchased from Wix?
answer:
To resolve the Google Workspace error message 'You do not have access to Email,' you need to ensure that your domain has been verified with Google and that the Gmail app is active. Follow these steps:

### Verify Your Domain using a TXT Record
1. Sign into your [Google Admin Console](http://admin.google.com/).
2. Click **Domains**. 
   
   **Note**: (If hidden) Click **More Controls** at the bottom of your Admin console and select **Domains**.
3. Click **Manage Domains**.
4. Click **Set up Admin Console** next to the domain you would like to verify. 
   
   **Note:** If your domain isn't listed, click **Add a Domain** to add a new domain.
5. Click **Next** and then **Continue** to choose TXT verification.
6. Copy the TXT record.
7. Add the TXT record to your domain's [DNS records](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-or-updating-txt-records-in-your-wix-account) in the **TXT Value** field.
8. Click **Verify**. 
   
   **Note**: If you receive a message that your domain couldn't be verified, please wait at least 10 minutes and try again. It may take a few tries for your domain to be verified.

### Enable Your Gmail App from the Google Admin Console
1. Log into the [Google Admin Console](https://admin.google.com/).
2. Click on **Apps.**
3. Click on **Google Workspace.**
4. Select the **Gmail** app and click the **ON** button.
5. Click **Turn On** in the dialog box to confirm.

**Note:** Changes to Google Workspace apps can take up to 24 hours to propagate.

   * Select **Logo** and click **Add Your Logo** to add your logo.

15. Click **Next**.

question: How can I customize the view of a report in the Wix dashboard to focus on specific data?
answer:
To customize your view in a report on the Wix dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to All Reports](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Analytics%20Reports&actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fanalytics/reports/?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the relevant report.
3. Choose what you want to do:
   
   #### Change report dates
   Change report dates to get the data you need for a certain time period. You can choose between preset time periods (e.g. Last 7 Days, Previous Month) or choose a custom date range (e.g. January 1, 2023 to March 15, 2024).
   
   1. Under **Select a time period**, click **Last 30 Days**.
   2. Select a preset period or click **Custom** to create a custom date range.

   **Tip:** Click **More** to see more preset options.

   #### Add filters
   Filter your reports with advanced metrics to only see the data you need. For example, in sales reports you can choose to see only specific service types or payment methods.
   
   1. Click **More** next to the report options.
   
   **Tip:** The number next to it (e.g. 23) shows you how many filter options are available.
   2. Select the values next to the relevant filter to apply them to your report.

   **Note:** To remove values from the filter, uncheck the box next to the value name or click the X to remove them.

   #### Select a measure
   Select the value by which you'll be measuring the data. For example, in a Traffic over Time report you can choose to view the number of site sessions or the average session duration.
   
   Under **Select a measure** click the current measure displayed, then select a different measure in the drop-down.

   #### Group data by time period
   Group data in your chart view according to your preferred time unit. Under **Group by**, click **Day**, **Week**, or **Month** to change the report.

   #### (Table view) Add or remove data columns
   With the new table view, you can add or remove columns to only see the data you need. For example, tailor a report to only include customer details or orders and payment information. You can also drag columns to re-order the table.
   
   1. Click the **Table (New)** view at the top.
   2. Click **Customize**.
   3. Select the checkbox next to the column(s) you want to add.

   **Tip:** Deselect the checkbox to remove it from the table.
   4. (Optional) Drag and drop columns to reorder the table.

   #### (Bar Chart Split view) Split report data between different metrics
   With the bar chart split view, you can split the data to get a better look based on a specific metric you choose. For example, in the Traffic Over Time report, split data by visitor type to see how many new and returning visitors your site received each day.

   **Tip:** Hover over the report to view exact stats (e.g. the specific date and number of returning visitors).

question: Can I use a third-party SSL certificate with my Wix site?
answer: Currently, Wix does not support third-party [SSL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-ssl-and-https) certificates. All Wix sites are enabled with HTTPS, so are created with inbuilt SSL certification. We do not authenticate sites built elsewhere. Therefore, we are unable to generate [CSR](https://help.101domain.com/ssl-certificates/what-is-a-certificate-signing-request-csr) files (SSL authentication) for domains and subdomains connected to external sites.

question: How can I display collection content on my Wix site using the CMS?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have created a collection in the Wix CMS.

To display collection content on your Wix site using the CMS, follow these steps:

1. **Design your page**: Decide how you want to display your collection content. You can choose from the following page types:
   - **Static pages**: Connect elements like text, images, repeaters, or Pro Galleries to the CMS to display collection item contents. Note that there is a limit of 100 static pages per site. Learn how to [connect a dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset) to elements on your page.
   - **Dynamic list pages**: Show content from multiple items in a repeater, gallery, or table. Visitors can click an item to go to the item's dynamic item page for more info. Learn more about [setting up dynamic list pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-dynamic-list-page).
   - **Dynamic item pages**: Display details about an individual item. Each collection item has its own dynamic item page URL. Learn more about [setting up dynamic item pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-dynamic-item-page).
   - **Dynamic item pages for listing items by category**: Show 'categories' of items, where each category has its own version of the page. Learn more about [creating dynamic pages that list items by category](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-dynamic-pages-that-list-items-by-category%EF%BB%BF).
   - **Dynamic manage item pages**: (Studio Editor only) Allow site collaborators and specific site members to manage collection content directly from your live site. Learn more about [creating dynamic pages for managing content on your live site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-a-dynamic-page-for-editing-items-from-your-live-site).

2. **Connect page elements to a dataset**: After setting up the type of page you want to use, connect the relevant page elements to a dataset that reads your collection content. Learn how to [connect elements to a dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset).

3. **Manage the dataset settings**: Control how the dataset interacts with the site elements and collection content. Change the dataset mode to determine whether the dataset can read from your collection, write to it, or both. Set the "Maximum items displayed" number to control how many items can load at a time. Add filters to only show certain items in the connected elements. Choose the order in which the collection items appear by creating sort conditions. Learn how to [customize your dataset settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-and-setting-up-a-dataset#step-3-edit-the-dataset-settings).

4. **(Optional) Create 'Load More' or navigational buttons**: If you have a repeater or gallery set to show many items, consider adding a '[Load More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images#load-more)' button to improve the page's loading performance. Add [navigational buttons](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images#navigation-actions) or [pagination bars](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar) to help visitors navigate through various collection items.

5. **(Optional) Let visitors filter the content**: Allow visitors to view only items that match filters they apply based on the collection field values. Choose from input elements like **Radio Buttons**, **Checkboxes**, **Dropdown**, **Selection Tags**, or **Slider** (Range Sliders only). Learn how to set up [input elements that allow visitors to filter collection content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-setting-up-filters-for-site-visitors-using-input-elements).

- **Right to access.** [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/gdpr-about-your-customers-data#getting-a-copy-of-your-customers-data).

- **Right to opt-out of the sale of personal information.** [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-do-not-sell-data-link-to-your-wix-site).

question: What guidelines should I follow to avoid copyright infringement when adding content to my Wix site?
answer:
When adding content to your Wix site, it is important to ensure that you have the rights to use that content. Here are some guidelines to help keep your site and content safe from copyright complaints:

- **Videos:** You can add videos to your site that have been uploaded to YouTube or Vimeo. If you uploaded the video yourself, you are free to use it on your site. For other content available through these services, it is recommended to read through the [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms) and [Vimeo](http://vimeo.com/terms) Terms of Use thoroughly before adding anything.

- **Music:** Most music is protected by intellectual property rights. According to the Wix Terms of Use, you may not upload, post, email, transmit, or otherwise make available any content that might infringe a third party's intellectual property rights. It is your responsibility to ensure that you have permission to use any audio content on your site.

- **Text:** All text added to your site should be original, unique, and created by you. It is not permissible to copy text from another person's site.

- **Software:** Software may be protected by intellectual property rights. It is your responsibility to ensure that you have the relevant permission/license to disclose and/or make available any software on your site.

### Tip
Check out the Wix Content blog to learn more about [the legalities of writing online.](https://www.wix.com/blog/content-writing/2018/02/legal-and-marketing-writing-online/)

question: How can I upload and customize my own shape dividers in Wix Editor?
answer:

1. **Upload Your Custom Divider**: You can upload SVG files as shape dividers. Ensure your SVG file is no larger than 250KB, with a recommended width of 1920px and a height between 50-300px.

2. **Customize Your Divider**: After uploading, you can adjust the design to fit your needs. The SVG file must be a closed shape, contain only one level of opacity, and not include text, strokes, gradients, or filters.

3. **Change the Color**: You can only change the color of SVG files that are the color RGB = #000000 (black).

For more detailed customization options, refer to the [Wix Editor guide on adding and customizing shape dividers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-shape-dividers#customizing-a-custom-shape-divider).

question: How can I use my free 1-year domain voucher with Wix?
answer:
To use your free 1-year domain voucher with Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Buy a Domain**.
3. Type the domain you'd like to claim, including the domain extensions (e.g. .com) and click **Search**.
4. Click **Get It** if the domain is available. 
   
   **Tip:** If your domain is not available, you can claim one of the recommended alternatives or try searching for a different domain.
5. Choose a registration period and click **Continue**. 
   
   **Note:** Make sure the domain voucher is applied in the summary section at this point.
6. Enter (or edit) your contact information and click **Continue**.
7. Select a privacy option: 
   
   * **Full privacy protection:** Your contact details won't appear in the WHOIS domain information records. The voucher does not cover the cost of Private Registration.

question: How can I add my Wix Store products to my Google Merchant Center catalog?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Have a [Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan)
- Add [Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-about-wix-stores) on your site
- [Verify your site with Google](https://support.wix.com/en/article/verifying-your-site-with-google-search-console-5033765)

### Step 1 | Get your site's data feed
First, you need to get your site's data feed in the Marketing Integrations section of your site's dashboard.

#### To get your data feed:
1. [Go to Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmarketing-integration%3FreferralInfo%3Dmarketing_integrations_article_link&title=Marketing%20Integrations&buttonText=Add%20Integrations) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Connect** under **Google Merchant**.
3. Click **Get Data Feed**.
4. Click **Copy** to copy your data feed's URL.
5. Click **Close**.

### Step 2 | Create a feed in Google Merchant Center
Next, you need to create a new feed in your Google Merchant Center account and add your data feed. You can select the countries where you sell your products, choose the languages that you use, and set the update schedule for Google to check for product changes.

#### To create a feed:
1. Sign in to [your Google Merchant Center account](https://merchants.google.com/mc/overview).
2. Select **Products**.
3. Select **Feeds**.
4. Click the Add Primary Feed icon under **Primary Feeds**.
5. Select your country of sale and language.
6. (Optional) Click **Add** if you need to add more countries.
7. Select the [feed destinations](https://support.google.com/manufacturers/answer/7443550) for your products.
8. Click **Continue**.
9. Enter a name for your feed.
10. Select **Scheduled fetch** under **Choose how to set up your feed and connect your data to Merchant Center**.
11. Enter a name for your feed schedule.
12. Enter the fetch frequency and fetch time for your update schedule.
13. Paste your data feed URL in the **File URL** field.
14. Click **Create Feed**.
15. (Optional) Click **Fetch Now** to fetch your products and add them to your feed now.

### Important
Your products sync with your Merchant Center catalog feed according to the feed schedule that you create. This means that your products do not update in real time. You can manually trigger a sync at any time by clicking **Fetch Now** on the Feeds page.

question: Why is some of the text on my Wix Chat widget not appearing in the correct site language?
answer:
Some sites might experience an issue with some of the text on the Wix Chat widget not appearing in the correct site language. For example, this may affect the "Let's Chat", "We'll reply as soon as we can" (response time text), and the pre-chat form texts. 

### Workaround
1. In your site's dashboard, navigate to **Settings.**
2. Click on **Language & Region.**
3. Change the **Site language** to something different.
4. Click **Save** in the upper right.
5. Change the **Site language** back to the desired language.
6. Click **Save** in the upper right.

This should reset your site language and resolve the un-translated text.

question: How can I change the sharpness of images on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the sharpness of images on your Wix site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Settings** on the top bar of the Editor.
2. Click **Image Sharpening**.
3. Select a preset:
   * **None:** This removes all sharpening from your images. Select this option if your images look too sharp with another preset.
   * **Mild:** A subtle sharpening preset which is great for softer, natural scenes.
   * **Classic:** A great all-purpose preset, recommended for most types of images. This is the default setting on your site.
   * **Moderate**: This preset is good for showcasing products, interiors or landscapes.
   * **Strong:** Use this preset with images that are visibly out of focus or that contain sharply defined edges or industrial scenes.
   * **Max:** This is a good preset for images with text in them, like posters and banners.
4. Click **Apply**.

### Tip
Try different presets to see which one looks best on your site. If your images look too sharp, click **None** in step 3.

question: How can I create a video from my media files using Wix Media?
answer:
To create a video from your media files using Wix Media, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your Media Manager.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-accessing-the-media-manager)
2. Select the images or videos you want to use.

3. Click **Create a Video** on the right.
4. Customize your video by going through the design steps:
   
   * **Content:**
     
     + Click the **Add** icon **\+** to add more images or video clips to your video.
     + Add titles to your video:
       
       - **Opening Text:** This appears at the beginning of your video and should introduce the concept of the video.
       - **Second Text:** This text appears next. Use it to explain more about the video content.
       - **Third Text:** This text is the next to appear. It's a good idea to make this a call-to-action to explain what you would like the viewers to do, such as "Visit Our Store".

   * **Design:**
     
     + **Choose a Video Style:** Hover over the style options to preview them, and select one for your video.

     + **Choose Colors and Font:** Select 2 colors and a font to include in your video. The way they'll be incorporated depends on the chosen style.
   * **Music:** Select a music track for your video. 
     
     **Tip:** You can enable the **Music Off** toggle to remove music from the video.
   * **Business info:** Click the **Include info at the end of the video** toggle to enable or disable it. You can edit the info as needed.
5. Click **Apply & Preview** to see the finished product.

question: What is Wix's policy regarding repeat DMCA infringement and how can I avoid account termination?
answer:
Wix.com takes copyright violation very seriously and opposes any unauthorized infringement of intellectual property. To avoid the suspension or termination of your account, please read our policy carefully. As explained in our [Terms of Use](https://www.wix.com/about/terms-of-use), Wix respects the intellectual property rights of third parties. To uphold these rights, Wix may terminate or suspend the accounts of repeated copyright infringers.

It is our policy that you may not post content without appropriate permissions, or in a manner that violates third parties' copyrights or other intellectual property rights. If you do so, in accordance with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act ([DMCA](https://www.copyright.gov/legislation/dmca.pdf)) and other applicable laws, Wix may terminate or suspend your account.

**Circumstances for action may exist in the following cases:**

- If your site has been found (by a court of competent jurisdiction) to have infringed the copyrights of a third party on two or more occasions; or
- In other cases of repeated clear abuse of usage of Wix Services (e.g., willful commercial piracy, or malicious attempts to destroy the value of copyrighted works); or
- If we receive a notice of infringement and, as a result, content posted on your site is removed, it constitutes a copyright strike. If you get three copyright strikes for content in your account within a one-year period, your account may be terminated.

However, if you submit a counter-notification in response to the copyrights owner’s notice (within the timeframe and in the manner specified in our guidelines), and such counter-notice is not answered by the copyrights owner, we may cancel the respective strike. Likewise, if the copyright owner retracts their claim, we may withdraw the strike.

In addition, Wix reserves the right to terminate or suspend your account if Wix believes, in its sole judgment, that circumstances relating to the infringement of third party intellectual property rights justify such action.

question: How can I improve my site's performance when displaying a large amount of items on a repeater or table in Wix CMS?
answer:
To improve your site's performance when displaying a large amount of items on a repeater or table in Wix CMS, you can adjust the **Maximum items displayed** field in your dataset settings to [control the number of items that can load](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-the-maximum-items-displayed-in-your-dataset-settings) at a time. This helps you load your page faster with fewer items on the initial page load, reduce the number of larger items, and enhance your page's design.

Additionally, if you have a large amount of content to show on data-bound elements, it is recommended to limit the amount of items that are loaded at once, and add a “[Load More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images#load-more)” button or a [pagination bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar), which will load one batch of such items at a time. A good practice would be to show up to 10 items with every new load.

If your repeaters need to contain a lot of content or be connected to a large collection, consider using a deferred dataset. These datasets load the connected content only after the rest of the page loads, which can improve your site's performance. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-deferred-dataset).

If there is content in your collection that is not needed on your page, you can stop it from being displayed by [adding a filter to the dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-filters-and-sorts-to-datasets-to-control-live-site-content) and choosing what content to display.

question: How can I effectively test my Wix AI Chat Assistant before making it live on my site?
answer:
To effectively test your Wix AI Chat Assistant before making it live, follow these steps:

1. **Choose the right questions to ask:** Test the AI Chat Assistant's knowledge of your products and services in your site's dashboard. Think like a site visitor and ask questions about your products/services, booking availability, and pricing. Be specific with your questions to better evaluate the AI's responses.

2. **Tips for effective testing:**
   - **Vary your questions:** Try short questions and longer phrases. Ask about different products, pricing, contact information, etc.
   - **Be concise:** Use words your site visitors would use. Avoid technical terms.
   - **Try different formats:** Use a variety of full statements, yes/no questions, and open-ended questions.
   - **Know your site:** Look for areas of your site's content that need improvement. Ask questions about these areas to test whether the AI Chat Assistant can also spot them.

3. **Giving feedback:** For every answer the AI Chat Assistant gives you, choose whether it's a good response or not. Submit feedback to let us know how the answer could be improved. The more specific and understandable your feedback is, the more we can improve the AI Chat Assistant.

When you're satisfied with the AI Chat Assistant's performance, click the toggle at the top right of the page to set it as active.

question: How can I access and use the Comments panel in Editor X to manage site comments?
answer:
To access the Comments panel in Editor X, click the Comments icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2021/01/12/42d6707e-3ae0-434c-a49b-c8f9cdb4d174/352db1d4-1c96-45ae-8b4f-311c58b4de16.png) at the top right of Editor X. Each site page has its own comments panel, allowing comments to be page-specific. You can see who wrote the comments, when they were posted, and the number of replies if there's an ongoing discussion. If you were mentioned in a comment, you can access it directly from the email notification you received by clicking **View Comment**.

When writing a comment, you can:

- Make your text bold or underlined.
- Add a bulleted list.
- Add an image or a file for others to preview, add to the page, or download.

You can also enter the **@** symbol when typing up the comment to mention someone on your team.

The Comments panel allows you to filter comments using the drop-down menu at the top right of the panel:

- **Open:** Open comments that have not been resolved.
- **Resolved:** Comments that were already resolved.
- **My Comments:** Comments that are related to you directly, including both comments that you added and other comments that mention you.
- **Current Breakpoint:** Comments related only to the breakpoint you're currently viewing (e.g., desktop, mobile).

Next to each comment, there is an icon indicating the specific breakpoint the person commenting was reviewing at the time. Hover over the icon to see the exact pixel range of that breakpoint.

question: How can I customize the fields on my Wix site's checkout page to collect specific information from customers?
answer:
To customize checkout page fields on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Checkout Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Checkout%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/ecom-platform/checkout-settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Customize your checkout**.
3. Click **Edit** next to **Checkout form**.
4. Choose what to do next:

### Customize a default field
* **Phone:**
  
  1. Click the **Phone** field in the preview.
  2. Enable or disable the **Required field** toggle. 
  
  **Note:** If disabled, customers can complete checkout without entering a phone number.
* **Delivery details:**
  
  1. Click the group of fields under **Delivery details** field in the preview.
  2. Enable or disable the **Show "Address - line 2"** toggle.

**Tip:** The email and name fields have no customizations.

### Add a new custom field
1. Click the **Create field** on the left.
2. Select the type of field you want to add.
3. Customize the field using the available general and advanced customizations.

**Tip:** Get detailed instructions on [how to add and customize custom fields](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-and-customizing-checkout-form-fields).

**Notes:**
* Go to the order in the **Orders** tab to view what customers entered in custom fields.
* Customers who check out with PayPal do so in the PayPal dashboard, so they may not see custom fields that you added.

### Create a conditional rule
You can create rules that govern which fields are displayed on your form. For example, you can have a custom field asking if this is a business purchase. If the customer selects "Yes", you can then display additional relevant fields. Customers who answer "No" won't see these fields. Learn how to [add conditional rules to your checkout fields](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-conditional-rules-to-your-checkout-page-fields).

### If you added an Additional Info field before Feb. 2024
* If you added a custom field before we released advanced checkout forms, it will still appear on your live site. No need to update anything.
* You'll see the field in the new form composer, but without most of the customization options (e.g. without the option to add placeholder text). It appears next to your default fields.
* To customize fields added before Feb. 2024, delete the field and re-add it. Note that this cannot be undone.

question: How do I approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Booking.com?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.

To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Booking.com:

1. [Log in to the Booking.com extranet](http://admin.booking.com) with your username and password.
2. Click **Account** in the menu at the top.
3. Select **Connectivity Provider** from the drop-down.

   **Note:** If the Connectivity Provider option is not available on the page, contact Booking.com to make this option visible.

4. Click **Search**.
5. Enter "HotelRunner" in the **Search Provider** field.
6. Click **Connect** on the page that opens.
7. Select the relevant permissions you want to give Booking.com.

   **Note:** Reservations, rates and availability, guest reviews, and reporting boxes are mandatory to complete the connection.

question: Is it possible for additional gallery images to automatically display when scrolling down in Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, on some galleries your site visitors need to click "Show More" to view more images. There is no option for additional images to automatically be displayed when your site visitors scroll down.

question: How can I edit the cover information of my Wix photo album?
answer:
To edit your album's cover information, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Photo Albums](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fphotography-albums%2F&title=Select+a+Site&primaryButtonText=Manage+Photo+Albums) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage** next to the relevant album.
3. Click **Customize.**
4. Click **Media**.
5. Click **Change Photo** under **Album Cover**.
6. Upload the relevant image.
7. Click **Text**.
8. Click the **Cover** tab.
9. Edit your album info:
   
   * **Album title:** Click the text box to add or change the title of your album.
   * **Button text:** Click the text box to add or change the text of the button that appears on your album cover.
   * **More info:** Click the **More info** toggle to enable or disable it:
     
     + **Enabled:** An additional field is added to your album cover. Here you can add some relevant info about your album, e.g., the album date. 
       
       - Click the text box to add more info about your album.
     + **Disabled:** Additional information is not displayed on your album cover.
   * **Business info:** Click the **Business info** toggle to enable or disable it:
     
     + **Enabled:** You can choose to add a business name in the field provided below or add a logo to your album cover. **Note:** The logo should be 300 x 100 px. We recommend it to be in PNG format.
     + **Disabled:** Your Business name or logo is not displayed on your album cover.

### Note
The album name you choose is part of your photo album URL, for example: 
* **Free site:** https://mystunningwebsite.wixsite.com/**album-name**.
* **Premium site:** https://**album-name**.mystunningwebsite.com/

question: Can I disable the loading of low-resolution images before the high-resolution ones on my Wix site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to disable the loading of low-resolution images before the high-resolution ones on Wix sites. This behavior is consistent across all Wix sites and many other sites on the web. It allows site visitors to see more meaningful content faster without any performance cost.

question: Can I use Todo Pago as a payment provider on Wix?
answer: Currently, Wix does not offer Todo Pago as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through Todo Pago and arrange the payment offline.

question: How can I ensure that non-Latin characters in my contacts are imported correctly into Wix?
answer:
To ensure non-Latin characters are properly imported, your file must be saved as "comma-separated". Follow these steps:

1. Upload your CSV file to [Google Spreadsheets](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets).
2. Click **File**, then **Download As**.
3. Select **Comma-separated values**. 

**Note:** Do not open the file.
4. Import your contacts following [these instructions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-contacts-importing-contacts-by-uploading-a-csv-file).

answer: Currently, in Wix Blocks, widget API properties can only contain up to 2,000 characters. This feature would allow you to have text properties that are longer than 2,000 characters.

answer: Currently, it is not possible to automatically copy the design of a product gallery and apply it to a different product gallery.

question: Can I track how many people read and download PDFs using analytics?

question: Is Midtrans supported as a payment provider on Wix?
answer: Currently, Wix does not offer Midtrans as a payment provider. If you use the [manual payment method](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-manual-offline-payments), you can mention that you accept payments through Midtrans Payments and arrange the payment offline.

question: Is the feature to add a mandatory CPF/CNPJ checkout field for Brazilian orders supported when using PayPal, Apple Pay, or Google Pay?
answer: Currently, when customers checkout using certain payment methods, such as PayPal, Apple Pay, or Google Pay, they may bypass the custom fields you added to the Checkout Page. Customers who complete the checkout process on the page (i.e., without one of the payment methods mentioned above) will see any custom fields you add. Learn how to [add a custom field](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-the-checkout-page#customizing-the-info-collected-from-customers), such as a CPF/CNPJ field, to the Checkout Page.

question: How can I add a custom field to my Wix booking form?
answer:
To add a custom form field to your Wix booking form, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Booking Form](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Customize%20Booking%20Form&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/bookings-options/bookings-form-settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add custom field** at the bottom of the **Form Fields** section.
3. Choose from the following options:
   * **Short answer** (30 characters max): For quick questions without the need for too much detail, e.g. years of experience training.
   * **Paragraph** (255 characters max): For more specific information which might require an explanation, e.g. Health conditions your coaches might need to know before a session.
   * **Checkbox** (500 characters max): For even more detailed answers which may require clients to review policy information at your business.
4. (Optional) Select the **Make this a required field** checkbox to make the field mandatory.
5. Click the Save icon.
6. Click **Save Form**.

**Notes:**
* You can delete, duplicate, or edit your custom fields in your form at any time by clicking the icons on the right.
* Clients who book via the Wix member apps do not see custom form fields.
* If you [enabled SMS reminders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/sending-sms-reminders-to-clients-in-wix-bookings), a checkbox appears below the phone number field so clients can opt in.

question: How can I organize my FAQs into categories using the Wix FAQ app?
answer: Once you've created your FAQs, you can organize them into categories to make it easier for your visitors to find an answer to a question on a particular subject. For example, you might want to split your FAQs up into separate categories such as Delivery, Returns, and Refunds. You can choose which categories you want to display on your site. [Learn more about FAQ categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/working-with-categories-in-the-wix-faq-app).

question: Can I use Redeban as a payment provider on Wix?

question: Can I apply the colors and fonts from my Wix logo to an existing site?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to apply the colors and fonts you used in your logo to an existing site.

### Workaround
You can update your site manually [using your logo's Color Code Guide](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-downloading-your-logo-in-the-wix-logo-maker#reviewing-your-logo-color-guide), or you can [create a new branded site from the Brand Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-creating-a-branded-site-in-the-wix-logo-maker).

question: How can I crop or extend an image using the Wix Photo Studio?
answer:
To crop or extend an image using the Wix Photo Studio, follow these steps:

1. [Access the Photo Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-accessing-wix-photo-studio).
2. Click **Crop & Extend** on the left.
3. Choose to crop or extend your image using the options available.

### Crop
1. Click **Crop**.
2. Choose how to crop your image:
   * **Crop ratio:** Crop your image to a predefined size and ratio (e.g. 1:1, 9:16, 3:4).
     **Tip:** Select **portrait** or **landscape** orientation to change the ratio options.
   * **Image size (px):** Set the size your image will be cropped to, using the **Width** and **Height** fields.
     **Note:** The maximum image size is 3000px x 3000px.
   * **Free hand:** Manually drag the corners of the image with your mouse.
3. (Optional) Click **Upscale** to automatically improve the resolution of your image.
   **Note:** The maximum image width/height for upscaling is 2,000px. Upscaling your image may increase the size it appears on your site.
4. (Optional) Change your image orientation: **Rotate left**, **Rotate right**, **Flip horizontally** or **Flip vertically**.
5. Click **Save**.

### AI Extend
1. Click **AI Extend**.
2. Choose how to extend your image:
   * **Extend ratio:** Extend your image to a predefined size and ratio (e.g. 1:1, 9:16, 3:4).
     **Tip:** Select **portrait** or **landscape** orientation to change the ratio options.
   * **Image size (px):** Adjust the size of your image using the **Width** and **Height** fields.
   * **Free hand:** Manually drag the corners of the image with your mouse.
3. Click **AI Extend**.
4. (Optional) Click **Upscale** to automatically improve the resolution of your image.
   **Note:** The maximum image width/height for upscaling is 2,000px. Upscaling your image may increase the size it appears on your site.
5. (Optional) Change your image orientation: **Rotate left**, **Rotate right**, **Flip horizontally** or **Flip vertically**.
6. Click **Save**.

**Notes:**
* Your image can be extended up to 512px on each side, but the generated image should not be bigger than the maximum image size (3000px x 3000px).
* The minimum image size that can be extended is 64px x 64px.
* The image aspect ratio (i.e. ratio of the image's width to its height) should be within 2.5:1 and 1:2.5 to be able to extend the image.

question: How can I view and restore a previous version of my site in Editor X?
answer:
To view and restore a previous version of your site in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Site History panel](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-and-managing-your-site-history).
2. You will see all of your site's autosaved versions, each labeled by the date and time it was saved.
3. Hover over the version you want to use and click **Restore**.

question: How can I change the language of my Member's Area on my Wix site?
answer:
To change the language of your Member's Area on your Wix site, you need to change the language of your site from the dashboard in your Language & Region settings. Follow these steps:

1. [Go to Language & Region](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Regional%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsettings%2Flanguage-and-region%2F) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Site Language** drop-down and select the desired language.
3. Click **Save**.

Changing the language of your site automatically translates all Member's Area related widgets into the desired language (e.g., My Account, Profile, Events, My Orders, etc.). However, this doesn't change the member pages' names, which also appear on your [Member Menu](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-customizing-your-members-area#choosing-the-pages-in-your-members-area). To localize the pages' names, you can either rename each page individually from the Page Settings panel or change your Wix account's language.

question: Can I add multiple lines of text on a button in Wix Editor?

question: Can I print the class participant lists in Wix Bookings?
answer: Currently, the feature to print class participant lists in Wix Bookings is not implemented. However, you can [export the participant list of classes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-managing-the-participant-list-for-your-classes).

question: How can I upload photos from Lightroom Classic to my Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have Lightroom Classic installed on your computer.
- Make sure you have added your Wix Pro Gallery to your Wix site before uploading images.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Download the Wix Pro Gallery plugin
1. Click the Pro Gallery in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Advanced**.
4. Scroll down to Integrations and click **Download Now**.

*Note: The Wix Pro Gallery plugin is downloaded to your computer as a zip file, make sure to unzip it (double-click on the zip file in the folder).*

#### Step 2 | Install the Wix Pro Gallery plugin in Lightroom Classic
1. Open Lightroom Classic on your computer.
2. Click **File** at the top left.
3. Click **Plug-in manager**.
4. Click **Add**.
5. Search for the unzipped plug-in file you previously downloaded and select it.
6. Click **Add Plug-in**.
7. Click **Done**.

#### Step 3 | Authorize and sync Wix Pro Gallery with Lightroom Classic
1. Go to Publish Services in the Library Module of Lightroom Classic.
2. Click **Set Up** next to Wix Pro Gallery.
3. Click **Authorize** to continue using the plugin. 

*Note: This opens the Wix Login page.*
4. Log in to your Wix Account.
5. Once you’re logged in, go back to Lightroom Classic.
6. Select the Sync checkbox in the Publishing Manager window.
7. Click **Save**.

*Note: Make sure to publish all changes made in the Wix Pro Gallery plugin in Lightroom Classic before you click sync again, so you don't lose your work.*

#### Step 4 | Publish your photos from Lightroom Classic to your Wix Pro Gallery
1. Go to your Pro Gallery in Lightroom Classic.
2. Drag the photos you want to upload to your gallery.
3. Click **Publish** in Lightroom Classic. 

*Note: Once you click **Publish** in Lightroom Classic, the changes you made are applied and updated in your Wix Pro Gallery.*

question: How can I create a branded app using Wix and what are the steps involved?
answer:
To create a branded app using Wix, follow these steps:

1. **Design the Theme**: Start by designing your app's theme, login, and launch screens from your Wix account.

2. **Preview the App**: Download a free preview link of the app to your phone to see how it looks.

3. **Update Content**: Once you are satisfied with the design, update the content inside your app using the Wix mobile app.

4. **Upgrade to a Branded App Plan**: Upgrade to a Branded App plan to connect an Apple Developer and Google Developer account.

5. **Submit for Approval**: Submit your app for approval to go live in Apple's App Store and Google Play.

For more detailed guidance, you can learn more about [the process of creating a branded app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-the-process-of-creating-a-branded-app).

question: How can I add a 'View Shop' button to my Facebook shop using Wix Stores?
answer:
To add a "View Shop" button to your Facebook shop, follow these steps:

1. Switch to the profile associated with the business page.
2. Go to your Facebook business page.
3. Click the More Actions icon and select **Add Action Button**.
4. Click **Try it**.
5. Click **View Shop**.
6. Select **Shop on Facebook**.
7. Click **Next**.
8. Click **Save**.

### Tip
Instead of a **View Shop** button, you also have the option of adding a **Buy Now** button. Clicking this button sends customers directly to your Wix Store.

question: Can I use a membership form to gather information about participants before they register for my online program?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to use a membership form to gather information about participants before they register for your program. However, you can collect information from site visitors by [adding a membership form to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-form-on-your-site). This form does not connect directly to your Online Program registration.

question: How can I use a Wix Promo Code to save on a Yearly Premium Plan purchase?
answer:
To use a Wix Promo Code and save 10% on a participating Yearly Premium Plan purchase, follow these steps:

1. Visit the [Wix Promo Code page](https://www.wix.com/promo-code/coupons).
2. Select a participating Yearly Premium Plan (note that this does not include the Combo Premium Plan).
3. Apply the promo code during your first purchase to receive the discount.

Please note that this promotion is not valid for Editor X. For more details, you can check the [Wix Coupon Terms of Use](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-coupons-terms-and-conditions).

question: Can I add dynamic screens to my branded app?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add dynamic screens to your branded app. Dynamic screens, similar to [dynamic web pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages), allow content to be [displayed from a CMS (Content Management System) collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-managing-collection-content-from-your-live-site).

question: Can I add a custom cover to my Wix Video player on mobile?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add a custom cover for the mobile view of your Wix Video player.

question: How can I connect PayPlus as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect PayPlus as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to PayPlus.
4. Depending on whether you need to create a new PayPlus account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your API Key and Payment Page UID.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account
   1. Click [**Create PayPlus using Credit or Debit card account**](https://www.payplus.co.il/signup?ref=wix-signup).
   2. Register for a PayPlus merchant account.
   3. Once your merchant account is approved, return to this window (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

question: How can I add a new interaction to an element in Editor X?
answer:
To add a new interaction to an element in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Select the relevant element.
2. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
3. In the Inspector, click the **Interactions** tab.
4. Click **+ Add** under **Hover** / **Click**.
5. Create your [preset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-a-preset-interaction) or [custom](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-click-and-hover-interactions-beta) interaction.

question: How can I add an app to my Wix site that is not available in the Marketing Integrations or Wix App Market?
answer:
If there are apps you'd like to add which aren't displayed in [Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmarketing-integration%3FreferralInfo%3Dmarketing_integrations_article_link&title=Marketing%20Integrations&buttonText=Add%20Integrations) or [Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market), there are alternative ways to add them:

1. **Google Tag Manager**: You can integrate many popular solutions, such as Crazy Egg, Hotjar, and Pinterest using Google Tag Manager. [Learn how to add Google Tag Manager to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-your-google-tag-manager-account-to-your-wix-site).

2. **Custom Code**: Many popular applications provide a custom code snippet, which can be easily installed through your Wix dashboard. When you get a code snippet from a third party, they should give you instructions about where to place the code (head or body) and how to use it. The placement of your code is crucial for it to load and execute properly. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/embedding-custom-code-on-your-site).

3. **Velo Development Platform**: Velo is a development platform created by Wix which can be used to integrate any application to your Wix Site. To use Velo, you may wish to hire a professional at [Wix Marketplace](https://www.wix.com/marketplace). [Learn more about Velo](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-velo-by-wix).

question: How can I adjust the color contrast on my Wix site to improve accessibility?
answer:
To adjust the color contrast on your Wix site, you can use the [Accessibility Wizard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-about-the-accessibility-wizard-7284021) available in the Wix Editor. Here are the steps to adjust the contrast:

1. Select **Settings**.
2. Select **Accessibility Wizard**.
3. Select **Scan My Site**.
4. Select cards titled **Color contrast**.
5. Use the slider to adjust the text and background color.
6. Select **Apply Changes**.

This tool scans your site for potential accessibility issues and allows you to enable advanced settings to keep improving your site's accessibility.

question: What do the icons in the Wix Editor mean when I click on an element, and how can I use them?
answer:
When you click an element in your Wix Editor, you may see several icons, each with specific actions:

- **Settings**: Click to set up the element. The settings are different for each element.
- **Layout**: Click to change the layout of the element. The layouts are different for each element.
- **Design**: Click to design the element. The design options are different for each element.
- **Animate**: Click to [add animation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-an-animation) to the element.
- **Link**: Click to [add a link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/what-do-you-want-to-link-to) to the element.
- **More Actions**: Click to show more options.
- **Crop & Edit**: Click to [make changes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-editing-an-image-in-the-editor-or-with-wix-photo-studio) to your image.
- **Upgrade**: Click to upgrade the element/feature.
- **Help**: Click to learn more about the element or find an answer to a question you have.
- **Stretch Handle**: Click and drag to make the element longer or shorter. This icon appears on strips and pages.
- **Stretch**: Click this icon to stretch the element to either the full-width of your site, or within the gridlines. This icon appears on elements such as strips and galleries.
- **Accessibility**: Click to view and edit your attributes. This icon is only shown on elements that you have already added custom aria attributes to. [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-adding-aria-attributes-to-custom-web-applications)
- **Connect to Data**: Connect the element to content collections to display and collect data on your site. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-content-management-system-an-overview#compatible-elements)

The icons available depend on the element type and its settings.

question: How can I compare the performance of my email campaigns using the Wix Email Marketing dashboard?
answer:
To compare the performance of your email campaigns using the Wix Email Marketing dashboard, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Wix Email Marketing dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-about-your-email-marketing-dashboard).
2. Scroll down to the **Results** section.

The Wix Email Marketing Performance widget will appear once you've sent at least three email campaigns to a minimum of 10 contacts. The widget is made up of two tabs:

- **Emails:** Lets you compare the open and click rate for different email campaigns sent by email.
- **Views:** Lets you compare the Email and Web views for all published email campaigns.

question: Can I refund orders processed through additional payment providers directly from the Wix dashboard?
answer: Currently, it's possible to refund orders from your Wix dashboard only when the payment was processed through PayPal, Stripe, or Wix Payments. If another payment provider was used, you can still refund your customers using the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/refunding-payments-made-through-other-payment-providers), but you need to complete part of the process outside the Wix dashboard. When you complete the steps, the order in the Orders tab is updated to show the refund.

question: Can I store clients' credit card details on my Wix site?
answer:
You can [now save and store clients' credit card information on file on your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-saving-and-charging-clients-credit-cards). 

### Tip
Your clients can also save and re-use their credit card details when booking services on your site using the [My Wallet page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-about-the-my-wallet-page) in your Members Area.

question: Can I set separate availability for video conferencing appointments in Wix Bookings?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to add separate availability for video conferencing appointments only. For example, businesses offering consultation services both physically and virtually on different days or hours, cannot set separate availability settings for each.

### Workaround
You can [add virtual meetings as an additional location](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-offering-services-at-multiple-locations) and set the staff hours accordingly. We do not recommend this option for businesses with multiple physical locations, as it may complicate scheduling management and reporting.

question: Can I set a different email address specifically for approving site members when manual approval is enabled?
answer: Currently, all new member requests are sent to the email address in the [business information](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information) of the site. If you have manual approval enabled, then it is not possible to set a different email address specifically for approving site members.

question: Can I save my forum posts as drafts in Wix Forum?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to save forum posts in draft form.

question: Can I receive a PDF copy of form submissions in the email notification using Wix Forms?
answer: Currently, using [new Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-the-difference-between-the-new-and-old-wix-forms), the [notification email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-choosing-who-gets-notified-about-form-submissions) you get for form submissions does not include a PDF copy of the actual submission. question: What actions do I need to take to comply with the EU Consumer Rights Directive 2014 for my Wix Store?
answer:
To comply with the EU Consumer Rights Directive 2014 for your Wix Store, you need to take the following actions:

- **State the return policy on your site**: EU customers have 14 calendar days from the purchase date to return items for any reason. You can simply state this on your site.

- **Refund customers within 14 days of cancellation**: From the day of cancellation, you have 14 days to refund your customer. You can refund customers through your payment method.

- **Show the total cost of the purchase**: The Wix Stores format already includes this, so no action is required.

- **State who will be responsible for the cost of returning items**: At the time of sale, clearly state who will be responsible for the cost of returning items. You can simply state this on your site.

- **Provide a withdrawal form**: Add a contact form and customize it as a withdrawal form for canceling contracts and initiating returns.

- **Remove all pre-ticked boxes**: Ensure there are no pre-ticked boxes on your website that offer consumers extra services. No action is required if this is already the case.

Please note that this information is not legal advice. Consult with a legal professional for further information.

question: What should I do if I lost access to my Apple generated email address used for signing into my Wix account?
answer:
If you have used **an Apple generated email address**, and have lost access to the details, you will need to [manage your Apple ID](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT210426) to recover access. Once you have recovered access to your Apple generated email address, you will be able to sign into your Wix account.

### Note
Accounts created with an Apple generated email address will have automated emails, from Wix, forwarded to the email address that is associated with their Apple ID account.

question: Is there a way to apply updated site styles to all elements with existing design overrides in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, there's no option to "reset" all these elements simultaneously and apply the updated styles, disregarding the overrides. question: Can I add rotatable (360 degrees) images for products in Wix Stores?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add rotatable (360 degrees) images for products in Wix Stores.

question: Can I organize, sort, or group my email marketing campaigns in different ways on the Email Marketing dashboard?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to organize, sort or group your email campaigns in different ways. Your email campaigns are shown in chronological order on the [Email Marketing dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-about-your-email-marketing-dashboard).

question: How can I pin a post to the top of my blog feed using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To pin a post to the top of your blog feed using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages and Menu** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Blog Pages**.
3. Click **Blog** or click the name of your Blog page if you renamed it.
4. Click the Blog Post element in your editor.
5. Click **Settings**.
6. Click **Display**.
7. Select the checkbox next to **More actions menu**.

10. Go to the blog on your live site.
11. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant blog post.
12. Click **Pin to Feed**.

To unpin a post, follow the same steps and select **Unpin Post**.

question: Is it possible to add a 'print' button to my Wix site for visitors to print pages?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to download a printer-friendly version or add a "print" button to your site for your visitors to print pages. However, visitors can print your site pages using **Ctrl**+**P**, though they may lose some of the formatting and styles appearing on the site page. Visitors can also take screenshots of your site pages and print them from their desktop.

question: How can I change the currency for my multilingual site on Wix?
answer:
To change your site's currency on Wix, follow these steps:

1. Click **Settings** on the left of your Dashboard.
2. Click **Language & Region** in the General Settings section.
3. Scroll down to the **Site Currency** section.
4. Select a currency from the drop-down list.
5. Click **Save**.

Please note that the currency you choose will be the same across all language versions of your site. It is currently not possible to display a different currency per language version. If you would like this feature in the future, you can vote for it [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-request-different-currencies-per-language).

question: How can I add hashtags to my Wix blog posts to help readers find related content?
answer: To add hashtags to your Wix blog posts, simply write the hashtag symbol (\#) followed by the text with no spaces anywhere in your post. Once you publish your post, readers can click on a hashtag to get a list of blog posts with the same hashtag.

question: How can I add Instagram Videos to my Instagram Feed using the Wix app?
answer: To add Instagram Videos to your Instagram Feed using the Wix app, you need to ensure that your Instagram account is connected to the Instagram Feed app by Wix. Once connected, any Instagram Videos you add to your Instagram account will automatically appear in your Instagram Feed gallery on your site. Please note that it can take some time for your video to appear in your Instagram Feed gallery after you post it. Additionally, it is not currently possible to display Reels in the Instagram Feed app. You can [vote for this feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-displaying-your-reels-on-your-instagram-feed-app) if you would like to see it implemented in the future.

question: How can I connect Titre Restaurants Conecs as a payment method through Lyra on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Titre Restaurants Conecs as a payment method through Lyra on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Titre-Restaurants Conecs.
4. Depending on whether you need to create a new Lyra account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Key and ShopID.
   2. Click **Connect.**

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create Lyra Collect account**](https://lyra.com/fr/wix-onboarding-collect/).
   2. Fill in the sign up form and proceed with the Lyra account verification.
   3. Once the Lyra Collect account is approved, sign in to your Lyra account and retrieve your account credentials (Shop ID and Key).
   4. Return to this window (repeat steps 1-3) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

question: How can I create a free shipping coupon in Wix Stores?
answer:
To create a free shipping coupon in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Coupons](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+New Coupon**.
3. Select **Free Shipping**.
4. Enter the coupon code. 
   
   **Note:** This is the code customers enter.
5. Enter the name of the coupon. 
   
   **Note:** Appears in the cart page and dashboard.
6. Select an option from the **Apply to** drop-down:
   
   * **All orders:** The coupon can be used for any purchase.
   * **Minimum order subtotal:** The coupon can be used when the order subtotal is over a specific amount. Enter the amount.
7. Select the **Include subscriptions** checkbox to apply this coupon to [product subscriptions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-selling-product-subscriptions). 
   
   **Note:** Applies to every cycle (e.g. every month of a monthly subscription).
8. Select when the coupon is valid:
   
   1. Enter the start date.
   2. Enter the end date, or select the **Don't set an end date** checkbox.
9. (Optional) Select the checkboxes next to the limits you want to apply:
   
   * **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon:** Enter the total number of times the coupon can be used. 
     
     **Tip:** Multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually.
   * **Limit to one use per customer:** Each customer can use the coupon only once.
10. Click **Create Coupon**.

question: How can I create a post in a Wix group using the dashboard?
answer:
To create a post in a Wix group using the dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Groups](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Groups&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsocial-groups-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant group.
3. Click the **Posts** tab.
4. Click **Create Post**.
5. Enter the text of your post.
6. Customize your post by adding interactive content:
   - **Image** icon to add an image.
   - **Gallery** icon to add an image gallery.
   - **Video** icon to add a video. You can upload a video from your computer or paste a URL from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook.
   - **GIF** icon to add an animated GIF.
   - **File** icon to add a file from your desktop.
   - **Emoji** icon to add an emoji.
   - **Divider** icon to add a dividing line.
   - **Poll** icon to choose a poll type.
7. Add an event, service, or product:
   - **Events:** Click the **Wix Events** icon, select an event from your list, then click **Embed**.
   - **Bookings:** Click the **Wix Bookings** icon, select a service from your list, then click **Embed**.
   - **Stores:** Click the **Wix Stores** icon, select a product from your list, then click **Embed**.
8. Add social media:
   - **Instagram:** Click the **Instagram** icon, paste a link to your post, then click **Embed**.
   - **X:** Click the **X** icon and paste a link to the tweet you want to share, then click **Embed**.
   - **TikTok:** Click the **Instagram** icon and paste a link to a TikTok Video, then click **Embed**.
9. Add a call-to-action button:
   1. Click the **Button** icon.
   2. Click the newly added button in your post.
   3. Click the **Settings** icon.
   4. Enter the text you want to display.
   5. Paste the relevant link.
   6. (Optional) Customize more of the button's settings and designs.
   7. Click **Save**.
10. Add or edit a topic by clicking **Topics** on the left to [add an existing topic or to create a new one](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-managing-topics).
11. Monetize your post by clicking **Monetize** on the left to [connect Pricing Plans](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-connecting-a-pricing-plan-to-a-group) if you only want to share the post with members who have subscribed to the connected plan.
12. When your post is ready to share, click **Post**.

question: How can I upload files to my Wix Blog post, and what are the file size and type limitations?
answer:
To upload files in Wix Blog:

1. Go to the [Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog) tab on your site's dashboard.

6. Select the file you wish to upload.

### File Types and Limitations

- **Upload limit:** You can upload an unlimited number of files to a blog post, however, the maximum size for each file is 500 MB.
- **Supported File Types:** You can upload any of the following file types: .bmp, .gif, .ico, .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .svg, .tif, .tiff, .webp, .avi, .mpeg, .ogv, .ts, .webm, .3gp, .3g2, .aac, .mid, .midi, .oga, .opus, .wav, .weba, .3gp, 3g2 .css, .csv, .html, .html, .ics, .js, .mjs, .txt, .xml, .json, .azw, .azw3, .kfx, .bz2, .doc, .epub, .odp, .ods, .odt, .pdf, .zip, .7z, .ppt, .pptx, .tar, .xls and .xlsx

question: Can I buy templates from the Wix Marketplace if I am not in the US or Canada?
answer: Currently, buying templates from the Marketplace is only available in the US and Canada. We're working on expanding this capability to more regions in the coming weeks.

question: How can I add a mouse effect to an element in the Studio Editor?
answer:
To add a mouse effect to an element in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Select the relevant element.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
3. Click the **Animations and Effects** tab.
4. Click **Mouse Effects**, then click **\+ Add**.
5. Select an effect from the collection.
6. (Optional) Click **Adjust Animation** at the bottom to customize settings like direction, distance, and easing.

question: Can customers pre-order products in the Branded App?
answer: Currently in the [Branded App](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-an-overview), your app members cannot pre-order a product or service. They can only pay for a product once it is available for purchase in your online store.

question: How can I change the direction of subpages in a vertical menu using Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the direction of the subpages in a vertical menu:

1. Click your menu.
2. Click the **Layouts** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/369319e8-4f14-4815-88ad-6c66c26a6e47.png).

   * **To the left**: The [subpages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-creating-a-subpage-drop-down-menu) of your dropdown menu open to the left of the menu item.

question: Can I add a 'Pin to Pinterest' button to gallery images in Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, you cannot add the Pin to Pinterest button to gallery images.

question: How can I add a shape divider to a section in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add a shape divider:

2. Click the Shape Dividers icon.
3. Click the **Top** or **Bottom** tab to choose where to add the divider.
4. Select a divider to add to your section:
   
   * **Suggested designs:** Click one of the styles available in the panel.
   * **Additional designs offered by Wix:**
     
     1. Click **+ More Shapes**.

question: How can I edit the author name and image for a writer added through the Members Area in Wix Blog?
answer:
To edit the author name and image for a writer added through the Members Area in Wix Blog, follow these steps:

1. The writer needs to log in via the login bar on your live site.

   ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/13691038-5aa8-4672-9b95-348c0733cabc/2020/05/05/073d8289-b641-4d26-9f71-2df87b1a70de/d0522657-b2fb-48c9-9ad5-2aa2e365bf52.png)
