question: How can I manage individual invoices in Wix, such as editing or duplicating them?
answer:
To manage individual invoices in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Invoices](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Invoices&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/invoices/invoices/list?referralInfo=KB-Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant invoice.
3. Choose what you want to do:

### Preview
- Click **Preview** to see the invoice your customer will receive.

### Edit
- You can edit any of your invoices, as long as they are not marked as Paid or Void.
  1. Click **Edit**.
  2. Edit the relevant information.
  3. Select an option at the top right:
     - **Preview:** Click the **Preview** icon to see the invoice your customer will receive.
     - **Save & Close:** Save the revised invoice without sending it.
     - **Collect Payment:** Charge or record a payment that relates to this invoice.
     - **Send Invoice:** Send the revised invoice to your customer. First review or edit the content of the email your customer will receive. Click **Send** when you're ready to send.

### Duplicate
1. Click **Duplicate**.
2. (Optional) Make changes to the invoice.
3. Select an option at the top right:
   - **Preview:** Click the **Preview** icon to see the invoice your customer will receive.
   - **Save & Close:** Save the revised invoice without sending it.
   - **Collect Payment:** Charge or record a payment that relates to this invoice.
   - **Send Invoice:** Send the revised invoice to your customer. First review or edit the content of the email your customer will receive. Click **Send** when you're ready to send.

**Note:** The following details update automatically in the duplicated invoice:
- **Issue Date:** The issue date is the date the invoice was duplicated.
- **Due Date:** The due date is calculated based on your payment terms.
- **Invoice #:** The invoice is given a new invoice number.

question: How can I create a standard automatic discount in Wix Stores?
answer:
To create a standard automatic discount in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automatic Discounts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Discounts&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/discounts) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Create Discount**.
3. Select **Standard discount** and click **Continue**.

   **Tip:** The **Discount type** is preselected.
4. Enter the discount name.

   **Tip:** Customers see this name during checkout.
5. Select what the discount applies to:
   
   * **All products:** The discount applies to each product that a customer buys (i.e. applies to multiple products in the same order).
   * **Specific products:** Click to select one or more products that the discount can be applied to.
   * **Specific categories:** Click to select one or more categories that the discount can be applied to.
6. (Optional) Create minimum requirements for the discount to apply:
   
   * **Minimum quantity (e.g. buy 3 hats get $10 off):**
     
     1. Select the **Minimum quantity of items** checkbox.
     2. Enter the number of items.
   * **Minimum amount (e.g. spend $50 on hats and get $10 off):**
     
     1. Select the **Minimum order subtotal** checkbox.
     2. Enter the minimum amount.
7. Select the type of discount from the **What is the discount?** drop-down and enter the required percentage, amount, or price.

   **Note:** If you offer an **Amount off discount** (e.g. $10 off), it's applied to every relevant item in an order.
8. Select the date and time when the discount starts.
9. (Optional) Select the dates when the discount ends:

   **Note:** By default, the discount starts immediately and doesn't have an end.
10. Select where customers see the sale name and details.
11. Click **Save**.

answer:

question: How can I get started with the CMS in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To get started with the CMS in the Wix Editor:

1. [Go to your Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **CMS** on the left side of the Editor.
3. Click **Start Now** or **Add to site**.
4. Select an option:
   * **Start with a preset:** Choose and customize a layout that comes with a collection and dynamic pages. Learn more about [adding collection presets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-collection-presets).
   * **Start by adding content:** Start from scratch by [creating a collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection) and adding content to it.

### Tips

question: Is it possible to remove test data from Wix Analytics reports?
answer: Currently, it's not possible to remove data from Wix Analytics. However, if you can cancel test orders created in your Store Orders tab or in your Bookings calendar, it will be removed from your Sales reports. Please allow one hour for your reports to update.

question: Is it possible to add a menu to the Quick Action Bar in Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add a menu to your Quick Action Bar.

question: Can customers redeem loyalty points when purchasing Online Programs on Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible for customers to earn and redeem loyalty points when purchasing [Online Programs](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-an-overview).

question: Can I change or hide the loading bar in the Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to hide or edit the media loader bar that appears on your site when certain media items are loading (e.g. galleries, pictures and videos).

question: Does Wix Blocks support ready-made dashboard templates to manage app data?
answer: Currently in Wix Blocks, while you can build dashboard pages to manage your app's data and collections and have the freedom to design these pages, there is a lack of ready-made templates specifically tailored for displaying lists of data items and managing individual data items efficiently.

question: How can I add new members to my Wix group using the dashboard?
answer:
To add new members to your Wix group using the dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Groups](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Groups&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsocial-groups-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant group.
3. Click the **Members** tab.
4. Click **\+ Add Members** on the right.
5. Choose how you want to add members to your group: Send email invites, add existing site members, or copy a sharable link to send.

**Tip:** Add your group's invite link to an [email marketing campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-and-sending-a-campaign-from-start-to-finish) and send it to people you'd like to join your group.

question: Can I migrate my gallery content from an Editor gallery to a Wix Pro Gallery?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to migrate your gallery content in an [Editor gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-gallery) to a Wix Pro Gallery. If you want to switch to a Pro Gallery, you must add a Pro Gallery and [add your media to the gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-adding-media-to-the-gallery) manually.

question: How can I change the language of the Password Window in my Wix site?
answer:
To change the language of the Password Window in your Wix site, you need to change your site's language settings. Here are the steps to do so:

1. Go to your site's [Language and Region settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Regional%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsettings%2Flanguage-and-region%2F).
2. Click the dropdown menu under **Site language**.
3. Select the language for your site from the list.

Please note that these steps only apply to sites with one language. If you have added Multilingual to your site, it is [not possible to change your site's main language](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-request-changing-your-sites-main-language).

question: How can I manage video channels in the Wix app?
answer:

question: How can I add Wix Music to my site and choose music for the player?
answer:

Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor.

### Step 1 | Add Wix Music to your site
To add the Wix Music player to your site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

question: Can I accept manual payments for individual sales and rentals on Wix Video?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to accept manual payments for Wix Video individual sales and rentals.

### Tip
You can add manual payments to any channel subscriptions connected to pricing plans by adding clients to the plan and setting the payment requirements. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-video-connecting-a-pricing-plan-to-a-video-channel)

question: Can I display multiple images or videos in the Expand Mode of a gallery item in Wix Pro Gallery?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to add multiple images / videos to the Expand Mode of a gallery item, e.g., displaying different angles of a painting inside the Expand Mode.

### Workarounds
* You can [create a sub-gallery in a lightbox](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-creating-sub-galleries) and have this serve as an expand mode for your images / videos.
* [Create a Wix Portfolio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-portfolio-an-overview) with multiple images / videos under one project.

question: Is it possible to automatically align text boxes across repeaters in Wix Editor?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible for text boxes to automatically align across your repeaters. If one of the items contains more text than in other items, the text boxes may become misaligned. However, you can manually align the text by expanding text boxes in the items that have less text, so that the boxes are the same size.

### To expand a text box:
1. Click the text box with less text in the repeater item.
2. Drag the handles on the text box to the same size as the text box with more text.

question: How can I manage translations for my Wix Online Programs using the Translation Manager?
answer:
To manage translations for your Wix Online Programs using the Translation Manager, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Translation Manager](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/multilingual?&title=Translation%20Manager&buttonText=Go+To+Translation+Manager) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over **Online Programs** on the left and click on the relevant program type: **Scheduled programs** or **Self-paced programs**.
   
   **Note:** It is only possible to translate published and active programs.
3. Choose the relevant option:
   
   * **If you auto-translated your site:** Review the automated translations and edit if necessary.
   * **If you didn't use auto-translation:** Translate the custom fields and policies manually.
4. Click **Save and Publish**.

Please note that currently, it is not possible to override the Online Programs widget texts in secondary languages in your editor.

question: How can I customize the layout of my service page in Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the layout of your service page in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.

4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Layout** tab.

   * Choose the alignment for your header.

question: How can I archive a pricing plan on my Wix site?
answer:

question: What can I do now that the Blogger Feed App is no longer available on Wix?
answer: The Blogger Feed App has been retired from the Wix App Market and is no longer supported. question: How can I add a sidebar to my Wix Blog Post page?

question: How can I send a broadcast message to my clients using the Wix app?

question: How can I change the cover image for a YouTube video on my Wix site?
answer: The video's static image settings (the image which appears before your video begins to play) are determined by YouTube and cannot be changed from your Wix account. If you uploaded the video to YouTube, you can change the image from the video's **Advanced settings** tab in your [YouTube](http://www.youtube.com) account. Any updates to information or cover images for a video have to be done directly on YouTube. Click [here](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/72431?hl=en) for more information.

question: How can I set up a subdomain in my Wix account to connect to an external site?
answer:
To set up a subdomain in your Wix account to connect to an external site, follow these steps:

1. **Method of Primary (Root) Domain Connection**: Ensure your domain is a Wix domain or connected to Wix via name servers.
2. **Subdomain Destination**: The subdomain should be directed to an external (non-Wix) website, resource, or blog.
3. **Action Required**: Add the required DNS records in your Wix account. You can learn more about this process by visiting the following link: [connect a subdomain to an external site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-subdomain-to-an-external-resource).

By following these steps, you can successfully connect your subdomain to an external site.

question: Can I group several components together in a horizontal arrangement or stack in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently, in [Wix Blocks](https://support.wix.com/en/article/blocks-unboxed-a-quick-tour), it is not possible to group several components together in a horizontal arrangement or stack. This feature would allow you to align elements side-by-side in a single row, making it easier to create organized and visually appealing layouts.

question: How can I add custom functionality and interactions to my Wix site using Velo by Wix?
answer:
To add custom functionality and interactions to your Wix site using Velo by Wix, you can follow these steps:

1. **Coding**: Use Velo by Wix to add [JavaScript](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/java-script-velo/java-script-support) code to your site. Work with Wix's [APIs](https://www.wix.com/velo/reference/api-overview/introduction) to enhance your site's functionality and interactions.

2. **CSS Customization**: Add [CSS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/css-editing) to customize the look and feel of your site.

3. **Server-Side Runtime**: Velo provides a full server-side runtime system based on Node.js. You can export functions from the backend to the client-side using [web methods](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-wix-studio/wix-studio-about-web-methods).

4. **Development Environment**: Write your code in the Wix Editor, the VS-Code based [Wix IDE](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-wix-studio/wix-studio-about-the-wix-ide), or [integrate your site with GitHub](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/workspace-tools/developer-tools/git-integration-wix-cli/about-git-integration-wix-cli) and use your own tools.

By following these steps, you can effectively add custom functionality and interactions to your Wix site using Velo by Wix.

question: How can I set up shipping rates based on weight in Wix Stores?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure that any previous shipping and tax settings in a merchant account (e.g., PayPal) are removed.
- Create or select a shipping region.

### To set up a rate by weight rule:
1. Click the **Select how shipping is calculated** drop-down, and select **Rate By Weight**.
2. Enter a name in the **Shipping Option Name** field (e.g. Standard Shipping).
3. (Optional) Enter a time in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
4. Enter the top limit of the first weight range (e.g. enter 2 kg. to create a rule for 0 - 2 kg).
   
   **Note:** The top limit of the first weight range is automatically set as the bottom limit of the second weight range.
5. Enter the rate (shipping price) for the first weight range.
6. Enter the top limit of the second weight range (e.g. 4 kg.).
   
   **Note:** The last weight range is always "x" weight and up. To create more than 2 ranges, click **+Add Range**.
7. Enter the rate (shipping price) for the second weight range.
8. (Optional) Click **Add Range** to add another weight range and rate (up to 30 ranges).

question: What does 'Discovered - Currently Not Indexed' mean in Google Search Console, and how can I resolve this issue?
answer:
When checking your site's coverage status report in Google Search Console, you may see that Google has marked some of your URLs as **Discovered - Currently Not Indexed**. This means that Google found this page, but decided not to crawl it for search results at the moment. It doesn't necessarily mean that your page has errors. It may mean that Google decided that crawling this page would overload your site and rescheduled crawling for a later time. It can also mean that you need to improve the quality of the content on the page.

**Check the troubleshooting steps below to resolve the issue:**

* Confirm that the page can be indexed by Google by clicking **Test Live URL** in Google's [URL Inspection Tool](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9012289?hl=en#test_live_page).
* Make sure to organize your page's content and divide it into categories/sections with unique text that doesn't exist in other pages. Duplicate content (or very similar content) appearing on different pages of your site may prevent them from being indexed.
* See that your subpages incorporate your keywords organically and have a visible connection to them.

### Tip
[Learn more about optimizing your site's content for SEO.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-sites-content-for-seo)

question: How can I connect a text element to a CMS collection in the Wix Editor?

question: How can I add a new dynamic item page to an existing collection in Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have added the CMS to your site and have existing dynamic pages.

To add a new dynamic page:

1. **Add a blank dynamic page:**
   
   * In **Wix Editor**:
     1. Click **Menus & Pages** on the left side of the Editor.
     2. Click **Dynamic Pages** then click the Settings icon next to the collection you want to link your dynamic page to.
     3. Click **Add Dynamic Item Page**.
   
   * In **Editor X**:
     1. Click **Pages** in the top bar.
     2. Hover over the relevant group of dynamic pages and click the More Actions icon.
     3. Click **Add Dynamic Item Page**.

2. **Use the page URL to determine the content displayed on the page:**
   1. Click the More Actions icon next to the new page.
   2. Click **Settings**.
   3. Edit the fields under **What's the page URL?**

   A typical scenario for editing the page URL is to display items based on the 'Title' field in your collection. To do this, click **Add Field** and select **Title**. This setting uses the 'Title' field as a reference to give the page a unique URL. For example, to display an item that has 'Lasagne' in the 'Title' field of a collection called 'Recipes', the URL looks like this: `https://mystunningwebsite.com/food/recipes/lasagne`.

   **What if I have two items with the same name?** Each dynamic page needs a unique URL. In the case of two items with the same name, only the first item in the collection is displayed. Add a second field to give the URL an additional value, making each one unique. For example, if the collection of recipes also has a field called 'Type', you can use it to generate unique URLs for each item. After adding the extra field, the URLs might look like this: `https://mystunningwebsite.com/food/recipes/lasagne/meat` and `https://mystunningwebsite.com/food/recipes/lasagne/vegetarian`.

Read more about [creating a unique dynamic page URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-unique-dynamic-page-urls).

question: How can I create a recurring event in Wix Events?
answer:
To create a recurring event in Wix Events, follow these steps:

1. **Create a Template Event**: Start by creating a template event. You can add all your details, such as the tour name, image, description, location, etc., to the template and save it.

2. **Select Dates**: Next, select the dates when your event is held.

3. **Publish**: Once you click "Publish", each occurrence of the event becomes an individual event which you can edit to reflect changes if needed.

4. **Create New Event Dates**: You can create new event dates from the template at any time.

For more detailed instructions, you can [learn how to create a recurring event](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-a-recurring-event-2644272).

question: How can I export my orders from Wix and customize the data included in the export?
answer:
To export your orders from Wix and customize the data included, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Orders tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the orders you want to export:
   * Select the checkboxes next to the relevant order(s).
   * Choose the checkbox next to **Order** at the top left to select all orders.
3. Click **Export**.
4. Select how you want to display exported orders:
   * **Item purchased:** Each item purchased is displayed in a separate row, even if they are part of the same order.
   * **Orders:** Each order is displayed in one row, even if multiple items were purchased.
5. Deselect the columns that you do not want to include (e.g., deselect billing and payment columns if they are not relevant at the moment).
6. Save the file to your computer:
   * **Chrome**: The CSV file downloads and appears on the bottom of your screen.
   * **Firefox**: Select **Open with** to open or **Save File** to save.
   * **Internet Explorer**: Click **Save** at the bottom of your screen.
   * **Safari**: The file opens. Click **cmd + s** on your keyboard to save the file (with a .csv extension, and Page Source format).

**Note:** The time of purchase recorded in the CSV file is always given in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). For instance: January 01, 5.00PM (PST) = January 02, 1.00AM (UTC).

question: What should I do if my Wix site is reported for malware due to unapproved code?
answer:
If your Wix site is reported for malware due to unapproved code, follow these steps:

1. **Review the Code**: If you have added any code using the HTML app or Velo by Wix, please review the code to ensure that it comes from a trusted source.

2. **Remove Malicious Code**: If we detect that your site has malicious code, your site will be taken down immediately. Remove any unapproved or suspicious code from your site.

3. **Submit a Request**: Once you've removed the code, or if you feel that your site was reported in error, you can submit a request to be removed from the list of malware sites [here](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/168328?hl=en).

question: How can I create a clickable phone number on my Wix site using a text box?
answer:
To create a clickable phone number with a text box on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add** ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/zG-Jlqc8lm_xpyv9W7izYdvGKLy0hncRgrHSzpSokNEsNqxFpDfRAFyuZ7pflbEDujMKOe41pHVAGDm4QRaJZBGYwI5dbV1vNXfxe4JhrkCxIrZ_FWj4pxa0Q_1JlyH1dqEBbG3QOp4bEYeJOA) on the left side of the mobile or desktop Editor.
2. Click **Text**.
3. Select your chosen text box to add it to your site, or click and drag it to the relevant location.
4. Click the text box.
5. Click **Edit Text**.
6. Enter your phone number.

### Want to try it another way?
You can also create a clickable phone number by: 
* Connecting your phone number to a [Quick Action Bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-the-quick-action-bar-on-your-mobile-site) on your mobile site.
* [Linking your number to other elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-a-link-to-an-element) on your site (such as a button).

### Note
On iPhones and iPads, when a clickable phone number is tapped more than three times consecutively, the device blocks the ability to make the call.

question: How can I add an embed or custom element to my mobile site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To add an embed or custom element to your mobile site:

1. Click **Add** ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/2_Q3UWFeRrr5eTMMy5BcmnSAohKtI_dMraA_5NEO86PZzJ1C6RLZFszKuF-1mKgkvV4ee4eSdDzyvTbeogg8P5XGH8QMTpNCPtZMEWh1kJV1_Jk7RjMl4g4JvgeWtKfTBU5Wfg_V) on the left side of the mobile Editor.

question: Is it possible to transfer a storage plan to a different site in Wix Media Manager?
answer:
Yes, it is possible to transfer a storage plan to a different site in Wix Media Manager. Here are the steps to do so:

1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/be0b50df-801c-4d6d-b81c-dc49333eccac/2022/06/24/f2896db0-6cb2-4d7d-a329-72005f56fdbf/52ce80ef-7d09-44f5-96e3-e4662e2e9564.png) next to the relevant storage plan you want to transfer.

4. Select the site you want to transfer the storage to.
5. Click **Next**.
6. Click **Assign**.

question: How can I enable SMS reminders for my clients in Wix Bookings?
answer:
To enable SMS reminders in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Booking Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Booking%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Emails & SMS Reminders**.
3. Enable the **Session Reminders** toggle under **Notifications clients get**.
4. (Optional) Click **View** to preview the message your members receive.

**Important:** You need to [upgrade to a Business Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-upgrading-wix-bookings-to-a-business-premium-plan) in order to send SMS reminders. SMS Reminders must comply with the [Wix SMS terms of use](https://www.wix.com/about/virtual-number-terms).

question: How can I change the height of a section in ADI?
answer:
To change the height of a section in ADI, follow these steps:

1. Hover over the section in the ADI builder that you want to change.
2. Click **Design.**
3. Click the **Customize Section Design** drop-down.
4. Select **Height** from the drop-down menu.
5. Click the **+** or **-** icons to enlarge or shrink the section.

### Note
Not all sections of ADI allow you to adjust their height, especially if doing so will negatively impact the user experience.

### Tip
For a shortcut, you can also click the **Show more** icon at the top left of a section and click **Height** from the drop-down menu. If the option isn't available, the section layout doesn't support height adjustment.

question: Can I lock layers in the Wix Editor to prevent accidentally moving elements?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to lock layers in the Editor to prevent accidentally moving elements while editing your site. However, if you want certain elements to always be visible on your live site, you can [pin them](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-pinning-elements-to-the-screen). Visitors can always see pinned elements on their screen, even if they scroll.

question: Can I set up an affiliate program offering cash incentives or payouts through the Wix Referral Program?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to set up an affiliate program offering cash incentives or payouts through a [Wix Referral Program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-referral-program-adding-and-setting-up-your-referral-program).

question: How can I check my site's global availability using the Uptime & Security dashboard?
answer: To check your site's global availability using the Uptime & Security dashboard, you can run an availability test every 24 hours. Your results will display on a world map, with a status message. You can click the dots on the world map to learn where your site is live. Access the Uptime & Security dashboard from [Site & Mobile App](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Uptime%20and%20Security&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/analytics/performance/reliability) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I change the zoom level in the Wix Editor if there is no built-in zoom feature?
answer:
The Wix Editor does not have a zoom feature, but you can use the zoom function available in your browser.

- Press **Ctrl** \+ **\+** (**Cmd** \+ **\+** on Mac) to zoom in.
- Press **Ctrl** \+ **\-** (**Cmd** \+ **\-** on Mac) to zoom out.

### Tip
Pressing **Ctrl** \+ **0** (**Cmd** \+ **0** for Mac) returns your browser to the default zoom.

For best functionality and in order to ensure full access to the editor and its tools, it is advised to keep your browser's zoom at 100%.

question: Can I downgrade my Google Workspace subscription from one plan to another?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to downgrade a Google Workspace subscription from one plan to another.

question: Can I connect email accounts from different providers to the same domain?
answer:
It is not possible to connect email accounts from more than one email provider to the same domain. You can have numerous domain-based emails, but they must be purchased from the same email provider (e.g., only from Google Workspace, or only from GoDaddy).

If you've purchased a Google Workspace business email from Wix and from another provider, you'll have to choose one and cancel the other:

- If you'd like to keep your external email (e.g., your GoDaddy email) you need to [cancel your Google Workspace business email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-canceling-your-business-email-renewal). Please make sure to [connect your external email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-an-email-purchased-outside-of-wix).

- If you'd like to keep your Google Workspace business email, you need to cancel your external email. In order to do so, please contact the external provider directly. Please make sure to [add the correct records](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-workspace-adding-google-workspace-mx-records-in-your-wix-account) for your Google Workspace business email.

question: Does Wix Hotels support adding additional languages beyond the ones listed?
answer: Currently, Wix Hotels supports the following languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Dutch, Danish, Norwegian, Polish, Russian, Swedish, and Turkish. If you would like to suggest additional languages, you can submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/contact?skipTroubleshooters=true).

question: How can I change the og:image for an individual page on my Wix site?
answer:
To change the og:image for an individual page on your Wix site, follow these steps:

question: Can members create events from my live site using Wix Events?
answer: Currently, it is not possible for members to create events from your live site.

question: How can I reactivate a canceled Premium or Studio site plan on Wix before the subscription ends?
answer:
To reactivate your Premium or Studio plan before the subscription ends, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Turn Auto Renew On** under the relevant subscription.

**Note:** Site plans canceled during the [14-day money back period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/requesting-a-refund-for-a-premium-plan) are canceled immediately and cannot be reactivated by turning the auto renew back on. In such cases, you can upgrade the site again to purchase a new plan.

question: How can I enable a printer-friendly version of my blog posts using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To enable a printer-friendly version of your posts using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to your Post page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Blog Pages**.
   3. Click **Post**.
3. Click the Post Page element on your page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Display** tab.
6. Click **Share & Print**.
7. Enable the **Enable share & print icons** toggle.
8. Select the **Print Post** checkbox.
9. Publish your site.

question: Is there an 'Upgrade' button available as a panel element in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently in Wix Blocks, you must manually implement the logic of sending an app user to an upgrade page. An 'upgrade' button as a panel element is not yet available.

question: How can I customize the default text style for my blog feeds using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To set default text style for your feeds using the Wix Editor:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to your Blog page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2021/11/02/0b84b086-cf99-4826-93e0-9ffff492898a/c4974969-a151-4474-b053-c2dcfe3e00e6.png) on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Blog Pages**.
   3. Click your Blog page under **Blog Pages**.
3. Click the Blog element on your page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Design** tab.
6. Click **Posts**.
7. Click the tabs to choose which feed you want to design:
   
   * **All Posts feed**: This is your main post feed. It displays all of your posts or specific posts that you've selected. You can customize the colors and fonts of the text, choose the color of the text on hover, and adjust the overlay (the semi-transparent background).

question: Can I connect my Wix Store to CJ Affiliate Marketing Network directly through the Wix dashboard?
answer: Currently, it's not possible to connect your Wix Store to CJ.com directly through the Wix dashboard, so that you can create sharable affiliate links for your products.

question: Can I convert an existing widget into a plugin in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently in Wix Blocks, it is not possible to directly convert an existing widget into a plugin. This means that users must recreate plugins from scratch.

question: Can I book multiple hotel rooms under one reservation?
answer: Currently, booking multiple rooms under one hotel reservation is not supported.

question: How can I update the typography styles on my site using Editor X?
answer:
To update a typography style in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Click the Site Styles icon on the top bar of the Editor.
2. Click the Edit icon on a typography style.
3. Customize the typography as you wish:
   * Change the font using the drop-down menu.
   * Adjust the text size.
   * Make your text bold or italicized.
4. Click **Apply**.

question: How do I connect PaidBy Bank as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect PaidBy Bank as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to PaidBy Bank.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new PaidBy Bank account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your:
      * **API Client Name**.
      * **Authorization Token**.
      * **Merchant ID**.
      * **Workflow**.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account
   1. Click [Create PaidBy Bank account](https://signup.paidbybank.com/).
   2. Fill in the registration form.
   3. Wait for a message from PaidBy Bank to get your credentials.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

question: Can I set a parent-child page relationship with an Editor page that is part of a third-party app in my site hierarchy?
answer: Currently, when defining your site hierarchy it is not possible to set a parent-child page relationship with an Editor page that is part of a third-party app. You can define your hierarchy by [setting parent-child page relationships](https://support.wix.com/en/article/defining-your-site-hierarchy-for-main-pages-url-and-breadcrumbs-structure) between pages that are not part of third-party apps.

question: How can I set a section as a global header in Editor X?
answer:
To set a section as a global header in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Click the relevant section in Editor X.
2. Click the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/11/17/e768cb96-3728-47d4-bc54-1d46a903c5cf/666491f2-3c55-4eea-a088-5186fea89980.png).
3. Click **Set as Global**.
4. Select the relevant option:
   * **Header:** Sections that appear at the top of the page.
5. Enter a name for your global section.

### Can't see the option to set a global header?
If the option is grayed out, it means another section is in that same position. If you can't see the other section, it might be set to "Don't Display" (which is why it's not visible). To set your section as a global header, move it to the top of the page:

1. Click **Layers** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/11/17/7289ee4c-3e4b-4244-9183-fb86c2bf118d/519ee547-1d17-415a-922c-2d5d3d910252.jpg) at the top of Editor X.
2. Click the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/11/17/e768cb96-3728-47d4-bc54-1d46a903c5cf/666491f2-3c55-4eea-a088-5186fea89980.png) next to the section you want to set as global.
3. Select **Move Up** for global headers.
4. Repeat steps 2-3 until the option to move up appears in gray.
5. Try again to set your section as a global header.

question: How can I upgrade my Wix Photo Albums storage if I'm nearing my storage limit?
answer:
To upgrade your Wix Photo Albums storage, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fphotography-albums/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.

### Tip
Alternatively, you can [upgrade your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/upgrading-an-existing-premium-plan). question: Can I make separate changes to all elements of Wix Bookings on mobile?
answer: It is currently not possible to make separate changes to all elements of Wix Bookings on mobile. Any changes in the desktop version of your Wix Bookings app appear in the mobile version as well.

question: How can I add hyperlinks to text in ADI?
answer:
To add hyperlinks to your text in ADI:

1. Click the text section.
2. Select the text you would like to add a hyperlink to.
3. Click the Link icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/1ddd9bce-2a39-4184-904e-b1e37f4e875e/2017/05/29/acc3c6a3-1f65-4c50-89dc-7e9db0fa4367.png) in the text editing menu.
4. Select the link type in the menu, and add the relevant details.

question: Can I create a dropdown menu with images or icons in Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, you cannot create a dropdown menu for your site using images or icons.

question: Can I use coupons for Wix Events at a mobile POS?
answer: It is not currently possible to accept coupons with Wix Events at a mobile POS. You can vote for the ability to accept coupons with [Wix Events](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-mobile-pos-request-accepting-coupons-for-wix-events-tickets-at-a-mobile-pos).

question: How can I customize the layout of my Wix Pro Gallery on a mobile site?
answer:
To customize the layout of your Wix Pro Gallery on a mobile site, follow these steps:

1. Go to your mobile Editor:
   * **Wix Editor:** Click the Switch to Mobile icon at the top of the Editor.
   * **Editor X:** Click the relevant breakpoint at the top of Editor X.
2. Click the Wix Pro Gallery in your mobile Editor.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Select a layout for your gallery.
5. Click **Customize Layout** to change the layout to look exactly as you want (see [Customizable Layout Features](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-choosing-a-wix-pro-gallery-layout-for-your-mobile-site-custom-vs-presets#customizable-layout-features) below).

**Note:** There are no navigation arrows in the expanded view. Instead, visitors swipe the screen to view the next gallery item.

question: How can I create a client kit in Wix Studio and invite my client to access it?
answer:
To create a client kit in Wix Studio and invite your client to access it, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Client Kits](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/client-kits) in your Wix Studio workspace.
2. Click **+ Create Client Kit**.
3. Select a Studio site to create a kit for and click **Continue**.
4. Click **Add resources** and upload your files or choose from Wix Studio tutorial videos.
5. Click **Agency details** and click the **Display details** toggle to share your contact details:
   
   * **Enabled:** Your contact details will be displayed as part of the client kit.
   * **Disabled:** Your contact details won't be shared with the client.
6. Click **Your client** to view the recipients and do one of the following:
   
   * Click **site collaborator** to add your client as a collaborator. 
     
     **Note:** It's important to indicate if you're sharing it with the client so that they can view but not edit the kit.
   * Click **transfer site ownership** to transfer the site to your client.
7. Click **Save** to send the invite and share the client kit.

Your client can access their personalized kit directly from their site's dashboard. Clients can view the client kit but can't edit it.

question: How can I connect a domain purchased from Wix to my upgraded site?
answer:
To connect your Wix domain to your site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the relevant option below to learn how to assign your domain to your site:

### Assign a domain that is currently assigned to a different site
1. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the relevant domain.
2. Click **Assign to a different Site**.
3. Select the site you want to connect and click **Next**.
4. Click **Assign**.

### Assign a domain that is not currently assigned to a site
1. Click **Assign** below the domain you want to connect.
2. Select the site you want to connect and click **Next**.
3. Click **Assign**.

**Important:** You must [upgrade your site with a plan](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website?referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter) before you can assign a domain to it.

question: Can I use Auto Ads in the Wix Monetize with AdSense app to optimize my site?
answer: Currently, the ability to optimize your site using Auto Ads in the Wix Monetize with AdSense app is not available.

question: Can I customize the message that unsubscribed readers see when they view a post connected to a subscription plan on Wix Blog?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to customize the message that unsubscribed readers see when they view a post that is [connected to a subscription plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-creating-blog-post-subscriptions).

question: How can I create a new automation in Wix Bookings?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have marked attendance for classes if you plan to use 'Client checked in X times' or 'Client checks in' automations.

To create a new automation in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Automations Dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/).
2. Click **+ New Automation**.

   **Note:** To use a suggested automation, search and select from the options under **Popular**. You can edit the trigger and actions of a suggested automation.
4. Click the title at the top to give your automation a name.

question: Can I apply a single password to the entire site in the Studio Editor?
answer: It is not currently possible to apply a single password to the entire site. As an alternative, you can [manually add a password to each site page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-managing-pages#changing-the-page-settings) from its settings.

question: How can I connect a Google 'book' button to my Wix Bookings site?
answer:
To connect a Google 'book' button to your Wix Bookings site, follow these steps:

1. Go to Booking Channels in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Connect** under Google.
3. Click **Get Started** to agree to Google's terms of use and Privacy policy.
4. Click the **Choose profiles** drop-down and click the checkbox next to the relevant Google Business profile(s) you want to connect.
5. Click **Continue**.
6. Click the Select services drop-down and click the checkbox next to the relevant services you want to display on Google.
7. Click **Connect**.

Make sure to create your [Google Business Profile](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fgoogle-my-business%3F&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Dashboard) before following the steps. It can take several days for the verification to complete.

question: How can I fix the issue where my dynamic list page links to the wrong dynamic item page in Wix CMS?
answer:
Misconfigured links on your dynamic list page can cause the wrong dynamic item page URL to load. To fix this issue, follow these steps:

1. Make sure the linked buttons or images on your dynamic list page's repeater, gallery, or table are connected to the dynamic page dataset. Learn how to [connect a repeater on your dynamic page to the dynamic page dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-dynamic-list-page#step-3-connect-the-repeater-to-the-cms).

question: How can I set up shipping fees based on the price of an order in Wix Stores?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have created or selected a shipping region as described in Step 1.

### Step-by-Step Instructions
1. **Click Shipping.**

   ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2020/11/29/b136c206-18cc-4a2a-901c-29a582a433f3/c50949de-fbf4-450f-9903-fb7009dec850.png)

2. **Select Rate By Price** from the **Select how shipping is calculated** drop-down.

   ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2020/11/29/14511187-8ed5-4e26-99b1-dfd16d9b29f9/256f23a1-b85e-4a7a-b918-fb46d7a6abd8.png)

3. Enter a name in the **Shipping Option Name** field (e.g. Standard Shipping).
4. (Optional) Enter a time in the **Est. Delivery Time** field.
5. Enter the top limit of the first price range (e.g. enter $20 to create a rule for purchases from $0 - $20).

   **Note:** The top limit of the first price range is automatically set as the bottom limit of the second price range.

6. Enter the rate (shipping price) for the first range.
7. Enter the top limit of the second price range (e.g. $50).
8. Enter the rate (shipping price) for the second price range.
9. (Optional) Click **Add Range** to add another price range and rate (up to 30 ranges).

   ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2020/11/29/2f655944-0cfe-43a7-8507-3511485b5779/987ec3b6-fa9c-42be-861e-c5d10ea890ac.png)

10. Click **Add another Delivery Option** to add additional options (e.g. Express Shipping).
11. (Optional) Check the **Add a handling fee to every order** checkbox and enter the handling fee.
12. Click **Save**.

### Tip
If you want to offer free shipping for orders over a certain price, simply type "0" in the **Rate** field for that price range.

question: How can I customize the layout of collapsible text on my Wix mobile site?

2. Click the Layout icon ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/_o63TCTCRJLLQGXjE3A037_Ewcw6NyoTwOCmtaYSCkiQ-u2XW00xPpyw3PUuq7gyYimF_Uw3SHZ5zdeCUAThh_PyIweKwILGTFEOkwv8aK-0mOQJNLRHa9B_LZJdEADO0BQvJb8y).

question: What types of changes to my Branded App require approval from Apple and Google?
answer:
Changes to your app's design or store listing descriptions must be re-submitted to Apple and Google for approval. These changes include anything that comes before the member log in or [visitor mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-login-screen-visibility) in your app. Changes that must be approved include:

## Brand and design
* **Name and icon:** Changes to your app's name and/or logo.
* **Launch screen:** Changes to the design of your app's launch screen (what members see when the app loads).
* **Login screen:** Changes to the login screen.

Learn more about [designing your Branded App](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-designing-your-app).

## Store listings
Since your app's store listings appear in both the App Store and Google Play, any content, icon, or category changes must be reviewed and approved by Apple and Google before the updated listings go live.

Learn more about [creating your store listing descriptions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-creating-store-listing-descriptions).

question: How can I resend an email campaign to recipients who haven't opened it yet?
answer:
To resend an email campaign to recipients who haven't opened it yet, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Email Marketing](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Email%20Marketing%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/shoutout/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Navigate to the campaign you want to resend under **Most recent email campaigns** and click the Resend icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/1de041c3-9554-4d04-9ed8-d7e127f698b3/2022/05/06/a25d297b-6f0a-4c06-bd33-fa70c7044b52/c7e66f9d-da76-40d3-9b15-af74fb081809.jpg) to resend the campaign to contacts on the list who didn't open. 
   
   **Note:** This icon only appears 24 hours after the first campaign was sent to give your recipients time to open when it's convenient for them.
3. Add a subject line for the campaign. You can use the same subject line as the previous campaign, however it is recommended to tweak it to try to improve the chances of people engaging with the campaign.
4. When you're ready to resend the campaign click **Send Now**. You can see how many recipients will receive the new campaign at the top. You can also select specific contacts to target.

In your Email Marketing dashboard, your resent campaign is displayed as a new campaign with the label 'Re-sent email.'

**Important:** Resending a campaign counts towards your monthly balance. To increase your balance, [upgrade your plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-upgrading-your-email-marketing-plan).

question: How can I edit the default booking confirmation email in Wix Bookings?

6. Choose which field to edit:
   * **Subject:** Customize the email subject line to entice your clients to open it.
   * **Message:** Edit the text of the email to include any information your clients need to know before attending.
7. (Optional) Click **Send Test Email** to send yourself a preview of the email.
8. Click **Save**.

### Notes
* The confirmation emails you receive display your business's time zone. The emails you send to your clients display the time zone they select.
* Test emails display ${priceText} and $12.34 as the service price and total. This will not appear in your actual confirmation emails.

question: How can I speed up the removal of deleted sites or old URLs from search results?
answer:
To speed up the removal of deleted sites or old URLs from search results, you can submit a request if you have verified your site with Google or Bing. Here are the steps to manually request removals:

1. **Google Search Console**: Use the [Google Search Console](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/1663419?hl=en) to submit a request for removal.
2. **Bing Webmaster Tools**: Use the [Bing Webmaster Tools](https://www.bing.com/webmasters/help/how-can-i-remove-a-url-or-page-from-the-bing-index-37c07477) to request the removal of URLs or pages.

If you have not verified your site with Google and Bing, you will need to wait for them to remove the pages automatically. Additionally, if you've created a new site and the URLs from the old site are still appearing in search results, you should [submit your sitemap to Google](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines) and other relevant search engines to help speed up the process.

Go to [Privacy & Cookies](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Privacy%20Center&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/cookie-consent-settings-app?referralInfo=article_displaying-a-cookie-banner) in your site's settings.
2. Click **Get Started** or, if you already have a cookie banner enabled, **Edit Cookie Banner**.
3. Enable the **Display Cookie Banner on Site** toggle.
4. Select the **Add a 'Decline All' button** checkbox.
5. (Optional) Customize your 'Decline All' button text.
6. Click **Save & Publish**.

question: Can I download individual images in formats other than JPG, GIF, or PNG from Wix Photo Albums?
answer: Currently, you can only download digital images in the following formats: JPG, GIF, PNG. GIF and PNG images will be converted to WEBP file format when downloaded individually. It is not possible to download digital files in other formats.

question: Can I use Wix Apps' Collections directly in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently, when building Blocks apps that integrate with [Wix apps](https://support.wix.com/en/business-solutions-apps) such as [Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-about-wix-stores) or Bookings, you can only use their APIs. However, you cannot access their database collections directly, cannot [use datasets to bind your widget](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blocks-about-collections#connecting-elements-to-collection-fields-data-binding) to these collections, and cannot test your widgets in Blocks to see how they appear with sample data for the Wix apps.

question: Is the Wix Retail Point of Sale available for merchants outside the US and Canada?
answer: The Wix Retail Point of Sale (POS) solution for brick and mortar stores is available for merchants in the US and Canada. If you would like to see Wix Retail POS supported in additional countries, you can submit a ticket with your feedback and suggestions [here](https://www.wix.com/support/conversations/category/contact).

question: How can I report a virus found on a Wix site?
answer: If you believe you have found a virus on a Wix site, please report it to: [security-report@wix.com](mailto:security-report@wix.com).

question: Can I set a preset aspect ratio for images in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to select a preset aspect ratio (such as 16:9, 5:4, etc.) for images in the Studio Editor. As an alternative, you can manually change an image's width / height by dragging its side handles. You can also enter the width and height values in the Inspector panel for more precise sizing. [Learn more about sizing images](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-setting-the-size-of-your-elements#resizing-an-element)

question: Is it possible to automatically add a cutlery option to all online orders in Wix Restaurants?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to automatically add a cutlery option to all online orders so that customers can indicate that they do not need you to include cutlery with their order. As a workaround, you can add cutlery as a [deselection option](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-managing-dish-options) to each dish. Customers can check the cutlery option to indicate that you do not need to send it with your order.

question: How can I remove design overrides on a specific breakpoint in the Wix Studio Editor?
answer:
To remove design overrides on a breakpoint:

1. Select the relevant element. 

   **Tip:** You can select it directly on the canvas, or [the Layers panel](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-working-with-layers).

### Did you know?
You can use the [responsive AI tool](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-using-ai-to-make-sections-responsive) to quickly optimize the layout of sections across all breakpoints.

question: Can I save the addresses of customers that I deliver to regularly in Wix Restaurants?
answer: It's now possible to save the address of a specific customer that you deliver to regularly by [adding a Members Area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-adding-a-members-area).

question: How can I add a video to my Wix event page?
answer:
To add a video to your Wix event page, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Video**.
2. Choose where to add the video from:
   * **Embed:** Paste a URL from YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook.
   * **Upload:** Upload a video from your computer or device.
3. (Optional) Adjust the video settings:
   * **Size** / **Alignment:** Adjust the size and positioning of the video.
   * **Settings:** Click the toggle(s) to enable or disable video download and mark the video as spoilers. Then click **Save**.

question: How can I customize the 'Out of Stock' message in my Wix Store's Product Gallery using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the 'Out of Stock' message in your Product Gallery using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

5. Edit the text:
   
   1. Click the **Text** tab.
   2. Edit the 'Out of Stock' text.

question: Can I pay for Wix services in installments?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to pay for Wix services in installments (i.e. to spread payments over a number of months).

question: Can I get a refund for a third-party app upgrade purchased through Wix?
answer: It is not possible to receive a refund for a third-party app upgrade (apps not made by Wix). Some app upgrades are monthly subscriptions. Canceling your upgrade stops the renewal payment from occurring at the end of the month. Learn how to [cancel an app upgrade](https://support.wix.com/en/article/canceling-an-app-subscription).

question: How can I connect PayU India as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect PayU India as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **See Options** next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
4. Click **Connect** next to PayU India.
5. Depending on whether you have an account with PayU India, or need to create a new one, follow the steps:

   ### Have an account
   1. Enter your Alias and Salt credentials.

      **Note:** For valid credentials, your PayU India account must be created through the [PayU/Wix Plugin](https://payu.in/plugins/wix).
   2. Click **Connect**.

   ### Don't have an account
   1. Click [**Create PayU India account**](https://onboarding.payu.in/app/account?service_intent=wix&partner_name=Wix&partner_sou[%E2%80%A6]aa98a2d2b0&source=Partnerhttps://payment-middleware.payu.in).
   2. Enter your email and click **Next**.
   3. Fill in the registration form and click **Next**.
   4. Follow the steps from PayU India in order to get your credentials:

      1. Login to your [PayU dashboard](https://www.Payu.in).
      2. Go to **My Account**.
      3. Go to **System Settings**, you’ll find your Login Alias and Salt credentials here.

         **Note**: Both Salt values can be used. We suggest you use the shorter one.
   5. Return to this window (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

question: Can I transfer my French (.fr) domain to Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to transfer a French (.fr) domain to Wix. In the meantime, you can connect a .fr domain to Wix by following the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-elsewhere).

question: Are there additional shipping options available for Google Merchant Solutions in Wix Stores?
answer: Currently, when you set up Google Merchant Solutions, the shipping options are limited to flat rate or free shipping.

question: Can I receive SMS notifications for appointments booked through Wix Bookings?
answer: Currently, Wix Bookings does not send SMS notifications when an Appointment is booked. Notifications are only sent by email.

question: How can I connect DPO Group as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect DPO Group as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** beside **DPO Group**.
4. Depending on whether you have an account with DPO Group or need to create a new one, follow the steps:

Go back to the [Accept Payments tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) (repeat steps 1-4) and follow the steps under **Have an Account** to connect your newly-created account.

question: How can I start using the Printify app by Printify on my Wix site?
answer: To use the Printify app by Printify on your Wix site, you need to [add Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores). Once Wix Stores is added, you can create and sell custom products, choose from over 250 products, and utilize a network of print providers from more than 90 locations. The app also features an easy-to-use mockup generator and is free to use. Check out the [Printify](https://www.wix.com/app-market/printify) app by Printify to get started.

question: Can I set different prices for the same menu item in different menus on Wix Restaurants?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to include the same menu item in two different menus (for example, an in-house menu and a take out menu) and set two different prices. As a workaround solution, you can create two menu items with the same name, description and options, and price them differently. **Tip:** When creating the duplicate menu item, do not select the existing item from the drop-down list.

question: Can I share my email campaign drafts with other Wix Email Marketing users?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to share email campaign drafts with other Wix Email Marketing users, or transfer draft newsletters to other Wix accounts.

question: How can I add a Wix Forum to my site using Editor X?
answer:
To add a Wix Forum to your site using Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Click the **App Market** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2020/03/12/5476b8e7-7306-4efe-bfd6-464c56210c38/4c80d414-4bd5-4e8c-a7ca-12706ddfccc0.jpg) on the top of Editor X.

question: How can I create a branded app without connecting it to a Wix site?
answer:
To create a branded app without a connected Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Branded App by Wix site](https://www.wix.com/app-builder).
2. Click **Build Your App**.
3. Select **Create a branded app from scratch** and click **Continue**.
4. Choose the type of branded app you want to create then click **Continue**.
5. Wix prepares your siteless dashboard. Start setting up your app by adding the app's name, uploading an app icon image, and choosing a brand color and navigation layout (you can change all this later in your dashboard).
6. Click **Continue to Dashboard**.
7. To start editing your app's content right away, click **Edit Mobile App** at the top right of your dashboard.

### Tip
The Home tab checklist shows you the next steps to get your app live in the App Store and Google Play.

Your branded app dashboard is where you can manage all aspects of the app. Once you've built your app's content, next steps include:

1. Connecting a payment method to your app (if you are planning on selling goods via the app).
2. [Purchasing a Branded App plan for this site](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Branded%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/branded-apps/premium).
3. Connecting an [Apple Developer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-creating-and-connecting-an-apple-developer-account) and [Google Developer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-creating-and-connecting-a-google-developer-account) account.
4. [Submitting the app to the App Store and Google Play](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-submitting-your-app-for-approval).

question: How can I automatically send an invoice when someone purchases my online program?
answer:
To automatically send an invoice when a program is purchased, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Online Programs](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Online%20Programs&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/challenges/list) in your site's dashboard.
2. Choose an option:
   * **If this is a new program:** Click **Create New** to [create a new program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-creating-a-new-program#step-2-enter-your-program-details). Once you choose a template, click **Edit** to enter your program details.
   * **Existing Programs:** Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/01/26/b3736435-0d71-4f7d-89d4-6c2cc9a3259c/ede58fab-ed86-4013-9da2-512fe658aef6.png) next to the program you want to edit.

This includes the invoice header, transaction details and incorporating company details from your [Business Info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information).

question: Can I reply to Wix Forms submissions directly from my email inbox?
answer:
Currently, using [new Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-the-difference-between-the-new-and-old-wix-forms), it is not possible to reply to form submissions through your email inbox. You need to click the button in the email, or head over to your dashboard, in order to respond to the submission.

### Workaround
You can click the email address that appears in the email notification to start a direct conversation. However, the correspondence won’t appear in your Wix account.

question: How can I turn off auto renewal for my Google Workspace business email through Wix?

question: How can I enable downloading of an entire photo album on my Wix site?
answer:
To enable downloading of an entire album on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/photography-albums/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Album** next to the relevant album.
3. Click **Edit** next to **Privacy and Permissions**.
