5. Click **Save**.

question: How can I add items to the cart using the Wix app for mobile POS?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have the Wix app installed and are logged into your site.

To add items to the cart:
1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Point of Sale** under Get Paid.
4. Select what you want to add to the cart:

### Add Wix Bookings services
1. If you also use Wix Stores, tap **Services**.
2. Tap to select the relevant service.
3. Add the appointment details.
4. (Optional) Tap the service price to edit it.
5. (Optional) Tap the **Notify client with an email** checkbox to send a booking confirmation via email.
6. Tap **Add to Cart**.
7. (Optional) Book additional sessions.

### Add Wix Stores products
1. Tap the **Products** tab.
2. Locate the products you want to add to cart using any of these methods:
   * Enter a search term.
   * Scan the product's barcode.
   * Tap **All Products** to search within a category.
   * Scroll through your products.
3. Tap to select the products and variants you want to sell.
4. Tap **Go to Cart**.

### Add a custom charge
1. Add a custom amount to the sale:
   1. Tap **Add Custom Charge**.
   2. Enter the amount, including cents.
   3. (Optional) Tap **Add Note** and enter information about the sale.
   4. Tap **Apply**.
2. Tap **Go to Cart**.

question: Can I schedule my website to publish at a later date or time using the Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to schedule a time for your website to publish at a later date or time.

question: How can I enable members to chat with each other in my Wix Forum?
answer: To enable members to chat with each other in your Wix Forum, you can use the Members Chat feature. This feature allows forum members to reach out directly and start conversations, enhancing the sense of community. You can learn more about enabling the members chat feature by clicking [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-chat-allowing-members-to-chat-with-each-other-using-members-chat#members-chat-1).

question: Can I customize roles and permissions for group admins in Wix Groups?
answer: The feature to customize roles and permissions for group admins in Wix Groups is not implemented yet. However, you can manage your group's members and make a member a group admin from the **Members** tab. Group admins can moderate group discussions, pin important posts, assign topics to posts, approve new member requests, and remove members who should no longer be part of the group. For more details, you can visit the [Wix Groups Managing Your Group](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-managing-your-group#managing-your-groups-members) page.

question: Can I redirect site members to a specific page after they sign up or log in on my Wix site?
answer:
Currently, when a site member signs up or logs in to your Wix site, they are directed to the page they signed up/logged in from. It is not possible to redirect site members to a specific page after they sign up or log in.

As a workaround, you can add a button to your page and link it to a members-only page. When your visitors click the button and log in, they will be directed to the members-only page.

### Instructions for Wix Editor:
1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Button**.
3. Drag a button onto your page.
4. Click the button on the page.
5. Click the **Link** icon.
6. Select a members-only page on your site under **Which page?**.
7. Click **Done**.
8. Publish your site.

### Instructions for Studio Editor:
1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Button**.
3. Drag a button onto your page.
4. Click the button on the page.
5. Click the **Link** icon.
6. Select a members-only page on your site under **Which page?**.
7. Click **Done**.
8. Publish your site.

### Tip
As an alternative solution, you can use [Velo by Wix](https://www.wix.com/velo) to code your own redirect.

question: Can I use gradients as backgrounds for text boxes and shapes in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to apply a gradient background to Studio Editor elements like text boxes and shapes. However, you can now [set gradients as the background for responsive containers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-using-containers#designing-containers).

question: Can I apply coupons to the sale of booking services at a mobile point of sale?
answer: We're thrilled to announce that it's now possible to apply [coupons](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-discount-coupons) to the sale of bookings services at a mobile point of sale.

question: Can I customize the content and design for outgoing emails in Wix Bookings without using automations?
answer: You can now [customize the content and design for outgoing emails](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-managing-your-outbound-client-emails) (confirmation, cancelation, reminder). You can also now add email attachments.

question: Can I integrate DoorDash Drive with Wix Restaurant Orders?
answer: You can now use [DoorDash Drive as a delivery partner](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-setting-up-doordash-drive-for-your-restaurant) with the new Wix Restaurant Orders app.

question: How can I display additional content from my CMS collection on my Wix Bookings pages?
answer:
Prerequisites:

- Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.
- [Enable Wix app collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections) so you can use Wix Bookings with the CMS.

To display additional content from your CMS collection on your Wix Bookings pages, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create a collection that references your Wix app collection
1. Create a [Multiple items (Default) collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection) where you will keep the additional info you want to integrate into your Bookings pages. In this article, we'll call this your 'Details' collection.
2. In the collection, click **+ Add Item** to add items for each service that you want to save additional details about.
3. Click **+ Add Field** to add fields for each type of content you want to save (e.g. [Rich Content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-rich-content-and-adding-it-to-a-dynamic-page)).
4. Click the relevant cells to add your content to each item.
5. Add a Reference field type and connect it to the Bookings Wix app collection:
   - Click **Manage Fields** then click **+ Add Field**.
   - Select **Reference** and click **Choose Field Type**.
   - Enter the **Field name**.
   - (Velo only) If necessary, update the **Field ID**, which is used in the site's code. You cannot update this ID later.
   - Click the **Referenced Collection** drop-down and select the relevant Wix App collection. For example, select **Services** under **Bookings**.
   - (Optional) Enter help text to include a tooltip in your collection next to the field name.
   - Click **Save**.
6. For each item, click the reference field and select the relevant service. You can select multiple services if you added a multi-reference field in the previous step.

### Step 2 | Build custom Bookings pages
If you want to add more details from your CMS collection to your Bookings Service or Calendar page, you must convert them to custom pages. This involves adding code and using the Velo APIs. You only need to convert the Bookings pages in which you want to add details from your 'Details' collection.

- [Build a custom Booking Calendar page with Velo](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/wix-apps/wix-bookings/build-a-custom-booking-calendar-page)
- [Build a custom Booking Service page with Velo](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/wix-apps/wix-bookings/build-a-custom-booking-service-page)

### Step 3 | Set up the datasets on your page: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the custom Bookings page where you want to show details from your CMS collection.
3. Add a dataset that connects to your 'Details' CMS collection:
   - Click **CMS** on the left.
   - Click **Add Content Elements**.
   - Click **Dataset**.
   - Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select your 'Details' collection.
   - Edit the **Dataset name** if needed and click **Create**.
4. (If you haven't already) Add a dataset that connects to your Bookings Wix app collection:
   - Click **Add a Dataset** at the bottom of the panel on the right.
   - Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select the **Services** collection under **Bookings**.
   - Edit the **Dataset name** if needed and click **Create**.
5. Add a URL slug filter to your Services dataset.
6. Add a reference filter to your 'Details' dataset:
   - Click **All page datasets** at the top of the **Dataset Settings** panel on the right.
   - Click the **More Actions** icon next to your 'Details' dataset and select **Dataset settings**.
   - Click **+ Add Filter** under **Filter**.
   - Click the **Field** drop-down, select your **Reference (Services)** field or **Multi-Reference (Services)** field, then click **Add Filter**.
7. Add the [supported elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-elements-and-the-collection-fields-they-can-connect-to) that you want to display details from your CMS 'Details' collection. For example, you could add the [Rich Content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-rich-content-and-adding-it-to-a-dynamic-page#adding-the-rich-content-element-to-your-page) element to display the rich content fields from your 'Details' collection.
8. [Connect the elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset) to the relevant fields in your 'Details' dataset.
9. (If you haven't already) Add and connect elements to your Services dataset to display details from your Bookings Wix app collection.
10. (Optional) If you also want to display content from your 'Details' collection on your Booking Calendar page, repeat these steps for your Custom Booking Calendar page.
11. Click **Preview** at the top right and use the **Preview** toolbar to test the connections for the relevant services.
12. Publish your site when you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How do I publish my Google Sheets spreadsheet to use it with the Table Master app?
answer:
To publish your Google Sheets spreadsheet for use with the Table Master app, follow these steps:

1. Open your Google Sheets spreadsheet.
2. Click **File** at the top left.
3. Click **Share**.

question: How can I schedule social media posts using the Social Media Marketing dashboard?
answer:
To schedule your social media posts using the Social Media Marketing dashboard, follow these steps:

1. **Create your content**: Use the dashboard to create different types of content, such as image or video posts.
2. **Access the scheduling tool**: Once your content is ready, take advantage of the scheduling tool available in the dashboard.
3. **Set the timing**: Choose a time that suits your business best to get your content out there. You can schedule your posts to send to your audience at a time you know they will see it, such as early in the morning on their commute to work.
4. **Plan ahead**: Take advantage of a creative flow and create multiple posts, setting them to send over the next few days or weeks.

Scheduling your posts for later means that you can keep your content flowing, without having to be available to actually send it. Learn more about [scheduling your social posts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/social-posts-scheduling-a-social-post).

question: How can I display my Wix Stores products on any page using the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* [Create your own products in Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-a-physical-product).
* Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.
* [Enable Wix app collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections) so you can use Wix Stores with the CMS.

### Step 1 | Add a Pro Gallery, repeater, or table to a page: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page or section where you want to display your Wix Stores products.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
4. Add a Pro Gallery, repeater, or table:
   * **Pro Gallery:**
     1. Click **Gallery**.
     2. Click and drag the Pro Gallery of your choice onto the page.
     3. Remove the default images from the gallery:
        1. Click the gallery and select **Manage Media**.
        2. Click **Select All** then click **Delete**.
        3. Click **Done**.
   * **Repeater:**
     1. Click **List**.
     2. Click and drag the repeater of your choice onto the page.
     3. Make sure your repeater has an image or button so you can link it to your Product Page later.
   * **Table:**
     1. Click **List**.
     2. Click **Tables** and drag the table of your choice onto the page.

### Step 2 | Connect your gallery, repeater or table to the CMS: Wix Editor
1. In your Editor, click the repeater, Pro Gallery, or table.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
3. Click **Create Dataset**. If you already have a dataset on your page, click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select **Create a New Dataset**.
4. Click the **Choose a collection** drop-down and select **Products** under the **Stores** Wix app collection.
5. (Optional) Click the **Dataset name** field and enter a name for the dataset.
6. Click **Create**.
7. (Repeaters only) Under **Connections**, click the repeater element you want to connect (e.g. Text, Button, Image).
8. Click the relevant drop-downs and select the [Wix Stores dynamic collection fields](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/wix-apps/wix-e-commerce-stores/wix-stores-products-collection-fields) you want to connect or the dataset linking options for buttons and images:
   * **Wix Stores collection fields:**
     + **Name (Text):** The product name you created in Wix Stores.
     + **Formatted Discounted Price (Text):** The price formatted with the currency (e.g. $20).
     + **Main Media (Image):** The main media item (image or video) for the product.
   * **Buttons and images linking options:**
     + **Navigate to Product Page URL:** Go to the web address of the product's page on your site.
     + **Add to cart:** Add the product to the cart.
     + **Open quick view:** Open a popup with details about the product.
9. (Repeaters only) Click **Repeater connections** and repeat steps 7-8 above to connect additional elements in the repeater.
10. Click to adjust your repeater elements, Pro Gallery or table as needed.
11. Click **Preview** to test the functionality.
12. Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How can I troubleshoot if my Wix automation is not triggering?
answer:
To troubleshoot if your Wix automation is not triggering, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Check the automation summary
View the statistics of an automation to see how many times it has been triggered, as well as the most recent activity.

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant automation and view statistics information in the panel on the right.

### Step 2 | Check that the right trigger app and filter (session, event, form, etc.) was set
Each automation is linked to a specific app (for example, Wix Stores or Wix Bookings). You choose the app when you set your trigger.

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant automation and click the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/be0b50df-801c-4d6d-b81c-dc49333eccac/2022/06/13/f9f288b6-e50a-40a5-883c-760ea19977d4/a6310292-8619-4733-a7a7-88933f302063.png).
3. Click **Edit**.
4. Check the selected trigger, making any updates necessary.
5. Click **Save**.

### Step 3 | Check the timing
When setting up your automation, you selected when it should respond to the trigger (for example, immediately or after one day). If you notice that the automation doesn't run when expected, go back and check the timing.

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant automation and click the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/be0b50df-801c-4d6d-b81c-dc49333eccac/2022/06/13/f9f288b6-e50a-40a5-883c-760ea19977d4/a6310292-8619-4733-a7a7-88933f302063.png).
3. Click **Edit**.
4. Click the **Timing** drop-down. Check the timing under **Choose a time to send this action** and update if necessary.
5. Click **Save**.

### Step 4 | Check the frequency
Check if the automation was set to run once per contact. If you've set your automation to **Send once per contact**, it only runs the first time your visitor (or you, if you're testing your automation) performs the action.

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant automation and click the More Actions icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/be0b50df-801c-4d6d-b81c-dc49333eccac/2022/06/13/f9f288b6-e50a-40a5-883c-760ea19977d4/a6310292-8619-4733-a7a7-88933f302063.png).
3. Click **Edit**.
4. Click the **Timing** drop-down.
5. In the **Limit frequency to** drop-down, check if **Once per contact** is selected. Update if necessary.
6. Click **Save**.

### Automations don't run retroactively
An automation only runs for triggers that happen when the automation is active. Learn more about how to [avoid missing trigger data](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-automations-dont-run-retroactively) and [manually adding recipients to an email automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-manually-adding-recipients-to-an-email-automation).

question: How can I benefit from using the Shared Gallery with the Members Area on my site?
answer:
When you use the Shared Gallery with the Members Area, members can:

- Track the amount of uploads, tags, and likes that other members have made.
- Share and report photos through the Members Area.
- Sort photos, view in expand mode, and also delete photos.

Only members who are part of the community are able to see which photos a member uploaded. Additionally, when a site visitor logs in, they are logged in to all parts of your site, including any special member sections like "My Orders" in Wix Stores. For more details, you can visit [this link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-about-the-members-area).

question: How can I translate my site menu using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To translate your site menu using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

3. Select the relevant language.
4. Select your menu type and follow the steps:

   #### Regular menu
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant menu item.
   3. Select the relevant option to choose how you want to translate the menu item:
      
      * **Edit name:** Manually translate the item name, enter your translation, and click **Done**.
      * **Auto-translate name:** Translate the name automatically.
   4. Repeat for the rest of your menu items and languages.

   1. Select your menu.
   2. Click **Edit Translation**.
   3. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant menu item.
   4. Select **Rename page**.
   5. Enter your translation.
   6. Click **Done**.
   7. Repeat steps 3-6 for the rest of your menu items.

question: How can I set up call forwarding to my agents using the Wix dashboard?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have [added call agents to your team](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-managing-multiple-call-agents) before setting up call forwarding.

To set up call forwarding using the Wix dashboard:

1. [Go to Business Phone Number](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fvirtual-numbers%3FreferralInfo%3DKB_Article&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Manage%20Business%20Phone%20Number) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Add Forwarding Number** in the **General** tab.
3. Select the desired call agent from the **Select a call agent** dropdown.

   **Note:** Click **Add Call Agent** to [add more agents](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-managing-multiple-call-agents) to your team.
4. (Optional) Click and drag the **Reorder** icon next to the relevant number(s) to set the order in which calls are forwarded to agents.

To remove an agent from call forwarding:
1. On the **General** tab, hover over the relevant agent under **Call Forwarding**.
2. Click **Remove** and **Confirm** the change.

When removing a call agent from your call forwarding list, that person can still make outgoing calls and they remain a call agent. Learn how to [remove existing agents completely](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-managing-multiple-call-agents).

question: How can I add a custom logo to my videos when they are embedded on other sites using Wix Video?
answer:
To add a custom logo to your videos when they are embedded on other sites using Wix Video, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Video Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Video%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to **Add Your Logos to Embedded Videos**. 

   **Note:** If you do not have a Premium Plan, the **Upgrade to Activate** button appears instead.
3. Click the Add Image icon to upload your logo.
4. Select the logo files from your computer.

### Notes
* You can add up to 3 logo files.
* The recommended format is transparent PNG, and the recommended size is 254x152 pixels.
* The logo you set as default appears in the videos your visitors embed. You can manually upload a separate logo for a specific video.

question: Does Wix support FTP service for file transfers?
answer:
Currently, Wix does not offer an FTP (File Transfer Protocol) service, like Filezilla. However, we do offer some transfer / import options when uploading media to your site in bulk. You can learn more about these options through the following links:

- [Uploading Media to the Media Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-uploading-media-to-the-media-manager)
- [Importing Media Files from Social Networks](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-importing-media-files-from-social-networks)
- [Importing Media from Your Wix Sites](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-importing-media-from-one-wix-site-to-another)
- [Importing Media Files Using a URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-importing-media-files-using-a-url)

If you are using Velo by Wix, you can integrate third-party FTP solutions with your Wix site using the Fetch-API. [Learn more about accessing 3rd-party services with the Fetch-API](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-accessing-3rd-party-services-with-the-fetch-api).

question: Can members save items to a wishlist in the Branded App?
answer: Currently in the Branded App, your app members cannot add individual products or services to a personalized wishlist. Having the ability to create a wishlist on your app helps your logged in members keep track of their favorite products and/or services by adding them to a personal list. They can refer back to their wishlist items at any time to decide what to purchase. [Learn more about how Wix Stores uses the wishlist feature on desktop](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-setting-up-a-wishlist).

question: How can I upgrade my Wix site to a monthly plan?
answer:
To upgrade your Wix site to a monthly plan, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Upgrade page](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmanage.wix.com%2Fstore%2Fplans%3FsiteGuid%3D%7BmetaSiteId%7D%26referralAdditionalInfo%3DHelpCenter&title=Select+a+Site+to+Upgrade&primaryButtonText=Upgrade+Site&referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter).
2. Click **Select** under the plan you wish to purchase.
3. Select **Monthly** and click **Continue to Checkout**.

### Note
After submitting your purchase, [your bank may require you to verify your identity](https://support.wix.com/en/article/paying-for-wix-services-strong-customer-authentication-sca-and-3d-secure-3ds). If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly.

question: How can I increase the number of collection items for my site if I have a Business Elite or Elite Premium plan?
answer: If you have a Business Elite or Elite Premium plan and need more collection items than your plan allows, you can get a custom CMS quota. To do this, [contact our sales team](https://www.wix.com/enterprise/form?referrer=cms-upgrade-en) to discuss your options for creating a custom CMS quota that fits your needs. Custom CMS quotas are available only for sites that have a Business Elite or Elite Premium plan. When you get a custom CMS quota, you increase the total number of collection items your site can have. The new quota replaces your current quota rather than adding to it.

question: How can I add a note to a blog post in Wix?
answer:
To add a note to a blog post in Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog) in your dashboard.

*Tip: Use the "@" symbol with a writer's name to mention them on the post, e.g. "@Jay Cee". [Learn more about mentions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-notes-to-your-posts#using-mentions-in-a-note)*

5. Click **Add**.

question: How do I create a new workspace in Wix Studio?
answer: When you switch to Wix Studio you'll land in a new account-level workspace. If you wish to create a new workspace, click the Workspace dropdown located in the top bar, then click **Create Workspace**. Choose a name, add a logo or image, and click **Create a Workspace**. Learn more about [creating a new workspace](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-creating-and-setting-up-a-workspace#creating-a-workspace).

question: How can I create a new announcement using the Wix app?
answer:

question: How can I optimize my Google Ads campaign using the Wix AI Assistant?
answer:
To optimize your Google Ads campaign using the Wix AI Assistant, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Google Ads](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{metaSiteId}/google-ads?referralInfo=KB_Google_ads_overview) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover on a campaign and click **Go to Dashboard**.
3. Click **Optimize with AI**.

**Tip:** This opens the Wix AI Assistant on the right. It analyzes the unique data of your campaign and recommends a campaign metric to start with (i.e. impressions, clicks, conversions).

4. Depending on what the Wix AI Assistant recommends, follow the steps below:

   - **Optimize impressions:**
     - Click **Optimize** next to **Impressions**, then select the relevant suggestion:
       - **Targeted locations:** Get suggestions for additional locations to target in order to reach a wider audience. Mark one or more of the suggested locations and click **Add**, or **Suggest other locations**.
       - **Keyword themes:** Add new [keyword themes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-ads-with-wix-tips-for-improving-your-campaign-performance#pick-keyword-themes-that-speak-to-your-target-audience) that match your audience's searches. Click **Add & Replace** to use the suggested keyword themes and replace the existing content, or **Suggest other keyword themes**.
       - **Daily spend:** Adjust your campaign's daily budget to increase ad visibility. If you agree with the recommended budget, confirm it so the AI Assistant can automatically make the change for you.

   - **Optimize clicks:**
     - Click **Optimize** next to **Clicks**, then select the relevant suggestion:
       - **Review search terms:** Find which search terms you should exclude from your campaign to make it perform better. Mark one or more of the suggested terms and click **Exclude Terms**, or **Suggest others**.
       - **Ad content:** Get suggestions for different headlines and descriptions to make your campaign more engaging. Click **Add & Replace** to use the suggested headlines and descriptions to replace the existing content, or **Show more content options**.
       - **Keyword themes:** Add new [keyword themes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-ads-with-wix-tips-for-improving-your-campaign-performance#pick-keyword-themes-that-speak-to-your-target-audience) that match your audience's searches. Click **Add & Replace** to use the suggested keyword themes and replace the existing content, or **Suggest other keyword themes**.

   - **Optimize conversions:**
     - Change your ad's site page to get more sales and generate more leads. Modify your ad's landing page (i.e. the targeting URL) to improve your campaign's conversion rates. If you agree with the suggested URL, click **Add & Replace**. If you would not like to change the URL, click **I'm satisfied with my URL**.

**Tip:** If you want to see other options, you can type "What else can you do?" in the chat. Don't worry if you don't see all these options offered–the recommendations may differ based on your site and your campaign settings.

question: How can I change the pickup hours for my restaurant orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To change the restaurant pickup hours using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Order Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/restaurants/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Pickup** tab.
3. Hover over the **Hours** field and click **Edit** to change your pickup hours.
4. Choose how you want to set your pickup hours:
   
   * **Opening Hours:** Pickup is available during your restaurant's opening hours.
   * **Custom Hours:** Set specific days and hours where pickup is available:
     
     1. Select the days.
     2. Select or deselect the 24 hours checkbox:
        
        + **Selected:** Customers can pick up their orders at any time.
        + **Deselected:** You set specific hours when customers pickup their orders.
     3. (Optional) Click the **Add \+** icon to add another day and/or time range. For example, you could set one pickup window for Monday - Thursday from 9AM-5PM and another for Friday - Saturday from 9AM-11PM.
5. Click **Apply**.
6. Click **Save** at the top right.

### Note
You can also enable or disable the toggle in the **Pickup** tab to temporarily disable the pickup option for your restaurant. If disabled, customers cannot go to your restaurant to pick up orders.

question: How can I manage my online program using the Wix dashboard?

2. Click the More Actions icon next to the program you want to edit.

   - **Edit Settings**: Edit program details like program name, description, price, groups and badges, and other settings. Learn more about [editing your program settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-managing-your-programs).
   - **Publish**: Publish your program if it is still a draft, then invite participants through an invitation link or an email campaign. Learn more about [publishing your online program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-creating-a-new-program#step-5-publish-your-program-and-invite-participants).
   - **End**: End an active program. (Participants are affected differently depending on the program schedule. Learn more about [editing program schedules](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-managing-your-programs#editing-scheduling).)
   - **Duplicate**: Make a copy of your program. This duplicates your program in the **Draft** tab. This can be useful to keep the settings of one program to build out another.
   - **Archive**: Send your program to the archive. You can find it in the **Archived** tab. Once a program is archived, you cannot unarchive it and participants will no longer be able to view the program. Learn more about [archiving a program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-removing-a-program). 
     
     **Note:** When you archive, current participants can still see the program, but it will not be visible on your live site. To show an archived program on your site, you must duplicate the program and publish it as a new program.
   - **Delete**: Delete a program that you no longer need. The program and its information will be permanently deleted. Learn more about [deleting a program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-removing-a-program).

**Tip:** Learn how to [manage your program on the go using the Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-managing-your-program-in-the-wix-owner-app).

question: How can I add a poll to a blog post using the Wix dashboard?
answer:
To add a poll to a blog post using the Wix dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/blog) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the post that you want to add media to.
3. Click the Add icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9dcc39dd-da6f-4c38-b1c3-ee79d33f39d5/2022/05/25/24caaa5d-da1a-4418-ab94-40d30780306f/73684fda-a5b3-4a7d-ad94-ed6c328068d4.png) beside the section where you want to add the poll.
4. Select **Poll** under **Elements**.
5. Select the type of poll that you want to create:
   * **Text in a list:** Creates a poll with a question and a list of clickable answers.
   * **Text & main image:** Creates a poll with a question, an image, and a list of clickable answers.
   * **Images in a grid:** Creates a poll with a question and a list of clickable images with answers written on them.
6. Enter your poll question and the answers that you want your readers to choose from.
7. (Optional) Customize the layout, design, and settings of your poll.
   
   **Layout**
   1. Click **Layout**.
   2. Customize your layout using the options:
      * **Question:** Enable the toggle to add a main image to your poll.
      * **Answers:** Select a List or Grid layout for your answers.
      * **Add an image to each answer:** Enable the toggle to add an image to each answer.
      * **Poll Direction:** Select a left-to-right or right-to-left direction for your poll.
   3. Click **Save**.
   
   **Design**
   1. Click **Design**.
   2. Customize the design using the options:
      * **Choose a background style:** Select a color, gradient, or image background for your poll.
      * **Corner Radius:** Adjust how rounded the edges of your poll and answers.
   3. Click **Save**.
   
   **Settings**
   1. Click **Settings**.
   2. Customize the settings using the options:
      * **Voting:** Select who can vote on the poll. You can choose to let everyone reader vote, or let only site members vote.
      * **People can pick multiple answers:** Enable the toggle if you want to let people vote more than once.
      * **Results:** Select who can see the results of the poll. You can choose to let everyone see the results, let only site members see the results, or make the results only visible to you.
      * **Show vote count:** Enable the toggle to display the number of votes that visitors have submitted.
      * **Show who voted:** Enable the toggle to display the names of the site members who voted on the poll.
   3. Click **Save**.
8. Click **Publish**.

question: What should I do if I forgot my Wix account password and can't sign in?
answer:
If you are unable to sign in to your Wix account because you have forgotten your password, you can have a reset link sent to your email address. Follow these steps to reset your password:

1. Go to [the Wix Log In page](https://users.wix.com/signin).
2. Enter your email address and click **Continue with Email**. 

   **Note:** If you're not sure which email address you used, try our [email locator](https://users.wix.com/account-recovery/enter-website).
3. Click the **Forgot Password?**.
4. Select **Forgot my password** and click **Next**.
5. Enter your email address and click **Send**.
6. Check your email and follow the instructions to create your new password.

If your email address exists in our system, you'll receive an email with the link to reset your password. Be sure to check your spam or junk folders. If you don't receive the email, make sure that you entered your email address correctly in the steps above.

### Troubleshooting password reset issues

- **Clear your browser’s cache and try again**
  1. [Clear your browser’s cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache).
  2. Close the browser and reopen it.
  3. Go back to the password reset email and click the link.

   **Note**: If you see a security warning pop-up, click **Load Anyway**.

- **Check that cookies aren’t blocked in your browser**
  - Go to your browser settings and make sure that you have [not chosen to block cookies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/enabling-cookies-in-your-browser).

- **Recover your account**
  - If you still can't sign in, you can try recovering your account. If you previously added [a recovery phone number](https://support.wix.com/en/article/updating-the-mobile-phone-number-in-your-wix-account) to your account, you can use it to access your account. If you haven't added a recovery phone number, you can fill out the [Wix Account Recovery form](https://users.wix.com/account-recovery?sessionId=ea3edf30-cd86-64b6-ab9c-a71d5480c904). Learn more about [recovering your account](https://support.wix.com/en/article/recovering-your-wix-account).

question: How can I enable consent mode in Google Tag Manager to comply with the new Digital Markets Act rules?
answer:
To enable consent mode in Google Tag Manager, follow these steps:

2. Select **Container Settings**.

8. Set your consent settings for the following tag types:

     ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/07611794-742f-4d53-8c5b-24ba712a6934/2024/02/25/74f89440-0e49-4b5b-920a-eabb81601ccd/ff9f7d33-e995-43b3-b57b-50abab78f7ac.png)

question: What fonts are available in the Wix Editor and how can I change them?
answer:
Wix offers a wide range of fonts to personalize your site, including fonts from sources like Adobe, Google, Monotype, and system fonts. Some of the available fonts include **Adobe Caslon**, **Amatic SC**, **Arial**, **Comic Sans MS**, **Courier New**, **Georgia**, **Helvetica**, **Lobster**, **Montserrat**, **Open Sans**, **Roboto**, and many more. You can view the complete list of fonts in the article.

To change your font in the Wix Editor, you can use the text settings panel. Here's how you can do it:

1. Click on the text element you want to change.
2. Click the 'Edit Text' button.
3. In the text settings panel, click the 'Font' dropdown.
4. Select the font you want to use from the list.

Additionally, you can set text themes to use throughout your site. For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the [changing your font](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-your-text-font) guide.

Please note that the availability of some fonts depends on your site language. You can learn more about [changing your site language](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-sites-language). Also, consider choosing [clear, legible fonts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-fonts-and-readability) to make your site more accessible.

question: How can I customize the social share settings for my site's pages on Wix?
answer:
To customize a page's Social Share settings on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-3c4f785a-4597-467a-8279-ceddc7b499e2&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to **Tools and settings**.
3. Click **Go to SEO Settings** under **SEO Settings**.
4. Select the page type that you want to edit. 

   **Note:** You will only see options for the pages that are part of your site. For example, if you [added Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores) to your site, you'll see an option to customize settings for **Products**.
5. Click **Edit** next to **Basics & social share**.
6. Scroll down to **Social share** and customize the relevant settings:

   - **og:title:** The title of the post when users share your page on social media. It can be the same as your page title tag.
   - **og:description:** The description (caption) of the post that displays under the **og:title** when you share on social networks. Use variables to show specific information about each page.
   - **og:image:** The image that displays next to the title and description when shared on social networks. Use variables to show a different **og:image** on each page. If you prefer one image for all your pages, add an image URL.

   **Tip:** Click **Get an Image URL from Site Files** to copy the URL of one of your site's media files. Then, hover over an image, click the **More Actions** icon and select **Copy URL**.
7. Click **Save**.

question: How can I customize the design of my collapsible text in Wix Editor?

question: How do I set up my restaurant's address and phone number in the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To set up your restaurant's address and phone number in the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Business Info](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/business-info?referralInfo=settings-lobby?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Business+Info) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to **Location and contact info** and enter your restaurant's address:
   
   * **Address:** Start typing your restaurant's street address and select it from the drop-down list.
   * **Address description:** (Optional) Enter an address description to help customers find you (e.g. rear entrance).
   * **Location name:** Enter a unique name for this restaurant location.
3. Enter your restaurant's contact details:
   
   * **Email:** Enter your restaurant's email address.
   * **Phone:** Enter your phone number.
   * **Fax:** Add your fax number.
4. Click **Save**.

**Important:** Make sure that the red pin on the map accurately marks your restaurant's location after entering the address.

If you encounter issues with the address or phone number, such as "Hmm... we can't find that address," try entering only the city (or country) and add the full address in the **Address Description** field. For phone numbers, ensure the area code matches your restaurant's location and enter the number as it would be dialed locally.

question: How can I connect Isracard powered by PayMe as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Isracard powered by PayMe as a payment provider on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard. 

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **See Options** next to **Third-Party Credit/Debit Card Providers**.
4. Click **Connect** next to **Isracard powered by PayMe**.
5. Create a new Isracard powered by PayMe account:
   
   1. Click [**Create Isracard powered by PayMe account**](https://wix2.isracard-global.com/system/kyc/signup/66409b0527901f003f5b292a).
   2. Fill in the registration form.
   3. Wait for a message from Isracard powered by PayMe to get your API Key. 
      
      **Note:** The API key will be received only after the account is verified with Isracard/PayMe, the verification process may take several business days.

6. Repeat steps 1-4 and enter the API key you received and your email address under **Account information**.
7. (Optional) Enable the **Installments** toggle to allow your customers to pay in installments.
8. Click **Connect**.

question: How can I increase my SMS quota on Wix?
answer:
To increase your SMS quota, you can either upgrade your existing site plan or purchase a standalone Wix SMS plan. Here are the steps to do so:

1. [Go to SMS Settings](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/wix-sms?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+SMS+Settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Choose what to do:

### Purchase an SMS plan
1. Click **Get More Texts**.
2. Click **Select** under the plan you would like to purchase:
   * **Starter:** 500 monthly texts
   * **Essentials:** 1,000 monthly texts
   * **Professional:** 2,500 monthly texts
   
   **Note:** At this time, the Professional plan is the largest plan we offer, but if your business requires more texts, you can [request it](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-sms-request-larger-sms-quota).
3. Enter your payment details and click **Submit Purchase**.

### Upgrade your site plan
1. Click **Manage Plan**.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon.
3. Select **Upgrade plan**.
4. Click **Select** under the plan you would like to purchase.
5. Choose the subscription period and click **Continue to Checkout**.
6. Enter your payment details and click **Submit Purchase**.

question: How can I accept payment for a booked session using Wix Retail POS?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that the session is scheduled for today and that you have access to the Wix Retail POS tablet.

To accept payment for a booked session using Wix Retail POS, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Select a session
1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Checkout** on the bottom bar.
3. Tap **Schedule** on the left.
4. Tap the relevant session.
5. (Optional) Mark attendance or edit the sale:
   * Tap **Actions**.
     + **Edit sale:** Remove a session from an order with multiple sessions.
     + **Mark attendance:** Mark the customer as **Checked-in** or **No-show**.

### Step 2 | Accept payment and complete checkout
1. Tap **Continue to Payment**.
2. (Optional) Edit the payment amount.
3. Tap **Charge**.
4. Choose the relevant payment method:

#### Accept credit card payment
1. Tap **Card**.
2. Use the card reader to swipe, dip (insert) or tap the card.
   * **Note:** Swiping is not available for all card readers.
3. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
   * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
   * Tap **Print Receipt**.
   * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
4. Tap **Done**.

#### Accept cash payment
1. Tap **Cash**.
2. Select the amount received from your customer.
   * **Note:** If you can't find the right amount, tap **Other** to enter a custom amount.
3. (If applicable) Give your customer their change listed under **Change Due**.
4. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
   * Tap **Print Receipt**.
   * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
   * Tap **Text Receipt**, enter the number, including country code, and tap **Text Receipt**.
   * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
5. Tap **Done**.

#### Accept payment by gift card
1. Tap **Gift Card**.
2. Enter or scan the gift card code and tap **Apply**.
3. If there is still money owed to complete the purchase, Tap **Add Payment** and process the balance using another payment method, such as cash or a credit card.
4. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
   * Tap **Print Receipt**.
   * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
   * Tap **Text Receipt**, enter the number, including country code, and tap **Text Receipt**.
   * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
5. Tap **Done**.

#### Manually enter credit card details
1. Tap **Manual Card Entry**.
2. Enter all the credit card details and tap **Charge**.
3. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
   * Tap **Print Receipt**.
   * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
   * Tap **Text Receipt**, enter the number, including country code, and tap **Text Receipt**.
   * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
4. Tap **Done**.

#### Accept split payment (more than one payment method)
1. Tap **Split Total** at the top right.
2. Enter the first payment amount.
3. Tap **Continue**.
4. Select a payment method (e.g. cash) and complete the first part of the payment.
5. Tap **Continue**.
6. (Optional) Edit the second payment amount.
   * **Tip:** To balance left to pay is calculated for you. You can edit the amount if the customer wants to split the payment into more than 2 payments.
7. Tap **Continue**.
8. Select a payment method (e.g. card) and complete the 2nd part of the payment.
9. Tap **Continue**.
10. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
    * Tap **Print Receipt**.
    * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
    * Tap **Text Receipt**, enter the number, including country code, and tap **Text Receipt**.
    * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
11. Tap **Done**.

#### Accepting partial payment (deposit)
1. Tap **Split Total** at the top right.
2. Enter the first payment amount.
3. Tap **Continue**.
4. Select a payment method (e.g. cash) and complete the first part of the payment.
5. Tap **Continue**.
6. Tap **Mark as Partially Paid**.
7. Tap **Mark as Partially Paid** to confirm.
8. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
    * Tap **Print Receipt**.
    * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
    * Tap **Text Receipt**, enter the number, including country code, and tap **Text Receipt**.
    * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
9. Tap **Done**.

#### Accepting other types of payment
1. Tap **Other**.
2. Enter a brief note documenting how the customer paid you (e.g. Venmo payment).
   * **Note:** The note appears in customer's receipts and in the Sales History tab in the tablet.
3. Tap **Record Payment**.
4. (Optional) Do one or more of the following:
    * Tap **Print Receipt**.
    * Tap **Email Receipt**, enter the email address if prompted, and tap **Send**.
    * Tap **Text Receipt**, enter the number, including country code, and tap **Text Receipt**.
    * Tap **Add a Note:** Enter an internal note (not visible to your customer) and tap **Save**.
5. Tap **Done**.

**Notes:**

question: How can I ensure my Wix site is compliant with the CCPA, especially regarding user data requests?
answer:
To ensure your Wix site is compliant with the CCPA, you need to take several steps:

1. **Create a Privacy Policy**: You must let your customers know how you collect, store, and use their data in a clear and transparent way. A privacy policy is a statement that discloses the ways in which your website gathers, uses, discloses, and manages your site-visitors' data. [Learn how to create a Privacy Policy](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-privacy-policy).

2. **Add a "Do Not Sell Data" Link**: The CCPA requires that Californian residents may request that their personal information is not shared with a third party. You can use the [Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20App%20Market&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/998ca89b-f566-4313-9143-2ab11a22a16d/app-market/) to add a Do Not Sell Data Link to your site's footer. Learn more about [adding a Do Not Sell Data link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-do-not-sell-data-link-to-your-wix-site).

3. **Use Wix Tools to Get a Copy of or Permanently Delete Your Site-Visitors' Data**: In accordance with the CCPA, site-visitors have the right to get a copy of their data or have it permanently deleted from your databases. Wix has developed tools to assist you in becoming CCPA compliant:
   - **Right to access**: [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/gdpr-about-your-customers-data#getting-a-copy-of-your-customers-data).
   - **Right to be deleted**: [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/gdpr-about-your-customers-data#permanently-deleting-your-customers-data).
   - **Right to opt-out of the sale of personal information**: [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-do-not-sell-data-link-to-your-wix-site).

By following these steps, you can help ensure that your Wix site is compliant with the CCPA and that you are respecting the rights of your site visitors.

question: How can I create event coupons using the Wix app?
answer:
To create a coupon from the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down to **Marketing** and tap **Coupons**.
4. Tap **Add a Coupon**.
5. Select an option:
   * Tap **$ Discount**, enter the amount (e.g. $10 off), then tap **Next**.
   * Tap **% Discount**, enter the percentage (e.g. 10% off), then tap **Next**.
6. Enter the coupon code. 
   
   **Note:** This is the code customers enter.
7. Enter the name of the coupon. 
   
   **Note:** Appears in the cart page and dashboard.
8. Tap **Next**.
9. Choose which tickets the coupon applies to:
   * **All tickets:** Clients can use the coupon when buying any event tickets.
   * **Specific event:** Clients can use the coupon when buying any tickets for a selected event. Select the event and tap **Next**.
   * **Specific ticket:** Clients can use the coupon when buying a ticket type for a specific event (e.g. student tickets). Select the relevant event and ticket type, then tap **Next**.
10. Choose how many times a customer can apply the coupon to an order:
    * **Apply to the lowest priced item**: If customer buys more than one relevant ticket, the discount applies only once.
    * **Apply to every item in the order**: All relevant tickets in the same order receive the discount.
11. Set the coupon's start and end date:
    1. Tap the date.
    2. Select the start date from the calendar.
    3. Enter the end date or tap **No end date**.
    4. Tap **Save**.
12. (Optional) Apply limits to the number of times the coupon can be used:
    * Limit number of total uses:
      1. Tap the **Limit number of total uses** toggle to enable it.
      2. Enter the number of times the coupon can be used.
13. Tap **Done**.

### Tip
Tap **Share** to share your new coupon on social media, through email, and more.

question: How can I verify my Cloudflare settings to ensure my domain is properly connected to Wix?
answer:
To verify your Cloudflare settings for connecting a domain to Wix, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your [Cloudflare](http://cloudflare.com/) account.
2. Go to the Websites tab and click on your domain name.
3. Go to the DNS tab and scroll down to your A and CNAME records in the DNS management section.
4. Under the Proxy Status, make sure that both A records and CNAME records are set to **DNS Only**.

**Note:** If your records are set to **DNS Only**, you don't need to do anything else. Your domain will function normally with Wix (as long as your DNS records are configured correctly with your domain registrar as well).

question: What should I do if I can't sign into my Wix account because I've lost access to my phone and haven't enabled 2-Step Verification for email?
answer:
If you are unable to sign into your Wix account because you have lost access to your mobile phone and have not enabled [2-Step Verification for email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-2-step-verification-for-your-wix-account#enabling-2-step-verification), please fill out our [ownership verification form](https://users.wix.com/account-recovery/reset-account-information). 

### Important
- Don't forget to provide us with a valid contact email so we can respond to you.

Our team will review your request. We'll contact you if any further information is required for the verification process.

### Notes
- After account recovery, you will need to [re-enable 2-Step Verification](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-2-step-verification-for-your-wix-account#enabling-2-step-verification) to continue using it. We recommend enabling both phone and email options.
- Wix reserves the right to determine and/or grant ownership to an account or site based on our reasonable judgment. We also reserve the right to deny granting access to a user who lost the account credentials, in our sole discretion, without liability to any party.

question: How can I prevent unwanted gaps and horizontal scroll bars in Editor X?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to Editor X and are familiar with navigating the Layers panel and Inspector panel.

To prevent unwanted gaps and horizontal scroll bars in Editor X, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Find elements to re-position in the Layers panel
1. Click **Layers** at the top of Editor X.
2. Click on any element to find it on the page.
3. Re-position the element using the following tools:
   * Drag and drop it to the right place.
   * Use the handles to decrease the size of the element.
   * [Adjust the margins](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-working-with-docking-and-margins#using-margins-for-positioning-elements) or [resize the element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-setting-the-size-of-your-element) from the **Inspector** panel.

### Step 2 | Check the edges of your page
Click each section and hover over all of the elements close to the edges of the page. If any of them are overflowing, you can move or resize them.

### Step 3 | Change the page's Overflow Content setting
1. Select your page:
   1. Go to the relevant page.
   2. Click **Layers** at the top of Editor X.
   3. Click **Page**.
2. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
3. Click the Layout tab.
4. Select **Hide** from the **Overflow content** drop-down.

### Step 4 | Check the section's height
1. Select the relevant section.
2. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
3. Click the **Layout** tab.
4. Check the **Height** and **Min H** settings under **Size**.

question: How can I set the image quality for individual media in the Wix Pro Gallery?

     **Note:** The higher the image quality, the longer it takes for your media to load. It is not recommended that you increase the image quality to above 90.

question: How can I ensure my Wix site is GDPR-compliant when it comes to cookies?
answer:
To ensure your Wix site is GDPR-compliant regarding cookies, you need to get affirmative consent from site visitors before placing non-essential cookies on their device. Here are the steps you can follow:

1. **Use the Wix Privacy Center**: You can add a cookie banner to your site using the [Wix Privacy Center](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText%3DOpen%2520Privacy%2520Center%26title%3DSelect%2520a%2520Site%26autoSelectOnSingleSite%3Dtrue%26actionUrl%3Dhttps://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/cookie-consent-settings-app&sa=D&ust=1590402322732000&usg=AFQjCNEFGEHzuyYvapkamLp7NiR8vQG1Rg). This allows your visitors to give their consent to non-essential cookies being placed on their device.

2. **Add a 'Decline All' Button**: If your site is based in France, or has French site visitors, it is recommended to add a 'Decline All' button to your cookie banner, as per the guidelines from the French data authority ([CNIL](https://www.cnil.fr/)).

3. **Learn More About Cookies**: You can learn more about [which cookies are placed on your site-visitors' browsers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cookies-and-your-wix-site) to ensure compliance.

By following these steps, you can help ensure that your Wix site meets GDPR requirements for cookies.

question: What information is not imported when transferring my menu to the new Wix Menus app?
answer:
When importing your menu to the new app, certain parts of the data are not copied over. Here's a summary of what's included and excluded:

- **Menus**: Yes
- **Sections**: Yes
- **Items**: Yes
- **Variants**: Yes
- **Modifier Groups & Modifiers**: Partially
- **Labels**: Yes
- **Specials**: Yes
- **Archive**: No
- **Online Orders properties**: Partially

### Archive
Archived information is not imported to the new app.

### Online Orders properties

question: How do I create a new SMS automation using my business phone number?
answer:
To create a new SMS automation using your business phone number, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation**.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**. 

   **Note:** To use a suggested automation, search for a keyword (e.g. "SMS") and select from the relevant options. You can edit the trigger and actions of a suggested automation.
4. Click the title at the top to give your automation a name.
5. Choose a [trigger](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-2-choose-a-trigger).
6. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   
   * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
   * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
   * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
7. (Optional) [Add a delay](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-3-optional-add-a-delay) between a trigger and its action, to have the action occur after a certain amount of time passes.
8. (Optional) [Add a condition](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-4-optional-add-a-condition) to make the automation occur when certain conditions are met.
9. Set up your action:
   
   1. Select **Send SMS via business number** as the [action](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation#step-5-choose-an-action) that occurs as a result of the trigger.
   2. Select **Customer phone number** in the **To:** drop-down.
   3. Compose your message.
10. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** to add a chain of [follow-up actions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-multi-action-automation) from the initial action.
11. Click **Activate** to save and activate the automation.

**Notes:**
* SMS automations only work if the person who triggered it has a phone number listed in their contact details.
* Your automated SMS message may be a [transactional message](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-transactional-sms-messages-best-practices) that informs your customers about the product or service they have purchased. Based on how it is written, it could be filtered or blocked.

question: How can I add and set up a lightbox on my site using the ADI Builder?
answer:
### Adding a Lightbox
To add a lightbox to your site, follow these steps:
1. Click the **Add** drop-down at the top left of the builder.
2. Click **Page**.
3. Select **Lightbox**.
4. Hover over your favorite design and click **Add This Page.**

### Setting Up Your Lightbox
To set up your lightbox, follow these steps:
1. Click on the lightbox in the ADI Builder to open the design and settings panel.
2. Click **Edit** to change the lightbox's text and media settings.
   - **Title:** Choose the header or main action item you want people to take such as Subscribe, Join, or Welcome.
   - **Subtitle:** Add a subtitle beneath the main header.
   - **Paragraph:** Use this space to encourage visitors to sign up, promote a sale, or further describe the lightbox's purpose.
   - **Media:** Edit the lightbox image. Click **Edit & Replace** to change the image, adjust it, or link the image to another page or URL.
   - **Buttons:** Change the button text and link the button to a page or URL. You can also add multiple buttons by clicking **+ Add Button.**

   **Note:** To hide any text or media element from your lightbox, deselect the blue checkmark beside the element.
3. Click **Design** to change the layout and design of your lightbox.
   - Scroll to see the different options for lightbox layouts including recommended designs. Hover over a design and click **Use This Layout** to update the lightbox.
   - (Optional) You can also click the **Customize Section Design** drop-down under the current layout to make text and color changes.
4. Click **Settings** to customize how your lightbox appears on your site and choose what page it shows up on.
   - Enable the **Automatically show lightbox** toggle to make the lightbox appear on your site.
   - Click the text field under **Which Pages Is It On?** to choose the page(s) where the lightbox shows up. For example, if it's a welcome lightbox, select **Home** to have it pop up only on the homepage. Or you can select **All Pages** to have the lightbox appear on every page.

   **Note:** Choose the placement of your lightbox carefully. Visitors may get frustrated if a pop-up appears on every page of your site.
   - Click and drag the **Delay** slider to choose how many seconds someone can view your site before the lightbox appears. You can also input a number in the number field at the right.

question: Can customers change the quantity of a specific optional extra added to a dish in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
Currently, customers cannot adjust or manually enter the quantity of an optional extra added to a dish. For example, if you allow customers ordering a burger to select how many ketchup packets to include with their order.

In the meantime, you can add multiple versions of the same optional extra (e.g., First Condiment Option, Second Condiment Option) when creating the dish. This allows customers to add the same optional extra more than once.

### To add multiple versions of the same optional extra:
1. Go to **Menus** in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant dish and click the **Edit** icon or click **New Dish** to add a new one.
3. Add the first option:
   
   1. Click **New Option** on the left.
   2. Enter the name of the first option in the **Name** field (e.g., First Condiment Option).
   3. Select **Extras**.
   4. Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the first choice (e.g., Ketchup).
   5. Click **New Choice**.
   6. Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the second choice (e.g., Mayonnaise).
   7. (Optional) Repeat steps e - f to add additional choices.
4. Add the second option:
   
   1. Click **New Option** on the left.
   2. Enter the name of the second option in the **Name** field (e.g., Second Condiment Option).
   3. Select **Extras**.
   4. Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the first choice (e.g., Ketchup).
   5. Click **New Choice**.
   6. Enter the name and price (if applicable) of the second choice (e.g., Mayonnaise).
   7. (Optional) Repeat steps 8 - 9 to add additional choices.
5. (Optional) Repeat step 5 to add another version of the option (e.g., Third Condiment Option).
6. Click **Save Changes** if you are editing an existing dish or **Add Dish** if you are adding a new dish.

Now, when your customer orders this dish, they can select the same optional extra twice (two Ketchup packets) or select two different optional extras (one Ketchup and one Mayonnaise).

question: How can I book a session and accept payment using Wix Retail POS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure that you have checked the availability of the service provider on your booking calendar on desktop or in the Wix app.

### To add bookings to the cart:
1. Open the POS tablet.
2. Tap **Checkout** on the bottom bar.
3. Tap **Services**.
4. Tap the relevant service.
5. (Optional) Add additional services, [store products, or a custom charge](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-retail-pos-making-a-sale#step-1-add-products-or-charges-to-the-cart).

### To assign a customer to the sale:
1. Tap **Select Customer**.
2. Select an option:
   * **Create a new customer**: Tap **+New Customer**, enter the details, and tap **Save**.
   * **Select a saved customer:** Search for the customer's name, email, or phone number or scroll down and select the customer.

### To accept payment:
1. Tap **Charge** at the bottom right.
2. Choose the relevant payment method:
   - **Accept credit card payment**:
     1. Tap **Card**.
     2. Use the card reader to swipe, dip (insert) or tap the card.
     3. (Optional) Tap **Email Receipt**, **Print Receipt**, or **Add a Note**.
     4. Tap **Done**.
   - **Accept cash payment**:
     1. Tap **Cash**.
     2. Select the amount received from your customer.
     3. (If applicable) Give your customer their change listed under **Change Due**.
     4. (Optional) Tap **Print Receipt**, **Email Receipt**, **Text Receipt**, or **Add a Note**.
     5. Tap **Done**.
   - **Accept payment by gift card**:
     1. Tap **Gift Card**.
     2. Enter or scan the gift card code and tap **Apply**.
     3. If there is still money owed, click **Add Payment** and process the balance using another payment method.
     4. (Optional) Tap **Print Receipt**, **Email Receipt**, **Text Receipt**, or **Add a Note**.
     5. Tap **Done**.

After payment is completed, the service is added to your calendar. The service provider is set as the default staff member and the date is the current date. The time is added in the past since sessions are often paid for upon completion.

question: How can I create a new CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To create a new CMS collection in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **CMS** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f0656688-8ed1-488a-888d-62373b7c3a3c/2021/07/13/be1f7f18-9356-4c33-b010-192982c912e9/59fd7aba-c990-4d61-ab3d-ad7d2e1cce16.png) on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Create Collection**.
4. Click **Start from scratch**.

   **Tip:** Alternatively, click **Create with AI** to [let AI (Artificial Intelligence) create a collection for you](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-a-collection-using-ai).
5. Click **Next**.
6. Enter a name for your collection.
7. Select an option to choose how many items you want in the collection:

   * **Multiple items (Default):** Manage multiple pages or lists of items with the same layout like projects or services. You can add many items and store massive amounts of content in this collection type that is suited for dynamic pages and elements.
   * **A single item:** Manage content for static pages and sections like a homepage or a promotional banner. This type of collection is best suited for static pages because it has just one item you can add fields to. Learn more about [single item collections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-single-item-collection).
8. Click **Create**.
9. Add fields to your collection manually or by importing a CSV file:

   * **Add fields manually:** Click **\+ Add Field** to begin [adding fields to your collection manually](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-a-field-to-a-collection).
   * **Import a CSV file:** Click **Import CSV file** to [upload a CSV file to your collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-importing-content-into-a-collection) and use its fields and items in the collection. This option is not available for single item collections.
10. (Optional) Add items to your collection unless you want to [store user submissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-a-custom-form-with-input-elements-that-submit-to-your-collection) in it:

    1. Click **\+ Add Item** at the top right.

       **Note:** Alternatively, you can click **\+ Add Item** at the bottom of your collection. When using the Table view and clicking **\+ Add Item** at the bottom, each field is automatically saved as you work.
    2. Enter details about the item in all the relevant fields and click **Save**.
    3. Repeat these steps to add more items to the collection.

question: How can I create a new blog category in Wix Blog?
answer:
To create a new blog category in Wix Blog, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Categories](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Categories&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/blog/categories) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **New Category**.

   **Note:** Your blog comes with a few default categories, click **Edit** to customize one.
3. Enter the category details:
   
   * **Category Label:** The label appears on your blog menu and at the bottom of blog posts in this category. Make sure to keep it short and informative.
   * **Category URL Slug:** This is the URL of the blog category which readers can see in the browser bar (and use to access the category directly). By default, it takes the category label as the slug (end of the URL), but you can edit it if you need to.

   **Note:** The URL slug must be at least two characters long and can't have more than one slash. For example, you can change the slug to **recipes/vegetables**, but you cannot change it to **recipes/vegetables/tomatoes**.
4. Enter the SEO and social sharing settings of the category. This info appears in search engines and when you share the category on social media.
   
   * **Category title:** Enter a title that describes your category. It does not have to be the same as the category label.
   * **Category description:** Enter a description for the category so readers know what to expect when they find your category on Google or see it shared on social media.
   * **Category image:** Adding an image is optional, this image appears when you share the category on social media.
5. Click **Save**.

**Tip:** You can also create a new category as you're creating your blog post. Click the **Categories** tab on the left of any blog post to assign and create new categories.

question: What are the initial steps and considerations for exporting products from Mexico to the United States using a Wix Store?
answer:
To start exporting your Wix Store products from Mexico to the United States, you should first familiarize yourself with the export requirements in Mexico. You can learn about the exportation of products out of Mexico through the [official Customs Services Portal](http://omawww.sat.gob.mx/aduanasPortal/Paginas/index.html#!/) and the [official Import and Export guide](http://omawww.sat.gob.mx/aduanasPortal/Paginas/index.html#!/guia_importacion), which includes information about the structure of the general administration of customs and procedures and requirements for exportation of goods out of Mexico.

Additionally, consider the following:

- **Packaging and labeling:** Ensure the type of packaging, materials, environmental conditions, package durability, buyer's specifications, labeling, and government regulations are all considered.
- **Means of transport:** Determine the international means of transport and the freight rates.
- **Product Price:** Calculate the export price of your product.
- **International sales contract:** Consider having an international sales contract to protect against legal risks related to international trade.
- **Payment method:** Decide on the most convenient payment method for making or receiving payments for merchandise.

For the importation process into the United States, comply with the importation process determined by the [U.S. Customs and Border Protection](https://www.cbp.gov/), which varies based on the merchandise imported. Basic instructions can be found in the [CBP guide](https://www.cbp.gov/trade/basic-import-export), and additional [tips](https://www.cbp.gov/trade/basic-import-export/importer-exporter-tips) are available on their website.

Once your online store is published, ensure you [set up store shipping](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-a-guide-to-setting-up-shipping-delivery-and-pickup) to handle potential shipments abroad.

question: How can I view Wix Pricing Plans events in Google Analytics?

To see Pricing Plans events in Google Analytics, follow these steps:
