question: How can I ensure my 301 redirects are set up correctly and avoid redirect loops?
answer:
To test whether you've set up your 301 redirect correctly, type your customized URL into your browser's address bar. If everything is set up correctly, you should be redirected to the defined destination page. Make sure that your domain is properly connected to Wix, otherwise the 301 redirect does not function properly.

### About redirect loops
A redirect loop happens when you create a redirect for a URL that goes back to a URL that you've already previously created a redirect for. This makes a constant loop where the two redirects compete with each other in a never-ending cycle.

For example, if your page's URL slug was originally "/about" and you changed it to "/about-us" and set up a redirect, then later changed it back to "/about" and tried to create a new redirect from "/about-us" to "/about", this would create a loop. 

- The second redirect would tell the URL Redirect Manager to redirect from "/about-us" to "/about".
- The first redirect would tell the URL Redirect Manager to redirect from "/about" to "/about-us" again.

You'll see an error message if you try to create the second redirect. In this situation, delete your original redirect since your page's URL is now what it originally was. If you still want to create a new redirect, you will need to enter a different URL to redirect to.

### Tip
You can check your domain connection using the [Wix Domain Troubleshooter](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-domain-assistant-3777632).

question: How can I perform a traceroute on my Windows computer to troubleshoot live site issues?
answer:
To perform a traceroute on your Windows computer, follow these steps:

1. Right-click the **Start** menu and select **Run**.
2. Type **cmd**, and then click **OK**.
3. Enter your domain in the cmd window:
   
   * **If you have a domain connected to your site**: Type **tracert www.domain.com** (replace **domain.com** with your own domain name).
   * **If you have a free site**: Type **tracert site-url-prefix.wixsite.com** (replace "site-url-prefix" with your [Site URL prefix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-wix-account-details#changing-your-account-details), located in your account settings).
4. Press **Enter** on your keyboard.
5. Take a [screenshot](https://support.wix.com/en/article/taking-a-screenshot-using-windows) of the information.
6. [Send your screenshot to Wix Customer Care](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-screenshot-to-a-ticket).

question: How can I set up a loyalty program on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have upgraded to a plan that includes accepting payments to launch the program.

### Step 1 | Create your loyalty program
1. [Go to Loyalty Program](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Loyalty%20Program&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/loyalty-accounts/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Start Now**.
3. Enter your program info:
   * **Program name:** Enter your loyalty program name.
   * **Points name:** Choose the term you want to use to describe "points" on your site.
   * **Points icon:** Select a loyalty points icon or upload your own.
4. Click **Continue to Setup**.

### Step 2 | Choose how members earn points
1. Click the **Points and rewards** tab.
2. Hover over the relevant **Ways to earn** method and click **Edit**.
3. Edit the following details:
   * **Let customers know how to earn points:** Describe an action that will earn points.
   * **Customer earns:** Set the number of points earned for this action.
4. Click **Save**.
5. Repeat for each way to earn you'd like to edit.

### Step 3 | Set up loyalty rewards
1. On the **Points and rewards** tab, scroll down to **Rewards**.
2. Create a new reward or edit an existing reward:
   * Create new reward: Click **+ Create New Reward**.
   * Edit existing reward: Hover over the relevant reward and click **Edit**.
3. Edit your reward coupon:
   * **Select what reward you want to offer:** Select percentage discount, monetary discount or free shipping.
   * **Reward name:** Enter the reward name that will be listed on your site.
   * **Apply to:** Choose whether to make this coupon valid against all or specific purchases.
   * Set the discount your coupon offers and/or the points it costs a customer.
4. Click **Save**.
5. Repeat for each reward you'd like to add or edit.

### Step 4 | Decide whether to activate email automations
1. Click the **Email automations** tab.
2. Click the **Status** toggle to choose what you want to do:
   * **Active:** Customers will automatically receive an email when they earn a reward.
   * **Inactive:** Customers will not automatically receive an email when they earn a reward.

### Step 5 | Review your loyalty program
1. Click the **Program info** tab.
2. Review your **Program details** and click **Edit Details** to make any changes.
3. Review your **Program overview** and click the **Points and rewards** or **Email automations** tab to make any changes.
4. Click **Launch Program** in the top right.
5. Click **Launch Program** in the pop-up.

### Step 6 | View your new site pages
1. Click **View in Editor** at the top of the screen.
2. To view your new Loyalty and My Rewards pages, [navigate](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-navigating-between-your-site-pages) to them by clicking the Switch Page panel on the top left of the Editor.

question: How can I customize the appearance of my invoices in Wix?
answer:
To customize your invoices in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Invoices](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Invoices&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/invoices/invoices/list?referralInfo=KB-Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More Actions** at the top right.
3. Select **Update invoice settings**.
4. Choose what you want to customize:
   
   **Header details**
   - **Document name and number:** Set the name that appears in the top right of your invoice and the numbering that appears beside this name. 
     
     **Note:** Once you set the invoice number, it cannot be changed to a lower number.
   - **Logo:** Your business logo is taken from your site's [Business Info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information). Any edits you make to your logo will be automatically reflected in your invoices.
   - **Header fields:** Choose the details to include in your header, such as reference number or sales representative. You can also create custom fields. 
     
     **Note:** You will add information to these fields when you're creating a new invoice.

   **Business info**
   - The details you see in this section are taken from your site's [Business Info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information). You can edit this business info and also add custom fields (e.g. Tax ID, IBAN) that you want to appear in your invoices.

   **Tax display**
   - Click to select the relevant checkboxes to control how you display taxes on your invoices. 
     
     **Note:** If you select none of the options below, your invoices just show total taxes. 
     - **Additional tax column:** Display tax next to each invoice item. 
     - **Tax breakdown in the Total section:** Display all taxes in their own section at the end of the invoice. 
     - **Display Items subtotal per tax group:** Display taxes according to their tax group at the end of the invoice.

   **Payments received**
   - Click to enable the **Show transaction details** checkbox to include breakdowns of payments made. These breakdowns include payment date, method and amount.

   **Footer notes**
   - Add notes or terms for your customers. These will appear at the bottom of your invoices.

**Tips:**
- To update your invoice language, [update your account language](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-the-language-of-your-account-dashboard-and-editor) in your site's dashboard. This affects all invoices.
- If you have an online store, you can [add store products to an invoice](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-invoices-for-store-orders#creating-an-invoice-from-scratch). A store order is automatically created when this invoice is issued.
- Manage and edit additional business info (e.g., contact info and business location) in [Business Info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information) in your site's dashboard.

question: Why was my Wix Payments account closed and what can I do about it?
answer:
Your Wix Payments account may be closed if it is deemed to be in breach of the [Wix Payments terms of service](https://www.wix.com/about/terms-of-payments). This can happen if:

- You fail to provide the necessary information and documentation during onboarding or when requested later.
- Your account receives an excessive number of fraudulent transactions.
- You are selling goods or services listed in the [prohibited products and services list](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-prohibited-products-and-services).

Once your account is closed, any credit remaining in your account is refunded to the credit card owner (the customer).

**Tips:**
- You can check your [Wix Payments account status](https://support.wix.com/en/article/understanding-the-status-of-your-wix-payments-account) at the top left of your Wix Payments dashboard.
- You can still [access your Wix Payments dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-the-wix-payments-dashboard-after-disconnecting-your-account), even if your Wix Payments account has been disconnected.

2. Click **Partner Dashboard** at the top.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Select **Team Management**.
5. Enter the email addresses of the team members you want to invite.
6. Select a role for your team member under **Roles & Site Access**.
   
   **Tip:** You can also click **Create New Role** if you need to create [a custom role](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-partners-creating-custom-roles-for-your-team-management-account).

7. Select the level of access that the team members have on your account:
   
   * **All sites and folders:** They can access every site and folder on your account.
   * **Specific sites or folders:** You can choose which sites and folders they have access to.

8. (Optional) Click **Add another role on different sites** if you want to give them a different role and level of access on another one of your sites.
9. Click **Send Invite**.

You can send invites to up to 50 email addresses at a time. After you send the invite, your team members receive an email with an invite link to your account's SSO login page.

question: Why is a member not appearing on the Members page in my Wix Blog site?
answer:
There are a number of reasons why you may not see a particular member on the Members page, who you expected to see there:

* **Member was approved, but hasn't logged in:** A member asked to join your site. You approved the member, but they haven't logged in after receiving approval. This member will appear on the members page only after they sign in for the first time.
* **Member accepted invite, but hasn't logged in:** You sent an invite but the person hasn't logged in since they received it. This member will appear on the members page only after they sign in for the first time.
* **Member hasn't joined the community:** Besides logging in, members need to join your community to appear on the Members page. The Community is an opt-in feature that allows your members to decide whether their information can be viewed by other members. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-setting-member-profile-privacy-when-signing-up)

### Tips
* You can encourage members to join the community by setting the **Join this site's community** checkbox to be selected by default. [Learn How](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-setting-member-profile-privacy-when-signing-up#to-set-the-checkbox-to-be-selected-by-default)
* You can check if a member has signed in to your site by [going to the Site Members tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Members&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/member-permissions/members) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I invite people to join my site using the Wix app?
answer:
To invite people to your site from the Wix app on your mobile device, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Tap **Mobile App**.
4. Tap the **Invite new members** tab.
5. Choose to invite people using the following methods:

### Email Wix Contacts
Send an email to the contacts saved in your Wix account.
1. Tap the available email provider (e.g. Gmail).
2. Customize your email:
   * **To:** Choose who should receive your email; all your contacts, or manually select contacts.
   * **Title:** Enter the title that appears at the top of your email.
   * **Message:** Write a short message telling your contacts why they should join you on the mobile app.
3. Tap **Send**.

### Send an SMS
Send the link and invite code to people by SMS (text message).
1. Tap **Send an SMS**.
2. Select the contacts you want to invite.
3. Tap Send in the message field on your phone.

### Share via social networks
Share the link and invitation code to any social network connected to your phone.
1. Choose how you want to send your invite to. For example, Facebook, WhatsApp, or Gmail.

question: How can I ensure my logo design looks good in all sizes according to Wix's best practices?
answer:
To ensure your logo design looks good in all sizes, follow these tips:

- Make sure that your logo looks good in all sizes, from large to small. Try to zoom out or check it in a small size like it normally appears on your brand materials, and check that everything is clear, and the text is readable.
- Avoid overlapping text when designing your logo, as the texts blend into one color and are unreadable in some files. This happens in the following file types:
  
  + **Standard logo files:** Black on Transparent, Black on White, White on Black and White on Transparent.
  + **Resizable vector files:** Black and White.

Additionally, ensure that the elements contrast against their background to prevent them from looking pixelated in small sizes. Be cautious with extremely thin font weights or thin-lined icons and shapes, as they can look blurred or even invisible in small sizes.

question: How can I request a refund for a new Wix Premium or Studio plan, and what are the conditions?
answer:
Wix offers a 14-day, money-back guarantee for new [Premium](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan) or [Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-upgrading-sites) site plans. If you purchased your site plan within the last 14 days, you're eligible for a full refund. 

### Eligibility for a refund
The 14-day refund policy only applies to **new** Premium or Studio plans. The refund policy does not apply if:
* You are requesting a refund for a plan renewal.
* You are requesting a refund for the upgrade of an existing plan.

If you do not meet the requirements for the 14-day refund policy, but you believe you still deserve a refund, [contact us](https://www.wix.com/contact) and we'll review your request.

### Request process for a refund
Cancel your site plan within the first 14 days of purchasing it to receive a full refund. There's no need to submit a request, simply click the button below to choose a plan to cancel. If you're eligible, your payment method will be refunded automatically. Please allow up to 20 business days for your refund to appear on your credit card statement.

After canceling, your site plan is immediately deactivated and you can no longer make use of Wix's premium features (e.g., removing Wix ads or connecting your own domain).

### Important
Wix is not responsible for any bank charges, commissions or overdrafts. The only way to remove these charges is through direct negotiation with your bank.

question: How can I add a custom element to my Editor X site and set it up with a server URL or Velo file?

      * **Server URL:** Click this option and enter the URL, including the file name.

question: What are the requirements for uploading a photo ID for Wix Payments verification?
answer:
Your photo ID must meet the following requirements:

* Your photo ID can be a passport, driver's license or a government issued ID card
* Your photo ID must be active and non-expired
* The photo must be in color
* Your ID must show all 4 borders and corners
* The ID must not have information blocked or blacked out
* The ID must be straightened, not angled or rotated
* The ID must not be blurry, overexposed or copied from another source (e.g. screenshot)
* Your first, middle and last name in your Wix Payments account must match those of your ID
* Your birth date in your Wix Payments account must match that of your ID
* For passports with a Machine-Readable Zone (MRZ), the MRZ must be visible.
* For driver's licenses or government issue ID cards, send a separate file for each side
* Documents must be sent in one of the following: HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, PNG
* The maximum file size is 10 MB
* The minimum file size is 1 KB for PDF, 100 KB for other formats

question: How can I add and set up a checkout requirement in Wix Stores using the Checkout Requirements app?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added the Checkout Requirements app to your Wix site.

To create a checkout requirement:

1. [Go to Checkout Requirements](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Checkout%20Requirements&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/wix-ecom-validation-rules/Rules/list) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add Requirement**.
3. Enter a requirement name (e.g. 2-candle minimum). 

   **Note:** Customers won't see this name.
4. Select the type of requirement you want to create:
   * Minimum quantity of products
   * Maximum quantity of products
   * Minimum order subtotal
5. Enter the required quantity/subtotal.
6. If you selected minimum or maximum quantity of products, select what the requirement applies to:
   * **Specific products:** Only specific product(s) count towards the minimum or maximum (e.g. if you set a 2-product minimum, customers must buy 2 of **each** of the specific products you select).
   * **All products:** The requirement applies separately to each product (e.g. if you set a 2-product minimum, customers must buy 2 of **each** product they buy, not 2 products from your shop).
7. If you selected **Specific products** in step 6, select those products. 

   **Tip:** Start typing the product name and select it from the list.
8. Choose what happens if customers don't meet the requirement:
   * **Yes, enable checkout but show a warning message:** Customers see your message explaining the requirement, but can still complete a purchase.
   * **No, disable checkout and show error message:** Customers see your message explaining why they can't complete the purchase and cannot complete a purchase.
9. Enter the message text you want your customers to see. 

   **Tip:** Make sure the message is clear and specific so that customers know what to do.

question: How can I set up a live stream from my desktop using Wix Video?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Ensure you have added a Wix Video element on the page where you want the live stream to appear and set it to display the channel the live stream will play on.
* Make sure you have an encoder before going live. This article discusses using the OBS encoder.

### Step 1 | Setting up your Live Stream
1. Go to your [Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/video-library/videos) and click **Live Stream**.
2. Click **Desktop** under **Go Live Now**.
3. Click **I Have an Encoder**.
4. Choose a Wix Video channel for your live stream.
   * Under **Video Info**, add the relevant details for your live stream:
     - Cover Image
     - Title (*This is the only mandatory field*)
     - Publisher
     - Categories
     - Tags
     - Description
   * Under **Video Pricing**, choose to monetize your stream or allow your fans to watch for free.
     - **Free**: Choose to allow anyone to watch or enable a mandatory sign-up.
     - **Paid**: Select the checkboxes for purchase or rental options.
   * Under **Show a Trailer**: Turn the toggle on and upload a file.
   * Under **More about this video**, enter more specific details like cast, crew, and mature content.
5. Click **Next** on the top right.
6. On the **Connect Stream** tab, copy the **Server URL** and **Stream key**.

### Step 2 | Open and connect your encoder
1. Open the OBS Studio Encoder on your computer.
2. Click **Settings** on the bottom right.
3. Click the **Stream** tab on the left.
4. Select **Custom Streaming Server** from the drop-down menu on top.
5. Paste each link (Server URL and Stream key) in the appropriate field.
6. Click **OK**. A feed from your camera should appear on the encoder.
7. Click **Start Streaming**. Your stream is live and online!
8. When you're done, click **Stop Streaming** on the encoder.

### Notes
* For security reasons, the stream key resets every hour.
* Wix Video only offers support for the OBS Studio encoder.

### Tip
Generate discussion and engage your fans by [enabling comments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/allowing-comments-in-wix-video).

question: How can I set up payment methods for my Wix Store?
answer:
To set up payment methods for your Wix Store, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **Accept Payments**.

In most cases, Wix automatically connects you to the most suitable provider available in your region. Options can include:

- **Wix Payments:** Connect to Wix's own Payment provider. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wix-payments)
- **Credit Card:** Connect to a third-party payment provider (e.g. Square, Stripe) to accept credit card payments. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-by-credit-card)
- **PayPal:** Accept payments through PayPal. Note that if you select the PayPal option, customers can pay by credit card even if they do not have a PayPal account. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-paypal-as-a-payment-provider)
- **Apple Pay:** Let customers on iOS devices checkout using Apple Pay. Note that the Apple Pay button is displayed only to customers viewing your site with a Safari browser on IOS or macOS devices. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-adding-apple-pay-as-a-payment-method)

**Tip:** You can add Apple Pay to your site even if you are not an Apple user.

- **Manual:** Accept cash, payment through apps, checks, bank transfers, or any other form of payment that is not tracked online. When selecting this method, customers see instructions at checkout explaining how to complete payment. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-manual-offline-payments)

question: How can I dispute a chargeback in my Wix Payments account?
answer:
To dispute a chargeback in your Wix Payments account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Your%20Transactions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpayments-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant payment to see its details.
3. Click **Get Started**.
4. Click **Dispute Chargeback** under the chargeback's details.
5. Select the product or service type of this transaction:
   * **Physical product:** Physical products delivered to your customer.
   * **Digital Product:** Digital files sent to your customer.
   * **Service:** Any service provided to a customer, either online (e.g. website design) or offline (e.g. yoga classes).
   * **Event ticket**: Tickets for events such as performances or conferences.
   * **Other**: A product or service that doesn't fall within any of the other categories.
6. Briefly describe your business and click **Continue**.
7. Begin building your case by submitting:
   * A cover letter explaining your case.
   * Relevant evidence to verify your case.
8. When ready, click **Preview & Submit Dispute** at the bottom.

**Tip**: You can click **Save Draft** if you’d prefer to complete the form later.

question: How can I add a scroll effect to the header in the Studio Editor?
answer:
To apply a scroll effect to the header in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Select the header.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2023/06/14/2dd40586-1f79-4376-aee0-387212a246bb/dfed4075-2e24-4ad8-a7c4-8857038d5f16.png) at the top right of the editor.
3. Under **Header settings**, choose a **Scroll effect** and set it up:
   - **Scroll with site**: No scroll effect is applied. When visitors scroll down the page, they also scroll away from the header.
   - **Freeze**: The header stays in place as visitors scroll down the page, so it's always visible. You can decide whether or not the header overlaps the next section while scrolling. If you set it to not overlap, you can set a top offset to create some distance between the header and the top of the page.
   - **Disappear**: As visitors scroll down the page, the header starts to disappear. You can decide whether or not the header overlaps the next section while scrolling, choose the direction for the header to disappear, set the distance, delay, duration, and ease of the effect.
   - **Fade out**: When visitors scroll down the page, the header fades out of view. You can decide whether or not the header overlaps the next section while scrolling, and set the delay and duration of the effect.

**Tip:** The scroll effect only applies to the page you're currently working on.

question: How can I cancel an event and refund guests who purchased tickets using Wix Events?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have set up how to communicate the change to guests by enabling and editing the cancelation email.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Set Up How to Communicate the Change to Guests
1. [Go to the Events tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit** on the relevant event.
3. Click the **Emails** tab.
4. Make sure the **Cancelation** toggle is enabled.
5. Click **Edit** to edit the email text.
6. Click **Save**.

#### Step 2 | Cancel Your Event
1. [Go to the Events tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the More Actions icon for the event you want to cancel.
3. Click **Cancel Event**.
4. Click **Cancel Event** to confirm.

**Tip:** If you enabled cancelation emails in step 1, an email is sent to your guests informing them of the change.

#### Step 3 | Refund Guests
1. [Go to the Events tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit** on the relevant event.
3. Click the **Orders** tab.
4. Click to select the first order you want to refund.
5. Click **Refund Order**.

**Note:** This takes you to the payment provider used to process ticket sales. Once there, you can refund your guests one by one. Make sure to keep a record of which guests you refunded.

question: How can I replace the retired 'Download My App' with a new app on my Wix site?
answer:
To replace the retired 'Download My App' with a new app on your Wix site, you can add the 'Download the Mobile App' application from the Wix App Market. Follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market/download-my-app-blocks).

question: How can I view the top selling products and understand customer spending trends using Wix Analytics?
answer:
To view the top selling products and understand customer spending trends using Wix Analytics, navigate to the **Sales Overview** page in the **Overviews** section under **Analytics** in your site's dashboard. Here, you can use the **Top stats** overview to find out what products are selling best, what items are converting the most, and what services are being booked most often. Depending on the Wix apps you have installed, you'll see personalized metrics such as:

- **Top selling items:** Discover which of your products, tickets, services, and subscriptions are most popular.
- **Top converting products (Wix Stores):** See which products convert well and identify the products that could convert better.
- **Top selling variants (Wix Stores):** Discover which product variants (e.g., size L, color brown) are selling the most.
- **Most abandoned products (Wix Stores):** Understand which products visitors add to their cart but don't end up purchasing.
- **Most booked services (Wix Bookings):** Discover which services were booked the most.
- **Top paying subscriptions (Wix Pricing Plans):** See which subscriptions bring you the most revenue.
- **Top selling events (Wix Events):** Discover which events bring you the most revenue and see the total tickets sold for each event.
- **Top selling dishes (Wix Restaurants):** See your top selling dishes and find out what customers ordered the most.

These metrics vary depending on your business app. For example, if you've installed Wix Events, you will see 'Tickets sold' as a top stat.

question: How do I connect iyzico as a payment method on my Wix site?

question: How can I invite participants to join my online program using the Wix dashboard?

question: How can I customize the member approval email for my site members?
answer:
To customize your member approval email, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Installed for you** tab.
3. Find the automation titled **Let site members know they’re approved**.
4. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the automation and select **Edit**.
5. Scroll down to **Action 1** (Send an email) and click **Edit** in the **Create an email** section.
6. Edit the contents of the email:
   
   * **Subject line:** Click **Edit** next to the subject line to adjust the subject line. You can click **\+ Personalize** to add a dynamic value.
   * **Text:** Click the text element(s) you want to edit and adjust the text. Then use the panel on the left to adjust the formatting or design.
   * **Button:** Click the button and use the panel on the left to edit its content or design.
   * **Add:** Click **Add** in the panel on the left to add elements to the email.
   * **Themes:** Click **Themes** in the panel on the left to personalize the theme of the email.
   * **Background:** Click **Background** on the panel on the left to update the background.
7. (Optional) Click **Preview \& test** to generate a preview and send yourself a test email.
8. Click **Save \& Continue** when you're done customizing the email.
9. Click **Save** to save the automation.

**Important:** To use this feature, you must have your [Signup & Login Security settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/managing-signup-login-and-security-settings-for-your-site-members#controlling-who-can-be-a-site-member) set to **Only people I manually approve**. No approval email is sent if this setting is turned off. Using a domain-based email for the sender details is recommended as there are limitations with the sender details of free email services (e.g. Gmail, yahoo).

question: How can I create a category in my Wix Forum to organize discussions?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to your site's dashboard as an admin.

To create a category in your forum:

1. [Go to Forum](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Forum&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/forum/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Categories** on the left.
3. Click **Add Category** at the top right.
4. Enter a name in the **Category Name** field (appears in the navigation menu).
5. Customize the **New Post** button text.
6. Enter a name in the **Category Header Title** field (appears in the header).
7. Enter a short description of what your category is about in the **Category Header Subtitle** field (maximum 65 characters).
8. Choose a background for your category header:
   
   * **Color:**
     
     + Click the **Background** **color** field to choose a color for your header background.
     + Click the **Opacity** field to increase or decrease the level of opacity of your header.
     + Click the **Text color** field to choose the color of your header text.
   * **Image:**
     
     + Click the **Add** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/13691038-5aa8-4672-9b95-348c0733cabc/2021/10/18/2df744cb-5325-45d6-8796-e7507198d035/9a15ddfc-d5c2-4dd4-af67-9ba3b7763b47.png) to add an image to your header.
     + Click the **Overlay color** field to choose the color for your image overlay.
     + Click the **Opacity** field to increase or decrease the level of opacity on your image.
9. Click **Edit** next to SEO to customize your category SEO.
10. Choose who has access to the category and its content:
    
    * **Everyone:** Any member can access this category.
    * **Logged in members:** Only members that are logged in can access this category.
    * **Selected members:** Only specific members, with certain roles, badges, or subscriptions can access this category.
11. Click the **Category guidelines** toggle to enable or disable it:
    
    * **Enabled:** A set of guidelines created by you are added to the category. These can include asking all members to stay within the topic of the category, etc.
    * **Disabled:** Guidelines do not appear on your category.
12. Click **Save**.

### Tip
Wix Forum comes with a sample category. Don't forget to either rename and customize the sample category, or delete it altogether.

question: What steps should I follow to transfer my domain from Wix if I am a Russian resident affected by the service restrictions?
answer:
To transfer your domain from Wix, follow these steps:

3. Select **Transfer away from Wix**.

6. Once you get the code, follow the instructions from your new domain host to transfer your domain.

Learn more about [transferring your domain away from Wix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/transferring-your-wix-domain-away-from-wix-2477749).

question: How can I view my site's sitemap on Wix?

question: How can I link a button to a video in my Wix Video player?

question: How can I set weekend rates for rooms in Wix Hotels?
answer:

question: How can I manage the Wix ticket service fee when creating tickets for my event?
answer:
When creating a new ticket, you can choose who covers the ticket service fee (buyer or business) charged by Wix on ticket sales. 

### Options for Managing the Ticket Service Fee:

1. **Pass the ticket service fee on to the buyer:**
   - The buyer pays an additional 2.5% fee on top of their ticket price.
   - At checkout, they see the service fee and the ticket price separately.
   - Example: If the ticket price is $100, buyers will see a total charge of $102.50 at checkout.

2. **Absorb the ticket service fee:**
   - You keep the total price lower for buyers.
   - The 2.5% fee is subtracted from your earnings.
   - Example: If the ticket price is $100, buyers will only pay $100 at checkout, and you will receive $97.50 after the fee is deducted.

For more details on creating tickets, visit [creating a new ticket](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-tickets-for-your-event).

question: How can I connect my Singaporean (.sg) domain to my Wix site?
answer:
To connect your Singaporean (.sg) domain to your Wix site, you need to upgrade your site with a plan. Once upgraded, you can connect your domain via Nameservers, which allows Wix to host your DNS records. This means you can manage them in your Wix account, and if you need assistance, Wix Customer Care can help you. 

Keep in mind:
- You will need access to your current domain registrar.
- New DNS records may take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

Learn how to [connect a domain to the Wix nameservers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

question: How can I embed a Pinterest widget on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To embed a Pinterest widget on your Wix site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Generate the code for the widget you want to add from Pinterest. You can use the following links to generate the code:
   - [Pinterest Board](https://developers.pinterest.com/tools/widget-builder/?type=board&boardHeight=240&boardWidth=400&imageWidth=80&template=square)
   - [Pinterest Pin](https://developers.pinterest.com/tools/widget-builder/?type=pin)

   - [Pinterest Follow button](https://developers.pinterest.com/tools/widget-builder/?type=follow)
   - [Pinterest Save button](https://developers.pinterest.com/tools/widget-builder/?type=pinit)

   **Note:** You need to copy both sets of code. The last piece of code needs to be added to the end of the first piece of code before the closing tag.

2. Once you have the code ready, go to the Wix Editor and click **Add Elements** on the left side of the Editor.
3. Click **Embed Code**.
4. Click **Embed HTML**.
5. Click **Enter Code**.
6. Make sure **Code** is selected under **What do you want to add?**.
7. Paste the code you copied from step 1 into the **Add your code here (HTTPS only)** field.
8. Click **Apply**.
9. (Optional) Enter alt text that describes what you're embedding in the **What's in the embed? Tell Google** field.
10. When ready, publish your site.

question: Why can't I upload my YouTube video to my Wix site?
answer:
If you are experiencing a problem with uploading a YouTube video, please check the following:

- Your video is set to **Public**. If your YouTube video is marked as **Private**, you cannot upload it to your Wix site. You can find your video's privacy settings on your video's **Basic info** tab in your YouTube account.
- **Embedding** is enabled. This setting can be found on your video's **Advanced settings** tab in your YouTube account.

Additionally, it is not possible to embed YouTube Shorts URLs directly. To embed a YouTube Short, change "/shorts/" in the URL to "/watch?v\=".

question: How can I disconnect a channel from the Channel Manager in Wix Hotels?
answer:
To disconnect a channel from the Channel Manager in Wix Hotels, follow the specific instructions for each channel:

### Booking.com
1. Go to [admin.booking.com](http://admin.booking.com/).
2. Click **Account**.
3. Go to **Channel Manager**.
4. Click **Deactivate**.

### Airbnb (API)
1. Login to your Airbnb host account.
2. Click **ACCOUNT** under your profile picture.
3. Click **Privacy & Sharing**.
4. Remove "Hotel Runner" from the connected apps section.

### Expedia
Please call your channel account manager and ask them to deactivate the HotelRunner for you.

### Other OTA's
Please call your channel account manager and ask them to deactivate the HotelRunner for you.

### iCals
1. Go to the **Room Type Mapping** for the iCal in Wix Hotels / Channel Manager.
2. Select **Don't send for the mapping**.
3. Click **Save**.
4. In another window, go to the admin dashboard of the relevant channel.
5. Go to the iCal section.
6. Delete the import calendars you created for HotelRunner.
7. Click **Save**.

Once you deactivate the channels, your connection at HotelRunner will end within 24 hours. If you would like the connection to be deactivated immediately, please email wix@hotelrunner.com after making sure your connection is deactivated on the channel's end.

If you are disconnecting all channels, you can turn off your Wix Hotels Channel app subscription so that it does not renew at the end of the subscription period. To do so, click [here](https://www.wix.com/account/subscriptions), click the **Show more** icon next to **Wix Hotel Channels** and click **Cancel App**.

question: How can I display pricing plans on multiple pages of my site using the Wix Editor?

question: How can I update the basic information of my online program using the Wix dashboard?
answer:
To update the basic information of your online program using the Wix dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Online Programs](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Online%20Programs&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/challenges/list) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the program you want to edit and click **Edit Settings**.
3. Click **Basic Info**.
4. Customize the settings based on the following options:
   * **Program name:** Enter a new name or edit the existing one.
   * **Category:** Add category labels to appear in your program list to help organize your list to make it easier to find.
   * **Cover Image:** Customize your cover image:
     + **Add a new image:** Click the **Add Image** icon to add a new cover image.
     + **Replace the image:** Hover over it and click the **Update** icon.

   * **Description:** Update your program description or enter a new one.

question: Can I automatically assign loyalty points to customers who follow my social media channels?

question: How can I set up an automation in Wix to automatically give loyalty points to customers?
answer:
To set up an automation with Wix Loyalty Program as the action to automatically give loyalty points, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** in the top right corner.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**. 
   
   **Note:** To use a suggested automation, search and select from the options under **Popular**. You can edit the trigger and actions of a suggested automation.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Click the app you'd like to base your trigger on in the **Trigger** section.
6. Select your chosen trigger from the available options. 
   
   **Note:** These options will differ depending on the app you selected in step 5.
7. Click **Give loyalty points** in the **Action** section.
   1. Describe an action that will earn points in the **Let customers know how to earn points** field. This text will be displayed on your site.
   2. (If relevant) If you've [added tiers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-loyalty-program-adding-tiers-to-your-loyalty-program) to your loyalty program, select the tiers you'd like this "way to earn" to apply to, and the number of points a customer in each tier will earn.
   3. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
   4. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
      
      * **Immediately:** The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
      * **Set custom time:** The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours and minutes.
   5. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set the trigger frequency:
      
      * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
      * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
      * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
8. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
9. Click **Activate** to save your new automation.

question: How can I add or update an SPF record in my Wix account?
answer:
To add or update an SPF record in your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page.
2. Click the **Show More** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2019/06/28/96c47964-91f2-4fc2-a3b9-869eb342b57a/ac38f09f-0dca-459b-9133-d47d229f7f02.png) next to the relevant domain and select **Manage DNS Records**.
3. Click **\+ Add Record** in the **TXT (Text)** section.
4. Click the **Host Name** field and enter the host name. 
   **Note:** Leave this field blank if instructed to add an **@** sign.
5. Click the **Value** field and enter the TXT value.

**Important:** The SPF record type is no longer used by all platforms. For this reason, you must add SPF records in the TXT section of your DNS records. You will need to contact your email provider in order to get your SPF record.

question: How can I view the predicted occupancy for my classes in Wix Analytics?
answer:
To view the predicted occupancy for your classes in Wix Analytics, follow these steps:

1. Go to the **Bookings Overview** page in the **Overviews** section under **Analytics** in your site's dashboard.
2. Choose the **Classes** view at the top right according to your service type.
3. In the **Predicted occupancy** section, click the drop-down to show the predicted occupancy for the **next week** (7 days starting next Sunday) or the **next 7 days** (7 days starting tomorrow).
4. The progress bar will show you the following details:
   - **Spots filled/Confirmed appointments:** This is the number of already booked sessions.
   - **Predicted:** This is the number of additional bookings that are likely to be made based on the confirmed bookings from the previous 3-4 weeks.
   - **Available:** This is the number of spots left open, calculated as the total capacity minus predicted occupancy.

**Note:** Predicted occupancy is the sum of confirmed spots that you already have for the next week/next 7 days and the predicted spots. The predicted numbers rely on the number of confirmed bookings in the past 3-4 weeks.

question: Is there a vacation mode feature in Wix Bookings?
answer:

When adding your vacation days in Google calendar, make sure to add the times as well (e.g., 7:00 AM \- 5:00 PM). Learn more about [syncing your personal calendars with Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-about-syncing-personal-calendars-with-wix-bookings).
* Manually add the vacation days to your Wix Bookings calendar as [blocked time](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-blocking-off-time-in-your-calendar).

question: How can I upgrade my Universal Analytics to Google Analytics 4?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your Google Analytics account and your site's dashboard.

### Step 1 | Create your Google Analytics 4 property
Use the GA4 Setup Assistant in your Google Analytics account to create and set up a new Google Analytics 4 property.

#### To create a GA4 property:
1. Sign in to [your Google Analytics account](https://analytics.google.com/analytics/web/).
2. Click the Admin icon at the bottom left of the page.
3. Select **GA4 Setup Assistant**.
4. Click **Get Started** under **I want to create a new Google Analytics 4 property**.
5. Click **Create property**.
6. Click **See your GA4 property** under **Explore and set up your GA4 property**.
7. Select **Tag installation**.
8. Select your stream under **Data Streams**.
9. Click the Settings icon.
10. Click **Show advanced settings** under **Page views**.
11. Deselect the **Page changes based on browser history events** checkbox.
12. Disable the **Site search** toggle.
13. Click **Save**.

### Step 2 | Add your Google Analytics 4 property to your site
Add your new property to Google Analytics in Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard to complete the upgrade.

#### To add your GA4 property:
1. Copy your measurement ID under **Web stream details**.
2. Go to [Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Marketing%20Integrations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/marketing-integration/) on your site's dashboard.
3. Click **View** under **Google Analytics**.
4. Click the Show More icon in the top right corner.
5. Click **Edit**.
6. Paste your Google Analytics 4 measurement ID in the pop-up.

**Note:** Make sure that there are no extra spaces before the code.
7. (Optional) Select the **IP Anonymization** checkbox if you want to hide your site visitors’ IP addresses from Google.
8. Click **Save**.

question: How can I add and customize text for images in my Wix gallery?
answer:
To add and customize text for images in your Wix gallery, follow these steps:

1. **Add Text Types:** You can add three types of text to your gallery images:
   - **Title:** Add an image title of up to 36 characters to summarize your image.
   - **Description:** Add an image description of up to 500 characters to expand on the content of the image and provide more details.
   - **Link:** Create an interactive gallery experience by linking your image to other sections, pages, or sites. You can set your images to open the relevant link once visitors click them.

   **Note:** Links are not displayed in galleries.

2. **Choose a Gallery Type:** Select a gallery design that fits your desired layout. You can choose a gallery that displays text on both regular and hover view, only on hover, or not at all.

3. **Customize Text Design:** Edit the design of image text to complement your gallery and site's look. Options include changing the font, selecting a color to match your site's theme, adjusting the text size, and setting the alignment of the text. You can also customize the text content and design of the **Show More** button if you have a large gallery.

4. **Accessibility and SEO:** Adding a title and a description to your images is beneficial for your site's [accessibility](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-images-and-galleries) and [SEO](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-images-and-galleries-for-seo-alt-text). The title is used as your image's alt text, helping assistive technologies and search engines understand it better.

For more detailed instructions, you can refer to the guide on [how to add and set up gallery text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-customizing-gallery-image-text).

question: Does Wix Music support right to left script languages like Hebrew or Arabic?

question: How can I change the access permissions for my Google Calendar to display events on my site's Google Event Calendar app?
answer:
To change access permissions for your Google Calendar, follow these steps:

1. Open your Google Calendar.
2. Click the **Settings** icon at the top right.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Scroll down to **Settings for my calendar** on the left.
5. Click to select the calendar you want to share.
6. Change your Access Permissions to any of the following:
   
   * **Public:** Click **Make available to public** and select **See all event details** from the drop-down.
   * **Public free/busy:** Click **Make available to public** and select **See only free/busy (hide details)** from the drop-down.
   * **Private:** Uncheck **Make available to public**.

### Notes
* You can only change the access permissions of the calendars you own.
* If your Google account was provided by an organization, you may need to contact your Google account administrator to change the sharing options. Click [here](https://support.google.com/a/answer/60765?hl=en) for more information.
* Each time you change the access permissions of a particular calendar you need to click the **Refresh** button in order for it to appear in the appropriate calendar type in your settings.

question: How can I optimize my website's on-page SEO using Wix tools?
answer:
To optimize your website's on-page SEO using Wix tools, follow these steps:

1. **Optimize On-Page Elements**: Use your chosen keywords to optimize on-page elements like title tags, meta descriptions, headers, and URLs. These elements provide search engines with valuable context about your content, making it easier for them to rank your pages in search results.

2. **Use the Wix SEO Assistant**: The Wix SEO Assistant can help you optimize your site's pages for search engines. It identifies potential issues with your site and gives you recommendations to improve your page's content, structure, and SEO attributes. Learn more about [optimizing your site with the Wix SEO Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-site-with-the-wix-seo-assistant).

3. **Add Keywords Thoughtfully**: Ensure that you've incorporated keywords naturally into your headlines, body text, and other relevant areas. Each page should be tailored to different keywords within a related topic to enhance its relevance and user experience.

4. **Regular Monitoring and Analysis**: Use tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console to continuously monitor your website's performance. Analyze keyword rankings, traffic patterns, and conversion rates to make informed SEO decisions. Regularly scan your site's pages for issues using the [Wix Site Inspection tool](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-site-inspection-an-overview).

By following these steps and utilizing Wix's built-in tools, you can effectively optimize your website's on-page SEO and improve its visibility in search engine results.

question: What measures does Wix Payments take to ensure PCI Compliance for secure financial transactions?
answer: Wix Payments complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards ([PCI DSS](https://www.vikingcloud.com/faq#16)). The PCI DSS is the highest information security standard for organizations or companies that accept credit card payments. This standard provides protection of the privacy and confidentiality of the card's data used to complete the online transaction. PCI Compliance helps to create a secure environment by improving the quality of the cardholder data in order to reduce the rate of credit card fraud cases. In addition, it ensures that the data for each payment is stored securely in a tamper-proof manner.

If the error continues to be displayed in Google Search Console, it is possible that there is an ongoing issue on Wix's end. [Contact Wix Customer Care](https://support.wix.com/en/article/contacting-wix-customer-care-for-support) to let us know and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

question: Is it possible to connect a PEC business email to Wix?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to connect a PEC business email to Wix. This is because the MX records needed are those for a subdomain (for example, **mx.yourdomain.pec.it** ). This is a format that Wix does not support.

At the moment, the only workaround to using the PEC business email associated with your domain is to proceed as follows:

1. [Delete the domain currently connected to your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/removing-a-domain-from-your-wix-account) (if you have already connected it via Name Servers).
2. [Add the same domain, this time using the pointing method](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-wix-using-the-pointing-method).
3. Ask your host to set up their NS records and, therefore, your business email as well.

You can use this email template and send it to your service provider. Make sure the records are configured as below.

*My name is* ***XXX*** *and I have purchased the following domain from you:* ***mydomain.it*** 

* *An A record for mydomain.it: 185\.230\.63\.107*
* *CNAME record for www.yourdomain.it:* pointing.wixdns.net

*Also, please set up your NS records and configure the* business email *associated with this domain accordingly.*

Once your provider has configured their Name Servers for your domain, you can add your PEC records in their control panel.

question: How can I maintain my site's Google rankings when moving to Wix using URL redirects?
answer:
To maintain your site's Google rankings when moving to Wix, you need to set up URL redirects. Here are the steps to follow:

1. **Upgrade and Connect a Domain**: You must [upgrade your Wix site with a Premium Plan](http://www.wix.com/upgrade/website) and [connect a domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-from-wix).

2. **Create New Pages**: When building your new site with Wix, [create new pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-changing-your-page-url) with URLs that match the ones from your old site. If you have new pages and cannot match the new URLs to the old ones, you can retain your SEO rankings by [creating a URL redirect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site).

3. **Verify and Submit Sitemap**: Once you have published your new Wix site, verify your site with [Google Search Console](https://support.wix.com/en/article/verifying-your-site-with-google-search-console-5033765) or other search engines. You can then submit your [sitemap](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines) directly to Google.

4. **Set Up URL Redirects**: Determine which of your previous site pages have already been indexed by Google by performing a search in Google using `site:yourdomain.com`. Note down the URL of each page that appears. [Set up your URL redirects](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site) so that each relevant URL corresponds to a page on your new site.

5. **Publish Your Site**: Click **Publish** from inside the Editor for the URL redirects to be activated. Make sure that you have selected **Let search engines index your site** from your site's SEO settings. [Learn How](https://support.wix.com/en/article/preventing-search-engines-from-indexing-your-site)

6. **Submit Your Sitemap to Google**: To speed up the caching process, open a [Google Search Console account](https://www.google.com/webmasters/tools/home?hl=en) and submit your [automatically generated sitemap to Google.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines)

By following these steps, you can effectively maintain your site's Google rankings when transitioning to Wix.

question: How can I verify my site with Naver Webmaster Tools using a meta tag on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you are using the Korean language version of Naver.
- You must have a custom domain connected to your Wix site.

### Step 1 | Get your meta tag from Naver
1. Sign in to [Naver Webmaster Tools account](https://searchadvisor.naver.com/console/board).
2. Enter your website URL under **Site Registration**.
3. Click the Add icon.
4. Select **HTML tag (태그)**.
5. Copy your meta tag.
6. Leave Naver Webmaster Tools open.

### Step 2 | Add the meta tag to your Wix site
1. In a new tab, [go to your SEO Dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO).

question: How can I set up an automatic response for incoming orders on my Wix Restaurants site using the original Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To set up an automatic response for incoming orders on your Wix Restaurants site using the original Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Automations) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation**.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Click **Wix Restaurants** app in the **Trigger** section.
6. Select your chosen action in the **Action** section and set up the action using the available options.
7. Click the **Timing** section to expand it.
8. Click the **Choose a time to send this action** drop-down to select when the action should be carried out:
   * **Immediately:** The action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.
   * **Set custom time:** The action is performed after the trigger, at a time set by you. Click the up and down arrows to set the number and click the drop-down to choose between days, hours, and minutes.
9. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
   * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
   * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
10. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** at the bottom to set up a multi-action automation.
11. Click **Activate** to save your new automation.

You can learn more about [creating a new automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation) and how you can respond to customers when they place orders on your site.

question: What are the limitations of restoring a saved version of my Wix site, specifically regarding Wix apps and CMS collections?
answer:
When restoring a saved version of your Wix site, there are specific limitations to be aware of:

- **Wix Apps**: Content in the following apps does not revert when restoring to a previously saved version of your site:
  - Wix Stores
  - Wix Blog
  - Wix Events
  - Wix Bookings
  - Wix Forum
  - Wix Video
  - Wix FAQ
  - Wix Restaurants
  - Wix Hotels

- **CMS (Content Management System)**: Restoring your site reverts its pages and their designs to a previous version. This applies to your [dynamic pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dynamic-pages) and their layouts. However, the content and data structure (schema) in your CMS collections are not reverted when restoring your site. You can [use CMS backups](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-backing-up-your-collections) to restore previous versions of your collections.

question: How can I apply a sale price to a single product in my Wix store?

question: How can I create SEO tags using AI on my Wix site?
answer:
To create SEO tags using AI on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. **Access your page title tag and meta description settings** in one of two places:
   * [The SEO panels of your installed Wix apps](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-pages-seo-settings-in-the-seo-panel).
   * [The SEO Settings "Edit by Page" tabs](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-seo-settings-1420929#editing-the-seo-settings-of-individual-pages).

2. **Click "Create AI text"** next to the **Title tag** or **Meta description** field.

3. The **AI Text Creator** window will open, presenting 3 suggestions. Choose what you want to do:
   * **Use Text:** Click **Use Text** next to the suggestion you want to use. You can then edit this text.
   * **Refine suggestions:**
     1. Provide key details and select a tone of voice to generate 3 refined suggestions.
     2. Click **Create**.
     3. Click **Use Text** next to the suggestion you want to use.

4. (Optional) **Edit the text** that now appears in the **Title tag** or **Meta description** field.

5. **Click "Save"** to apply your changes.

The AI Text Creator uses your business name, business category, page title, page description, and location to generate these tags. It also uses your keywords if you're using it for a Wix Blogs page.

question: How can I create multiple Google Ads with Wix campaigns and manage their budgets?
answer:
To create multiple Google Ads with Wix campaigns, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Google Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Google%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/google-ads/eligibility) in your site's dashboard.
2. The campaigns page shows all your current campaign(s) in a list. Click **Create New Campaign** at the top right to make another Google Ads with Wix campaign.
3. (For Wix Stores only): Choose an advertising goal for your new campaign: **Drive site traffic** or **Boost product purchases**.
4. Customize the settings and ad content of your new ad campaign. [Learn more about creating campaign content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-ads-with-wix-creating-a-campaign#step-2-customize-your-ad-settings).
5. Set your new campaign's daily budget. The daily budget is taken from your total monthly subscription and applied as ad credits. Drag the slider to see an estimate of ad clicks per day with your chosen budget.
6. Click **Launch** to launch your new campaign.

Your new campaign appears in the campaigns page. The status label is **In Review** until the campaign content is approved by Google.

### How your budget works with multiple campaigns

You pay for one Google Ads with Wix subscription regardless of how many campaigns you run. You can also always buy extra ad credits with a one-time payment that are added on top of your subscription. Your ad credits are used to run your ads. When you choose a daily budget for a new campaign, it's taken from the total 'bucket' of ad credits available for all campaigns in your account. To get more ad credits, click **Manage ad credits & budget** in the campaigns page and increase your subscription.

question: How can I add and manage tags in my CMS collection?
answer:
To add and manage tags in your CMS collection, follow these steps:

1. [Go to CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20CMS&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, you can click **CMS** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/07/18/c6258392-fdef-4a6b-8b85-1149e3260153/ab886b0a-e79c-4664-bea2-56ac47af29cb.png) in [your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26), then click **Your Collections**.
2. Click the relevant collection.
3. Click **Manage Fields**.
4. Click **\+ Add Field**.
5. Select **Tags** and click **Choose Field Type**.
6. Enter a name for the field in the **Field name**.
7. (Velo only) If necessary, update the **Field ID**, which is used in the site's code. You cannot update this ID later.
8. (Optional) Enter help text to include a tooltip in your collection next to the field name.
9. Click **Save**.
10. Click the Tags field of the relevant item and choose what you want to do:

### Add a new tag to an item
1. Enter the name of the tag you want to use.
2. Press **Enter** on your keyboard or select **\+ Create {tag name}**.
3. Repeat these steps to add multiple tags for the same item.
4. Select the Tags field for a different item and repeat these steps to add new tag fields to the item.

### Add existing tags to an item
1. Click **\+ Add Tag**.
2. Select the tags that you want to add to the item from the list of existing tags.
3. Select the Tags field for a different item and repeat these steps to add existing tags to the item.

### Rename, merge, or delete tags
If you rename, merge, or delete tags, the changes are applied to the tags everywhere they exist.

**To manage your tags:**
1. Click **\+ Add Tag**.
2. Select **Manage Tags**.
3. Choose what you want to do:
   * **Rename:** Change the name of the tag everywhere it is in use. Click the relevant tag, edit the name and press **Enter** on your keyboard.
   * **Merge:** Combine multiple tags into one tag everywhere the tags are in use:
     1. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/05/21/ea274b92-b7b5-4b55-9e2d-da14c4519827/a50b53c4-b17a-40cf-9fd5-b6af719da6cf.png) next to the relevant tag and select **Merge**.
     2. Select the checkbox next to the tags you want to merge and click **Merge**.
     3. Enter a name for the tags you're combining and press **Enter** on your keyboard.
   * **Delete:** Remove a tag from all the items it's assigned to:
     1. Click the **More Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/05/21/ea274b92-b7b5-4b55-9e2d-da14c4519827/a50b53c4-b17a-40cf-9fd5-b6af719da6cf.png) next to the relevant tag and select **Delete**.
     2. Click **Delete** to confirm.
4. Click **Close**.

question: What should I do if I'm having trouble adding additional meta tags to my Wix site?
answer:
If you're having issues with adding additional meta tags, try the following:

### Check if the meta tag is already added
You can add up to 10 meta tags. However, you can't add the same meta tag twice. It's also not possible to add a default meta tag that Wix already created for you. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/understanding-your-pages-default-seo-settings)

### Make sure that the meta tag format is correct
You can only use **<meta>** and **<link>** tags in valid HTML format. 

For example: 

```html
<meta key="value" another_key="value"/>
<link rel="value" href="value"/>
```

question: How do I connect a network card reader to my Wix Retail POS tablet?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have the BBPOS WisePOS E card reader.
- Unbox and charge your card reader.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1: Connect the reader to WiFi
1. Check which network your POS tablet is connected to by clicking the Menu icon on the tablet, selecting **App & Tablet**, and clicking **Wi-Fi & Network**.
2. On the card reader, if you see WiFi networks displayed, tap to connect to the same WiFi network as your tablet.
3. If you don't see WiFi networks displayed:
   - Swipe right on your card reader screen.
   - Tap the **Settings** button.
   - Enter **07139** as the PIN code.
   - Select **Network**.
   - Connect to the same WiFi network as your tablet.

#### Step 2: Pair the card reader to your POS tablet
1. After connecting to WiFi, a three-word code should appear on the card reader screen. If not, generate the code by:
   - Swiping right on your card reader screen.
   - Tapping the **Settings** button.
   - Selecting **Generate pairing code**.
2. Open the POS tablet.
3. Tap the Menu icon at the bottom left.
4. Tap **Manage Hardware**.
5. Select **Set up Card Reader**.
6. Tap **Connect** next to **Network reader**.
7. Tap **+Pair a New Network Reader**.
8. Enter the three-word code you see on the reader.
9. (Optional) Give your card reader a name to help manage multiple readers.
10. Click **Pair Reader**.

**Tip:** After your reader is paired, you'll see it in your list of available card readers in the **Manage Hardware** tab in the tablet.

question: How can I reactivate my domain if it was deactivated due to unconfirmed contact information?
answer:
To reactivate your domain, you can follow these steps:

### From your Wix account:
1. Go to the [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page. 
   **Note:** If you have more than one domain in your account, scroll to the relevant domain.
2. Click **Resend Confirmation Email**. 
   **Note:** If you don't see this option, you do not need to confirm your domain's contact email.
3. Confirm your domain's contact information: 
   
   1. Access the mailbox for your domain's contact email address. [Learn How](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-and-updating-your-wix-domain-contact-information)
   2. Open the email titled **Confirm Your Domain Contact Information** (sent from wix-team@notifications.wix.com).
   3. Click **Confirm** in the email.

### From the parking page:
1. Enter your domain in your browser's address bar.
2. Click **Reactivate Domain** on the parking page. 
   **Note:** If a parking page does not appear on your domain, you must reactivate your domain from your Wix account.
3. Confirm your domain's contact information: 
   
   1. Access the mailbox for your domain's contact email address. [Learn How](https://support.wix.com/en/article/viewing-and-updating-your-wix-domain-contact-information)
   2. Open the email titled **Confirm Your Domain Contact Information** (sent from wix-team@notifications.wix.com).
   3. Click **Confirm** in the email.

Once you confirm your domain contact info, it may take up to 48 hours for your domain to propagate and display your site again. Learn more about [domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: How can I allow my fans to name their price for downloading a single on Wix Music?

question: How can I add pricing information for a physical product in Wix Stores?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed the steps to add product media and enter basic product information.

To add pricing information:

1. Enter the product's base price.

   **Tip:** If you create product options, you'll be able to price them differently by adding a price increase or decrease to this price.

2. (Optional) Add a sale to the product:

   1. Enable the **On sale** toggle.
   2. Select an option:
      * Click the price icon and enter the amount of the discount (e.g. $10 off).
      * Click the percentage icon and enter the discount percentage (e.g. 10% off).
      * Enter the sale price directly in the **Sale Price** field (e.g. enter a $50 discount price).

3. Display a [price per unit](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-displaying-the-product-price-per-unit) for this product (e.g. $5 / lb).

   1. Enable the **Show price per unit** toggle.
   2. Under **Total product quantity in units**, select the relevant type of unit (e.g. ounces) from the drop-down.
   3. Under **Total product quantity in units**, enter the total product quantity in units (e.g. if you are selling a 5 ounce jar, enter "5").
   4. Under **Base units**, enter the unit you want to measure by (e.g. enter 1 ounce to display a price per ounce).

4. (Optional) Enter the [cost of goods](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-calculating-cost-of-goods) (e.g. $10).

question: Can I set individual elements as global so they appear on multiple site pages?

question: How can I end my Facebook Ads campaign early and what happens to the unused ad spend?

4. Click **End Anyway** to confirm.

### Tip
If you want your campaign to end once your subscription expires rather than immediately, turn off auto-renewal of your subscription. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-turning-off-auto-renewal-for-your-facebook-ads-subscription)

### Note
If you attempt to restart your campaign after your subscription has expired, you must purchase a new subscription before the campaign can go live and use any remaining ad spend. question: How can I add video conferencing to my event using the Wix app?

2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/11/10/bdebceaa-3cca-42c8-b60d-6c55923bf8fa/bb911823-182e-4453-b87e-0dbbe1ab5d50.png) at the bottom.

question: How can I change the header scroll effect on my Wix mobile site?
answer:
To change the scroll effect on your mobile header:

1. Click the header in your [mobile Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-accessing-the-mobile-editor).
2. Click **Change Header Scroll**.
3. Select an option:
   
   * **Scrolls with site:** The header is always at the top of the site and scrolls with it.
   * **Freezes:** The header is always at the top of the mobile screen. This effect does not work if your header is larger than half the screen size.
   * **Disappears:** The header disappears when you scroll down the site, but is at the top of the screen when you scroll upward.
   * **Fades out:** The header slowly disappears as you scroll down the page. It reappears as you scroll upward.

### Important note about the freeze scroll effect
If your header has too much content and is too big on mobile, the freeze scroll effect is disabled on the live mobile site. This is because when set to frozen, the header would cover the entire viewport of the mobile device and the rest of the site content would not be visible at all.

question: How can I add a new room type in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
answer:
To add a room type in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Room Types](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1c5b7dec-159e-48cf-b618-6d77d7a17f8c%7C2%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Room+Types) in the dashboard.
2. Click **\+ Create Room Type**.
3. Select the relevant room type from the **Kind of room** drop-down then click **Next**.
4. Enter your room's details:
   - **Display name:** Enter the room name your customers see when they search for available rooms on your site.
   - **Adult capacity:** Enter the number of adults the room can accommodate.
   - **Total capacity:** Enter the total number of people the room can accommodate, including children.
   - **Number of rooms:** Enter how many of this room type your property offers.
   - **Revenue Account:** Choose **Accommodation** from the drop-down (you can update this later if necessary).
5. Click **Next**.
6. Enter your base price details:
   - **Base Price (per night):** We recommend you enter a value as high as your most expensive rate.
   - **Set base price for what occupancy?:** Choose the relevant number of guests that your base price applies to from the drop-down.
   - **Different occupancy:** Set the pricing using the available options:
     - **Percentage:** Choose whether the price increases or decreases by the percentage amount.
     - **Fixed amount:** Choose whether the price increases or decreases by the fixed amount.
7. Click **Next**.
8. Click the checkbox next to the amenities you offer in this room type (e.g. bed types, room features, domestic appliances, etc). Then, click **Next**.
9. Click the Add Photo icon to upload photos of this room. **Note:** The maximum image size is 2MB.
10. Click **Complete**.
11. When ready, click **Save** at the top.
