question: What should I do if I receive a 'Keep it different from other pages' error message in the Wix SEO Setup Checklist?
answer:
If you receive a **Keep it different from other pages** error message in the SEO Setup Checklist, it means you are using the same title tags and meta descriptions for multiple pages. To resolve this, ensure that each SEO title tag is unique for each of your site's pages. Here are some tips for writing effective SEO title tags:

* Each title tag should be unique, providing concise information on what the page is about.
* Include a target keyword for each individual page of your site.
* Add your business or site name.
* Include the location of your business to your homepage title tag; this will help Google know to display your site to searchers in your area.
* The length of your title tag should be 55-70 characters.

Use the pipe sign ‘|’ to distinguish different parts of your title tag. For more guidance, you can check out these additional [SEO tips for beginners](https://www.wix.com/blog/2018/06/diy-seo-tips-for-beginners/) in the Wix Blog.

question: What are the guidelines for naming a Branded App to ensure it is not rejected by Apple's App Store or Google Play?
answer:
When choosing a name for your Branded App, make sure it follows these guidelines:

- **Do not include:**
  - Any special characters (e.g. \#, @, \&) or emojis
  - Prices or pricing information (e.g. 'Free app!')
  - Trademarked names or data
  - Names already used in popular apps or references to other apps
  - Inappropriate or irrelevant content
  - Names over the 30 character limit

- **Tips for choosing a name that won't be rejected:**
  - Pick a unique name that accurately describes your app and its content.
  - Choose a name that is simple and easy for your users to remember.
  - Don't try to 'game the system' as [Apple says](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/) by using popular or existing app names to draw more attention to your app.
  - Reflect the app's core features in the name.
  - Check the availability of the name before you submit. This includes all social media handles and domain names as well.

### Tip
Your app's subtitle (which you'll pick in the **Store Listings** section of your branded dashboard) is a great way to add additional context to your app without including it in the name itself.

Read more about [Apple's Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/) and the [Google Play Developer Policy](https://play.google.com/about/developer-content-policy/).

question: How can I inform my site visitors about the use of cookies on my Wix site?
answer: To inform your site visitors about the use of cookies, you can add a section about your site's cookies in your privacy policy. You can also use the [Wix Privacy Center](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Privacy%20Center&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/cookie-consent-settings-app?referralInfo=article_cookies-and-your-wix-site) to add a cookie banner to your site. question: How can I optimize third-party code on my site to improve performance?
answer:
To optimize third-party code on your site and improve performance, you can follow these steps:

1. **Add the `defer` attribute** to your third-party script. This attribute tells your visitors' browser to not wait for the script, so your site content can load uninterrupted. The third-party embed loads in the background and runs when the site's DOM is complete.

2. **Place third-party scripts at the end of the code body.** This ensures that your regular site content doesn't get delayed or prevented from rendering.

3. **Reduce the amount of third-party code** on your site where you can. Only use code that is necessary for your business and site needs, and remove any that are no longer required.

2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select **Remove from Wix**.
3. Click **Remove Domain**.
4. Click **Connect a domain you already own**. 
   
   **Note:** If you don't see this option, click **Add an Existing Domain**, then select **Connect a domain you already own**.
5. Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click **Next**.
6. Enter your domain name and click **Next**. If required, confirm that you are the owner of that domain. 
   
   **Tip:** Keep this window open so you can return to verify your connection in step 7.

question: How can I verify my site with Bing to improve its ranking in search results?

question: How can I allow clients to cancel their subscriptions on my Wix site?
answer:
To allow clients to cancel a subscription:

1. [Go to Pricing Plans](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Pricing%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/membership/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Create a new plan or edit an existing one.
3. Scroll down to the **Settings** section.
4. Enable the **Allow customers to cancel their subscription** toggle.
5. Click **Save** to save the plan.
6. Repeat steps 2 - 5 for any other plans in which you want to enable cancellation.

### Refunding clients
* Canceling a plan does not trigger a refund.
* **One-time payment:** To issue a refund, contact your payment provider (e.g. PayPal, Stripe, etc.)
* **Recurring payment:** When a client cancels a recurring payment, such as a monthly payment, the purchased plan and payment does not continue for the next cycle (e.g. for the next month).

question: How can I optimize the title tags, meta descriptions, and URL slugs for my Wix store's product pages?
answer:
To optimize the title tags, meta descriptions, and URL slugs for your Wix store's product pages, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the product you want to customize.
3. Scroll down and click **Edit SEO Settings** on the right.
4. Edit any of the following:
   * **URL Slug:** This text is the last part of your page's URL. You should only change this if it's necessary to reflect the content of your page. We recommend keeping it short and easy to read. Note: You can customize your URL structure to remove the "product-page" prefix in [your site's SEO Settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-seo-settings-1420929).
   * **Automatically redirect visits from the old URL to the new one**: When you change a product page's URL slug, you can choose to let Wix automatically redirect visitors who try to use the old URL to the new URL. Alternatively, you can disable this toggle and [manually create your own redirect](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site).
   * **Title tag:** Add a title that summarizes what the product is. We recommend giving concise product names (maximum 60 characters) that help potential customers understand the product.
   * **Meta description:** Add a short description of your product (maximum 156 characters). This description helps users decide if the page is relevant to them.
5. Click the **Let search engines index this page** toggle to set whether search engines can [crawl and index](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/beginner/how-search-works#crawling) your page or not:
   * **Enabled**: Search engines will index your page. People can find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines.
   * **Disabled**: Search engines will not index your page. People cannot find your page when searching keywords and phrases in search engines. **Note:** Selecting **Disabled** prevents products from appearing in [Wix Site Search](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-and-optimizing-a-search-box-for-stores) results.
6. Click **Save**.

question: How can I upload photos from Lightroom Classic to Wix Photo Albums?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have previously installed the Wix Photo Albums app on your site before April 2024.
- Download and install the Wix Photo Albums plugin from your Wix dashboard.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Download the Wix Photo Albums plugin
1. Go to [Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/photography-albums/) in your site’s dashboard.
2. Click **Tools** on the side bar menu.
3. Click **Download Plug-in** in the **Lightroom Classic** section.

**Note:** The Wix Photo Albums plugin is downloaded to your computer as a zip file, make sure to unzip it.

#### Step 2 | Install the plugin in Lightroom Classic
1. Open Lightroom Classic on your computer.
2. Click **File** at the top left.
3. Click **Plug-in manager**.
4. Click **Add**.
5. Search for the unzipped plug-in file you previously downloaded and select it.
6. Click **Add Plug-in**.
7. Click **Done**.

#### Step 3 | Authorize and sync Wix Photo Albums with Lightroom Classic
1. Go to Publish Services in your Lightroom.
2. Click **Set Up** next to Wix Photo Album.
3. Click **Authorize** to continue using the plugin.
4. Log in to your Wix account.
5. Once you’re logged in, go back to Lightroom.
6. Go to your Library.
7. Right-click on the **Wix Lightroom Plugin** and click **Edit Settings**.
8. Click **Sync** in the Sync section. Click **Cancel** to close the window.

**Note:** This will automatically sync all of your Wix photo albums and galleries.

#### Step 4 | Publish your photos from Lightroom to Wix Photo Albums
1. Go to your Photo Album in your Lightroom.
2. Drag the photos you want to upload to the relevant album or gallery.
3. Click **Publish** on Lightroom.

**Note:** Once you click ‘Publish’ on Lightroom, the changes you made (add, edit or remove photos and galleries) will be applied and updated on Wix Photo Albums.

question: How can I change the currency used to pay for my Wix Premium plan after moving to a new country?
answer:
To change the currency used to pay for your Premium plan, follow these steps:

1. **Cancel the Premium plan that you want to change:**
   
   1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
   2. Click the More Actions icon next to the plan associated with the relevant site.
   3. Click **Cancel plan**.
   4. Click **Cancel Now**.

2. **Duplicate the site that the plan is assigned to:**
   
   1. [Go to the dashboard of the site](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D).
   2. Click the More Actions icon and click **Duplicate Site**.
   3. Enter a name for the duplicate site.
   4. Click **Duplicate**.

3. **Reassign the canceled Premium plan to the duplicate site:**
   
   1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
   2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan.
   3. Click **Assign to a Different Site** and choose the duplicated site.
   4. Click **Next**.
   5. Click **Assign**.

4. **Upgrade the original site from your new location:**
   
   1. [Go to the dashboard of the original site](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D).
   2. Click **Upgrade** on the left.
   3. Click **Select** under the Premium plan you want to purchase.
   4. Follow the steps to complete the purchase.

5. **Assign your domain back to your original site:**
   
   1. [Go to Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
   
   **Note:** If you have more than one domain in your account, select the domain you want to reassign.
   2. Scroll down to the **Unassigned Domains** section.
   3. Click the More Actions icon.
   4. Click **Assign to a Site.**
   5. Choose a site from the options if there is more than one, then click **Next.**
   6. Click **Assign.**

This workaround involves duplicating your site, moving the existing Premium plan there, and in the meantime, upgrading the original site from the new location.

question: How can I set up my Google Business Profile for 'Order with Google' in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure your site is [connected to a domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-you-own-to-your-wix-site).

### To set up your Google Business Profile:
1. [Go to Restaurant Orders Settings](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/wix-restaurants-orders-new/settings?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Orders+Settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Scroll down to **Promotions and Growth** and click **Order with Google**.
3. Click **Set Up Profile** to set up your Google Business Profile.
4. Click **Start Now**.
5. Choose how to add your Google Business Profile:

### Import an existing profile
1. Click **Import Existing Profile**.
2. (If necessary) Sign in to your Google account.
3. Click **Allow**.
4. Select the business profile you want to import, then click **Add**.

### Create a new profile
1. Click **Create New Profile**.
2. Enter the name of your business in the search bar, then do as follows:

   **If your business appears in the list:**
   1. Click your business name in the list.
   2. Click **Next**.
   3. Click **Verify & Manage**.

   **Note:** If you see an error message that says your business is managed by someone else, you'll need to [request ownership of the profile](https://support.google.com/business/answer/4566671).

   **If your business doesn't appear:**
   1. Click **Next**.
   2. Choose how your business info will appear on your Profile:
      1. **Choose a business category:** Enter a category for your business and select an option from the list.
      2. **Add your business details:** Enter a description, phone number and site URL for your business.
      3. **Location:** Select a location for your business:
         * **At a physical address:** You only serve customers at a physical location (e.g. art gallery).
         * **Within a service area:** You only visit or deliver to customers.
         * **At an address and a service area:** You have a physical location and you also deliver to customers (e.g. dine-in bakery, and delivery service).
      4. Enter your location details based on your previous choice. For example, if you chose **Within a service area**, you need to select a country and enter a service area.
      5. Click **Include optional info (photos, opening hours & more)** to add more information about your business:
         * **Photos:** Add photos of your business
         * **Opening hours:** Add the days of the week that you open on and the hours that you are available.
         * **Add attributes:** Add additional attributes to your profile. For example, you can add accessibility attributes to share with your customers who have specific accessibility needs.
3. Click **Submit to Google** at the top right.
   * If you are not signed in to your Google account, you'll be prompted to do so.
   * If you do not have a Google account, you can create one.
4. Follow the prompts to verify your business location.

question: How can I connect the Faster Payment System as a payment method through Oceanpayment on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect the Faster Payment System (FPS) as a payment method through Oceanpayment on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Faster Payment System.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new Oceanpayment account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Terminal and SecureCode.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create Oceanpayment account**](https://www.oceanpayment.com/contact-sales).
   2. Fill in the registration form and click **Send**.
   3. Wait for an email or chat message from Oceanpayment to get your Terminal and SecureCode.
   4. Return to the [Accept Payments tab](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-the-accept-payments-tab) (repeat steps 1-5) and follow the steps under **Have an account** to connect your account.

Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your Oceanpayment account, as transactions may be declined if they do not match. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: How can I order branded merchandise using the Wix Logo Maker?

question: How can I test a live URL using the Google Search Console's URL Inspection Tool?

question: What types of images can I edit using the Wix Photo Studio, and are there any restrictions?
answer: You can edit images that you have uploaded, created using the [AI Image Creator](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-creating-images-with-the-wix-ai-image-creator), or images from Unsplash. Additionally, you can only upload one image at a time to the Wix Photo Studio.

question: What are the commercial rights associated with a logo created using Wix Logo Maker?
answer: Wix Logo Maker lets you create and purchase your own personalized logo for your business and website with full commercial rights. Full Commercial rights mean that Wix does not limit the types of commercial usage of your logo and you can use it to promote or sell products and services as you deem fit. However, Wix provides the Wix Logos as-is: Wix cannot vouch for the uniqueness of your Wix Logo, cannot guarantee that the logo you choose is not already used or owned by someone else, and you may or may not be able to register or use your Wix Logo as a trademark. For any legal aspects related to the usage of the logo please consult an attorney.

question: How can I cancel my Branded App plan and request a refund within the first 30 days?
answer:
To cancel your Branded App plan and request a refund within the first 30 days, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.

question: How can I set up a loyalty program for my Wix restaurant to reward customers?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have upgraded to a plan that includes accepting payments.

To set up a loyalty program for your Wix restaurant, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Create your loyalty program
1. [Go to Loyalty Program](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Loyalty%20Program&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/loyalty-accounts/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Start Now**.
3. Enter your loyalty program details:
   * **Program name:** Add your loyalty program name.
   * **Points name:** Choose a name for your loyalty points. You can choose **Points** or create a custom name.
   * **Points icon:** Select a loyalty points icon.
4. Click **Continue to Setup**.

## Step 2 | Choose how your customers earn points
1. Click the **Points and rewards** tab.
2. Hover over **Place a restaurant order** and click **Edit**.
3. Enter your loyalty points details:
   * **Let customers know how to earn points:** Describe what customers have to do to earn points.
   * **Points earned for every $1.00 spent:** Choose how many points are earned per $1 spent.
4. Click **Save**.

## Step 3 | Set up your loyalty rewards
1. Hover over **Order discount** and click **Edit**.
2. Enter your loyalty rewards details:
   * **Reward name:** Enter a name for your reward.
   * **Discount:** Enter the discount amount.
   * **Cost in points:** Choose how many points need to be redeemed in order to receive a discount.
3. Click **Save**.

## Step 4 | Decide whether to activate email automations
1. Click the **Email automations** tab.
2. Click the **Status** toggle to turn email automations on or off:
   * **Active:** Customers automatically receive an email when they earn a reward.
   * **Inactive:** Customers do not automatically receive an email when they earn a reward.

## Step 5 | Review and launch your loyalty program
1. Click the **Program info** tab.
2. Review your **Program details** and click **Edit Details** to make any changes.
3. Review your **Program overview** and click the **Points and rewards** or **Email automations** tab to make any changes.
4. Click **Launch Program** at the top right of the page.
5. Click **Launch Program** again to confirm.
6. Click **Add Widget** to install the Loyalty widget and add it to the checkout page.
7. Click **Add to Checkout**.
8. Click **Add** to confirm.

question: How can I create a customer segment in Wix based on specific criteria?
answer:
To create a segment in Wix, you're organizing your contacts into groups built from specific filters and criteria. Follow these steps:

1. **Choose a Filter**: Your contacts can be filtered by either a **contact attribute** (e.g., city, country) or **contact activity** on your site (e.g., number of purchases, last purchased).

2. **Add Conditional Logic**: Once you've decided on your filter, add conditional logic (e.g., is equal to, is less than).

3. **Select a Value**: Depending on the filter, you might also choose a value. For example, if you want to target customers who have spent a lot in the past but haven't visited your site in a while, you could create a segment that identifies people who have spent more than $500 but haven't visited in the last 3 months.

You can also use [segments overview](https://support.wix.com/en/article/how-segments-overview-works) to monitor activity within key segments that Wix suggests for you. Additionally, you can [add custom fields](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-custom-fields-to-contacts) to your contacts to collect additional customer information, which can be used as segment filters.

question: What is ICANN's 60 Day Lock Policy and how can I manage my domain if I'm affected by it?
answer:
ICANN's 60 Day Lock Policy states that it is not possible to transfer a domain within 60 days of:

* Registering the domain
* Changing the registrant contact information
* Transferring your domain between different domain providers

This limitation applies to both incoming (to Wix) and outgoing (away from Wix) transfers and cannot be circumvented by Wix.

If you are unable to transfer your Wix domain away from Wix due to this limitation, you can keep the domain in your Wix account and point it to your external site in the meantime. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-wix-domain-to-an-external-site) to learn more.

Alternatively, if you were trying to transfer your domain to Wix and were unable to due to this limitation, you can connect your domain to Wix in the meantime. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-purchased-elsewhere) to learn more.

### Note
* After changing your contact information you are required to [confirm your information](https://support.wix.com/en/article/icann-confirming-your-domain-contact-information) within 14 days of the change. Failure to confirm your contact information within 14 days will result in the suspension of your domain.
* If your final goal is to transfer your domain to another domain provider, please be advised that you should do so before changing your contact information, in order to avoid triggering the 60 day lock.

question: How can I use the 'Submit' click action to save user input to my CMS collection?
answer:
To use the 'Submit' click action to save information to your collection that visitors provide in input elements, follow these steps:

1. Ensure your dataset mode is set to **Write** or **Read & Write**.
2. Connect your button or image to the dataset.
3. Use input elements to collect data from visitors.
4. When visitors click the 'Submit' button, the inputs are saved to your collection.

- If the dataset mode is **Write**, this action submits the inputs as a new item.
- If the dataset mode is **Read & Write**, this action updates the displayed item.

Learn how to [create a custom form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-a-custom-form-with-input-elements-that-submit-to-your-collection) using input elements that saves to your CMS collection.

question: How can I change the dynamic page dataset settings in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the dynamic page dataset settings in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the relevant dynamic page in your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

   1. Click **CMS** on the left.
   2. Click **Manage Page Connections**.

   **Tip:** Click **Open** next to **Connected to collection** to go to the collection that connects to the dataset.

4. Click **Preview** to test your connections.

question: How do I add and set up a Pay Button on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Purchase [a plan that allows you to accept payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/choosing-a-premium-plan).

### Step 1 | Add a Pay Button
To add a Pay Button to your site:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
3. Search for the Pay Button app.
4. Click **Add to Site**.

### Step 2 | Set up your payment method
To connect a payment method to your Pay Button:
1. Click the **Pay Button** in the editor.
2. Click **Manage Payment Methods**.
3. Click **Connect** next to the relevant payment methods (you can select multiple).
4. Follow the relevant steps to complete the set-up process:
   - **Automatically Connected:** You can start accepting payments immediately, but in order to receive the funds, you must complete the set-up process below.
   - **Recommended Provider:** To accept payments, you must create an account or connect an existing account with the recommended provider:
     1. Click **Set Up Account**.
     2. Connect your account:
        - **Have an account:**
          - Enter your credentials.
          - Click **Sign in** and follow the steps to connect your account.
        - **Don't have an account:**
          - Click **Create new account** and follow the steps to create your account.

### Step 3 | Customize the settings of your button
To customize the settings of your button:
1. Click the Pay Button in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Enter the product's name under **Item Name**.
4. Enter the product's price under **Item Price**.
5. Edit the text that appears on the button under **What does this button say?**
6. (Optional) Enable the **Show Terms & Conditions Checkbox** toggle.
7. Check the email address under **Email Notifications**.

### (Optional) Step 4 | Choose a layout for your button
To choose the layout of your button:
1. Click the Pay Button in your editor.
2. Click the **Layouts** icon.
3. Select the direction and alignment for the button's text.

### (Optional) Step 5 | Customize the design of your button
To customize the design of your button:
1. Click the Pay Button in your editor.
2. Click the **Design** icon.
3. Choose one of the preset designs for your button.
4. Click **Customize Design** for advanced options for the **Regular** and **Hover** view.

question: What should I do if I receive a suspicious invoice letter for my Wix domain renewal from a company like DNS Services?
answer:
If you receive a suspicious letter or email from another company (such as DNS Services) with an invoice for a domain you purchased with Wix, ignore it as it is a scam.

### Tip
If you don't know who your domain registrar is, you can find out by visiting [whois.com](https://www.whois.com/whois/) and entering your domain name to view your domain details.

To help prevent this from happening, we recommend purchasing [Private Registration](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-privacy) with your domain. This hides your address and phone number from public WHOIS directories.

If you have already purchased your domain with Public Registration, you can add privacy protection by manually extending your domain registration for at least an additional year. Learn more about [activating private registration for a Wix domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/activating-private-registration-for-a-wix-domain).

question: Do customers receive additional email notifications such as renewal reminders or notifications about changes for their pricing plans?

question: How can I update multiple orders at once in Wix Stores?
answer:
To update multiple orders at once in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Orders tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select checkboxes next to the orders you want to update.
3. Click the action from the top bar:
   
   * **Assign Tags:** Add or remove tags you created. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/assigning-tags-to-orders)
   * **Export:** Click to download a .CSV file. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/exporting-orders-3126323)
   * **Print Orders:** Send orders to your printer.
   * **Print Shipping Label:** Create and print multiple labels through Wix Shipping. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-printing-shipping-labels-with-wix-shipping#purchasing-and-printing-multiple-labels-at-once) 
     
     **Note:** This option is not available in all regions.
4. Click **More Actions** and select an action:
   
   * **Mark as paid:** Mark the selected orders as "Paid".
   * **Mark as fulfilled:** Mark the selected orders as "Fulfilled" (Relevant only for store orders).
   * **Create Invoice:** An invoice is created and appears in the Invoices tab.
   * **Archive:** Adds the selected orders to the archive.

### Notes
* You can create an invoice for up to 100 invoices at once.
* You cannot add tracking numbers to multiple store orders at once.

question: Can I change design presets dynamically through code in Wix Blocks?

question: What does error code 8024 mean in SSO troubleshooting, and how can it be resolved?
answer: Error code **8024** means "SSO user doesn't exist." In SSO for clients, users (clients) must already exist as SSO users when they attempt to log in with SSO. We identify users by their external user id (their ID in IdP) and the SSO ID. This error is returned when such a user doesn't exist. To resolve this issue, ensure that the user is correctly set up in the Identity Provider (IdP) and that their external user ID and SSO ID are correctly configured in the system.

question: How can I build a new menu using the Wix app for my restaurant?
answer:
To build a new menu using the Wix app for your restaurant, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Catalog**.
4. Tap **Restaurant Menus (New)**.
5. Tap the **+ Add Menu** button.
6. **Menu name:** Enter a name for the menu, for example: Specials.
   
   1. **Menu description:** Enter a description for the menu. For example: "Dive into our specials menu, where our chef's creativity shines! Discover delightful seasonal treats and delicious innovations that'll make your taste buds dance with joy."
   
   **Note:** You can add line breaks to your descriptions.
   2. **Mark as a draft:** Select the checkbox to mark the menu as a draft while you make changes. When a menu is marked as a draft, it won't show in the Editor or your live site.
7. Tap **Save**.
8. Tap the menu you just created.
9. Tap the **Add Section** button:
   
   1. **Section name:** Enter a name for the menu section. For example: Vegan.
   2. **Description:** Enter a brief description of the menu section for customers to see on your live site. For example: "Indulge in our plant-based wonders, where every bite of our vegan dishes embodies the perfect balance of deliciousness and healthy nourishment."
10. Tap the section you just created.
11. Tap **Save**.
12. Repeat steps 9-10 for all of the menu sections. Tap **+ Add Section** to add another section to this menu.
13. Tap **Add Item**:
   
   1. **Item name:** Enter the name of the menu item.
   2. **Item description:** Describe the menu item so that customers know what they're ordering.
   3. **Item labels:** Add labels to help customers identify key information about the dish (Vegan, Gluten Free, Extra Hot, etc.). Tap the checkbox near the label to select it.
   4. **Price:** Enter either a single price or a varying price to your menu item. The currency is set based on your [settings in business info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-setting-up-your-restaurant-address-and-phone-number).
   5. **Image:** Select or upload an image to your item.
   
   **Note:** You have to enter a name and price for your menu item. You can choose to hide prices in the Editor.
14. Tap **Save**.
15. Repeat steps for all of your menu items.

question: How can I create and send an invoice to a client using Wix Studio?
answer:
To create and send an invoice to a client in Wix Studio, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Marketplace Overview](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/marketplace) in your Wix Studio workspace.
2. Click the **Invoices** tab on the left.
3. Click **Create New** at the top right and select **Invoice**.

   **Tip:** You can also [create recurring invoices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-creating-and-managing-recurring-invoices) to get paid on a weekly, monthly or yearly basis.
4. Enter the following details for this invoice:
   
   * **Due Date:** Choose a due date for the invoice.
   * **Customer:** Choose a client for this invoice.
   * **Invoice title:** Enter a title for this invoice.
5. Add the products or services for this invoice:
   
   * **Product or Service:** Select a product or service to add to the invoice. 
     
     **Tip:** Select **\+ Add New** to create a new item. Then enter the details and click **Save**.
   * **Quantity:** Enter the quantity of the product or service.
   * **Price:** Enter a price for the product or service.
   * (Optional) **\+ Add Tax:** Add one or two tax rates to the line item.
   * (Optional) **Write a description:** Enter additional details about the product or service.
   * (Optional) **\+ Add Line Item:** Add additional products or services to your invoice.
   * (Optional) **\+ Add Discount:** Apply a percentage discount to the total amount.
6. Enter additional info for the invoice:
   
   * **Notes:** Enter any notes you'd like your client to be aware of.
   * **Terms:** Enter any terms that apply to this invoice.
7. Choose to preview, save, collect payment or send your invoice:
   
   * **Preview:** Click **Preview** at the top right to see the invoice your client will receive.
   * **Save:** Click **Save \& Close** at the top right to save the invoice to send at a later time.
   * **Collect Payment:** Choose whether to charge your client with a credit card or record receipt of payment for this invoice.
   * **Send:** Click **Send Invoice** at the top right to first review or edit the content of the email your client will receive with the invoice. Click **Send** when you're ready to send.

question: How can I connect multiple database collections in my CMS to display related information?
answer:
To connect multiple database collections in your CMS and display related information, you have two options:

1. **Create Reference Fields**: 
   - Reference fields act as pointers to a different collection, creating a connection between collections in the actual structure of the primary collection. This allows you to access all the information in the referenced collections from within the primary collection. Note that dynamic page URLs cannot be based on reference fields.
   - [Learn more about adding a reference field to a CMS collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-reference-field-to-a-cms-collection).

2. **Filter a Dataset**:
   - Filtering datasets allows you to create connections between collections that both have a field with the same data without using a reference field. This setup lets one dataset respond to another, displaying only items whose field values match the current item of the second dataset. Remember, the connection exists only between the datasets on that page, and you will need to filter any additional datasets separately.
   - [Learn more about adding filters and sorts to datasets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-filters-and-sorts-to-datasets-to-control-live-site-content).

By using these methods, you can create pages that display related information from different collections, such as a repeater listing songs with artist photos or a dynamic item page showing artist details and their songs.

question: Can I connect list items in the Selection Tags input element to field types other than Text and Number when collecting content?
answer: Currently, when using the [Selection Tags input element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-selection-tags) to **collect content**, you can only connect these choices to Text and Number field types. You cannot connect these choices to other field types such as the Tags field type.

question: How can I customize the design of the Search Results page in Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the design of your Search Results page in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click the **Search Results** page.
3. Click the Search Results element on the page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Design** tab.
6. Choose what you want to customize:

#### Search bar

Customize the search bar on the results page. The search bar allows visitors to quickly search for something else without having to scroll through the page. 
Select **Search Bar**, and customize the below options: 
* **Background opacity & color:** Click the color box to select the background color of the search bar, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.
* **Border width:** Drag the slider to adjust the thickness of the border.
* **Border opacity & color:** Click the color box to select the color of the search bar's border, and drag the slider to increase or decrease the opacity.
* **Text font & color:** Click the color box to select the text color, and click the text field to adjust the font, size, and formatting.
* **Icon opacity & color:** Click the color box to select the icon color, and drag the slider to increase or decrease its opacity.

#### Results menu

Customize the results menu, which shows where the search term was found on your site (e.g. pages, store). 
Click **Results Menu** and customize using the below options: 
* **Text font & color:** Click the color box to select the text color, and click the text field to adjust the font, size, and formatting.
* **Border opacity & color:** Click the color box to select the border color, and drag the slider to adjust its opacity.
* **Selected border color:** Click the color box to select the border color of a menu item when it is selected.

#### Search results

Customize the list of search results section of the page. 
Select **Search Results** to customize the options below: 
* **Search Results:** Click the color boxes next to the relevant text to select the color, and click the text field to adjust its font, size, and formatting.
* **Pagination:** Customize the pagination bar at the bottom of the search results page with the below options:

  + **Text font & color:** Click the color boxes next to the relevant text to select the color, and click the text field to adjust its font, size, and formatting.
  + **Selected text color:** Click the color box to select the text color of the selected page in the pagination bar.
* **Text Highlight:** Adjust how highlighted text looks on the results page using the below options:

  + **Background color:** Click the color picker to choose a background color, and drag the slider to adjust its opacity.
  + **Font color & style:** Click the color picker to choose a font color, and add bold, italics, or underline to the text.

#### Buttons

Customize the buttons that appear in the search results section of the page. 
Select **Buttons** to customize the View All Button and the Add To Cart Button: 
* **Text font & color:** Click the color box to select the text color, and click the text field to adjust its font, size, and formatting.
* **Fill color & opacity:** Click the color box to select the button color, and drag the slider to adjust its opacity.

question: How can I create a coupon for my Wix event tickets?
answer:
To create a coupon for events:

1. [Go to Coupons](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **\+ New Coupon**.
3. Select a discount type:
   
   * **$ Discount**
   * **% Discount**
4. Enter the coupon code that your customers need to use.
5. Enter the name of the coupon. 

   **Note:** This name appears on the cart page and your site's dashboard.
6. Enter the discount amount / percentage under **Discount**.
7. Click the **Apply to** drop-down menu and select what the coupon applies to:
   
   * **Specific ticket:** Applies to one ticket type you created for an event (e.g. early-bird ticket). Click the **Ticket** drop-down and select the type.
   * **Specific event:** Applies to all ticket types for an event. Click the **Ticket** drop-down and select the event.
   * **All tickets:** The coupon can be applied to any ticket and any event on your site.
8. Select one of the following:
   
   * **Apply once per order (to the lowest priced item):** Customers who buy 2 or more tickets get a discount for only one ticket.
   * **Apply to each eligible item in the order:** Customers who buy 2 or more tickets get a discount on each one.
9. Select when the coupon is valid:
   
   1. Enter the start date.
   2. Enter the end date, or select the **Don't set an end date** checkbox.
10. (Optional) Limit the coupon use (e.g. available for the first 50 guests):
   
   1. Select the **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon** checkbox.
   2. Enter the number of times the coupon can be used. 
   
   **Tip:** Multiple purchases by the same customer are counted individually.
11. Click **Create Coupon**.

question: How can I manually submit my Wix site's sitemap to Google Search Console?
answer:
To manually submit your Wix site's sitemap to Google Search Console, follow these steps:

question: How can I add and set up an icon button in the Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor.

To add an icon button to your site:

3. Click **Button**.
4. Click **Icon Buttons**.

You can choose from free media available from Wix, or upload your own.
   * **Icon only:** Display only an icon on the button. Set up the following options:
     + **Choose icon:** Click the **Replace** icon ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/z6ZrkIIFObm5Ar04kRcNkKN5CggrigK8-034Ut8Cv96ddzvU3I4sjvE_6v8fWmyUp3hGkc4sa_ruJ-5Ct264wLNJWDmlc4ln0V09Y2p-cI8-K3jdgwVU2a4V6OU3sGY7JWDr4GO8) to select a new icon for your button. You can choose from free media available from Wix, or upload your own.
     + **What's the alt text?:** Enter an alt text description of the icon.
   * **Text only:** Display only text on the button. Enter the text you want to display on the button under **What does it say?**.

To add a link to your button:
1. Click your icon button.
2. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2021/06/06/868c09f5-c67f-4530-8dfe-4ed4ee500153/a445bae1-12ff-4b91-9207-dfd4f64d2d88.png).

4. Depending on the link type you selected, add the relevant information.

To customize your icon button:
1. Click your icon button.
2. Click the **Design** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2021/11/15/c47d700f-ff3e-4fee-ab10-887b3c5b44e6/1028f268-16f6-4f0a-bf7c-72efa9482642.png) icon.
3. Select a different preset design, or click **Customize Design** to adjust the existing design.
4. Under **Customize Design**, choose the button state from the drop-down menu:
   * **Regular:** How the button is displayed before visitors interact with it.
   * **Hover:** How the button is displayed when visitors hover over it.
5. Customize the design from the following tabs:
   * **Background Fills**: Customize the [fill of your button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-the-design-of-your-buttons#button-design-options).
   * **Text**: Adjust the [design of the button text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-the-design-of-your-buttons#text-formatting-options).
   * **Borders**: Edit the [width and design of your borders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-the-design-of-your-buttons#button-design-options).

   * **Shadows**: Add and customize a [shadow effect on your button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-the-design-of-your-buttons#button-design-options).
   * **Layout**: Select what to display on your button, and [adjust the alignment](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-the-design-of-your-buttons#button-design-options).

question: How can I customize the design of a Wix form to improve accessibility?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that field titles are displayed and defined as per Step 1 and Step 2.

To customize the form's design:

1. Select the form in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Select **Design**.
4. Choose which part of the form you want to customize:
   
   * **Fields**: 
     
     1. Select **Form Fields**.
     2. Select **Hover** from the drop-down menu.
     3. Change the field design:
        
        + **Fill color & opacity:** Set the color of the field background and drag the slider to change the opacity.
        + **Border color & opacity:** Set the color and opacity of the field border.
   * **Buttons:**
     
     1. Select **Buttons**.
     2. Select the button you want to customize (Submit, Back, Upload, etc.).
     3. Click the **Hover** tab.
     4. Change the button's design:
        
        + **Text color:** Set the color of the button text in the hover state.
        + **Color & opacity:** Set the color of the button background and drag the slider to change the opacity.
        + **Border color & opacity:** Set the color and opacity of the button's border.

### Tips
* You should also customize the form fields in the Error state to ensure improved accessibility.
* [Learn more about colors and contrast in site accessibility](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-text-and-graphics)

question: How can I review reports about members from my site's dashboard?
answer:
To review reports from your site's dashboard:

1. [Go to Site Members](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Members%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/member-permissions/members) in your site's dashboard.

question: How does Wix determine which customers are subject to US sales tax?
answer: Sales tax is charged according to the billing address (zip code) entered with your credit card information and type of subscription purchased. Please ensure your billing information is correct. If it's not, [you can update your billing information](https://support.wix.com/en/article/managing-your-payment-methods-for-wix-services#updating-a-payment-method).

question: How can I set up my Wix site to allow clients to check in using a chip, card, or barcode?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that the Client Check-In app is added to your site and updated to the latest version.

To allow clients to check in by scanning a chip, card, or barcode, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Manage Apps](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Apps&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-installed-apps/) in your dashboard.
2. Click **Open** next to Client Check-In.
3. Click the **Scan** tab.
4. Enable the **Let members scan to check in** toggle.
5. Choose what happens when clients scan using the wedge reader:
   * **Check them into all sessions:** Clients check in for all their upcoming appointments and classes.
   * **Check them into their first available sessions:** Clients check into the next class or appointment they booked.
   * **Let members choose which session to check into:** Allow clients to choose which classes or appointments they want to check into.
6. Click **Save**.

After enabling the toggle, the **CheckInId** field appears on your members' Contact cards. You then use this field to enter the member's card, chip, or barcode ID number. Next, scan the card, chip, or barcode to sync it with the client's profile. This will allow them to check themselves in when arriving for their bookings.

To connect the Client Check-In app to a wedge reader:

1. Connect your wedge reader to your computer or tablet.
2. [Go to Contacts](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Contacts&title=Select%20a%20site%20to%20update&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fmy-account%2Fsites%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fcontacts) in your site's dashboard.
3. Hover over the relevant contact and click **View**.
4. Click **Edit Contact**.
5. Enter the ID number on the client's card, chip, or barcode next to **checkInId**.
6. Scan the client's card, chip, or barcode for the first time to activate the client on the system.
7. Click **Save**.

question: Can I customize the scroll bars in the Studio Editor?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to design the site's scroll bars. This means you cannot change the color, width, background, shadow, radius or any other value.

question: How can I customize my Wix site using the Wix app on my mobile device?
answer: With the Wix app, you can customize your site directly from your mobile device to keep it updated. question: How can I edit the invite code for my Wix Member App?
answer:
To edit an invite code:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.

question: Why can't I find the Billing/Invoices and Billing/PriceQuotes collections in my Wix CMS Editor and Site Dashboard?
answer: The **Billing/Invoices** collection and **Billing/PriceQuotes** collection have been temporarily removed from CMS in both the Editor and Site Dashboard.

question: Why do I see a black frame on the preview of my embedded YouTube videos, and how can I fix it?
answer: The black frame or bars that you see appear in the preview of the video only. When you play the YouTube videos, you will not see these black bars, provided that you are using the appropriate aspect ratio. We have thoroughly investigated this issue and found that the root cause is on YouTube's end and affects all embedded YouTube videos, regardless of where the video has been embedded.

question: How can I share my promotional video created with Wix Video Maker on social media platforms?

question: How can I add and set up a Members Area on my Wix site if I don't have it installed?

question: Can I accept installments for invoices paid online using Wix Invoices?

question: How do I change the daily spend of my Google Ads campaign with Wix?
answer:

1. From the main campaigns page, click **Manage Spend & Credits** at the right.
2. View the ad credits remaining in the current billing cycle. Click **Adjust Daily Spend** to change your daily spend.

question: What happens to my Google Ads credits if I pause a campaign using Wix?
answer:
If you pause a campaign, you have the option at any time to resume the campaign using only your remaining Google ad credits. As soon as you pause, the following changes happen:

* Your ad is no longer shown on Google.
* Your remaining ad credits remain in your account.
* If the paused campaign was your last active campaign on the account, auto renew is turned off for the subscription.

**Note:** Any Google Ads credits that have an expiry date may expire while the campaign is paused.

question: Is it possible to limit the Selection Tags input element to only one selection?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to set the [Selection Tags input element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-selection-tags) to only accept one selection from the list of choices. However, you can use Velo to limit the Selection Tags input element to only allow visitors to choose one selection at a time.

### Workaround: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your Editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page with the connected Selection Tags element.
3. Enable Velo Dev Mode:
   1. Click **Dev Mode** at the top of the Editor.
   2. Click **Turn on Dev Mode**.
4. Replace the gray text with the code below, after the first line: **$w.onReady(function () {**

```javascript
$w('#selectionTags1').onChange((event) => {
 const indeces = $w('#selectionTags1').selectedIndices;
 const singleIndex = indeces.slice(-1);
 $w('#selectionTags1').selectedIndices = singleIndex
 })
```

1. (If needed) Replace **selectionTags1** with the ID of your Selection Tags element. Click the relevant Selection Tags element to find its ID in the [Properties and Events panel](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/workspace-tools/velo-workspace/properties-events-panel/working-with-the-properties-events-panel).

**Note:** Do not remove the hashtag (**\#**) or apostrophes (**'**) in the code.

question: How can I customize the success message for a new form on my Wix site?

question: How can I set up an automation in Wix to notify me when an invoice is overdue?
answer:
To set up an automation in Wix to notify you when an invoice is overdue, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Automations Dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/).
2. Click **+ New Automation.**
3. Click the title to give your automation a name.
4. Set up the trigger:
   
   1. Select **Invoices** under **Trigger**.
   2. Select the checkbox next to **When the invoice is overdue**.

question: How can I change the email address associated with my Wix account?
answer:
To change the email address associated with your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Account Settings](https://manage.wix.com/account/account-settings) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Account email** field.
3. Enter your Wix account password in the pop-up.
4. Enter your new account email address.
5. Retype your new account email address to confirm it.
6. Click **Next**.
7. Check your email account for an email from Wix.
8. Copy the 6-digit confirmation code.
9. Go back to Account Settings in your Wix account.
10. Paste the code into the pop-up.
11. Click **Submit**.

### Important
* Make sure that your new email address is a real address with no typos. Wix sends a code to this email address to verify it.
* Each Wix account needs a unique email address. It's not possible to use an email address that's already linked to another Wix account.

question: How can I set up an automation in Wix Chat to automatically send a chat message when a visitor submits a form?
answer:
To set up an automation in Wix Chat to automatically send a chat message when a visitor submits a form, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** in the top right corner.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
   
   **Note:** To use a suggested automation, search and select from the options under **Popular**. You can edit the trigger and actions of a suggested automation.
4. Click the title to give your automation a name.
5. Click the app you'd like to base your trigger on in the **Trigger** section.
6. Select your chosen trigger from the available options.
   
   **Note:** These options will differ depending on the app you selected in step 5.
7. Click the **Limit frequency to** drop-down to set trigger frequency:
   
   * **Don't limit (trigger every time):** Your action will take place every time it is triggered by a visitor.
   * **Once per contact:** Your action will take place only once per contact.
   * **Once per contact every 24hrs:** Your action will take place only once per contact in any 24hr period.
8. Click **Send a chat message** in the **Action** section.
   
   **Note:** **Send a chat message** will only be an action option for certain triggers.
9. Enter the chat message you'd like to send in the **Message** field.
10. Click the **Send this message only when I'm online to chat** toggle to specify when these messages are sent:
    
    * **Enabled:** This chat message will only be sent when your [chat status](https://support.wix.com/en/article/schedule-your-chat-hours) is online.
    * **Disabled:** This chat message will be sent whether your chat status is online or offline.
11. (Optional) Set a delay and add a condition to specify the automation:

### Add a delay
Set the delay between a trigger and its action, to have the action occur after a certain amount of time passes.
1. Click **+ Add Delay**.
2. Click the drop-down and select when to perform the action (e.g. days, hours and minutes).

   **Note:** If you don't add a delay, the action is performed as soon as the trigger occurs.

### Add a condition
Add a condition to make the automation occur when certain conditions are met.
1. Click **+ Add Condition**.
2. Click the **Continue the automation if** drop-down and select the criteria you want to use to decide whether this automation continues each time it's triggered.
3. Click the drop-down that appears next to your criteria drop-down to select your operator (e.g. "is", "is not").
4. Click the drop-down or text box that appears next to the operator drop-down to complete your condition.

   **Note:** The logical statement you've created will determine whether the automation continues.
5. (Optional) Click **+ Add Criteria** to add more conditions.
12. (Optional) Click **+ Add an Action** at the bottom to set up a [multi-action automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-multi-action-automation).
13. Click **Activate** to save your new automation.

question: Can I fully customize the cookie banner in the Wix Editor, such as modifying its size or changing its location on the screen?

question: Can I add items from different Wix Photo Albums to one cart?

question: How can I change my password on my Wix account?
answer:
To change your password on your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Account Settings](https://manage.wix.com/account/account-settings) in your Wix account.
2. Under **Edit Password:**
   
   1. Enter your current password.
   2. Enter your new password.
   3. Enter your new password again.
3. Click **Save**.

When creating a secure password for your Wix account, ensure it is at least 6 characters long (recommended at least 12 characters) and may contain English upper and/or lower case characters, numbers, and any of the following special characters: **\_ \- ! @ \# $ % ^ \& \***. Note that your password cannot contain a period (**.**). It is also recommended to add a [Recovery Phone Number](https://support.wix.com/en/article/updating-the-mobile-phone-number-in-your-wix-account) to help you recover your account if needed.

question: How can I generate AI text for my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have added a text element to your page as described in Step 1.

To generate AI text:

1. Click the text box in your editor.
2. Click the **AI Tools** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/09/13/b0658bf7-5a1c-4f41-858e-edcc7d15ccfc/9ad1aa8a-cf89-47dd-a599-003b015e7dae.png) icon.
3. Choose from the following options:

### Create new text with AI
Use AI to generate fresh content. Describe the text you need, specify the section, and let AI generate a paragraph, title, or tagline tailored to your request.

1. Click **Generate new text**.
2. Use the text box to describe the text you want AI to create. You can make your prompt more specific using the following options:

   * **Write a paragraph for:** Select the relevant section from the dropdown.
   * **Title:** Click this option if the AI-generated text should be a title. This adds the specific instruction to your prompt.
   * **Tagline:** Click this option if the AI-generated text should be a tagline (i.e. a brief sentence about your site/section). This adds the specific instruction to your prompt.
3. Click the **Submit** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/10/01/ff06a5df-4c35-4d3d-8ff1-df3cfcaf9523/9d6d7bd8-5ecf-4f27-9399-0222c4a71d2e.png) icon.

### Improve existing text with AI
Refine your text with AI by selecting from the options below to rewrite, shorten, or adjust the tone. You can also rephrase, translate, or expand the AI-generated text, ensuring it's just right for your needs.

1. Choose from the following options:

   * **Rewrite text**
   * **Make shorter**
   * **Change tone to enthusiastic**
   * **Fix grammar and spelling**
   * **Edit with Text Creator**
2. (Optional) Adjust the AI-suggested text using the following options:

   * **Rephrase:** Reword the text.
   * **Make shorter:** Shorten the text.
   * **Change tone:** Use the dropdown to choose from professional, enthusiastic, casual confident or funny tone.
   * **Translate to:** Use the dropdown to choose one of 15 languages to translate the text to.

   **Tip:** Click **See More** to choose from additional options such as **make longer**, **write as bullets** and **simplify language**. You can also change the number of options AI generates by clicking the **Generate options** drop-down.
3. Click **Use text**, or the **Copy text** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/21e446eb-7f73-4f2f-84b1-c6b77e64e45e/2024/10/01/301b9d4b-6b0a-4fb1-a0b5-a63400d61f47/daf12ede-b569-4ecc-bb35-c74dded00968.png) to use it elsewhere.

question: Can I search through the content of my group in Wix Groups?

question: How can I end my Facebook Ads campaign with Wix before the month is up, and what happens to my subscription?
answer:
To end your Facebook Ads campaign with Wix before the month is up, you can follow these steps:

1. Go to your Facebook Ads dashboard.
2. Click on the option to [end your campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-ending-a-campaign).

When you end your campaign, it ends instantly, and auto-renew is turned off. You can restart an ended campaign at any time before your subscription expires by clicking **Edit & Restart** from your Facebook Ads dashboard. Resuming a campaign also turns auto-renew back on. Any unused ad spend will remain in your account until you resume the campaign. If the [subscription expires](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-pausing-and-resuming-your-ad-campaign-9219531#resuming-after-your-subscription-has-expired), you need to purchase a new subscription in order to activate the campaign and use the remaining ad spend.

question: How can I display a cookie consent banner on my site to comply with GDPR regulations?
answer: In accordance with regulations like the [GDPR](https://support.wix.com/en/article/preparing-your-wix-site-for-the-gdpr), you must ask for consent before placing "non-essential" cookies on your visitor’s device. Add a cookie banner to inform them about the cookies you're using and collect their consent. The content of your cookie banner is fully customizable. You can edit any text or explanation on the banner to your individual style and needs. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/displaying-a-cookie-banner-on-your-site)

question: How can I archive or delete a conversation in the Wix app?

question: What should I do if I encounter a URL error when adding a link to my email marketing campaign?
answer:
If your campaign contains a URL error, check the URL you are adding to your campaign against the following blacklist checkers:

* [Spamhaus](https://www.spamhaus.org/lookup/)
* [Barracuda](https://www.barracudacentral.org/lookups)
* [Spamcop](https://www.spamcop.net/bl.shtml)

If the URL is shown as blacklisted, you cannot add it to your campaign.

question: Can I freeze my footer into a fixed position inside ADI?
answer: Currently you cannot freeze your footer into a fixed position inside ADI. If you want to freeze your footer, you should [head to the Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-moving-from-adi-to-the-editor) and follow the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-customizing-your-site-footer).

   2. Open the relevant blog post.

2. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26) and navigate to the relevant page.
3. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
4. Click **Button**.
5. Click the button you want to add, or drag it to the relevant location.
6. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/cdff0ec4-6b02-4f12-8539-cf6a845d4dac.png).
7. Select **Web Address**.
8. Paste the blog post URL in the **What's the web address (URL)?** field.
9. Select whether the external URL opens in a **New Window** or in the **Current Window**.
10. Click **Done**.

![A screenshot showing the option to add a web address to a button](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/13691038-5aa8-4672-9b95-348c0733cabc/2024/07/31/cc62928e-8afa-45c6-88f1-055abe7348ed/dc27248b-84b4-4e82-86ea-e4cc00144bdc.png)

question: How can I access my form's submissions table using the ADI builder?

4. In the toolbar above the image, click the **Image Editor** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/f1b5ecb4-ca89-48f1-8ab9-874357eb9d8b/2024/07/03/8edade8a-1a0e-4f78-803d-e875820da33b/0f27073b-d148-420a-828f-6d7147b1131e.png).

question: How can I customize the layout of the member login bar on my Wix mobile site?
answer:
To change the layout of the member login bar on your mobile site, follow these steps:

1. Click the mobile menu in the [mobile editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-getting-started-with-the-mobile-editor).
2. Click **Edit Menu**.
3. Click the member login bar.
4. Click the **Layouts** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/f43b2840-e00d-413c-b386-7deed81d7131.png).
5. Customize the Login Bar layout using the following options:
   
   * **Avatar size:** Drag the slider to change the size of the member's profile pic on the Login Bar.
   * **Show bell icon for notifications:** Enable or disable login bar notifications for your members.
   * **Login bar alignment:** Choose how to align the text on the Login Bar Menu. **Left**, **center** or **right**.
   * **Arrow icon:** Choose a shape for the arrow visitors click to open the Login Bar Menu. Then drag the **Arrow size** slider to change the size of the arrow.

### Tip
You can [move the login bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-moving-elements-between-the-mobile-menu-header-and-footer) between your menu, header, and footer by right-clicking it, and clicking **Move To**.

question: Can I customize the design of buttons in the Spaces app beyond the Primary, Secondary, or Link options?
answer: Currently, you can choose between 3 design options for buttons that you add to the Spaces app: Primary, Secondary or Link. At this time, it is not possible to design your buttons further.

question: How can I manage and place phone orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To manage and place phone orders using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/restaurants/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More** at the top right and select **\+ Create New Order**.
3. Enter the customer's phone number and click **Next**.
4. Enter their contact details and click **Next**. 

   **Note:** Information for returning customers is saved and you can add comments about the customer.

5. Select the order type and click **Next**:
   
   * **Delivery:** Enter the customer’s delivery address.
   * **Pickup:** Select the location for customer pickup.

6. Add the customer's order:
   
   1. Select the dish from the menu.
   2. Enter any special requests for the order.
   3. (Optional) Click the Plus and Minus icons to change the quantity of the item.
   4. Click **Add to order**.

7. Once you've added the full order, click **Go to Checkout**.
8. Choose a payment method for the order. **Note:** You'll only be able to choose from the [payment providers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-setting-up-payment-methods-for-orders) that are set up in your account.
9. Click **Place Order**.
10. Click **Done**.

### Note
Phone orders only work for orders placed for right now. Currently, there isn't an option to place an order for another time or date. Make sure to toggle on **ASAP** orders in **Order scheduling**.

question: What steps do I need to follow to verify my Wix Payments account as a sole proprietor in the United Kingdom?
answer:
To verify your Wix Payments account as a sole proprietor in the United Kingdom, follow these steps:

1. **Ensure Personal and Company Information is Correct:**
   - Your first, middle, and last name, as well as your date of birth, must match those listed in your photo ID.

2. **Bank Account Details:**
   - Double-check that you've entered your bank account number(s) correctly.
   - Submit a business bank account.

3. **Company Information:**
   - Your company's name and its Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) number must match the company's registered information.
   - Your **Doing Business As** name should match what appears on your customers' statements.

4. **Address Verification:**
   - Enter a physical address to verify your account. PO Boxes are not accepted as a valid address.
   - Upload an address verification document, such as a utility bill, to confirm your address. The document must have been issued within the last 6 months.

5. **Document Uploads:**
   - Upload a document that proves the validity and ownership of the UTR during registration.
   - Upload a color copy of your photo ID and bank statement to verify your identity. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/guidelines-for-uploading-documentation-for-wix-payments).

6. **Business Description:**
   - Use the dropdown menu to select your Business Type.
   - Use the text box to add a short description of your products/services.

7. **Verification Time:**
   - Allow 7 business days for the account to be verified. If 7 business days have already passed and you've verified the information is correct and matches your bank account details, [contact Wix Customer Care](https://support.wix.com/en/article/contacting-wix-customer-care-for-support).
