question: How can I clear Wix cookies from my Google Chrome browser?
answer:
To clear Wix cookies from your Google Chrome browser, follow these steps:

1. Open Google Chrome.
2. Click the More icon at the top right.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click **Privacy and security** on the left.
5. Click **Cookies and other site data**.
6. Scroll down and click **See all cookies and site data**.
7. Type **wix** in the search field at the top right. 
   
   **Note:** Make sure to type "**wix**" with lowercase letters.
8. Click **Clear displayed data**.
9. Click **Clear**.

### Note
Wix no longer supports the editing or viewing sites on IE11. Make sure to use a [supported browser](https://support.wix.com/en/article/supported-browsers) to view or edit your site.

question: Can I import or export widgets from one custom app to another in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently in Wix Blocks it is not possible to import or export widgets from one custom app to another. This feature would allow you to build a widget in the Blocks editor and then add the widget to another Wix Blocks app you're building.

question: Can I create a "Buy One, Get One 50% Off" discount in Wix Stores?
answer: Yes, it's now possible to create a "Buy X get Y" automatic discount in Wix Stores where you can offer the "Y" at a reduced price or for free. For example, you can set up a discount like "Buy 2 T-shirts, get the 3rd for 50% off". You can learn how to create a [Buy X get Y automatic discount](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-creating-automatic-discounts#creating-buy-x-get-y-discounts).

question: How can I customize the launch and login screens of my Wix branded app?
answer:
To customize your app's system screens, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Branded Mobile App tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Your%20Branded%20App%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/mobile-app?activeTab=branded) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit Mobile App**.
3. Click **Screens** on the left.
4. Under **System screens** choose which screen you want to edit:

### Launch screen
1. Click **Launch**.
2. Choose what you want to edit:
   * **Color:** Choose a color for your launch screen background and button text.
   * **Image:** Choose an [image](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-member-apps-adding-and-setting-up-media-in-your-app#adding-and-setting-up-an-image-on-your-app) or use your app icon.
3. Tap **Save**.

### Login screen
1. Click **Login**.
2. Choose what you want to edit:
   * **Screen text:** Choose a title, tagline, and button text on your login screen.
   * **Colors:** Edit the colors of your login screen background and text.
   * **Image:** Choose an [image](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-member-apps-adding-and-setting-up-media-in-your-app#adding-and-setting-up-an-image-on-your-app) or use your app icon.
3. Tap **Save**.

Note: Since this feature is only available for the Branded app, make sure to purchase a [Branded App Premium plan.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-purchasing-a-branded-app-plan) Changes to your app's launch screen will go live once you [resubmit your app to the App Store & Google Play](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-app-changes-to-apple-and-google).

question: What does the 'Bounce rate' measure in Wix Analytics Traffic & Behavior reports?
answer: The 'Bounce rate' is the percentage of visitors who left your site after viewing only one page.

question: How can I add and customize an archive menu in my Wix blog?
answer:
To add and customize an archive menu in your Wix blog, follow these steps:

1. Go to the page you want the feed to appear on.
2. Click the **Add** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/13691038-5aa8-4672-9b95-348c0733cabc/2021/07/05/cfb0c6d5-07ce-4436-b7d3-af215395665a/2685e29d-34b0-4fd7-aff4-712ad4beccba.png) in the left panel of your Editor.
3. Click **Blog**.
4. Select the **Archive Menu** element.
5. Drag it to position it on the page.
6. Click the element in your Editor.
7. Click **Settings**.
8. Click the **Display** tab to customize the archive menu display:
   - Click the **Show newest posts first** toggle to show the most recent archived posts.
   - Click the **Show number of posts** toggle to display the number of posts in the archive widget.
   - **Number of months displayed**: Drag the slider to adjust the number of months displayed in the category widget.
9. Click the **Layout** tab to customize the category layout:
   - **Text alignment**: Choose where you would like the text to appear:
     - **Left**: The text appears on the left in the widget.
     - **Center**: The text appears in the center of the widget.
     - **Right**: The text appears on the right in the widget.
   - **Text padding (left & right)**: Drag the slider to adjust the amount of padding at the sides of the widget.
   - **Text padding (top & bottom)**: Drag the slider to adjust the amount of padding at the top and bottom of the widget.
10. Click the **Design** tab to customize the design:
    - **Font style & color**: Click the **Expand** icon to select a font style and click the color box to select a font color.
    - **Background color**: Click the color box to choose a background color and drag the slider to adjust the level of color.
    - **Divider opacity & color**: Click the color box to choose the divider color and drag the slider to adjust the level of opacity.
    - **Divider width**: Drag the slider to adjust the width of the divider.
    - **Border opacity and color**: Click the color box to choose the border color and drag the slider to adjust the level of opacity.
    - **Border width**: Drag the slider to adjust the width of the border.
    - **Corner Radius**: Drag the slider to adjust the corner radius.

### Note
The archive results page uses the category page settings. You can customize the archive page by changing the archive feed settings.

### Tip
You can also add a category menu to your blog feed. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-and-customizing-a-category-menu) to learn how.

question: Is it possible to show or hide elements based on their connected collection field values?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to show or hide elements based on their connected collection field values. For example, you cannot choose to show or hide a button based on whether its connected boolean field is marked or unmarked (set to "True" or "False").

question: How can I create a layered structure for my site in Editor X?
answer:
When planning the design of your site in Editor X, it's important to begin by creating a layered structure. We recommend creating the parent containers first, then adding children elements by dragging and dropping them in the right place. 

The structure you create is reflected in the [Layers panel](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-the-layers-panel). The following layers make up the structure of your site:

- **Page:** From the Layers panel, you can edit the page's background color and add padding. Click the **Show More** icon next to **Page** to control these settings.
- **Sections:** Every page is made up of at least one section. You can create as many vertical and horizontal sections as you need. You can also create [Master sections](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-global-sections) that appear on multiple pages.
- **Containers:** Nest elements within containers to easily create a responsive structure and ensure they stay in place. Add a basic [container box](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-containers) or smart layout tools like [Stack](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-and-customizing-a-stack), [Layouters](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-layouters) and [Repeaters](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-repeaters).
- **Elements:** These are the elements you add from the **Add** panel (e.g., Text, Button, Forms). You can [dock](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-working-with-docking-and-margins) single elements or [stack](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-adding-and-customizing-a-stack) multiple elements to ensure that they stay in the same order and spacing in every screen size.

**Important:** While grids are not part of the hierarchical model, they may still affect the sizing and positioning of your elements. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-grids)

question: How can I create a branded app for an existing client site using Wix Studio?
answer:
To create a branded app for an existing client site using Wix Studio, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Branded Mobile Apps](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/branded-app?referralInfo=sidebar&viewId=all-items-view) in your Studio Workspace.
2. Click **Get Started.**
3. Select a site for the branded app and click **Continue**. This takes you from your Studio workspace to the relevant site's dashboard.

   **Note:** You will only see Step 2 and 3 if this is your first time building a branded app. If you have built an app before, you will go directly to the Branded Mobile Apps dashboard. Click the **Create New Branded App** drop-down at the top right and then select **Create for existing site** to choose a site.

4. You are now on the Mobile app tab of your client's site dashboard. In the **Your own mobile app** tab, add the branded app's name and choose an icon. Then click **Next**.
5. Select a theme color for the app. You can always change this later. Then click **Next**.
6. Choose a navigation layout for the app. Then click **Next**.
7. (Optional) Scan the QR code to see how the app appears on mobile devices. Then click **Continue Setup**.
8. Now start editing the features and content of the app. Click **Edit Mobile App** to open the web editor. [Learn how to edit the features and content of the app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-customizing-your-apps-features-and-content).
9. Once you're finished editing your app's content, the next steps include:
   
   1. [Purchasing a Branded App plan for this site](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Branded%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/branded-apps/premium).
   2. Connecting an [Apple Developer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-creating-and-connecting-an-apple-developer-account) and [Google Developer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-creating-and-connecting-a-google-developer-account) account.
   3. [Submitting the app to the App Store and Google Play](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-submitting-your-app-for-approval).

question: How can I edit an existing logo in the Wix Logo Maker before downloading it?
answer:
To edit an existing logo in the Wix Logo Maker before downloading it, follow these steps:

1. [Go to the Wix Logo Maker](https://www.wix.com/logo/maker/esh). 

   **Note:** This will take you to the Brand Studio of the most recent brand you were working on.

2. Click the **Logo and Brands** drop-down at the top.

question: How can I add an element to my site using the Studio Editor?
answer:
To add elements in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2023/06/14/cef22a14-dfc9-43c7-a54f-72ed83266050/741248d2-4240-497e-a282-2a7d15d8afac.png) on the left side of the Editor.

question: Can I display a monthly calendar view for Wix Events on mobile devices?
answer: Currently, mobile devices display the calendar view as a list. It is not possible to change it to a monthly calendar view.

question: How can I switch from Wix Studio to the regular Wix experience, and what should I do before making the switch?
answer:
To switch from Wix Studio to the regular Wix experience, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Workspace Settings](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/team/workspace-settings?referralInfo=sidebar) in your Wix Studio workspace.
2. Click **Find out more** at the bottom.
3. Select the **I understand that I will lose access to all Studio and Partner features** checkbox to confirm.
4. Click **Leave Wix Studio**.

### Before you begin:
- Remove all of your teammates from this workspace. To do this:
  1. [Go to Team](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/team?referralInfo=sidebar) in your Wix Studio workspace.
  2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant teammate.
  3. Click **Remove from Team**.
  4. Click **Remove Collaborator** to confirm.
- If you're a Wix Partner, you'll also need to remove your custom branding. To do this:
  1. [Go to Custom Branding](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/custom-branding) in your Wix Studio workspace.
  2. Click the **Remove Custom Branding**.
  3. Click **Remove** to confirm.

### Important Notes:
- You must be the owner of the workspace to leave Wix Studio.
- If you choose to leave Wix Studio, your free site CMS quota reverts to 1,000 collection items.

question: Can clients set the duration of a service when booking through Wix Bookings?
answer: Currently, clients can only book services for pre-determined time slots (for example, one-hour treatments offered throughout the day). It is not possible for clients to select the start time and end time of a service.

question: How can I set up my Wix Inbox profile to ensure my outgoing emails have a professional appearance?
answer:
To set up your Wix Inbox profile and ensure your outgoing emails have a professional appearance, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Inbox](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Inbox&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/inbox/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Settings** drop-down at the top right.
3. Click **Profile & collaborators**.
4. Customize your personal profile in the **Your profile** section:
   * **Name:** Enter your name, as you'd like it to appear when you send messages.
   * **Image:** Upload an image you'd like to be displayed with chat messages you send.
   * **Email signature:** Enter your email signature and use the toolbar to style the text.
5. (Optional) Click **Send Test Email** so you can preview how an outgoing email will look.
6. Click **Save Changes** at the top right.

### Tip
As site owner, you'll receive an email notification every time a chat or inbox message is received. You can [change the email address](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-inbox-managing-your-notification-settings#faqs) these notifications go to.

question: How can I display a map on the Event Details page using Wix Events?
answer:
To display a map on the Event Details page using Wix Events, follow these steps:

### Using Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the Event Details & Registration page:
   - Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   - Click **Event Pages**.
   - Click **Event Details & Registration**.
3. Click the Event Details element on your page.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Display** tab.
6. Enable the **Map** toggle to display a map on your Event Details page.

### Using Studio Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the Event Details & Registration page:
   - Click **Pages** on the left side of the editor.
   - Click **Event Details & Registration**.
3. Click the Event Details element on your page.

question: How can I ensure my website elements resize properly on different screen sizes using Editor X?
answer:
To ensure your website elements resize properly on different screen sizes using Editor X, you can utilize fluid sizing and relative units of measure. In the Inspector panel, choose between Fixed and Fluid sizing options. Fixed means the element’s size stays the same regardless of the viewport, while Fluid means your element automatically resizes according to the breakpoint and your preferences. 

Your layers are structured according to the parenting model, where the top layer acts as a parent to the bottom layer (i.e., the child). To make sure your elements don’t overlap and look great in every screen size, set the sizing of your layers from top to bottom. Using relative measurements like the percentage (**%**), you can make child elements resize in relation to their parent elements. For example, set a section to take up 50% of the page’s width regardless of the screen size. You can do the same with any element or container within the section to make your page as responsive as possible.

For more detailed guidance, you can refer to these resources:

* [Understanding your site's structure](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-about-your-pages-structure-parent-child-and-sibling-elements)
* [Setting the size of your elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-setting-the-size-of-your-element)

question: What should I do if I'm not receiving email notifications from Wix Bookings?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that your domain's MX records are set up correctly if you're using your own domain email address.

If you or your staff are not receiving emails from Wix Bookings, follow these steps to resolve the issue:

### Step 1 | Check your MX records if using your own domain
If the email address you're using for your Wix account is your domain's email address (i.e. example@yourdomain.com), check that your [MX records are set up correctly](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-an-email-purchased-outside-of-wix) and your domain is properly connected.

### Step 2 | Confirm the relevant email addresses are correct
Your notification emails go to the address you enter in the Business Info tab in your site's dashboard. Your staff's notification emails go to the address listed in the staff tab of the dashboard. If necessary, edit these email addresses to the correct ones and save your changes.

#### To confirm your email address is correct:
1. [Go to Business Info](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/business-info?referralInfo=settings-lobby?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+Business+Info) in your site's dashboard.
2. Check the email address under **Location & Contact Info** and edit if necessary.

#### To confirm a staff member's email address is correct:
1. Go to [Staff](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Staff&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/staff?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant staff member and click **Edit**.
3. Enter the staff member's correct email address if required.
4. Repeat steps 2 - 3 as necessary for other staff members.

### Step 3 | Send a test email to confirm that you can receive emails
Send yourself a test email to make sure that your email address is receiving emails.

#### To send a test email:
1. Go to [Booking Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Booking%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/settings) in your site dashboard.
2. Click **Emails & SMS notifications**.
3. Click **Edit** next to **Send clients an email confirmation when they book**.
4. Scroll down to the **Create an email** section and click **More Actions** under the email preview.
5. Click **Preview & Test**.
6. Click **Send Test Email** in the top right.
7. Enter your email address in the **Send to** field.
8. Enter the **Subject**, **Sender's name**, and **Reply-to email**.
9. Click **Send**.
10. Click **Done**.
11. Check your email inbox for the test email.

### Step 4 | Check your email account's spam folder
Check your email account's spam or junk folder to see if emails from appointments@wixbookings.com are being directed there in error. If they are, make sure to whitelist appointments@wixbookings.com.

### Step 5 | Check with your email provider to see if Wix emails are blocked
If the test email didn't arrive, even after whitelisting emails from appointments@wixbookings.com, try contacting your email provider to ask if Wix notification emails are being blocked. If they are, ask your email host to whitelist them.

question: How can I add a preset interaction to an element in Editor X?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have selected the element that will trigger the interaction.

To add a preset interaction to an element in Editor X, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add a trigger (Click or Hover)
1. Select the element that should trigger the interaction.
2. Click the Inspector icon at the top of Editor X.
3. In the Inspector, click the Interactions tab.
4. Click **+ Add** under **Hover** / **Click**.

### Step 2 | Set up your interaction
1. In the Interaction Setup panel, choose what happens **On Hover** / **On Click**:
   * **Start Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element triggers the chosen animation.
   * **Reset Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element removes any animation that was previously applied.
   * **Toggle On/Off:** Clicking the element triggers the animation and a second click removes it. (Note: This option is only available for click interactions.)
2. Select the **Animated element**:
   * **Make the element trigger its own animation:** Click the element's name (the word **(self)** appears next to it).
   * **Animate a different element on the page:** Select an element from the drop-down, or click **Choose on Canvas** to select it on the page.
3. Select an animation:
   1. Click the **Presets** tab.
   2. Choose an animation from the list.

### Step 3 | (Optional) Adjust the animation
1. In the Inspector, click **Adjust Animation** at the bottom.
2. Customize the available settings to your liking:
   * **Delay:** Drag the slider to add a delay (in seconds) before the animation starts.
   * **Duration:** Drag the slider to set the duration of the animation (in seconds).
   * **Easing:** Choose how the animation eases in and out from the drop-down.
   * **Scale:** Choose how much your element grows or shrinks.
   * **Angle:** Change the angle of movement.
   * **Distance:** Make your element move farther from, or closer to, its default position on the page.
   * **Direction:** Change the direction your element rotates in.
3. (Optional) Click **Preview** to see how your animation looks and make adjustments, if needed.

question: How can I select a child element in Editor X?
answer:
By default, when you click an element in the Editor, its [parent element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-about-your-pages-structure-parent-child-and-sibling-elements) is selected. For example, if a button appears inside a container, clicking the button selects the container. You need to click again in order to select a child element. You can also use a keyboard shortcut - hold the **Cmd** / **Ctrl** key and click the element. Alternatively, you can [change your layer selection preferences](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-working-with-layers-on-your-page#setting-a-layer-selection-preference), so child elements are always selected first.

### Tip
You can also use the [Layers panel](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-using-the-layers-panel) to locate and select elements on the page.

question: How can I display blog posts from specific categories using dynamic pages in Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites:

- The Wix Blog installed. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-and-setting-up-your-blog#step-1-add-wix-blog-to-your-site)
- Wix App Collections enabled. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections#how-to-show-or-hide-wix-app-collections)
- A few posts and categories created. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-creating-and-managing-blog-categories)
- An additional dataset. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-datasets)

To display blog posts from specific categories using dynamic pages in Wix, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Add a dynamic page for your blog category
1. Click **CMS** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Wix App Collections**.
   
   **Note:** If you don't see **Wix App Collections**, make sure you've [enabled them](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-working-with-wix-app-collections).
3. Under **Blog**, hover over **Categories** and click the More Actions icon.
4. Click **Add Blank Dynamic Page**.

## Step 2 | Add a repeater or table
1. Click **Add** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **List**.
3. Drag and drop your selected repeater or table onto the page.

## Step 3 | Add and connect a second dataset and filter
1. Click **CMS** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Add Content Elements** then click the Add icon next to **Dataset**.
3. Click the newly added dataset.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Select **Posts** from the **Connect a collection** drop-down.
6. Click **+ Add Filter**.
   1. Select **Categories (Categories)** from the **Field** drop-down.
   2. Click **Another dataset** under **Value source**.
   3. Select **Categories Item** from the **Dataset** drop-down.
   4. Click **Add Filter**.

## Step 4 | Connect your repeater or table
1. Click your repeater or table in your Editor.
2. Click the Connect to CMS icon.
3. From the **Connect a dataset** drop-down, select the **Posts dataset**.
4. Link each of the components of your repeater or table to the appropriate fields in the collection.

**Note:** You can also link an image or button to **Post Page URL (URL)**. This brings the visitor to that blog post when clicked.

1. Click **Preview**.

### What’s Next?
If you have multiple posts on one page, you can use the [load more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-about-dataset-click-actions-for-buttons-and-images#load-more) or [pagination bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-pagination-bar) options to show more blog posts.

To enable the site search feature for your site using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Mobile App** under **Manage**.
4. Tap the **More actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/71d20af0-560e-44a5-bb38-bf3f513b58fa/2021/02/18/f3d6fcb2-d213-4139-b8cb-937a2e86ddaf/69876733-37b3-4ae0-84c1-4dd1bfca3df7.png) at the top.

question: How can I manage the guest list for my event using the Wix app?

4. Tap **Published Events**.
5. Select the relevant event.
6. Tap the **Manage** tab.
7. Select **Guest list**.

9. Update a guest's arrival status:
   * **RSVP:** Tap the Check-in icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2022/12/22/cf5a8849-e344-4b0e-b628-8e87afbfee95/38d08611-3592-4086-a395-643bf9daca8f.png) to change the status to "Arrived".

10. (Optional) Tap a guest to view their details, updated ticket payment status, and more.

question: Can I delete my site from the Spaces by Wix app?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to remove your site from the Spaces by Wix app. However, there are some workarounds you can use:

* You can [remove your site from appearing in search in the Spaces app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/spaces-by-wix-allowing-visitors-to-search-for-your-site). This prevents visitors from joining your site in the Spaces app, but does not remove your site from the Spaces app for visitors who have already joined in the app.
* You can [remove the invite banner](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-managing-the-invite-banner-of-the-mobile-web-version-of-your-site) that appears on the mobile version of your site and allows visitors to join your site in the Spaces app.
* You can [enable the Join Approval toggle](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-mobile-apps-managing-your-app-from-the-wix-owner-app#manage-roles-permissions) in Roles & Permissions. This prevents visitors from joining your site in the Spaces app unless you approve them.

question: How do I create my first forum post on Wix Forum?
answer:
To create your first forum post on Wix Forum, follow these steps:

1. Publish your site.
2. Go to your forum page in your live site.
3. Click **Create New Post**.
4. Choose what type of post you'd like to create:
   * **Start a Discussion**: Start a conversational discussion with other members.
   * **Ask a Question**: Ask a specific question and get answers directly from the community.
5. Add the relevant content.
6. Click the toolbar to add additional elements to your post.
7. When you're ready, click **Publish**.

question: How can I reschedule an email campaign that I have already scheduled in the Email Marketing dashboard?
answer:
To reschedule an email campaign that you have already scheduled, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Email Marketing](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Email%20Marketing%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/shoutout/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **View all Campaigns**.
3. Click the **Scheduled** tab.
4. Click the **Reschedule** icon next to the relevant scheduled email campaign.
5. Select the date you want using the calendar.
6. Set the time in the drop-down.
7. Click **Reschedule**.

**Notes:**
- Pausing a scheduled email campaign prevents it from being sent until you choose to send or schedule it again.
- Creating a scheduled campaign requires an email marketing plan.

question: How can I write a blog post on my mobile device using Wix?
answer:
To write a post on a mobile device using Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to your blog on a mobile device.
2. Log in using the email associated with your Wix account.
3. Tap **Create a Post**.
4. Write your post title and content.
5. Tap **Save & Continue**.
6. Do any of the following:
   * **Choose Category:**
     1. Tap to select up to three categories.
     2. Tap **Done**.
   * Tap **Save as Draft**.
   * Tap **Save & Publish.**

**Note:** Only those with writing privileges can see the **Create a Post** button. For more information on writing privileges, visit [this link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-writers-and-editors-in-wix-blog).

question: How can I use Wix Bookings to manage different types of services for my clients?
answer: Wix Bookings offers a comprehensive scheduling solution that allows clients to book different kinds of services. Whether you and your staff offer full courses, classes, one-on-one sessions for free or for a fee, you can handle it all in Wix Bookings. Learn more about Wix's [Online Booking System](https://www.wix.com/online/booking-system).

question: Can I design the header of my Branded App beyond the preset designs?
answer: Currently, when designing your Branded App, you can choose from 2 preset header designs; Detailed and Minimal. It is not yet possible to design the header further.

question: Can non-member clients cancel their bookings themselves on my Wix site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible for clients who have not registered as site members to cancel their bookings on your site themselves.

question: Can I add additional fields to the pre-chat form in Wix Chat?
answer: Currently, it's not possible to add additional fields to the pre-chat form.

question: How can I receive my first payout through Wix Payments?
answer:
To receive your first payout through Wix Payments, follow these steps:

1. **Verify Your Wix Payments Account**: Your first payout can only be scheduled once your Wix Payments account is [successfully verified](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-verification-process).

2. **Process and Schedule Payments**: Every payment you accept through Wix Payments must be [processed](https://support.wix.com/en/article/processing-payments-in-wix-payments) and [scheduled](https://support.wix.com/en/article/scheduled-payouts-in-wix-payments) before it can be sent to your bank account.

3. **Check Payout Schedule**: After receiving your first payment, it's available for payout within an average of 7 days. You can see when your payout is scheduled to be sent directly from the **Payouts** area in your Wix Payments dashboard.

4. **Receive Payout**: Once sent, it can take between 3-5 business days for the payout to reach your bank account.

### Notes
- Incomplete Wix Payments account [verification](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-verification-process) may delay the timing of your first payout.
- If you have [multiple payment methods](https://support.wix.com/en/article/working-with-grouped-payment-methods-in-wix-payments) active in your Wix Payments account, your payouts may be scheduled by their group.

question: How can I add password protection to my Wix site?
answer:
To password protect your site:

1. Click **Settings** at the top of the Editor.
2. Click **Site Password**.
3. Select an option:
   * **Everyone**: Everyone can view your site. This means that your site is public and there are no additional restrictions.
   * **Password Holders**: Only people who have the password can view your site. Enter your chosen password.
4. Click **Save**.

### Note
You can only see the password window on your live site. It does not appear when previewing your site.

question: Can I search for members using their title, company name, or email address on the Members Page?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to search for members using other information like their title, company name or email address. Members can only be found by typing a person's first or last name in the search bar on the [Members Page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-the-members-page-that-displays-all-members).

question: How do I connect my Wix POS tablet to the accessories?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have unboxed the Wix POS tablet and have all the necessary accessories ready.

### To connect the Wix POS tablet and accessories:
1. Unbox the Wix POS tablet.
2. Carefully place the tablet with the screen facing down so you can access the ports. 
   
   **Tip:** The tablet base can swivel.
3. Plug the power adapter into the tablet’s USB Type C port. 
   
   **Note:** Don't connect it to the power outlet yet.
4. Connect the barcode scanner via the USB-A port.
5. Connect your printer:
   
   * **HP Printer:** If you purchased an HP printer, connect it via the USB-C port.
   * **Epson m30 series printer:** If your Epson printer connects via USB, then connect it via the USB-C port. If it connects using another method, [learn how to set up and connect your Epson printer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-retail-pos-setting-up-the-receipt-printer#setting-up-an-epson-m30-series-printer).
6. Connect the cash drawer to the printer using a RJ-12 connector.
7. Plug the power adapter into a power outlet.

question: Can I create filters in my Wix Inbox to organize my messages?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to create filters in Wix Inbox.

question: How can I set up Wix Payments on my site?
answer: To get started with Wix Payments, go to [Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/payments/) in your site's dashboard and select **Accept Credit/Debit Cards with Wix**. question: Can I add a poll to my site using the Wix Editor's Add Elements panel?

question: Is it possible to manually or automatically re-trigger failed automations?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to manually or automatically re-trigger failed automations in order to attempt to trigger a failed automation again.

question: Can I allow other people or businesses to sell their products on my Wix site?
answer:
Currently, Wix does not have a feature which would allow other people or businesses to sell their products on your site. 

### Tip
If you have a third party app which allows this option, you can add it by [embedding the HTML code](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-embedding-a-site-or-a-widget).

question: How can I add a new item to my advanced menu in Wix Editor?
answer:
To add new items to the menu in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click the advanced menu in your editor.
2. Click **Manage Menu**.
3. Click **+ Add Menu Item** at the bottom.
4. Choose the item type you want to add to your menu:
   * **Site Pages:** Add site pages as menu items.
   * **Link:** Add a link to your menu. You can link to external sites, documents, and more.
   * **Section:** Add a [page section](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-about-sections) as an item to your menu. When visitors click it, they're brought to the section.
   * **Anchor:** Display a link to a [page anchor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-about-anchors-9563) on your menu. Clicking it brings the visitors to the relevant anchor.
   * **Dropdown title:** Add a dropdown menu to organize your items. Once you add the title, you can drag and drop menu items below the dropdown.
   * **Mega menu:** Add a container that's displayed when visitors hover over the item in the menu. You can change the layout and design of the container, and add elements. [Learn more about mega menus](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-mega-menu).

question: How can I add and customize a multi-step form on my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor and are familiar with navigating it.

### Step 1 | Add a form to your site: New Forms
1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Contact & Forms**.
3. Click **Create New Form** and drag the form element onto the page.
   
   **Tip:** You can also select a form from the pre-installed templates including Contact, Subscribe, and Order forms.
4. Click the form in the editor and click **Edit Form** to open the form builder.

### Step 2 | Customize the steps of your form: New Forms
1. Click the form in your editor.
2. Click **Edit Form**.
3. Click **Pages** on the left.
4. Click **Add Page**.
5. Select the new page.
6. Click **Add** on the left.
7. Drag the relevant fields onto your new page. The types of fields include:
   - **Contact fields:** Add fields that collect and store personal data in [your Contact List](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-your-contact-list).
   - **General fields:** Add elements like multi choice, checkboxes, drop-downs, and answer boxes.
   - **Date fields:** Add time and date fields for appointment scheduling or time-sensitive inquiries.
   - **Layout elements:** Add a header or text element to organize the form or further explain a field.

   **Tip:** To rename, reorder, delete, or add additional pages to your form, select the relevant page and click **Manage pages**.

### Note
To add more steps to your form, [upgrade your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-upgrading-wix-forms).

question: How can I personalize my free Wix URL and what are the limitations?
answer:
When you publish your site for the first time, your web address (URL) is in the following format: **siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress**. To make this more personalized, you can [edit the free Wix URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-free-wix-url-8591528):

* **Site URL prefix:** By default this is generated from your name in your Wix account. You can edit your site URL in your Account Settings.
* **Site address:** This is the name of your website. You choose your site name when saving your site for the first time. You can edit it at any time from your site dashboard.

### Important
This will not remove the 'wixsite.com/siteaddress' part of the URL. You need to [upgrade your site with a plan](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website?referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter) before you can connect a [custom domain](https://www.wix.com/domains) to your site.

question: How can I purchase additional Google Workspace business emails through Wix?
answer:
To purchase additional Google Workspace business emails through Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Business Email](https://manage.wix.com/account/mailboxes) in your Wix account.
2. Scroll to the relevant business email and click **Add Users**.
3. Click the drop-down menu to select the number of additional business emails you want to add.
4. Choose your saved payment method or click **Use Another Card** and fill in your payment details.
5. Click **Submit Purchase**.

**Important:** After submitting your purchase, your bank may require you to verify your identity. If you're experiencing any issues with the authentication process, contact your bank directly. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/paying-for-wix-services-strong-customer-authentication-sca-and-3d-secure-3ds)

**Note:** You can set up your new business emails from the Users section of the [Google Workspace Admin console](https://admin.google.com). Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/purchasing-and-managing-additional-google-workspace-formerly-g-suite-mailboxes) to learn more.

question: Is it possible to search for specific elements or content in the Translation Manager?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to search for specific elements or content in the Translation Manager. You can, however, filter your site content by page to narrow down your search.

question: Can I resend a review request to a customer who hasn't opened the first one in Wix Stores?
answer: Currently, you can send customers one review request. It's not possible to send multiple requests, even if your customer hasn't opened the first request.

question: How can I delete my blog from my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To delete your blog from your Wix site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9432a2ad-f01d-4a3d-ae53-370c37e15e62/2018/01/16/80095203-0eb9-4a60-bca3-a5f7bd116a34.png) on the left side of the editor.

question: Is KCP supported as a payment provider on Wix?
answer: Currently, Wix does not offer KCP as a payment provider. If you use the Manual payment method, you can mention that you accept payments through KCP and arrange the payment offline.

question: How can I limit access to specific pages on my Wix site to certain member roles using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To limit pages to specific members using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
2. Hover over the relevant page and click the **More Actions** icon.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click the **Permissions** tab.
5. Select **Site Members** under **Who can access this page?**
6. Select **Specific members** under **Which members can access this page?**
7. Enable the **Members with roles** toggle.
8. Click **Manage Roles** and select the relevant role(s).
9. Click **Apply**.

Make sure that you have [created Member Roles](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-members-creating-member-roles) before proceeding with these steps.

question: How can I add a recovery phone number to my Wix account?
answer:
To add a recovery phone number to your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Account Settings](https://manage.wix.com/account/account-settings) in your Wix account.
2. Scroll down to **Login Info**.
3. Click **Add Phone Number** next to **Recovery Phone Number**.
4. Enter your mobile phone number.
5. Click **OK**.
6. Enter the confirmation code sent to your mobile phone.
7. Click **Confirm**.

question: Can I add or edit alt text for multiple images at once in my Editor or site dashboard?
answer: Currently, you can only [individually add / edit alt text for images inside your Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-images-and-galleries-for-seo-alt-text). It is not possible to bulk add or edit alt text from your Editor or site dashboard for all your images on your site.

question: Can I use PicPay as a payment provider on Wix?
answer: Currently, Wix does not offer PicPay as a payment provider. If you use the [Manual payment method](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-manual-offline-payments), you can mention that you accept payments through PicPay and arrange the payment offline.

question: Can Wix Forms detect the specific address from which a form was submitted?
answer: Currently, using [Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-an-overview), it is not possible to detect the specific address from which a form was submitted. However, you can access the general location of the form submission using the [form submission report](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-analytics-about-your-form-submission-reports).

question: Can I move my Wix Invoices from one site to another within my Wix account?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to move Wix Invoices from one Wix site to another within your account.

question: Can I assign specific roles with dedicated permissions to collaborators in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently in Wix Blocks, you can only assign collaborators the role of **Co-admin**, which provides them with full permissions to access and edit the app. The feature to assign more specific roles with dedicated permissions, such as **Designer**, **Developer**, **Content Manager**, or **App Manager**, is not yet implemented. For more information on managing collaborators, you can visit [this link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blocks-managing-collaborators-in-blocks).

question: Can I select different title and body text styles within Wix Forum posts?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to select different title and body text styles from within Wix Forum posts. The first line of a post is set to one default heading, and the body is set to a smaller paragraph style. However, you can [customize the type size and font style](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forum-designing-your-forum#customizing-the-design-of-your-text) using the Wix Forum design settings in your site's Editor.

question: How can I hide the number of registered participants for a session in the Wix member apps?
answer:
To hide the number of participants registered for a session in the Wix member apps, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down to Settings and tap **Bookings Settings**.
4. Tap **Customize Display**.
5. Tap to disable the **Show Occupancy** toggle.
6. Tap **Save**.

When hidden, members only see if the class or service is full or available to be booked. As the site owner, you can still see the number of participants registered for a session.

question: How can I cancel my Business Phone Number service with Wix before it renews automatically?
answer:
To cancel your business phone number:

1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://manage.wix.com/account/subscriptions?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the Business Phone Number you want to cancel.
3. Select **Cancel Business Phone Number**.
4. Select **Cancel auto renew**.
5. Click **Cancel now**.

### Important
* If you turn off the auto-renewal of your phone number subscription, you can still choose to revert to auto-renewal if you change your mind before the expiry date.

question: How can I receive premium support after purchasing a Premium plan?
answer: Purchasing a Premium plan entitles you to receive premium support. When you [contact us](http://www.wix.com/contact) as a premium user, we handle your request ahead of free user requests. question: Can I charge guests a fee for last-minute cancellations or no-shows with Wix Table Reservations?
answer:
Currently, it is not possible to charge guests a fee for last-minute cancellations or no-shows with Wix Table Reservations.

question: How can I translate my restaurant menu using Wix Multilingual?
answer:
To translate your restaurant menu using Wix Multilingual, follow these steps:

1. **Add and set up Wix Multilingual**: First, you need to [add and set up Wix Multilingual](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-adding-and-setting-up-wix-multilingual). You can do this from your editor, your site's dashboard, or from the Wix App Market.

question: Can I use Wix Multilingual to translate my CMS collection content?
answer: We are excited to announce that you can now translate your CMS collection content with Wix Multilingual. Learn how to [get started translating your CMS content](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-multilingual-translating-cms-collection-content).

question: How can I customize the reset password email for my site members on Wix?
answer:
To customize the reset password email for your site members on Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Installed for you** tab.
3. Find the automation titled **Send site members a reset password email**.
4. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the automation and select **Edit**.
5. Scroll down to **Action 1** (Send an email) and click **Edit** in the **Create an email** section.
6. Edit the contents of the email:
   
   * **Subject line:** Click **Edit** next to the subject line to adjust the subject line. You can click **\+ Personalize** to add a dynamic value.
   * **Text:** Click the text element(s) you want to edit and adjust the text. Then use the panel on the left to adjust the formatting or design.
   * **Button:** Click the button and use the panel on the left to edit its content or design.
   * **Add:** Click **Add** in the panel on the left to add elements to the email.
   * **Themes:** Click **Themes** in the panel on the left to personalize the theme of the email.
   * **Background:** Click **Background** on the panel on the left to update the background.
7. (Optional) Click **Preview & test** to generate a preview and send yourself a test email.
8. Click **Save & Continue** when you're done customizing the email.
9. Click **Save** to save the automation.

Make sure to keep the email type **Business critical** to ensure that password reset emails are sent to your members regardless of their consent to receive promotional emails.

question: Can I track the PageView event as a server-side event using Meta Pixel?
answer: Currently, it is only possible to track a PageView event for [Meta Pixel conversion tracking](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/meta-pixel/implementation/conversion-tracking/) as a browser-side event. question: Can I redeem loyalty points with Wix Hotels?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to redeem loyalty points with Wix Hotels. You can however, [offer coupons as rewards](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-loyalty-program-managing-your-loyalty-program#updating-your-rewards).

question: How do I connect Evergreen Payments Northwest as a payment provider on my Wix site?
answer:

question: Can site members create events within a group on Wix?
answer: Currently, it is not possible for your site members to create events within a group. However, you can [allow members to create their own group](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-adding-new-members-to-your-group) based on shared interests to form an online community.

question: How can I give Wix the necessary permissions from my Wix account to manage my Facebook Ads?
answer:
To give permissions from your Wix account:

1. Go to [Facebook Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpaid-ads%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site dashboard.
2. Click **Start Now**.
3. Click **Connect to Facebook**.

5. Click **Choose what you allow** to view mandatory permissions.

7. Click **OK** at the bottom right.

If you receive an error message after connecting your Facebook account, it means at least one mandatory permission is missing. Click **Manage Permissions** to view and approve the missing permissions.

question: Can I add dynamic values from Wix Stores to automation emails?

question: How can I set up my business using Wix Bookings to start getting booked?
answer:
To set up your business using Wix Bookings and start getting booked, follow these essential steps:

1. **Choose a template:** Start with a stunning Wix template. 
   * [Select a template](https://www.wix.com/website/templates/).

2. **Create your services:** Choose which of our 3 types of services are [right for you](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-the-right-booking-service-for-your-business).
   * [Create an appointment](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-an-appointment).
   * [Create a class](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-availability-for-classes-in-wix-bookings).
   * [Create a course](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-a-course).
   * [Take any of your services online](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-an-online-service-via-zoom).

3. **Add staff members:** Have people working for you? Add them to your team.
   * [Add staff members](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-staff-members) who provide services.
   * Let staff members [manage their calendars](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-staff-permissions-in-wix-bookings).
   
   **Tip:** The default staff member (you) is labelled "Staff Member #1". Don't forget to edit the name.

4. **Set availability:** If you provide appointment services, their availability is based primarily on your default work hours and the hours of staff members who provide the service.
   * [Set default work hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-default-work-hours).
   * [Set staff hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-editing-your-staff-members-working-hours).

5. **Customize how Wix Bookings is displayed on your site:**
   * Decide [where to display services](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-displaying-selected-services-on-different-pages) on your site (All together? On separate pages?).
   * Customize each of the pages your client sees as they select a service and book it:
     + [Service List](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-setting-up-your-service-list)
     + [Service Page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-customizing-your-service-pages)
     + [Calendar Pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-customizing-your-calendar-pages)
     + [Booking Form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-and-setting-up-your-booking-forms)
     + [Confirmation Page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-customizing-your-thank-you-page-3173018)
     + [Checkout Page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-understanding-your-checkout-settings)
     + [Members Area](https://support.wix.com/en/site-members/customizing-your-members-area)

6. **Set how you collect payment:**
   * [Connect a payment provider](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-an-overview) (Wix Payments, Stripe, PayPal, etc.) to accept credit/debit cards and other payment methods online.
   * Choose [how you'd like clients to pay](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-getting-paid-offline) for each service (Pay when booking? Pay when arriving?).
   * Offer clients [membership plans or packages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-about-memberships-and-packages).

7. **Add your business details:** [Set up your business address, currency, time zone](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information) etc.

8. **Upgrade your site & connect a domain:** Upgrade so clients can start booking services.
   * [Purchase the right Premium Plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-upgrading-wix-bookings-to-a-business-premium-plan) for your business.
   * [Get your own domain](https://support.wix.com/en/article/purchasing-a-domain-from-wix-3133977) (available for free for 1 year with some Premium Plans).

9. **Publish your site:** Ready to go live? Click "Publish" and share your site with the world.

question: Can I use template page layouts in the Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, template page layouts are not supported in the Editor. In the meantime, you can choose between two types of page layouts; standard and without a header and footer. To learn more, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-applying-a-page-layout-standard-no-header-footer).

question: Is it possible to receive notifications about rejected orders in Wix Restaurants?

This feature is available with the [Wix Restaurants Orders (NEW) app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-restaurants-adding-and-setting-up-wix-restaurants-orders-new).

question: Can I add more than one Wix Bookings app to my site to create a multilingual booking site?

question: Can I add tips or extra fees when collecting payment from clients using Wix Bookings?

Additionally, you can [add extra fees directly from your Orders page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editing-orders-8769551), such as an extra processing fee for online payments or a last-minute booking fee for appointments scheduled on short notice.

question: How can I test my Velo package using Wix Blocks before installing it on a live site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have created your Velo package.

To test your Velo package using Wix Blocks before installing it on a live site, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create a Test Version in Blocks
1. Click **Test** in your **Wix Blocks** package environment (if you have never built this package, complete the name and description fields).
2. Click **Create** to confirm that you want to create a test version.

**To update your test version after more changes:**
1. Click **Test**.
2. Click **Update Test Version**.

The package now automatically updates on any editor (just refresh!) and live site where it's installed.

### Step 2 | Install your test version in the Editor
1. Turn on Dev Mode in a Wix or Editor X site.
2. Select ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/57e9f77c-6d15-498d-ac4e-c4d09bf3a490/2021/08/18/79003db4-3b7f-4046-90cf-1ac915540fd5/93486206-0231-4f66-960c-c94c21c24906.png) **(Code Files) \> Packages \> Install a Package**.
3. Click **My Packages**.
4. If you see only the test version, Click **Install** for the test version of your package, and then confirm that you want to install it.
5. If you see another version of your package, click **see all versions** to find your test version.
6. Click **Install** next to your test version in the package manager.

When you install a test version it is clearly labeled in your list of installed packages.

### Step 3 | Publish a site with the test version
After you've installed the test version in the editor, it's time to publish your site. Note that the test version only comes into effect when the site is published - nothing will happen before publishing. You can choose whether to publish the site or a **test version of the site** (recommended). This allows you to check the behavior of the test version discreetly without impacting the live site.

**To publish a test site:**
1. Click the arrow to the right of the **Publish** button and from the drop-down menu.
2. Click **Create Test Sites**.
3. Then, click **Create New Test Site** to confirm that you want to discard the previous test site, if there is one, and create a new one.

When you create the test site, the editor provides its URL.

question: How can I create a one-time payment plan using the Pricing Plans app?
answer:
### Prerequisites
* Make sure to [add the Pricing Plans app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-adding-the-pricing-plans-app) to your site.
* To sell plans on your site, you must [connect a payment provider](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-setting-up-payments).

### To create a pricing plan:
1. Go to [Pricing Plans](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Pricing%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/membership/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ Create Plan**.
3. Enter the plan name.
4. (Optional) Enter a brief description of the plan.
5. Add benefits under **List what's included in this plan**.

### To connect benefits to your plan:
1. Scroll down to **Other benefits**.
2. Select the checkbox next to the services or content types you want to include.
3. Add the relevant details (e.g., the specific services that are included).

### To set the price and duration of your plan:
1. Select **One-time payment** in the **Pricing options** section.
2. Enter the plan **Price**.
3. Select the relevant duration from the **Length of plan** drop-down. You can select **Custom** to enter your own duration.
4. (Optional) Charge a setup fee:
   1. Click to enable the **Charge a setup** fee toggle.
   2. Enter the amount under **One-time setup fee**.
   3. Enter the name for the fee under **Setup fee name**.

### To adjust your plan's settings:
1. Scroll down to **Settings**.
2. Choose how you want to adjust your plan's settings:
   - Enable the **Limit 1 purchase per person** toggle.
   - Enable the **Allow plan cancellation** toggle.
   - Enable the **Let people set start date** toggle.
   - Add a plan policy by clicking **Add** next to **Add a policy**.
   - Add custom form fields by clicking **Select** next to **Collect additional info at checkout**.
   - Customize a Thank You page by clicking **Edit** next to **Customize a Thank You page**.
3. Click **Save** at the top to finish creating your plan.

question: How can I change the channel displayed on my Wix Video player?

question: Can I add a hyperlink to a container in the Studio Editor?

question: Can I change the design of the Language Menu on my mobile site to be completely different from the desktop version?

question: Can I add several images to a menu item in Wix Restaurants?

question: Can I customize the page that site members see when they try to access a page they do not have permission to access?

question: Can I add a Share button to an image or gallery on my Wix site?

question: Can I add a picture selection field in Wix Forms to allow visitors to choose from multiple visuals?
answer: Currently, in the [new Wix Forms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-creating-a-form-using-new-wix-forms), there is no option to add a picture selection field that allows visitors to choose an option from multiple visuals and/or colors or thumbnails.

question: How can I customize my site on the Wix member apps using the Wix app?

question: How can I access my form submission reports in Wix Analytics?

question: Can I merge multiple galleries together in the Wix Editor?

question: How can I change the language of my Wix Forum to Spanish?

question: How can I connect Paidy as a payment method through KOMOJU on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Paidy as a payment method through KOMOJU on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** next to Paidy.

   **If you have a KOMOJU account:**
   1. Sign in to your KOMOJU account and make sure the account is in Live Mode.
   2. Return to Wix and enter your KOMOJU **Secret Key**.
   3. Click **Connect**.

   **Tip:** Check if your payment method is [active in KOMOJU](https://help-ja.komoju.com/article/321-article).

   **If you don't have a KOMOJU account:**
   1. Click [**Create KOMOJU account**](https://komoju.com/en/sign_up).
   2. Follow the instructions to sign up.
   3. (When your account is approved) Repeat steps 1-4 and select **I have a KOMOJU account**.

   **If you have already connected KOMOJU and want to add another payment method:**
   1. Sign in to your [KOMOJU](https://komoju.com/sign_in/) account.
   2. Add the payment method you wish to connect and confirm that the payment method is active.
   3. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) in your site's dashboard.
   4. Click **Manage** next to KOMOJU.
   5. Enable the toggle next to your desired payment method.

   **Tip:** Make sure your payment method is [active in KOMOJU](https://help-ja.komoju.com/article/321-article).

question: How can I add a button in the Studio Editor and what are the differences between basic and styled buttons?
answer:
To add a button in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2023/06/14/cef22a14-dfc9-43c7-a54f-72ed83266050/741248d2-4240-497e-a282-2a7d15d8afac.png) on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Button**.
3. Scroll through the designs and drag a **Basic Button** or **Styled Button** onto the page.

### Differences between Basic and Styled Buttons:

- **Basic Buttons:** These buttons only display text and have a more "minimal" look. They support actions like copying the button's design to another element and getting content suggestions for the button text. In smaller screen sizes, Basic Buttons auto-wrap the text.

- **Styled Buttons:** These buttons can display both text and icons, and offer advanced customization options such as image backgrounds and color gradients. However, they do not support copying the button's design to another element or getting content suggestions for the button text. In smaller screen sizes, Styled Buttons display an ellipsis.

question: How can I manage and customize the tabs on my Wix site?
answer:
To manage and customize the tabs on your Wix site, follow these steps:

### Managing Your Tabs
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the tabs element.
3. Click **Manage Tabs**.
4. Select how you want to manage the tab items:
   - **Add a new tab:** Click **Add Tab** at the bottom of the panel.
   - **Rename tabs:** Hover over the relevant item, click the **More Actions** icon, click **Rename**, enter the new name, and click **Done**.
   - **Duplicate a tab:** Select the relevant item and click **Duplicate Tab** at the bottom of the panel.
   - **Change the order of tabs:** Click and drag the items into the order you want.
   - **Set your default tab:** Hover over the relevant item, click the **More Actions** icon, and click **Set as default**.
   - **Delete a tab:** Hover over the relevant item, click the **More Actions** icon, and click **Delete**.

### Changing Your Tabs' Layout
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the tabs element.
3. Click the **Layout** icon.
4. Choose how you want to adjust your tab's layout:
   - **Tab distribution:** Choose between **Default** or **Stretch**.
   - **Space between tabs:** Adjust the spacing.
   - **Space between tabs & container:** Adjust the spacing.
   - **Horizontal padding:** Adjust the padding.
   - **Vertical padding:** Adjust the padding.
   - **Overflow tabs:** Choose between **Scroll** or **Wrap**.
   - **Tab direction:** Choose the display direction.

### Customizing the Tabs' Design
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the tabs.
3. Click the **Design** icon.
4. Click **Customize Design**.
5. Select an option under **What do you want to design?** and customize it with the available options:
   - **Tab container:** Customize background fills, borders, corners, shadow, and layout.
   - **Tabs:** Customize for each state (regular, hover, selected) with background fills, text, borders, corners, and shadow.
   - **Scroll button:** Customize for regular and hover states with background fills, borders, corners, shadow, icon, and layout.
   - **Containers:** Customize background fills, borders, corners, shadow, and layout.

**Tip:** Click the **Apply design to other states** icon to give the items the same look for every state.

question: Is it possible to share a widget between apps in Wix Blocks so that updates to the widget are reflected across all apps?

question: How can I record my screen on an Android device if it doesn't have built-in screen recording capabilities?
answer:
If your Android phone does not have screen recording capabilities, you can use the [AZ Screen Recorder](https://az-screen-recorder.en.uptodown.com/android) app. Here’s how to record with the AZ Screen Recorder:

1. Open the app on your phone.
2. Click the **Record** icon.
3. Click **Start Now**.
4. Upload your video to a hosting site such as YouTube, Dropbox, or Google Drive.
5. Make sure to set the video viewing permissions to 'public'.
6. [Contact Wix Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact) and send us the URL to your recording.

question: How can I set up collection permissions to allow only registered members to view and contribute to certain collections on my Wix site?
answer:
To set up collection permissions that allow only registered members to view and contribute to certain collections on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. **Access Collection Settings**: Go to your CMS and open the collection you want to modify.
2. **Change Permissions**: Navigate to the collection settings and select 'Custom' permissions.
3. **Set View Permissions**: Under 'Who can view this content', choose 'Site Members'. This ensures that only registered members can view the collection content.
4. **Set Contribution Permissions**: For allowing contributions, set the 'Collect content' permission to 'Site Members'. This will enable registered members to add new items to the collection.
5. **Review and Save**: Review your settings to ensure they align with your site's privacy and security standards, then save the changes.

By setting these permissions, you ensure that sensitive information stays within your trusted user base, while still allowing registered members to contribute to the collections. For more detailed instructions, you can learn how to [change your collection permissions from the collection settings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-your-collection-permissions).

question: How can I add a verification meta tag to my Wix site using the Site Verification Tool?
answer:
To add a verification meta tag to your Wix site using the Site Verification Tool, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your SEO Dashboard](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/seo-home?referralInfo=KB-f3388913-140f-47a9-b2ba-4bf86b60e04e&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+SEO).
2. Select **Go to Site Verification** under **Tools and settings**.
3. Click a search engine to expand.
4. Enter the meta tag relevant to that search engine.
5. Click **Save**.

### Important
* The tag must be in a [valid HTML format](https://support.wix.com/en/article/header-code-meta-tag-guidelines#correct-format-for-header-codes-per-tool).
  
  + The format should be `<meta name=”XX” content=”XX”/>`
  + Missing or extra attributes such as ‘<’, or ‘ “ ‘, will create an issue.
* The tag must belong to the right webmaster tool. For example, if you try to verify with Google Search Console using a Bing verification meta tag, it won't work.

question: How can I select and arrange multiple elements in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To select multiple elements in the Wix Editor, you can click and drag your cursor over them. Alternatively, hold down the **Shift** key on your keyboard and click the elements to select them. You can also select all elements at once by pressing **Ctrl**\+**A** on your keyboard, which selects all elements in a specific container or all of the page's elements if you didn't click a container first.

To arrange the elements:
1. Select all relevant elements.
2. Click the Layout icon ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/BEc2-NlydCYLgbmwZdAA6cGoq-T-7apEmQmhlgI4yC6OhLbD8cP-mgkMLsuI23UJ1Nhb9bLQQhaicH6fKAOh3BqTWqQpXiT3JJ3F15-NPpxttM_v4Df3ESCvslkBd_B1E3fQ3UIB).
3. Do the following to arrange them all at the same time:
   * **Align:** Align all elements to the same direction (e.g. left, center, top, etc.)
   * **Distribute:** Distribute your elements evenly on a horizontal or vertical axis, to keep your layout neat and tidy.
   * **Match Size:** Make all elements the same height, width, or overall size.

All of these options are also available in [the Editor toolbar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-using-the-editor-toolbar-to-adjust-elements).

question: How can I import a step from an existing program in Wix Online Programs?
answer:
To import a step from an existing program in Wix Online Programs, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Online Programs](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Online%20Programs&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/challenges/list) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant program you want to import steps to.
3. Scroll down to the **Content** / **Schedule** section and click **\+ Add**.
4. Click **Import Step**.
5. Click the **Select a program** drop-down and choose the program you want to import steps from.
6. Click the **Select a step** drop-down and choose the step you want to import.
7. Click **Add & Edit**.

**Tip:** You can also click **Create New** to add a new step from scratch.
8. (Optional) Edit the content of the imported step to suit your needs.
9. Click **Save**.

**Tip:** You can import a [Quiz](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-adding-and-managing-a-quiz) as a separate step, bringing in the entire quiz or survey. However, it is not possible to import specific quiz or survey questions.

question: How can I set up SEO for a page in ADI?
answer:
To set up your page SEO in ADI, follow these steps:

1. Click the **Pages** menu on the top bar inside ADI.
2. Click the page that you want to set up.
3. Click the **Settings** icon.
4. Click **SEO Basics**.
5. Enter the information:
   
   * **Title Tag (For Search Results):** Enter your site's name, page name, and location. This information also appears in the browser tab.
   * **Meta Description (For Search Results):** Enter a short description of your site's page.
   * **Keywords:** Enter words that are related to your page. You can add up to 10 keywords.
   * **Hide this page from search results:** Select or deselect the checkbox:
     
     + **Selected**: Your page is not displayed in search engine results.
     + **Not selected**: Your page is displayed in search engine results. 
     
     **Note:** Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adi-showing-or-hiding-your-site-in-search-engine-results) to learn how to show or hide your entire site from search engines.
   * **Page URL:** Enter the ending for your page URL (your page address on the web). If you do not enter anything, your page name is used by default. 
     
     **Note:** If you change your page URL, visitors who reach your old URL will get a 404 error. To prevent this happening you can [set up 301 redirects](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-up-a-301-redirect-for-a-page-on-your-site). Additionally, social features such as likes and comments will be reset.
6. Click **Let's Go** to view your personalized SEO plan on Wix Wiz.

**Tip:** Publish your site in order for changes to take effect. Search engines may take a few days to update the information.

question: How can I troubleshoot if I'm not receiving email notifications when a guest RSVPs to my Wix event?
answer:
To troubleshoot if you're not receiving email notifications when a guest RSVPs to your Wix event, follow these steps:

1. **Make sure email notifications are set up correctly:** Go to the relevant event and check that you are [set up to receive notifications when someone RSVPs](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-managing-emails-you-send-and-receive#setting-the-frequency-of-your-email-alerts). 
   - **Tip:** If you are set up to receive email alerts daily, you will not receive a notification immediately each time a guest RSVPs.

2. **Make sure your mailbox is working:** Send yourself a test email to ensure that your email address is receiving regular emails.

3. **Check to see if the alerts went to spam:** Look in your spam/junk/bulk/promotions folder for the email notification. If found, whitelist the email address: [wix-team@notifications.wix.com](mailto:wix-team@notifications.wix.com).
   - **Tip:** Try searching for missing emails using the [wix-team@notifications.wix.com](mailto:wix-team@notifications.wix.com) email address.

4. **Make sure you're checking the correct email address:** Email notifications are sent to the email address you entered in the General Info tab in your site's dashboard. To learn how to access the General Info tab or change the email address, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-the-email-address-for-rsvp-notifications-in-wix-events).

5. **Test sending alerts to another email address:** For testing purposes, try [changing your business email](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-the-email-address-for-rsvp-notifications-in-wix-events) in general info settings, preferably under a different domain (for example, if it's a Gmail address, test one that is not Gmail). Then complete a test registration to check if you receive email notifications to the other email address.
