question: How can I add hover interactions to a box in Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have added and designed a box or repeater in the Wix Editor.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Access Hover Mode**
   - Select your box in the editor.
   - Click the **Hover Interactions** icon ![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/4G8nL6yqsuPiM-i8g38LbxleCliWtXJ9COztpynjkqbDl4Ewgox2oifnFytJ2Y7OyNseZ5abSbKW6ezusMIm40UWRTaH83zHDl49ffaGMd5RajhyzJE9Ho8fSbmW0B0c92wgSnVl).
   - Click **Get Started**.

2. **Add Hover Interactions**
   - **Add elements that appear on hover**
     1. Click the **Add to Hover** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/07/02/de5afcf6-ced0-44cd-b07f-42bd5e53364d/86a3c2e1-cc9c-494c-b0a0-7514433e0e80.png) at the top left.
     2. Click the element you want to add to the box.

   - **Hide elements on hover**
     - Select the element and press **Delete** on your keyboard, or click the **Hide Element** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/06/13/5ddfce41-1ea9-49a7-83d8-0ceef0167d71/1a9d4f68-6b2f-4ed8-a79e-75686785bc3f.png).

   - **Choose an effect for the element on hover**
     1. Select the box in your editor.
     2. Click **Choose Effect**.
     3. Select an effect from the available options.
     4. (Optional) Click **Customize** to tailor the effect to your needs.

3. **Set Timing for Effects**
   - Select the element in your editor.
   - Click the **Timing** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/11/16/02c478a1-3f29-47fb-9e44-18d67903ba61/6f1d33b5-0a3e-4c02-b0af-41a025b7eda0.png).

     - **Duration:** Drag the slider to choose the duration (in seconds) of your effect.
     - **Delay:** Drag the slider to select the delay (in seconds).
     - **Easing:** Choose how your element should transition from its regular state to the effect.

4. **Change the Container's Design on Hover**
   - Select the box in your editor.
   - Click the **Hover** tab at the top of the box.
   - Click the **Design** icon ![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/4O8XC2DBehwJKcPpek4YdvPZFUcQfbQiK6vOyYtovzErBWB_HjLgWHG1aekjaqsK1EUhkZ_Wpu_Iff8fipzak6hfFJ_bI7uK5qFEE_GbfxSgIiFMgoPlJbrlWz5aoLxrPxaoftXQ).
   - Select the relevant tab on the left of the panel to edit the design:
     - **Fill Color & Opacity:** Adjust the background opacity and color.
     - **Border:** Edit the color and adjust the border opacity and width.
     - **Corners:** Adjust the roundness of the corners.
     - **Shadow:** Enable a shadow and edit its properties.

question: How can I ensure my clients receive video conferencing links in their confirmation emails for online services in Wix Bookings?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have switched to the latest version of Wix Bookings.

To ensure your clients receive video conferencing links in their confirmation emails for online services, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Disable your confirmation emails
First, disable your normal confirmation emails to prevent your clients from receiving too many notifications per booking. Your clients will still receive the relevant video conferencing link in a separate email.

#### To disable your confirmation emails:
1. [Go to Booking Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Booking%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Emails & SMS Reminders**.
3. Disable the toggle next to Confirmation email.

### Step 2 | Create automated confirmation emails with video conferencing links
With your normal confirmation emails disabled, you can now create an automated email to clients when they book services. This automated email will contain the relevant booking details, including the video conferencing link and password for online services.

#### To create automated confirmation emails with video conferencing links:
1. [Go to Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation**.
3. Click **+ Start from Scratch**.
4. Click **Wix Bookings**.
5. Click **Session booked** as the trigger for the automation.
6. Click the services drop-down and choose **Specific services**.
7. Under **Select a service**, click the checkboxes to select all relevant online services you want to send the single confirmation email to.
8. Click **Apply**.
9. Click **Send an email** under **Choose an action**.
10. Click **Edit Template**.

   **Note:** Click **Add Details** and confirm your sender details for the automated emails, if prompted.
11. Click **Add**.
12. Click **Text**.
13. Add the relevant text, for example: "Video conference link:" or "Online lesson link:".
14. Click **+ Add Dynamic Value**.
15. Select **Video Conference URL** from the drop-down.
16. (Optional) Enter the fallback text in the field provided.
17. Click **Add**.
18. (Optional) If you use Zoom with password protection for your online services, add your password to the emails:

    1. Click **+ Add Dynamic Value**.
    2. Select **Video Conference Password** from the drop-down.
    3. Enter the password.
    4. Click **Add**.
19. Click **Save & Publish** at the top.

### Note
Your clients can unsubscribe from your automated emails if they wish, but not from your Booking confirmation emails.

question: How can I transfer ownership of my .com.au domain purchased at Wix to another business?
answer:
To transfer ownership of a .com.au domain purchased at Wix, follow these steps:

1. **Submit a Request:** Contact [Wix Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact) with the title 'Transfer ownership of a .com.au domain'.

2. **Pay the Transfer Fee:** There is a non-refundable transfer ownership fee of USD $12.50, which includes a 1-year domain registration renewal for the new owner. This fee is paid via PayPal.

3. **Complete the Forms:**
   - Download the 'Current Registrant (Transferor) Form' and the 'New Registrant (Transferee) Form' sent by Wix Customer Care.
   - Fill in the requested details. Ensure the registrant name matches the 'Registrant' field on the domain's [WHOIS listing](https://www.whois.com/whois/).
   - Print and sign each form.

4. **Upload Documents:** Upload legible images (in PDF format) of the signed documents to your Wix Customer Care ticket.

5. **Confirmation:** Wix will contact you to confirm whether the transfer was successful. Note that confirmation may take a number of days as it requires independent confirmation from a third-party registrar.

**Important:** The transferee must have an Australian business address, and the domain begins a new [registration period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/domain-life-cycle#registration-period) after the change of ownership. Any remaining time on the original subscription will not carry over to the new subscription.

question: How can I optimize images on my Wix site to improve loading times?
answer:
To optimize images on your Wix site and improve loading times, follow these steps:

1. **Choose the correct media format:**
   - **Images:** Use JPEGs for web optimization unless you need transparency, in which case PNGs are suitable. JPEG images are smaller in download size while maintaining similar quality.
   - **SVG images:** Use SVG graphics for decorative shapes or business logos as they are lighter and load faster. Resizing SVGs does not affect their quality or sharpness. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-about-vector-art)
   - **GIFs:** Prefer modern video encoding formats over GIFs for better quality and smaller size. Videos can be placed inside [VideoBoxes](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-using-videoboxes), which support [transparent videos](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-transparent-video).

2. **Upload the best image quality:**
   - Upload images with a resolution of at least 2560 X 1440 pixels. Wix will optimize them to the exact dimensions displayed on the screen without any loss of quality.

3. **Compress large images:**
   - Wix automatically optimizes images for the best online quality and fast download. You do not need to resize or compress images before uploading unless the file is over 25MB.

4. **Divide large background images into sections:**
   - Split large background images into sections roughly the same length as a screen to allow other images time to load as visitors scroll down your page.

5. **Note:**
   - When you upload an image to your site, it is automatically converted to WebP format, which is better optimized for site performance.

question: How can I create a private member page in Wix for members to view their own uploaded content?
answer:
To create a private member page in Wix where members can view their own uploaded content, follow these steps:

### Using Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Members Area**.
4. Click **+ Add Member Pages** at the bottom.
5. Click **+ Add Page** under **Private Page**.
6. [Add a dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-and-setting-up-a-dataset) to the page and connect it to the collection that stores the content your members submitted.
7. [Add a filter](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-filters-and-sorts-to-datasets-to-control-live-site-content#adding-filters-to-your-dataset) for the **Owner (Text)** field with the **Condition** set to "is" and the **Status** to "logged in".
8. [Add elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-elements-and-the-collection-fields-they-can-connect-to) that can display collection content (e.g. repeaters, text, images).
9. [Connect the elements to the dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-elements-to-a-collection-using-a-dataset).

### Using Studio Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **+ Add New Page** at the bottom.
4. Click **Add** under **Custom Member Page**.
5. (Optional) Customize the page's name and permissions:
   - **Rename the page:** Double-click the page and enter the new name.
   - **Limit the page to specific roles or pricing plans:**
     1. Hover over the page and click the **More Actions** icon.
     2. Click **Settings**.
     3. Click the **Permissions** tab.
     4. Select the relevant option under **Which members can access this page?**.
6. [Add a dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-and-setting-up-a-dataset) to the page and connect it to the collection that stores the content your members submitted.

When you preview the page, you are the logged-in user, so you will see the content you yourself have uploaded. If you have not yet uploaded any items to the collection, your page will not show any content when you preview it.

question: How can I connect my existing .ie domain to my Wix site?
answer:
To connect your existing .ie domain to your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. **Upgrade your site with a plan**: You need to have an upgraded Wix site to connect a domain. You can do this by visiting [Wix Upgrade](http://www.wix.com/upgrade/website).

2. **Connect via Nameservers**: It is recommended to connect your domain to Wix via Nameservers. This method allows Wix to host your DNS records, enabling you to manage them directly in your Wix account.

3. **Access your current domain registrar**: Ensure you have access to your current domain registrar to make the necessary changes.

4. **Propagation time**: Be aware that new DNS records may take up to 48 hours to fully propagate.

For detailed instructions, you can learn more about [connecting a domain to the Wix nameservers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

Please note that currently, it is not possible to purchase or transfer a .ie domain directly through Wix. If you would like this feature in the future, you can [vote for this feature](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-purchasing-or-transferring-an-irish-ie-domain-with-wix).

question: What should I do if my domain is in the 'Pending Renew/Delete' status and I want to retrieve it?
answer:
It is not possible to retrieve your domain while in the status "PendingRenew" or "PendingDelete" in the [WHOIS database](https://www.wix.com/tools/whois). These statuses mean that your domain is no longer in the [redemption period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/retrieving-an-expired-domain-during-the-redemption-period) and registration can't be extended. To retrieve your domain, wait until it becomes publicly available again for anyone to purchase. This usually happens within 10 days from the beginning of the "PendingRenew/Delete" period.

### Important
* You can only repurchase the domain once it clears the "PendingRenew/Delete" period and becomes available again. This is true for all domains in this status, not just domains purchased from Wix.
* It is not guaranteed that your domain will be released and become available after the "PendingRenew/Delete" period. This is why we recommend resolving any payment issues before your domain enters this period.

### How can I check my domain's status in the WHOIS database?
You can use [Wix's WHOIS lookup tool](https://www.wix.com/tools/whois) to check your domain's status. Search for your domain name (including the top-level domain, for example, mystunningwebsite.com) and look for **Domain Status** in the results.

### How can I check when my domain is available to purchase again?
You can monitor the domain status in the [WHOIS lookup tool](https://www.wix.com/tools/whois) and repurchase it as soon as it becomes available. Once the domain is no longer in the "PendingRenew/Delete" status you can [check if the domain is available to purchase](https://support.wix.com/en/article/checking-if-a-domain-name-is-available).

question: How do I add and set up the Dropbox Folder app on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor or Studio Editor and a Dropbox account.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Add the Dropbox Folder app to your site

**For Wix Editor:**
1. Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the editor.
2. Search for the Dropbox Folder in the search bar.
3. Click **Add to Site**.
4. Select the app in your editor and click **Settings**.
5. Do one of the following:
   * Click **Connect Account** and sign in to your Dropbox account.
   * Click **Create a new account:**
     1. Sign up with Dropbox.
     2. Verify your email address.
6. Click **Allow** to grant access to display your Dropbox folders.

**For Studio Editor:**
1. Click **App Market** on the left side of the editor.
2. Search for the Dropbox Folder app in the search bar.
3. Click **Add to Site**.
4. Select the app in your editor and click **Settings**.
5. Do one of the following:
   * Click **Connect Account** and sign in to your Dropbox account.
   * Click **Create a new account:**
     1. Sign up with Dropbox.
     2. Verify your email address.
6. Click **Allow** to grant access to display your Dropbox folders.

**Tip:** If a pop-up does not open, try [turning off your pop-up blocker](https://support.wix.com/en/article/disabling-your-pop-up-blocker) or updating your browser version.

#### Step 2 | Choose which folders you want to display
1. Click the Dropbox Folders app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Folders** tab.
4. Click **Select Folder**.
5. Hover over the folder you want to display and click **Select**.

**Tip:** If you added a folder recently, and it doesn't appear, click the **Refresh** icon.

#### Step 3 | Customize how the app looks on your site
1. Click the Dropbox Folders app in your editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Layout** tab to choose how you want to display the files inside your folder:
   * **List:** Displays the full list of files in your folder.
   * **Icon:** Displays the folder name. When clicked, a pop-up appears with a list of files.
4. Click the **Settings** tab to choose what info you want to show in the folder:
   1. Click the **Show title** toggle to show or hide the folder title.
      **Tip:** Edit the folder title in the **Title text** field.
   2. Click the **Show number of items** toggle to show or hide the number of files.
   3. Click the **Allow file preview** toggle to show or hide the title.
5. Click the **Design** tab to customize the colors, fonts, and icon style.

**Note:** The design options differ depending on the layout you chose in step 3 above.

question: How do I set up a billing method in Printify for my Wix store?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have connected your store to Printify.

After a customer purchases a Printify product in your Wix store, you'll need to pay Printify for it. After this is done, Printify creates the product and ships it to your customer.

You can handle the payment to Printify in two ways:

* **Automatic:** Set up automatic payment by adding a payment method (PayPal or credit card) in the Printify dashboard. [Learn How](https://help.printify.com/hc/en-us/articles/4483644218769-How-do-I-set-up-payments-in-Printify) 

  When a paid order comes in, (or when you mark an order as "Paid"), your payment to Printify is processed automatically and the order is fulfilled. You won't need to do a thing.

* **Manual:** When you receive an order, you can go to the **Orders** tab in the Printify dashboard and click **Fulfill orders** to pay for the order manually. It is then fulfilled by Printify.

To learn more about fulfilling Printify orders, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-fulfilling-printify-products).

question: How can I track Core Web Vitals for all my organization's sites using the account level monitoring dashboard?
answer:
The account level monitoring dashboard allows you to quickly and easily track the Core Web Vitals scores for all your organization's sites. Core Web Vitals include:

* **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP):** An indication of a site's loading time - more specifically, how long it takes for the largest content element in the site's viewport to load.
* **Interaction to Next Paint (INP):** An assessment of your site's responsiveness to all click, tap, and keyboard interactions that occur throughout each visit on every page. The final INP value is the longest interaction observed.
* **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS):** A measurement of unexpected movements of elements that change the layout of the page.

By tracking these metrics, you can identify areas for improvement and optimize site performance to enhance site visitor satisfaction. For more detailed, site-specific insights, you can click **View Breakdown** next to the relevant site to explore specific metrics and receive improvement tips. Learn more about [Core Web Vitals](https://support.wix.com/en/article/site-performance-about-core-web-vitals) for improved site performance.

question: How can I set up payments in my Wix form using the new Wix Forms?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure you've [connected your site to a payment method](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-an-overview) and [upgraded your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-upgrading-wix-forms).

### Step-by-Step Instructions
1. Click the form you want to add payments to.
2. Click **Edit Form**.
3. Click **Product** or **Donation** under **Transaction fields**.
4. Click **Install Checkout**. 
   
   **Note**: If you have added the Product Order Form template, skip this step.
5. Click the **General** tab.
6. Depending on whether you want to sell products or raise donations, follow the steps below.

#### Single Product
1. Give a short title that tells people what you are asking for in the field. 
   
   **Note**: To hide the title, click the **More Actions** icon and then **Hide field title**.
2. Enter the name of your product, select an image and set the price for your product.
3. (Optional) Click the **More Actions** icon and select **Check as default**.
4. Set the product options that meet your needs:
   * **One of each**: Offer one item on your form for a fixed price.
   * **Multiples of any**: Offer multiples of your item on your form for a fixed price.
   * **Required field**: Make this field mandatory for your visitors to fill out.
   * **Field description**: Add a note that gives details or instructions about the field.

#### Multiple Products
1. Give a short title that tells people what you are asking for in the field. 
   
   **Note**: To hide the title, click the **More Actions** icon and then **Hide field title**.
2. Enter the name of your product, select an image and set the price for your product.
3. Click **Add Product** to add more product(s).
4. Enter the details of your additional product(s).
5. (Optional) Click the **More Actions** icon to move products up or down your product list, check as default or delete products.
6. Set the product options that meet your needs:
   * **One of each**: Offer one of each item on your form for a fixed price.
   * **Multiples of any**: Offer multiples of each of your items on your form for a fixed price.
   * **Only one**: Offer only one of your items on your form for a fixed price.
   * **Required field**: Make this field mandatory for your visitors to fill out.
   * **Field description**: Add a note that gives details or instructions about the field.

#### Donation
1. Give a short title that tells people what you are asking for in the field. 
   
   **Note**: To hide the title, click the **More Actions** icon and then **Hide field title**.
2. Enter the donation amount(s).
3. (Optional) Enable **Allow custom amount** to allow your users to set their own donation amount.
4. Set the donation options that meet your needs:
   * **Required field**: Make this field mandatory for your visitors to fill out.
   * **Field description**: Add a note that gives details or instructions about the field.
   * **Column display**: Align your donation options in one, two or three columns.

### Tip
Write a few details about your product/service within your form to give your site visitors more information about what they're purchasing.

question: How can I find and delete the old Cookie Alert app from my site if it's not visible in the editor?
answer:
If you are having trouble finding and deleting the old Cookie Alert app from your site, follow these steps:

1. **Check the page layout**: Ensure that the page layout is set to regular, as the Cookie Alert app is visible only in this layout.
2. **Turn on the ruler in the editor**: Use `Ctrl+M` to navigate through the elements on the page.
3. **Identify hidden elements**: If you come across an element that has "\-" in the element position (X, Y), remove the "\-" to reveal what element it is.

### Notes
- Sometimes the Cookie Alert app may be outside of visible grid lines, making it hard to find. You can also check the elements in the "layers".
- After deleting the app, it may take up to 24 hours for the banner in the app to disappear.

question: How can I replace an image in my email marketing campaign template using Wix?
answer:
To replace an image in your email marketing campaign template using Wix, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Email Marketing](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Email%20Marketing%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/shoutout/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit** next to an existing campaign or [create a new one](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-a-new-campaign).
3. Select the relevant image in your campaign.
4. Click **Change Image**.
5. Select an image from:
   * **Site Files:** Images that you've uploaded to your site. Click **Upload Media** to upload a new image.
   * **Media from Wix:** Free images available for you to use. Browse through the available images using the categories on the left or the search bar on the right.
   * **Shutterstock Images:** Images available for purchase. Select an image and click **Buy Image** to purchase it.
6. Click **Add to Page**.
7. (Optional) Choose from the following options, then click **Apply**:
   * **Edit:** Use the [Wix Photo Studio tools](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-using-the-wix-photo-studio-tools) to enhance and improve the image.
   * **Add a link:** Enable the toggle and enter the URL you want to link the image to.
   * **Design:** Use the sliders to adjust the padding around the image.

### Note
Email campaign images have a width of 700 pixels. If you replace the template image with a wider image, it resizes to 700 pixel width. Smaller images retain their original size.

### Tip
Learn more about [modifying your email campaign template](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-elements-to-your-email-campaign).

2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.

7. Tap **Add Media** to add images or video clips to your video.
8. Tap **Next** and add titles to your video:
   
   * **Opening Title:** This appears at the beginning of your video and should introduce the concept of the video.
   * **Second Title:** This text appears next. Use it to explain more about the video content.
   * **Third Title:** This text is the next to appear. It's a good idea to make this a call-to-action to explain what you would like the viewers to do, such as "Visit Our Store".

question: What is the purpose of TTL in DNS records and should I change the default TTL value?
answer: Time to live (TTL) is the value of time that tells servers how long to store a DNS record locally before discarding. You should leave the TTL for your DNS records set to the default time. Changing a TTL value does not speed up the time it takes for a DNS record to propagate. It only changes the amount of time before your computer is forced to make a new DNS request.

question: Why does a charge appear twice on my customer's bank statement, and what should be done if it doesn't disappear?
answer: Sometimes a charge may appear to have been made twice on your customer's bank statement. This does not mean that your customer makes two payments. When paying for goods or services by credit card, a credit card company may authorize the card for the amount due before the actual funds are taken. The authorization (pending charge) appears on your customer's bank statement and may look like a charge, however, no funds are actually taken at that time. The authorization should disappear from online bank statements within a month. If the authorization does not disappear, please advise your customer to contact their bank for further information.

question: Is there a specific field type for email addresses in CMS collections?
answer:
Currently, CMS collections do not have a field type used specifically for email addresses. However, you can use workarounds to achieve similar functionality:

* **To create dynamic links that open the visitor's mail client:** Create a URL field type in your collection for storing the email addresses. Then, add the email addresses to the field with **mailto:** at the beginning of each address (e.g. **mailto:support@email.com**). Lastly, link a button or image to a dataset that connects to this URL field. When visitors click the link, their email client opens with the relevant address in the 'To:' field. 

* **To store email addresses submitted through custom CMS forms:** You can use the Text Input element set to collect emails. Then, connect it to a Text or URL field type in your collection where the emails will be stored. 

For more details, you can refer to the following links:
- [Create a URL field type](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-a-field-to-a-collection)
- [Link a button or image to a dataset](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-connecting-a-button-to-a-dataset)
- [Text Input element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-adding-and-setting-up-a-text-input)

question: How can I get help with an issue regarding my printed merchandise order from Order a Print?
answer:

question: How can I set up a fulfillment service in my Wix store?

question: How can I edit the SEO settings for a dynamic list page in my CMS?

question: How can I create a Wix Payments account to accept payments on my site?
answer:

2. Click **Connect** next to Wix Payments.

   **Note**: [Wix Payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-wix-payments) is not yet available to all users.

3. Enable the toggles of the payment methods you wish to accept through Wix Payments and click **Continue**.
4. Click **Complete Setup**.
5. Select an option under **Business Type**:
   
   * **Individual/Sole Proprietorship**: Select this option if you are doing business as an individual and fill in your personal details, as well as your business description.
   * **Partnership/Ltd/Liability Co./Corporation/NGO**: Select this option if you are doing business as a business and fill in both your business information and your personal details.
   * **Regional account types**: In some countries, [other business types](https://support.wix.com/en/article/the-difference-between-individual-and-business-accounts-in-wix-payments#regional-account-types) may be selected which align with local business definitions.
6. Enter your details:
   
   * Identification information
   * Address
   * Bank details
   * Business information
   * Business description
7. Click the checkbox to accept the Terms & Conditions and service fees.
8. Click **Submit**.

After submitting your details, you are required to go through a [verification process](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-verification-process).

question: How can I create a discount for my restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To create a discount for your restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Marketing & SEO](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpromote-home%3F&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Go+to+Marketing) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Restaurant Discounts** tab on the left.
3. Click **+ New Discount**.
4. Select a discount type:
   * **Percentage off item:** Offer a percentage discount (per item).
   * **Amount off item:** Offer a fixed price discount (per item).
   * **Amount off order:** Offer a discount on the total price of the order.
5. Create your discount:
   * **Name:** Enter a name for the discount.
   * **Discount:** Enter the percent or amount you're offering to customers.
   * **Description:** Explain to customers what the discount applies to. 
   
   **Note:** Customers see this description during checkout.
6. Set the conditions for your discount:
   1. (Optional) **Minimum order price:** Offer a discount to orders that are over a certain amount.
   2. **Delivery type:** Choose the delivery types where the discount applies:
      * **Delivery:** Discount applies for delivery orders.
      * **Pickup and Contactless Dine-in:** Discount applies for customer pickup and contactless dine-in orders.
   3. **Platform:** Choose the platforms where the discount applies:
      * **Site:** When customers order from your restaurant site.
      * **Mobile (Web & App):** When customers order on their mobile phones.
      * **Phone order:** When you're taking order from customers on the phone.
   4. **Apply to:** Select what restaurant items the discount applies to and click **Apply**:
      * **Entire menu:** All items on your menus are discounted.
      * **Sections:** Select the checkbox next to menu sections to which the discount applies.
      * **Dishes:** Select the checkbox next to menu items to which the discount applies.
   5. **Available:** Apply the discount to your opening hours, or specific days and times and click **Apply**.
7. (Optional) Click the **Discount Coupon** toggle if you want customers to enter a coupon code during checkout to receive the discount. Then, select the usage limit for your coupon code:
   * **Unlimited:** Coupon can be used an unlimited number of times.
   * **Limited:** Enter the number of times the coupon can be used (e.g. select 100 to create a coupon good only for the first 100 customers that use it in an order).
8. Click **Save**.

question: What should I do if my Wix site is not displaying correctly on my mobile device?
answer:
If your Wix site is not displaying correctly on your mobile device, follow these troubleshooting steps:

### Step 1 | Check your operating system and browser
Make sure that the **device and browser** you're using are supported and you're using the most up-to-date version. If not, you can download a new browser from the Apple App Store or the Google Play Store. 

**Supported operating systems on mobile devices:** 
* iPhone: iOS 14 and above (iPhone 7 and above)
* Android: 9.0 and above

**Supported browsers on mobile devices:** 
* Google Chrome
* Safari

### Step 2 | Clear your cache and cookies
Clear your browser's cache and cookies. For instructions on how to clear the cache on your mobile device, please choose from the list below: 
1. [iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201265)
2. [Android](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050)

### Step 3 | Check the site view
Check to see if you are viewing your site in landscape or portrait view on your device. 
Currently, Wix sites are [only supported on mobile devices in portrait mode](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-request-optimized-landscape-view-on-mobile-sites).

### Important Information
* Tablet devices, such as iPads and Android tablets, display the desktop version of your site. Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/troubleshooting-ipad-and-tablet-live-site-issues) to learn about Wix sites compatibility with tablets.
* Wix sites load on Windows phones, however we are currently not testing functionality and therefore, are unable to offer support for any issues that may occur on this type of device.

### Tip
If you are using Google Analytics, you can check the traffic received from different mobile devices in the mobile section.

question: How do I set up receipt printing with Wix Mobile POS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have completed the purchase of a compatible thermal printer.

### Step 1 | Purchase a printer
Before you can start printing receipts, you need to acquire a compatible thermal printer. Choose from one of the Star Micronics or Epson thermal printers. Make sure it appears on the list of compatible printers and supports a Bluetooth, WiFi, or Ethernet connection.

### Step 2 | Pair the printer with your mobile device
Now that you have your printer, you can pair it to your mobile device.

#### To pair your printer and phone:
1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** at the bottom.
3. Under **Get Paid**, tap **Point of Sale**.
4. Tap the More Actions icon at the top right.
5. Select **POS settings**.
6. Tap **Connect** next to **Receipt printer**.
7. Follow the manufacturer's instructions to turn on your printer's Bluetooth and tap **Connect**.

#### Bluetooth
1. Make sure you have allowed location and nearby devices discovery permissions on your mobile device.
2. Ensure your printer's Bluetooth is turned on.
3. In your phone, tap **Connect** next to the relevant printer.
4. Pair your mobile POS with your printer.

#### WiFi and Ethernet
Follow your thermal printer manufacturer instructions to connect it to the same network as your mobile device.

### Step 3 | Customize your receipt
With Wix POS, you can customize your receipt and decide what information you want to display. Learn how to [customize Mobile POS receipts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-mobile-pos-customizing-receipts).

### Step 4 | Print a receipt at a sale
Now that your printer is connected and your receipts are customized, you have the option of printing a receipt at a sale.

#### To print a receipt at a sale:
1. Process a sale and collect payment.
2. Tap **Send Receipt**.
3. Select **Print receipt**.

question: What are some effective strategies to gain backlinks for my website?
answer:
To gain backlinks for your website, consider the following strategies:

* **Submit Site URL to Directories:** Directories categorize and list websites, boosting your site's visibility with valuable backlinks. Smaller, niche-based directories can be particularly powerful. For example, if your business is an art gallery, search for art-based directories. If your site has a physical location, submit it to local directories relevant to your site's purpose.

* **Social Networking:** Engage in online communities related to your niche. Blogs, forums, and social media sites are filled with people interested in similar topics, offering link-building opportunities. Join these groups and establish yourself as a valuable community member.

* **Content Creation:** Create articles or blog posts related to your expertise. Research trending topics and write guidelines, articles with data-based statistics, or infographics that tell an interesting story—anything people would want to quote and share within the industry.

* **Guest Blogging:** Write guest blog posts for credible sites related to your business's niche. This increases your online presence and creates quality backlinks to your site.

* **Posting Testimonials for Other Services:** If you regularly cooperate with certain companies or suppliers, contact them to post a testimonial on their website that includes a link to your site.

Remember, a single, quality link from a popular site is better than a large number of poor-quality links. Avoid deceptive practices and consult [Google's quality guidelines](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/66356) and the [black hat SEO techniques](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-black-hat-seo-techniques) article for more information.

question: How do I add and set up an upload button in my CMS using the Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Make sure to [add the CMS to your editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) if you haven't already.

### Step 1 | Add the upload button element: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page in which you want to add an upload button.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
4. Click **Input**.
5. Click **Upload Buttons** under **Advanced**.
6. Click and drag the upload button you want to use onto the page.

### Step 2 | Connect to the CMS through a dataset: Wix Editor
1. In your editor, click the upload button you just added.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
3. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to the collection you will store submissions in. Alternatively, click **Add a Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to store submissions in.
4. Add a field to your collection where you will store the upload button submissions.

### Step 3 | Set the dataset mode and collection permissions: Wix Editor
1. In the panel on the right, click **Dataset Settings**.
2. Click the **Dataset mode** drop-down and select **Write**.
3. (If necessary) Click the permissions type under **Collection Permissions** and select **Form submissions** in the 1st drop-down. You can click the additional drop-downs to refine the permissions. Click **Save** once you're done setting the permissions.

### Step 4 | Customize the upload button: Wix Editor
1. In your editor, click the upload button.
2. Click **Settings** and edit the following:
   - **Upload settings:** Choose the maximum number of files visitors will be able to upload at the same time and set the field as required, if needed.
   - **Display options:** Customize the field title, button text, and text below the button.
3. Click the **Layout** icon to adjust the spacing, direction, alignment, and icon position. Click **Advanced** to set the alignment and direction of specific text.
4. Click the **Design** icon and choose a preset button. Click **Customize Design** to further customize the button's design.

### Step 5 | Create a submit button
Add a regular button or image and connect it to the same dataset that connects to your submissions collection. Then set the click action for the button or image to **Submit**. This allows the uploaded files to 'write', or create a new item in the submissions collection upon clicking the submit button.

Learn how to [create a submit button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-a-custom-form-with-input-elements-that-submit-to-your-collection#step-5-create-a-submit-button) for your upload button.

question: What should I consider when selecting a domain name to improve my site's SEO?
answer:
When selecting a domain name to improve your site's SEO, consider the following:

* **Unless your company name is an acronym, avoid using them:** For instance, if your company name is Best's Sushi Tokyo, don't abbreviate it to bst.com when BestsSushiTokyo.com is both:
  
  + Easy to remember for your users.
  + Includes the entire business name, which optimizes it for search engines.
* **Be wary of using hyphens:** Contrary to what you might think, hyphens between keywords in your domain do not make them easier for search engine bots to read. In fact, too many hyphens can damage the credibility of your domain, not to mention make it difficult for your visitors to type.
* **Avoid Copyright Infringement:** Sounds obvious enough, but you would be surprised how often this mistake is made. Check that the domain name you wish to use isn't going to lead you straight to court. Visit the relevant copyright office (for example, copyright.gov in the US) before you register your domain.
* **Add keywords:** Your domain name is a great place for a keyword or two, but don't make the domain name too long. If your company name is slightly abstract and doesn't provide an idea about what you do, consider adding one of your keywords i.e. company name is Big Corp, the domain name could be BigCorpBuilders.com.

### Tip
Remember, your domain should appeal not just to your site visitors, but also to search engines. Check out [this video about choosing the best domain name](https://www.wix.com/seo/learn/resource/how-to-choose-the-right-domain-name?utm_source=kb) on the SEO Learning Hub.

question: How can I customize the layout of my Wix Music player?
answer:
To customize the player's layout:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the Wix Music player.
3. Click **Settings.**
4. Click the **Layouts** tab.
5. Choose a layout: **Vertical**, **Horizontal**, or **List**.
6. Choose what you want to customize:

### Vertical
* **Control bar:** Choose a design for the control bar.
* **Album / Playlist / Single cover image:** Show or hide the cover image.
* **Show music info:** Choose to show the info on or below the cover image.
* **Show track list:** Show or hide your track list.
* **Track info includes:** Display the track name only or the name and the artist.
* **Show track actions:** Show the track actions on all tracks or just the active track.
* **Track list spacing**: Adjust the spacing between tracks.

### Horizontal
* **Control bar:** Choose a design for the control bar.
* **Album / Playlist / Single cover image:** Show or hide the cover image.
* **Track actions:** Show track actions on all tracks or just the active track.
* **Track list spacing**: Adjust the spacing between tracks.

### List
* **Album / Playlist / Single info:** Show or hide the album / playlist / single info.
* **Play buttons:** Choose the play button style: **Round**, **Classic**, or **Cover Image**.
* **Track info includes:** Display the track name only or the name and the artist.
* **Track actions:** Show the track actions on all tracks or just the active track.
* **Track duration:** Display track duration or not.
* **Track list spacing:** Adjust the spacing between tracks.
* **Stretch to fit:** Stretch the player to fill the width of the screen.

question: How can I ensure that using Google Fonts on my Wix site complies with the GDPR?
answer:
In a recent decision, a regional court in Munich ruled that the “dynamic use” of Google Fonts violates the EU GDPR. This is due to the fact that your visitor's IP address could be transmitted to Google's servers in the United States. Wix has developed an in-house solution to remedy this issue. Google Fonts are now hosted locally within Wix. This means that no IP data is transmitted from the EU to Google's servers in the United States. 

**Note**: If you add fonts to your site using alternative methods such as custom embeds, custom elements or iframes, they may contain Google Fonts and we cannot guarantee that these will be hosted locally.

question: How can I create a custom loyalty rewards function using Wix Functions?
answer:
To create a custom loyalty rewards function using Wix Functions, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Loyalty Program](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Loyalty%20Program&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/loyalty-accounts/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Program** at the top right.
3. Scroll down to **Rewards** and click the **Create Reward** drop-down.
4. Select **Build with Functions**.
5. Choose how to create your function:
   * **Use a function template:** Click **Use Template** next to the relevant template.
   * **Create your own function:** Click **Start from Scratch** at the bottom left to build your own custom reward.
6. (In the Functions Builder) Click the **Output** to choose how the award is applied.
   
   **Tip:** The output is the result you want to occur at the end of the function flow.
7. Set a points-to-discount conversion rate.
   
   1. **Points:** Set the number of points for the conversion rate (e.g., 20 points = $2 discount).
   2. **Discount value in site currency:** Set how much the points are worth when converting them into a discount at checkout (e.g., 20 points = $2 discount).
   
   **Tip:** You can also click **Customize** above a field to build more complex logic into the output or condition.
8. (Optional) If you are using a template, you can click the existing **Condition** step to update it to match your needs. For example, if you're using the 'Total spend bonus' template, you might want to change the total spend required for members to be eligible for the reward.
9. Name the new reward you're creating:
   
   1. Click the **More Actions** icon at the top right.
   2. Select **Function configuration**.
   3. Enter a reward name and description.
      
      **Tip:** Loyalty members will see this name on the main Loyalty page as well as the My Rewards page.
   4. Click **Save**.
10. Click **Activate** at the top right.

Once your function is activated, loyalty program members who have met the relevant criteria can exchange loyalty points for a discount. The amount of points / discount depends on what you entered as the output.

question: How can I remove a page from Google search results if it still appears after adding a 'noindex' tag?
answer:
If you've already prevented search engines from indexing your page, it may still sometimes appear in search results. For example, Google may have crawled your site **before** you prevented it from indexing the page. You can send a request to Google to remove the URL using their [URL removal tool](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9689846?hl=en).

### To remove a URL:
1. Go to [Google Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console).
2. Click **Removals**.
3. Click **New Request**.
4. Select **Clear Cached URL**.
5. Enter your page's URL.
6. Click **Next**.

### Important
* After you send the request, you should ask Google to crawl the page again by [requesting indexing for it](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/crawling/ask-google-to-recrawl).
* It can take some time for Google to remove your page from search results.

question: What elements are automatically added to my site when I install the Wix Site Search app, and how can I customize them?

You can customize the parts of your site that are searchable, how many results are displayed, the layout and design of your search bar, and the placeholder text that's displayed in the bar. [Learn more about customizing your search bar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/understanding-customizing-your-search-results-page#customizing-your-page-display).

- **Results Page**: This displays a list of results related to the term your visitor is searching for. The results page is hidden by default, meaning that it isn't displayed on your site menu. Your visitors can only see this page when they search for a term in your search bar. [Learn more about the results page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/understanding-customizing-your-search-results-page).

question: How can I troubleshoot if my page is not eligible for rich results?
answer:
To troubleshoot if your page is not eligible for rich results, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Check that the rich result type is supported
Not all rich result types are supported by Google. You can check the [list of supported rich result types](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7552505?hl=en#supported-result-types) to see if it's currently supported in the report.

### Step 2 | Make sure the page is indexed
Rich results can only be shown for pages that can be crawled and indexed. You can use the [URL Inspection tool](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9012289) to check if a page is indexed and if Google can access it. Test the live version of the page as well to confirm that Google can access it.

### Step 3 | Ask Google to recrawl your pages
If you've recently added new pages or made updates to your site, you can [ask Google to recrawl your URLs](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/6065812). Note: It can take up to a week for Google to index your pages after you submit a request.

### Step 4 | Make sure Google can access your page
Google can only create rich results for pages it can access. You can use the [URL Inspection tool](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9012289) to check whether Google can access your page.

### Step 5 | Make sure your structured data markup is valid
If your page's markup is invalid, Google may not be able to recognize it as a rich result. If the test can find your markup but it can't parse it, it should appear in the [Unparsable structured data report](https://search.google.com/search-console/unknown-type).

### Step 6 | Check that rich results are supported for your location
Certain rich result types might not be supported for your location yet. Check [the features guides](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/structured-data/intro-structured-data?hl=en) section of Google's structured data documentation to see if your location is supported.

question: How can I create a private forum category in Wix Forum and manage access for specific members?
answer:
To create a private category in Wix Forum and manage access for specific members, follow these steps:

1. Go to your [Forum](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Forum&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/forum/) in your site's dashboard.

3. Do one of the following:
   * Create a new category
   * Select an existing category
4. Scroll down to **Access & Monetization** and choose **Selected Members**.
5. Click **Add** next to the relevant option:
   * **Members:** Select the members that you want to give access to your category.
   * **Roles:** Once you’ve created a role, you can give members with the same role access to this category.
   * **Badges:** Once you've created a badge, you can give members that have that badge, access to this category.
   * **Subscriptions:** By adding a plan to the category, only members that have access to the plan, can access the category.

Note that notifications cannot be sent for private categories. You can manage all of your site members from the Member List in your site's dashboard by clicking [here](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Members%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmember-permissions%2Fmembers).

question: How can I add private registration to my existing Wix domain?
answer:
To add private registration to an existing domain subscription, extend your domain registration for at least an additional year and choose the **Private registration** option.

question: Can I increase the excerpt character count for my Wix blog posts beyond 140 characters?

question: How can I hide the header and footer on a specific page in Wix Editor?

question: What steps can I take to prevent email throttling in my email marketing campaigns?
answer:
To prevent email throttling in your email marketing campaigns, ensure that your contact list is maintained and updated regularly. Follow these email marketing best practices:

* Get explicit consent from every recipient to send them emails.
* Avoid including any suspicious or prohibited content in your emails.
* Clean your list every six months to ensure all email addresses are still valid.

For more helpful tips on sending your campaigns, view a full list of [Wix Email Marketing best practices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-email-marketing-best-practices).

question: Can I change the URLs of individual images in the Wix Pro Gallery?

question: How can I set up order pacing for my restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app?
answer:
To set up order pacing for your restaurant using the original Wix Restaurants Orders app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Order Settings](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Frestaurants/ordersSettings%3F&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Order+Settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Advanced**.
3. Click the **Order Pacing** toggle:
   
   * **Enabled:** Limit the number of orders placed according to your rush hours:
     
     + **Order limit per 15 minutes:** Enter the number of orders you can fulfill every 15 minutes.
     + **Include Contactless Dine-in orders:** Select the checkbox to include contactless dine-in orders.
     + **Rush hours:** Set the days of week and times of day to apply the order limit to and click **Apply**.
   * **Disabled:** Customers can place orders on your site without any limitations.
4. Click **Save**.

Order pacing is available only for ASAP orders and is automatically applied to online orders for delivery and pickup. You can also include contactless dine-in orders by enabling the **Include Contactless Dine-in Orders** toggle. If you have specific peak hours, you can set the order pacing to apply for only those times. Note that you can't set your rush hours from the Wix app; you need to do it from your desktop.

question: How can I create a new workspace in the Wix Studio app?

question: How can I manage the step order and visibility for my self-paced online program?
answer:
To manage the step order and visibility for your self-paced online program, follow these steps:

3. Select **Edit Settings**.
4. Click **Content**.

   * **Any Order:** Participants can complete steps in the order they want.
   * **Fixed Order:** Participants can complete steps in the order you set for them. Enable the **Hide future steps** toggle to hide the content of future steps until a current step is completed.
6. Enable the relevant toggles to customize your video step experience:
   
   * **Require to watch videos:** Set a required percentage participants must watch to complete the step.
   * **Autoplay next video step:** Automatically play the next video after the current one ends. **Note:** These settings apply to all video steps in your program.
7. Click **Save**.

question: How can I automate my accounting by connecting my site with QuickBooks Online using the QuickBooks Connector app by Intuit?
answer:
To automate your accounting by connecting your site with QuickBooks Online using the QuickBooks Connector app by Intuit, follow these steps:

1. **Ensure you have one of the following apps added to your site:**
   - [Wix Stores](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-wix-stores)
   - [Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-about-wix-bookings)
   - [Wix Events](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-wix-events-to-your-site)
   - [Wix Hotels](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-wix-hotels)

2. **Install the QuickBooks Connector app by Intuit** from the [Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market/2374b1f8-39ba-4d4c-bfd3-2fdec89ee4c4/overview).

3. **Features and benefits include:**
   - Retrieve orders from your Wix Store, Wix Bookings, Wix Events, or Wix Hotels.
   - Create new items in your QuickBooks Online account when you create products in your store.
   - Automatically create sales in your QuickBooks Online for orders that customers make on your site.
   - Map tax codes from your store orders to tax codes in your QuickBooks Online.
   - Eliminate human error from manual data entry between your QuickBooks Online and your website.

By following these steps, you can save hours of manually entering invoices, customers, and products from one app to another, and streamline your accounting processes.

question: How can I contact a customer who placed an order through the Wix app?
answer:
To contact a customer from the Wix app:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Open the order or reservation you want to view contact details for:
   
   * **For orders:**
     
     1. Tap **Manage** at the bottom right.
     2. Tap **Orders**.
     3. Tap the New, In Progress or All tab to locate the correct order.
   * **For reservations:**
     
     1. Tap **Manage** at the bottom right.
     2. Tap **Reservations**.
     3. Tap the Open, Upcoming or History tab to locate the correct reservation.
3. Scroll to the end of the order or reservation to locate the contact info. Choose what you want to do:
   
   * **Call the customer:** Tap the **Call** icon under Phone Number.
   * **Email the customer:** Tap the **Email** icon under Email Address.

**Note:** If you can't see a contact option it means the customer did not provide that information when making their order or reservation.

question: How can I enable and customize a Wix Gift Card for my Wix Store?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure you have set the currency you want to use in your site before setting up your gift card. [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments)

### Step 1 | Enabling gift cards
To enable gift cards:
1. Go to the [Gift Cards](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Gift%20Cards&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/gift-cards) tab in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add Gift Card to Site**.

### Step 2 | Customize your gift card details
To customize your gift card details:
1. Go to the [Gift Cards](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Gift%20Cards&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/gift-cards) tab in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Edit Gift Card**.
3. Edit the gift card name.
4. Edit the description.
5. Change the image:
   
   1. Hover over the gift card image and click the Show More icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/10/19/4b83c9d1-06bb-4afb-99f4-8a2bc8d1fadc/e5a7f84c-3a83-47d2-83e5-a8241539df1b.png).
   2. Select **Change Image**.
   3. Upload a gift card image and click **Add to Page**.
   
   **Tip:** Use [Wix Logo Maker](https://www.wix.com/createlogo6/wix_logo_maker) to help design a gift card image.
6. Edit the gift card amounts that customers can purchase:
   
   1. Type the amount you want to add and press **Enter** on your keyboard.
   2. Click the **x** next to any amount you want to remove.
7. Set an expiration policy:
   
   * **They never expire:** The gift card has no expiration date.
   * **[x] months from the date of purchase:** Enter the number of months the card can be used before it expires.
   
   **Important:** Laws in some regions do not permit expiration dates for gift cards. Check your local laws.
8. Click **Save**.

**Note:** Once you save your gift card, your Gift Card page will automatically update to the new information you have just added.

### Tip
Click **Preview** in your ADI Builder to see how your Gift Card page looks before publishing.

question: How can I customize the ways customers earn points in the Wix Loyalty Program to align with my business goals?
answer:
To customize the ways customers earn points in the Wix Loyalty Program, you can tailor the earning actions to your specific business goals. For example, if you're hosting an event and want to encourage people to RSVP, you can create an incentive by offering 50 loyalty points to anyone who RSVPs. Some ways customers can earn points include:

- Becoming a site member
- Purchasing a store product
- Booking a session
- Placing a restaurant order
- Buying an event ticket
- RSVPing to an event

You can also use Wix Automations to create even more ways customers can earn points. This allows you to align the loyalty program with your business objectives effectively. For more details, you can learn more about [how customers earn points](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-loyalty-program-managing-your-loyalty-program#updating-how-customers-earn-loyalty-points).

question: How can I disable the pop-up blocker in Google Chrome to allow Wix.com pop-ups?
answer:
To disable the pop-up blocker in Google Chrome and allow Wix.com pop-ups, follow these steps:

1. Open Google Chrome on your computer.
2. Click the three dots in the upper-right corner of the browser window to open the menu.
3. Select 'Settings' from the dropdown menu.
4. Scroll down and click on 'Privacy and security'.
5. Click on 'Site settings'.
6. Under 'Content', click on 'Pop-ups and redirects'.
7. In the 'Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects' section, click 'Add'.
8. Enter `[*.]wix.com` and click 'Add'.

This will allow pop-ups from Wix.com while keeping the pop-up blocker enabled for other sites. For more detailed instructions, you can visit the [Google Chrome support page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/disabling-the-google-chrome-pop-up-blocker).

question: How can I ensure my Vimeo video is properly embedded on my Wix site?

2. Click the relevant video to open the video edit page.

   **Note**: The selection will save automatically.
5. Find the **Embed** section at the bottom of the panel.
6. Set the **Where can this be embedded?** setting to **Anywhere**. 
   
   **Note**: This selection will also save automatically.
7. Ensure that the video link privacy setting from the icon next to share and Embed in the top right corner is set to **Public**. 
   
   **Note**: Vimeo has recently updated their privacy settings which requires you to also select a maturity rating for your videos before it can be set to public.

question: Can I use subscript and superscript text in the Studio Editor?
answer:
Currently, subscript and superscript text are not supported in the Studio Editor. As an alternative, you can use separate text boxes to achieve a subscript or superscript effect.

question: How can I design my business card using the Wix Business Card Maker?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have selected a business card template as described in Step 1.

After choosing your card's template, you can start designing it from the business card editor. From this editor you can customize the card's text, image, color and more. You may also want to change an element's location. You can reposition elements by dragging and dropping, or arrange any overlapping elements using the toolbar above your card design. From this toolbar, you can also duplicate and delete elements.

### Text
1. Select the relevant text on your card or click **Add Text** on the left.
2. Customize the text using the following options:
   * **Edit Text:** Type to replace the existing text.
   * **Font:** Select a font from the dropdown menu.
   * **Opacity & Color:** Click the color box to change the text's color and drag the slider to adjust its transparency.
   * **Font Size:** Drag the slider to increase or decrease the size of the text.
   * **Letter Spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the space between letters.
3. (Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking **Switch to Back** / **Switch to Front** and repeating steps 1 and 2.

### Shape
1. Click **Add Shape** on the left or click the existing shape on your template.
2. Choose from a square or circle shape.
3. Customize your shape using the following options:
   * **Shape Opacity & Color:** Click the color box to change the shape's color and drag the slider to adjust its transparency.
   * **Border Width:** Drag the slider to adjust the shape's border width.
   * **Border Opacity & Color:** Click the color box to change the shape's border color and drag the slider to adjust its transparency.

### Vector art
1. Click **Add Vector Art** on the left or click the existing vector art on your template.
2. Search for and select the vector art you like.
3. Click **Add to Template.**
4. Drag and drop the vector art to its position and resize using the grip handles.
5. Customize your vector art using the options on the left:
   * **Image Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the vector art's transparency.
   * **Image Colors:** Click **Change Colors.** Then click the relevant color box to change the vector art's color(s).
6. (Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking **Switch to Back** / **Switch to Front** and repeating steps 1 to 5.

### Image
1. Click **Add Image** on the left or click the existing image on your template.
2. (If uploading an image) Click the relevant image in the Media Manager and click **Add to Template**.
3. Customize your image using the options on the left:
   * **Image Opacity:** Drag the slider on the left to adjust the transparency of the image.
4. (Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking **Switch to Back** / **Switch to Front** and repeating steps 1 to 3.

### Background
1. Click **Change Background** on the left.
2. Click the color box to change the card's background color.
3. Drag the slider to adjust the color's opacity.
4. (Optional) Edit the other side of the card by clicking **Switch to Back** / **Switch to Front** and repeating steps 1 and 2.

Once you finish customizing your design click **Done** to choose your paper type and card quantity.

question: What are the eligibility requirements for the Google Ads credit offer for Wix sites?
answer:
To be eligible for the Google Ads credit offer for Wix sites, you must meet the following requirements:

1. **New to Google Advertising:** You must be new to Google advertising, with no previous Google Ads campaigns related to your site.
2. **Spend Requirement:** You must spend $500 USD (or your currency equivalent) on ad clicks within the first 60 days of your campaign. The specific amounts for different currencies are:
   
   * **USD:** Spend 500 USD within the first 60 days to receive 500 USD ad credit.
   * **GBP:** Spend 400 GBP within the first 60 days to receive 400 GBP ad credit.
   * **EUR:** Spend 400 EUR within the first 60 days to receive 400 EUR ad credit.
   * **JPY:** Spend 60,000 JPY within the first 60 days to receive 60,000 JPY ad credit.

   All other currencies which are converted to USD need to spend $500 USD to receive the $500 ad credit.

### Tip
Since your ad budget is spent on clicks, you have a better chance of being eligible if you set your monthly subscription to at least $300 (around 10 USD per day).

You can track your eligibility from your Google Ads dashboard in **Ad credit promo**.

question: What are the benefits of selecting Private registration for a domain with Wix?
answer:
Selecting **Private registration** (with Wix as your registrar) allows you to keep your personal information private. With this option, all of your personal details are replaced with Wix's details and are not available in the public WHOIS database. Similar to public registration, Wix lists an alternative email address (e.g. example.com@wix-domains.com) and phone number instead of your personal information. To help minimize spam, anyone trying to get in touch with you will be referred to a dedicated online contact form instead (with the exception of ICANN, the domain regulatory body).

Private registration safeguards you against:

- **Identity theft**: Just as you may protect your banking information, address, or phone number, it is also important to keep other personal information private. Private registration helps to protect against malicious attacks that seek to steal your information.
- **Unwanted solicitations**: If your personal information is available on WHOIS it is also easily accessible to telemarketers, spammers, and scammers.
- **Domain hijacking**: Private registration, with Wix as your registrar, helps protect against those who seek to purchase your domain name. Domain names can be very valuable and, as a result, you may be harassed with attempts to purchase your domain.

**Important**: Private registration does not guarantee protection from spammers. Listing your personal details (e.g. email address) on your site might also put you at risk. We recommend [using a contact form on your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-form-on-your-site) instead of sharing your contact details. Private registration does not protect you in cases where the disclosure of your details is required under applicable law.

question: How can I track the source of traffic to my Wix site using UTM parameters?
answer:
To track the source of traffic to your Wix site using UTM parameters, you need to add a UTM tag to your site's URL. The UTM tag is composed of three parts, known as **UTM parameters**:

- **Source**: The platform the visitor came from. Examples include Facebook, Google, Bing, and email.
- **Medium**: How the visitor reached your site. Examples include an advert, email, or organic search.
- **Campaign Name**: The name of the campaign, as defined by the campaign creator.

The URL is connected to the UTM with a question mark (**?**) and the UTM parameters are connected with ampersands (**&**).

For example, a UTM-tagged URL might look like this: `?utm_source=google&utm_medium=ppc&utm_campaign=mysearchcampaign`.

When you use [Wix Email Marketing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-getting-started) or [Facebook Ads by Wix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-an-overview), the UTM tag is added automatically to the URL. You can also manually add UTM tags to URLs in other marketing campaigns.

5. Sign up or log in to your Gifted account.
6. (In your Gifted dashboard) Click **Customize your gift card** and choose what to do next:
   
   ### Enter the gift card details
   1. Select an option:
      * **Let customers choose their own gift card value:**
        1. Select **Custom Value**.
        2. Enter minimum and maximum possible values.
      * **Offer gift cards at set amount(s):**
        1. Select **Set Values**.
        2. Enter the gift card amounts you offer, separated by commas.
   2. Set when the gift card expires, or set it to never expire. 
      
      **Tip:** Gift card expiration is illegal in some regions. Check your local regulations.
   3. (Optional) Enter additional info (e.g. terms and conditions).
   4. Click **Save**.

   ### Design the gift card
   1. Click **Gift Card Design** at the top.
   2. Design the look of your gift card using the available options.
7. Go back to your Editor and publish your site.

### Important
If you decide in future to stop selling gift cards, do not delete the Gifted app or disable the **Let customers pay with a gift card at checkout** toggle. These actions will prevent gift card holders from redeeming their purchases.

question: How can I check if my domain's DNS records have propagated using whatsmydns.net?
answer:
To check if your domain's DNS records have propagated using whatsmydns.net, follow these steps:

1. **Locating your Domain Records in Your Wix Account**
   - Go to the [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) page in your Wix account.
   - Click the **Show More** icon.
   - Click **Manage DNS records**.
   - Scroll to the record you want to check, e.g., NS (name servers), A record, etc.

2. **Checking Your Domain's Name Server Connection**
   - Go to [whatsmydns.net](https://www.whatsmydns.net/).
   - Enter your domain name **without** the www. prefix (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com) in the search field.
   - Select **NS** from the drop-down menu.
   - Click **Search**.
   - The search result should match the 'Value' field in your Wix records if your domain has propagated correctly.

3. **Checking Your Domain's A Record**
   - Go to [whatsmydns.net](https://www.whatsmydns.net/).
   - Enter your domain name **without** the www. prefix (e.g., mystunningwebsite.com).
   - Select **A** from the drop-down menu.
   - Click **Search**.
   - Next to each server location, you should see your domain IP address. Compare the search results to the records in your domain host's account to ensure they are the same.

4. **Checking Your Domain's CNAME Record**
   - Enter your domain name, **including** the 'www.' prefix (e.g., www.mystunningwebsite.com).
   - Select **CNAME** from the drop-down menu.
   - Click **Search**.
   - Next to each server location, you should see the address your CNAME points to (e.g., www135.wixdns.net). Compare search results to ensure they are the same as those shown in the 'Value' field of your CNAME records in your Wix account.

### Note
- Make sure you are logged in to the Wix account that contains your domain to view the correct records.
- If you see a red checkmark next to a location, it means no record has propagated or there is a communication issue between the server and whatsmydns.net.

### Tip
If your domain has the correct records, but your live site is still not connected, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-domain-assistant-3777632) to troubleshoot.

question: How can I display blog posts from a specific category using a repeater or table in Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have installed the Wix Blog, enabled Wix App Collections, and created a few posts and categories.

To display blog posts from a specific category using a repeater or table, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Add a dataset and connect it to your blog's categories
1. Click **CMS** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Add Content Elements** then click the Add icon next to **Dataset**.
3. Click the newly added dataset.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Select **Categories** from the **Connect a collection** drop-down.

## Step 2 | Add a repeater or table to your page
1. Click **Add** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **List**.
3. Drag a repeater or table onto your page.

## Step 3 | Add another dataset and connect it to your blog posts
1. Click **CMS** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Add Content Elements** then click the Add icon next to **Dataset**.
3. Click the newly added dataset.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Select **Posts** from the **Connect a collection** drop-down.

## Step 4 | Connect your repeater or table to the Posts dataset
1. Click your repeater or table in your Editor.
2. Click the **Connect to Data** icon.
3. From the **Connect a dataset** drop-down, select the **Posts dataset**.
4. Link each of the components of your repeater or table to the appropriate fields in the collection.

## Step 5 | Set up your filters
1. Click the **Posts dataset**.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click **+ Add Filter**.
4. Click the **Field** drop-down and select **Categories (Categories)**.
5. Select **Another dataset** under **Value source**.
6. Select **Categories dataset** under **Dataset**.
7. Click **Add Filter**.
8. Click the **Categories dataset**.
9. Click **Settings**.
10. Click **+ Add Filter**.
11. Click the **Field** drop-down and select **Label (Text)**.
12. Type the name of the category you want to show in the **Value** field.
13. Click **Add Filter**.
14. Click **Save**.
15. Click **Preview**.

question: What steps should I take to ensure my Wix site is accessible and compliant with regional laws?
answer:
To ensure your Wix site is accessible and compliant with regional laws, follow these steps:

1. **Use the Accessibility Checklist**: Start by completing the universal steps outlined in the [Accessibility Checklist](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-checklist-for-improving-your-sites-accessibility "Follow link"). This checklist covers the basics for every region and helps make the content you add to your site accessible.

2. **Site Audit**: After completing the checklist, have your site audited by a local, legal Accessibility Consultant. The audit will either legally confirm compliance success or provide you with the remaining steps to complete, specific to your region’s compliance regulations.

3. **Review Local Legislation**: As the site owner, you are responsible for reviewing and complying with local legislation applicable to you or your site visitors.

While Wix provides many back-end accessibility features, such as keyboard semantics and ARIA attributes, it is important to ensure that the content you add is also accessible. Remember, compliance is a legal matter, and Wix cannot guarantee compliance with all accessibility laws and worldwide regulations.
