question: How can I connect a domain purchased elsewhere to my Wix site using the recommended method?
answer:
To connect a domain purchased elsewhere to your Wix site using the recommended method, follow these steps:

1. **Upgrade Your Site**: Ensure that you have upgraded your site to a premium plan. You can do this by visiting [Wix Upgrade](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website).

2. **Access Your Domain Registrar**: Make sure you have access to your current domain registrar. If you're unsure who your domain registrar is, you can find out by visiting [whois.com](https://www.whois.com/whois/) and entering your domain name to see your domain details.

3. **Connect via Name Servers**: It is strongly recommended to connect your domain by changing its name servers. This method allows Wix to host your DNS records while your domain remains registered with its current host. You will continue to pay for domain registration with your current domain host.

4. **Follow the Steps**: Follow the steps to [connect your domain to the Wix name servers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

By using the name server connection method, you ensure that Wix hosts your DNS records, which simplifies the management of your domain's DNS settings.

question: What happens if my credit card expires before my Wix subscription renewal, and how can I update my payment details?

If your card has expired or if your renewal payment has failed or declined, you can update your card details. question: How can I set up a Wix Automation to send a discount coupon via email?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have completed the setup of a new automation and selected a trigger.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Set up an automation**
   - Begin by creating a new automation from scratch. Select a trigger and decide if you'd like to limit frequency, include a delay, or add special conditions for your automation. Learn more about successfully [creating an automation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-creating-a-new-automation).

2. **Choose the 'add a coupon' action**
   - Click **Add a coupon**.
   - Select whether to send a unique coupon each time in the **Select the type of coupon code** section.
   - Click the **Select a coupon** drop-down to choose the [coupon](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-offering-discounts-and-coupons) you'd like to use or create a new one.
   
   **Important:**
   - This automation will stop working if the coupon end date or use limit is reached.
   - Make sure your coupon has a clear coupon code and coupon name. This will be seen by your visitors when adding the coupon to an email, etc.

3. **Add the coupon to an email as a dynamic value**
   - Click **+ Add Action**.
   - Click **Send an email**.
   - (Optional) Click **Edit** in the **Manage details** section to edit your [sender details](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-customizing-automated-emails#adding-sender-details).
   - Click **Edit** in the **Create an email** section to add your coupon [dynamic value to your email template](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-customizing-automated-emails#editing-your-email-template).
   - Click any text element or add a new one.
   - Click where you want to add the dynamic value.
   - Click **+ Add Personalized Content**.
   - Search coupon to see the available options in the drop-down menu.
     - Coupon ID
     - Coupon code
     - Coupon name
     - Coupon offer description
   - (Optional) Write a fallback text in the text box.
   - Under **Set email type**, select a type for your email to determine how or when your recipients can mute or unsubscribe from your emails:
     - **Promotional:** Non-essential business information or marketing content. Recipients who have unsubscribed or muted the selected notification topic will not receive this email.
     - **Business transactional:** Essential information to your customers, directly related to their activity on your site. Recipients who have muted the selected email notification topic will not receive this email.
     - **Business critical:** Only meant for critical cases. Recipients cannot mute these emails and they will be sent regardless of any unsubscribe preferences.
   - Under **Set recipients**, select all who will receive this automated email when it's triggered:
     - **Include trigger contact:** Recipient who triggered this automation.
     - **Include additional recipients:** Additional recipients who didn't trigger this automation.
   - Click **Activate**.

question: What are some tips to improve email deliverability for my marketing campaigns?
answer:
To improve your email deliverability, follow these best practices:

1. **Only email subscribers:** Send campaigns only to those who have consented to receive correspondence from you. Avoid sending emails to people who haven't heard of your business to prevent spam complaints and lower sender reputation.

2. **Build your email list organically:** Avoid buying or scraping email addresses. Grow your list by adding subscriber forms to your site and offering valuable content in exchange for sign-ups. Use a double-opt-in to confirm consent.

3. **Regularly maintain your email list:** Frequently check for inactive subscribers, spam emails, and non-existent addresses to avoid hard bounces. Provide an option for people to unsubscribe.

4. **Write an informative and engaging subject line:** Ensure your subject line is straightforward and not spammy or clickbait.

5. **Clearly identify yourself and your business:** Make sure your business name and address are clearly identified in the email content or footer to build trust.

6. **Keep your audience engaged:** Send relevant and stimulating content that encourages interaction. Include links, ask for feedback, and keep the conversation going.

7. **Gradually increase the number of emails you send:** Avoid sending a flood of emails at once. Warm up your email list by gradually increasing the number of emails as engagement grows.

question: How can I add more columns to a form in Editor X?

### Move form fields to the new column
After setting up your columns in the desired width, move the form fields on the grid using drag and drop.

As your form fields are now split between multiple columns, you may want to adjust or even remove some rows.

   - Click **Input**.
   - Click **Switch**.

3. **Connect the Switch element to the CMS collection**:
   - Click the **Connect to CMS** icon on the Switch element.
   - Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select a dataset that connects to the collection where you will store the submissions.
   - Click the **Toggled state connects to** drop-down and choose the boolean field in which you will store the submissions.
   - **Tip:** To add a new field for storing submissions, select **Add new field**, then enter the field name and click **Add**.
   - Set the dataset mode and collection permissions:
     - Click **Dataset Settings**.

question: How can I sync my Wix Hotels reservation calendar with an external calendar service like Google Calendar or Airbnb?
answer: To sync your Wix Hotels reservation calendar with an external calendar service that uses iCal, such as Google Calendar, Airbnb, or VRBO, you can follow the instructions provided in the [Sync Wix Hotels with an external calendar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/importing-reservations-from-an-external-calendar-ical-to-wix-hotels) section. question: How can I set up the Get Files to Dropbox app on my Wix site?
answer:
### To set up the Get Files to Dropbox app:

#### Step 1 | Open the Settings panel of the app.
1. Select the app in the Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.

#### Step 2 | Connect your account and select the folder that files can be uploaded to.
1. Click **Connect Account**.
2. Log in to your Dropbox account and allow access.
3. Click the **Folder** tab.
4. Hover over the relevant folder and click **Select**.

#### Step 3 | Edit the app settings.
1. Click the **Settings** tab.
2. Drag the **Max size per upload** slider to change the maximum file size site visitors can upload.
3. Drag the **Disable when storage left is (MG)** slider to change the storage size at which you no longer allow site visitors to upload.
4. Select what visitors must send you when uploading: 
   * **An email:** Visitors must enter a valid email address.
   * **A password:** Enter a password and give it to site visitors you allow to upload.
   * **Nothing:** Site visitors can upload files without doing anything additional.
5. Select a language from the drop-down list.
6. Click the **New subfolder per upload** toggle. 
   * **Enabled:** A subfolder is created for each upload.
   * **Disabled:** Files are uploaded to the selected folder.
7. Click the **Email me for every upload** toggle. 
   * **Enabled:** You receive an email every time someone uploads a file.
   * **Disabled:** You do not receive an email when someone uploads a file.
8. Click the **Users can add a message** toggle. 
   * **Enabled:** A message field appears which site visitors can use to send you a message when uploading.
   * **Disabled:** No message field appears in the app.

#### Step 4 | Change the app layout.
1. Click the **Layout** tab.
2. Select a layout: 
   * **Full:** All upload options appear on your site.
   * **Button:** An Add File button appears on your site. Additional options appear after the button is clicked.

#### Step 5 | Customize the app design.
**Note:** Design options vary for different layouts. 
1. Click the **Design** tab.
2. Click the color box to select a background color and drag the slider to change the opacity.
3. Click the color box to select a border color and drag the slider to change the border width.
4. Click the color box to select a title font color and click the **Expand** icon to select a font.
5. Click the color box to select a font color for the file size limit and click the **Expand** icon to select a font.
6. Click the **Expand** icon to select a button font.
7. Click the color box to select a color for the **Add File** button.
8. Click the color box to select a color for the **Send** button.
9. Click the color box to select a font color for the email and message fields and click the **Expand** icon to select a font.
10. Click the color box to select a background color for the email and message fields.
11. Click the color box to select a border color for the email and message fields and drag the slider to change the border width.

#### Step 6 | Customize the app text.
1. Click the **Text** tab.
2. In the **Text Labels** section, edit any of the text visitors see before uploading. 
3. In the **Loading Screen Labels** section, edit any of the text visitors see while uploading. 
4. In the **Success Screen Labels** section, edit any of the text visitors see after successfully uploading.

question: Can Wix Invoices automatically add Wix Events to an invoice?

question: Can I fill the entire logo background with an uploaded image in Wix Logo Maker?

question: How can I manage posts using the Wix Groups Feed API?

question: How can I update the contact information for my .com.br domain?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to your Registro.br account and know your login credentials.

To update the contact information for a .com.br domain, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Change Your Domain's Contact Information at Registro.br

1. Go to [https://registro.br/2/login](https://registro.br/2/login). 
   **Note:** Since the website is in Portuguese, we recommend viewing in Google Chrome so that your browser can translate it for you. Click the **Translate** icon at the top right of your browser's URL bar and select **Translate**. Alternatively, you can view the [directions in Portuguese](https://support.wix.com/pt/article/atualizando-informa%C3%A7%C3%B5es-de-contato-para-dom%C3%ADnios-combr).

2. Enter your username and password and click **ACCESS** to login. 
   **Note:** If you don't know your username, click **Do not remember**. Then enter your domain admin email, first name, and last name and click **SEARCH**. If you don't know your password, click **I don't remember or I don't have the password** to have password reset directions emailed to your domain's contact email.

3. Click **My data** at the top right.

4. Update the domain's contact info and click **TO SAVE**.

Once you've updated your contact info, you'll receive a confirmation email from hostmaster@registro.br.

## Step 2 | Change the Contact Information Wix has for Your Domain

Send an email or forward your confirmation email from Registro.br to **support@wix.com**. Make sure to include the following: 
* Your domain name.
* Which contact fields you've changed. Specify if you've changed them for your **Administrative** contact, your **Technical** contact, or both.

Once Wix receives your domain's updated contact info, they will change it in their system's end.

### Notes
* Wix updates your domain's contact information internally. You will not see the updated changes in your Wix account.

question: How do I set up the countdown clock on my Wix site after adding it?

3. Click the **Select countdown type** drop-down and select an option:
   * **Fixed:** Your countdown clock runs once, until a specific date and time. Enter the end date and select your time zone.
   * **Repeats:** Your countdown clock runs multiple times, i.e. every day, week or month. Select when your clock restarts, enter start and end times and select your time zone.
   * **Set per visitor:** Your countdown is specific to the visitor that's seeing it and starts when the visitor lands on the page. Choose the unit of time you want to use and the duration of the countdown.
4. Click the **End Message** tab.
5. Click the **Show message** toggle to enable or disable it:
   * **Enabled:** A message appears to show that the special event or sale has ended. You can click the text box in the app widget to change the text that is displayed.

question: How can I add input elements to allow visitors to filter content in my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Add the [CMS (Content Management System)](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site.
- Connect a [repeater](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-dynamic-content-in-a-repeater), [gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-displaying-collection-content-in-a-pro-gallery), or [table](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-displaying-collection-content-in-a-table) to your CMS collection.

### Step 1 | Add input elements set to filter content: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to the page that includes the repeater, gallery, or table you want visitors to filter.
3. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
4. Click **Input**.
5. Under **Selection**, click the type of input element you want visitors to use to filter content. Choose from the following elements that allow filtering: **Radio Buttons**, **Checkboxes**, **Dropdown**, **Selection Tags**, or **Slider** (Range Sliders only).
6. Click and drag the relevant input element onto the page.
7. (Optional) Repeat steps 3-6 above to add more input elements that your visitors will use to filter the content.

### Step 2 | Connect your input element(s) to the CMS: Wix Editor
1. In your editor, click the input element you just added.
2. Click the **Connect to CMS** icon.
3. Click **Filter content**.
4. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select the same dataset that connects to the repeater, gallery, or table that you want visitors to filter.
5. Click the **Filter content by** drop-down and choose which collection field visitors will use to filter the content that displays.
6. (Optional) Add a condition that affects how the filter works:
   - Click **Advanced Filtering.**
   - Click the **Condition** drop-down and choose an operator that controls how the filter is applied (e.g. **Is not**, **Does not equal**, **Does not include**).
7. Repeat these steps for each input element you want visitors to use to filter content.
8. Click **Preview** to test using your inputs element(s) as filters.
9. Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: How can I view the revenue from different types of subscriptions over the last 12 months in Wix Analytics?
answer:
To view the revenue from different types of subscriptions over the last 12 months in Wix Analytics, go to the **Revenue over the last 12 months** section. This section displays a graph of the total revenue you've received from different types of subscriptions on your site over the last 12 months. You can view revenue for all plans together or click the **All plans** drop-down to filter by a specific plan. The 4 revenue types include:

* **One-time:** Revenue from subscriptions that aren’t recurring (the client pays only once).
* **First recurring:** Revenue from the first payment of a recurring subscription.
* **Recurring:** Revenue from recurring payments (excluding first payment).
* **Expected recurring:** This metric calculates all the payments that you should get from existing subscriptions this month, but have not yet received.

**Important:** This isn’t a prediction based on historical sales, rather a projection of upcoming payments for existing subscriptions. This metric does not include new subscriptions that may be purchased in the future (during this month), and does not consider any possible cancellations.

question: Can I set different availability settings for each appointment service in Wix Bookings?

For example, if a staff member works five days a week, all their associated appointments are available to book for those five days. Creating different availability settings for different appointment types would offer more flexibility to your overall business operations. For example, you could offer one appointment type only on weekends, and another type only in the afternoons on weekdays.

     + Select the page from the **Select Page** drop-down menu.
     + Select the location on the page from the **Where on Page** drop-down menu.

     + Enter your PayPal email address.

question: How can I choose a Custom layout for my Wix Pro Gallery and what options are available for customization?
answer:
To choose a Custom layout for your Wix Pro Gallery, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the Pro Gallery element on your page.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click the **Layout** tab.
5. Select a layout for your gallery.
6. Click **Customize Layout** to change the layout to look exactly as you want.

### Customization Options:
- **Collage**: Show images of different orientations placed randomly. Options include scroll direction, gallery orientation, automatic sliding, thumbnail size, spacing, collage density, and how many images load.
- **Masonry**: Display images in columns or rows. Options include gallery orientation, thumbnail size, spacing, design settings, images per row, and load more button.
- **Grid**: Show images within a grid. Options include scroll direction, thumbnail resize, image ratio, automatic sliding, fit to screen, items per row, thumbnail size, image per column, spacing, and load more button.
- **Thumbnails**: Show multiple thumbnails next to the selected image. Options include gallery ratio, thumbnail resize, thumbnail placement, thumbnail size, loop images, automatic sliding, and thumbnail spacing.
- **Slider**: Show multiple images with a horizontal scroll. Options include gallery ratio, thumbnail resize, image ratio, loop images, automatic sliding, and spacing.
- **Slide Show**: Show one image at a time with horizontal scroll. Options include gallery ratio, thumbnail resize, loop images, automatic sliding, play button, pause on hover, and info bar size.
- **Strip**: Show multiple images in one column. Options include spacing, load more button, and how many images load.
- **Column**: Show multiple images at a time in one row. Options include gallery ratio, loop images, automatic sliding, and spacing.
- **Bricks, Mix, and Alternate**: Display gallery items of different sizes and orientation side by side. Options include spacing, load more button, and how many images load.
- **Magic**: Change the layout to another one in one click by selecting **Create Magic Layout**.

question: How can I delete my workspace in Wix Studio?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you are the owner of the workspace and have completed the removal of all Premium plans, services, and domains.

To delete your workspace in Wix Studio, follow these steps:

1. **Remove all Premium plans and services from your workspace**:
   - Cancel each service that you have in your workspace (e.g., Premium plan, domain, mailbox, app) separately.
     1. [Go to Premium Subscriptions in your workspace](https://www.wix.com/account/subscriptions?originWidgetName=billings).
     2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant subscription.
     3. Click **Cancel Plan**/**Domain**/**Mailbox**/**App**.

2. **Remove any additional domains from your workspace**:
   - If you purchased a domain from Wix, you should cancel or transfer it. If you connected an external domain, follow these steps:
     1. [Go to Domains in your workspace](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains).
     2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant domain.
     3. Click **Remove from Wix**.

3. **Move sites to Trash**:
   - Move any remaining sites in your workspace to Trash.
     1. [Go to Sites in your workspace](https://manage.wix.com/studio/sites?referralInfo=sidebar&viewId=all-items-view).
     2. Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant site.
     3. Click **Move to trash**.
     4. Click **Move to Trash** to confirm.
     5. Repeat for all remaining sites in your account.

4. **Delete your workspace**:
   - Once you've moved your remaining sites to the trash, canceled all existing Premium services and domains, you can delete your workspace.

**Important Notes**:
- When you delete a workspace in Wix Studio, it permanently deletes all projects, settings, and data associated with that workspace.
- If you only belong to one workspace and you delete it, you will also close your Wix account entirely.
- There is no way to recover a workspace after you delete it.
- You can only delete a workspace if you're the owner of it.

question: What are the requirements for setting up an individual Wix Payments account?
answer:
Before creating a Wix Payments individual account, make sure you meet the following requirements:

* **Acceptable identification**: A valid (non-expired) driver's license, government issued ID card or passport.
* **Address:** You need to provide a physical address. PO boxes are not accepted.
* **Business description:** Include a brief description of your business, stating the type of products or services you sell and their prices. For more information, see our [best practices for merchants](https://support.wix.com/en/article/best-practices-for-merchants-using-wix-payments).
* **Bank account details:** The name of the bank account holder needs to match the personal details provided for the Wix Payments account. Please note that only a personal bank account can be used.

question: Can I show a subpage menu under the More item in Wix Editor?

question: Can I use Wix Multilingual to translate Facebook ads for my Wix site?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to translate Facebook ads with Wix Multilingual. When creating a Facebook ads campaign for your Wix site, you can [write the content of the ad caption and headline](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-creating-a-new-campaign#step-2-customize-your-ad-content) in whatever language you prefer and this will be displayed to the viewer of the ad. For dynamic ads that display store products, product names and descriptions are synced from your Wix store based on the main language of your site. Translations using Wix Multilingual do not sync with your ad campaign. Viewers of the ad only see product names and descriptions in your site's main language.

question: How can I send my email marketing campaign using the Wix app?

question: How can I preview my site in different screen sizes using Editor X?
answer:
To preview your site in different screen sizes using Editor X, you can use the following methods:

### Dragging the handles on the Canvas

1. Drag the handles on the sides of the page to increase or decrease the width and see how your elements are arranged. This is especially useful when you need to check elements with [fluid measurements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-setting-the-size-of-your-element) (e.g., vh, vw, %).

### Clicking the Preview button

1. Click **Preview** at the top right of the Editor.
2. View your site in different screen sizes by doing the following:
   * Click the drop-down menu at the top to select a device.
   * Drag the handles to increase or decrease the width.
   * Define the width and height of the screen in pixels.
3. Click **Edit Site** to continue editing, or **Publish** to make your changes live.

### Tip
You can also [add custom breakpoints](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-managing-breakpoints) to edit your site for a specific screen size.

question: How can I troubleshoot my cash drawer on Wix Retail POS if it's not operating correctly?
answer:
To troubleshoot the cash drawer on Wix Retail POS, follow these steps:

1. Disconnect the cash drawer from the receipt printer.
2. Wait a few minutes.
3. Reconnect the cash drawer to the receipt printer.
4. Tap **Checkout** on the bottom bar.
5. Select **Actions** and then **Open Drawer w/o Sale** to open it manually.
6. If the cash drawer is still not working, restart the tablet.

If the problem persists, contact [Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact).

question: How can I create an IP Allowlisting rule using the Wix enterprise solution?

question: How can I create a custom CMS role with specific permissions for my team in Wix?
answer:
To create a custom CMS role in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Roles & Permissions](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20this%20Site&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/manage-website/authorization) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage Roles** at the top.
3. Click **+ Create New Role**.
4. Enter the **Role Title** and **Description** in the relevant fields.
5. Click **CMS** in the **Permissions** section.
6. Select the checkboxes next to the permissions you want to assign to the role:
   
   * **View Content:** Can view content in collections but cannot edit the content.
   * **Add Content:** Can add and edit content in existing collections.
   * **Manage Backups:** Can add, restore and delete backups for all collections.
   * **Manage Indexes:** Can add and delete indexes for all collections.
   * **Manage Collections:** Can create new collections, delete collections, and add, delete, or edit fields in collections.
7. (Optional) Select more permissions from other areas (e.g. Editor, Sites, Stores) to add them to the role.
8. Click **Save**.

question: How can I customize the header of my site on the Wix member apps using the dashboard?

4. Click the **Icons** drop-down to add quick actions to your header and all screens. The icons displayed in the panel depend on the Wix apps you added to your site (e.g., Wix Stores):
   - **Show shopping cart icon:** Click the toggle to add a shopping cart icon to the header so members can easily navigate to their cart.

   - **Subtitle:** Enter a slogan or a short announcement.
   - **Show logo:** Enable the toggle to display your logo in the header.
   - **Show general info:** Enable the toggle to show a link to a screen with basic information about your business.
6. Click the **Cover photo** drop-down to upload a cover photo for your site.
7. Click the **Members info** drop-down to choose what member information you want to show in the header:
   - **Show member count:** Click the toggle to show or hide the number of members in your app's header.

8. Click the **Action buttons** drop-down to add buttons to your header:
   - **Show Invite Button:** Click the toggle to show or hide a button that allows members to invite more people to your app.
   - **Show Custom Button:** Click the toggle to add a custom button to your header. For example, a 'Send Us a Message' button can send members to chat with you in real-time.
9. Click **Save & Publish**.

question: How can members view their notifications on the Wix member apps?

question: How can I change the business location for accepting payments on my Wix site?
answer:
To change the business location for accepting payments on your Wix site, you can follow these steps:

### Changing your site's general information details
1. Go to the [Business Info](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Business%20Info&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fsettings%2Fbusiness-info%2F) section of **Settings** in your site's dashboard.

3. Enable **My business has a physical address.**

**Note:** This will not change the current payment setup, but all the further actions on the Accept Payments tab will be performed in accordance with the location chosen. question: How can I change the email address my Wix Chat notifications go to?
answer:
Email notifications are automatically sent to the email address you used when signing up for your Wix account. If you want email notifications to go to a different email address, such as your business email address, you can add it as a site collaborator. **Note:** Any new email address you'd like to add as a site collaborator must have a separate Wix account. 

**To add your business email as a site collaborator:**

1. [Go to Inbox](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Inbox&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/inbox/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Settings** drop-down at the top right.
3. Click **Notifications**.
4. (Optional) Click the **Email notifications** toggle to disable email notifications if you no longer want to receive email notifications to your main account email.
5. Click the **Profile & team** tab.
6. Click **+ Invite People** next to **Your team**.
7. Enter a business email or an alternative email where you want to receive chat and inbox notifications.
8. Click **Send Invite**.
9. Go to the new email's inbox and click **Accept Now** in the email.
10. Log in to the Wix account that's associated with the new email address and click **Accept**.
11. The new email address is automatically assigned a Back Office Manager role and appears in the **Your team** list. Click the toggle under **Email notifications** to turn on email notifications for this email.

question: How can I create an email campaign to promote my music using Wix Music?

question: How can I set up a loyalty program for my Wix store to increase customer retention?
answer:
To set up a loyalty program for your Wix store, follow these steps:

1. **Create a loyalty program**: Customize it to reflect your store's personality by choosing a program name, a name for your points, and an icon that represents your brand.
2. **Define actions and rewards**: Decide which actions customers take to earn points, how many points they get per action, and what the rewards are. For example, customers can get points every time they perform set actions, such as buying $50 worth of items.
3. **Redeem points**: When customers have accumulated enough points, they can redeem them using coupons.

Learn how to [create your own loyalty program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-loyalty-program-adding-and-setting-up-your-loyalty-program).

question: How can I add a preset click or hover interaction to an element in the Studio Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have selected the element that will trigger the interaction.

To add a preset click or hover interaction to an element in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add a trigger (Click or Hover)
1. Select the element that should trigger the interaction.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2023/06/14/2dd40586-1f79-4376-aee0-387212a246bb/dfed4075-2e24-4ad8-a7c4-8857038d5f16.png) at the top right of the editor.
3. Click the **Animations and Effects** tab ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2021/11/25/7d8bb681-6024-4951-86e9-c1201cd53273/97dcf9c3-7477-45d8-a7a5-a3bfdef51c56.png).
4. Select **Hover** / **Click**.
5. Click **+ Add**.

### Step 2 | Set up the interaction
1. (In the Setup panel) Choose what happens **On Hover** / **On Click**:
   * **Start Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element triggers the chosen animation.
   * **Reset Animation:** Clicking / Hovering over the element removes any animation that was previously applied.
   * **Toggle On/Off:** Clicking the element triggers the animation and a second click removes it. 
   
   **Note:** This option is only available for click interactions.
2. Select the **Animated element**:
   * **Make the element trigger its own animation:** Click the element's name (the word **(self)** appears next to it).
   * **Animate a different element on the page:** Select an element from the drop-down, or click **Choose on Canvas** to select it on the page.
   
   **Tip:** Hold the **Cmd** / **Ctrl** key to select a child element.
3. Select an animation:
   1. Click the **Presets** tab.
   2. Choose an animation from the list.

### Step 3 | (Optional) Adjust the animation
1. (In the Inspector) Click **Adjust Animation** at the bottom.
2. Customize the available settings to your liking:
   * **Delay:** Drag the slider to add a delay (in seconds) before the animation starts.
   * **Duration:** Drag the slider to set the duration of the animation (in seconds).
   * **Easing:** Choose how the animation eases in and out from the drop-down.
   * **Scale:** Choose how much the element grows or shrinks.
   * **Angle:** Change the angle of movement.
   * **Distance:** Make the element move farther from, or closer to, its default position on the page.
   * **Direction:** Change the direction the element rotates in.
3. (Optional) Click **Preview** to see how the animation looks and make adjustments, if needed.

question: Can I customize the 'Go to Link' text in all galleries on Wix Editor?
answer: Currently, you can edit the 'Go to Link' text only on the Pro Gallery. For more information, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pro-gallery-adding-a-link-to-a-gallery-item).

question: How can I make bulk updates to product prices in my Wix store's dashboard?
answer:
To change the base price of products in your Wix store's dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Store Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the products you want to change:
   * **All products:** Select the checkbox at the top left.
   * **Individual products:** Select the checkboxes next to the relevant products.
   * **Category:** Click **Filter** and select 1 or more categories.
3. Click **More Actions.**
4. Select **Change Price**.
5. Select an option from the **What change would you like to make?** drop-down.
6. Enter the amount, price, or percentage.
7. Click **Change Prices**.

**Note:** When you change the base price of a product, other prices change accordingly. For example, if a product has a sale price of $10 off the regular (base) price, the $10 will come off the new price. Learn how [changing the base price affects product variant with different prices and subscriptions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-the-price-of-multiple-products-at-once#when-variants-have-a-price-difference).

question: What are the benefits of choosing a classic ad format for my Facebook Ads campaign?
answer:
**The benefits of choosing a classic ad:**

* **Fully customizable**: Choose the ad's image, caption, headline and call-to-action to drive potential customers to a specific place.
* **Video capabilities:** With classic ads, you can choose to upload a video to make your product or service come to life in the ad.
* **More focused creative:** Since you get more control over the messaging, you can use a classic ad to drive potential customers to a specific sale or place on your site (like a landing page or one-off page) rather than a product page.

### Tip
Learn more about the [best practices for creating classic ads](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-best-practices-for-creating-image-and-video-ads).

question: How can I edit an existing pricing plan on my Wix site?
answer:
To edit a pricing plan on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Pricing Plans](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Pricing%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/membership/) tab in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the plan you want to edit.
3. Make any of the following changes:
   
   * **Edit the plan details:** You can update or customize the **Plan name**, **Image** and **Description** at any time.
   * **Edit the services and content included:** Select only the relevant checkboxes in the **Benefits** section for services and content you want to include. You can also remove existing or outdated benefits that you no longer offer. Learn more about [connecting a plan to content and services](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-connecting-a-plan-to-content-and-services).
   * **Edit the plan's price:** Enter a new price under **Pricing options**, you can also choose a new payment frequency, length of plan etc using the available options. Learn more about [creating a one-time payment plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-one-time-payment-plan) or [creating a recurring payment plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-creating-a-recurring-payment-plan).
   * **Update the plan policy:** Click add or edit next to **Add a policy** under Settings.
4. Click **Save**.

question: How can I handle reported posts in Wix Forum?
answer:
When a forum reader reports content they find offensive or think is spam, you receive a notification of this report. You can then review the report and decide if you want to take action. It's important to note that members can only report other members' posts, comments, and replies. Posts, comments, and replies created by Admins and Moderators cannot be reported. 

For more detailed actions, you can refer to the following resources:

- To learn how to delete a post, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forum-deleting-posts).
- To learn how to block or delete a site member, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forum-blocking-or-deleting-site-members).

question: How can I add recipients to my email campaign in Wix?
answer:
To add recipients to your email campaign in Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Create an email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-and-sending-a-campaign-from-start-to-finish) or [edit an existing one](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-managing-your-campaign).
2. [Customize the elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-elements-to-your-email-campaign) in your campaign to your liking.

   **Tip:** [Preview and test your email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-email-campaign#sending-a-test-email-before-sending-your-campaign) to make sure it is perfect before you add recipients and send.
3. Click **Next**.
4. (Optional) [Import contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-contacts-importing-contacts-from-a-gmail-account) from a CSV file or your Gmail account:
   
   1. Click **Import Contacts** at the bottom right.
   2. Click **Import Contacts** in the popup to confirm.
   3. Choose between **CSV file** or **Gmail account** and follow the steps on-screen.
   4. When ready, click **Back to email marketing** at the top.
5. Select who you want to send this email to:
   
   * **Target group:** Select specific groups of contacts to receive your campaign. You can include all subscribers, specific [segments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-campaign-to-a-segment) or [labels](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-contact-labels), or select individual contacts.
   * **All Contacts:** All contacts on your list will receive your campaign.
6. Click **Next** at the top right.
7. [Send your email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-sending-your-email-campaign).

**Note:** You can enable the **Filter out inactive contacts** toggle to remove [inactive contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-about-active-and-inactive-contacts) from your list. **We do not recommend sending campaigns to inactive contacts** as this can increase your bounce rate, cause emails to be marked as spam, and decrease your [email deliverability](https://support.wix.com/en/article/increasing-your-mail-deliverability).

question: How can I freeze the mobile menu on my Wix site to keep it visible while scrolling?
answer:
To freeze your mobile menu on your Wix site, follow these steps:

question: How can I update the keywords in my Wix SEO Setup Checklist?

question: Can I change the alignment of my restaurant menu in Wix Restaurants?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to change the alignment of your restaurant menu (e.g., right-to-left), for either the Menus app or the Orders app.

question: Can I add optional extra benefits to a Pricing Plan and let customers choose if they want them?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to add optional extra benefits to a Pricing Plan (either free or paid) and allow customers to choose if they want to include them.

question: Can I add my own help articles to my Wix Blocks app so they open when a user clicks the ? icon in the action bar?

question: How can I add dish options to my menu in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
To add dish options to your menu in Wix Restaurants, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your dashboard.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-sites-dashboard)
2. Click the **Menus** tab.
3. Do one of the following:
   * **Edit a dish:**
     1. Navigate to the dish you want to add options to.
     2. Click to edit it.
   * **Create a new dish:**
     1. Click **New Dish**.
     2. Enter the dish details.
4. In the **Dish Options** section, click **New Option**.
5. In the **Name** field on the left, enter a name for this option (e.g. Toppings, Temperature, Hold the...).
6. Under **Type**, select **Selection**, **Extras**, or **Deselection**.
7. Under **Choices**, enter the first choice (e.g. Pineapple, Rare, Sauce) or select it from the list of existing choices.
8. (Optional) Enter a price for the choice.
9. (Optional) Click **New Choice** and repeat steps 7 - 8 to add additional options.
10. Click **Save**.

### Note
If you add "single choice selection" dish options, the price displayed on the online ordering page will always follow this formula: "base price + cheapest single choice available". If you'd like to add a single choice dish option that will not increase the cost of the dish, then simply set it to $0.00.

question: Can customers place an order to an address that can't be found on the Wix Restaurants map?
answer: Currently, when a customer places an order in your online ordering system, they are required to enter their address. Wix Restaurants then checks that the address exists and is located in one of your delivery areas. Therefore customers cannot enter an address which cannot be found on the Wix Restaurants map.

question: Can I embed Vimeo videos in my Wix Portfolio?
answer: Yes, you can now [embed Vimeo videos in your Wix Portfolio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-portfolio-adding-media-to-projects#embedding-videos-by-url).

question: How can I schedule a discount for my products using the Wix Store Scheduler app?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have added the Wix Store Scheduler app to your site.

### To schedule a discount:

question: How can I delete an image from my Wix site using the Wix Editor?

question: How can I block or delete a site member from the Member List on my Wix site?

question: Can I change the order in which elements load on my site or enable specific elements to be pre-loaded?

question: Can I connect the slideshow element to a dataset in the Wix Editor?
answer:
Currently, in the Wix Editor, it is not possible to connect the slideshow element to a dataset. This would allow you to display details about a different CMS (Content Management System) collection item on each slide of your slideshow.

### Workarounds
* In the Studio Editor, you can connect slideshows to datasets to show a different collection item in each slide. You can build your site in [the Studio Editor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-studio-about-the-studio-editor) if you would like this capability.
* You can [connect supported elements](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-elements-and-the-collection-fields-they-can-connect-to) that are attached to your slideshow slides to a dataset to show CMS content for a single item. This does not allow you to show a different item on each slide, however, you can connect the elements on each slide to different collection fields to show different details about a single item on each slide.

question: How can I manually schedule an appointment in Wix Bookings and handle payment collection?
answer:
To manually add an appointment in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Business%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add**, or select a time slot on the calendar.
3. Select **Appointment**.
4. Enter the client details.
5. Click to select the relevant service.
6. Enter the date, arrival time, and location for the service.
7. (Optional) Click to select the **Repeats** checkbox if you want to create a recurring appointment:
   - Select how frequently the recurring appointments take place from the **Repeats** drop-down.
   - Select the number of times the appointments repeat from the **For** drop-down.
8. Click the relevant option to choose what you want to do:
   
   **Book**
   - Choose this option to complete the booking now, and collect payment later using the Booking Calendar.
   
   **Book & Collect Payment**
   - Choose this option if you want to take payment immediately or if you want to send an invoice right away.
   
   **To collect payment:**
   - **Charge with pay link:** Choose this option to [create a payment link](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-pay-links-creating-and-managing-pay-links) you can send to your client. Then fill out the details:
     1. **Link name:** Enter a name for your pay link.
     2. **Price:** Enter the amount of money your pay link will charge your customer.
     3. **Description:** Enter a description for your pay link. This should clearly summarize the reason for payment.
     4. **Open Settings:** Click to expand the setting panel. Then choose what you want to do:
        - **Set an expiration date:**
          1. Click to enable the **Set an expiration date** toggle.
          2. Click to set the expiration date.
        - **Limit the number of payments:**
          1. Click to enable the **Limit the number of payments** toggle.
          2. Enter the relevant number of payments.
     5. Click **Create Link**.
   - **Charge card manually:** Choose this option if the client wants you to charge their credit card manually.
     1. Enter the client's credit card details, including their Zip or postal code.
     2. (Optional) Click to select the charge custom amount checkbox. This is useful if your client wants to make partial payments.
        - Enter the amount you want to charge.
        
        **Note:** The remaining balance appears next to **Amount due**.
     3. (Optional) Click to select the Save this card to the customer's file checkbox.
        
        **Important:** Make sure you get your client's consent before saving their credit card details.
     4. Click **Charge**.
   - **Charge with invoice:** Choose this option to [send your client an invoice for the order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-sending-an-invoice).
     1. Click **Create Invoice.**
     2. Choose what you want to do next:
        - **Print:** Print out the invoice if your client requires a physical copy.
        - **Share Link:** Create a shareable link that you can send via email, social media, or messenger app.
          1. Click to create a link to the invoice.
          2. Click **Copy Link**.
          3. Click **Done**.
          
          **Note:** When you create the link to the invoice, it automatically marks the invoice as **Sent**.
        - **Send via Email:** Send the client their invoice via email.
          1. Click to edit the **subject line**.
          2. Click to edit the **message** you send in the email.
          3. Click **Send**.
   - **Mark as paid:** Choose this option to mark the order as paid.
     1. Click **Mark as Paid** to confirm. **Note:** You cannot undo this action.
     2. (Optional) Click the **Mark a custom amount as paid** checkbox to allow for partial payments.
        - Enter the partial payment in the field.
        - Click **Mark \[amount] as paid**. **Note:** You cannot undo this action.

### Tips
- A notification appears if:
  - You are scheduling the appointment outside working hours.
  - You haven't assigned a staff member to the service.
  - There’s another appointment booked at that time.

You can still go ahead with the booking; this is just to help prevent double bookings. If you’re booking a [recurring session](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-scheduling-recurring-appointments), any conflicts appear on the schedule summary page.

- To schedule a similar session for the same client, select the relevant appointment on the calendar, then click **Book Again**. Fill in the appointment details to finalize the new booking.

question: How can I use text operators in the new automation builder to send a coupon only after an order is paid?
answer:
To use text operators in the new automation builder to send a coupon only after an order is paid, follow these steps:

1. **Create an Automation**: Start by creating an automation that triggers when an order is placed.
2. **Add a Condition**: Add a text operator condition to check the payment status of the order.
3. **Specify the Condition**: Set the condition to check if the payment status is 'PAID'.
4. **Define the Action**: In the **THEN** path, define the action to send a coupon if the condition is met.

**Important Notes**:
- The value must be 'PAID' or 'UNPAID' written in English, even for sites in other languages.
- This will only work for payments made online.

question: What is the difference between contacts and subscribers in Wix, and how can I find my subscribers?
answer:
In Wix, **Contacts** are:

- Anyone who has contacted you through your site (e.g., through a contact form).
- Anyone who you manually added to your contacts.
- Any contact lists that you've imported to your contacts.

**Subscribers** are:

- Anyone who subscribed to your newsletter (e.g., through the [Get Subscribers form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-subscribe-form)).
- Anyone who has actively agreed to receive newsletters or updates from your site.

To find your subscribers, go to [Contacts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-contacts-managing-your-contact-list) and look in the **Subscribers** folder on the left.

question: How can I customize the chat icon on my mobile site when Wix Chat is the only action in the Quick Action Bar?

question: How can I connect CoinGate as a payment provider for cryptocurrency payments on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect CoinGate as a payment provider for cryptocurrency payments on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **Connect** beside CoinGate.
4. Depending on whether you are creating a new CoinGate account or have an existing account, follow the instructions:

   **Have an account**
   1. Enter your Api App Token.
   2. Click **Connect**.

   **Don't have an account**
   1. Click [**Create CoinGate account**](https://dashboard.coingate.com/register).

Ensure that the currency used in your Wix account matches the currency in your CoinGate account to avoid transaction declines. Learn how to [change your currency](https://support.wix.com/en/article/setting-your-currency-for-accepting-payments).

question: How can I resolve the issue of text appearing as two lines on my Wix site when viewed on an iPad or tablet?
answer:
To resolve the issue of text appearing as two lines on your Wix site when viewed on an iPad or tablet, follow these steps:

1. **Remove formatting from the text:**
   - Copy and paste the text into Notepad (TextEdit on Mac).
   - Paste the text into a [new text box](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-editing-text) by pressing **Ctrl** + **Shift** + **V** (or **Cmd** + **Shift** + **V** on Mac) on your keyboard.
   - (If necessary) [Format your text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-formatting-your-text) using the options in the **Text Settings** panel.

2. In your Editor, expand the width of your text box slightly so that there is room for your text to widen without it appearing on the next line.

3. [Publish your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-publishing-your-site).

4. [Clear your browser's cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-clearing-your-browsers-cache-on-a-mobile-device).

5. View your live site to make sure the text appears correctly.

question: What are the supported file types and size limits for uploading images to a Wix site?
answer:
For site images, Wix supports the following file types: JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, WEBP, JPEG 2000, and RAW. The supported JPEG 2000 file formats include .jp2, .jpg2, .j2k, .jpf, .jpm, .j2c, .jpc, .jpx, and the supported RAW file formats include .arw, .srw, .nef, .cr2, .cr3, .crw, .rwl, .rw2, .raw, .raf, .pef, .orf, .mrw, .dng, .sr2, .srf, .kdc, .k25, .dcr, .x3f, .erf, .3fr. Animated WEBP images are currently not supported and convert to static images.

The file size limits for images are 25MB, and for GIFs, it is 15MB.

For background images, the supported file types are JPG, PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPE, JFIF, BMP, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF, TIF, and WEBP, with a recommended file size of at least 3000 x 3000px.

question: How can I add hashtags to my Wix Forum posts?
answer: To add hashtags to your Wix Forum posts, simply write the hashtag symbol (#) followed by the text, with no spaces between them, and then publish your post. This will help readers find posts related to the topics they're interested in.

question: Can site members sign up and log in using a phone number or username instead of an email address?
answer:
Currently, when a visitor signs up or logs in as a member to your site, they enter an email address. It is not possible to let them sign up or log in using other identifying information such as a phone number or username.

### Tip
Your site visitors can sign up with social logins (e.g. Google or Facebook account) if they don't want to use an email address and password.

question: How can I enable Single Sign-On (SSO) login for my organization using Wix?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have completed the setup of your Identity Provider (IdP) settings and have the necessary information such as Client ID, Client Secret, and Config URL.

To enable SSO login and set it as required:

1. Click the **Enable SSO** toggle to enable or disable SSO login:
   * **Enabled:** Your users can sign in to their Wix account using SSO or other methods such as an email address and password.
   * **Disabled:** Your users cannot sign in using SSO. They can still sign in using other methods.
2. Click the **Set SSO as required** toggle to choose whether or not you want to require your users to sign in by SSO.
   * **Enabled:** Users can only sign in with SSO. They cannot sign in using other methods such as an email and password. Account owners can still sign in using other methods.
   * **Disabled:** Users can sign in using SSO or other methods.

**Important:** Wix recommends that you manually test your SSO settings before setting SSO as required.

3. Click **Save Changes**.

question: Why can't I publish updates to Velo SPIs from my site collaborator account?

question: How can I send a test email campaign to see how it looks in a live inbox?

question: How can I create bulk coupons using the Bulk Coupon Creator app on my Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have added Wix Stores, Wix Bookings, or Wix Events to your site and created a single coupon.

To create bulk coupons using the Bulk Coupon Creator app, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Bulk Coupon Creator](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/app/08973bdf-f3a5-476e-aab1-4eeb5db12795?&title=Select%20a%20Site&buttonText=Manage+Coupons) in your site's dashboard.
2. Under **Choose a coupon to duplicate**, enter the name of the coupon you created and select it.

### Use Wix's blank CSV template
1. Click **Wix’s blank CSV template** to download the template file.
2. Open the file.
3. Replace the sample coupon codes in column A with the codes you want to use.
4. Save or download the file as a CSV file.
5. Upload the CSV file:
   1. Click **+Upload CSV File**.
   2. Select the file from your computer and click **Open**.
   3. Click **Create Coupon**.
6. Click **Got It** once the coupons are created.

### Use Wix's code generator tool
1. Click **Code generator tool**.
2. Enter the number of codes you want to create (up to 1000).
3. Enter the number of characters in your code (up to 20).
   
   **Note:** This does not include the characters in the prefix.
4. (Optional) Enter a prefix to your codes (e.g. Summer Sale).
5. Click **Generate**.
6. Click **Download CSV**.
   
   **Note:** This automatically uploads the generated codes.
7. Click **Create Coupon**.
8. Click **Got It** once the coupons are created.

question: How can I edit the details of an order in Wix Stores?
answer:
To edit order details in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Orders](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Orders&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/orders) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant order.
3. Click **More Actions**.
4. Select **Edit order**.
5. Choose what you want to edit:

### Add an item
You can add additional items to an order that a customer placed. 
1. Click **Add Item**.
2. Select what you want to add:
   * **Product:**
     1. Select the store product you want to add.
     2. (For products with variants) Click **Continue** and select product option(s).
   * **Service** (appointments only):
     1. Select the Wix Bookings appointment you want to add and click **Continue**.
     2. Select the location, day, and time.
   * **Menu item:**
     1. Select the restaurant item you want to add.
     2. If relevant, select modifiers.
3. Click **Add to Order**.
4. (Optional) Enter a note about why you changed the order under **Reason for editing**. This isn't visible to customers.
5. Click **Update Order**.
6. (Optional) Select the **Email the customer about changes made to this order** checkbox.
7. Click **Update Order** to confirm.

### Remove an item
You can remove the following from an order:
* Store products that haven't yet been fulfilled.
* Wix Bookings services that haven't already taken place.
* Restaurant items that haven't been delivered.

If it's too late to remove an item, you can [refund all or part of the order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/refunding-customers).

**To remove an item from the order:**
1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant item.
2. Select **Remove**.
3. (Store orders only) Deselect the **Update inventory** checkbox.
4. Click **Update Order**.
5. (Optional) Select the **Email customer about changes made to this order** checkbox.
6. Click **Update Order** to confirm.

### Change an item variant
If your customer bought a particular variant of a product or menu item but wants to change the variant, you can remove the item and add it again with the correct variant, using the instructions above.

### Add a custom item
You can add any item to an order as a custom item.
1. Click **Add Item**.
2. Select **\+Add Custom Item**.
3. Enter a title to explain what the item is.
4. Enter the price.
5. (Optional) Enter additional info about the order (e.g. item size). **Note:** This is visible to customers.
6. Click **Add to Order**.
7. (Optional) Enter a note about why you edited the order. This isn't visible to customers.
8. Click **Update Order**.
9. (Optional) Select the **Email the customer about changes made to this order** checkbox.
10. Click **Update Order** to confirm.

### Edit the price of an item
You can increase or decrease the price of an item in an order if you need to make a change. After you do so, you can bill your customer for the additional charge or give them a partial refund for the order.

**To edit the price of an item:**
1. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant item.
2. Select **Edit price**.
3. Enter a new price and click **Apply**.
4. Click **Update Order**.
5. Click **Update Order** to confirm.

### Add a fee, tip, or discount
You can add an extra charge to an order when a customer wants to leave a tip or, for example, to charge for gift wrapping. In addition, you have the flexibility to offer your customer a discount even though they already placed the order.

**To add a fee or tip:**
1. Click **Add Fees & Tips** on the right.
2. Enter the name (e.g. gift wrapping).
3. Enter the amount.
4. Click **Add**.

**To add a discount:**
1. Click **Add Discount** on the right.
2. Enter the discount reason (e.g. employee discount).
3. Enter the amount.
4. Click **Add Discount**.

question: How do I add and set up a PayPal Buy Now button in Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have a PayPal Business or Premier account.

### Step 1 | Add a Buy Now button
To add a Buy Now button to your site:
1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/RXtvBVeNsPkYLfP5LwOQR3bSpZaDdyNQdCx2BvWdMSPzKNPHo3-vCjRGXOBN1Yy9rvI-pjTKnSr_eWVYfs_vM_iRvQy4sm-Qfj1yuUckVToFDoSeDVqFaZfvq41-sn3wW5Kao-B5WAjj_HGZFpN-RQ) in your Editor.
2. Click **Button**.
3. Click **PayPal Buttons**.
4. Click and drag the Buy Now button to add it to your site.

### Step 2 | Set up your button
To set up your PayPal Buy Now button:
1. Click the PayPal button in the Editor.
2. Click **Add PayPal Info**.
3. Select **Selling** under **What's this button for?**.
4. Set up the buttons with the below options:
   
   1. **What's your PayPal email?:** Enter the email address you want to link into the field.
   2. **What's the product's name?:** Enter the name of the product or item into the field.

You do not get notifications on your Wix account for purchases made through PayPal buttons. This is because the payments are made to the PayPal account, and not your Wix account.

question: How can I create an event schedule in Wix Events?

Guests can filter the schedule to locate the content they're interested in. After you create a tag, apply it to other items of the same type.

   6. Click **Add**.
7. Repeat steps 5 and 6 to add additional items to the schedule.

question: How can I create a price quote using Wix?
answer:
To create a price quote using Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Price Quotes](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Price%20Quotes&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/price-quotes) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **\+ New Quote** at the top right.
3. Provide or confirm your basic business info, as you want it to appear on your price quotes:
   * **Business Name:** Enter the name of your business.
   * **Business email address:** Enter your business email address.
   * (Optional) **Your logo:** Upload your business logo.
   * **Automatically create invoices for accepted price quotes:** Enable this toggle to [automatically convert price quotes into invoices](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-price-quotes-converting-price-quotes-into-invoices).
4. Click **Create Price Quote**.
5. Enter the **Quote Info** for this price quote:
   * **Title:** Enter a title to clearly summarize the reason for payment.
   * **Customer:** Click the drop-down to select a contact from your Contact List.
   * **Expiration Date:** Select the date this quote expires.
   * **Payment Terms:** Click the drop-down and select an option:
     + **Due on Receipt:** Customers are required to pay once the product/service is received/complete.
     + **Net \+ 15:** Payment to be made within 15 days of product/service receipt/completion.
     + **Net \+ 30:** Payment to be made within 30 days of product/service receipt/completion.
     + **Net \+ 60:** Payment to be made within 60 days of product/service receipt/completion.
6. Enter the **Quote Details** (product/service details) for this invoice:
   * **Enter item here:** Click the drop-down and select the relevant product or service. 
     **Tip:** Select **\+ Add Item** if you need to create a price quote for a new item. Then enter the details and click **Save**.
   * (Optional) **Enter a description:** Provide a description relating to the product/service.
   * **Price:** Enter the price per unit.
   * **Quantity:** Enter the quantity of the product or service.
   * (Optional) **Tax 1 / Tax 2:** Click the drop-downs to apply one or two tax rates. 
     **Note:** Click **\+ Add Tax** to create a new tax rate.
   * (Optional) **Discount:** Enter a figure next to **Discount** to apply a percentage discount to the total amount.
   * (Optional) Click **\+ Add Line Item** to add another product or service, then repeat these steps.
7. (Optional) Enter the **Additional info** details for this price quote:
   * **Notes:** Enter any notes you'd like your customer to be aware of.
   * **Terms:** Enter any terms that apply to this price quote.
8. Choose to save or send your price quote:
   * **Save:** Click **Save as Draft** at the top right to save the price quote to send at a later time.
   * **Send:** Click **Preview \& Share** at the top right to first view a preview of your quote. Then click **Send** to review or edit the content of the email your customer will receive. Click **Send** again when you're ready to send the price quote.

**Tip:** If you have Wix Chat installed on your site, a chatbox will appear on your quote. When your customer receives your quote, they can use the chatbox to discuss projects and services, and negotiate with you in real-time. Learn more about [Wix Chat](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-chat-an-overview).

question: How can I customize the login settings in the Wix File Share App to control who can access my shared files?

9. Click the **Join the community is checked by default** toggle to choose whether or not the "Join the community" checkbox is selected by default.
10. Click the **Policies** tab.
11. Click the **Terms of Use** toggle to enable or disable the Terms of Use link:

question: How can I connect Privat24 as a payment method through Interkassa on my Wix site?
answer:
To connect Privat24 as a payment method through Interkassa on your Wix site, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Accept Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Set%20Up%20Payments&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7b%7bmetaSiteId%7d%7d/payments/) on your site's dashboard.

   **Tip:** Check your business location at the top right. If incorrect, click the drop-down menu to change it.

2. Click **See More Payment Options**.
3. Click **See Options** next to Third-Party Credit / Debit Card Providers.
4. Click **Connect** next to **Privat24**.

Depending on whether you have an existing Interkassa account or need to create a new one, follow the instructions:

### Have an account

**Important:** Check that your Interkassa account is verified before trying to connect it to your site.

1. Retrieve your Interkassa Checkout ID and Checkout Secret (Sign Key):
   
   1. Open a new tab in your browser and log in to your Interkassa account.
   2. Click your username at the top right to open the drop-down menu.
   3. Click **Checkout Mode**.
   4. Click **Edit Checkout**.
   5. Click **Security**.
   6. Click **Sign Key**.
   7. Copy your Checkout ID and the Checkout Secret (Sign Key).

2. Paste the **Checkout ID** and the **Checkout Secret (Sign Key)** into Wix.
3. Click **Connect**.

### Don't have an account

1. Click [**Create Interkassa account**](https://interkassa.com/tarifi).
2. Follow the instructions in Interkassa to create your account. Once verified, you will receive an email from Interkassa with your username and password.
3. Log in to your Interkassa account.
4. Retrieve your Interkassa Checkout ID and Checkout Secret (Sign Key):
   
   1. Click your username at the top right to open the drop-down menu.
   2. Click **Checkout Mode**.
   3. Click **Edit Checkout**.
   4. Click **Security**.
   5. Click **Sign Key**.
   6. Copy your Checkout ID and the Checkout Secret (Sign Key).

5. Go back to your Wix account (repeat steps 1-4).
6. Paste the **Checkout ID** and the **Checkout Secret (Sign Key)** in the pop-up.
7. Click **Connect**.

question: How can I add a Vimeo video to my Wix site using the Single Video Player?
answer:
To add a Vimeo video to your Wix site using the Single Video Player, follow these steps:

### Using Wix Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

3. Click **Video and Music**.
4. Click **Single Video Player**.
5. Click the **Vimeo** option and drag it to the relevant location.
6. Click **Change Video**.
7. Paste the video URL in the **What's the video's web address?** field.
8. **Customize the playback options:**
   * **Autoplays:** Click the toggle to enable or disable it:
     * **Enabled:** The video autoplays on mute. Visitors can turn the sound on manually.
     * **Disabled:** The video does not play automatically.
   * **Plays in a loop:** Enable the toggle to have your video play in a continuous loop.
9. Scroll down, and enter a description of the video in the **What's this video about?** field.

### Using Studio Editor:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

3. Click **Media**.
4. Click **Single Video Players**.
5. Click the **Vimeo** option and drag it to the relevant location.
6. Click **Change Video**.
7. Paste the video URL in the **What's the video's web address?** field.
8. **Customize the playback options:**
   * **Autoplays:** Click the toggle to enable or disable it:
     * **Enabled:** The video autoplays on mute. Visitors can turn the sound on manually.
     * **Disabled:** The video does not play automatically.
   * **Plays in a loop:** Enable the toggle to have your video play in a continuous loop.
9. Scroll down, and enter a description of the video in the **What's this video about?** field.

### Notes
* Make sure that your video privacy settings in Vimeo are set to **Anyone can see the video** and the embed settings are set to **Anywhere.**
* **Vimeo Plus users**: Wix has switched the static domain from **static.wix.com** to **static.parastorage.com**. Therefore, if your video is no longer working, go to your Vimeo Plus settings and make sure that **static.parastorage.com** is defined as the allowed domain.

question: How can I add and set up a Wix Forum on my site using ADI?
answer:
To add and set up a Wix Forum on your site using ADI, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add** on the top bar inside ADI.
2. Click **Apps**.
3. Scroll down to **Forum** and click **Add**. 

   **Note:** A new page is added to your site called Forum. Access this page from the **Pages** menu at the top left.
4. Hover over the app and click **Manage** to create new forum posts, edit posts, and delete posts.
5. Click **Design** to select a different layout for your forum.
6. Click the More Actions icon and click **Settings** to open the forum settings.
7. Set up your forum by customizing the following:
   
   ### General Settings
   - **Forum Name:** Update the name of your forum.
   - **Forum Description:** Describe what your forum is about. Your forum name and description are displayed in the main category list header.
   - **Main Page:** When you have multiple categories, you can choose to display a post list or a category list on your forum's main page.
   - **Sort Posts By:** Click the dropdown to choose a criteria such as Most Viewed, Most Liked, or Newest to sort each forum post.
   - **Display:** Choose which display elements to show with each forum post. Deselect the blue checkmark on the right for the elements you don't want to appear.
   - **Show New Posts:** Enable or disable the toggle to display or hide new and related posts.
   - **Post Auto-Suggest:** Enable or disable the toggle to display or hide suggested similar posts.
   - **Forum Menu:** Enable or disable the toggle to allow site members to log in from the forum.
   - **Member Signup Settings**: Click the **Member Signup** button to update the member settings of your site. **Note:** these options apply to your Member's Area only.

   ### Category List
   Your forum's main page displays the category list by default. You can change the text of your category list banner in your forum's general settings. 
   - **Header:** Show or hide the forum's header and banner image.
   - **Subcategories:** Show or hide any subcategories from your main category list.

   **Note:** To customize your category list you must have more than one category in your forum. To add, edit or rearrange categories first preview your site, click the **Settings** icon at the top right of the forum and select **+ New Category.**

   ### Post List
   Each category of your forum has its own page and post list that displays every post in that category. 
   - **Header:** Select or deselect the blue checkmark to show or hide the post list's page header and banner. 

   **Note:** If you want to edit the content of a specific post list banner you can do so from preview or from your live site.

   ### Posts
   When someone posts to your forum, they see a toolbar at the bottom of the text box with options of different elements they can add to their post. 

   Select or deselect the blue checkmark beside the elements you want to show or hide in the post's toolbar.

question: What is the 'liability shift' in Wix Payments and how can I avoid being held liable for fraudulent payments?
answer:
The 'liability shift' is a term used to describe a change in how banks and processing networks handle some types of credit card fraud. This refers to payments made in person (card present), where the card is read by a card reader. From 2015, businesses that aren’t set up to accept chip cards can now be held financially liable for certain types of fraudulent payments, where a [chargeback](https://support.wix.com/en/article/chargebacks-in-wix-payments) is filed against the merchant.

To avoid being held liable for these types of fraud, it is important to have up-to-date card reading technology, such as [Wix POS](https://www.wix.com/pos). Generally speaking, the party supporting the most secure technology for each fraud type will prevail in a chargeback dispute. In the case of a technology tie, the fraud liability remains with the issuer.

As a merchant accepting in-person payments, it is recommended to verify a customer's payment using a card's EMV chip whenever possible. Having an up-to-date card reader will allow you to insert or tap the chip. You should use the magnetic strip (swipe) only if there is no EMV chip on your customer's card.

question: How can I restore a deleted collection from a backup in my CMS?
answer:
To restore deleted collections from a backup in your CMS, follow these steps:

1. Go to [CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Content%20Manager&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More Actions** at the top.
3. Click **Backups**.
4. Click **Restore** next to the backup you want to restore.
5. Click the checkbox next to each collection you want to restore.
6. Click **Restore [#] Collections**.
7. Click **Yes, I am sure** to confirm you want to permanently override changes made after the backup creation date.
8. Click **Restore**.

When you restore a backup, you can choose whether to restore all your collections or specific ones. Restoring a collection permanently deletes any changes made to the collection after the backup was created. This includes site visitor submissions saved after the backup date.
