question: What should I do if I'm unable to open the Wix Editor on my computer?
answer:
If you are unable to open the Wix Editor, the issue is usually local, specific to your computer, browser, or internet connection. You can troubleshoot most of these issues by following these steps:

1. Go through [the Wix Technical Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-technical-assistant) and follow the steps to troubleshoot the issue.
2. If the problem persists, open an [incognito window](https://support.wix.com/en/article/opening-your-browser-in-incognitoprivate-browsing-mode) in your browser.
3. Sign in to Wix and try to open your editor.
4. Open the console (**Ctrl** + **Shift** + **J** on PC or **Cmd** + **Option** + **J** on Mac).
5. Click the **Console** tab at the top of the panel and refresh the page (F5).
6. Take a screenshot of the entire browser window, including the console. Make sure to include the first red error message(s) that appears in the console in your screenshot.

If you are still unable to open your editor, contact [Wix Customer Care](https://support.wix.com/en/article/contacting-wix-customer-care-for-support) and provide the following details:
- The name or URL of your Wix site.
- The name and version of the web browser you're using.
- The name and version of your computer's operating system.
- A screenshot of your console view showing the first line of the error message.

question: What are the recommended image sizes for cover images in a Wix blog, and how do they vary by layout?

question: Why was my app review removed from the Wix App Market?
answer:
Your app review might have been removed for several reasons:

- **Spamming or advertising**: The review contains content that is considered spam or advertising.
- **Irrelevant Content**: For example, text that is gibberish and is not a review, or a review that is not related to the app itself, such as a general question about Wix or about another app.
- **The review contained profanity or slander**: The review contains content that is considered profanity or slander.

For more details, you can refer to the [App Market Terms of Use](https://www.wix.com/about/app-market-terms) and the general [Wix Terms of Use](https://www.wix.com/about/terms-of-use).

question: How can I set permission levels for my live streaming event page on Wix?

question: How can I add and customize the new Wix Tips app on my site?

4. Click **Add to Site**.
5. Click **Get Started**.

   **Note:** If you have the old Wix Tips app, follow the directions on your site to remove it.

6. Customize your tip settings:
   
   ### Collect tips for orders
   - **Allow clients to leave a tip when they checkout on your site:** Enable the toggle to let clients add a tip at checkout.
     
     **Note:** The first time you enable this, you need to install the **Tip** plugin and publish your site. In the pop-up, click **Add Plugin**, then click **Go to Editor**. The plugin will be added to your site automatically. Click **Publish**, then return to your dashboard.
   - **Allow admins to add a tip when collecting payment:** Admins can collect tips from any page where payment is collected (e.g., Booking Calendar, Booking List, and Orders page).

   ### Tipping options
   - **Percentage:** Set your tips as a percentage of the total order amount.
   - **Fixed amount:** Offer fixed amount tips, such as $2.00 or $5.00.
   - **Default selected tip:** Select a default tip amount from the drop-down menu or select **No tip**.
     
     **Note:** The default options are based on the tip options you set up.
   - **Let customers leave custom tip amounts:** Enable the toggle to let customers enter their own tip amount.

   ### Additional settings
   For Booking services only, choose how you want to split tips for orders with multiple staff members:
   - **Split tips proportionately:** Tips are divided based on the services provided by each staff member.
   - **Split tips evenly:** Tips are equally divided among the staff, regardless of service prices.

question: How can I add a scroll animation to my Wix Pro Gallery and customize its settings?

question: How can I ensure that my site's design looks great on all screen sizes using the Studio Editor?
answer:
To ensure your site's design looks great on all screen sizes using the Studio Editor, you can customize your designs per breakpoint. Breakpoints are screen width ranges that represent the possible screens and devices visitors use, such as tablets and mobiles. The Studio Editor uses a cascading concept, where changes made on larger breakpoints trickle down to smaller breakpoints, but changes on smaller breakpoints don't affect larger breakpoints.

Additionally, you can use the responsive AI tool to make your sections responsive on all screen sizes with just one click. This tool identifies groups of related elements and applies the ideal layout tool for each group, such as stack or grid.

For element resizing, you can edit the element's size in pixels and select a responsive behavior to ensure it looks great on every screen size. Every element comes with a default responsive behavior, like scaling proportionally, which controls how it gets resized on other screens. You can change an element's responsive behavior from the Inspector panel to better meet your needs.

To make an element's design match any screen, enable the **Scale properties** toggle in the Inspector. This ensures that the design looks ideal on every screen, automatically adjusting properties like borders.

For text, the Studio Editor automatically scales text in proportion to the screen size. You can set minimum and maximum values to ensure the text never gets too small or too big. For more precise control, select **Custom** to set the size range for each separate breakpoint.

question: How can I add a health waiver to my Wix site?

2. Click **Old Forms** at the top. 

   **Note:** We are in the process of releasing a new version of Wix Forms, but it's not available to everyone yet. If you built your site using the Wix Editor, scroll down and click **\+ Create Standalone Form**.
3. Click **\+ Create Standalone Form**.
4. Select the **Health Waiver** form template.
5. Click **Get Started**.
6. Give your waiver a name using the **Form title** field.
7. Use the **Form description** field to tell visitors what the form is about.

question: How can I make bulk updates to rates, availability, and restrictions in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner?
answer:
To make bulk updates in Wix Hotels by HotelRunner, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Bulk Updates](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1a6e0874-2039-49cf-bef3-9138bb5c3b16%7C3%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Bulk+Updates) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Rate plans** drop-down and select the relevant rate plan(s) you want to update.
3. Enable the toggles next to the filters you want to add:
   
   * **Base price:** Update the price of your base rates during a specific timeframe. 
     
     * **Fixed:** Enter a new base price beside the relevant rooms.
     * **Adjustment:** Enter the percentage or fixed amount increase or decrease to your base price next to the relevant rooms.
   * **Availability:** Enter how many rooms of a given type you have available during a specific timeframe. Confirm the number is accurate to avoid double-bookings.
   * **Minimum Stay:** Encourage longer stays by setting a minimum stay restriction. This can help ensure more capacity during the off-season.
   * **Stop sell:** Block the sale of specific rates for a period of time. This is useful to protect revenue during the off season.
   * **Close to arrival (CTA):** Restrict guests from arriving on specific dates. This is helpful during busy periods when you need to lighten the workload for your staff.
   * **Close to departure (CTD):** Restrict guests from departing on certain dates. This is helpful during busy periods when you need to lighten the workload for your staff.
4. Choose a date range for your bulk updates under **Apply to**.
5. (Optional) Click **+ Add date range** to apply these bulk updates to another time.
6. Click the **Days** drop-down to apply the bulk updates to specific days of the week.
7. Click the **Channels** drop-down to apply the bulk updates to a specific channel.
8. Click **Preview Changes** at the top right.
9. Review your bulk updates, then click **Save**.
10. (Optional) Repeat steps 3-10 to apply different bulk updates to other room types.

### Tips
* Use the Multi-fill button to quickly apply the same updates to multiple rooms at the same time.
* As you add more filters to a bulk update, you may need to scroll across to enter the information.

question: How can I create a coupon in Wix Stores that requires a minimum order amount?
answer:
To create a coupon with a minimum order amount in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Coupons tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Coupons&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/coupons/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+New Coupon**.
3. Select a coupon type:
   * $ Discount
   * % Discount
   * Free Shipping
4. Enter the coupon code in the **Coupon Code** field. 
   
   **Note:** This is the code customers must enter during checkout to get the discount.
5. Enter the name of the coupon in the **Coupon Name** field. 
   
   **Note:** This name appears in the Coupons tab and on the cart page.
6. Enter the coupon details (varies according to which coupon type you selected in step 3. There are no coupon details for free shipping coupons).
7. Click the **Apply to** drop-down menu and select **Minimum order subtotal**.
8. Enter the minimum amount in the **Minimum subtotal** field.
9. Set the validity of the coupon in the **Valid between** field:
   
   1. Enter the start date of the coupon.
   2. Enter the end date of the coupon, or select the **Don't set an end date** checkbox.
10. (Optional) Select the checkbox next to any limit on coupon use:
    
    * **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon:** Enter the number of times the coupon can be used in total (each purchase by a customer or by different customers is counted).
    * **Limit to one use per customer:** If a customer tries to use the coupon a second time, it won't work.
11. Click **Create Coupon**.

question: How can I use the Accessibility Wizard in Wix to identify and fix accessibility issues on my site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you are using the Wix Editor, as the Accessibility Wizard is only available there.

To use the Accessibility Wizard to identify and fix accessibility issues on your Wix site, follow these steps:

## Step 1 | Open the Accessibility Wizard
Open the Wizard from your Editor settings to begin making your site more accessible for visitors.

### To open the Accessibility Wizard:
1. Select **Settings** at the top of the Wix Editor.
2. Select **Accessibility Wizard.**
3. Select **Scan My Site** on the right.

## Step 2 | Fix detected issues
After your site has been scanned, you are presented with a list of detected issues. Select each issue to open the instructions, and make sure that you apply the changes when you have fixed them. Once you're finished, select **Continue to Step 2**.

### Important
You need to resolve all of the detected issues to progress to the next step in the Wizard.

## Step 3 | Find and fix issues
Next, the Find and Fix Issues step highlights more settings on your site that may need to be adjusted for accessibility. This section is not automatic, and the components need to be manually adjusted.

### Important
You need to manually mark each option as done in order to finish this step.

For more detailed guidance on specific issues like alternative text, main headings, and color contrast, refer to the relevant sections in the Wizard.

question: How can I change the layout of a horizontal menu in Wix Editor?
answer:
To change the layout of a horizontal menu in Wix Editor:

1. Click the menu in your editor.
2. Click the **Layout** icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/03/1b56c768-b70a-48ea-94b7-d420e27793c9.png).
3. Click either the **Menu** or **Dropdown** **menu** tab and customize the options:

### Menu layout options
* **How to display items that don't fit**: Choose how to display items that don't fit in the menu:
  
  + **Wrapped:** A second line is added to display the menu items.
  + **Scroll:** Visitors can view the hidden menu items by scrolling.
* **Horizontal spacing between items:** Use the slider to adjust the horizontal spacing between menu items.
* **Vertical spacing between items:** Use the slider to adjust the vertical spacing between menu items.
* **Items fill the whole menu:** Click the toggle to enable or disable this option:
  
  + **Enabled:** Menu is stretched to fit the entire menu.
  + **Disabled:** Items are not stretched, and are automatically aligned to the left, right, or center of the menu.
* **Align text:** Align the text to the left, right, or center.
* **Display items from:** Display items from left to right, or right to left.
* **Item Padding:** Use the sliders to adjust the vertical and horizontal space each item takes up in the menu.

### Dropdown menu layout options
* **How do dropdown menus open?:** Select how the dropdown items appear:
  
  + **Flyout:** The dropdown items appear under the menu items.
  + **Columns:** Columns appear under the main menu, containing the dropdown items.
* **Spacing between menu & dropdown menu:** Use the slider to adjust the distance between the menu and the dropdown menu.
* **Stretch to full width:** Use the toggle to enable or disable this option:
  
  + **Enabled:** Dropdown menu stretches to full width of the page.
  + **Disabled:** Dropdown menu stays within the gridlines of the main menu.
* **Number of columns:** Use the slider to adjust how many columns are in the dropdown.
* **Align columns:** Choose to align columns to the left, right, center, or justified.
* **Spacing between columns:** Use the slider to adjust the distance between columns.
* **Align dropdown menu:** Align the dropdown menu to the left or center.
* **Align text:** Align the dropdown text to the left, right, or center.
* **Padding:** Use the sliders to adjust the horizontal and vertical space the dropdown menu fills.
* **Spacing between items:** Use the slider to adjust the spacing between dropdown items.

**Note:** There are different customization options depending on the display option you have selected (Flyout/Columns).

question: How can I accept payment for booked services using the Wix Mobile POS?
answer:
To accept payment for booked services at a mobile POS using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Bookings Calendar**.
4. Select a service from the calendar:
   - **Appointment:**
     1. Tap to select the relevant date.
     2. Tap to select the relevant appointment.
     3. Tap **Collect Payment**.
   - **Class or Course:**
     1. Tap to select the relevant class or course.
     2. Tap **Manage Participants**.
     3. Tap to select the relevant participant.
5. Select an option:
   - **Go to checkout:** Collect cash, card, tap-to-pay, or gift card payment. You can add discounts, tips, coupons, or a custom charge to the sale. If you sell Wix Stores products, you can add products to the sale.
   - **Charge with invoice:** Issue an invoice requesting payment for the session.
   - **Mark as paid:** Accept payment offline and mark the session as paid.
6. If you selected **Go to checkout:**
   1. (Optional) Tap **Add More Items** to add additional products or services to the order.
   2. (Optional) Tap **Add Custom Charge** to add a custom amount to the order.
   3. (Optional) Tap **Add a Discount** to add a price reduction.
   4. Tap **Charge**.
   5. Choose how you want to accept payment:
      - **Cash:**
        1. Tap **Cash**.
        2. Enter the amount you received and tap **Accept Cash** or select a preset cash amount.
        3. Give your customer the change.
      - **Card:**
        1. Tap **Card**.
        2. If prompted, select **Bluetooth card reader**.
        3. Let the customer swipe, insert, or tap their credit card.
        4. Tap **Send Email** to send a receipt via email or **No Thanks** if not needed.
      - **Manual card entry:**
        1. Tap **Manual card entry**.
        2. Tap **Go to Checkout**.
        3. Enter all the credit card details and tap **Next**.
        4. Enter the customer's zip code / postal code.
        5. Tap **Confirm & Pay**.
        6. Tap **Send Email** to send a receipt via email or **No Thanks** if not needed.
      - **(US only) Tap to Pay:**
        1. Select **Card**.
        2. If prompted, tap to select the relevant **Tip** amount, or tap **No Tip**.
        3. If prompted, select **Tap to Pay**.
        4. Let the customer tap their credit card on your mobile device.
        5. Tap **Send Receipt** to send a receipt via email, text, or print, or **No Receipt** if not needed.
      - **Gift card:**
        1. Tap **Gift card**.
        2. Enter your customer's gift card code or scan their physical gift card and tap **Apply**.
        3. Tap **Complete Sale**.
        4. Tap **Send Receipt** to send a receipt via email, text, or print, or **No Receipt** if not needed.
      - **Split payment:**
        1. Tap **Split Payment**.
        2. Enter the first payment amount.
        3. Tap **Continue**.
        4. Select a payment method and complete the first part of the payment.
        5. Tap **Continue**.
        6. Edit the second payment amount if needed.
        7. Click **Continue**.
        8. Select a payment method and complete the payment.
        9. Tap **Continue**.
        10. Tap **Send Receipt** to send a receipt via email, text, or print, or **No Receipt** if not needed.

**Note:** Make sure you [set up your mobile device as a point of sale](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-mobile-pos-setting-up-a-point-of-sale) before starting.

question: How can I resolve a soft 404 error in Google Search Console for a page with meaningful content?
answer:
To resolve a soft 404 error in Google Search Console for a page with meaningful content, follow these steps:

1. **Review your affected pages:** If your affected pages **do** have meaningful content, use the URL Inspection Tool to request reindexing for your page by [submitting your page's URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines#submitting-individual-urls-to-search-engines).

2. **Review the content of the affected pages:** Soft 404 errors are sometimes caused by a lack of organic or unique content on a page. To resolve this issue, you must optimize your affected pages' content for SEO, ensuring that your pages' content contains unique and organic text. Don't forget to add [alt text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-images-and-galleries-for-seo-alt-text) to your images too.

For more tips, you can [learn more about optimizing your site's content for SEO.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-sites-content-for-seo)

question: How can I set permissions for who can download media from my Shared Gallery app?
answer:
To set download permissions in the Shared Gallery app, follow these steps:

1. Select the Shared Gallery app in your Editor.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Click the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Set Gallery Permissions**.
5. Choose who can download media:

   * **Everyone:** Everyone who visits your shared gallery can download media.
   * **Members only:** Just site members can download media from your shared gallery. This is the default setting.

question: How can I import reservations from an external calendar to Wix Hotels using iCal?
answer:
To import your external calendar to Wix Hotels using iCal, follow these steps:

1. [Locate your iCal URL](https://support.wix.com/en/article/finding-your-ical-url).
2. [Go to your dashboard.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-sites-dashboard)
3. Click the **Hotels** tab.
4. Click to expand the **Reservations** tab.
5. Select **iCal**.
6. Click the **Choose Type** drop-down menu and select a room type.
7. Paste your iCal URL into the URL field.
8. (Optional) Click **Add Calendar** to add another room type and paste the iCal URL in the URL field.
9. Click **Save**.

### Important
- You can only import from services that allow you to export your calendar in iCal format.
- The sync is one way only, from iCal to the Wix Calendar.
- If you have multiple room types, you must add a different iCal URL for each room type.
- This feature is not compatible with the Wix Hotels Channel Manager. If you want to connect the Channel Manager, please delete all the URLs in this tab before doing so.

question: How can I find and edit my mobile menu in the Wix Mobile Editor if it's not visible?
answer:
If you don't see the mobile menu inside your mobile Editor, follow these steps to find and edit your menu:

1. **Check the menu icon**: Click the Mobile Menu icon in your mobile Editor and then click **Edit Menu**.

2. **Check your hidden elements**: Click the **Hidden on Mobile** icon on the left side of the mobile Editor. If the menu is listed, you can unhide it by clicking the **Show Element** icon.

3. **Edit the design of your menu**: Use Ctrl + M (or Cmd + M on a Mac) to cycle through the elements on the page. Once you locate the menu, you can edit the design of the mobile menu.

4. **Check for overlapping elements**: Right-click an element in the Editor, hover over **Overlapping Items**, and click the menu from the list.

5. **Use the layers panel**: Click the Layers icon on the bottom left of the Editor, select **Header**, **Page**, or **Footer**, and click the menu from the list.

6. **Check your page layout**: Click **Menus & Pages** on the left side of the mobile Editor, hover over a page name, click the **Show More** icon, click **Mobile Settings**, and select the **Standard** page layout.

If the menu is not highlighted on your mobile Editor when you select it from the list, it is outside the visible part of the mobile Editor. You can change its position by adjusting the X or Y axis in the [toolbar](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-using-the-editor-toolbar-to-adjust-elements).

question: How can I add and set up a donation form on my Wix site?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure you've [connected your site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accepting-payments-an-overview) to a payment method and [purchased a Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-upgrading-wix-forms).

### Step 1 | Add a Donation Form to Your Site
Add a predefined donation form to your site, then drag and drop it to anywhere on your site. You can change the form fields and the design of your donation form anytime.

#### To add a donation form:
1. Click ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/10/df6f248e-f3bb-46fe-b177-7e64f27bb3c8.png) **Add** on the left side of the Editor.
2. Click **Contact & Forms**.
3. Click **Donation** on the left.
4. Click or drag any of the forms under **Donation** onto your site.

### Step 2 | Manage Your Donation Fields
After adding your donation form, customize the fields according to the information you want visitors to submit. You can add, edit or remove fields as needed.

#### To manage your form fields:
* **Add a new field:**
  1. Click the form.
  2. Click **Add New Field** or click the **Plus** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/e9471e96-8e0a-4ac1-9fa6-02e99938bd27/2020/10/14/b4982162-a1ba-4ce2-aee0-be4435de8ac0/e76ecd77-f52c-46be-b303-9fcc7948adc4.png).
  3. Click the **Add** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/03/10/01938e77-bd06-4819-9e55-e0a2d8c9b9a9/d8077b04-21d1-4e9d-9476-daea14aad290.png) next to the field you want to add.
* **Edit an existing field:**
  1. Click the relevant field in your form.
  2. Click **Edit Field**.
  3. Edit the field using the available options:
     + Click the **Field title** text box to add a title for the field name.
     + Select the relevant option under **Show initial text**:
       - **None:** No text appears in the field.
       - **Placeholder text:** Add text to the field to help visitors understand what they should enter (e.g. "Add it here").
* **Remove a field:**
  1. Click the relevant field in your form.
  2. Press "Delete" on your keyboard.

### Step 3 | Setup Payments on Your Donation Form
Send your site visitors to checkout when they submit your donation form. You can suggest a donation amount by setting a default, or allow visitors to decide.

#### To setup payments on your form:
1. Click **Donate**.
2. Click **Settings**.
3. Choose what happens when a visitor submits a form:
   - **Show success message**: Display a success message. Edit the message settings by entering the message you want to show and setting how long the message should show for.
   - **Go to site page or popup**: Direct visitors to another page on your site or a popup.
     1. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9fece466-836a-4dbb-b473-f21bfa85fc71/2018/04/25/8dabe042-8e57-45ce-8375-c4bfb822929d.png).
     2. Select the link destination on the left and enter the link details on the right.
     3. Click **Done**.
   - **Link to external URL**: Direct visitors to an external web address.
     1. Click the **Link** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9fece466-836a-4dbb-b473-f21bfa85fc71/2018/04/25/8dabe042-8e57-45ce-8375-c4bfb822929d.png).
     2. Enter the URL on the right.
     3. Click **Done**.
   - **Show link to file download**: Allow visitors to download a file after submitting the form. **Note:** This is a Premium feature which requires a [Premium plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-upgrading-wix-forms).
     1. Click **Upload file** to choose the file your site visitors will download.
     2. Edit the download link text.
4. Scroll down to **Accept Payments on Your Form**.
5. Click **Set Up Payment Form**.
6. Click **Get Started** and set up the desired payment form type.

**Tip**: Click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-payments-to-a-site-form#step-3-add-a-product-service-to-your-form-1) to set up your payment form type.

question: How can I troubleshoot errors in my structured data markup on a Wix site?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that you have completed any necessary prerequisites related to structured data markup.

To troubleshoot errors in your structured data markup on a Wix site, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Check the Format of Your Markup
- Wix site pages can only use markup in a [JSON-LD format](https://json-ld.org/).
- Ensure your code begins with the HTML tag `<script type="application/ld+json">` and ends with `</script>`.
- Use only one script tag and include only one main markup type.
- Ensure your markup has less than 7,000 characters.

### Step 2 | Check for HTML tags inside your JSON-LD
- The only HTML tags allowed in your markup are the script tags at the beginning and end of the code.
- Avoid entering HTML tags inside the JSON-LD part, as this will cause validation to fail.

### Step 3 | Check your punctuation
- Each JSON-LD element must be wrapped in curly brackets `{ }`.
- Separate each element in the JSON-LD with a comma, except for the last element.
- Use straight quotes `""` instead of curly quotes `“”`.

### Step 4 | Check your fields for spaces
- All fields should have the format: "key":"content" and must be on a single line.
- Avoid pressing 'Enter' to create a line break within a field, as this will cause validation to fail.

### Tip
If you want to validate your markup for eligibility for rich results or you're having issues with your markup, you can check it by pasting it into the [Google Rich Results Tool](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results?utm_campaign=sdtt&utm_medium=code).

question: How does Wix optimize image loading to improve site performance?
answer: Wix optimizes image loading through automatic image optimization and lazy loading. When you upload an image to a Wix site, images less than 25MB are automatically compressed for optimal quality and site loading time. Additionally, Wix uses a technique called lazy loading, which boosts loading time by replacing high-resolution images with low-resolution versions. The low-resolution placeholders load instantly, while the high-resolution content loads in the background and automatically replaces the placeholders once loaded.

question: How can I connect a Single Video Player to my CMS collection in the Wix Editor?
answer:
To connect the Single Video Player to the CMS in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).

   1. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/65d5031a-8d20-483c-b08f-0a758e1cf2fd/68a0236f-77f4-43c6-931f-8298ae691a9e/2022/11/17/01f24c8b-2ea3-4d06-a26d-9975a43d617e/a79e245b-4870-4444-ba82-248eca4eb9a7.png) on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Video & Music**.

3. Select the Single Video Player you just added and click the **Connect to CMS** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2023/06/16/2d484f5d-e1bf-4d48-9e42-82216e8b88de/08e74518-edad-42f8-b007-c974ba767eb6.png).
4. Click the **Choose a dataset** drop-down and select an existing dataset that connects to your collection. Alternatively, click **Add a Dataset**, then choose the collection you want to connect, give the dataset a name and click **Create**.
5. Under **Connections**, click the drop-downs to connect the video player to the relevant collection fields:
   
   * **Video title connects to:** Select the Text, Address, or Tags field you want to use as the video title. Select **Add new field** if you want to add and connect a new collection field for your video title.

   Note: If you choose a URL field type as the video source, the actual title of the embedded video may override the field you chose for your video title.
   ![A screenshot of the CMS connection options available for the player.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/09/20/4b68c412-4f27-4157-b3a7-0ed88e0facd4/c23b4b2b-0d6f-4c0d-832c-5a7527751a7b.png)

      * **Read:** Elements that are connected to the dataset can read and display content from your collection. The elements cannot modify the collection content.
      * **Read & Write:** Elements that are connected to the dataset can display content from your collection. Input elements can add or edit content in your collection.
   ![Screenshot of the dataset settings.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2024/09/20/f00577ed-ee36-465b-b5c6-1986ed9ea2d1/3de2dd2e-e2f7-4ff3-b1be-cf740618a4b1.png)

   **Tip:** If the video source is a Video field type, you can enable the video title from the layout settings. question: How can I promote my Branded App using Wix's marketing tools?
answer:
To promote your app with Wix's marketing tools:

1. [Go to the Branded Mobile App tab](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Your%20Branded%20App%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/mobile-app?activeTab=branded) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Marketing Tools**.

You will only see the marketing tools if your app is already live in both the App Store and Google Play.

1. Choose what you want to do:

### Share your app's invite link
Copy your app's invite link and share it directly with your contacts or social media following. 
1. Click **Share Invite Link**.
2. Click **Copy** to copy the link directly or choose a social platform to share the link on.

### Send a custom push notification to members' phones
Send a push notification to your Branded App members from the Wix app on your mobile device. Direct them to a product or service, a specific tab on your app, or create a custom screen that members see after tapping the notification. 
1. Click **Create Push Notification**.
2. [Create and customize a push notification](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-creating-and-sending-custom-push-notifications) and then send it to either specific app users or all users at once.

### Keep customers updated with a mobile announcement about the latest news and offers
Create a mobile announcement in your app that appears in the 'Announcements' section. You can also choose to send the announcement as a push notification to app users. 
1. Click **Create announcement**.
2. [Customize your announcement title and body text](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-sending-an-announcement-as-a-push-notification) and add media before sending.

### Increase discoverability in the App Store and Google Play with better keywords
Optimize your app's store listing by adding effective keywords that will be more likely to pull up your app in searches. 
1. Click **Choose Keywords**.
2. Under **Keywords**, add some keywords to help determine how your app appears in results. You can also view Apple's tips for choosing keywords.

Learn more about [choosing the right keywords for your app's store listings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/branded-app-by-wix-creating-store-listing-descriptions#step-2-increase-your-apps-discoverability).

### Add a 'join my app' invite banner to the top of your mobile site
Convert your mobile site visitors to app users by adding an invite banner. 
1. Enable the toggle to add the invite banner on your mobile site.
2. (Optional) Click **Preview Banner** to see how the invite banner appears for mobile site visitors.

### Add a 'Download my app' widget to your site 
Add a widget to your site that allows site visitors to input their phone number and receive a text message with the invite link and details to join you in the app.

### Showcase your app with social media marketing
Create dynamic image and video social posts to market your app and post them across your social channels. Build your brand with the available pre-built templates or start from scratch and build your own. Then publish your content directly to your social accounts. 
Learn more about [building social posts with social media marketing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/social-posts-creating-and-customizing-a-social-post).

### Send a targeted promotional email campaign
Create an email marketing campaign to promote your app in order to keep your current users engaged as well as encourage downloads from contacts on your mailing list who haven't joined you in your app. 
1. Click **Create Email Campaign**.
2. [Create your campaign from the Email Marketing dashboard](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-and-sending-a-campaign-from-start-to-finish) and send it to your contacts or to a segment of people.

### Create a paid Facebook Ads or Google Ads campaign to promote your app
Get more traffic and reach a wider audience by running a paid ad campaign for your branded app. If you run a [Facebook Ads](https://support.wix.com/en/article/facebook-ads-an-overview) or [Google Ads](https://support.wix.com/en/article/google-ads-with-wix-an-overview) campaign with Wix, everything is managed from your site's dashboard.

### Tip

question: How do I create a CMS collection in Wix to use with a repeater?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure to [add the CMS](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-getting-started) to your site if you haven't already.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Create a CMS collection: Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **CMS** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Create Collection**.
4. Enter a name for your collection.
5. Leave **Multiple items (Default)** selected and click **Create**.
6. Add fields to your collection manually or by importing a CSV file:
   * **Add fields manually:** Click **\+ Add Field** to begin [adding fields to your collection manually](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-adding-a-field-to-a-collection).
   * **Import a CSV file:** Click **Import CSV file** to [upload a CSV file to your collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-importing-content-into-a-collection).
7. Add items to your collection:
   1. Click **\+ Add Item**.
   2. Add content about the item to each relevant field.
   3. Repeat this step to create as many items as you need.
8. Set permissions for the collection:
   1. Click **More Actions** and select **Permissions & privacy**.
   2. Choose which permissions to use for the collection:
      * **Show content:**
        1. Click **Show content**.
        2. Click the **Who can view this content?** drop-down and choose an option:
           * **Everyone:** Any site visitor can view the collection content on the live site.
           * **Members only:** Only site members can view the collection content on the live site.
        3. Click **Save**.
      * **Collect content:**
        1. Click **Collect content**.
        2. Click the **Who can add content to this collection?** drop-down and choose an option:
           * **Everyone:** Any site visitor can add content to the collection from the live site.
           * **Members only:** Only site members can add content to the collection from the live site.
        3. Click the **Who can view this content?** drop-down and choose an option:
           * **Admin:** Site owners and collaborators can view the collection content from the live site.
           * **Members only:** Only site members can view the collection content from the live site.
           * **Everyone:** Any site visitor can view the collection content from the live site.
        4. Click **Save**.
      * **Custom:**
        1. Click **Custom**.
        2. Click the relevant checkboxes next to each role to choose whether visitors with the role can view, add, update, or delete collection content from the live site:
           * **Admin:** Site owners and collaborators always have view, add, update, and delete permissions from the live site. You cannot change the permissions associated with this admin role.
           * **Item's creator:** This role's permissions only apply to the specific items that a member creates themselves.
           * **Members only:** This role applies to members of your site only.
           * **Everyone:** This role applies to everyone who can access your live site.
        3. Click **Save**.

question: What are the steps and requirements for transferring my domain to Wix?
answer:
To transfer your domain to Wix, follow these steps and ensure you meet the requirements:

1. **Upgrade Your Site**: To connect your domain, you must [upgrade your site](https://www.wix.com/upgrade/website?referralAdditionalInfo=HelpCenter).

2. **Request an Authorization Code**: Obtain this code from your current domain registrar.

3. **Check Domain Age**: Ensure that at least 60 days have passed since your domain was registered, as the domain will be locked otherwise. Note that changes to the registrant information also [lock your domain for 60 days](https://support.wix.com/en/article/icanns-60-day-lock-policy).

4. **Verify Domain Unlock**: Make sure your domain is unlocked.

5. **Change Privacy Settings**: If your domain has private registration, change your domain privacy settings to **public** at your domain host.

### Important Considerations

- **Domain Extensions**: Currently, you can only transfer domains with the following extensions: .com, .org, .net, .biz, .info, .co, .guru, .email, .expert, .photography, .pictures, .space, .rocks, .tokyo, .xyz, .company, .club, .solutions, .today, .technology, .tips, .center, .directory, .ninja, .photos, .land, .agency, .gift, .holiday, .christmas, .top, .design, .london, .online, .org, .party, .site, .store, .shop, .wiki, .mx, and .website.

- **Retaining Registration Time**: Any remaining time left in your domain's current registration period is retained when you transfer it to Wix. The minimum 1-year extension you buy when transferring to Wix is added to any remaining time left in your domain's registration period, so you do not lose any registration time you've already paid for with your old domain registrar.

### Alternative Option

You can [connect your domain to your Wix site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers) rather than transfer it to Wix if you would prefer to keep your domain with your current host.

question: How do I add and design states in a multi-state box in Editor X?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that Dev Mode is turned on in Editor X.

To add and design states in a multi-state box, follow these steps:

1. **Add a multi-state box**:
   - Click **Add Elements** at the top of Editor X.
   - Click **Layout Tools**.
   - Click **Multi-State Boxes**.
   - Drag a multi-state box to the relevant location on your page.

2. **Add and design the states**:
   - Select the multi-state box.
   - Click **Manage States**.
   - Click a state to select it.
   - Add elements and design the state as you wish.

   **Tip:** While designing the states, Dev Mode is not required. This means everyone can customize them – not just developers.

3. **Add a new state**:
   - Select the multi-state box.
   - Click **Manage States**.
   - Click **Add New State**.
   - Add an ID for the state:
     1. Hover over the new state and click the More Actions icon.
     2. Click **Edit ID.**
     3. Enter a new ID for this state.
     4. Click **Done**.

4. **Rename a state**:
   - Select the multi-state box.
   - Click **Manage States**.
   - Click the More Actions icon next to the current state's name.
   - Click **Edit ID**.
   - Enter the new ID in the text box and click **Done**.

5. **Remove a state**:
   - Select the multi-state box.
   - Click **Manage States**.
   - Click the More Actions icon next to the current state's name.
   - Click **Delete**.

6. **Reorder states**:
   - Select the multi-state box.
   - Click **Manage States**.
   - Click and drag the Reorder icon up or down to change the order of the states.

**Design tip:** The states can have different height properties, which allow you to reveal additional info for example. However, the width of your states always stays the same.

question: How can I view the individual recipient statistics for my email campaign in the Wix app?
answer:
In the Wix app, you can view the individual recipient statistics for your email campaign by accessing the **Recipient Stats** section. This section provides a breakdown of the following metrics:

- **Sent:** The total amount of contacts you've sent the email campaign to.
- **Delivered:** The total number of contacts who received your email campaign to their inboxes. You can also see the percentage they make of those sent.
- **Opened:** The contacts who have opened your email campaign. You can also see the percentage they make of those delivered.
- **Clicked:** The contacts who have clicked links inside your email campaign (a button, a direct URL). You can also see the percentage they make of those opened.
- **Not delivered:** The total number of contacts who did not receive your email campaign because these emails bounced.
- **Not opened:** The contacts who received the campaign but did not open it.

**Tip:** Click any stat to see the list of recipients that were counted.

question: How can I use the AI tool in the Studio Editor to make a section responsive?

3. Click the Responsive AI icon.
4. Click **Generate Now**.
5. In the preview, click through the breakpoints to see how the section looks.
6. Choose what to do next:
   * **Apply Design:** Instantly apply the AI suggestions to the section.
   * **Discard Changes:** Ignore the AI suggestions and go back to your original design.

The responsive AI tool automatically identifies groups of related elements in your layout, applies the best layout tool for each group, and adjusts element definitions to ensure they look great on all breakpoints.

question: Why is a video in my Wix Video Library unavailable and how can I resolve this issue?
answer:

1. You have filmed a live stream but you don't have enough video storage to post the video on your site.
2. You downgraded your site and you now have less video storage so the video has become unavailable.

**Resolution:**

You can only post the video once you delete other videos from your site or [purchase a higher plan.](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fpremium-add-on%2Fstorage%3Fmsid%3D%7BmetaSiteId%7D%0A%0A&title=Select+a+Site+to+Add+Storage&primaryButtonText=Add+Storage)

### Tip
Learn more about [upgrading your video storage](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-video-upgrading-your-video-storage).

question: How can I connect a domain purchased from another registrar to my Wix site?

question: How do I connect a signature input element to a CMS collection in Wix Editor?
answer:
Prerequisites:

question: How can I schedule a live stream in advance using Wix Video?
answer:
To schedule a live stream in advance using Wix Video, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Live Stream** at the top right.
3. Click **Schedule Event**.
4. Click the **Channel** drop-down and select which channel your stream will appear in.
5. Set when you want your stream to go live under **Schedule a Live Stream**:
   * **Go live on:** Select the date from the calendar.
   * **Go live at:** Select the time of day.
6. Fill in the **Video Info** section:
   * **Cover Image:** Choose a cover image or video for your live stream so that your viewers do not see a blank placeholder before the live stream begins.
   * **Title:** The name of the video. This is required.
   * **Publisher:** The name of the publisher.
   * **Categories:** The category your live stream will appear in.
   * **Tags:** Tags that help viewers find your live stream.
   * **Description:** Information about what your live stream is about.
7. Select an option under **Video Pricing**:
   * **Free:** Viewers do not need to pay to watch your video. Click the **Viewer options** drop-down and select an option:
     + **Anyone can watch**: Allow anyone to watch.
     + **Sign up only**: Viewers must sign up as site members before they can watch the video.
   * **Paid:** Viewers need to pay to watch your video. Use the checkboxes and drop-down options to:
     + Rent or sell your video.
     + Set the price.
     + Set the availability (applies to renting only).
8. Click the **Show Trailer** toggle to display a trailer of your video and then click **upload** to add it (applies only if you are selling videos).
9. Fill in additional information under **More About This Video:**
   * Click the drop-down to enter any additional information about your video.
10. Click the **Let Viewers Embed this Video** toggle to enable or disable the option (Premium feature):
    * **Enabled:** Your viewers can embed the video. Select the checkboxes next to the information you want to display on the embedded video. You can see what your video will look like in the preview on the right side.
    * **Disabled:** Your viewers cannot embed the video.
11. Click **Save**.

### What happens until I go live?
* A countdown timer appears within the Wix Video player on your site.
* Visitors can add your stream to their calendars.
* You can set up pricing to watch your stream.
* Your site automatically refreshes as your stream approaches so that your viewers won't need to manually reload the page.
* You can send an email campaign telling your viewers about your event. [Learn more about creating email marketing campaigns.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-a-new-campaign)

question: How can I ensure my Wix site is compliant with the LGPD regarding cookies and data processing consent?
answer:
To ensure your Wix site is compliant with the LGPD regarding cookies and data processing consent, follow these steps:

1. **Provide Information About Cookies:** You are required to provide complete information about which cookies you are using. You can use your privacy policy to provide such information to your visitors. Learn more about [which cookies are placed on your site-visitors' browsers](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cookies-and-your-wix-site).

2. **Add a Cookie Banner:** Use the Wix Privacy Center to add a cookie banner to your site. With a cookie banner, your visitors can give their consent to non-essential cookies to be placed on their device. Learn more about [Privacy and Cookies](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-privacy-cookies).

3. **Request Consent for Data Processing:** If you want to receive affirmative consent from your site visitors before processing their data, you can do so by:
   - [Displaying a Cookie Banner on Your Site](https://support.wix.com/en/article/displaying-a-cookie-banner-on-your-site)
   - [Using Wix Forms to Receive Explicit Consent](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-wix-forms-to-receive-explicit-consent)
   - [Creating a Custom Form and Connect it to a Database using Velo by Wix](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VyMsDTwge18)
   - [Adding a Policy Checkbox to Your Wix Stores Checkout Page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-the-checkout-page)
   - [Customizing Your Booking Form’s Fields in Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-and-setting-up-your-booking-forms)

By following these steps, you can help ensure that your Wix site is compliant with the LGPD regarding cookies and data processing consent.

question: How can I integrate Wix Pricing Plans with other Wix apps to offer exclusive content or services?
answer:
You can integrate your pricing plans with other Wix apps used on your site. For example, you can create a plan that grants access to members-only pages on your site. Or, create a plan that bundles multiple Wix Bookings services into one package.

### Integrate the following Wix apps and features with pricing plans:

- **Site Pages:** Use your pricing plans to sell access to exclusive content on [hidden site pages](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-making-site-pages-members-only).
- **Wix Bookings:** Sell access to services created in Wix Bookings. You can [sell membership plans](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-membership-plan-in-wix-bookings) that last a set amount of time or [create a package](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-offering-packages) of services (e.g. 5 manicures at a reduced rate).
- **Wix Events:** [Offer discounts to membership plan holders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-a-membership-plan) when they buy event tickets.
- **Wix Blog:** Create exclusive content on your blog and [limit access to plan holders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-creating-blog-post-subscriptions). You can limit access to specific blog posts or to your entire blog page.
- **Wix Online Programs:** [Create an online program](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-an-overview), such as a 30-day pushup challenge, and sell access to it through your pricing plans.
- **Wix Forum:** [Create exclusive forum categories](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forum-limiting-specific-categories-to-paying-subscribers) that only plan holders can access.
- **Wix Video:** Create exclusive content in your video channel and [limit access to plan holders](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-video-connecting-a-pricing-plan-to-a-video-channel).
- **Wix File Share:** Create a file-sharing library with the [File Share app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-apps-about-the-file-share-app) and [limit access or permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-apps-managing-permissions-per-folder-in-the-wix-file-share-app) to all or part of your library to plan holders.
- **Wix Groups:** [Create a members-only community](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-groups-creating-a-new-group#step-1-choose-a-type-of-group) where you can share tips and advice and clients can get to know each other better.

### Ready to combine pricing plans with Wix apps?
[Go to the Wix App Market](https://www.wix.com/app-market) to add and set up the apps you want to integrate with pricing plans. Learn more about [connecting pricing plans to Wix apps and features](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-connecting-a-plan-to-content-and-services).

question: How can I move a domain purchased elsewhere from one Wix account to another?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to both the current and new Wix accounts.

### Step 1 | Remove the domain from your Wix account
1. Sign in to the Wix account where your domain is currently added.
2. [Go to Domains](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/domains) in the account.
3. Copy your domain's DNS records. 
   - **Note**: If your domain is [connected by pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pointing-vs-name-servers-domain-connection-methods), skip ahead to step 4.
4. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the relevant domain and select **Remove from Wix**.
5. Click **Remove Domain** to confirm.

### Step 2 | Add the domain to another Wix account
1. Sign in to the Wix account you're adding the domain within.
2. [Go to Domains](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/domains) in the account.
3. Click **Add an Existing Domain** and select **Connect a domain you already own**.
4. Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click **Continue**.
5. Enter your domain name and click **Let's Go**.
6. Click **Yes, I own this domain** under the search field.
7. Finish connecting your domain via name servers or pointing: 
   - **Name servers:** (Recommended) This connection method keeps the domain's DNS records managed in your Wix account. Continue at [step 1.7 here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers#step-1-add-the-domain-to-your-wix-account) to finish connecting your domain via name servers.
   - **Pointing:** This connection method requires the domain's DNS records to be hosted outside of Wix. Learn how to [finish connecting your domain via pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-wix-using-the-pointing-method#step-1-add-the-domain-to-your-wix-account).

question: How can I create a membership plan in Wix Bookings?
answer:
To create a membership plan in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Booking Services](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Booking%20Services&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/offerings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Create a new appointment or class, or edit an existing one.
3. Scroll down to the **Price and Payment** section.
4. Choose the relevant price option in the **Price type** drop-down. 
   * **Fixed Price:** Set a standard price for the service.
   * **Free:** Choose this option for free service.
   * **Varied prices:** Create different price options depending on either the client type or the staff member.
   * **Custom Price:** Describe how you charge for the service, for example, "Price negotiable".
5. Create the pricing plan and connect the booking service to it:
   1. Click **Create New Plan** next to **Memberships & Packages**.
   2. Click **Membership**.
   3. Click **Next**.
   4. Enter the Membership name and Description.
6. Click the **What services are included?** drop-down.
7. Click the checkbox next to the services you want to include in the membership. Or you can click **Select All Services** to create an all-inclusive membership.
   
   **Note:** The service you are creating is already linked to this plan.
8. Click the second drop-down and choose from the following options:
   * **Unlimited number of sessions:** Allow clients to attend as many sessions as they like.
   * **Limited number of sessions:** Choose the number of sessions clients can attend as part of their membership.
     1. Set the limit in the **Number of sessions** field.
9. Choose how clients pay under **Price and Duration**:
   * **Recurring payments:** After checkout, clients pay weekly, monthly or yearly for their membership. This is a great way to improve monetization on your site.
     1. Choose how often the membership payment recurs from the **Payment period** drop-down.
     2. Enter the recurring cost in the **Price** field.
     3. Choose an end date using the **Payments stop after** drop-down.
     4. (Optional) Enable the toggle to [offer clients a free trial period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/pricing-plans-offering-your-clients-a-free-trial-period).
   * **One-time payment:** Your clients pay for the membership as they check out:
     1. Enter the membership's price.
     2. Decide how long this membership is valid for using the drop-down.
   * **Free:** Clients won't be charged for the membership plan.
     1. Choose how long the membership is valid for using the drop-down.
10. Select the checkbox next to any relevant perks you want to add to the membership under **Extra Benefits**.
11. Under Settings, choose any additional terms and conditions you want to add to the membership from the following options:
   * **Limit to 1 per person:** Enable the toggle to limit the membership to one per client.
   * **Let clients cancel:** Enable the toggle to allow clients to cancel their membership at any time on your site.
   * **Clients set start date:** Enable the toggle to allow clients to choose at checkout when their membership begins.
   * **Add a policy:** Create your own terms & conditions for the membership.
     1. Click **Add**.
     2. Enter your terms and conditions in the field provided.
     3. Click **Save**.
12. Click **Save**.
13. When ready, click **Save** at the top right to update this service.

**Tip:** You can edit the membership plan later on both the service creation form under [Booking Services](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Booking%20Services&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/bookings/scheduler/owner/offerings) or from [Pricing Plans](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Pricing%20Plans&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/membership/) in the site dashboard.

question: How can I connect my existing domain to Wix using the pointing method?
answer:
Prerequisites: You must [upgrade your Wix site](http://www.wix.com/upgrade/website) before you can connect your domain.

To connect your existing domain to Wix using the pointing method, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add the domain to your Wix account

1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click **Add an Existing Domain**.
3. Click **Connect a domain you already own.**
4. Select the site you want to connect your domain to and click **Continue**.
5. Enter the domain name and click **Let's Go**.
6. Click **Yes, I own this domain** in the sentence below the search field.

   - If a "Start Transfer" option appears, click **connect your domain** in the sentence below it.

### Connect your domain manually (Start button)

1. Review the information on screen and click **Start**.
2. Click **pointing** in the sentence at the top of the screen.
3. Click **Switch to Pointing Instructions**.

### Step 2 | Update the DNS records in your domain host account

1. Log in to your domain's current host account:
   - Open a new tab in your browser.
   - Go to your domain host's site and log in.
   - Go back to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard.
   - Click **I logged in**.
2. Find your domain settings page:
   - Go to the domains page on your domain host's site.
   - Find your domain and go to its settings panel.
   - Return to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard.
   - Click **I found my domain settings**.
3. Find your DNS Records:
   - In your domain settings, find the area where you manage or edit DNS server records.
   - Return to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard.
   - Click **I found the records**.
4. Replace your DNS records:
   - On your domain host's site, replace your current records with the Wix DNS records provided on your Wix domains page.
   - Return to the step-by-step outline in your Wix dashboard.
   - Click **I updated my records**.

**Important:** Be sure to update **both your CNAME and A record** with your domain host. If you don't, your site will appear unsecure and your visitors may see a warning message.

### Step 3 | Wait for your domain to propagate

Your work is done. It may take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and your site to appear worldwide. Learn more about [domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: How can I add a YouTube video to my site using the Single Video Player?
answer:
To add a video from YouTube using the Single Video Player, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click Add![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/05/aa91fc0d-2a7c-4f06-a0a1-f600d4850851.png).
3. Click **Video and Music**.
4. Click **Single Video Players**.
5. Click the **YouTube** video, or drag it to the relevant location.
6. Click **Change Video**.
7. Paste the video URL in the field **What's the video's web address?**
8. Click the **Autoplays** toggle to set whether or not your video will play automatically:
   
   * **Enabled:** The video autoplays on mute. Visitors can turn the sound on manually.
   * **Disabled:** The video does not play automatically.
9. Click the **Play on loop** toggle to set whether or not your video plays on loop.
   
   * **Enabled:** The video plays on loop.
   * **Disabled:** The video plays just once.
10. Enter a description for the video under **What's this video about?**.
11. Publish your site.

### Important
* The smallest size player you can add to your site is 320 pixels by 180 pixels. This is because it is not possible to display audio controls on players smaller than this due to a YouTube restriction.
* When adding your own video from YouTube, make sure that in your video settings in YouTube:
   
   + The video is set to **Public.**
   + The **Allow Embedding** box is checked.
* Views for embedded videos to your site may not register on that video's native platform.
* A YouTube video will always play from the beginning (00:00:00) in your Single Video Player, even if you enter a URL set up to start playing from a different point (e.g. 15 seconds in).

question: What accessibility features are included in Wix's accessible templates, and what additional steps should I take to ensure my site is fully accessible?
answer:
Wix's accessible templates come with basic built-in accessibility features, such as accessible heading structures and site color contrast. However, some advanced accessibility features, like custom ARIA labels and alt text, are not included and need to be added manually.

To continue optimizing your site for accessibility, follow these steps:

1. Go through the [accessibility checklist](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-checklist-for-improving-your-sites-accessibility#accessibility-checklist) to ensure your site has utilized all of the accessibility features that Wix offers.
2. Prepare your site's structure by following the guidelines [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-site-structure).
3. Reduce motion on your site as explained [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-reducing-motion).
4. Add an accessibility statement to your site by following the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-adding-an-accessibility-statement-to-your-site).
5. Prepare your images and galleries using the tips [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-images-and-galleries).
6. Prepare your text and graphics as outlined [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessibility-preparing-your-text-and-graphics).

Please note that while Wix strives to ensure accessibility, they cannot guarantee compliance with local accessibility laws and regulations. It is recommended to consult an accessibility expert to ensure your site meets the criteria outlined in your region's accessibility regulations.

question: How can I dispute a chargeback in Wix Payments if I believe it to be unjustified?
answer:
If you believe a chargeback to be unjustified, we recommend you dispute it. A win will improve [your chargeback ratio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/understanding-your-chargeback-ratio) and you can recover the value of the payment, as well the chargeback fee.

## To file a chargeback dispute:
1. [Go to Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Your%20Transactions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpayments-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant payment to see its details.
3. Click **Dispute Chargeback** under the chargeback's details.
4. Select the product or service type of this transaction:

   * **Physical product:** Physical products delivered, as described, to your customer.
   * **Digital Product:** Digital files sent to your customer.
   * **Service:** Any service provided to a customer, either online (e.g. website design) or offline (e.g. yoga classes).
   * **Event ticket**: Tickets for events such as performances or conferences.
   * **Other**: A product or service that doesn't fall within any of the other categories.
5. Begin building your case by submitting:

   * A cover letter explaining your case.
   * Relevant evidence to verify your case.
6. When ready, click **Preview & Submit Dispute** at the bottom.

**Tip**: You can click **Save Draft** if you’d prefer to complete the form later.

question: How can I effectively choose keyword themes for my Google Ads campaign using Wix?
answer:
When picking your keyword themes for a Google Ads campaign using Wix, follow these guidelines:

* **Aim for a maximum of 7-10 keyword themes:** Adding too many keyword themes might show the ad in less relevant results. Your themes need to be relevant and concise enough so they show to the right audiences. Also, don't use punctuation marks, URLs, phone numbers, or keyword themes that exceed 20 characters.
* **Use long-tail keyword themes rather than short-tail keyword themes:** Long-tail keyword themes (e.g. 'organic coffee shops near me') are more effective than short-tail or single keywords (e.g. 'coffee shop'). Try to be as specific and descriptive to your business as possible to maximize the best audience.
* **Don't repeat words you are already eligible for:** Remember, a single keyword theme also represents similar phrases and words. For example, the keyword theme 'bakery' also means your ad will potentially be shown for searches like 'local bakery' 'cake shop' 'bakery near me.' So don't add both 'bakery' and 'local bakery' as two separate themes.
* **Utilize excluded terms:** Add [excluded terms](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-excluded-terms) to make sure your ad doesn't appear for irrelevant searches. For example, if you sell eyeglasses, you might want to add 'wine glasses' or 'drinking glasses' as excluded terms.
* **Remember your advertising strategy:** Are you advertising your overall business or a specific product/service? Limit your keyword themes to precisely what you're advertising.
* **Think like your customers:** What is your audience most likely to be searching for when looking for the product or service you offer? **Tip:** You can include brands as keyword themes without causing trademark issues.

question: How do I set up a Facebook and Instagram ad campaign using Wix?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Make sure you've completed the following setup steps:
1. Publish your site.
2. Upgrade your site by purchasing a plan.
3. Connect a custom domain.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Choose a campaign goal
1. [Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpaid-ads%3FreferralInfo%3Dkb-article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Select a goal:
   * **Boost sales:** Create a Sales campaign to promote your business to your audience likely to purchase your product and/or service.
   * **Get sales (For Wix Stores):** Create a Sales campaign with a dynamic image carousel or single image/video to advertise your products.
   * **Generate leads:** Create a Leads campaign to promote your business to your audience likely to share contact info or submit a form.
3. Click **Get Started**.
4. Sign in with your Facebook account.

#### Step 2 | Connect your Facebook assets
1. Click **Add Facebook Assets**.
2. Go through the steps to add your assets.
3. Next click **Connect Assets to Wix** and go through the steps to connect your accounts.
4. Click **Continue to Create Campaign**.

#### Step 3 | Choose your ad settings and targeting
1. Click the **Site page that your ad will lead to** drop-down to select the page visitors navigate to after clicking your ad (e.g. your Wix Stores product page).
2. Next select an option for campaign targeting:
   * **AI targeting:** Allow Meta's AI to find the optimal audience for your campaign.
     1. Enter the countries you want to target under **Targeted countries**.
     2. Click **Continue**.
   * **Custom targeting:** Define your own audience using specific demographics of people.
     1. Enter the places (cities, countries, zip codes) you want to target under **Targeted countries**.
     2. Continue refining your audience by selecting a gender, age range, and audience interests.
     3. Click **Continue**.

#### Step 4 | Create your ad content
1. Choose an ad format and follow the instructions to create your content.
   * **Dynamic carousel (Wix Stores only):**
     1. Enter your ad content. The limit is 500 characters.
     2. (Optional) View a preview of what a dynamic carousel might look like.
     3. Click **Continue**.
   * **Single image or video:**
     1. Enter your primary ad text. The limit is 500 characters.
     2. Upload media for your ad.
     3. Enter an ad headline. The limit is 40 characters.
     4. Click the **Call to action button** drop-down to choose an option.
     5. Click **Continue**.

#### Step 5 | Set your ad budget and launch
1. Choose an option under **Set campaign budget**:
   * **Select preset budget:** Choose a preset daily budget.
   * **Enter custom budget:** Enter an estimated daily spend for your campaign.
2. Click **Save & Checkout** to finish creating your campaign and submit your purchase.

Your campaign now goes into review for Wix and Meta approval. This process can take up to 72 hours. Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads in your site's dashboard to check on the approval progress.

question: How can I add or update MX records in my Wix account?
answer:
To add or update MX records in your Wix account, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the relevant domain.
3. Select **Edit MX Records**.
4. Click the drop-down menu and check if your email provider is listed:
   - **If your email provider is listed:** Select them from the list and click **Start Connecting**. You've just added your provider's MX records and do not need to continue adding them in the next steps.
   - **If your email provider is not listed:** Click **Other (provider not on the list)** and proceed to the next step.
5. Get your email provider's MX records (and any other necessary DNS records).
6. Add the MX records:
   - Click the **Points to** field and enter the mail server address of your MX record.
   - (If you have multiple MX records) Add the additional MX records:
     1. Click **+ Add Another**.
     2. Click the **Points to** field and enter the mail server address of the next MX record.
     3. Repeat this step for each additional MX record you need to add.
   - Click **Connect Business Email**.
7. (If instructed by your email provider) Add DNS records:
   - Click the **Show More** icon on the right and select **Manage DNS Records**.
   - Scroll to the record type you'd like to add (e.g., CNAME, TXT) and click **+ Add Record**.
   - Enter the DNS record in the relevant fields.
   - Click **Save**, then click **Save Changes** in the pop-up message.
   - Repeat steps 2-4 above to add more DNS records.

**Important:** When adding more than one MX record, add the record with the lowest [Priority value](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-the-priority-of-your-mx-records) first. They should appear in ascending order from lowest to highest Priority value. The Priority values themselves do not need to match your provider's directions.

question: How can I manage my group notifications on the Wix live site?
answer:
To manage your group notifications on the Wix live site, follow these steps:

1. Go to your live site and log in.
2. Go to the relevant group on your live site.
3. Click the **More Actions** icon at the top right of the group.
4. Click **Notification Settings**.
5. Choose where you want to get notifications from:

#### Website notifications

- Click the **Website notifications** toggle to manage site notifications (in the bell icon) when there are group updates:
  - **Enabled:** You receive site notifications when there are group updates. Select the checkboxes next to the updates you want to know about:
    - **Posts:** When someone posts in the group.
    - **Comments:** When someone comments in the group.
    - **Reactions:** When someone reacts to your post (e.g. with an emoji).
    - **Member Requests:** Get notified about new member requests.
    - **Group Updates:** When an admin makes changes to the group.
    - **New Members:** When new members join the group.
  - **Disabled:** You are not notified about group updates.

#### Email

- Click the **Email** toggle to get notified by email when there are group updates:
  - **Enabled:** You receive email notifications about the group updates you choose. Select the checkboxes next to the updates you want to know about:
    - **Posts:** When someone posts in the group.
    - **Comments:** When someone comments on your post.
    - **Member Requests:** Get notified about new member requests.
    - **Group Updates:** When an admin makes changes to the group.
    - **New Members:** When new members join the group.
  - **Disabled:** You do not receive email notifications about group updates.

**Note:** Notifications are sent to the email address you enter in the [business info](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-your-sites-business-information) of your site's dashboard.

#### Mobile app

- Click **Mobile App** to get notifications on the Wix mobile app for the following group updates:
  - **Enabled:** You receive notifications on the app about the group updates you choose. Select the checkboxes next to the updates you want to know about:
    - **Posts:** When someone posts in the group.
    - **Comments:** When someone comments in the group.
    - **Reactions:** When someone reacts to your post (e.g. with an emoji).
    - **Member Requests:** Get notified about new member requests.
    - **Group Updates:** When an admin makes changes to the group.
    - **New Members:** When new members join the group.
  - **Disabled:** You do not receive notifications on the app about group updates.

question: Does Wix support IPv6 for domains?

question: Can I add a scroll bar to text boxes in Wix Editor?
answer:
Currently, Wix does not support adding a scroll bar to text boxes due to their impact on site design and function. Scroll bars in text boxes are not supported because:

- It isn't advised in modern web design.
- They do not work well on touch devices (such as iPads and iPhones).
- It is advisable to have only one scroll bar on your site, and it should be the site scroll-bar.

As an alternative, you can add CSS to a [HTML element](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-about-embeds-and-codes-on-your-site) on your site. You can refer to the [tutorial available at w3schools](https://www.w3schools.com/cssref/tryit.php?filename=trycss_overflow) for guidance.

Please note that Wix is unable to provide support for external HTML codes that are added to Wix sites as the codes have not been tested by Wix.
