question: How can I create an automation in Wix Bookings to send discount coupons to clients after they book a session?
answer:
To create an automation for sending coupons in Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Automations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Wix%20Automations&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/triggers/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+ New Automation** or click an existing automation to edit it.
3. Click the title to give your automation a name.
4. Select **Bookings** as the trigger.
5. Choose an option under **Select a trigger for this app**:
   - **Session is booked:** This option is great for welcoming new clients.
   - **Booking is canceled by you or a client:** This option is useful for retaining clients after a cancelation.
   - **Client is checked-in for the 1st time:** Encourage your clients to book another session.
   - **Client is checked-in to first X sessions:** Reward clients for repeat business.
   - **Client is checked-in to a session:** Great for engaging with clients who try your newest services.
   - **Client was last checked-in a while ago:** Encourage clients to return to your business by offering a discount.
   - **A session starts:** Encourage clients to return as they are enjoying your services.
   - **A session ends:** Make it easy for clients to book their next session right away.
6. Choose which services the coupon automation applies to from the **Select which services trigger this automation** drop-down.
7. Select **Send coupon via email** as the action.
8. Select an option under **Set Coupon**:
   - **Yes, send unique single-use coupons:** Send unique single-use coupons to everyone that triggers the automation. The coupon you select in the next step will be duplicated with random characters added to its code.
   - **No, always send the same coupon:** Send the same coupon to everyone that triggers the automation.
9. Click the drop-down under **Set Coupon** and select an existing coupon template or [create a new one](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-creating-discount-coupons).
10. (Optional) Edit the coupon details, sender details, and [email template](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-customizing-automated-emails).
11. Click the **Timing** drop-down then set the timing and frequency for sending the coupons:
    - **Choose a time to send this action:** Click the drop-down and choose when to send the coupons (immediately or set a custom time).
    - **Limit frequency to:** Click the drop-down and choose how many times the same contact can trigger the automation.
12. (Optional) Click **+ Add Follow-up Action** to add more automations to the trigger.
13. Click **Activate.**

**Note:** The automation stops working when the coupon's end date or use limit is reached.

**Tip:** You can also create up to 1,000 coupons, each with unique codes, using the free [Bulk Coupon Creator app](https://www.wix.com/app-market/bulk-coupon-creator?referral=search-result&appIndex=0&referralTag=Bulk%20Coupon%20Creator&referralSectionName=search-result). question: Can I change the name server (NS) records for my Wix domain?

question: How can I ensure that a form in Wix CMS does not submit if a required field is left empty?
answer: Most input elements can be set as "Required." When an input element is required, the form will not submit if the field is empty. This prevents incomplete submissions and ensures that all necessary information is collected. If you set the connected collection field to "Required," users will see an error message if they attempt to submit the form with empty values. Note that switches do not have a "Required" option, but checkboxes do.

question: Is dark mode supported on the Wix platform?

question: How can I create a non-square logo using the Wix Logo Maker?
answer:
To create a non-square logo using the Wix Logo Maker, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Brand Studio](http://www.wix.com/logo/maker/esh).

   **Note:** If this is your first time creating a Logo in the Wix Logo Maker, skip to step 4.

2. Click the **My Brands** drop-down at the top.
3. Select the relevant brand.
4. Hover over the relevant logo design and click the Edit icon.
5. Choose the shape of your logo using the **Icons** panel or the **Shapes** panel:
   
   * **Symbols panel:**
     1. Click the **Symbols** icon on the left and search for your preferred symbol.
     2. Click the symbol to add it to your logo.
     3. Click the Move Backward icon as many times as necessary in the toolbar at the top of the Logo Maker.
     4. (If necessary) Resize and [customize](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-customizing-your-logo-in-the-wix-logo-maker) your logo elements.
   
   * **Shapes panel:**
     1. Click the **Shapes** icon on the left and select your preferred shape.
     2. Click the Move Backward icon as many times as necessary in the toolbar at the top of the Logo Maker.
     3. (If necessary) Resize and [customize](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-customizing-your-logo-in-the-wix-logo-maker) your logo elements.

6. Click **Next** at the top right to purchase and download your logo.
7. [Extract](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-extracting-your-logo-files-from-the-zip-folder) your files from the .zip folder and use the "Original on Transparent" logo file.

### Note
* Currently, it is not possible to cut out or erase parts of a shape, icon, or text in the Logo Maker. You can vote for this feature [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-request-cut-out-tool-to-remove-parts-of-a-shape-icon-or-text-in-the-wix-logo-maker). Be aware that if you try and achieve this effect by overlapping your logo with shapes or icons, they will be visible in the white, black, monochrome, grayscale and transparent files of the logo.
* [Learn how you can hide a specific element in your logo here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-hiding-and-deleting-elements-in-the-wix-logo-maker-9549844).

question: How do I set up my first card reader with the Wix Dashboard Card Reader solution?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Connect to Wix Payments and purchase the BBPOS WisePOS E card reader.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Connect to Wix Payments
Ensure you have connected to [Wix Payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-wix-payments-account).

#### Step 2 | Get the card reader
Order the BBPOS WisePOS E card reader from the [Wix POS shop](https://www.wix.com/en-ca/pos/hardware/product-page/wisepos-desktop-card-reader).

#### Step 3 | Unbox and charge your card reader
1. Unbox your card reader.
2. Insert the battery.
3. Press the power button to turn the reader on.
4. If required, charge your reader.

#### Step 4 | Connect your first card reader to WiFi
1. [Go to POS Checkout](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20In-Person%20Checkout&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/pos-checkout) in your site's dashboard.
2. Add a product, service, or charge to the cart (e.g., add a $1 charge from the **Custom Charge** tab).
3. Click **Charge** and select **Card**.
4. Click **Pair Reader**.
5. Select an option:
   - **WiFi networks are displayed:** Connect to the relevant network.
   - **WiFi networks not displayed:**
     1. Swipe right on your card reader screen.
     2. Tap the **Settings** button.
     3. Enter **07139** as the PIN code.
     4. Select **Network**.
     5. Connect to the relevant network.
6. Return to the popup and tap **Next**.

#### Step 5 | Generate and enter your code
1. Go back to the popup on your computer.
2. Select an option:
   - **Code is displayed:** Enter the three-word code in the pop-up, including the hyphens.
   - **Code not displayed:** Generate a code and enter it:
     1. Swipe right on your card reader screen.
     2. Tap the **Settings** button.
     3. Select **Generate pairing code**.
     4. Enter the three-word code in the pop-up, including the hyphens.
3. (Optional) Give your card reader a name.
4. Click **Pair Reader**.

After a reader is paired, you'll see it listed in your POS settings.

question: How can I schedule recurring appointments using Wix Bookings?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have discussed the details of the recurring appointments with your client.

To schedule recurring appointments using Wix Bookings, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Add the appointment to your calendar
1. [Go to Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **Add** drop-down at the top, or click to select a time slot on the calendar.
3. Click **Appointment**.

### Step 2 | Add the client details and select a service
1. Click to select the client details from the **Client Name** drop-down. You can also type in a new client's name and then click **+ Add to contacts**.
2. (Optional) Add the client's phone number.
3. Click **Continue**.
4. Select a service from the service list.

### Step 3 | Add the appointment details
1. Select the **Date** and **Arrival time** of the appointment.
2. Click the **Repeats** checkbox to make it a recurring appointment.
3. Select how frequently the recurring appointments take place from the **Repeats** drop-down.
4. Select the number of times the appointments repeat from the **For** drop-down. 

   **Note:** You can schedule a maximum number of 6 recurring appointments at a time.
5. Select the relevant **Location** from the drop-down.

### Step 4 | (Optional) Edit the appointment details
1. Click the **Edit** icon next to the appointment details.
2. Edit the session details:
   * **Session starts:** Enter the time the session starts.
   * **Duration:** Select the duration of the appointment.
   * **Staff member:** Select the staff member in charge of the service from the **Staff member** drop-down.
3. Select the relevant option from the **Payment options** drop-down:
   * **Use client's plan now**
   * **Use client's plan later**
   * **Collect payment**
4. Click **Save**.
5. Click **Continue**.

### Step 5 | Confirm the recurring appointment
1. (Optional) Click the **Remove** icon to remove any unwanted sessions.
2. Click the relevant option to choose what you want to do:
   * **Book**
   * **Book & Collect Payment**

### Step 6 | Charge your client from your Booking Calendar
1. Select the relevant appointment from your Booking Calendar.
2. Select the relevant option from the **Collect Payment** drop-down:
   * **Charge with pay link**
   * **Charge card manually**
   * **Charge with invoice**
   * **Mark as paid**

question: How can I customize the design of my Wix blog post page?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have accessed the Blog Post page in your Wix Editor or Studio Editor.

To customize the design of the post page:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to your Post page:
   
   1. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
   2. Click **Blog Pages**.
   3. Click **Post**.
3. Click the Post page in your editor.
4. Click **Settings**.
5. Click the **Design** tab.
6. Choose what you want to design:

### Navigation
Customize the design of the menu that appears at the top of the post page.
 
1. Click **Navigation**.
2. Customize the font style and color when your site visitors click and hover on the text in your blog post and adjust the post background opacity and color.

### Text style and color
Customize the design of the post text. Make sure to select a color and font that's easy to read. You can override these settings when writing the blog post.
 
1. Click **Text style and color**.
2. Customize the font style and color of your paragraph and heading text and change the color of your links and hashtags.

### Ratings
Customize the design of the star that shows the rating your post received.
 
1. Click **Ratings**.
2. Customize the opacity and color of the star used to indicate how your site visitors rate a post. Change the font and color of the ratings text.

### Tags
Customize the design of the tag labels that appear on your blog posts.
 
1. Click **Tags**.
2. Choose what you want to customize:
   
   * **Tag label:** Enable or disable the **Show Label** toggle to show or hide a tag label.
   * **Tag Layout:** Choose a layout for your tag and adjust its alignment.
   * **Spacing between tabs:** Drag the relevant slider to adjust the spacing between tabs.
   * **Tag Design:** Customize the Regular and Hover view of your tags by adjusting the fonts, background, and borders.

### Background and Buttons
Customize the design of the post background and buttons used on the post page.
 
1. Click **Background & Buttons**.
2. Choose what you want to customize:
   
   * **Post background:** Drag the relevant slider to adjust the post background.
   * **Button style** and customize the following: Click the color box to choose a color for your button text and background color.

question: How can I enable autoplay for videos in Wix Video, and what should I do if I'm using the strip layout?
answer:
To enable or disable autoplay in Wix Video, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Wix Video** player on your page.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Click the **Player** tab.
5. Click the **Autoplay on load** toggle:
   
   * **Enabled:** Your videos play automatically when the page loads.
   * **Disable:** Visitors have to click to play the videos.

### Note
Videos set to autoplay always start on mute due to browser restrictions.

### Using autoplay with the strip and slider layouts
The Autoplay on load toggle is not available for the strip and slider layouts. You can get a similar effect in strip layout using the following workaround:

1. [Go to Video Library](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Videos&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/video-library/videos) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Channels** on the left.
3. Select the channel that you want to play automatically.
4. Click **Edit** on the right.
5. Under **Channel cover**, click **Upload** or **Change**.
6. Add the video or GIF file that you want to autoplay.
7. Click **Save** on the top right.

Select the channel with the automatically playing cover to appear in the Wix Video player on your site:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click the **Wix Video** player on your page.
3. Click **Settings**.
4. Select the channel that you updated with the automatically playing cover video.
5. In the **Player** tab, select **Channel cover** under "What to show in frame"?

**Note**: Only GIF files will work on your mobile site.

question: How can I perform a ping test on my Windows computer to troubleshoot connection issues with my Wix site?
answer:
To perform a ping test on your Windows computer, follow these steps:

1. Right-click the **Start** menu and select **Run**.
2. Type **cmd**, and then click **OK**.
3. Enter your domain:
   * **If you have a domain connected to your site**: Type **ping www.domain.com** (replace **domain.com** with your own domain name).
   * **If you have a free site**: Type **ping site-url-prefix.wixsite.com** (replace **site-url-prefix** with your [Site URL prefix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/changing-your-wix-account-details#changing-your-account-details), located in your account settings).
4. Press **Enter**.
5. Take a [screenshot](https://support.wix.com/en/article/taking-a-screenshot-using-windows) of the information.
6. [Send your screenshot to Wix Customer Care](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-a-screenshot-to-a-ticket).

question: How can I access Hopp.bio pages in Indonesia if I'm experiencing issues due to governmental restrictions?
answer:

1. **Connect a Custom Domain**: [Upgrade to a Hopp Pro plan](https://support.wix.com/en/article/hopp-by-wix-upgrading-to-a-pro-plan) to connect a custom domain to your Hopp Link in Bio page.

2. **Try using "hopp.to" instead of “hopp.bio”**: Change "hopp.bio/example" to "hopp.to/example" whenever you share the link or in your browser.

### Please note
Custom domains can only be connected to Link in Bio pages. For landing pages and short links created with Hopp, please use the "hopp.to" URL instead of "hopp.bio".

question: How can I connect Online Travel Agency (OTA) channels to the Wix Hotels Channel Manager and what updates are automatically synchronized?
answer:
To connect Online Travel Agency (OTA) channels to the Wix Hotels Channel Manager, you need to set up the channel manager and connect to services. You can find detailed instructions on how to do this [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-your-hotel-to-booking-channels-using-the-channel-manager).

With OTA channels, the following changes are updated **automatically** in both systems (two-way synchronization):

- Minimum and Maximum night stays.
- Regular and seasonal rates.
- Temporary rate changes made with [Quick Rates](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editing-your-property-rates-using-quick-rates).
- Reservations made by guests through your Wix site.
- Reservations made by guests through an online travel agency.
- Room rates and weekend rates you set in the Rooms tab of your Wix Hotel manager.
- The length of stay you set in your Wix Hotel manager.

**Note:** You cannot make updates to dates you manually [set as not available](https://support.wix.com/en/article/marking-rooms-as-not-available-in-wix-hotels) in your Hotel calendar.

question: How can I view my page's source code in Google Chrome the way search engines do?

2. Open the page's source code view:
   
   * **Windows:** Right-click the page and select **View page source** (or **View source**). Alternatively, you can press **Ctrl + U** on your keyboard.
   * **Mac:** Press **Cmd** + **Option** + **U** on your keyboard.
3. Open the developer tools:
   
   * **Windows:** Press the **F12** key on your keyboard.

5. Hover over **More tools** and select **Network conditions**.
6. Deselect **Use browser default** under **User Agent**.
7. Select **Googlebot** from the drop-down menu.
8. Refresh the page.

question: How can I change the priority of MX records in Wix?
answer:
It is not possible, or necessary, to change the Priority values (e.g., 0, 10, 20) of MX records in Wix. The Priority values of your MX records are automatically determined by the order in which you add them. The first record you add is given a Priority value of 10, the next is given a Priority of 20, and so on.

When adding MX records, add the record with the lowest Priority value first. Then, continue adding the records in order, with the second lowest Priority value next, and so on. MX record Priority values are only arbitrary numbers that indicate the order of the records. Their numbers do not need to match the values in your email provider's directions, but they do need to be in the same order.

Learn more about [adding or updating MX records](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-or-updating-mx-records-in-your-wix-account).

question: Why does my Wix site display as a thin vertical strip on mobile devices, and how can I fix it?
answer:
If your Wix site appears as a thin vertical strip on mobile devices, it is likely due to an improper connection to a domain. Specifically, this issue arises when a domain is connected by masking, redirecting, or framing a free Wix URL, which is not supported. To fix this issue and ensure the integrity of your site's design, layout, and SEO, you must properly connect your domain to Wix. You can learn more about connecting your domain to your Wix site [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-the-wix-name-servers).

### Note
* It may take up to 48 hours for the domain record changes to take effect. You can learn more about domain propagation [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).
* If 48 hours have passed since you connected your domain to your Wix site and you're still unable to access your site via your domain, use the [Domain Troubleshooter](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-domain-assistant-3777632) to find out if there is a connection problem.

question: What does the 'Crawled - Currently Not Indexed' message mean in Google Search Console, and what steps can I take if I want my page to be indexed?
answer:
The 'Crawled - Currently Not Indexed' message in Google Search Console means that Google has crawled the page but chose not to index it. As a result, the URL won't appear in search results for the time being. This message doesn't indicate any errors on your page, and it's not necessary to resubmit the URL to be crawled and indexed. Depending on Google's decision, it may or may not be indexed in the future.

If you consider this page important to display in search results and the live test doesn't show any errors, you can try to [request indexing](https://www.google.com/webmasters/tools/googlebot-fetch). We recommend confirming that the page doesn't show any other errors or warnings by testing your live URL in Google's [URL Inspection Tool](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9012289?hl=en#test_live_page).

### Tip
Check our [content quality guidelines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/optimizing-your-sites-content-for-seo) to optimize your site's SEO.

question: How can I show or hide the number of participants in my online program using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To show or hide the number of participants in your online program using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Program Pages**.
4. Select the relevant program page.

   **Note:** The Program List page and Visitor Page automatically sync the setting that shows or hides the number of participants. Showing or hiding the number of participants in one of these pages also applies the change to the other page.

5. Click the relevant program element on your page.
6. Click **Settings**.
7. Click the **Display** tab.
8. Click the **Participants** toggle to change the visibility of the number of participants in your program:
   
   * **Enabled:** The number of program participants is displayed on your live site.
   * **Disabled:** The number of program participants is not displayed on your live site.
9. Publish your site when you're ready to make the change go live.

### Tip
[Customize the program details](https://support.wix.com/en/article/online-programs-customizing-your-program-pages) such as your program's cover image, duration of the program or number of program steps.

question: Can I set a price range for a product or assign multiple prices to the same product in Wix Stores POS?
answer:

question: Can I add locales to my site's languages in Wix Multilingual?

question: How can I create a new coupon for my online programs using the Wix dashboard?
answer:

2. Click **+ New Coupon**.
3. Select the type of coupon you want to offer:
   * **$ Discount**: Offer a fixed monetary discount amount.
   * **% Discount**: Offer a percentage discount.
4. Enter the **Coupon code** participants need to use the coupon.
5. Enter the **Coupon name** for your own records.
6. Enter the **Discount** you want to offer.
7. Select the relevant programs from the **Apply to** drop-down:
   * **All Programs:** Participants can use the discount for all programs.
   * **Specific Program:** The discount is available for the programs you choose. Select the relevant program from the **Program** drop-down.
8. Select the dates the coupon is valid between.
9. (Optional) Select the **Limit uses** checkbox(s) to:
   * **Limit the total number of uses for this coupon:** Set the number of times the coupon can be used.
   * **Limit to one use per customer:** The same participant can't use the coupon more than once.
10. Click **Create Coupon**.

question: How can I share a link to a specific service from my Dayful site using the Wix app on my mobile device?

question: How can I set up a PayPal Donate button on my Wix site?

1. **Add the PayPal Donate Button**: Navigate to the Wix Editor and add the PayPal Donate button to your site.
2. **Enter Organization Details**: Once added, input the relevant information such as the organization's name and ID number.
3. **Set Donation Amount**: You can either set a predetermined donation amount or allow your visitors to choose how much they want to donate.

When visitors click the button on your live site, they're directed to PayPal to complete the donation. Funds usually arrive in the linked account instantly. If you have more than one organization, you can add multiple Donate buttons to your site and link them to the relevant accounts.

For detailed instructions, visit [Learn how to add and set up your PayPal Donate Button](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-adding-and-setting-up-a-paypal-donate-button).

question: How can I use the calculation unit to set the size of elements in Editor X?
answer: In Editor X, the calculation unit is a handy tool when you need to accurately size an element while using fluid units of measure. You can write a "formula" that determines an element's width or height. This allows you to combine different measurements in the calculation, such as vh and px. For example, to design a header (100px) and a section that together take up the exact viewport height (100vh) on every screen size, you can set the section's height to (100vh - 100px). This ensures that the header is always taken into account in the calculation (100px). You can learn more about using calculation to determine the size of your elements [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/editor-x-setting-the-size-of-your-element#using-calculation-to-determine-the-size-of-your-elements).

question: What are the eligibility requirements for receiving the Google Ads credit offer with Wix, and how is the credit applied to my account?
answer:
To be eligible for the Google Ads credit offer with Wix, you must meet the following conditions:

1. You must be new to Google advertising and have not previously run a Google Ads campaign with your site.
2. You must spend $500 USD (or your currency equivalent) on ad clicks within the first 60 days of your campaign.

If you are eligible for this ad credit, Google applies it directly to your available ad credits, and you will receive a notification via email as well as in your site's dashboard. The ad credit is not refundable, and you must spend it within 60 days of receiving it in your account.

After you have spent $500 USD within the first 60 days, Google automatically applies the amount to your available ad credits. You will receive an email about the new credit, as well as a dashboard notification. Note that since the credit comes directly from Google, it may take a few days to see the credit applied to your account after you have fulfilled the requirements.

question: How does Wix determine if a contact is inactive in email marketing campaigns?
answer: Wix measures your contacts' behavior over time to discern who is an active contact and who is inactive. A contact turns inactive when a week passes after they have received at least 5 email marketing campaigns or automated emails and have not opened or clicked any of them. Any inactive contacts automatically become active again once they open an email campaign or an email from an automation they've triggered.

question: How can I customize my business card using the Wix Logo Maker?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have selected a card template from the Brand Studio.

To customize your business card in the Wix Logo Maker, follow these steps:

### Template
1. Click the **Templates** icon to choose a new card template.
2. Scroll through the available templates and select the one you like best.

### Palette
1. Click the **Palette** icon to change the card's color palette.
2. Scroll through the available color palettes and select the one you like best.

### Text
1. Click the **Text** icon on the left.
2. Hover over the text you want to customize and click **Customize**.
   - **Edit text:** Click the text field to replace the text.
   - **Font:** Click **Change Font** to select a new font.
   - **Alignment:** Select your text's alignment (left, center, right).
   - **Text fill color:** Click the color box to change the text's color.
   - **Fill color opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the text.
   - **Outline width:** Drag the slider to adjust the outline around your text.
   - **Text outline color:** Click the color box to choose the color of your text's outline.
   - **Size:** Drag the slider to change the text's size.
   - **Letter spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the space between the letters.
   - **Flip:** Click the relevant icon to flip the text horizontally or vertically.
   - **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the text.
   - **Text Curve:** Drag the slider to bend the text into a curve.
   - **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move the text left or right.
   - **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move the text up or down.
   - **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable a shadow behind the text and edit the shadow's properties.
   - **Blur:** Click the toggle to enable blurring and adjust the blurriness of the text.

### Symbols
1. Click the **Symbols** icon on the left.
2. Hover over the icon you want to edit and click **Customize**.
   - **Icon:** Click **Change icon** to replace the existing icon.
   - **Color:** Click the color box to edit the logo's color.
   - **Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the icon.
   - **Size:** Drag the slider to change the icon's size.
   - **Flip:** Click the relevant icon to flip the icon horizontally or vertically.
   - **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the icon.
   - **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move the icon left or right.
   - **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move the icon up or down.
   - **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable a shadow behind the icon and edit the shadow's properties.
   - **Blur:** Click the toggle to enable blurring and adjust the blurriness of the icon.

### Shapes
1. Click the **Shapes** icon on the left.
2. Hover over the shape you want to edit and click **Customize**.
   - **Shape:** Click **Change** to select a new shape.
   - **Fill color:** Click the toggle to enable color inside the shape's border.
   - **Color:** Click the color box to select the shape's color.
   - **Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of the shape's color.
   - **Border:** Click the toggle to display a border around your shape and edit the border's properties.
   - **Width:** Drag the slider to adjust the shape's width.
   - **Height:** Drag the slider to adjust the shape's height.
   - **Flip:** Click the relevant icon to flip the shape horizontally or vertically.
   - **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate the shape.
   - **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move the shape left or right.
   - **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move the shape up or down.
   - **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable a shadow behind the shape and edit the shadow's properties.
   - **Blur:** Click the toggle to enable blurring and adjust the blurriness of the shape.

### Images
1. Click the **Images** icon on the left.
2. Upload an image or select an image from the Wix Exclusive Images library.
   - **Size:** Drag the slider to adjust the size of your image.
   - **Opacity:** Drag the slider to adjust the transparency of your image.
   - **Flip:** Flip your image horizontally or vertically.
   - **Rotate:** Drag the slider to rotate your image.
   - **Horizontal position:** Drag the slider to move your image left or right.
   - **Vertical position:** Drag the slider to move your image up or down.
   - **Shadow:** Click the toggle to enable a shadow around your image and edit the shadow's properties.
   - **Blur:** Drag the slider to adjust the blurriness of your image.

### Background
1. Click the **Background** icon on the left.
2. Click the color box to change the background color. Choose from the suggested colors or select your own.

### Element arrangement
- To reposition elements using the Align drop-down:
  1. Click the element you want to reposition.
  2. Click **Align** on the toolbar.
  3. Select the position you want to move your element into.

- To rearrange elements using the same toolbar:
  1. Click the element you want to arrange.
  2. Click the relevant option:
     - **Move forward:** Moves the element forward one layer.
     - **Move backward:** Moves the element backward one layer.
     - **Duplicate:** Adds a copy of your element to the canvas.
     - **Delete:** Deletes the element.

**Tip:** You can press **Ctrl** + **A** or **Cmd** + **A** (if you're using a Mac) to select and group all the elements on your card, and move them around the canvas.

question: How can I create a dynamic page that lists items by category in my CMS?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have a [CMS collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-creating-a-collection) with items you want to categorize.
- Make sure you've created a [dynamic item page](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-setting-up-a-dynamic-item-page) for your collection.

### Step 1 | Add a field for categorizing your collection items
To display different categories of items on your site, your collection needs a field that defines which category each item belongs to. Add or choose a 'category' field in your collection, then enter values in the field to categorize each item.

#### To add a 'category' field to your collection:
1. Go to [CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20CMS&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the relevant collection.
3. Click **Manage Fields**.
4. Click **+ Add Field**, choose the **Text** or **Number** field type and click **Choose Field Type**.
5. Enter the **Field name** (e.g. Category).
6. (Optional) Update the **Field ID**.
7. (Optional) Enter **Help text**.
8. (Optional) Click the **Validations** tab.
9. (Optional) Click the **Default value** tab.
10. Click **Save**.
11. Enter the name of the category that each item belongs to in your new 'category' field.

### Step 2 | Add a dynamic page that lists items per category
Create a new dynamic list page for your collection. This dynamic page will serve as a template with different versions for each category.

#### Wix Editor
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **CMS** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click **Your Collections**.
4. Hover over the relevant collection and click the **More Actions** icon.
5. Click **Add dynamic page**.
6. Select **List page** and click **Add to Site**.

### Step 3 | Modify the URL slug structures
You need to convert your new dynamic list page to a type of dynamic item page that lists items per category. To do so, edit the page's URL slug structure.

#### To edit the URL slug structure of your dynamic 'category' page:
1. Hover over the dynamic list page, click the **More Actions** icon and select **SEO**.
2. Edit the **URL slug structure** so it includes your 'category' field and does not conflict with existing URL slug structures.
3. Press **Enter** on your keyboard.
4. (Optional) Rename your dynamic category page.

### Step 4 | Customize your dynamic category page
Your dynamic 'category' page should now act as a dynamic item page with different versions for each of your categories.

#### To customize your dynamic category page:
1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Go to your dynamic category page.
3. (Optional) Add elements to your repeater or remove elements you do not need.
4. Click the repeater element and select the **Connect to CMS** icon.
5. In the **Connect Repeater** panel, click the element you want to connect.
6. Under **Connections**, click the relevant drop-downs to connect the element to the relevant collection field or dataset action.
7. Click **Preview** and use the toolbar to test each version of your dynamic category page.
8. Click **Publish** if you are ready to make the changes go live.

question: Can I add a nested list type property to the widget API in Wix Blocks?
answer: Currently in Blocks, you can add a [list type property](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-an-app/develop-your-app/frameworks/wix-blocks/blocks-widget-api/creating-and-managing-list-type-properties-in-widget-api) to the [widget API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-an-app/develop-your-app/frameworks/wix-blocks/blocks-widget-api/about-the-widget-api). question: Can I save a form design as an asset in Wix Forms to reuse it on another site?

question: How can I add tax to ticket sales in Wix Events?
answer:
To collect tax on ticket sales in Wix Events, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. [Create a ticketed event](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-events-creating-a-single-event) and [create tickets](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-tickets-for-your-event) for the event.
3. Click the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Edit** next to **Ticket settings**.
5. Enable the **Tax** toggle.
6. Enter the tax name (e.g. VAT or Sales Tax). **Note:** The tax name appears on the checkout page.
7. Enter the tax rate (e.g. 10%).
8. Select how you want to add the tax:
   
   * **Add tax to the total sale at checkout:** The tax is added on top of the ticket price during checkout.
   * **Include tax in the ticket price:** Tax is included in the ticket price. The breakdown is displayed during checkout.
9. Click the **Apply tax to pay what you want tickets** toggle to enable or disable it. 

   **Tip:** The "Pay what you want" ticket type allows guests to set their own ticket price.
10. Click **Save**.

question: How can I view and chat with live site visitors using Wix Chat?
answer:
To view and chat with your live site visitors using Wix Chat, follow these steps:

1. **Go to your site's [dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Your%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fhome/?referralInfo=KB_Article).**
   
   **Note:** This feature is available from any section of your dashboard.

2. **Click the Inbox icon** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/71d20af0-560e-44a5-bb38-bf3f513b58fa/2021/03/30/ea659175-bf24-40e3-b3f7-adeb8a97a7a4/09f14519-f75a-4e7c-91d9-bec24db109d7.png) **at the top right corner.** All current site visitors are displayed in the pop-up window.

3. **Click a visitor to open a new inbox message.**

   **Note:** If a live site visitor has provided info in the past (e.g. filled out a contact form) their name appears. If they haven't provided any information they appear as "Visitor #".

4. **From Wix Inbox, choose what you want to do:**

   **Chat with the visitor**
   1. Type your message in the text box.
   2. Click **Send** at the bottom right.

   **Note:** Make sure your chat status is set to 'online' so the visitor can see you're available to chat. To check your chat status:
   1. Click the **Settings** drop-down at the top right of your inbox.
   2. Enable the **Chat Status** toggle.

5. **View the visitor's site activity**
   At the top of the inbox message, you can see all available information about the site visitor including:
   * The site page they're viewing
   * The type of device they're using

     **Note:** Hover over the site page to view the device type
   * How long they've been on your site
   * The number of times they've visited your site

     **Note:** Hover over the site time to see visit number
   * Their location

**Tips:**
* You can also view and chat with live site visitors from the Wix app. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-viewing-and-chatting-with-live-site-visitors)
* [Enable desktop notifications](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-inbox-managing-your-notification-settings) to make sure that you never miss a chat.

question: How can I add and set up a Featured Service element on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?

question: How can I customize the menu icon in the Wix mobile editor?

2. Click the Design icon ![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/j-rXK3SQAEZoPrh7cdaR14ihsCQqEsLllKBidFTcrvvztKxDV-KXxP_BjTpNXNFmd-j-f7zbM_TsxRf3_6HB0Mfsxvow9tuHcYoCJbE5Bn5rvLLWaC4EFHvpkQw9kmMhLaUiL-V3=s0).
3. Select a preset from the options available.
4. Click **Customize Design**.
5. Select which state you'd like to customize the icon for by clicking a tab (**Closed** or **Open**).

### Customize the fill color and opacity
- Click the Fill Color and Opacity tab ![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/jqWP8aSlXJqE3EewMHJPH5CtulJQ0ehQTAR_6B6c58Geogt9WjK8-dCAyE2SNcj-nXfJ5HWjVWv09tSj7dm12nhi2dpSh4NSnk6pqZiACZ5lMitxFsJwDTTgO80cIezsiS9c8FMkoMWUnIDFLSgyfIc) and customize it with the options:

question: How can I use calculation to determine the size of an element in Editor X?
answer:
To use calculation to determine the size of an element in Editor X, follow these steps:

1. Select the relevant element in Editor X.
2. Click the Inspector icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8696077d-830a-4b1e-bd86-9df98f89994a/2020/06/12/79bb96e0-651e-4f0c-a50a-0aeea89045a8/13421282-6c31-40a6-9205-5a4625d5c38d.png) at the top of Editor X.
3. Under **Size**, click the current measurement (e.g., px, %, etc.) marked in blue.
4. Click **Calculation**.
5. Enter the formula for your element's width or height.

For instance, use calculation to design a header (100px) and a section that, together, take up the exact viewport height (100vh) in every screen size. You can set the section's height to (100vh \- 100px), so the header is always taken into account in the calculation (100px).

question: Can I add a watermark to my images in the Wix Pro Gallery?
answer: Currently, you cannot add a watermark to your uploaded images in the Wix Pro Gallery in order to protect the copyright. As a workaround, you can create and add a watermark [using text in the Wix Photo Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-using-the-wix-photo-studio-tools#text). Be aware that when doing this, it is not possible to add text to multiple images at once. The text needs to be added to each image separately.

question: How can I delete multiple images from the Shared Gallery app on my live site?
answer:
To delete multiple images or videos from your live site:

1. Go to the Shared Gallery app on your live site.
2. Log in using the email address associated with your Wix account.
3. (Optional) If you've created albums, select the album that has the images or videos you want to delete.
4. Click the **More Actions** icon above the image or video.
5. Choose **Select** from the dropdown menu.
6. Select the images or videos that you want to delete.
7. Click **Delete** in the top right corner of the app.
8. Click **Delete** in the pop-up to confirm.

### Tip
Click **Delete All Media** from the **Settings** tab in your Editor to reset your gallery and delete all images and videos at once.

question: How can I connect a domain I already own to Wix using the enterprise solution?
answer:
To connect a domain you already own to Wix, follow these steps:

1. **Update the DNS Records:** You need to update the DNS records in your domain host account (usually the company you bought your domain from). This involves changing the name servers so that Wix hosts your DNS.

2. **Follow the Step-by-Step Outline:** Wix Studio for enterprise provides a step-by-step outline to help you with this process.

Once the domain has been connected, it can take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and your site to appear worldwide.

question: How can I ensure explicit consent for email marketing on my Wix site?
answer:
To ensure explicit consent for email marketing on your Wix site, you can use the following methods:

1. **Using Wix Forms**: Add an opt-in checkbox to your form. This requires site visitors to check the box and confirm consent before subscribing. You can learn how to do this by following the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-a-subscriber-opt-in-checkbox-to-a-site-form).

2. **Get Subscribers**: Add a checkbox to obtain explicit consent from site visitors. You can also link your [privacy policy](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-privacy-policy) or your [terms and conditions policy](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-a-terms-and-conditions-policy). For more details, click [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-elements-to-your-email-campaign).

Remember, it is your responsibility to ensure that Wix services comply with your local laws, and you should seek legal advice to understand and prepare for any additional requirements.

question: Can I run multiple Google Ads campaigns for one site using Wix?

question: Can I connect a drop-down input element to a Multi-Reference field in a collection?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to connect an input element, such as a drop-down or radio buttons, to a [Multi-Reference field](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-multi-reference-fields) in a collection.

question: How can a visitor log out of a password protected page on a Wix site?
answer: A password protected page requires your site visitors to enter a password. They are not required to log in. Therefore, there is no option to log out. If your site visitors would like to re-enter the password, they need to clear their [browser's cache](https://support.wix.com/en/article/clearing-your-browsers-cache) to remove the password memory. The next time that they try to access the page, they will be required to insert the password again.

question: How can I ensure that my Multibanco payment method is active on Wix?
answer: In order to accept online payments, you must connect a payment provider. Once connected, your checkout will be active for your chosen payment method(s). You need to have your account successfully verified to receive payouts.

question: What are the steps to create a Facebook & Instagram Ads campaign using Wix?
answer:
To get started creating a Facebook & Instagram Ads campaign using Wix, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Facebook & Instagram Ads](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Facebook%20Ads&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpaid-ads%3FreferralInfo%3Dkb-article) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Start Advertising**.
3. Complete the **Get ready to advertise on Facebook & Instagram** checklist which includes:
   1. Publishing your site
   2. Upgrading your site by purchasing a plan that fits your business
   3. Connecting a custom domain
4. Connect your meta assets to Wix including the Facebook page you want to advertise, the relevant Meta Business Account, and a Facebook Pixel & Conversions API (CAPI).
5. Build your campaign including customizing your ad targeting, creating your ad content, and setting a budget.
6. Purchase a Facebook & Instagram Ads with Wix subscription and launch your campaign.

A new Meta Ads account is created for you when you launch a Facebook & Instagram Ads campaign with Wix. Any existing Meta Ads accounts you may have are separate from this account.

question: How can I change the focal point of an image in my Wix Photo Album?
answer:
To change the focal point of an image in your Wix Photo Album, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/photography-albums/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage** next to the relevant album.
3. Click **Customize** at the top right.
4. Hover over your gallery in the panel on the left and click **Manage Media**.
5. Select an image and click the **Focal point** icon under the selected image.
6. Click the position on the thumbnail image where you want the focal point to be. The focal point is displayed as a white circle. 

**Tip:** You can also click and drag the circle over the image to select a focal point.
7. Click **Done**.

question: How does Wix ensure the security of user information during the signup process?
answer: Wix's signup and login services are completed through a secure server. The information provided to Wix in the signup process is secured via HTTPS/SSL communication. Additionally, Wix uses cryptography hash functions to protect your information. Your password is stored as a hash digest and, in the event of a security breach, your original password cannot be recovered from our servers.

question: How can I create and share a favorites list for my clients using Wix Photo Albums?
answer:
To create and share a favorites list for your clients using Wix Photo Albums, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Photo Albums](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Photo%20Albums&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/photography-albums/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Create a new album. [Learn how to create an album](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-photo-albums-creating-a-photo-album)
3. Click **Publish Now**.
4. Click **Manage Album Settings**.
5. Click **Get Started** under **Favorites lists** on the right.
6. Click **+Create List**.
7. Add a name for your list.
8. (Optional) Add instructions or additional information for your clients under **Add a note**.
9. Select who can access your list under **Privacy settings**.
   * **Public:** Anyone that can view your album can view this list.
   * **Secret:** Only people with the link can access the list.
10. Click **Save**.
11. Choose how you want to share the link, or tap **View List** to see what it looks like.
    * **Copy link:** Copy the link and send it to your client.
    * **Email:** Send the link via email.
    * **WhatsApp:** Send the link via WhatsApp.

**Tip:** After you've created your list, you can view it on your live site, download the photos that your clients select, update your list's information, and manage your list's members. [Learn more about managing your favorites list](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-photo-albums-managing-your-favorites-lists).

question: Can I have different form layouts per breakpoint in Wix Forms?
answer: Currently in the [new Wix Forms,](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-adding-and-customizing-a-form) it's not possible to have different form layouts per breakpoint. On the mobile breakpoint, the form is always shown in a single column layout.

question: What are the Wix Content Guidelines and where can I find them?
answer: Wix Content Guidelines are part of Wix.com's commitment to providing a positive and respectful online experience. These guidelines articulate the acceptable content on the platform based on Wix's core values and provide transparent information about content moderation principles. You can find the guidelines at [Wix Content Guidelines](https://www.wix.com/about/content-guidelines).

question: How can I create and publish a blog post from my mobile device using Wix?
answer:
To create a post from a mobile device:

1. On a browser on your mobile device, access your blog page.
2. Log in using the email associated with your Wix account.
3. Tap **Create a Post**. 
   **Note:** The "Create a Post" button is only visible to those with writing privileges.
4. Write your post title and content.
5. Click **Save & Continue**.
6. Do any of the following: 
   
   * **Choose Category:** 
     
     1. Tap to select up to three categories.
     2. Tap **Done**.
   * **Save as Draft:** Tap to save. You can publish the post later.
   * **Save & Publish:** Tap to publish your post on your live site.

You can perform almost all blog functions (editing, adding categories, etc.) using your mobile device. You can also add any of the following to a post:

* [Images or GIFs](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-media-to-a-blog-post): Click the **Image** icon and select an image or GIF to upload.
* [Galleries](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-media-to-a-blog-post): Click the **Gallery** icon and select images to upload.
* [Videos](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-media-to-a-blog-post): Click the **Video** icon and add a link from YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook.
* [Divider lines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-divider-lines-to-blog-posts): Click the **Divider** icon to add a divider line, then customize it.
* [HTML](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-html-code-to-a-blog-post): Click the **HTML** icon to embed an iframe or display an external site in a post.
* **Quotations:** Highlight the text you want to quote and click the **Quotation** icon.
* **Links:** Highlight the text you want to make into a link, click the **Link** icon, enter the URL and click **Update**. (Optional) Select the **Add a nofollow tag**.
* [Hashtags](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-blog-adding-hashtags-to-blog-posts): Add a hashtag symbol (#) and text with no spaces (e.g. #newclasses) anywhere in a post.

question: How can I update the Simplified View settings for my Wix site on Chrome for Android?

question: How can I add a Members Area to my Wix restaurant website using the Wix Editor?

question: How can I create a new price quote using the Wix app?
answer:
To create a new price quote using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the [Wix app](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-owner-app-an-overview).
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Tap **Price Quotes** under **Getting Paid**.
4. Tap **Create Price Quote**.
5. Tap **\+ Choose a contact** to select the recipient of your price quote. 

   **Note:** If the recipient isn't yet a contact, you can add them to your Contact List.
6. Enter your price quote title, expiration date, and default payment terms in the **Quote Details** section.
7. Tap **\+ Add Items** in the **Product or Service** section to select the relevant product or service. 

   **Note:** You can add a new product or service if needed.
8. (Optional) Tap **Add** next to **Discount** to add a discount.
9. (Optional) Tap **Edit** next to **Notes** or **Legal Terms** to make updates.
10. Tap **Next** in the top right.
11. Choose what you want to do:

    * **Share via:** Share a link to this price quote via one of your device's native apps.

    * **Preview:** View a preview of the price quote your recipient will see.
    * **Save and close:** Save your price quote as a draft.

question: How can I set up a Zapier automation to connect Wix with a third-party app?
answer:
To set up a Zapier automation to connect Wix with a third-party app, follow these steps:

1. [Log in to your Zapier account](https://zapier.com/app/login).
2. The Zapier automation builder will open. Use the panel on the right to set up your automation. First, use the "Event" drop-down to select the Wix app that you want to trigger your automation.
   
   **Note:** If you can't find the trigger you want, select "Wix custom triggers" to create a custom trigger. If you select this option, you need to set up your automation in [Wix Automations](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-automations-getting-started) and then return to Zapier to complete setup.
3. In the "App & event" section, click "Continue".
4. In the "Account" section, click "Continue".
   
   **Note:** Before continuing, you may need to sign into your Wix account and grant Zapier permissions to connect to Wix.
5. In the "Trigger" section, use the "Select specific trigger to use" drop-down to select your exact trigger (based on the Wix app you already selected).
   
   **Note:** At this stage, you may have further selections to make to define your trigger.
6. In the "Trigger" section, click "Continue".
7. In the "Test" section, click "Test trigger" to test your trigger and select a test record to use.
   
   **Note:** When you test your trigger, "dummy data" is used. This is not real data from your site, even though the Zapier platform mentions collecting data and using it to test the trigger.
8. Click "Continue with selected record".
9. In the pop-up that opens, select your action app.
10. Use the panel on the right to continue setting up your automation. Select your action event.
11. In the "Account" section, click "Continue".
    
    **Note:** Before continuing, you may need to sign into an external account (e.g. Google account for a Google product) and grant Zapier permissions to connect to this account.
12. Make any further selections required to define your action (e.g. for Google Sheets action, select drive, spreadsheet, worksheet, data to add, etc.).
13. Click "Continue".
14. Click "Test step" to test this step.
15. Check that the test has been successful (e.g. row successfully added to Google Sheet).
16. Click "Publish".

### Note
You will be able to create a Zapier automation for a Wix app that hasn't been added to your site, but your automation won't function. If the app has been added to your site but there is no data triggering your automation, nothing will happen.

question: How can I add alt text to items in my Wix Pro Gallery to improve SEO?

question: How can I set up shipping rates by product in Wix Stores?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure that any previous shipping and tax settings in a merchant account (e.g., PayPal) are removed before starting.

To set up shipping rates by product in Wix Stores, follow these steps:

### Step 1 | Create or Select a Shipping Region
1. Go to the [Shipping & fulfillment](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Shipping&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list?referralInfo=sidebar) settings in your site's dashboard.
2. Select an option:
   - **Edit a default rule:** Click the region you want to set up.
   - **Create a new rule:**
     1. Click **Add Region**.
     2. Click **+Add destination**, start typing a country name and select it.
3. (Optional) Select specific region(s) within a country:
   1. Click **Edit** next to the region number.
   2. Deselect the checkboxes next to the regions or states you don't want the rule to apply to and click **Done**.
4. (Optional) Click the title (e.g., Region 2) and rename it (e.g., England & Scotland).
5. Click **Done** or move directly on to the next step.

### Step 2 | Create Product Groups and Add Products to the Group
1. Click **Shipping**.
2. Select **Rate by Product** from the **Select how shipping is calculated** drop-down.
3. Create your first group:
   1. Click **Create Groups**.
   2. Give this group a name (e.g., Default).
   3. Click **Next**.
4. Create your next group:
   1. Click the **Setting** icon at the top right.
   2. Select **+Add New Group**.
   3. Give this group a name (e.g., Heavy).
   4. Click **Add Group**.
5. (Optional) Add additional groups.
6. Assign each product to a group by selecting the relevant group from the drop-down.
7. When you've created all your groups and assigned every product to a group, click **Done**.

### Step 3 | Set Shipping Rates for Product Groups
1. Create the first delivery option:
   1. Enter a title in the **Shipping Option Name** field (e.g., Standard Shipping).
   2. (Optional) Enter the estimated delivery time.
   3. Enter the shipping fees for each product group.
2. (Optional) Click the **Offer free shipping when customer buys over a certain amount** checkbox and enter the amount.
3. (Optional) Click **+Add Another Delivery Option** to offer customers another shipping option (e.g., Express shipping). Follow the same instructions to set up delivery times and rates.

### Step 4 | Select Advanced Settings
1. Select how to apply the shipping rates at checkout:
   - **Apply group rate to each product in the order:** For example, the "Ceramics" shipping group has a $5 charge. If a customer buys 2 vases, they are charged $10 for shipping.
   - **Apply group rate once for all products ordered from a group:** For example, the "Ceramic" shipping group has a $5 charge. If a customer buys 2 vases, they are charged $5 for shipping the 2 vases.
   - **Apply the highest group rate once to the entire order:** For example, the "Ceramics" shipping group has a $5 charge and the "Towel" shipping group has a $2 charge. When a customer buys a vase and a towel, they are charged $5 for the order.
2. (Optional) Select the **Add a handling fee to every order** checkbox and enter the amount.

### Step 5 | (Optional) Offer Local Delivery or Pickup Options
After saving your shipping rule, you can select the region again and add local delivery or pickup options.
- Add local delivery [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-setting-up-local-delivery)
- Add store pickup [Learn how](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-setting-up-store-pickup-as-a-delivery-option)

### Step 6 | (Optional) Set Up Additional Regions
If you want to ship to other regions, you can set those up now. For other regions, follow the same instructions as above, skipping the product group creation step (that's done). After choosing a new region (e.g., Canada) and selecting **Rate by Product** from the drop-down, enter the name, time, and rates for each delivery option you want to set up. The product groups are already there.

question: How can I manage my messages in Wix Inbox?
answer:
To manage your messages in Wix Inbox, follow these steps:

1. Go to [Inbox](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Inbox&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/inbox/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Hover over the relevant message and click the More Actions icon.
3. Choose what you want to do:
   
   ### Save as contact
   - Click **Save as contact**.
   - Enter contact details and choose to add a label or assignee.
   - Click **Save**.
   
   ### Archive a message
   - Click **Archive**.
   - To view and manage archived messages, click **All conversations** at the top left of your inbox and select **Archive**.
   
   ### Star a conversation
   - Click **Star conversation** to mark the message as starred.
   - To view and manage all starred messages, click **All conversations** at the top left of your inbox and select **Starred**.
   
   ### Mark a message as unread
   - Click **Mark as unread**.
   
   ### Report as spam
   - Click **Report as spam**.
   - Click **Report & Delete**.
   
   ### Delete a message
   - Click **Delete**.
   - Click **Delete** in the pop-up to confirm.

To perform the same action on multiple messages, hover over the messages you want to select and click the checkboxes to the left of each message. Then, click the appropriate icon for the action you want to perform, such as Archive, Mark as Unread, or Delete.

question: How can I select an element in the Wix Editor if it's behind another element?
answer:
Prerequisites: Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor.

If an element is behind another element in the Wix Editor, you can use the Overlapping Items feature to select it. Here are the steps to do so:

1. Right-click the element covering the element you're trying to select.
2. Hover over **Overlapping Items**.

question: How can I troubleshoot issues with my Meta Pixel not showing data in Facebook Business Manager after adding it to my Wix site?
answer:
If your Meta Pixel is not showing data in Facebook Business Manager after adding it to your Wix site, follow these troubleshooting steps:

1. **Use the Meta Pixel Helper extension**: This tool helps identify and troubleshoot common Meta Pixel issues. [Learn more](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-pixel/support/pixel-helper/#troubleshooting).

2. **Check that your domain is connected properly**: Ensure your domain is connected to your site. Use the [Wix Domain Assistant](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-domain-assistant-3777632) to resolve any domain issues.

3. **Check that you added your Meta Pixel correctly**: Make sure your site is connected to your Meta Pixel in [Marketing Integrations](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fmarketing-integration%3FreferralInfo%3Dmarketing_integrations_article_link&title=Marketing%20Integrations&buttonText=Add%20Integrations) in your site's dashboard. You should see **Connected** in the top right corner. Do not embed the Meta Pixel code directly into your site using the HTML element.

4. **Check that you don't have an ad blocker on your browser**: Disable ad blocking on Wix if you're using AdBlock or Ad-Blocker. 
   - **AdBlock**: 
     1. Click the AdBlock button in your browser.
     2. Click **Don't run on pages on this site** (Chrome) or **Don't run on pages on this domain** (other browsers).
     3. Click **Exclude**.
     4. Refresh the page.
   - **Ad-Blocker**: 
     1. Click the Ad-Blocker button in your browser.
     2. Click **Enabled on this site** to disable the option.
     3. Refresh the page.

5. **Check that the Meta Pixel ID was added to your PRIMARY domain**: 
   - Go to [Custom Code](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fmanage-website%2Fembeds%2F&title=Select+a+Site&primaryButtonText=Manage+Custom+Code) in your site's dashboard.
   - Click the **Show More** icon next to **Meta Pixel** and select **Edit**.
   - Check that the correct domain is selected under **Select Domain**. If not, select the correct domain and click **Apply**.

6. **Check that you haven't added your Meta Pixel ID in more than one place**: Ensure the Meta Pixel ID is not added to both the [Google Tag Manager](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-google-tag-manager-to-your-wix-site) and Marketing Integrations. Remove it from one location if necessary.

**Note:** If your site uses a cookie banner, the Meta Pixel will only gather data after a visitor consents to using the relevant cookies. [Learn More](https://support.wix.com/en/article/displaying-a-cookie-banner-on-your-site).

question: How can I create a price quote in Wix Studio?
answer:
To create a price quote in Wix Studio, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Marketplace Overview](https://users.wix.com/login/select-workspace?redirect_to=https://manage.wix.com/studio/marketplace) in your Wix Studio workspace.
2. Click the **Price Quotes** tab on the left.
3. Click **\+ New Quote** at the top right.
4. Enter the quote info:
   * **Title:** Give a title for this quote.
   * **Customer:** Choose a client to send this quote to.
   * **Expiry Date:** Select the date this quote expires.
   * **Payment Terms:** Select the payment terms for this quote (**Due on Receipt** / **Net \+ 15** / **Net \+ 30** / **Net \+ 60** or **Set custom terms**).
5. Enter the quote details:
   * **Product or Service:** Select a product or service to add to the quote. 
     **Tip:** Select **\+ Add Item** to create a price quote for a new item. Then enter the details and click **Save**.
   * (Optional) **Description:** Enter a description for the product or service.
   * **Price:** Enter a price for the product or service.
   * **Quantity:** Enter the quantity of the product or service.
   * (Optional) **Tax 1 / Tax 2:** Add one or two tax rates to the quote.
   * (Optional) **\+ Add Line Item:** Add additional services to the quote.
   * (Optional) **Discount:** Apply a percentage discount to the total amount.
6. Enter additional info for the quote:
   * **Notes:** Enter any notes you'd like your client to be aware of.
   * **Terms:** Enter any terms that apply to this price quote. 
     **Note:** These fields appear at the bottom of your price quote.
7. Save or send your price quote:
   * **Save:** Click **Save as Draft** to save the price quote.
   * **Send:** Click **Next** to preview the quote. Then click **Send** to review the content of the email your client will receive. Click **Send** again to send the price quote to your client.

question: How can I cover a negative balance in my Wix Payments account?

[Go to Payments](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Your%20Transactions&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fpayments-dashboard/?referralInfo=KB_Article) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I reset my default A and CNAME records in my Wix account?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that your domain is not connected via pointing. If it is, these directions do not apply, and you should contact your domain host for help with resetting your DNS records.

### Step 1 | Reset your default A records
1. [Go to Domains](https://manage.wix.com/account/domains) in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/d6b40156-9694-4cfe-9209-54815ef9d6dc/2019/06/28/96c47964-91f2-4fc2-a3b9-869eb342b57a/ac38f09f-0dca-459b-9133-d47d229f7f02.png) next to the relevant domain and select **Manage DNS Records**.
   
   **Note:** If you're not seeing this option, your domain may be [connected via pointing](https://support.wix.com/en/article/connecting-a-domain-to-wix-using-the-pointing-method). You'll need to contact your domain host to reset your records.
3. Hover over the A record that has your domain name in the **Host Name** field and click **Edit**.
   
   **Note:** Click **\+ Add Record** in the A (Host) section if you need to add the A record.
4. Click the **Value** field and enter the following IP address: **185.230.63.107**
   
   **Note:** Leave the **Host name** field blank.
5. Click **Save**, then **Save Changes** in the pop-up message.

### Step 2 | Reset your default CNAME records
From the same **Manage DNS Records** page as the previous step:
1. Hover over the CNAME record that has **www.** before your domain name and click **Edit**.
   
   **Note:** Click **\+ Add Record** in this section if you need to add the CNAME record.
2. Type **www** in the **Host name** field.
3. Click the **Value** field and enter the following address: **initial.wixdns.net**
4. Click **Save**, then **Save Changes** in the pop-up message.

### Next
It can take up to 48 hours for your domain's new DNS records to propagate and for your site to appear worldwide. Learn more about [domain propagation](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-domain-propagation).

question: Can I transfer an existing Facebook Ads campaign from one site to another in Facebook Ads?

question: How can I customize the SEO settings for my Wix site's pages using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To customize the SEO settings for your site's pages in the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26).
2. Click **Pages & Menu** on the left side of the editor.
3. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant page.
4. Click **SEO basics**.
5. Customize any of the following SEO settings:
   * **URL slug (last part of the page's URL)**: This text is the last part of your page's URL. You should only change this if it's necessary to reflect the content of your page. We recommend keeping it short and easy to read.
   * **Title tag (title in search results)**: Add a title tag that summarizes the content of the page. Enter your title tag as it is meant to appear on search engines results.
   * **Meta description (description in search results)**: Add a short meta description of the content on the page. This description helps users decide if the page is relevant to them.
6. Publish your site.

question: What are the requirements for displaying business contact information on my Wix site to ensure my account can be verified with Wix Payments?
answer:
To ensure your account can be verified with Wix Payments, you need to add the name of your business and easy-to-find contact details to your site. Hard-to-find or no contact information is a major source of frustration for your visitors, as well as a reason why your account cannot be verified on Wix Payments. 

### Business Name
Display your business name clearly on your website. It can be the name of your business entity, or your “Doing Business As” name. If you’re a sole proprietor, this may be your own name. When presenting your legal business name (i.e. your corporate, LLC or partnership name), or your trade name (your Doing Business As name), in your website, make sure it's identical to the ones you provided during your Wix Payments account setup. The business name you display on your site should also appear as your [statement descriptor](https://support.wix.com/en/article/customizing-your-wix-payments-statement-descriptor), which is the business name your customers see on their card statements.

### Business Location
Add your business’s physical address, including the country. Make it easy for your clients to see this information before they complete a payment or book a service. This information is usually placed on the [footer](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-placing-elements-in-your-header-footer-and-page#moving-elements-to-the-footer) and [checkout area](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-about-your-basic-site-info) for easy visibility. Please, note that certain types of addresses, such as a post office box or mail-forwarding address, are not considered valid business addresses.

### Customer Service Contact Information
Your site needs to include an email address and/or telephone number where customers can reach you. We recommend giving customers multiple ways to contact you.

question: What are the differences between Wix SMS and Wix Business Phone Number for sending text messages?
answer:
Wix offers two products for sending SMS (text) messages to your customers: **Wix SMS** and **Wix Business Phone Number**.

- **Wix SMS** automatically sends pre-installed texts, such as reminder texts to your Wix Bookings customers, confirmation texts to your Wix Table Reservations customers, or order updates to your Wix Restaurants Orders (New) customers. It does not allow you to make phone calls or send texts you have composed.

- **Wix Business Phone Number** can be used for both phone calls and texts. The texts that you send are composed and sent by you. It does not support sending automated SMS reminders or confirmations.

Both services provide you with a dedicated phone number for sending texts (and making calls with Business Phone Number). You can choose a number for your Wix SMS and a number for your Business Phone Number when you set these up.

For more details on the plans available, you can check the [SMS plans](https://manage.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?siteType=HtmlWeb&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/wix-sms/purchase?&title=Select%20a%20site&buttonText=Go+to+SMS+Plans) and [Business Phone Number plans](https://support.wix.com/en/article/business-phone-number-upgrading-your-plan).

question: What does the 'Could Not Determine the Prominent Video' error mean in Google Search Console, and how can I fix it?
answer:
The 'Could Not Determine the Prominent Video' error in the Video Indexing Report means that Google has found one or more videos on your page, but it can't determine which is the most important video. Some reasons for this error include:

* Your video is not immediately visible on your page, and your visitors need to scroll down to see it (also known as "below the fold")
* The size of your video is too small
* You have more than one video on the page
* You have a background video on your page

If you think that any of these issues apply to your video, it is recommended to fix the issue and then [request reindexing for the page](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/crawling/ask-google-to-recrawl).

question: How can I enable comments for all my blog posts on Wix?
answer:
To enable or disable commenting for all posts on your Wix blog, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Blog](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20My%20Blog&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/blog) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click the **More Actions** drop-down.
3. Click **Blog settings**.
4. Enable the **Comments** toggle.
5. Choose who can leave comments on your blog posts:
   
   * **Members only:** Only members can leave comments on your blog posts.
   * **Everyone:** Anyone that visits your site can leave a comment. 
     
     **Note:** You may see more spam with this option. This is why the ability to upload images within comments is limited to Members only.
6. Click the **Ratings** toggle:
   
   * **Enabled:** Visitors can leave a star rating when they leave a comment.
   * **Disabled:** Visitors cannot leave a star rating when they leave a comment.

**Tip:** Enable the comments counter in the Blog Feed Display settings to show the number of comments in your posts.
