question: How do I connect my Wix Hotels by HotelRunner account to Pitchup.com?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure all room rates and availability are set on the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
- Update your rooms with 2 weeks of rates and availability.
- Ensure your account on Pitchup.com is active, and the room types are created and updated for at least three months.

### To approve Wix Hotels by HotelRunner for connection on Pitchup.com:
1. Log in to the Pitchup.com extranet with your username and password.
2. Click **Bookings** in the menu at the top.
3. In the Integration section on the right, click **Get API key**.
4. Copy and paste the **API key (other booking systems)**.
5. [Go to the Channel Manager](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1a6e0874-2039-49cf-bef3-9138bb5c3b16%7C4%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Channel+Manager) in your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
6. Click **Connect** next to Pitchup.com.
7. Enter your **Pitchup.com API Key** in the **Hotel ID** field.
8. Click **Save and Continue**.

### To map your room types:
1. Collect your room IDs on the Pitchup.com extranet in **Room Details** under **Property**.
2. In another tab on your browser, go to [Channel Manager](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%2Fapp%2F826670ba-3a6b-4157-ac72-7c4fca9ce220%2F1a6e0874-2039-49cf-bef3-9138bb5c3b16%7C4%3F&title=Select+a+site&primaryButtonText=Open+Channel+Manager) in the Wix Hotels by HotelRunner dashboard.
3. Click **View channel details** next to Pitchup.com.
4. Click **Fetch room types**.
5. Hover over each room type and click **Expand**.
6. Match your Pitchup.com room types with your room types on Wix Hotels by HotelRunner using the drop-downs.
7. Click **Save** at the bottom.

### Activate the Pitchup.com connection
After completing your room mapping, click **Activate**. Once the Pitchup.com connection is complete, all your inventory (rates, availability, and restrictions) on your Wix Hotels by HotelRunner calendar will be transferred to your Pitchup.com account.

question: Why does my mobile live site load zoomed in or out on my Android device using Chrome?
answer:
We are aware of an issue on specific Android devices where mobile live sites are loading zoomed in or zoomed out when using the Chrome browser. This is caused by an issue on Chrome browser’s side.

### Workaround
In Chrome, the site is dependent on the font size chosen in the operating system accessibility settings of the device itself. Therefore, please check the accessibility settings of the mobile device you are using and, depending on the issue you are experiencing, proceed with one of the following options:

* **For zoomed in mobile live site** → decrease the font size.
* **For zoomed out mobile live site** → increase the font size.

In addition, please make sure that you are using the latest version of the Chrome app.

### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to the Wix Editor and the relevant page where you want to add the Facebook Comments box.

### Step 1 | Add a Facebook Comments box
To get started, add a comments box to your page. Each box is connected to the page you add it to, so you can create as many as you need.

#### To add a comment box:
1. Open the relevant page in your Editor.
2. Click **Add Elements** ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/11/75df84b3-7efb-4be9-8fea-7e94666ef748.png).
3. Click **Social**.
4. Click **Facebook**.
5. Drag the **Facebook Comments** element onto your page.

### Step 2 | Change the Facebook Comment box settings
After you've added a Comments box, choose its look and behavior. You can set how many comments are displayed, and change the color of comment text.

#### To change the settings:
1. Click the Facebook Comments element in your Editor.
2. Click the Settings icon ![](https://d2eyqiy4n03ve6.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/2015/08/10/e36bce07-9d38-4317-97a3-dfb354b12a44.png).
3. Choose how you want to adjust the box:
   * **No. of comments to show**: Use the slider to change the number of comments displayed on your site. Alternatively, enter a number directly into the box.
   * **Text color:** Set whether the comment text is light or dark.

### Step 3 | Moderate Facebook comments
Add your Facebook username to your site's settings in order to monitor your followers' comments. Adding your username can also prevent errors when using the Comments box, and other related elements (such as Facebook Like).

#### To moderate your Facebook comments:
1. Add your Facebook username to Wix:
   1. Go to [your site's settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/settings).
   2. Click **Website Settings**.
   3. Enter your username into the **Facebook username** field.
   4. Click **Save**.
   5. Publish your site from the Editor.
2. Moderate your comments:
   1. Open your live site, and navigate to the relevant page.
   2. Click **Moderation Tool** to open Facebook's Developers page.
   3. Moderate each comment as needed.

### Important
Facebook Comments are page specific. Each Facebook Comments box that you add to your site is connected to the page that it was added to. Therefore, if your visitor commented on one page of your Wix site, the comment will only appear on that page.

question: How can I effectively use keywords on my website to improve SEO according to the article?
answer:
To effectively use keywords on your website and improve SEO, follow these best practices:

- **Incorporate Keywords Organically:** Your keywords should appear throughout the content of your site. Use these words in your site's text in an organic way, keeping them in their correct context.

- **Add Valuable Content:** If you feel that a certain search phrase cannot be mentioned any more in your site content (organically), try adding more content to your site. Make sure that these additions contribute something of value to your site visitors.

- **Choose Relevant Keywords:** Use keywords and search phrases that you want search engines to relate to your site. Also, use keywords and search phrases that you think your site's potential visitors are entering in search engines to find you, your company, or the service you provide.

- **Limit Search Phrase Length:** Each search phrase should be between 1 to 4 words.

- **Consider Competition:** Consider the amount of competition for a given keyword or search phrase and try to use specific and unique phrases. For example:
  - Broad terms with high competition for ranking: Jaguar, Car, California Dealerships
  - More specific terms: Bob's Jaguar Dealership: Jaguar Dealership in East Bakersfield

- **Optimize Content:** Make the most of your content by using keywords and search phrases that contribute to your SEO.

### Important
Any edits or changes to your site must be crawled again by search engines before they appear in search results. If you want to try to speed up the process, you can [submit your page's URL to search engines](https://support.wix.com/en/article/submitting-your-sitemap-and-urls-directly-to-search-engines#submitting-individual-urls-to-search-engines).

### Tip
- You can learn more about choosing keywords in [this SEO Learning Hub video](https://www.wix.com/seo/learn/resource/what-are-keywords-and-how-to-choose-the-right-ones?utm_source=kb).
- You can also use [Wix's keyword research tool](https://support.wix.com/en/article/using-keyword-research-tools-to-optimize-your-sites-seo) to find strong keywords to help your site rank higher in search results.

question: How can I copy and paste content between collections in the CMS, and what should I be aware of regarding content type mismatches?
answer:
In the CMS, you can copy and paste items and fields within collections and between collections. This includes copying and pasting from external sources such as Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel. 

To copy and paste content:

1. Click and drag to select the fields you want.
2. Copy them using **Ctrl** + **C** (or **⌘** + **C** on Mac).
3. Click where you want the cells to appear.
4. Paste them using **Ctrl** + **V** (or **⌘** + **V** on Mac).

### Note
When pasting content between collections or other sources, make sure the content type matches the field type you are pasting into. If you try to paste different content types into a collection, you'll see a warning message. If you paste anyway, a **Warning** icon appears in each field where the content does not match the field type. Hover over the icon for more information about the mismatch.

question: How can I set up a custom fulfillment service in my Wix store to handle orders?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure you have access to your Wix site's dashboard.

### Step 1 | Add and set up a fulfillment service
1. [Go to the fulfillment services](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Fulfillment&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list/fulfillment-services) settings in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add Fulfiller**.
3. Enter the service name (seen only by you).
4. Enter the email address (orders are sent to this address).
5. Select the action that triggers sending a store order to the fulfiller.
6. Click **Save & Continue**.

### Step 2 | Select which products are fulfilled by the service
1. If not already on the **Assign products to fulfiller** page:
   1. [Go to the fulfillment services](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Fulfillment&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/store/shipping-and-tax/list/fulfillment-services) settings in your site's dashboard.
   2. Click **Assign Products**.
2. Depending on the products you want to assign, follow the steps:
   * **Assign individual products to a service:** Click the **Fulfillment service** drop-down next to a product and select a fulfiller.
   * **Assign multiple products at once:**
     1. Select which products you want to assign:
        + **All products:** Select the checkbox at the top left.
        + **Individual products:** Select or deselect the checkboxes next to products.
     2. Click the **Choose Services** drop-down and select a fulfiller.
3. Click **Done**.

### Step 3 | Set fulfillment for new products
1. [Go to Products](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Products&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https:%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Fdashboard%2F%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D%2Fstore%2Fproducts%3FreferralInfo%3Dsidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Create a new physical product or edit an existing one.
3. Scroll down to the **Advanced** section on the right.
4. Click the **Fulfilled by** drop-down and select a fulfiller.

question: How can I schedule a multi-service appointment for my clients using Wix Bookings?
answer:
To schedule a multi-service appointment for clients in your Booking Calendar, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Booking Calendar](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Open%20Booking%20Calendar&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/scheduler/owner/calendar?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add** at the top right, or click to select a time slot on the calendar.
3. Select **Appointment**.
4. Enter the **Client name**. 

   **Note:** For new clients, enter their name and then click **+ Add [New client name] to contacts**. You can then enter their email and phone number to finish creating the new contact.
5. Click **Continue**.
6. Click to select the first service.
7. Select the relevant day from the **Date** drop-down calendar.
8. Select the relevant start time in the **Arrival time** field.
9. Leave the **Repeats** checkbox unchecked. When you add multiple services to an appointment you cannot [create a recurring session](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-scheduling-recurring-appointments).
10. Choose where the appointment takes place from the **Location** drop-down. This is only relevant if you offer services in different locations.
11. Click **+ Add Another Service**.
12. Hover over the relevant service and click **Select**.
13. (Optional) Repeat steps 11-12 to add more services. 

   **Tip:** When you click any of the services in the Booking Calendar, you can see the number of bookings within the same order.
14. (Optional) Click the **Edit** icon next to the relevant service to modify it:

    1. Edit any of the following details:
       * **Session starts:** Select the start time of the appointment.
       * **Duration:** Select how long the session will last.
       * **Staff member:** Choose the relevant staff member in charge of the appointment. 

         **Note:** If the selected staff member is not available at the specific date or time, a yellow scheduling conflict notification appears. You can still book the appointment and make the necessary arrangements with your staff.
       * **Payment options:** Choose how or when your client will be charged, depending on which payment plan.
    2. Click **Save**.
    3. Repeat this step for each service you need to edit.
15. Choose what you want to do:

    * **Book:** Click **Book** to finish scheduling the session without collecting payment up front.
    * **Book & Collect Payment:** Click **Book & Collect Payment** to finish scheduling the session and collect payment. This takes you to the Orders tab in the dashboard. Choose an option from the **Collect Payment** drop-down on the Orders page.

Yes. If you have Photo Albums Store on your site, you can continue to use it the same way. You can still add new albums, manage your store and accept orders. [Order a Print](https://www.orderaprint.com/wix-photo-albums) will remain responsible for fulfilling and shipping orders as normal. If you have questions/concerns around the order status or quality of your prints, contact Order a Print directly:

- **Website:** [https://www.orderaprint.com/wix-photo-albums](https://www.orderaprint.com/wix-photo-albums)
- **Email:** support@orderaprint.com

question: How can I manually add a reservation in the original Wix Hotels?
answer:
To manually add reservations in the original Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

1. [Go to your dashboard.](https://support.wix.com/en/article/accessing-your-sites-dashboard)
2. Click the **Hotels** tab.
3. Click the **Reservations** tab.
4. Click **New Reservation**.
5. Click the **Reservation Status** drop-down menu and select a reservation type. 
   * **Reserved**: This booking is to reserve a room.
   * **Checked In**: The guests have checked in.
   * **Checked Out**: The guests have checked out.
   * **Not Available**: This room is not available.
6. Enter the booking details (Check in, Check Out, etc.)
7. Enter the guest details (First Name, Last Name, Phone Number, etc.). **Note**: Payment details will display after selecting your Room and Room Type.
8. Click **Save**.

**Tip**: You can also manually add a reservation by selecting dates on the calendar and clicking **Create Reservation**.

question: How do I connect Printify to my Wix Store?
answer:
To connect Printify to your Wix Store, follow these steps:

1. Go to the Wix App Market in your Editor:
   * **Wix Editor:** Click **Add Apps** on the left side of the Editor.
   * **Editor X:** Click **App Market** at the top of Editor X.
2. Start typing **Printify** in the search box and select it.
3. Click **+Add**.
4. Click **Allow and Install**.
5. Select an option:
   * Sign up to create a new Printify account
   * Log in to an existing Printify account
6. (For new accounts) Follow the instructions in the email you received to confirm your email address.
7. Go to the [Printify dashboard](https://printify.com/app/welcome).
8. Click the **Profile** icon at the top right.
9. Select **My Account**.
10. Click **My Stores**.
11. Click **Add new store**.
12. Click **Connect** next to **Wix**.
13. If you have more than one Wix site, click **Select** next to the site you want to connect.
14. Click **Allow and Install**.
15. From the **Select store that you want to connect to** drop-down, select the Printify store you want to connect to your Wix site, and click **Continue**.

**Tip:** If you just created your Printify account, your default store is named "My new store".

question: How do I publish my site using the Wix Editor?
answer:
To publish your site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Publish** at the top right of the editor.
2. (Optional) Click **View Site** to see your live site.
3. Click **Done** to return to the editor.

**Note:** Clicking **Save** won't make your changes live. After saving, make sure to click **Publish** to show the updates on your live site.

question: What should I do if my email campaign sample fails when sending to a new contact list?
answer:
If your email campaign sample fails, you should:

1. **Make sure that your list contains only valid addresses.** Once the emails are validated, make sure you're only adding valid contacts before you send out a new campaign. Any invalid contacts must be removed from your [Contact list](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Contact%20List&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/contacts/).

   **Tip:** Additionally make sure you only send your emails to contacts who have given you their consent, using a [subscribe form](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-forms-adding-and-setting-up-a-subscribe-form).

2. **When your list is ready, try sending your email campaign again.**

question: Can I hide the Agenda filters on the Wix Member Apps?

However, in your editor, [you can select which filters you want members to see](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-customizing-your-booking-calendar-page#choosing-which-elements-to-display-on-the-booking-calendar-page).

question: How can I generate more traffic to my Wix site?
answer:
To generate more traffic to your Wix site, consider the following strategies:

1. **Share your site on social media:** Add any of the [social sharing buttons](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-editor-getting-more-shares-for-your-site) available in the Editor, open your live site and share it with your friends. Ask your friends to reshare so that you get even more views.

2. **Promote your site using Wix Email Marketing:** [Create an email campaign](https://support.wix.com/en/article/email-marketing-creating-a-new-campaign) announcing your site and send it to all of your subscribers. You can use Wix Email Marketing to promote special offers on your site, or simply to let your friends know about it.

3. **Get a personal campaign manager for your business:** Let a specialist run targeted ads for you on Facebook and Google. Your personal campaign manager will also offer monthly phone consultations and fine tune your site to boost conversions. [Learn more](https://www.wix.com/marketplace/hire/marketing-promoting/seo-services)

4. **Add a third-party app from the Wix App Market:** We have a number of apps available in the Wix App Market which help generate traffic to your site. Check out the following apps:
   - [GetTraffic](https://support.wix.com/en/article/third-party-app-gettraffic-by-infolinks-media)
   - [Site Booster](https://support.wix.com/en/article/third-party-app-site-booster-by-appsharp)
   - [Rabbit SEO](https://support.wix.com/en/article/third-party-app-rabbit-seo-by-seo-tools)
   - [rankingCoach SEO](https://support.wix.com/en/article/third-party-app-rankingcoach-seo-by-rankingcoach)

### Tip
- Need help getting your site found in search results? Check out Wix [SEO Setup Checklist](https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-your-online-presence-with-the-wix-seo-setup-checklist) for a step-by-step plan designed to help improve your site's SEO.
- Take a look at this [blog post](https://www.wix.com/blog/2016/12/free-places-to-promote-your-website/) for more ideas on how to promote your site.

question: How can I add a new staff member to my Wix Bookings site using the dashboard?
answer:
To add a new staff member to your Wix Bookings site using the dashboard, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Staff](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Staff&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/bookings/staff?referralInfo=sidebar) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **+Add Staff**.
3. Enter the staff member's basic details including their full name, a description of their role, their email address, phone number, and a profile picture. 

   **Note:** Make sure you have permission to use staff members’ personal details and image.
4. Add the staff member's **Staff settings**:
   
   * **Booking permissions:** Click **Give Permissions** to allow the staff member to view their personal booking calendar, and to manage their own clients and sessions. [Learn more about giving staff permissions in Wix Bookings](https://support.wix.com/en/article/adding-staff-permissions-in-wix-bookings).
   * **Personal calendar syncing (requires booking permissions):** Click **Invite to Sync Calendar** to allow the staff member to sync their personal and work calendars. The staff member must have the relevant permissions (see **Booking permissions** above).
   * **Video conferencing account:** Click **Add Individual Account** to override the default video conferencing account for your site and add the staff member's personal account. Choose between adding Zoom or a custom video conferencing account. [Learn more about managing multiple video conferencing accounts](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-advanced-video-conferencing-for-online-services).
5. (Optional) Click **Add Working Hours** to [customize the staff member's working hours](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-editing-your-staff-members-working-hours).
6. Click **Save**.

Note: If you added the [Staff Widget](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-bookings-adding-and-customizing-a-staff-widget-on-your-site) to your site, visitors will see your staff members' working hours in the widget.

question: Can I create discounts that apply only to specific product variants in Wix Stores?
answer:
Currently, it's not possible to create coupons or automatic discounts that apply only to a specific variant of a product. For example, if you have a ring that comes in gold and silver, you can't create a discount that applies only to the silver variant.

### Workaround
Sell your product variants as separate products and create discounts for the relevant product. For example, instead of selling the gold and silver rings as variants, you can create them as 2 separate products.

question: What should I do if I want to sell a new product that might be prohibited by my payment provider?
answer: If you decide to begin selling a new product, we recommend you check your payment provider's Terms of Service before you begin selling the item. If the products are prohibited, you’ll need to select a different payment provider that supports those products, or remove them from sale. For Wix Payments users, check our list of [Wix Payments restricted and prohibited goods and services](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-payments-prohibited-products-and-services). For users of other payment providers, you need to check with your individual provider for their list of prohibited items.

question: Can I create a negative balance invoice for refunded or returned products or services in Wix?
answer:
Currently, it's not possible to create a negative balance invoice when crediting a customer account to correct a payment error or for a product/service that was refunded or returned (e.g. refunded store orders, items returned by your customer). 

While you can't issue an invoice reflecting a refund, you can [issue a refund through Wix Payments](https://support.wix.com/en/article/refunding-customers-in-wix-payments).

question: How can I delete a field from my CMS collection without causing issues on my site?
answer:
To delete a field from your CMS collection, follow these steps:

1. [Go to CMS](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20CMS&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/%7B%7BmetaSiteId%7D%7D/database/) in your site's dashboard. Alternatively, you can click **CMS** in [your editor](https://manage.wix.com/account/site-selector/?actionUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wix.com%2Feditor%2F%7BmetaSiteId%7D%3FeditorSessionId%3D%7Besi%7D%26), then click **Your Collections**.
2. Click the relevant collection.
3. Click **Manage Fields**.
4. Hover over the relevant field and click the **More Actions** icon.
5. Click **Delete**.
6. Click the **Yes, delete field** checkbox then click **Delete**.

Before deleting, ensure the field is not used in any datasets, SEO settings, or connected page elements to avoid breaking connections. You cannot delete a field if it's used in the dynamic page's [URL slug structure](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-creating-unique-dynamic-page-urls). If you're unsure if a field is in use, you can [hide it from your collection view](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-hiding-sorting-and-filtering-fields-in-your-collection-view) instead of deleting it. If you accidentally delete a field, you can [use backups to restore the collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-formerly-content-manager-backing-up-your-collections).

question: How can I set up my Wix site to display user-submitted feedback to everyone, but only allow members to submit it?
answer:
To display user-submitted feedback to everyone while only allowing members to submit it, you need to configure both collection permissions and dataset modes as follows:

**For the collection permissions:**
- Set **Custom** permissions for your Comments collection.
- Select **View** next to **Everyone** to allow anyone to read the comments on the live site.
- Select **Add** next to **Members only** to restrict comment submissions to site members.
- Optionally, select **Update** next to **Item's creator** if you want the member who submitted a comment to be able to edit their own comment after submitting it. Learn how to [change your collection's permissions](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-changing-your-collection-permissions).

**For the dataset modes:**
- **The dataset that connects to your custom form:** Set the dataset mode to **Write**.
- **The dataset that connects to the element that displays the comments:** Set the dataset mode to **Read**.

**Note:** Alternatively, you could connect both your custom form and the element you use to display the comments to the same dataset. Then, choose the **Read & Write** dataset mode. This would allow the input elements that make up your custom form to 'write' to your collection. Meanwhile, the repeater, table, or text element used to show the comments would be able to 'read' the collection content and display it.

question: How can I add and customize a text mask element in Wix Editor?
answer:
To add a text mask element in Wix Editor, follow these steps:

1. Open the relevant page in your Editor.
2. Click **Add Elements**.
3. Click **Text**.
4. Click **Text Mask**.
5. Drag a text mask design you like onto your page.

**Tip:** Some of our designs include a video background. Hover over a design to see it in action.

Once you've added your text mask element, you can customize it by changing the text, resizing, and designing it:

### To change the text:
1. Click the text mask element in your Editor.
2. Click **Change Text**.
3. Enter your text under **Add your own text**.

**Note:** The text saves automatically.

### To resize a text mask:
1. Click the element in your Editor.
2. Drag the handles around the element to make it bigger or smaller.

### To design a text mask:
1. Click the text mask element in your Editor.
2. Click the Design icon.
3. Choose how you want to design your text mask:

#### Customize the Fill
1. Click the Fill icon.
2. In the **Media** tab, click **Change Media**.
3. Drag the slider to adjust the opacity of the media fill.
4. (Optional) Enable the **Apply Color Overlay** toggle to add a layer of color on top of the background.
5. Scroll up and click the **Gradient** tab.
6. Click the Change Gradient box next to the slider.
7. Choose the type of gradient you want from the dropdown: Linear, Radial, or Conic.
8. Design your gradient by adjusting the colors, angle, and focal point.
9. Click the Fluid Gradient icon at the top.
10. Design your gradient by adjusting the colors and setting the size and spread of each color.

#### Format the Text
1. Click the Text icon.
2. **Font:** Choose a different font from the drop-down.
3. **Styles:** Make your text bold, italicized, underlined, or add a strike through.
4. **Alignment & formatting:** Align your text to the left, center, or right, and choose your text direction.
5. **Capitalization:** Choose how you want to capitalize your text.
6. **Character spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of spacing between each character.
7. **Line Spacing:** Drag the slider to adjust the amount of spacing between each line.
8. **Choose HTML tag:** Choose the relevant tag for your text (e.g. H1, P) to improve your accessibility and SEO.

#### Define the Shadow
1. Click the **Apply shadow** toggle to enable it.
2. Click the wheel to adjust the angle of the shadow, or enter the angle degree in the box.
3. **Distance:** Change the amount of distance between the text and the shadow.
4. **Blur:** Make your shadow more or less blurry, depending on what you like.
5. **Opacity and color:** Adjust the opacity and color of your shadow.

question: Can visitors sort live site collection content connected to the CMS?
answer: Currently, it is not possible to provide a way for visitors to sort live site content that is connected to the CMS. However, with Velo, it is possible to give visitors the ability to sort live site content. To do so, add the action event handler (e.g. [dropdown onChange](https://dev.wix.com/docs/develop-websites/articles/coding-with-velo/backend-code/events/reacting-to-user-actions-using-events#adding-an-event-handler-to-an-element)) and within it, use the [setSort() function](https://www.wix.com/velo/reference/wix-dataset/dataset/setsort) for the dataset connected to the displayed content.

question: Can I choose to send notifications only for specific blog posts on Wix?
answer: Currently, every time you publish your blog posts, your subscribers/members are notified. It is not possible to choose if you want to send a notification for all newly published posts or just specific ones.

question: Can I show an element on some pages of my Wix site and not others?

Then, follow the instructions [here](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-tutorial-hiding-an-element-on-certain-pages) to learn how to hide an element from specific pages.

question: How can I set up a delivery area for DoorDash Drive in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have set up an online payment method.
- Enable tips for online orders.

### To set up a DoorDash Drive delivery area:
1. Go to [Order Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Order%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/restaurants/ordersSettings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Delivery & Delivery Partners**.
3. Click **+ New Area**.
4. (Optional) Enter a minimum order amount for this area.
5. Click the **Delivery method** drop-down and select **DoorDash Drive for Restaurants**.
6. (Optional) Click the **Cover part of the delivery fee** checkbox to pay part of the delivery fee that DoorDash charges your customers and enter the amount you want to cover.
7. Under **Pickup instructions**, enter instructions for the DoorDash courier.
8. Under **Maximum Delivery Time**, enter an estimate of how long it should take from the time you receive an order until your customers receive it (i.e. prep time + delivery time).
9. (Optional) Click the Edit icon under **Availability** to edit your delivery hours. Then click **Apply**. **Note:** You can also temporarily make this delivery unavailable by disabling the **Availability** toggle.
10. Click **Save**.
11. If you have more than one location, you can repeat the steps above to set up additional delivery areas.
12. (Recommended) Place a test order with delivery DoorDash to make sure delivery works smoothly.

question: How can I format text in the Wix Editor to make it stand out and improve its readability?
answer:
To format your text in the Wix Editor and make it stand out, follow these steps:

1. **Highlight the text** you want to format.
2. Click **Edit Text**.
3. Use the following tools to format your text:
   
   - **Theme**: Click the **Theme** drop-down and select a theme. Customize the theme using the formatting tools, then click **Save Theme** to save the changes.
   - **Font**: Click the **Font** drop-down and choose a font. You can also upload your own fonts and add language fonts.
   - **Font Size**: Click the **Font Size** drop-down and set the size. You can enter values between 6 to 999 px.
   - **Bold**: Click the Bold icon to bold the text.
   - **Italicize**: Click the Italics icon to italicize the text.
   - **Underline**: Click the Underline icon to underline the text.
   - **Color**: Click the Color icon and select a color to change the text color.
   - **Highlight**: Click the Highlight icon and select a color to add a background color to the text.
   - **Link Text**: Click the Link icon to choose the link destination and enter the link details.
   - **Align**: Click the Alignment icon to align your text to the left, center, or right, or justify it across the textbox.
   - **Bullets & numbering**: Click the Bullets & numbering icon to create a bulleted or numbered list.
   - **Indent**: Click the Decrease indent icon or the Increase indent icon to change the size of the indent.
   - **Text Direction**: Click the Change text direction icon to change the direction of your text between left-to-right and right-to-left.
   - **Effects**: Click **Effects** and select one to add glow, blur, shadow, outline effects, and more.
   - **Character spacing**: Click **Character & line spacing** and set the amount of space between the characters.
   - **Line spacing**: Click **Character & line spacing** and set the line spacing or select **Automatic** to automatically fill the text box.
   - **Vertical text**: Click **Vertical text** and the **Enable vertical text** toggle to flip your text.
   - **SEO & accessibility**: Click **Choose HTML tag** and select one from the drop-down to use HTML tags for SEO and accessibility.

### Notes
- You cannot link text that spans over two paragraphs unless you use **Shift** + **Enter** to create the line space instead of Enter.
- You can remove the underline of hyperlinked text by selecting the linked text and clicking the **Underline** icon.
- Wix has licenses for the fonts in the Editor, available for digital use ONLY within your Wix site. For more information, view the [Wix Terms of Use](http://www.wix.com/about/terms-of-use).

question: How can I change my Wix Premium or Studio plan if the 'Change Plan' button is not available?
answer:
If you are unable to change your plan using the standard steps, you can use the following workaround. These steps are complex, so keep this page open in a separate tab for reference. To summarize, you will be canceling your plan's auto-renewal, duplicating your site, signing up for a new plan (the one you want to change to), then applying your new subscription to your original site.

**Important:** Canceling your plan's auto-renewal means that your old plan will remain active until the end of the subscription period. If you cancel your plan after your [14-day refund period](https://support.wix.com/en/article/requesting-a-refund-for-a-premium-plan), both subscriptions will overlap, and you won't receive a credit for the remainder of your old plan.

1. **Cancel the plan that you want to change:**
   
   1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
   2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the relevant plan.
   3. Click **Cancel Plan**.
   4. Click **Cancel Now**.
   5. Enter the reason for cancellation and click **Cancel Now**.

2. **Duplicate the site that the plan is assigned to:**
   
   1. Go to your [site's dashboard](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
   2. Click the **Site Actions** drop-down.
   3. Click **Duplicate Site**.
   4. Enter a name for the duplicate site.
   5. Click **Duplicate**.

3. **Reassign the canceled plan to the duplicate site:**
   
   1. Go to [Premium Subscriptions](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController?originWidgetName=billings) in your Wix account.
   2. Select the canceled plan.
   3. Click **Assign to a different site** next to **Assigned to:**.
   4. Click **Assign** next to the duplicate site.

4. **Upgrade the original site to the plan of your choice:**
   
   1. Go to the [dashboard of the original site](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Dashboard&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/home/).
   2. Click **Upgrade** at the top of the dashboard.
   3. Click **Select** under the plan you want to purchase.
   4. Follow the steps to complete the purchase.

5. **Assign your domain back to your original site:**
   
   1. Go to the [Domains](https://premium.wix.com/wix/api/mpContainerStaticController#/domains?connectSiteToSingleDomain=true) page.
   2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the domain you want to reassign.
   3. Click **Assign to a site.**
   4. Select the site you wish to assign the domain to (your original site, not the duplicate).
   5. Click **Next**.
   6. Click **Assign**.

question: Can I get a refund for my Wix domain purchase if I change my mind within 14 days?
answer: Wix domain purchases are separate from Premium or Studio site plan purchases, and therefore do **not** have a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you feel that you deserve a refund, see [further information about refunds](https://www.wix.com/refund/). Alternatively, you can [contact Customer Care](https://www.wix.com/contact) to tell us why and we will review your request. If you no longer wish to keep the domain you purchased, you can cancel your subscription by [turning off the auto renewal process](https://support.wix.com/en/article/canceling-a-wix-domain). The domain will expire on the next renewal date.

question: How can I design a Ticket PDF for my Wix event?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Before you can design a Ticket PDF, you must [create a ticketed event](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-tickets-for-your-event).

### Step 1 | Access your ticketed event
To get started, access the relevant ticketed event. You can design a Ticket PDF for new events or update the ticket design for existing events.

#### To access your ticketed event:
1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage** next to the relevant event.
3. Click the **Tickets and Seating** tab.
4. Click **Edit** next to the ticket type.
5. Click **Design** under **Ticket PDF**.

### Step 2 | Design your Ticket PDF
Design a new event ticket or revamp an existing ticket with a fresh look. Start by selecting a template of your choice and choose what event information appears on the ticket. You can also customize the ticket background, style the text, and add your own logo to promote your business.

#### To design your Ticket PDF:
1. Click the tabs on the left to customize your Ticket PDF:
   - **Template**: Select a design that suits your event.
     1. Click **Templates**.
     2. Select the desired template.
   - **Display**: Choose what info you want the ticket to show.
     1. Click **Display**.
     2. Enable the toggle next to the info you want to show on the Ticket PDF (e.g. order number, QR code, Ticket & price).
   - **Text**: Customize the style of your event text in each of the four categories (e.g. event title, ticket details title, ticket details, and ticket policy).
     1. Click **Text**.
     2. Hover over the relevant text and click **Customize**.
     3. Choose what you want to customize and format your text (e.g. font, size, color).
   - **Image**: Add an image to showcase your event.
     1. Click **Image**.
     2. Upload your desired image.
     3. (Optional) Edit the image using the [Wix Photo Studio](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-media-about-the-wix-photo-studio).
   - **Logo**: Promote your brand by adding your own logo.
     1. Click **Logo.**
     2. Choose what to do next:
        * **Replace the existing logo:** Hover over the logo and click **Replace**. You can choose a new file from the Media Manager.
        * **Edit the existing logo:** Hover over the logo and click **Edit**. You can use the Wix Photo Studio to make adjustments.
        * **Create a logo:** Use the Wix [Logo Maker](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-logo-about-the-wix-logo-maker-2200409) to design your own logo.
   - **Dividers**: Customize the divider style and color.
     1. Click **Dividers**.
     2. Choose how to customize the divider:
        * **Select a different style:** Click any divider style to apply it.
        * **Change the color:** Click the color box and select the color you want.
        * **Change the size:** Set the size of the divider.
   - **Background**: Pick a color or upload an image for the background of your ticket.
     1. Click **Background**.
     2. Choose how to customize the background:
        * **Change the color:** Click the color box and select the color you want.
        * **Add an image:** Click the Add icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/e9471e96-8e0a-4ac1-9fa6-02e99938bd27/2023/04/27/dd1f66da-e37c-43b2-bddf-9cf947cb743f/03efe3b3-ca39-4b2c-bfc0-764073f15826.jpg) below **Upload image**, then (in the Media Manager) select or upload your image.
        * **Opacity:** Drag the slider to change the transparency of the ticket color.

### Step 3 | Apply your design to the Ticket PDF
Once you've designed your ticket, click **Apply** at the top right. Then, click **Back to Events** at the top left to edit any necessary ticket information.

#### Note
For existing events, new guests purchasing tickets get the updated ticket design, while current ticket holders keep their original ticket.

#### Preview how your ticket looks
1. [Go to Events](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Events&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/events/) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Manage** next to the relevant event.
3. Click the **Tickets** tab.
4. Click **Edit** next to the ticket type.
5. Click **Preview** under Ticket PDF.

question: What is the chargeback ratio threshold for merchants using Wix Payments, and what happens if it is exceeded?
answer: The industry standard chargeback ratio threshold is under 1% (i.e. less than 1 chargeback per 100 payments). Generally, receiving a chargeback demand during your first month selling in Wix Payments is not a good indication. Neither is maintaining a high chargeback ratio after three months of business. As a merchant, keep in mind that the more chargebacks you receive, the riskier Wix Payments considers your business to be, which may lead to closing your account, withholding your payouts and other risk preventing measures.

question: How can I add and customize an Accordion element in the Studio Editor?
answer:
To add an Accordion element in the Studio Editor, follow these steps:

1. Click **Add Elements** on the left side of the editor.
2. Click **Layout Tools**.
3. Click **Accordions**.
4. Drag an Accordion you like onto your page.
5. Edit the content of the Accordion items:
   
   1. Select the Accordion element you just added.
   2. Click **Manage Items**.
   3. Click the item you want to edit. 
      
      **Tip:** This opens the item on the canvas so you can see what it currently shows.
   4. Add the relevant elements and information to your item.

To manage Accordion items:

1. Select the Accordion element.
2. Click **Manage Items**.
3. Hover over the item and click the **More Actions** icon.
4. Choose what to do with this Accordion item: **Duplicate**, **Rename** or **Delete**.

**Tips:**
- Click **Add Item** at the bottom of the panel to add a new blank item.
- You can change the order of your items. Hold the **Reorder** icon next to an item and drag it to the desired location.

To choose how the Accordion opens and closes:

1. Select the Accordion element.
2. Click the **Settings** icon.
3. Select an option under **Choose the default state**:
   
   * **All items closed:** Visitors first see the Accordion items closed. They choose which item to expand to read more.
   * **First item opened:** Visitors see the content of the top item while the other items are closed.
   * **All items opened:** Visitors see the content of all items when the page loads.
4. Click the **Allow multiple open items** toggle:
   
   * **Enabled:** Visitors can have as many open items as they like in the accordion.
   * **Disabled:** Visitors can only open one item at a time.
5. (Optional) Apply a transition effect that appears when visitors click an item to open it.

**Note:** The option to allow multiple items open in the Accordion is not available if you choose **All items opened** as the default state.

To design an Accordion:

1. Select the Accordion element.
2. Click the **Open Inspector** icon at the top right of the editor.
3. Choose what you want to design from the drop-down:
   
   * **Titles:** These are the titles of your items. You can design the titles to look different when visitors hover over them.
   * **Containers:** These are the containers that show the content of each item.
   * **Accordion items:** This controls the entire space of an Accordion item (title and container included).
4. Use the available options to pick different backgrounds, fonts, corners, borders and more.

To adjust the Accordion layout:

1. Select the Accordion element.
2. Click the **Layout** icon.
3. Adjust the layout of the Accordion element:
   
   * **Choose an icon:** Select the icon that appears next to your item titles: **Arrow** or **Plus**.
   * **Icon position:** Decide if the icon appears to the left or right of your titles.
   * **Title padding:** Drag the sliders to add horizontal and vertical padding around the item titles.

**Tip:** You can [apply a CSS grid](https://support.wix.com/en/article/studio-editor-working-with-an-advanced-css-grid) to every individual item to create your pixel perfect layout.

question: How can I update the og:image for my Wix site when sharing on LinkedIn?

question: How can I import reviews into Wix Reviews using a CSV file?
answer:
### Prerequisites
- Ensure you have downloaded the Wix CSV template file.

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### Step 1 | Download the Wix CSV template file
1. [Go to Reviews](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Wix%20Reviews&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/reviews) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Import Reviews**.
3. Click **Download Sample CSV.**
4. Open the CSV file. 
   - **Note:** Mac users should open the file with Numbers or Excel version 15 or higher.
5. Save the downloaded file in CSV (Comma delimited) format.

#### Step 2 | Add your reviews and upload the file

##### a | Add your reviews
1. Enter the data into the template using the guidelines in the table below.
2. Delete the rows of sample data so they won't be imported.
3. Save the file in a CSV format.

| **Field** | **Instructions** |
| --- | --- |
| **created_at** | Any of the following formats are acceptable: mm/dd/yyyy, yyyy-mm-dd, Mth d, yyyy, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss |
| **customer_name** | Mandatory field. Max. 100 characters |
| **customer_email** | Mandatory field. Max. 320 characters |
| **rating** | Mandatory field. The accepted format is any whole number from 1 to 5. |
| **product_id** | Mandatory field. This field connects your review with the correct product. |

##### b | Upload the CSV file
1. [Go to Reviews](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Manage%20Wix%20Reviews&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/reviews/settings) in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Import Reviews** to go back to the popup.
3. Click **Upload CSV File**.
4. Upload the updated file you saved and click **Continue**.
   - **Tip:** You'll receive an import review showing how many reviews will be imported and listing rows which contain errors.
5. Do one of the following:
   - **No errors:** Click **Import Reviews** to complete the process.
   - **Products with errors:** If you have products with errors, you can either correct the errors and import again or import your products as is. If you go ahead and import without fixing errors, only products without errors are imported.

### Important
- Images may take up to 1 hour to upload if you have many reviews. You can continue to make changes while images upload in the background.

question: How can I verify my domain with Pinterest using a Wix site?

5. Click **Save**.

### Step 3 | Complete site verification on Pinterest

2. Click **Continue**.
3. Enter your website's URL in the field.
4. Click **Verify**.
5. Click **Done**.

question: What are spam traps and how can I avoid them in my email marketing campaigns?
answer:
A spam trap refers to email addresses that cannot receive emails. There are several types of spam traps, including misspelled email addresses, inactive email addresses, and non-existent email addresses. Internet Service Providers (ISPs) such as Gmail and Yahoo Mail, as well as anti-spam organizations, use the non-existent addresses to identify marketers who aren't following the email distribution regulations. If your recipient list includes non-existent or inactive addresses, it may be flagged as proof that your campaign is being sent to people who didn't give permission for you to contact them. It can also signify a purchased email list. Continuously sending campaigns to purchased email lists can lead to your Wix Email Marketing account being restricted. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/about-spam-traps)

The best way to avoid a spam trap is to make sure all your recipients have given you explicit permissions (i.e. through a subscriber signup form) to contact them. It's also important to go through your email list and 'clean it' by removing old email addresses. [Learn more](https://support.wix.com/en/article/improving-the-deliverability-of-your-campaign#tips-to-improve-your-email-deliverability)

question: How can I automatically generate invoices for online paid orders in Wix Restaurants?
answer:
To automatically generate an invoice for every order paid online in Wix Restaurants, follow these steps:

1. [Go to Checkout Settings](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Checkout%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/ecom-platform/checkout-settings) in your site's dashboard.

question: How can I add and customize a social bar on my site using ADI?
answer:
### Prerequisites
Ensure that you have access to the ADI Builder and your site is set up.

### Step 1 | Add a social bar
Most of our site templates already come with a social bar. If you need to, add the Social Bar app to your site.

#### To add a social bar:
1. Click **Add** on the top bar inside ADI.
2. Click **Apps**.
3. Hover over **Social Bar** and click **Add**.

### Step 2 | Add social network links to your social bar
Next, link your social bar icons to your social network accounts.

#### To add your social links to your social bar:
1. Click the social bar in the ADI Builder.
2. Hover over the social network you want to link to on the left and click the Edit icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/5c3e602a-8647-41f7-bb22-686374bf97ce/2022/05/30/17796703-9082-4d28-aaae-53ce1138cc85/c01da961-f35e-40c6-8950-be027c79961a.png).
3. Paste your social network link in the relevant field.

**Want to add more social network links?**
You can add additional social networks to the 3 existing networks (Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn). Just paste the link to your social network in the **Paste your link here field**, and the relevant icon is automatically added.

### Step 3 | Customize your social bar
Choose a design for your social bar to complement your site, and change its colors to make it stand out.

#### To customize your social bar:
1. Hover over the social bar in the ADI Builder and click **Social Bar**.
2. Customize the bar using the following options:
   * **Design:** Click **Design** and choose from 4 design options.
   * **Colors:** Click a color on the color palette to apply it to your social bar.

   **Tip:** Click **Edit site colors** to completely change the colors available for your social bar.

### Notes
Removing social links or hiding social icons does not delete the app from your site. Click the **Edit** icon on the social bar and click **Delete** to remove the social bar from your site.

question: How can I delete a staff member from Wix Bookings using the Wix app?
answer:
To delete a staff member from Wix Bookings using the Wix app, follow these steps:

1. Go to your site in the Wix app.
2. Tap **Manage** ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/8769cf44-f342-494c-b25f-cc98c9da3e82/2021/04/12/3fc0f98c-0997-47b3-b7bd-6ae31a67e078/ce9c0fe5-f60d-4448-8fc2-9ba4cf636f93.png) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down and tap **Settings**.
4. Tap **Booking Settings**.
5. Tap the **Staff** tab.
6. Tap the relevant staff member.
   ![A screenshot where to find staff in your Wix app.](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/e8d9ab8e-d3c2-427f-a4f2-1e90c04f91d4/2024/11/04/cb79f208-ed93-45ac-8109-6373b893d11d/98cfc844-b922-408f-969d-d99a68507401.png)

question: How can I add the WhatsApp channel to my Wix Chat chatbox?
answer:
To add the WhatsApp channel to your Wix Chat chatbox, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Channels](https://www.wix.com/my-account/site-selector/?buttonText=Go%20to%20Channel%20Settings&title=Select%20a%20Site&autoSelectOnSingleSite=true&actionUrl=https://www.wix.com/dashboard/{{metaSiteId}}/chat/channels/) tab in your Chat Settings.
2. Click the toggle next to WhatsApp to let visitors contact you via WhatsApp in your chatbox. 
   
   **Note:** Click **Get Started** if this is your first time setting up chat channels.
3. Enter your phone number in the **Your phone number (with country code)** field. This phone number should be the one linked to the WhatsApp account you'd like to use. 
   
   **Note:** Make sure you enter your phone number in full international format: a plus sign (\+) followed by the country code, city code and local phone number, e.g. \+1 408 XXX XXXX. Remember to remove any leading 0s.
4. (Optional) Enter an info message (e.g. availability hours) in the **WhatsApp info text** field. This message appears in your chatbox when visitors select 'WhatsApp' as their preferred chat method.
5. (Optional) Enter a default message in the **Pre-filled message** field. Visitors can edit or change this message before they send it to you.
6. Click **Save Changes** at the top right.
